options.C: Flush the pipes by a anti-virus fluid.

explanation: 【译文】Flush the pipes with a disinfectant solution.【词汇】flush…with=用…冲洗，disinfectant solution=消毒液，pipe=管子。【解析】A正确：flush with和disinfectant solution均为标准表达。B把disinfectant错换成virus solution（病毒溶液），消毒液变病毒液，含义适得其反。C把消毒液写成anti-virus fluid，且冠词a anti-virus应为an，属术语错译加语法错误。

question: 这种化合物能释放有毒的烟雾。

options.A: This compound can eliminate poisonous fumes.
options.B: This compound can release poisonous fumes.
options.C: This composite alloy can release poisonous fumes.

explanation: 【译文】This compound can release poisonous fumes.【词汇】compound=化合物，release=释放，poisonous fumes=有毒烟雾。【解析】B正确：compound、release、poisonous fumes三处关键词全部对应。A把release错换成eliminate（消除），“释放”与“消除”方向相反。C把compound错换成composite alloy（复合合金），材料类别张冠李戴，属词义错译。

question: 在两个螺栓的螺纹上涂抹少量机油。

options.A: Make a little oil to the threads of the two bolts.
options.B: Apply a small quantity of oil to the threads of the two bolts.
options.C: Apply a small quantity of oil to the threads of the two nuts.

explanation: 【译文】Apply a small quantity of oil to the threads of the two bolts.【词汇】apply…to=把…涂抹到，a small quantity of=少量，thread=螺纹，bolt=螺栓。【解析】B正确：apply…to是“涂抹”的标准结构，threads对应“螺纹”、bolts对应“螺栓”。A用“Make a little oil to”替代apply，动词误用导致语法不通。C把bolts错换成nuts（螺母），螺栓与螺母是配对但不同的紧固件，属张冠李戴。

question: 停止发动机启动程序。

options.A: Stop the engine run-up practice.
options.B: Stop the engine start procedure.
options.C: Stop the engine ignition project.

explanation: 【译文】Stop the engine start procedure.【词汇】engine start=发动机启动，procedure=程序，run-up=试车。【解析】B正确：engine start procedure为“发动机启动程序”的标准表达。A错换成run-up practice（试车练习），指暖机试车训练而非启动程序，张冠李戴。C把start换成ignition（点火）、procedure换成project（项目），两处错译，程序名称完全失真。

question: 压力值必须高于800千帕。

options.A: The temperature value must be more than 800 kPa.
options.B: The compression value must be more than 800 kPa.
options.C: The pressure value must be more than 800 kPa.

explanation: 【译文】The pressure value must be more than 800 kPa.【词汇】pressure=压力，more than=高于、大于，kPa=千帕。【解析】C正确：pressure准确对应“压力”，more than对应“高于”。A把pressure错换成temperature（温度），物理量张冠李戴。B错换成compression（压缩量/压紧），compression与pressure近义但指被压缩的状态或量，不能表示压力值，属词义错译。

question: 给出使用紧急出口的准确指示。

options.A: Give precise instructions for using emergency exits.
options.B: Give special directions for using urgent exits.
options.C: Give accurate data for using urgent exits.

explanation: 【译文】Give precise instructions for using emergency exits.【词汇】precise=准确的，instruction=指示，emergency exit=紧急出口。【解析】A正确：precise instructions对应“准确指示”，emergency exits为“紧急出口”标准术语。B两处错误：special（特别的）≠准确；urgent exits非规范术语，emergency exit才是“紧急出口”。C把instructions错换成data（数据），“给出数据”≠“给出指示”，且urgent exits同样不规范。

question: 为泄漏测试做准备。

options.A: Prepare for the built-in test.
options.B: Prepare for the leak test.
options.C: Prepare for the load test.

explanation: 【译文】Prepare for the leak test.【词汇】prepare for=为…做准备，leak test=泄漏测试，built-in test=机内自测。【解析】B正确：leak test为“泄漏测试”标准术语。A把leak错换成built-in（内置的），built-in test指机内自检测试，与泄漏测试是不同测试类型。C错换成load test（载荷测试），leak与load近形干扰，属词义错译。

question: 给电瓶充电。

options.A: Charge the battery.
options.B: Fill the battery.
options.C: Add the battery.

explanation: 【译文】Charge the battery.【词汇】charge=充电，battery=电瓶、电池。【解析】A正确：charge the battery为“给电瓶充电”的标准表达。B把Charge错换成Fill（加注、填充），加油加水可用fill，充电能只能用charge。C错换成Add（添加），同样不含“充入电能”之义，均属动词错译。

question: 计算电路中的电压。

options.A: Count the velocity in the circuit.
options.B: Compute the current in the route.
options.C: Calculate the voltage in the circuit.

explanation: 【译文】Calculate the voltage in the circuit.【词汇】calculate=计算，voltage=电压，circuit=电路。【解析】C正确：calculate、voltage、circuit三处关键词全部对应。A两处错误：count（计数）≠calculate（计算）；velocity（速度）与voltage近形但词义完全不同。B同样双错：current（电流）≠voltage；route（路线）与circuit（电路）近形干扰。

question: 下载文件，点击这里。

options.A: To download the file, click here.
options.B: To load the document, click here.
options.C: Tap here to get the document.

explanation: 【译文】To download the file, click here.【词汇】download=下载，file=文件，click here=点击这里。【解析】A正确：download对应“下载”、click here对应“点击这里”。B把download错换成load（加载），下载与加载是不同操作，且file换成document不如原词贴切。C三处偏离：click换成tap（轻触）、file换成document、download换成get，关键动词全部改变。

question: 告诉制造商这个问题。

options.A: Inform the administration of the problem.
options.B: Announce the problem to the operator.
options.C: Tell the manufacturer about the problem.

explanation: 【译文】Tell the manufacturer about the problem.【词汇】manufacturer=制造商，tell sb. about sth.=告诉某人某事，operator=运营人。【解析】C正确：manufacturer准确对应“制造商”，tell…about结构规范。A把manufacturer错换成administration（管理部门/局方），告知对象张冠李戴。B错换成operator（运营人/操作员），且announce（宣布）语气过重，不属于“告诉”。

question: 更换损坏的零件。

options.A: Remove the damaged parts.
options.B: Replace the damaged parts.
options.C: Repair the damaged parts.

explanation: 【译文】Replace the damaged parts.【词汇】replace=更换（以新换旧），damaged=损坏的，part=零件。【解析】B正确：replace准确对应“更换”。A用remove（拆除），只拆不换，漏译“换上新件”这一核心要素。C用repair（修理），修理旧件与更换新件是两种不同处置方式，属词义错译。

question: 飞行安全必须得到保证。

options.A: The aircraft safety should be ensured.
options.B: The flight safety must be assured.
options.C: The navigation safety must be insured.

explanation: 【译文】The flight safety must be assured.【词汇】flight safety=飞行安全，must=必须，assure/ensure=保证。【解析】B正确：flight、must、assured三处全对。A两处错误：flight换成aircraft（飞机），且should（应该）弱化了must（必须）的强制语气。C把flight错换成navigation（导航），且insured意为“投保”（保险），与ensure近形但词义完全不同。

question: 姿态指示仪指示飞机相对于地平线的姿态。

options.A: Altitude meter shows the aircraft altitude relative to the horizon.
options.B: Attitude meter shows the aircraft attitude relative to the horizon.
options.C: Altitude meter shows the aircraft altitude relative to the level.

explanation: 【译文】The attitude meter shows the aircraft attitude relative to the horizon.【词汇】attitude=姿态，altitude=高度（经典易混词），relative to=相对于，horizon=地平线。【解析】B正确：attitude（姿态）和horizon（地平线）全部对应。A把attitude错换成altitude（高度），attitude/altitude是经典形近易混词，高度表与姿态仪是两种仪表。C同样误用altitude，还把horizon换成level（水平面），两处偏离。

question: 泵安装在液压马达后面。

options.A: The pump is installed behind the hydraulic motor.
options.B: The gearbox is installed behind the pneumatic motor.
options.C: The  hydraulic motor is installed behind the pump.

explanation: 【译文】The pump is installed behind the hydraulic motor.【词汇】pump=泵，hydraulic motor=液压马达，behind=在…后面。【解析】A正确：pump和hydraulic motor均对应，behind方位关系正确。B两处错误：pump换成gearbox（齿轮箱），hydraulic换成pneumatic（气动的），动力类型张冠李戴。C主宾颠倒：译成“液压马达装在泵后面”，方位关系与原文完全相反。

question: 清洁轮子后，用压缩空气吹干。

options.A: When wheel is dried, clean with the compressed air.
options.B: When wheel is cleaned, dry with the compressed air.
options.C: When wheel is cleaned, dry with the impressed air.

explanation: 【译文】When the wheel is cleaned, dry it with the compressed air.【词汇】clean=清洁，dry=吹干，compressed air=压缩空气。【解析】B正确：先cleaned后dry的顺序与compressed air介质均对应题干“清洁后吹干”。A把条件与动作颠倒成“轮子干燥后再清洁”，时间顺序完全相反。C顺序虽对，但把compressed（压缩的）错写成impressed（印象深刻的），近形词导致语义不通。

question: 这个钢板长1.5米，厚3/8厘米。

options.A: The steel plate measures 1.5 metres long and 3/8 centimeter thick.
options.B: The steel plate measures 1.5 metres long and 3/8 decimeter thick.
options.C: The aluminum plate measures 1.5 metres long and 3/8 decimeter thick.

explanation: 【译文】The steel plate measures 1.5 metres long and 3/8 centimeter thick.【词汇】steel plate=钢板，measure=尺寸为，centimeter=厘米，decimeter=分米。【解析】A正确：steel和centimeter均准确对应。B把centimeter错换成decimeter（分米），1分米=10厘米，单位错译导致尺寸放大十倍。C两处错误：steel换成aluminum（铝），centimeter同样错成decimeter，材料与单位双错。

question: 定期检查仪表的准确性。

options.A: Timely check the instruments for accuracy.
options.B: Instuments shuld be periodically checked for accuracy.
options.C: Timely check the instruments if it is accurate.

explanation: 【译文】The instruments should be checked periodically for accuracy.【词汇】periodically=定期地，timely=及时地（易混），accuracy=准确性，check…for=检查…是否。【解析】B正确：periodically对应“定期”、for accuracy对应“准确性”，虽有Instuments/shuld两处拼写瑕疵，但为三项中唯一含义正确者。A用timely（及时地）替代periodically，检查频率概念错译。C既用timely，又把for accuracy错改成if it is accurate，语法不通且改变句式。

question: 故障代码中的第一对数字表示相应的ATA章。

options.A: ATA chapter is indicated by a pair of the digits of the first  fault code.
options.B: ATA chapter is indicated by latest pair of the digits of the fault code.
options.C: The first pair of the digits of fault code indicates the applicable ATA chapter.

explanation: 【译文】The first pair of the digits of the fault code indicates the applicable ATA chapter.【词汇】the first pair of digits=第一对数字，fault code=故障代码，indicate=表示，applicable=相应的。【解析】C正确：the first pair of digits对应“第一对数字”，applicable对应“相应的”，主谓结构与题干一致。A把first移位修饰fault code，变成“第一个故障代码的一对数字”，修饰关系错译。B把first错换成latest（最新的），词义错译。

question: 冲压空气涡轮位于右后机身整流罩内。

options.A: Turbine press air is in the aft right body fairing.
options.B: The ram air turbine is located in the aft right body fairing.
options.C: The air pressed by turbine is located in aft right body fairing.

explanation: 【译文】The ram air turbine is located in the aft right body fairing.【词汇】ram air turbine=冲压空气涡轮，be located in=位于，aft=后部，fairing=整流罩。【解析】B正确：ram air turbine为标准术语，aft right body fairing对应“右后机身整流罩”。A写成“Turbine press air”，词序颠倒、术语生造，不可接受。C把部件名译成“the air pressed by turbine”（被涡轮压过的空气），完全曲解冲压空气涡轮这一专有名词。

question: IDG包括一个恒速驱动装置和一个由滑油冷却的发电机。

options.A: The IDG drives a constant-speed unit and an oil cooled generator.
options.B: The IDG includes a variable-speed drive and an fuel cooled generator.
options.C: The IDG consists of a constant-speed drive and an oil cooled generator.

explanation: 【译文】The IDG consists of a constant-speed drive and an oil cooled generator.【词汇】IDG=整体驱动发电机，consist of=由…组成、包括，constant-speed drive=恒速驱动装置，oil cooled=滑油冷却的。【解析】C正确：consists of准确表达“包括/由…组成”，constant-speed与oil cooled均对应。A把“包括”译成drives（驱动），改变IDG与部件的关系，句意失真。B两处错误：constant-speed换成variable-speed（变速，相反），oil换成fuel（燃油），且冠词an fuel语法错误。

question: 这种方法广泛应用于在图上绘出导航用的向量。

options.A: This method is used widely in plotting vectors for navigation problems on a chart.
options.B: Plotting factors for navigation problems on a chart is a widely used method.
options.C: Drawing factors for navigation problems on a chart is a widely used method.

explanation: 【译文】This method is used widely in plotting vectors for navigation problems on a chart.【词汇】plot=绘出，vector=向量（易混factor=因素），navigation=导航，chart=图。【解析】A正确：is used widely对应“广泛应用”、plotting vectors对应“绘出向量”、on a chart对应“在图上”。B把vectors错换成factors（因素），且改写句式使“绘图”变成主语，偏离原意。C同样误用factors并把plotting换成drawing，属词义错译。

question: 副翼位于每侧机翼后缘外侧。

options.A: The ailerons are located to the outside rare edge of each wing.
options.B: The spoilers are located on the outside rare edge of each wing.
options.C: The ailerons are located on the outboard trailing edge of each wing.

explanation: 【译文】The ailerons are located on the outboard trailing edge of each wing.【词汇】aileron=副翼，outboard=外侧，trailing edge=后缘，wing=机翼。【解析】C正确：ailerons、outboard trailing edge均为标准术语。A把trailing edge错写成rare edge（无此术语），关键部位名称错译。B把ailerons错换成spoilers（扰流板，另一操纵面），且同样使用rare edge，部件错译加术语错误。

question: 索引编号系统在后面的段落中进行了描述。

options.A: The Index Numbering System is described in the following paragraph.
options.B: The Index Numbering System is introduced in the next paragraph.
options.C: The Index Numbering System is compared in the later paragraph.

explanation: 【译文】The Index Numbering System is described in the following paragraph.【词汇】index numbering system=索引编号系统，describe=描述，the following paragraph=后面的段落。【解析】A正确：described和following paragraph均准确对应。B把described换成introduced（介绍、引入），“描述”强调详细说明而非简单提及，词义不到位。C换成compared（比较），“进行了比较”与“进行了描述”含义完全不同，属词义错译。

question: 制造商可能会省略不适用于其产品的系统。

options.A: Manufacturers may optimize products that do not conform to their systems.
options.B: Manufacturers may omit systems not applicable to their product.
options.C: Manufacturers may object to products that are suitable for their systems.

explanation: 【译文】Manufacturers may omit systems not applicable to their product.【词汇】omit=省略，not applicable to=不适用于，system=系统。【解析】B正确：omit对应“省略”，systems not applicable to their product完整对应“不适用于其产品的系统”。A两处错误：omit换成optimize（优化），宾语换成products且conform to their systems关系颠倒。C把omit换成object to（反对），又把not applicable换成suitable（适用），否定关系丢失，方向相反。

question: 手机的前面板有一个触摸屏和一个返回键。

options.A: On the front of the phone, there's a screen, and you can touch the home button.
options.B: The screen of the phone is on the panel, and you can touch the home button.
options.C: The front panel of the phone has a touchscreen and a home button.

explanation: 【译文】The front panel of the phone has a touchscreen and a home button.【词汇】front panel=前面板，touchscreen=触摸屏，home button=返回键/主键。【解析】C正确：front panel、touchscreen、home button三个部件名全部对应，has准确表达“有”。A把touchscreen拆译成“a screen, and you can touch”，曲解为屏幕加可触摸按键，结构混乱。B把“前面板有触摸屏”错译为“屏幕在面板上”，部件所属关系完全改变。

question: 词典不包括技术动词，因为它们太多了。

options.A: The dictionary does not include verbs sorted by trades because there are too many.
options.B: The dictionary excludes majors because there are too many verbs.
options.C: The dictionary does not include technical verbs because there are too many.

explanation: 【译文】The dictionary does not include technical verbs because there are too many.【词汇】technical verb=技术动词，include=包括，because there are too many=因为它们太多。【解析】C正确：technical verbs对应“技术动词”，原因从句结构完整对应“因为它们太多”。A把technical错换成sorted by trades（按行业分类的），修饰语错译。B把宾语换成majors（专业），且因果倒置为“动词太多所以排除专业”，逻辑关系混乱。

question: 如可能，使用一个经批准的简单动词表达。

options.A: Use a simple verb to express the approved possibility if permitted.
options.B: If possible, use an approved simple verb to express.
options.C: If allowed, use a simple verb for approving.

explanation: 【译文】If possible, use an approved simple verb to express it.【词汇】if possible=如可能，approved=经批准的，simple verb=简单动词。【解析】B正确：if possible对应“如可能”，approved simple verb对应“经批准的简单动词”。A把“经批准的”移位修饰possibility，变成“表达被批准的可能性”，修饰对象错译。C两处错误：if allowed（如被允许）≠if possible；for approving把approved（已批准的）改成“为了批准”，词义错译。

question: 请不要用湿的手去触碰USB电源适配器。

options.A: Please do not make the USB power adapter wet with your hands.
options.B: When the USB power adapter is wet, please do not touch it.
options.C: If your hands are wet, do not touch the USB power adapter.

explanation: 【译文】If your hands are wet, do not touch the USB power adapter.【词汇】wet hands=湿的手，touch=触碰，power adapter=电源适配器。【解析】C正确：把“湿的手”转化为条件状语If your hands are wet，语义等价且符合英文表达习惯。A错译成“不要用手把适配器弄湿”，湿的对象从手变成适配器，张冠李戴。B同样把条件对象弄反：“适配器湿的时候不要碰”，与“手湿时勿碰”完全不同。

question: 文件必须易于修改。

options.A: The file must be very easy to rewrite.
options.B: Every document must be simple to modify.
options.C: Document must be readily revisable.

explanation: 【译文】Document must be readily revisable.【词汇】readily=容易地，revisable=可修改的，rewrite=重写（程度过重）。【解析】C正确：readily revisable为“易于修改”的规范简洁表达，符合手册文件语境。A把“修改”错换成rewrite（重写），重写指推倒重写，远超“易于修改”的程度，词义错译。B的simple to modify意思接近，但Every改变了“文件”的指称范围，且modify不如revisable贴合“修订”语境，属次优表达。

question: 确保你能同时听到600赫兹的声音。

options.A: Make sure that you can hear the 600 Hz tone at the same time.
options.B: Ensure that you heard the sound of 600 Hertz.
options.C: Be sure that you can hear the voice of 600 Hertz.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that you can hear the 600 Hz tone at the same time.【词汇】make sure=确保，tone=声音、音调声，at the same time=同时，Hz=赫兹。【解析】A正确：tone对应设备提示“声音”，at the same time对应“同时”。B两处错误：heard用过去式（应为can hear），且漏译“同时”这一要素。C把tone错换成voice（人声），“600赫兹的人声”不合理，音调声与人声属词义错译。

question: 因此，你必须写短句并使用简单句结构。

options.A: So, you'd have to note down short sentences in simple sentence structures.
options.B: Thus, you have to write shortly and use simple sentences.
options.C: Therefore, you must write short sentences and use simple sentence structure.

explanation: 【译文】Therefore, you must write short sentences and use simple sentence structure.【词汇】therefore=因此，short sentences=短句，simple sentence structure=简单句结构。【解析】C正确：Therefore、must、write short sentences、simple sentence structure四要素全部对应。A把write错换成note down（记下），动作错译，且you'd have to语气弱于must。B把“写短句”错改成write shortly（写得简短），词性改变，漏译“短句”这一名词要素。

question: 在所有起落架轮子周围放置轮挡。

options.A: Place chocks around all landing gear tires.
options.B: Set the wheel gears beneath all landing gear wheels.
options.C: Assemble blocks around all landing gears.

explanation: 【译文】Place chocks around all the landing gear tires.【词汇】chock=轮挡（专用术语），landing gear=起落架，around=在…周围，tire=轮胎/机轮。【解析】A正确：chocks为“轮挡”标准术语，around all对应“在所有…周围”。B把chocks错换成wheel gears（生造词），且beneath（在…下面）改变了“周围”的方位。C把chocks换成blocks（垫块，非轮挡专称），Assemble（组装）≠Place（放置），两处错译。

question: 如果底漆层损伤，进行修理。

options.A: If the first coat is damaged, do a repair.
options.B: If the protective finish is damaged, do a repair.
options.C: If the primer layers are damaged, do a repair.

explanation: 【译文】If the primer layers are damaged, do a repair.【词汇】primer layer=底漆层，damaged=损伤的，do a repair=进行修理。【解析】C正确：primer layers是“底漆层”的标准译法，do a repair对应“进行修理”。A把primer错换成first coat（头道涂层），字面相近但不是“底漆”专称，术语不到位。B换成protective finish（保护涂层/面漆），涂层类型张冠李戴。

question: 去除导线的绝缘层。

options.A: Peel the coating from the harness.
options.B: Strip the insulation from the wire.
options.C: Stripe the insulation from the harness.

explanation: 【译文】Strip the insulation from the wire.【词汇】strip=剥除（绝缘层专称），insulation=绝缘层，wire=导线。【解析】B正确：strip the insulation from the wire是剥线操作的标准表达。A两处偏差：wire换成harness（线束，多根导线的集合），范围扩大；Peel（撕削）也不如Strip（剥绝缘皮）专业。C把Strip误拼为Stripe（条纹），且同样误用harness，属拼写加术语双重错误。

question: 这种化合物是有毒的。

options.A: This compound is poisonous.
options.B: This composite is toxic.
options.C: This agent is volatile

explanation: 【译文】This compound is poisonous.【词汇】compound=化合物，poisonous=有毒的，volatile=易挥发的。【解析】A正确：compound和poisonous完全对应题干“化合物是有毒的”。B把compound错换成composite（复合材料），近形词干扰；toxic虽也表有毒，但关键名词已错。C两处错误：compound换成agent（试剂），poisonous换成volatile（易挥发的），把毒性偷换成物理性质，属词义错译。

question: 陀螺仪的突然操作会导致水平安定面发生不必要的移动。

options.A: Rapid operation of the accelerometer can cause unexpected movement of the vertical stabilizer.
options.B: Accidental movement of the compass can cause unwanted operation of the oriental stabilizer.
options.C: Sudden operation of the gyro can cause unwanted movement of the horizontal stabilizer.

explanation: 【译文】Sudden operation of the gyro can cause unwanted movement of the horizontal stabilizer.【词汇】gyro=陀螺仪，sudden=突然的，unwanted=不必要的，horizontal stabilizer=水平安定面。【解析】C正确：gyro、horizontal stabilizer、unwanted均准确对应。A两处错误：gyro换成accelerometer（加速度计），horizontal换成vertical（垂直的），设备与方向全错。B同样双错：gyro换成compass（罗盘），horizontal换成oriental（东方的，生造搭配）。

question: 拆除中间的双臂曲柄装置，

options.A: Remove the middle bellcrank unit.
options.B: Remove the moderate dualcrank unit.
options.C: Remove the middle doublecrank unit.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the middle bellcrank unit.【词汇】remove=拆除，bellcrank=双臂曲柄（航空专用术语），middle=中间的。【解析】A正确：bellcrank为“双臂曲柄”的标准航空术语，middle对应“中间”。B两处错误：bellcrank换成dualcrank（非规范术语），middle换成moderate（中等的），术语生造加词义错译。C用doublecrank替代bellcrank，字面像“双臂曲柄”但同样不是规范术语。

question: 两个系统可以同时接通。

options.A: Two systems can be energized at a time.
options.B: Two systems can be engaged at the same time.
options.C: Two systems can be adopted separately.

explanation: 【译文】Two systems can be engaged at the same time.【词汇】engage=接通、启用，at the same time=同时，at a time=每次一个（易混）。【解析】B正确：engaged对应“接通”，at the same time对应“同时”。A把at the same time换成at a time（一次一个），含义相反：原文是两个一起接通，A译成每次只能一个。C两处错误：engaged换成adopted（采用），separately（分别地）与“同时”方向相反。

question: 某些飞机结构是复合材料。

options.A: Some aircraft parts are combined materials.
options.B: Some airplane structures are composite materials.
options.C: Some aircraft structures are compound materials.

explanation: 【译文】Some aircraft structures are composite materials.【词汇】composite materials=复合材料（固定术语），structure=结构，aircraft=飞机。【解析】B正确：composite materials为标准术语，structures对应“结构”。A两处错误：composite换成combined（组合的，非术语），structures换成parts（零件），范围与术语双偏。C用compound materials，compound指化合物/混合物，“复合材料”的规范说法是composite material，属术语错译。

question: 收到，可以推出飞机。

options.A: Roger that, clear for dispatch.
options.B: Copy that, clear for pressing.
options.C: Roger, clear for pushback.

explanation: 【译文】Roger, clear for pushback.【词汇】Roger=收到（无线电用语），clear for=获准进行，pushback=推出（机位推出）。【解析】C正确：Roger对应“收到”，pushback为“推出飞机”的地面操作标准术语。A把pushback错换成dispatch（放行/签派），放行是签派许可概念而非地面推出动作，张冠李戴。B错换成pressing（按压），词义完全无关。

question: 在两个副翼后部有调整片。

options.A: There are trim tabs at the rear of both ailerons.
options.B: There are trim tabs at the rear of both flaps.
options.C: There are trimmable stabilizers at the rear of both elevators.

explanation: 【译文】There are trim tabs at the rear of both ailerons.【词汇】trim tab=调整片，aileron=副翼，at the rear of=在…后部。【解析】A正确：trim tabs和ailerons均为标准术语，at the rear of对应“后部”。B把ailerons错换成flaps（襟翼），操纵面张冠李戴。C两处错误：trim tabs换成trimmable stabilizers（可配平安定面），ailerons换成elevators（升降舵），整句部件名称全错。

question: 方向舵是一个被固定在垂直安定面上的可移动的翼面，它用于偏航控制。

options.A: The rudder is a replaceable airfoil which is mounted to the vertical fin and is used for yaw control.
options.B: The rudder is a removable wing which is fixed to the vertical stabilizer and is used for pitch control.
options.C: The rudder is a removable airfoil which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and is used for yaw control.

explanation: 【译文】The rudder is a movable airfoil attached to the vertical stabilizer and used for yaw control.【词汇】rudder=方向舵，airfoil=翼面，vertical stabilizer=垂直安定面，yaw control=偏航控制。【解析】C正确：airfoil、vertical stabilizer、yaw control三要素全对；removable在此表“可动的”，movable会更精确但已是选项中最贴切者。A把“可移动的”错换成replaceable（可更换的），属性错译。B两处错误：airfoil换成wing（机翼，层级不同），yaw换成pitch（俯仰），控制轴张冠李戴。

question: 地面控制描述了滑行和地面操作时的最小转弯半径。

options.A: Ground Control depicts minimum diameter of turning for taxiing and ground operation.
options.B: Ground Control describes minimum radius of turn for taxiing and ground handling.
options.C: The least radius of turn for taxiing and ground maneuver is described in Ground Control.

explanation: 【译文】Ground Control describes the minimum radius of turn for taxiing and ground handling.【词汇】describe=描述，radius of turn=转弯半径，taxiing=滑行，ground handling=地面操作。【解析】B正确：describes、minimum radius of turn、ground handling均对应题干。A两处错误：depicts（描绘）不如describes规范；diameter（直径）把“半径”翻倍，数值概念错译。C句式倒装尚可，但least不如minimum规范，ground maneuver也不如ground handling贴合“地面操作”。

question: 此程序解释如何识别迫在眉睫的问题以及如果发生故障该怎么处理。

options.A: This program describes how to identify an immediate failure and how to handle a malfunction occurred.
options.B: This procedure explains how to recognize impending problems and what to do if malfunctions occur.
options.C: How to confirm the current problems and what should you do when malfunctions occur are described in this procedure.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure explains how to recognize impending problems and what to do if malfunctions occur.【词汇】procedure=程序，impending=迫在眉睫的，recognize=识别，malfunction=故障。【解析】B正确：procedure、impending problems、malfunctions occur三要素全对。A两处错误：impending换成immediate（立即的≠将至的），且a malfunction occurred语法有误。C把recognize换成confirm（确认）、impending换成current（当前的），词义错译且句式臃肿。

question: 描述可能故障的排故信息和这些故障的补救措施应在此手册中提供。

options.A: Troubleshooting messages explaining possible failures and corrective measures must be covered in this handbook.
options.B: You may find the troubleshooting information about the malfunctions and the related measures for them in this manual.
options.C: Troubleshooting information describing probable malfunctions and the remedial actions of those malfunctions shall be provided in this manual.

explanation: 【译文】Troubleshooting information describing probable malfunctions and remedial actions shall be provided in this manual.【词汇】troubleshooting information=排故信息，remedial action=补救措施，shall=应（表强制）。【解析】C正确：probable malfunctions、remedial actions、shall be provided三要素全对。A两处偏差：messages不如information规范，failures不如malfunctions贴合“故障”。B把“应提供”改写为“你可以找到”，主客颠倒，义务语气丢失。

question: FAA批准的适航限制应作为单独的文件来准备并纳入主维修手册。

options.A: A separate document should be prepared for FAA approved airworthiness limitations which are excluded in the primary maintenance manual.
options.B: FAA approved airworthiness limitations shall be prepared as a separate document for inclusion in the principal maintenance manual.
options.C: FAA approved airworthiness limitations must be contained as an integrated documentation for inclusion in the main maintenance manual.

explanation: 【译文】FAA approved airworthiness limitations shall be prepared as a separate document for inclusion in the principal maintenance manual.【词汇】airworthiness limitation=适航限制，separate document=单独文件，for inclusion=纳入，principal=主要的。【解析】B正确：separate document、inclusion、principal三要素全对。A把“纳入”错写成excluded（排除在外），方向相反。C把separate换成integrated（一体的），“单独”变“一体化”，方向相反。

question: 如果使用折合页，当折叠时，页码必须是可见的。

options.A: If you use folding page, the page number must be invisible when folding.
options.B: The page number must be viewing if you fold the page.
options.C: If folded pages are used, the page number must be visible when folded.

explanation: 【译文】If folded pages are used, the page number must be visible when folded.【词汇】folded pages=折合页，page number=页码，visible=可见的（invisible反义）。【解析】C正确：folded pages对应“折合页”、visible对应“可见的”、when folded对应“当折叠时”。A把visible错换成invisible（不可见的），方向相反，与保证页码可见的意图背道而驰。B语法错误：must be viewing意为“页码正在观看”，应为must be visible，词性和语义全错。

question: 所有相关数据应按逻辑方式分组。

options.A: All the related data shall be grouped in a logical manner.
options.B: A logical method is required to group the unconcerned data together.
options.C: Divide all the involved data into groups logically.

explanation: 【译文】All the related data shall be grouped in a logical manner.【词汇】related=相关的，shall be grouped=应被分组，in a logical manner=按逻辑方式。【解析】A正确：related对应“相关”、shall be grouped对应“应分组”、logical manner对应“逻辑方式”。B把related错换成unconcerned（不相关的），方向相反。C改为祈使句Divide，把陈述性规定变成操作指令，文体语气偏离，且involved也不如related贴切。

question: 在这两种情况中的任一情况下，都将包括一个图表来显示贯穿整个手册所使用的标准符号。

options.A: In either case, a chart will be included in showing standard symbols used throughout the manual.
options.B: In both cases, a figure will be contained to show the normal symptoms used in the whole manual.
options.C: Through the handbook, a form shall be used to show the normal signs in these two cases.

explanation: 【译文】In either case, a chart will be included to show the standard symbols used throughout the manual.【词汇】in either case=任一情况（两者之一），standard symbols=标准符号，throughout the manual=贯穿整个手册。【解析】A正确：either case、standard symbols、throughout the manual均对应。B两处错误：either换成both（两者都，数量相反），standard symbols换成normal symptoms（正常症状）。C逻辑混乱：form和normal signs偏离原文要素。

question: 用清洗液对腐蚀进行清洁时，要避免损坏周围区域。

options.A: When cleaning corrosion with a cleaning fluid, avoid damaging adjacent areas.
options.B: Avoid damaging the area around when we clean the corrosion with cleaner.
options.C: Use solution to clean the corroded area and prevent to damage the surroundings.

explanation: 【译文】When cleaning corrosion with a cleaning fluid, avoid damaging the adjacent areas.【词汇】cleaning fluid=清洗液，avoid doing=避免做…，adjacent areas=周围区域。【解析】A正确：cleaning fluid、avoid damaging、adjacent areas三要素全对。B表达松散：the area around不地道（应为surrounding/adjacent areas）。C改为祈使句偏离原陈述语气，且prevent to damage为错误搭配（应为prevent damage）。

question: 关闭隔离活门。

options.A: Check the bypass valves.
options.B: Close the isolating valves.
options.C: Inspect the check valves.

explanation: 【译文】Close the isolating valves.【词汇】close=关闭，isolating valve=隔离活门，bypass valve=旁通活门。【解析】B正确：Close和isolating valves均准确对应题干“关闭隔离活门”。A两处错误：Close换成Check（检查），动作错译；isolating valves换成bypass valves（旁通活门），活门类型张冠李戴。C同样双错：Inspect（检查）≠关闭，check valves（单向活门）≠隔离活门。

question: 将机轮挡好轮档。

options.A: Put the actuators against the tires.
options.B: Put the chocks against the wheels.
options.C: Put the chain against the brakes.

explanation: 【译文】Put the chocks against the wheels.【词汇】chock=轮挡，put…against=把…抵住，wheel=机轮。【解析】B正确：chocks为轮挡专称，put…against准确表达“挡好轮挡”。A两处错误：chocks换成actuators（作动器），wheels换成tires（轮胎，侧重橡胶件而非机轮整体）。C同样双错：chain（链条）≠轮挡，brakes（刹车装置）≠机轮。

question: 将探头移至下游，再次监测温度。

options.A: Move the sensor downstream and calculate the temperature again.
options.B: Move the probe downstream and monitor the temperature again.
options.C: Move the part downstream and measure the temperature again.

explanation: 【译文】Move the probe downstream and monitor the temperature again.【词汇】probe=探头，downstream=下游，monitor=监测，again=再次。【解析】B正确：probe、downstream、monitor、again四要素全对。A两处错误：probe换成sensor（传感器，范畴词不精确），monitor换成calculate（计算），监测动作错译。C把probe换成part（零件），过于泛化；measure（测量）虽近monitor但“监测”强调持续观察，关键名词已错。

question: 一个液压马达驱动这个泵。

options.A: A hydraulic pump operates the motor.
options.B: A fuel pump operates the motor.
options.C: A hydraulic motor operates the pump.

explanation: 【译文】A hydraulic motor operates the pump.【词汇】hydraulic motor=液压马达，operate=驱动、带动，pump=泵。【解析】C正确：hydraulic motor为主语、pump为宾语，驱动关系与题干一致。A主宾颠倒且部件错译：变成“液压泵驱动马达”，与“马达驱动泵”完全相反。B把hydraulic motor换成fuel pump（燃油泵），驱动主体张冠李戴，液压与燃油系统不同。

question: 让油漆在环境温度下变干燥。

options.A: Let the plate dry at applicable temperature.
options.B: Let the plant dry at available temperature.
options.C: Let the paint dry at ambient temperature.

explanation: 【译文】Let the paint dry at ambient temperature.【词汇】paint=油漆，ambient temperature=环境温度，dry=变干。【解析】C正确：paint和ambient temperature均准确对应。A两处错误：paint换成plate（板材），ambient换成applicable（适用的），均为近形词干扰。B同样双错：plant（植物/工厂）≠paint，available（可用的）≠ambient（环境的），干燥条件完全改变。

question: 在烤箱里烘干油滤。

options.A: Dry the filter in an oven.
options.B: Dry the filter in the cover.
options.C: Dry the filter in the fire.

explanation: 【译文】Dry the filter in an oven.【词汇】dry=烘干，filter=油滤，oven=烤箱。【解析】A正确：oven对应“烤箱”，dry the filter对应“烘干油滤”。B把oven错换成cover（盖子），“在盖子里烘干”不合常理。C错换成fire（火），“在火里烘干”不仅词义错译，还存在直接点燃油滤的安全隐患，属危险的方向性错误。

question: 安装两个垫片，每个3.5毫米厚。

options.A: Install two mats, each 3.5 mm thick.
options.B: Install two spacers, each 3.5 mm thick.
options.C: Install two rings, each 3.5 mm thick.

explanation: 【译文】Install two spacers, each 3.5 mm thick.【词汇】spacer=垫片、间隔件，install=安装，each…thick=每个…厚。【解析】B正确：spacers为“垫片/间隔垫”标准术语，each 3.5 mm thick结构正确对应“每个3.5毫米厚”。A把spacers错换成mats（垫子），日常词替代专业零件术语。C换成rings（环），垫片与环是不同形状的零件，属词义错译。

question: 氧化很容易发生。

options.A: Oxidation occurs very easily.
options.B: Oxygen occurs very easily.
options.C: Nitrogen occurs very easily.

explanation: 【译文】Oxidation occurs very easily.【词汇】oxidation=氧化（作用），oxygen=氧气（近形），occur=发生。【解析】A正确：oxidation对应“氧化”这一化学过程，occurs对应“发生”。B把oxidation错换成oxygen（氧气），氧气是物质名词而非“氧化”现象，近形词干扰。C错换成nitrogen（氮气），词义完全无关，属词义错译。

question: 执行拧紧程序。

options.A: Do the tightening procedure.
options.B: Do the loosening procedure.
options.C: Do the strengthening procedure.

explanation: 【译文】Do the tightening procedure.【词汇】tighten=拧紧，loosen=松开（反义），strengthen=加强（近义干扰）。【解析】A正确：tightening对应“拧紧”，do the procedure对应“执行程序”。B把tightening错换成loosening（松开），方向相反——拧松与拧紧是完全相反的操作。C错换成strengthening（加强、强化），加强结构不等于拧紧紧固件，属近义词干扰。

question: 检查拆下的零件是否损坏

options.A: Examine and remove the parts that are damaged.
options.B: Examine the removed parts with damage.
options.C: Examine the removed parts for damage.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the removed parts for damage.【词汇】examine…for damage=检查…是否损坏（固定句型），removed parts=拆下的零件。【解析】C正确：examine…for damage为“检查有无损坏”的标准结构，removed parts对应“拆下的零件”。A两处错误：把for damage换成and remove…damaged，变成“检查并拆除损坏件”，多出“拆除”动作，句式杂糅。B用with damage（带有损坏的）替代for damage，变成“检查已损坏的零件”，检查目的错译。

question: 说明具体的风险或可能的结果。

options.A: Give an explanation to show the specified risk or possible result.
options.B: Give an explanation to show the special risk or possible result.
options.C: Give an explanation to show the specific risk or possible result.

explanation: 【译文】Give an explanation to show the specific risk or possible result.【词汇】specific=具体的，specified=规定的（易混），special=特殊的（易混），possible result=可能的结果。【解析】C正确：specific对应“具体的”，possible result对应“可能的结果”。A把specific错换成specified（被规定的），“规定的风险”不等于“具体的风险”，近形词干扰。B错换成special（特殊的）：special强调“与众不同”，specific强调“明确具体”，题意取后者，属词义错译。

question: 确保传感器处无液压油渗漏。

options.A: Make sure there is no leakage of hydraulic fluid at the router.
options.B: Make sure there is no leakage of hydraulic fluid at the transducer.
options.C: Make sure there is no leakage of hydraulic fluid at the transponder.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure there is no leakage of hydraulic fluid at the transducer.【词汇】transducer=传感器（物理量转换器件），leakage=渗漏，hydraulic fluid=液压油。【解析】B正确：transducer为航空语境“传感器”标准术语，no leakage对应“无渗漏”。A把transducer错换成router（路由器/路径装置），设备张冠李戴。C错换成transponder（应答机），transducer/transponder近形但功能完全不同：前者转换物理量，后者收发信号，属词义错译。

question: 警告、注意事项和提示可用于突出或强调重点。

options.A: Warnings, cautions and notes may be used to highlight or repeat important points.
options.B: Warnings, cautions and notes may be used to highlight or emphasis important points.
options.C: Warnings, cautions and notes may be used to highlight or emphasize important points.

explanation: 【译文】Warnings, cautions and notes may be used to highlight or emphasize important points.【词汇】warning/caution/note=警告/注意事项/提示，highlight=突出，emphasize=强调（动词），emphasis=强调（名词）。【解析】C正确：emphasize为动词原形，与highlight并列，词性和词义均对应“强调”。A把emphasize错换成repeat（重复），“强调”变“重复”，词义错译。B用名词emphasis，不能与动词highlight并列，属词性/语法错误。

question: 禁止使用任何非受控的技术文件去做维修工作。

options.A: It is not permit to work with any uncontrolled technical document for maintenance work.
options.B: It is not permitted to work with any uncontrolled technical document for maintenance work.
options.C: It is not allowed to work with any  unreliable technical document  for maintenance work.

explanation: 【译文】It is not permitted to work with any uncontrolled technical document for maintenance work.【词汇】not permitted=禁止（被动式），uncontrolled=非受控的（文件受控体系术语），technical document=技术文件。【解析】B正确：not permitted语法正确，uncontrolled准确对应“非受控”（文件版本控制概念）。A把permitted错写成permit，is not permit缺少过去分词，属语法错误。C把uncontrolled错换成unreliable（不可靠的），“非受控”是版本管理概念，与“不可靠”含义不同，属词义错译。

question: 本规范第7版完全取代了以前的所有版本和修订版。

options.A: This Issue 7 of the specification fully takes place all issues and revisions before.
options.B: This Issue 7 of the specification fully covers all prior issues and revisions.
options.C: This Issue 7 of the specification fully replaces all previous issues and revisions.

explanation: 【译文】This Issue 7 of the specification fully replaces all previous issues and revisions.【词汇】issue=版次，replace=取代，previous=以前的，revision=修订版。【解析】C正确：replaces对应“取代”，previous对应“以前的”，fully对应“完全”。A把replaces错换成takes place（发生/举行），take place不能接宾语表示“取代”，短语误用。B错换成covers（涵盖、覆盖），“涵盖旧版”与“取代旧版”含义不同，弱化了版本更替关系。

question: 当检查人员要求时，请出示你的执照和资格授权。

options.A: when the inspector asks, please show your license and obligations.
options.B: Please show your license and qualification authorization when asked by the inspector.
options.C: Please show your license and quality duties when asked by the inspector.

explanation: 【译文】Please show your license and qualification authorization when asked by the inspector.【词汇】inspector=检查人员，license=执照，qualification authorization=资格授权。【解析】B正确：qualification authorization对应“资格授权”，when asked对应“当要求时”。A把authorization错换成obligations（义务），“执照和义务”语义不通。C换成quality duties（质量职责），qualification与quality近形干扰，属词义错译。

question: 要了解更多信息，请参阅官方的参考书。

options.A: For more information, refer as official reference books.
options.B: For more information, refer to official reference books.
options.C: More information referred to official reference books.

explanation: 【译文】For more information, refer to official reference books.【词汇】for more information=要了解更多信息，refer to=参阅（固定搭配），reference book=参考书。【解析】B正确：refer to为“参阅”的唯一正确搭配，祈使结构对应“请参阅”。A错写成refer as，refer无此搭配，属介词错误。C缺主语与祈使结构，“More information referred to…”语法不通，祈使语气完全丢失，official（官方的）也被漏译。

question: 轻微地移动它，使它能够对准小孔。

options.A: Move it lightly and make it through the hole
options.B: Move it slightly to make it aim at the hole
options.C: Move it gently to make it enter the hole

explanation: 【译文】Move it slightly to make it aim at the hole.【词汇】slightly=轻微地（幅度小），aim at=对准，hole=孔。【解析】B正确：slightly对应“轻微地”，aim at对应“对准”，两个考点全对。A两处错误：lightly侧重“用力轻”不如slightly贴切；through the hole（穿过孔）≠对准孔，动作目标错译。C把aim at错换成enter the hole（进入孔），“对准”是预定位而非穿入，属词义错译。

question: 把修理板材准确地放在损坏区域。

options.A: Place the repaired board carefully in the damaged place.
options.B: Place the repair form directly above the damage.
options.C: Put the repair sheet accurately on the damaged area.

explanation: 【译文】Put the repair sheet accurately on the damaged area.【词汇】repair sheet=修理板材/修补片，accurately=准确地，damaged area=损坏区域。【解析】C正确：repair sheet、accurately、damaged area三要素全对。A多处错误：sheet换成board（板子），accurately换成carefully（小心地），repaired（已修好的）也改变了“修理用板材”的含义。B把sheet换成form（表格），accurately on换成directly above（正上方），方位关系错译。

question: 确保孔的直径小于规定的值。

options.A: Ensure that the porosity is less than the specified error.
options.B: Ensure that the depth of the hole conforms to the specified value.
options.C: Make sure that the diameter of the hole is less than the specified value.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the diameter of the hole is less than the specified value.【词汇】diameter=直径，less than=小于，specified value=规定的值。【解析】C正确：diameter、less than、specified value三要素全对。A两处错误：diameter换成porosity（孔隙率），value换成error（误差），检测对象和比较基准全错。B把diameter换成depth（深度），且把less than换成conforms to（符合），“小于规定值”变“符合规定值”，判定标准完全不同。

question: 操作标牌应列出清单或配图解说明。

options.A: Operational Tags need to be listed or made a legend.
options.B: Operating Placards shall be listed or illustrated.
options.C: Operation Instructions have to be listed or mapped out.

explanation: 【译文】Operating placards shall be listed or illustrated.【词汇】operating placard=操作标牌，shall=应，list=列出清单，illustrate=配图解说明。【解析】B正确：placards为“标牌”航空专称，listed or illustrated对应“列出清单或配图解说明”。A把placards错换成tags（标签），且made a legend（做成图例）偏离“配图解”的表达。C把placards换成instructions（说明书），“操作标牌”与“操作说明”是不同文件类型，mapped out也偏离“配图解”。

question: 操作调光开关，确保光的强度发生变化。

options.A: Turn the dimming knob and find out the intensity of the light changes.
options.B: Press the light exchange switch to observe the change of light intensity.
options.C: Operate the dimmer switch and make sure that the intensity of the light changes.

explanation: 【译文】Operate the dimmer switch and make sure that the intensity of the light changes.【词汇】dimmer switch=调光开关，make sure=确保，intensity=强度。【解析】C正确：dimmer switch为“调光开关”标准术语，make sure对应“确保”，intensity对应“强度”。A两处偏差：dimmer switch换成dimming knob（调光旋钮，部件不同），make sure换成find out（查明），确认动作错译。B把dimmer switch换成light exchange switch（生造词），Press也窄化了“操作”的含义，术语错译。

question: 计算机依据这些数值计算能源消耗。

options.A: The computer consumes the energy based on these values calculations.
options.B: The computer calculates the energy consumption from these values.
options.C: The computer counts these values based on the energy costs.

explanation: 【译文】The computer calculates the energy consumption from these values.【词汇】calculate=计算，energy consumption=能源消耗，from these values=依据这些数值。【解析】B正确：calculates对应“计算”、energy consumption对应“能源消耗”、from对应“依据”。A把calculates错换成consumes（消耗），变成“计算机消耗能源”，主谓关系颠倒，逻辑相反。C两处错误：counts（计数）≠calculates；energy costs（能源成本/费用）≠energy consumption（消耗量），近形词干扰。

question: 每一个维修项目都有程序可遵循。

options.A: Every maintenance item has to obey a procedure.
options.B: Follow the procedure to do the repair.
options.C: For every repair, there is a procedure for us to follow.

explanation: 【译文】For every maintenance item, there is a procedure to follow.【词汇】maintenance item=维修项目，procedure=程序，there is…to follow=有…可遵循。【解析】C正确：there is a procedure…to follow准确还原“有程序可遵循”的存在句结构，for us to follow语气自然。A把“有程序可遵循”错译成has to obey（不得不服从），“可遵循”的提供性含义变成强制服从，且item作主语obey拟人不当。B改为祈使句“按程序做修理”，陈述变指令，文体和主语均偏离题干。

question: 油滤组件污染表明泵有故障。

options.A: An inoperative pump will be identified by a decontaminated filter.
options.B: Contaminated filter elements indicate a defective pump.
options.C: If filter elements are clean , the filter elements are inoperative.

explanation: 【译文】Contaminated filter elements indicate a defective pump.【词汇】contaminated=受污染的，filter element=油滤组件/滤芯，indicate=表明，defective=有故障的。【解析】B正确：contaminated filter elements对应“油滤组件污染”，indicate对应“表明”，defective pump对应“有故障的泵”。A逻辑颠倒且词义相反：“故障泵被去污染的滤芯识别”，decontaminated（已去污染的）与contaminated相反。C两处错误：contaminated换成clean（干净的，相反），结论变成“滤芯失效”而非“泵有故障”，张冠李戴。

question: 提高温度以减少固化时间。

options.A: The temperature can be increased by decreasing the cure time.
options.B: Decreasing the cure time that can increase the temperature.
options.C: Increase the temperature to decrease the cure time.

explanation: 【译文】Increase the temperature to decrease the cure time.【词汇】increase=提高，decrease=减少，cure time=固化时间，to do=以便（表目的）。【解析】C正确：increase…to decrease…准确表达“提高…以减少…”的目的关系。A因果颠倒：“通过减少固化时间来提高温度”，手段与目的互换。B同样颠倒且语法不通：“减少固化时间可以提高温度”，目的状语被错改成主语结构，逻辑关系完全错误。

question: 在地面减速时，所有扰流板都打开。

options.A: During ground speed braking, all the spoiler panels are activated.
options.B: During ground deceleration, all the spoiler panels are closed.
options.C: During ground speed stabilizes, most of the pedals are activated.

explanation: 【译文】During ground deceleration, all the spoiler panels are activated.【词汇】ground deceleration=地面减速，spoiler panel=扰流板，activated=打开/作动，closed=关闭（反义）。【解析】A正确：ground speed braking对应“地面减速”语境，all the spoiler panels are activated对应“所有扰流板都打开（作动）”。B把activated错换成closed（关闭），方向相反——地面减速时扰流板必须展开而非收起。C两处错误：spoiler panels换成pedals（踏板），most of（大部分）≠all（所有），部件与数量全错。

question: 从软管上拆下盖子。

options.A: Remove the caps from the hoses.
options.B: Remove the caps from the tubes.
options.C: Remove the caps from the manifolds.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the caps from the hoses.【词汇】remove…from=从…上拆下，cap=盖子、堵帽，hose=软管。【解析】A正确：caps和hoses准确对应，remove from结构规范。B把hoses错换成tubes（硬管），软管与硬管材质不同，部件类别错译。C错换成manifolds（歧管），属近义部件干扰，同样是词义错译。

question: 阀门故障的主要原因是液压油污染。

options.A: The primary cause of valve failure is contamination of the hydraulic fluid.
options.B: The primary cause of valve failure is poisonousness of the hydraulic fluid.
options.C: The primary element of valve failure is contamination of the hydraulic fluid.

explanation: 【译文】The primary cause of valve failure is contamination of the hydraulic fluid.【词汇】primary cause=主要原因，valve failure=阀门故障，contamination=污染，hydraulic fluid=液压油。【解析】A正确：primary cause、valve failure、contamination三要素全对。B把contamination错换成poisonousness（毒性），“液压油毒性”不是“污染”概念，词义错译。C把primary cause换成primary element（主要元件/因素），“原因”被偷换成“要素”，因果关系丢失。

question: 检查密封有无缺陷。

options.A: Check the seal for detects.
options.B: Examine the seal for defects.
options.C: Examine the suffer for defects.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the seal for defects.【词汇】examine…for defects=检查有无缺陷（固定句型），seal=密封，defect=缺陷。【解析】B正确：examine…for defects为标准检验句式，seal对应“密封”。A把defects错写成detects（检测，动词第三人称），for detects词性错误、语义不通。C把seal错换成suffer（遭受），近形词完全无关，属拼写/词义错误。

question: 阻尼器可防止控制装置突然移动。

options.A: The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.
options.B: The damper prevents sudden movement in case of the control.
options.C: The damper prevents  until the control moves suddenly.

explanation: 【译文】The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.【词汇】damper=阻尼器，prevent=防止，sudden movement=突然移动。【解析】A正确：prevents sudden movement of the control准确对应“防止控制装置突然移动”。B加插in case of（万一），把宾语结构拆散，“防止控制装置万一的突然移动”语法不通、语义改变。C用until连接，变成“阻尼器一直防止直到控制装置突然移动”，逻辑关系完全错译。

question: 如果没有任何支架损坏，请继续此步骤。

options.A: If none of the components are damaged, continue the procedure.
options.B: If none of the brackets are damaged, continue the procedure.
options.C: If none of the brackets are damaged, continue the task.

explanation: 【译文】If none of the brackets are damaged, continue the procedure.【词汇】bracket=支架，none of…damaged=没有任何…损坏，continue the procedure=继续此步骤。【解析】B正确：brackets对应“支架”、procedure对应“步骤”。A把brackets错换成components（部件/组件），范围扩大，部件不限于支架。C把procedure错换成task（任务），“步骤”与“任务”层级不同，continue the task也不如procedure贴合手册语境，属词义错译。

question: 此步骤仅适用于包括极少量铆钉的修理。

options.A: This procedure is only for repairs that include a very small number of screws.
options.B: This procedure is only for repairs that include a very small number of nuts.
options.C: This procedure is only for repairs that include a very small number of rivets.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure is only for repairs that include a very small number of rivets.【词汇】rivet=铆钉，a very small number of=极少量，be only for=仅适用于。【解析】C正确：rivets为“铆钉”标准术语，a very small number of对应“极少量”。A把rivets错换成screws（螺钉），铆钉不可拆卸而螺钉可旋出，工艺完全不同，紧固件类型错译。B错换成nuts（螺母），同样是张冠李戴的紧固件干扰。

question: 根据需要设置控制杆的长度。

options.A: Set the width of the control rod as necessary.
options.B: Set the length of the control rod as necessary.
options.C: Set the height of the control rod as necessary.

explanation: 【译文】Set the length of the control rod as necessary.【词汇】length=长度，control rod=控制杆，as necessary=根据需要。【解析】B正确：length对应“长度”，as necessary对应“根据需要”。A把length错换成width（宽度），尺寸维度张冠李戴。C错换成height（高度），长、宽、高三个尺寸名词互相干扰，属词义错译。

question: 润滑垫圈的一侧。

options.A: Lubricate one side of the washers.
options.B: Lubricate one side of the seals.
options.C: Wash one side of the washers.

explanation: 【译文】Lubricate one side of the washers.【词汇】lubricate=润滑，washer=垫圈，one side=一侧。【解析】A正确：lubricate对应“润滑”，washers对应“垫圈”，one side对应“一侧”。B把washers错换成seals（密封件/封严圈），垫圈与密封件功能不同，部件错译。C把Lubricate错换成Wash（清洗），润滑与清洗是性质相反的保养操作，属词义错译。

question: 遵守部件的拆卸程序。

options.A: Obey the removal tasks for the components.
options.B: Follow the installation procedures for the components.
options.C: Obey the removal procedures for the components.

explanation: 【译文】Obey the removal procedures for the components.【词汇】obey=遵守，removal=拆卸，procedure=程序，component=部件。【解析】C正确：removal procedures对应“拆卸程序”，components对应“部件”。A把procedures错换成tasks（任务），“程序”强调步骤序列，与“任务”概念不同。B把removal错换成installation（安装），拆卸与安装方向相反，属最严重的操作反向错误。

question: 外径必须与内径同轴。

options.A: The external diameter must be concentric to the internal diameter.
options.B: The outer radius and the inner radius must be suitable.
options.C: The exterior radius must be installed on a common shaft with the interior radius.

explanation: 【译文】The external diameter must be concentric to the internal diameter.【词汇】external diameter=外径，internal diameter=内径，concentric=同轴的、同心的。【解析】A正确：external/internal diameter对应“外径/内径”，concentric为“同轴”标准术语。B两处错误：diameter换成radius（半径），concentric换成suitable（合适的），几何关系完全丢失。C把diameter错成radius，且installed on a common shaft（装在同一根轴上）是安装方式而非“同轴”这一几何属性，概念错译。

question: 确保罗盘系统1和罗盘系统2是同步的。

options.A: Be sure that magnet plate system 1 and magnet plate system 2 are identical.
options.B: Make sure that compass system 1 and compass system 2 are synchronized.
options.C: Ensure that magnet plate system 1 and magnet plate system 2 are simultaneous.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that compass system 1 and compass system 2 are synchronized.【词汇】compass system=罗盘系统，synchronized=同步的，identical=相同的，simultaneous=同时发生的。【解析】B正确：compass和synchronized均准确对应。A两处错误：compass换成magnet plate（磁板，生造词），synchronized换成identical（相同的），“同步”不等于“相同”。C同样误用magnet plate，且把synchronized换成simultaneous（同时发生的），系统间的时间同步与事件同时发生概念不同，属词义错译。

question: 检查开口是否有从边角开始的裂缝。

options.A: Check the cut for gaps that start at its corners.
options.B: Examine the opening for cracks that start at its corners.
options.C: Inspect the clearance of gate from the corner.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the opening for cracks that start at its corners.【词汇】opening=开口，examine…for=检查有无，crack=裂缝，start at its corners=从边角开始。【解析】B正确：opening、cracks、start at its corners三要素全对。A两处错误：opening换成cut（切口），cracks换成gaps（缝隙），检查对象和缺陷类型均错。C语义混乱：clearance（间隙）替换裂缝，of gate from the corner结构破碎，“检查开口”的主体动作漏译。

question: 按下适用的按钮弹出磁盘驱动器。

options.A: Push the applicable button to eject the disk drive.
options.B: Press the applicable key to pop out the tape actuator.
options.C: Compress the applicable button to jet the disk actuator.

explanation: 【译文】Push the applicable button to eject the disk drive.【词汇】push=按下，applicable=适用的，eject=弹出，disk drive=磁盘驱动器。【解析】A正确：eject对应“弹出”、disk drive对应“磁盘驱动器”、applicable对应“适用的”。B多处错误：button换成key，disk drive换成tape actuator（磁带作动器），目标设备完全错译。C两处错误：Push换成Compress（压缩），eject换成jet（喷射），“弹出驱动器”被译成“喷射作动器”，动词全错。

question: 这个舱内有一些电子设备。

options.A: This compartment includes some of the electrical equipment.
options.B: This cabin has some of the electromotive equipment.
options.C: This bay contains some of the electronic equipment.

explanation: 【译文】This bay contains some of the electronic equipment.【词汇】bay=（设备）舱，electronic=电子的，electrical=电气的（易混），contain=包含。【解析】C正确：bay为航空“设备舱”专称，electronic对应“电子”，contains对应“有”。A两处偏差：bay换成compartment（隔舱，泛指），electronic换成electrical（电气的）——电子设备用electronic，电气系统用electrical，经典易混点。B把bay换成cabin（客舱），electromotive（电动的）也不等于电子的，双重错译。

question: 红灯每隔半秒闪一次。

options.A: The red lights flash in half-second intervals.
options.B: The red lights twinkle in demi-second.
options.C: The red lights flag after each half a second.

explanation: 【译文】The red lights flash at half-second intervals.【词汇】flash=（灯光）闪烁，at…intervals=每隔…，half-second=半秒。【解析】A正确：flash为灯光闪烁的标准动词，half-second intervals对应“每隔半秒”。B把flash错换成twinkle（闪烁，多用于星星），非技术用语，且demi-second为法语式拼法，英语规范用half-second。C错换成flag（打旗语/标记），“每隔半秒打信号”含义改变，属词义错译。

question: 如果温度降到零下，排空水系统。

options.A: When the temperature is below zero, depressurize the water system.
options.B: If the temperature drops below zero, deflate the water system.
options.C: If the temperature decreases to less than zero, drain the water system.

explanation: 【译文】If the temperature drops below zero, drain the water system.【词汇】drop below zero=降到零下，drain=排空（液体系统），water system=水系统。【解析】C正确：drain是“排空系统内液体”的标准动词，decreases to less than zero对应“降到零下”。A把drain错换成depressurize（释压），释压只放掉压力不排空液体，是完全不同的维护操作。B错换成deflate（放气），放气用于轮胎气球，排空水系统必须用drain，属词义错译。

question: 易碎接头是常闭活门。

options.A: The fragile connector is usually closed.
options.B: The quick-break switch is normally in the off position.
options.C: The frangible fitting is a normally closed valve.

explanation: 【译文】The frangible fitting is a normally closed valve.【词汇】frangible fitting=易碎接头（受撞击即断的安全件），normally closed=常闭的，valve=活门。【解析】C正确：frangible fitting和normally closed valve均为标准术语。A多处偏差：frangible换成fragile（脆弱的，非专用术语），fitting换成connector（接头，泛化），normally换成usually（通常）。B把整件译成quick-break switch（快断开关），部件类型张冠李戴，off position也偏离“常闭活门”概念。

question: 机身是半硬壳结构。

options.A: The fuselage is a semi-monocoque structure.
options.B: The fuselage is a demi-plate.
options.C: The airframe is of half-shell structure.

explanation: 【译文】The fuselage is a semi-monocoque structure.【词汇】fuselage=机身，semi-monocoque=半硬壳式（结构），structure=结构。【解析】A正确：semi-monocoque为“半硬壳式”标准术语，fuselage对应“机身”。B把semi-monocoque错换成demi-plate（半板），术语完全失真。C两处偏差：fuselage换成airframe（机体结构，含机翼尾翼，范围扩大），half-shell虽字面相近但不是“半硬壳式”的规范译名，术语不到位。

question: 雷达罩大部分材料是玻璃纤维。

options.A: Most material of the radar scope is fiberglass.
options.B: Most of the material in the radome is fiberglass.
options.C: Most of the material in the radar cap is fiberglass.

explanation: 【译文】Most of the material in the radome is fiberglass.【词汇】radome=雷达罩（radar+dome合成词），fiberglass=玻璃纤维，most of the material=大部分材料。【解析】B正确：radome为“雷达罩”的标准术语，fiberglass对应“玻璃纤维”。A把radome错换成radar scope（雷达显示器/示波器），天线罩与显示器是完全不同的设备，张冠李戴。C换成radar cap（雷达帽），生造搭配，非规范部件名，属术语错译。

question: 如有必要，加一个垫圈。

options.A: Add a bracket if necessary.
options.B: Add a fastener if necessary.
options.C: Add a washer if necessary.

explanation: 【译文】Add a washer if necessary.【词汇】add=加装，washer=垫圈，if necessary=如有必要。【解析】C正确：washer对应“垫圈”，if necessary对应“如有必要”。A把washer错换成bracket（支架），零件类型张冠李戴。B错换成fastener（紧固件），fastener是螺栓螺母铆钉等的总称，范围远大于垫圈，属范围错误。

question: 把温度写在发动机记录卡上。

options.A: Write the temperature on the engine record card.
options.B: Record the temperature of the engine until writing it on the card.
options.C: Recording the temperature of the engine is done by writing it on the card.

explanation: 【译文】Write the temperature on the engine record card.【词汇】write…on=写在…上，engine record card=发动机记录卡，temperature=温度。【解析】A正确：简洁祈使句Write…on准确对应“把温度写在记录卡上”。B把简单动作拆成“先记录温度再写到卡上”，until writing it on the card结构混乱且改变原意。C改成被动陈述“记录温度是通过写在卡上完成的”，指令变描述，祈使语气丢失且表达冗赘。

question: 逆时针旋转盖子。

options.A: Turn the cap counterclockwise.
options.B: Turn the cap clockwise.
options.C: Rotate the cap clockwise.

explanation: 【译文】Turn the cap counterclockwise.【词汇】turn=旋转，cap=盖子，counterclockwise=逆时针，clockwise=顺时针（反义）。【解析】A正确：counterclockwise对应“逆时针”。B错换成clockwise（顺时针），旋转方向完全相反——维修中拧错方向可能损坏螺纹或连接件。C同样用clockwise，方向相反，Rotate虽可表旋转但方向词错误致命，属方向相反类错译。

question: 拆下四个螺栓中的一个。

options.A: Move any of the four bolts.
options.B: Remove one of the four bolts.
options.C: Remove each of the four bolts.

explanation: 【译文】Remove one of the four bolts.【词汇】remove=拆下，one of the four=四个中的一个，bolt=螺栓。【解析】B正确：Remove对应“拆下”，one of the four对应“四个中的一个”。A两处错误：Remove换成Move（移动），“拆下”变“挪动”；one of换成any of（任何一个），数量限定关系改变。C把one of换成each of（每一个），“拆一个”变成“四个全拆”，数量完全相反。

question: 如果故障频繁发生，则进行系统测试。

options.A: If the failure takes place occasionally, the system need to be tested.
options.B: If there is a failure that seldom take place, do a system test.
options.C: If the failure occurs frequently, do a system test.

explanation: 【译文】If the failure occurs frequently, do a system test.【词汇】frequently=频繁地，occasionally=偶尔（反义），seldom=很少（反义），do a system test=进行系统测试。【解析】C正确：frequently对应“频繁地”、occurs对应“发生”、do a system test对应“进行系统测试”。A把frequently错换成occasionally（偶尔），频率副词方向相反，且need to be tested结构不如指令句贴切。B错换成seldom（很少），“很少发生”与“频繁发生”含义相反，且that seldom take place语法上应为takes。

question: 将用过的油排放到一个容器中。

options.A: Drain the used oil into a container.
options.B: Pump the used oil into a container.
options.C: Suck the used oil into a container.

explanation: 【译文】Drain the used oil into a container.【词汇】drain=排放（靠重力排液），used oil=废油，container=容器。【解析】A正确：drain为“排放”标准动词，into a container对应“到一个容器中”。B把Drain错换成Pump（泵送），泵送需动力设备驱动，与靠重力排放的方式不同。C错换成Suck（抽吸），同样是主动抽取而非排放，操作方式错译。

question: 把补片剪到正确的尺寸。

options.A: Cut the shim to the correct size.
options.B: Trim the washer to the correct size.
options.C: Cut the patch to the correct dimension.

explanation: 【译文】Cut the patch to the correct dimension.【词汇】patch=补片，cut…to size=剪到尺寸，dimension=尺寸。【解析】C正确：patch对应“补片”、Cut对应“剪”、dimension对应“尺寸”。A把patch错换成shim（薄垫片），修补用补片与调整间隙的垫片是不同材料，部件错译。B两处错误：Cut换成Trim（修剪边缘），patch换成washer（垫圈），动作与部件双错。

question: 确保客舱压力外流活门打开。

options.A: Make sure the cabin pressure relief valve is open.
options.B: Make sure the cabin pressure outflow valve is open.
options.C: Make sure the cabin pressure bypass valve is open.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure the cabin pressure outflow valve is open.【词汇】outflow valve=外流活门，cabin pressure=客舱压力，make sure=确保。【解析】B正确：outflow valve为“外流活门”专称，控制客舱空气外流的部件。A错换成relief valve（释压/安全活门），超压保护装置与外流活门功能不同。C错换成bypass valve（旁通活门），三种活门功能各异，属张冠李戴的词义错译。

question: 将其中一个空调组件电门置于“高流量”位。

options.A: Set the air conditioning switch to the up position.
options.B: Place an air conditioning switch above the normal position.
options.C: Put one of the pack switches in the HIGH position.

explanation: 【译文】Put one of the pack switches in the HIGH position.【词汇】pack switch=空调组件电门，one of=其中一个，HIGH position=“高流量”位。【解析】C正确：pack switches为空调组件电门专称，HIGH position对应“高流量”档位，one of对应“其中一个”。A两处偏差：pack switches泛化成air conditioning switch，HIGH错成up（向上），档位名称错译。B语义偏移：“放在正常位置之上”既漏译“其中一个”也无HIGH位要素，关键信息缺失。

question: 飞行计划的最高高度将受到影响。

options.A: Maximum attitude for flight planning will be affected.
options.B: Maximum altitude for flight planning will be affected.
options.C: Maximum attitude for flight planning will be effected.

explanation: 【译文】Maximum altitude for flight planning will be affected.【词汇】altitude=高度，attitude=姿态（经典易混），affected=受到影响，effected=使发生（易混）。【解析】B正确：altitude对应“高度”，affected对应“受到影响”。A把altitude错换成attitude（姿态），一字之差含义完全不同，最高高度变最高姿态。C双重错误：同样误用attitude，且把affected写成effected——effect作动词意为“使发生、实现”，“将被引起”语义不通，属近形词错误。

question: 这个程序给出了第六级低压引气叶片的检查说明。

options.A: This procedure gives the inspection sources of the sixth stage low pressure bleed air blade.
options.B: This procedure shows the inspection instruction of the sixth stage low pressure bleed air blade.
options.C: This procedure has the inspection progress of the sixth stage low pressure bleed air blade.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure gives the inspection instructions for the sixth stage low pressure bleed air blade.【词汇】inspection instruction=检查说明，sixth stage=第六级，low pressure bleed air blade=低压引气叶片。【解析】B正确：inspection instruction对应“检查说明”，虽用shows而非gives略口语，但关键名词正确。A把instruction错换成sources（来源），“检查来源”语义不通。C错换成progress（进度），“检查进度”不等于“检查说明”，属词义错译。

question: 规则总数从65条减少到53条。

options.A: Total number of rules is decreased from 65 to 53.
options.B: Total number of rules ascended from 65 to 53.
options.C: Total number of rules increased from 65 to 53.

explanation: 【译文】The total number of rules is decreased from 65 to 53.【词汇】decrease=减少，increase=增加（反义），ascend=上升（反义），from…to…=从…到…。【解析】A正确：decreased对应“减少”，from 65 to 53数值完整对应。B错换成ascended（上升），“从65上升到53”自相矛盾，方向相反。C错换成increased（增加），同样与数值下降趋势矛盾，属方向相反类错译。

question: 单词列表只突出显示主要更改。

options.A: The word list only shows major changes.
options.B: The word list only shows minor changes.
options.C: Only major changes are highlighted in the word list.

explanation: 【译文】Only major changes are highlighted in the word list.【词汇】highlight=突出显示，major=主要的，minor=次要的（反义），word list=单词列表。【解析】C正确：highlighted直接对应“突出显示”，major对应“主要的”，only位置准确表达“只突出主要更改”。A语义相近但用shows（显示）弱化了highlighted“突出强调”的含义，取舍上C更完整准确。B把major错换成minor（次要的），方向相反：突出次要更改与题意相悖。

question: 在STE中,不允许使用小写字母的单词。

options.A: A word in lowercase letters is unapproved in STE.
options.B: A word in bold letters is unapproved in STE.
options.C: A word in uppercase letters is not approved in STE.

explanation: 【译文】A word in lowercase letters is unapproved in STE.【词汇】lowercase=小写字母，unapproved=不允许的/未批准的，bold=粗体，uppercase=大写。【解析】A正确：lowercase对应“小写字母”，unapproved对应“不允许”。B把lowercase换成bold（粗体），词义错译；C把lowercase换成uppercase（大写），与“小写”恰好相反，属方向相反错误。

question: 在程序句中，冒号前最多可以使用20个单词。

options.A: In procedural sentences, you can use a maximum of 20 words before the comma.
options.B: In procedural sentences, you can use a maximum of 20 words before the colon.
options.C: In procedural sentences, you can use at least 20 words before the full stop.

explanation: 【译文】In procedural sentences, you can use a maximum of 20 words before the colon.【词汇】procedural sentence=程序句，a maximum of=最多，colon=冒号，comma=逗号，full stop=句号。【解析】B正确：a maximum of 20 words=最多20个单词，before the colon=在冒号前。A把colon错译为comma（逗号），标点张冠李戴；C两处错误：把a maximum of换成at least（至少，方向相反），把colon换成full stop（句号）。

question: 将句子的第一部分与垂直列表中的后续项分开.

options.A: Separate the first part of the sentence as the subsequent items in the lateral list.
options.B: Apart the first part of the sentence from the subsequent items in the horizontal list.
options.C: Divide the first part of the sentence from the subsequent items in the vertical list.

explanation: 【译文】Divide the first part of the sentence from the subsequent items in the vertical list.【词汇】divide...from...=把…与…分开，vertical list=垂直列表，subsequent=后续的，lateral=侧向的。【解析】C正确：divide...from对应“与…分开”，vertical对应“垂直列表”。A两处错误：vertical换成lateral（侧向的），from换成as（作为），逻辑关系改变；B两处错误：vertical换成horizontal（水平的），且apart是副词不能作谓语动词，属语法错误。

question: 我们建议你不要在机库里执行此程序。

options.A: We advice you not do this procedure in the hangar.
options.B: We recommend that you do not perform this procedure in the hangar.
options.C: We are against perform this procedure in the hangar.

explanation: 【译文】We recommend that you do not perform this procedure in the hangar.【词汇】recommend=建议，perform=执行，hangar=机库，advice=建议（名词）。【解析】B正确：recommend that you do not perform准确对应“建议你不要执行”，虚拟结构规范。A两处错误：advice是名词不能作谓语，应用动词recommend/advise，且“not do”缺to结构错误；C把recommend换成are against（反对），词义相反，且against后接perform形式错误。

question: 通气油箱排放单向活门是在1号和2号主油箱外侧油箱端部肋上。

options.A: A surge tank drain single valve is on the outside fuel tank end rib in main tank 1 and main tank 2.
options.B: A surge tank drain one way value is on the inboard fuel tank end rib in main tank 1 and main tank 2.
options.C:
A surge tank drain check valve is on the outboard fuel tank end rib in main
tank 1 and main tank 2.

explanation: 【译文】A surge tank drain check valve is on the outboard fuel tank end rib in main tank 1 and main tank 2.【词汇】surge tank=通气油箱，check valve=单向活门，outboard=外侧的。【解析】C正确：check valve=单向活门，outboard=外侧，术语全对应。A两处错误：check valve换成single valve（单个活门），outboard换成不规范的outside；B两处错误：check valve写成one way value（拼写错误），outboard换成inboard（内侧，方向相反）。

question: 缓慢增加压力（每分钟不超过一圈）。

options.A: Augment the pressure slowly (no less than one turn each minute).
options.B: Increase the pressure slowly (not more than one turn each minute).
options.C: Release the pressure slowly (not more than one turn each minute).

explanation: 【译文】Increase the pressure slowly (not more than one turn each minute).【词汇】increase=增加，not more than=不超过，turn=圈（转动量），release=释放。【解析】B正确：increase=增加，not more than one turn=不超过一圈，两考点全对应。A两处错误：not more than换成no less than（不少于，方向相反），augment非手册常用批准动词；C把increase换成release（释放），操作方向完全相反。

question: 一般来说，在描述飞机或它的系统时，应该使用第三人称措辞。

options.A: When described the aircraft and its system, you should always use third people talking.
options.B: Generally, in describing the airplane or its system, third person wording should be used.
options.C: When you describing the airplane systems, third person mood shall be used.

explanation: 【译文】Generally, in describing the airplane or its system, third person wording should be used.【词汇】generally=一般来说，third person wording=第三人称措辞，describe=描述。【解析】B正确：generally=一般来说，third person wording=第三人称措辞，被动语态“should be used”对应“应使用”。A语法错误：When described从句缺逻辑主语，third people talking系生造表达；C语法错误：When you describing缺be动词，且wording（措辞）错译为mood（语气/情态）。

question: 简要描述和说明各种新型飞行仪表的工作原理。

options.A: Briefly describe and explain principle of operation of any new kinds of flight instruments.
options.B: The working principles of various new flight gauges are easily introduced and expressed.
options.C: The new types of flight facilities should be described and explained shortly.

explanation: 【译文】Briefly describe and explain the principle of operation of new types of flight instruments.【词汇】briefly=简要地，flight instruments=飞行仪表，principle of operation=工作原理。【解析】A正确：briefly=简要，describe and explain=描述和说明，instruments=仪表，考点全对应。B多处错误：instruments换成gauges，briefly换成easily（容易地），祈使句改成被动句；C两处错误：instruments换成facilities（设施），briefly换成shortly（不久，词义错译）。

question: 解释如何检查它们是否正常运行，以及如何识别故障。

options.A: Explain check them whether normal or not, and how to identify a fault.
options.B: Make clear that if they operate properly and how to isolate the malfunction.
options.C: Explain how to check them for proper operation and how to recognize a malfunction.

explanation: 【译文】Explain how to check them for proper operation and how to recognize a malfunction.【词汇】proper operation=正常运行，recognize=识别，malfunction=故障。【解析】C正确：check them for proper operation=检查是否正常运行，recognize a malfunction=识别故障，两个how to结构并列规范。A语法混乱：Explain check them whether normal or not多个谓语动词直接相连；B词义错译：recognize换成isolate（隔离），Make clear that if...结构不成立。

question: 找到与EICAS状态信息一起显示的相关维修信息。

options.A: Find the related EICAS status message which present with the maintenance information .
options.B: Find the correlated maintenance message that shows with the EICAS status message.
options.C: Find the applicable maintenance message displaying with the EICAS status message.

explanation: 【译文】Find the applicable maintenance message displayed together with the EICAS status message.【词汇】applicable=相关的/适用的，maintenance message=维修信息，EICAS status message=EICAS状态信息。【解析】C正确：被找对象是“维修信息”，它“随EICAS状态信息一起显示”，applicable对应“相关”，displaying with对应“一起显示”，主客关系正确。A主宾颠倒：变成“与维修信息一起显示的EICAS状态信息”，张冠李戴；B的correlated多指数据关联，that shows with语法生硬，不如C准确。

question: 技术动词必须遵守与STE中其他被批准的动词相同的规则。

options.A: Technical verbs are the same as other approved verbs in STE to obey the rules .
options.B: Technical verbs must obey the same rules as other approved verbs in STE.
options.C: The approved verbs are required to obey the rules in STE as well as the technical verbs.

explanation: 【译文】Technical verbs must obey the same rules as other approved verbs in STE.【词汇】technical verb=技术动词，obey=遵守，approved=被批准的，the same...as=与…相同的。【解析】B正确：must obey the same rules as完整对应“必须遵守与…相同的规则”，比较结构规范。A句式错误：are the same as...to obey the rules把比较结构和目的结构错误混接，逻辑不通；C主宾颠倒：变成“被批准的动词被要求遵守规则”，主语从technical verbs换成approved verbs，属逻辑错误。

question: 你可以用技术动词的过去分词作形容词。

options.A: You can use the past form of technical verbs as adjectives.
options.B: You can use the past tense form of technical verbs as adverbs.
options.C: You can use the past participle of technical verbs as adjectives.

explanation: 【译文】You can use the past participle of technical verbs as adjectives.【词汇】past participle=过去分词，adjective=形容词，past tense=过去时，adverb=副词。【解析】C正确：past participle=过去分词，as adjectives=作形容词，两个语法术语全对应。A把past participle换成past form（过去式），语法概念不同，属词义错译；B两处错误：past participle换成past tense form（过去时形式），adjectives换成adverbs（副词），词类概念全错。

question: STE词典给出了一个经过批准的有不同词性的替代词。

options.A: The STE dictionary gives an approved alternative that has a different part of speech.
options.B: The STE dictionary gives an approving alternative word has a different word class.
options.C: The English dictionary gives an approved alternative word with a different part of speech.

explanation: 【译文】The STE dictionary gives an approved alternative that has a different part of speech.【词汇】STE dictionary=STE词典，approved=经批准的，alternative=替代词，part of speech=词性。【解析】A正确：approved alternative=经批准的替代词，different part of speech=不同词性，that定语从句规范。B两处错误：approved换成approving（赞同的，主被动含义相反），word has缺关系词属语法错误；C把STE dictionary换成English dictionary，词典对象张冠李戴。

question: 导言中应包括按主题字母顺序排列的索引。

options.A: The introduction should be included in an alphabetical index by subject.
options.B: An alphabetical index by subject is to be included in the introduction.
options.C: The introduction includes an alphabetical index subject.

explanation: 【译文】An alphabetical index by subject is to be included in the introduction.【词汇】introduction=导言，alphabetical index=字母顺序索引，by subject=按主题，be included in=被包括在。【解析】B正确：以index为主语“应被包括在导言中”，被动语态方向正确，by subject=按主题。A主宾颠倒：变成“导言被包括在索引中”，逻辑方向相反；C两处问题：改用主动includes尚可接受，但删去by写成index subject，“按主题的字母索引”语义残缺。

question: 在某些情况下，电线有颜色编码，这些应该在线路图上标明。

options.A: These must be shown on the wiring diagram under some specific conditions and wires are colour coded.
options.B: Wires are coded in color in certain condition and these should be marked on the wiring diagram.
options.C: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be indicated on the wiring diagram.

explanation: 【译文】In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be indicated on the wiring diagram.【词汇】in some cases=在某些情况下，color coded=颜色编码，wiring diagram=线路图。【解析】C正确：in some cases=在某些情况下，color coded=颜色编码，be indicated on the wiring diagram=在线路图上标明。A语序混乱：条件状语移到句尾，两分句堆叠致逻辑不清；B两处瑕疵：coded in color不规范，in certain condition应为conditions，属语法错误。

question: 在涡轮前过热热电偶上安装终端接线片。

options.A: Install the point tags on the negative overheat thermocouple of the turbine.
options.B: Install the terminal tags on the forward overheat thermocouple of the turbine.
options.C: Install the port tags on the rearward overheat thermocouple of the turbine.

explanation: 【译文】Install the terminal tags on the forward overheat thermocouple of the turbine.【词汇】terminal tag=终端接线片，forward=前部的，overheat thermocouple=过热热电偶，rearward=后部的。【解析】B正确：terminal tags=终端接线片，forward=（涡轮）前部，方位与部件全对应。A两处错误：forward换成negative（负极的），terminal tags换成point tags（点标记）；C两处错误：forward换成rearward（后部，方向相反），terminal换成port（端口），部件与方位均错。

question: 在正文的其余部分，使用了相关的经批准的缩写。

options.A: In the remaining parts of the text, the related approved abbreviations are used.
options.B: In the attached parts of the text, the related disapproved abbreviations are used.
options.C: In the remaining parts of the text, the related approved abstracts are used.

explanation: 【译文】In the remaining parts of the text, the related approved abbreviations are used.【词汇】remaining=其余的，approved abbreviations=经批准的缩写，abstract=摘要，disapproved=不被批准的。【解析】A正确：remaining parts of the text=正文的其余部分，related approved abbreviations=相关的经批准的缩写。B两处错误：remaining换成attached（附加的），approved换成disapproved（不被批准，方向相反）；C把abbreviations换成abstracts（摘要），形近词词义错译。

question: 溶剂会对油漆造成损坏。

options.A: Solvents can avoid damage to paint.
options.B: Solvents can cause damage to paint.
options.C: Solution can cause damage to paint.

explanation: 【译文】Solvents can cause damage to paint.【词汇】solvent=溶剂，cause damage=造成损坏，paint=油漆，solution=溶液。【解析】B正确：solvents=溶剂，cause damage to paint=对油漆造成损坏，因果方向正确。A把cause换成avoid（避免），“造成损坏”变成“避免损坏”，方向相反；C把solvents（溶剂）换成solution（溶液），形近但所指不同，属词义错译。

question: 操作员调整了连杆。

options.A: The operator reassembled the linkage.
options.B: The operator adjusted the cable.
options.C: The operator adjusted the linkage.

explanation: 【译文】The operator adjusted the linkage.【词汇】operator=操作员，adjust=调整，linkage=连杆，reassemble=重新组装，cable=钢索。【解析】C正确：adjusted=调整，linkage=连杆，两个考点词全部对应。A把adjusted换成reassembled（重新组装），维修动作张冠李戴；B把linkage换成cable（钢索），被调部件错译，adjusted一词虽保留但宾语错误。

question: 你可以调节音量控制。

options.A: You can adjust the volume control.
options.B: You can adjust the value control.
options.C: You can override the voice control.

explanation: 【译文】You can adjust the volume control.【词汇】volume control=音量控制，adjust=调节，value=数值，override=超控/覆盖。【解析】A正确：volume=音量，adjust=调节，control对象准确。B把volume换成value（数值），形近词错译，控制对象改变；C两处错误：volume换成voice（语音），adjust换成override（超控），动作和对象全部错译。

question: 安装座垫之前先安装座椅

options.A: Install the cushion before you install the seat.
options.B: Install the seat before you install the cushion.
options.C: Install the seat after you install the cushion.

explanation: 【译文】Install the seat before you install the cushion.【词汇】seat=座椅，cushion=座垫，before=在…之前，after=在…之后。【解析】B正确：先install the seat再install the cushion，before准确体现“先装座椅后装座垫”的次序。A把座椅与座垫顺序写反，变成先装座垫；C把before换成after，时间关系相反，含义等价于先装座垫后装座椅。

question: 当门开着时要小心。

options.A: Be patient while the door is opening.
options.B: Be aware of the door when it  is opening.
options.C: Be careful while the door is opening.

explanation: 【译文】Be careful while the door is opening.【词汇】be careful=小心，while=当…时候，be aware of=注意到，patient=有耐心的。【解析】C正确：be careful=小心，while the door is opening=当门开着时，警示语气与题干一致。A把careful换成patient（耐心的），品质词词义错译；B把careful换成aware of（注意到），“注意门”不等于“小心”，警惕含义不足且搭配对象改变。

question: 在使用危险品之前，请遵守以下注意事项：

options.A: Before you use dangerous materials, obey these precautions:
options.B: Before you use dangerous materials, omit these precautions:
options.C: Before you use dangerous materials, disobey these precautions:

explanation: 【译文】Before you use dangerous materials, obey these precautions:【词汇】dangerous materials=危险品，obey=遵守，precaution=注意事项，disobey=违反。【解析】A正确：before you use=在使用…之前，obey these precautions=遵守这些注意事项。B把obey换成omit（省略/遗漏），动作方向相反；C把obey换成disobey（不遵守），前缀dis-使语义完全反转，属方向相反错误。

question: 确保工作区域有足够的空气流通。

options.A: Make sure that there is supplied airflow in the work area.
options.B: Make sure that there is sufficient airflow in the work area.
options.C: Make sure that there is efficient airflow in the work area.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that there is sufficient airflow in the work area.【词汇】make sure=确保，sufficient=足够的，airflow=空气流通，efficient=高效的。【解析】B正确：sufficient airflow=足够的空气流通，there is结构对应“有”。A把sufficient换成supplied（被供应的），词性词义均不符；C把sufficient换成efficient（高效的），形近词错译，“高效的气流”不等于“足够的空气流通”。

question: 穿戴好面罩和防护服。

options.A: Put down a face mask and protective clothing.
options.B: Put on a face goggle and protective clothing.
options.C: Put on a face mask and protective clothing.

explanation: 【译文】Put on a face mask and protective clothing.【词汇】put on=穿戴，face mask=面罩，protective clothing=防护服，goggle=护目镜。【解析】C正确：put on=穿戴，face mask=面罩，protective clothing=防护服，动作与两件用品全对应。A把put on换成put down（放下），动作恰好相反；B把face mask换成face goggle（护目镜），防护用品张冠李戴，且mask与goggle是不同护具。

question: 中央油箱中的燃油总量为5000磅。

options.A: The total quantity of fuel in the center tank is 5000 lb.
options.B: The Total Fuel Quantity of the main tank is 5000 pounds.
options.C: The total fuel consumption from the center tank is 5000 pounds.

explanation: 【译文】The total quantity of fuel in the center tank is 5000 lb.【词汇】total quantity=总量，center tank=中央油箱，consumption=消耗量，main tank=主油箱。【解析】A正确：total quantity of fuel=燃油总量，center tank=中央油箱，数值单位对应。B把center tank换成main tank（主油箱），油箱位置错译；C把quantity换成consumption（消耗量），“燃油总量”变成“燃油消耗量”，词义错译。

question: 在裸露的金属上涂一薄层密封胶。

options.A: Spread a thin layer of sealing compound with a brush on the surface of the bare metal.
options.B: Spray a thin layer of sealing compound on the metal sheet.
options.C: Apply a thin layer of sealant on the bare metal.

explanation: 【译文】Apply a thin layer of sealant on the bare metal.【词汇】apply=涂覆，thin layer=薄层，sealant=密封胶，bare metal=裸露金属。【解析】C正确：apply=涂，a thin layer of sealant=一薄层密封胶，bare metal=裸露金属，简洁准确。A两处问题：with a brush属题干没有的添加信息，且on the surface of the bare metal表达冗赘；B两处错误：apply换成spray（喷涂，工艺方式不同），bare metal换成metal sheet（金属板），基体表面错译。

question: 底漆层厚度必须介于0.05毫米到0.06毫米之间。

options.A: The coating thickness must be more than 0.05mm and less than 0.06mm.
options.B: The thickness of the second coating layer must be 0.05mm and 0.06mm.
options.C: The thickness of primer layer must be between 0.05 mm and 0.06 mm.

explanation: 【译文】The thickness of the primer layer must be between 0.05 mm and 0.06 mm.【词汇】primer layer=底漆层，thickness=厚度，between...and...=介于…之间。【解析】C正确：primer layer=底漆层，between 0.05 mm and 0.06 mm=介于0.05至0.06毫米之间，区间表达规范。A漏译primer（底漆），只说coating（涂层），要素缺失；B两处错误：primer layer换成second coating layer（第二层涂层），must be 0.05mm and 0.06mm变成须等于两个值而非取值区间，逻辑错误。

question: 机身上有三个千斤顶顶点。

options.A: There are three jacks onboard the fuselage.
options.B: There are three jacking adapters on the fuselage.
options.C: There are three jacking points on the fuselage.

explanation: 【译文】There are three jacking points on the fuselage.【词汇】jacking point=千斤顶顶点/顶升点，fuselage=机身，adapter=适配器，jack=千斤顶。【解析】C正确：jacking points=千斤顶顶点，on the fuselage=在机身上，there are对应“有”。A把jacking points换成jacks（千斤顶），“顶点”变成设备本身，张冠李戴；B把points换成adapters（适配接头），部件类型错译。

question: 断开所有测试不需要的系统。

options.A: Turn off all the unnecessary systems.
options.B: Disconnect all the systems which are not necessary for the test.
options.C: Disconnect all testing systems as necessary.

explanation: 【译文】Disconnect all the systems which are not necessary for the test.【词汇】disconnect=断开，necessary for the test=测试所需的，turn off=关闭。【解析】B正确：disconnect=断开，systems not necessary for the test=测试不需要的系统，限定从句完整。A两处错误：disconnect换成turn off（关闭，动作不同），unnecessary漏掉for the test限定，范围扩大；C两处错误：限定从句改成testing systems（测试系统），as necessary=按需要，与“不需要的”含义相反。

question: 在大翼除冰系统安装伸缩管。

options.A: Reinstall the supply ducts in the wing de-icing system.
options.B: Install the telescopic ducts in the wing de-icing system.
options.C: Install the elastic ducts in the wing anti-icing system.

explanation: 【译文】Install the telescopic ducts in the wing de-icing system.【词汇】telescopic duct=伸缩管，wing de-icing system=大翼除冰系统，anti-icing=防冰，elastic=弹性的。【解析】B正确：telescopic ducts=伸缩管，de-icing=除冰（去除已形成的冰），install=安装。A两处错误：install换成reinstall（重新安装），telescopic ducts换成supply ducts（供气导管）；C两处错误：telescopic换成elastic（弹性的），de-icing换成anti-icing（防冰，预防结冰，时机不同）。

question: 取液压油油样。

options.A: Get a sample of hydraulic fluid.
options.B: Scavenge the hydraulic fluid.
options.C: Service the hydraulic reservoirs.

explanation: 【译文】Get a sample of hydraulic fluid.【词汇】sample=样品，hydraulic fluid=液压油，scavenge=清除残液，service=勤务。【解析】A正确：get a sample of=取…的样品，hydraulic fluid=液压油，对应“取液压油油样”。B的scavenge指抽回/清除系统内残余油液，不是“取样”，动作词义错译；C的service the hydraulic reservoirs=给液压油箱做勤务，对象从“油样”变成“油箱”，张冠李戴。

question: 确保襟翼位置对称。

options.A: Make sure that the position of the wing flaps is symmetrical.
options.B: Make sure that the wing flaps must move symmetrically at all time.
options.C: The wing flaps are moved to the symmetrical position.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the position of the wing flaps is symmetrical.【词汇】wing flap=襟翼，symmetrical=对称的，position=位置，symmetrically=对称地。【解析】A正确：position of the wing flaps=襟翼位置，is symmetrical=是对称的，对应“位置对称”这一状态检查。B把“位置对称”改成“必须始终对称移动”（move symmetrically at all time），状态误作动作要求；C漏译make sure（确保），且“被移动到对称位置”强调移动结果，与“位置本身对称”语义不同。

question: 该规范给出了继电器、二极管和系统其他部件的符号。

options.A: The specification gives the symbols for relays, diodes, and other parts of the system.
options.B: The specification gives the requirement for markings on relay, triode and other parts of the system.
options.C: The specification excludes symbols for relays, diodes, and other system parts.

explanation: 【译文】The specification gives the symbols for relays, diodes, and other parts of the system.【词汇】specification=规范，symbol=符号，relay=继电器，diode=二极管，triode=三极管。【解析】A正确：symbols for relays, diodes=继电器、二极管的符号，other parts of the system=系统其他部件，全部对应。B两处错误：symbols换成requirement for markings（标记要求），diodes换成triode（三极管，器件错译）；C把gives换成excludes（排除/不含），“给出”变成“排除”，方向相反。

question: 不要用普通螺母替代自锁螺母。

options.A: Do not replace the self-locking nuts with plain nuts.
options.B: Do not use a general fastener instead of a self-locking one.
options.C: The general purpose nut is interchangeable with the self-locking nut.

explanation: 【译文】Do not replace the self-locking nuts with plain nuts.【词汇】replace A with B=用B替代A（A被换下），self-locking nut=自锁螺母，plain nut=普通螺母，interchangeable=可互换的。【解析】A正确：replace the self-locking nuts with plain nuts=用普通螺母替代自锁螺母，替代方向与题干完全一致。B把plain nuts泛化成general fastener（通用紧固件），范围扩大；C把禁令改成“普通螺母与自锁螺母可互换”，禁止含义反转，属方向相反错误。

question: 不要给出含糊、概括的信息。

options.A: Do not give vague, general information.
options.B: Do not provide clear, general information.
options.C: Do not list complex, valid information.

explanation: 【译文】Do not give vague, general information.【词汇】vague=含糊的，general=概括的，information=信息，valid=有效的。【解析】A正确：vague=含糊，general=概括，两个定语与题干完全对应。B把vague换成clear（清晰的），定语词义相反；C把vague换成complex（复杂的）、general information换成valid information（有效信息），两个定语均错译，整句含义走样。

question: 每个句子最多20个单词。

options.A: Use a minimum of 20 words in each sentence.
options.B: Use a maximum of 20 words in each sentence.
options.C: Use more than 20 words in each sentence.

explanation: 【译文】Use a maximum of 20 words in each sentence.【词汇】a maximum of=最多，a minimum of=最少，more than=超过，each sentence=每个句子。【解析】B正确：a maximum of 20 words=最多20个单词，上限表达准确。A把maximum换成minimum（最少），限值方向相反；C的more than 20 words=超过20个单词，与“最多20个”直接矛盾，属方向相反错误。

question: 写出注释只是给出信息，而非指令。

options.A: Write notes only to give content, not commands.
options.B: Write notes only to give information, not instructions.
options.C: Write cautions only to give information, not orders.

explanation: 【译文】Write notes only to give information, not instructions.【词汇】note=注释，information=信息，instruction=指令/指示，command=命令，caution=注意事项。【解析】B正确：notes=注释，give information=给出信息，not instructions=而非指令，三处考点全对应。A两处错误：information换成content（内容），instructions换成commands（命令，语气更强）；C把notes换成cautions（注意事项/告诫），注释类别错译，且orders替换instructions语义偏移。

question: 不要将不同主题的内容放在同一段落中。

options.A: Do not put different topics in the same paragraph.
options.B: Do not provide different meanings in the same parentheses.
options.C: Do not arrange different contents in the same chapter.

explanation: 【译文】Do not put different topics in the same paragraph.【词汇】topic=主题，paragraph=段落，the same=同一个，parentheses=括号。【解析】A正确：different topics=不同主题的内容，in the same paragraph=在同一段落中。B两处错误：topics换成meanings（含义），paragraph换成parentheses（括号/插入语）；C把paragraph换成chapter（章节），篇幅单位错译，段落层级被夸大。

question: 如果它们掉落，会出现永久性损坏。

options.A: If they fail, temporary damage can occur.
options.B: If they drop, permanent injury can occur.
options.C: If they fall, permanent damage can occur.

explanation: 【译文】If they fall, permanent damage can occur.【词汇】fall=掉落，permanent=永久性的，damage=损坏，temporary=临时的，injury=伤害。【解析】C正确：fall=掉落，permanent damage=永久性损坏，can occur=会出现。A两处错误：fall换成fail（失效，形近词错译），permanent换成temporary（临时的，方向相反）；B的drop虽接近掉落，但damage换成injury（人身伤害），部件损坏被误作人员受伤，对象错译。

question: 有必要对这些区域进行频繁检查。

options.A: It is necessary to generally check these areas.
options.B: It is imperative to regularly inspect these areas.
options.C: Frequent inspection of these areas is necessary.

explanation: 【译文】Frequent inspection of these areas is necessary.【词汇】frequent=频繁的，inspection=检查，necessary=有必要的，imperative=绝对必要的。【解析】C正确：frequent inspection=频繁检查，is necessary=有必要，主谓结构与题干对应。A把frequent换成generally（一般地），频率要素错译；B两处问题：imperative（必须）语气强于necessary，regularly（定期地）不等于“频繁”，时间频率概念错译。

question: 暂时连接护盖。

options.A: Connect the cover immediately.
options.B: Attach the cover temporarily.
options.C: Install the cover permanently.

explanation: 【译文】Attach the cover temporarily.【词汇】attach=连接/装上，cover=护盖，temporarily=暂时地，permanently=永久地。【解析】B正确：attach the cover=连接护盖，temporarily=暂时，动作与时间限定全对应。A把temporarily换成immediately（立即），时间概念错译；C把temporarily换成permanently（永久地），时间含义恰好相反，属方向相反错误。

question: 仅授权人员才能执行安装程序。

options.A: Only approved personnel can do the installation procedure.
