options.B: Only releasing personnel can do the installation procedure.
options.C: Only authorized personnel can do the replacement procedure.

explanation: 【译文】Only approved personnel can do the installation procedure.【词汇】approved personnel=批准/授权人员，installation procedure=安装程序，only=仅，releasing personnel=放行人员。【解析】A正确：only approved personnel=仅授权人员，installation procedure=安装程序，两处限定全对应。B把approved换成releasing（放行人员），人员资质类别错译；C的authorized personnel虽正确，但installation换成replacement（更换），程序类型错译。

question: 温度调节是自动的。

options.A: Humidity adjustment is manual.
options.B: Pressure adjustment is automatic.
options.C: Temperature adjustment is automatic.

explanation: 【译文】Temperature adjustment is automatic.【词汇】temperature=温度，adjustment=调节，automatic=自动的，manual=人工的。【解析】C正确：temperature adjustment=温度调节，automatic=自动的，主语和表语全对应。A两处错误：temperature换成humidity（湿度），automatic换成manual（人工的，方向相反）；B把temperature换成pressure（压力），被调节对象错译，automatic一词虽对但主语已变。

question: 每一节应从右侧页面开始。

options.A: Each section shall be started on a right-hand page.
options.B: Each section shall be stated on a left-hand page.
options.C: Each section shall be proceeded from a right-hand column.

explanation: 【译文】Each section shall be started on a right-hand page.【词汇】section=节，right-hand page=右侧页面，shall=应，column=栏。【解析】A正确：each section=每一节，be started on a right-hand page=从右侧页面开始，版面方位准确。B两处错误：started换成stated（陈述，形近词错译），right-hand换成left-hand（左侧，方向相反）；C两处错误：started换成proceeded（继续进行），page换成column（栏目），版面单位错译。

question: 用大量肥皂水清洗窗户。

options.A: Clean window using much quantities of soap and water.
options.B: Clean window using liberal quantities of soap and water.
options.C: Clean window with large quantities of soap and water.

explanation: 【译文】Clean the window using liberal quantities of soap and water.【词汇】liberal quantities=大量（手册惯用语），soap and water=肥皂水，clean=清洗。【解析】B正确：liberal quantities of soap and water是航空手册中“大量肥皂水”的规范惯用表达。A的much quantities搭配错误（much不接可数复数quantities），属语法错误；C的large quantities语义相近，但liberal quantities为手册标准措辞，且using比with更贴合作业语境，故取B。

question: 急拉氧气面罩来获取氧气。

options.A: Take the oxygen mask in a hurry to start the flow of oxygen.
options.B: Pull the oxygen mask with a sudden movement to start the flow of oxygen.
options.C: Pull the oxygen mask in a must to start the flow of oxygen.

explanation: 【译文】Pull the oxygen mask with a sudden movement to start the flow of oxygen.【词汇】oxygen mask=氧气面罩，with a sudden movement=以突然的动作（急拉），start the flow of oxygen=开始供氧。【解析】B正确：pull=拉，with a sudden movement对应“急拉”的爆发式动作方式，start the flow of oxygen=获取氧气。A两处偏差：pull换成take（拿取），力度不符，in a hurry=匆忙而非“用力急拉”；C的in a must系生造搭配，无此用法，属语法错误。

question: 把插头插到插座上。

options.A: Torsion the plug to the receptacle
options.B: Mate the plug to the receptacle
options.C: Connect the plug to the receptacle

explanation: 【译文】Mate the plug to the receptacle.【词汇】mate=配接/插接（插头与插座对接），plug=插头，receptacle=插座，torsion=扭转。【解析】B正确：mate the plug to the receptacle准确表达插头插入插座的阴阳配接动作。A把mate换成torsion（扭转），动作方式完全不符；C的connect虽可表连接，但只泛指接通，未体现插头插入插座的对插特征，精确性不及mate。

question: 在批准例子中的词并不是强制性的。

options.A: The word given in the approved examples is not controlled
options.B: The word given in the approved examples is not mandatory
options.C: The word given in the approved examples is not a must

explanation: 【译文】The word given in the approved examples is not mandatory.【词汇】approved example=批准的例子，mandatory=强制性的，controlled=受控的，must=必须（口语）。【解析】B正确：mandatory=强制性的，正式规范用词与题干对应。A把mandatory换成controlled（受控制的），“受控”不等于“强制”，词义错译；C的is not a must属口语表达，正式手册用语应选mandatory，语体不规范。

question: 确保螺栓拧紧。

options.A: Make sure that the bolts are tight.
options.B: Make sure that the screws are securely installed.
options.C: Make sure that the bolts are loose.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the bolts are tight.【词汇】bolt=螺栓，tight=紧固的，screw=螺钉，loose=松动的。【解析】A正确：the bolts are tight=螺栓处于紧固状态，对应“螺栓拧紧”。B两处偏差：bolts换成screws（螺钉），tight换成securely installed（安装牢固），被检对象和状态点均改变；C把tight换成loose（松动），检查标准恰好相反，属方向相反错误。

question: 将零件运输到大修车间。

options.A: Transport the part to the overhaul shop.
options.B: Transport the part to the maintenance shop.
options.C: Remove the part to the overhaul shop.

explanation: 【译文】Transport the part to the overhaul shop.【词汇】transport=运输，overhaul shop=大修车间，maintenance shop=维修车间，remove=拆下。【解析】A正确：transport=运输，overhaul shop=大修车间，动作与目的地全对应。B把overhaul shop换成maintenance shop（维修车间），车间等级错译；C把transport换成remove（拆下），“运输到车间”变成“拆到车间”，动作错译且搭配不通。

question: 重启程序之前再校正这个错误

options.A: Check the defect before you start the procedure again.
options.B: Rectify the defect before you start the procedure again.
options.C: Define the defect before you start the procedure again.

explanation: 【译文】Rectify the defect before you start the procedure again.【词汇】rectify=纠正/校正，defect=缺陷/错误，before=在…之前，start...again=重新开始。【解析】B正确：rectify the defect=校正这个错误，before you start the procedure again=重启程序之前，两考点全对应。A把rectify换成check（检查），只查不改，动作不完整；C把rectify换成define（定义），“校正”变成“下定义”，词义错译。

question: 不要摇晃物体

options.A: Do not jar the instruments
options.B: Do not pivot the instruments
options.C: Do not shake the instruments

explanation: 【译文】Do not shake the instruments.【词汇】shake=摇晃，jar=震动/猛撞，pivot=绕轴枢转。【解析】C正确：shake=摇晃，直接对应题干动作，力度与方式一致。A的jar指猛烈震动、撞击，动作强度和方式与“摇晃”不同，词义错译；B的pivot指绕支点枢转，是定轴转动而非摇晃，动作方式错译。（注：题干“物体”与选项instruments“仪器”用词不完全一致，但不影响选项判断。）

question: 在吊起齿轮箱之前组装好可移动的起重机

options.A: Assemble the movable car before you lift the gearbox
options.B: Assemble the movable hoist before you lift the gearbox
options.C: Assemble the movable handle before you lift the gearbox

explanation: 【译文】Assemble the movable hoist before you lift the gearbox.【词汇】assemble=组装，movable hoist=可移动起重机，lift=吊起，gearbox=齿轮箱。【解析】B正确：movable hoist=可移动的起重机，before you lift the gearbox=吊起齿轮箱之前，设备与顺序全对应。A把hoist换成car（小车），起重设备错译；C把hoist换成handle（手柄），设备变成零件，张冠李戴。

question: 在同样的温度下固化密封胶。

options.A: Solid the sealant at a peripheral temperature.
options.B: Cure the sealant at a uniform temperature.
options.C: Solid the sealant at the same temperature.

explanation: 【译文】Cure the sealant at a uniform temperature.【词汇】cure=固化（密封胶熟化），sealant=密封胶，uniform temperature=均匀/恒定温度，solidify=使固化。【解析】B正确：cure是密封胶“固化”的标准动词，uniform temperature对应“同样的（恒定一致的）温度”。A两处错误：cure换成solid（形容词误作动词，固化应为solidify），uniform换成peripheral（外围的）；C的solid同样动词不成立，虽same temperature字面接近但整体语法错误，故取B。

question: 不要为了缩短句子而省略冠词，因为这会导致歧义。

options.A: Do not omit articles to make the sentence shorter, because this can cause ambiguity.
options.B: Do not make the sentence shorter to omit articles, because this can cause ambiguity.
options.C: Do not omit articles to avoid ambiguity, because this can make the sentence shorter.

explanation: 【译文】Do not omit articles to make the sentence shorter, because this can cause ambiguity.【词汇】omit=省略，article=冠词，ambiguity=歧义，make...shorter=使…缩短。【解析】A正确：省略冠词的目的是缩短句子，结果是导致歧义，目的-结果链条与题干一致。B把目的关系颠倒：变成“为了省略冠词而缩短句子”，因果错位；C把结果与目的对调：省略冠词的目的成了避免歧义，歧义反而变成缩短句子的原因，逻辑全反。

question: 程序包含告诉你如何完成一项任务的指令。

options.A: Procedures contain tasks that give instructions on how to perform them.
options.B: Procedures contain general instructions that show you how to do tasks.
options.C: Procedures contain instructions that tell you how to do a task.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures contain instructions that tell you how to do a task.【词汇】procedure=程序，instruction=指令，task=任务，contain=包含。【解析】C正确：程序包含的是instructions（指令），指令的功能是tell you how to do a task（告诉你如何完成一项任务），包含层级正确。A逻辑颠倒：程序包含的变成tasks，再由tasks给出instructions，主客关系混乱；B两处偏差：多出general（概括的）限定，show you how to do tasks用复数tasks且show不如tell贴切。

question: 恢复电池容量至要求的标准。

options.A: Return battery capacity to assigned standard.
options.B: Replace battery capacity to required standard.
options.C: Restore battery capacity to required standard.

explanation: 【译文】Restore battery capacity to required standard.【词汇】restore=恢复，battery capacity=电池容量，required standard=要求的标准，replace=更换。【解析】C正确：restore=恢复，required standard=要求的标准，restore...to搭配对应“恢复至标准”。A把required换成assigned（指定的），标准的属性错译；B把restore换成replace（更换），“恢复容量”变成“更换容量”，动作错译且语义不通。

question: 封面包含的信息将由制造商自行决定。

options.A: The cover contains manufacturer's information and will be subject to its discretion.
options.B: The cover is determined by the manufacturer and the information should be comprehensive.
options.C: The information to be included on the cover will be left to the manufacturer's discretion.

explanation: 【译文】The information to be included on the cover will be left to the manufacturer's discretion.【词汇】cover=封面，to be included=将被包含的，manufacturer=制造商，discretion=自行决定。【解析】C正确：information to be included on the cover=封面包含的信息，left to the manufacturer's discretion=由制造商自行决定，句式对应。A把“封面的信息”改成“制造商的信息”，信息归属错译；B改写成“封面由制造商决定且信息应全面”，comprehensive属无中生有，裁量含义未译出。

question: 许多电源系统部件位于电子设备舱。

options.A: Many electrical power components are in the EE compartment.
options.B: Many electrical power components are in the cargo compartment.
options.C: Many electrical power components are in the APU compartment.

explanation: 【译文】Many electrical power components are in the EE compartment.【词汇】electrical power component=电源系统部件，EE compartment=电子设备舱，cargo compartment=货舱，APU compartment=APU舱。【解析】A正确：electrical power components=电源系统部件，EE compartment=电子设备舱，位置准确。B把EE compartment换成cargo compartment（货舱），舱位错译；C换成APU compartment（APU舱），位置张冠李戴，电子设备部件位置均错。

question: 确保客舱压力恒定。

options.A: Make sure that the cargo compartment pressure stays constant.
options.B: Make sure that there is pressure in the cabin.
options.C: Make sure that the cabin pressure stays constant.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the cabin pressure stays constant.【词汇】cabin=客舱，pressure=压力，stay constant=保持恒定，cargo compartment=货舱。【解析】C正确：cabin pressure=客舱压力，stays constant=保持恒定，两个考点全对应。A把cabin换成cargo compartment（货舱），舱位对象错译；B只说“客舱有压力”，漏译“恒定”这一核心状态要求，要素缺失。

question: 使用危险品前，要遵守这些注意事项。

options.A: When preparing dangerous goods, follow the operational instructions.
options.B: Before you use dangerous materials, obey these precautions.
options.C: Prior to applying any hazardous material, understand the principles of it.

explanation: 【译文】Before you use dangerous materials, obey these precautions.【词汇】before you use=使用前，dangerous materials=危险品，obey precautions=遵守注意事项。【解析】B正确：before you use=使用前，obey these precautions=遵守这些注意事项。A两处错误：use换成preparing（准备），precautions换成operational instructions（操作指令）；C两处错误：prior to applying变成“施用前”，understand the principles（理解原理）代替“遵守注意事项”，动作错译。

question: 安全程序由制造商提供。

options.A: The safety procedures are supplied by the manufacturer.
options.B: Safety procedures are to be supplied to the manufacturer.
options.C: Safety procedures are provided for manufacturers to follow.

explanation: 【译文】The safety procedures are supplied by the manufacturer.【词汇】safety procedure=安全程序，supply=提供，supplied by=由…提供，manufacturer=制造商。【解析】A正确：are supplied by the manufacturer=由制造商提供，被动方向与题干一致。B把by换成to，变成“提供给制造商”，施受方向完全相反；C的provided for manufacturers to follow=提供给制造商去遵守，制造商从“提供方”变成“执行方”，角色颠倒。

question: 旋转门把手直到下面的门被抬起。

options.A: Turn the handle of the door until the lower gate is lifted.
options.B: For lowering the upper door, door handle should be turned.
options.C: The lever of door should be turned until the lower door opens.

explanation: 【译文】Turn the handle of the door until the lower gate is lifted.【词汇】turn=旋转，handle=把手，until=直到，lift=抬起，lever=操纵杆。【解析】A正确：turn the handle=旋转门把手，until the lower gate is lifted对应“直到下面的门被抬起”，动作与结果对应。B两处错误：lower写成upper（上部，方向相反），且改写成“为降下上部门应转把手”，因果混乱；C两处偏差：handle换成lever（操纵杆），lifted换成opens（打开），“被抬起”的机械动作没有译出。

question: 文本应尽可能简明扼要。

options.A: Text shall be as brief and concise as practicable.
options.B: The text is simple and clear for readers.
options.C: When preparing the text, it must be easy and relevant.

explanation: 【译文】Text shall be as brief and concise as practicable.【词汇】brief=简明的，concise=扼要的，as...as practicable=尽可能地，shall=应。【解析】A正确：brief and concise=简明扼要，as...as practicable对应“尽可能”的程度限定，shall对应“应”。B只说“简单清楚”，漏译“尽可能”，且simple and clear不等于brief and concise，要素缺失加词义偏差；C换成easy and relevant（容易且相关），完全偏离“简明扼要”的考点。

question: 尝试移动驾驶杆。

options.A: Try to move the control column.
options.B: Move the control column momentarily.
options.C: Try to move the control column forward.

explanation: 【译文】Try to move the control column.【词汇】try to=尝试，control column=驾驶杆，momentarily=短暂地，forward=向前。【解析】A正确：try to move=尝试移动，control column=驾驶杆，无添加要素，简洁准确。B把“尝试”改成“短暂地移动”（momentarily），动作性质改变且漏译try to；C多出forward（向前），添加了题干没有的方向限定，属添加信息错误。

question: 确保指示器显示的数值正确。

options.A: Make sure that the indicated value is correct.
options.B: Make sure that the value shown on the controller is right.
options.C: Make sure that the value shown on the indicator is correct.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the value shown on the indicator is correct.【词汇】indicator=指示器，value=数值，shown on=显示在…上的，controller=控制器。【解析】C正确：the value shown on the indicator=指示器显示的数值，correct=正确，显示载体明确。A的indicated value=被指示的数值，没有点明“在指示器上显示”，要素残缺；B把indicator换成controller（控制器），部件张冠李戴，且right不如correct正式。

question: 将1号自动定向仪调谐至已知频率。

options.A: Turn ADF 1 to unknown frequency.
options.B: Tune ADF 1 to a known frequency.
options.C: Tune VOR 1 to a known channel.

explanation: 【译文】Tune ADF 1 to a known frequency.【词汇】tune...to=调谐至，ADF=自动定向仪，known frequency=已知频率，VOR=甚高频全向信标。【解析】B正确：tune=调谐，ADF 1=1号自动定向仪，a known frequency=已知频率，设备与参数全对应。A两处错误：tune换成turn（转动），known换成unknown（未知，方向相反）；C两处错误：ADF换成VOR（导航设备张冠李戴），frequency换成channel（频道）。

question: 将该步骤执行两次。

options.A: Do this procedure again.
options.B: Repeat this procedure.
options.C: Do this procedure two times.

explanation: 【译文】Do this procedure two times.【词汇】two times=两次，procedure=程序/步骤，repeat=重复，again=再次。【解析】C正确：two times明确对应“两次”这一精确次数要求。A的again只是“再做一次”，表达“再执行一次”而非“执行两次”，次数含义不符；B的repeat this procedure=重复该程序，同样未明确“两次”的精确次数，精确性均不及C。

question: 涂三层底漆。

options.A: Apply three layers of coating.
options.B: Apply three layers of primer.
options.C: Apply three layers of bottom primer.

explanation: 【译文】Apply three layers of primer.【词汇】apply=涂覆，layer=层，primer=底漆，coating=涂层（泛指）。【解析】B正确：three layers of primer=三层底漆，涂料类型精确。A把primer换成coating（涂层），丢失“底漆”这一特定涂料类型，范围扩大；C的bottom primer属冗余表达，primer本身即底漆，bottom系画蛇添足，表达不规范。

question: 如果电缆扭曲，断开两个电插头。

options.A: If the cable twists, disconnect the two connectors.
options.B: If the wire bents, break the two connectors.
options.C: If the cable wire breaks, disconnect both ends of the connectors.

explanation: 【译文】If the cable twists, disconnect the two connectors.【词汇】cable=电缆，twist=扭曲，disconnect=断开，connector=电插头/接头。【解析】A正确：the cable twists=电缆扭曲，disconnect the two connectors=断开两个电插头，条件与处置动作对应。B多处错误：cable换成wire，twists换成bents（拼写错误，应为bends），disconnect换成break（弄断）；C两处错误：twists换成breaks（断裂），two connectors改成both ends of the connectors（接头两端），表述偏离。

question: 找出损伤类型和尺寸。

options.A: Find the type and dimensions of the damage.
options.B: Locate the damage and its dimensions.
options.C: Designate the damage type and then give it a dimension.

explanation: 【译文】Find the type and dimensions of the damage.【词汇】type=类型，dimension=尺寸，damage=损伤，find=找出/查明。【解析】A正确：the type and dimensions of the damage=损伤的类型和尺寸，两个要素齐全。B漏译type（类型），只说“定位损伤及其尺寸”，要素缺失，且locate偏“定位位置”；C把“查明”改成designate（指定）和give it a dimension（赋予尺寸），查明变成人为指定，动作性质错译。

question: 这是该类型紧固件的典型安装程序。

options.A: This is an installation procedure used by this typical fastener type.
options.B: This installation procedure is typical for this type of fastener.
options.C: It's typical to install the fastener according to this procedure.

explanation: 【译文】This installation procedure is typical for this type of fastener.【词汇】typical=典型的，installation procedure=安装程序，fastener=紧固件。【解析】B正确：procedure is typical for this type of fastener=该程序对此类紧固件是典型的，主表结构与题干一致。A句式错误：procedure used by this typical fastener type变成“被该典型紧固件使用的程序”，主客颠倒；C改写为“按此程序安装紧固件很典型”，评价对象偏移，结构松散。

question: 对甚高频导航系统执行排故程序。

options.A: Troubleshoot the VHF Communication system per FIM.
options.B: Do the troubleshooting procedure on the VHF navigation system.
options.C: Do the fault isolation procedure for the ADIRU system.

explanation: 【译文】Do the troubleshooting procedure on the VHF navigation system.【词汇】troubleshooting procedure=排故程序，VHF=甚高频，navigation system=导航系统，ADIRU=大气数据惯性基准组件。【解析】B正确：do the troubleshooting procedure on=对…执行排故程序，VHF navigation system=甚高频导航系统。A两处错误：navigation换成communication（通信系统），并擅自添加per FIM（按故障隔离手册），属添加信息；C把VHF navigation system换成ADIRU system，系统对象完全张冠李戴。

question: 如果未得到工作授权，不要执行该发动机测试。

options.A: Do not authorize to do the engine test.
options.B: The engine test will not be completed if you are not authorized.
options.C: If you are not approved to do this work, do not do this engine test.

explanation: 【译文】If you are not approved to do this work, do not do this engine test.【词汇】approved=被授权/批准的，work authorization=工作授权，engine test=发动机测试。【解析】C正确：not approved to do this work=未得到工作授权，do not do this engine test=不要执行该发动机测试，条件与禁令完整。A结构错误：Do not authorize to do变成“不要授权去做”，主语动作指向全错；B把禁令改成陈述“测试将无法完成”，漏译“不要执行”的禁止语气，语用功能错译。

question: 配平控制旋钮安装在控制台座上。

options.A: The trim control knob is installed on the control pedestal.
options.B: The trim control button is mounted under the control pedestal.
options.C: You can find the trim control button on the control panel.

explanation: 【译文】The trim control knob is installed on the control pedestal.【词汇】trim control knob=配平控制旋钮，control pedestal=控制台座，is installed on=安装在…上。【解析】A正确：knob=旋钮，installed on the control pedestal=安装在控制台座上，部件与位置准确。B两处错误：knob换成button（按钮），on换成under（在…下方），位置方向相反；C两处错误：knob换成button，control pedestal换成control panel（控制面板），且句式变成“可以找到”。

question: 不要在有污水的地方拖动。

options.A: Do not taxi where there is dirt.
options.B: Do not tow in areas where there is slush.
options.C: Do not land in locations where there is slush.

explanation: 【译文】Do not tow in areas where there is slush.【词汇】tow=拖动/牵引，slush=融雪泥水/污水，taxi=滑行，land=着陆。【解析】B正确：tow=拖动，areas where there is slush=有污水的区域，动作与场景对应。A两处错误：tow换成taxi（飞机靠自身动力滑行，与“拖”不同），slush换成dirt（尘土/污物）；C把tow换成land（着陆），动作完全错译。

question: 检查连杆是否平稳移动。

options.A: Check whether the linkage moves slightly or not.
options.B: Examine the linkage for smooth movement.
options.C: Inspect the status of the linkage movement.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the linkage for smooth movement.【词汇】linkage=连杆，smooth movement=平稳移动，examine...for=检查…是否符合，slightly=轻微地。【解析】B正确：examine the linkage for smooth movement=检查连杆是否平稳移动，for引出检查标准，规范简洁。A把smooth换成slightly（轻微地），whether moves slightly or not变成“是否轻微移动”，含义全变；C只说“检查连杆运动状态”，漏译“平稳”这一核心判据，要素缺失。

question: 如果你把这部件弯曲得太厉害，它就会折断。

options.A: If you bend this part too far, it will break.
options.B: The part will bend if you break it too much.
options.C: If you bend the part too much, it will separate.

explanation: 【译文】If you bend this part too far, it will break.【词汇】bend=弯曲，too far=过度/太厉害，break=折断，separate=分离。【解析】A正确：bend this part too far=把部件弯得太厉害，it will break=它就会折断，条件-结果链条完整。B因果颠倒：变成“你把它折断太多它就会弯曲”，逻辑荒谬；C把break换成separate（分离），折断的严重程度被弱化，词义错译。

question: 用肥皂和水的溶液清洗。

options.A: Use a solution of foam and water to clean.
options.B: Clean with bleach and water.
options.C: Clean with a solution of soap and water.

explanation: 【译文】Clean with a solution of soap and water.【词汇】solution=溶液，soap=肥皂，foam=泡沫，bleach=漂白剂。【解析】C正确：a solution of soap and water=肥皂和水的溶液，清洗介质准确。A把soap换成foam（泡沫），溶液成分错译；B把soap换成bleach（漂白剂），清洗介质张冠李戴，且漏译solution概念。

question: 不要让泡沫变成固体。

options.A: Do not let the flame become solid.
options.B: Never let the foam become liquid.
options.C: Do not let the foam become solid.

explanation: 【译文】Do not let the foam become solid.【词汇】foam=泡沫，become solid=变成固体，flame=火焰，liquid=液体。【解析】C正确：foam=泡沫，become solid=变成固体，do not let=不要让，三处全对应。A把foam换成flame（火焰），形近词错译；B把solid换成liquid（液体），“变固体”变成“变液体”，变化方向相反。

question: 将油门快速移动到慢车位置。

options.A: Quickly move the throttle to the middle position.
options.B: Move the throttle quickly to the idle position.
options.C: Push the throttle quickly to the neutral position.

explanation: 【译文】Move the throttle quickly to the idle position.【词汇】throttle=油门，idle position=慢车位置，neutral position=中立位置，quickly=快速地。【解析】B正确：move the throttle quickly=快速移动油门，idle position=慢车位置（发动机最小推力位）。A把idle换成middle position（中间位置），档位错译；C两处错误：move换成push（推），idle换成neutral（中立位），动作与档位均错。

question: 铆钉之间的距离参见图401。

options.A: Refer to FIG. 401 for the distance between rivets.
options.B: If you want to know the distance between bolts, refer to FIG. 401.
options.C: Look at FIG. 401 for the dimension between bolts.

explanation: 【译文】Refer to FIG. 401 for the distance between rivets.【词汇】refer to=参见，distance=距离，rivet=铆钉，bolt=螺栓，dimension=尺寸。【解析】A正确：refer to FIG. 401=参见图401，the distance between rivets=铆钉之间的距离。B两处问题：rivets换成bolts（螺栓），If you want to know属多余的口语化添加；C两处错误：rivets换成bolts，distance换成dimension（尺寸/维度），间距概念被换成尺寸概念。

question: 不要使用可能引起火花的测试设备。

options.A: Always use test element that can cause sparks.
options.B: Never use test equipment which can cause cracks.
options.C: Do not use test equipment that can cause sparks.

explanation: 【译文】Do not use test equipment that can cause sparks.【词汇】test equipment=测试设备，cause sparks=引起火花，crack=裂纹，element=元件。【解析】C正确：do not use=不要使用，test equipment that can cause sparks=可能引起火花的测试设备。A把否定禁令改成Always use（总是使用），方向完全相反，且equipment换成element（元件）；B把sparks换成cracks（裂纹），危害类型错译，spark与crack形近但无关。

question: 所有航程距离均应以海里表示。

options.A: All range distances shall be expressed in nautical miles.
options.B: All range dimensions shall be defined in kilometers.
options.C: Nautical miles should not express all range distances.

explanation: 【译文】All range distances shall be expressed in nautical miles.【词汇】range distance=航程距离，nautical mile=海里，be expressed in=以…表示，kilometer=公里。【解析】A正确：all range distances=所有航程距离，shall be expressed in nautical miles=应以海里表示。B两处错误：distances换成dimensions（尺寸），nautical miles换成kilometers（公里），单位与对象均错；C主谓颠倒成“海里不应表示所有航程距离”，逻辑完全错误。

question: 确保材料的保质期未过期。

options.A: Make sure that the warranty life of the material is not expanded.
options.B: Make sure that the retirement period of the material is not exceeded.
options.C: Make sure that the shelf life of the material is not expired.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the shelf life of the material is not expired.【词汇】shelf life=保质期/贮存寿命，material=材料，expire=到期，warranty life=保修期。【解析】C正确：shelf life=保质期，not expired=未过期，术语精准对应。A两处错误：shelf life换成warranty life（保修期），expired换成expanded（扩大，形近词错译）；B把shelf life换成retirement period（退役期限），寿命类型术语错译。

question: 减震器是一个可伸缩油气装置。

options.A: The shock absorber is a telescopic oleo-pneumatic unit.
options.B: The shock absorber is a flexible hydraulic-pneumatic unit.
options.C: The shock strut is an elastic oil-air unit.

explanation: 【译文】The shock absorber is a telescopic oleo-pneumatic unit.【词汇】shock absorber=减震器，telescopic=可伸缩的，oleo-pneumatic=油气的，unit=装置。【解析】A正确：telescopic=可伸缩，oleo-pneumatic unit=油气装置，两个专业术语全对应。B两处错误：telescopic换成flexible（柔性的），oleo-pneumatic换成hydraulic-pneumatic（液气混合，介质表述不同）；C两处错误：shock absorber换成shock strut（减震支柱，概念偏窄），oleo-pneumatic换成oil-air（非规范术语）。

question: 此程序对B类零件特别重要。

options.A: This program is partially important to type B parts.
options.B: This procedure is of particular importance to type B parts.
options.C: This procedure is not especially important to type B parts.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure is of particular importance to type B parts.【词汇】procedure=程序，particular=特别的，be of importance=重要，partially=部分地。【解析】B正确：is of particular importance=特别重要，procedure=程序，type B parts=B类零件，全部对应。A两处错误：procedure换成program（计划/程序），particular换成partially（部分地，形近词错译）；C加入not变成“并非特别重要”，与题干语义相反。

question: 如果故障信息依然存在，按压航电设备测试面板上的音频取消按钮。

options.A: If fault message continues, push the audio cancel pushbutton on the aviation electric test panel.
options.B: If fault message persists, press audio cancel pushbutton on the avionics test panel.
options.C: If fault message goes on, press audio cancel pushbutton on the airborne test panel.

explanation: 【译文】If fault message persists, press audio cancel pushbutton on the avionics test panel.【词汇】persist=持续存在，audio cancel pushbutton=音频取消按钮，avionics=航电设备，test panel=测试面板。【解析】B正确：persists=依然存在，avionics test panel=航电设备测试面板，术语规范。A把avionics换成aviation electric（航空电气），非标准缩写术语；C两处问题：avionics换成airborne（机载的），goes on为口语表达不如persists正式。

question: 执行此程序来保护碳钢钢索。

options.A: Do the procedure to preserve the carbon steel cables.
options.B: Do the procedure to lubricate the stainless steel cables.
options.C: Do the procedure for the protection of the carbon steel harnesses.

explanation: 【译文】Do the procedure to preserve the carbon steel cables.【词汇】preserve=保护/防护保存，carbon steel=碳钢，cable=钢索，harness=线束，lubricate=润滑。【解析】A正确：to preserve the carbon steel cables=来保护碳钢钢索，目的状语与材料对象全对应。B两处错误：preserve换成lubricate（润滑，手段错译），carbon steel换成stainless steel（不锈钢，材料错译）；C把cables换成harnesses（线束），保护对象错译。

question: 在操作过程中，注意不要刺穿液压油箱。

options.A: During the operation, please be careful not to pierce the hydraulic oil tank.
options.B: During the operation, pay attention not to punch the hydraulic reservoir.
options.C: During the procedure, take care not to puncture the hydraulic reservoir.

explanation: 【译文】During the procedure, take care not to puncture the hydraulic reservoir.【词汇】puncture=刺穿，hydraulic reservoir=液压油箱/储压箱，take care not to=注意不要，punch=冲孔。【解析】C正确：puncture=刺穿，hydraulic reservoir=液压油箱，take care not to对应“注意不要”，术语规范。A两处偏差：puncture换成pierce（穿透，可用但非手册规范词），hydraulic oil tank不如reservoir专业；B把puncture换成punch（冲孔/冲压），制造动作错译。

question: 此专用工具用于拔出衬套。

options.A: The function of this special tool is to remove the shims.
options.B: The purpose of this special tool is to extract the bushing.
options.C: The function of this special tool is to extend the washer.

explanation: 【译文】The purpose of this special tool is to extract the bushing.【词汇】purpose=用途，extract=拔出，bushing=衬套，shim=调整垫片，washer=垫圈。【解析】B正确：purpose对应“用于”，extract=拔出，bushing=衬套，功能与对象准确。A把bushing换成shims（调整垫片），拔取对象错译；C两处错误：extract换成extend（延伸，形近词错译），bushing换成washer（垫圈），动作与零件均错。

question: 方向舵可用于推力不对称的情况。

options.A: The rudder can be used in case of thrust asymmetry.
options.B: The vertical stabilizer can be used in case of throttle symmetry.
options.C: The rudder can be used in situations where thrust is symmetric.

explanation: 【译文】The rudder can be used in case of thrust asymmetry.【词汇】rudder=方向舵，in case of=在…情况下，thrust asymmetry=推力不对称，vertical stabilizer=垂直安定面。【解析】A正确：rudder=方向舵，thrust asymmetry=推力不对称，in case of=在…情况下。B两处错误：rudder换成vertical stabilizer（垂直安定面，部件错译），thrust asymmetry换成throttle symmetry（油门对称，双重错译）；C把asymmetry换成symmetric（对称），适用情形恰好相反。

question: 检查洗手池排泄口、水龙头及其管路有无渗漏。

options.A: Check wash basin drains, water tap and its lines for leakage.
options.B: Inspect the washing sink, faucet and its pipe for leakage.
options.C: Examine the washing hand drain port, tap and the line for crack.

explanation: 【译文】Check wash basin drains, water tap and its lines for leakage.【词汇】wash basin drain=洗手池排泄口，water tap=水龙头，lines=管路，leakage=渗漏。【解析】A正确：wash basin drains=洗手池排泄口，water tap=水龙头，for leakage=检查有无渗漏，check...for结构规范。B两处偏差：wash basin drains被压缩成washing sink（洗手槽），“排泄口”漏译，lines换成pipe范围变窄；C多处错误：leakage换成crack（裂纹，缺陷类型错译），washing hand drain port表达生硬不通。

question: 操作检查液压刹车蓄压器的预充压力。

options.A: Operate and check the pre-charge pressure of the hydraulic brake supercharger.
options.B: Operationally check the hydraulic brake accumulator pre-charge pressure.
options.C: Operate and examine the pre-charge pressure of the hydraulic brake pressurizer.

explanation: 【译文】Operationally check the hydraulic brake accumulator pre-charge pressure.【词汇】operationally check=操作检查，accumulator=蓄压器，pre-charge pressure=预充压力。【解析】B正确：operationally check对应“操作检查”，hydraulic brake accumulator=液压刹车蓄压器，术语全对应。A两处错误：operationally check拆成operate and check（变成两个动作），accumulator换成supercharger（增压器）；C把accumulator换成pressurizer（加压器），部件错译。

question: 除非在平稳的空气中，否则不要超过这个速度或马赫数，而且要小心。

options.A: Do not go beyond this speed or Mach number besides in steady air, and then be careful.
options.B: Do not increase by this speed or Mach number unless in steady air, and be careful.
options.C: Do not exceed this speed or Mach Number except in smooth air and then only with caution.

explanation: 【译文】Do not exceed this speed or Mach number except in smooth air and then only with caution.【词汇】exceed=超过，Mach number=马赫数，smooth air=平稳气流，with caution=小心地/谨慎地。【解析】C正确：exceed=超过，except in smooth air=除非在平稳空气中，only with caution=且须小心，三层限定完整对应。A两处错误：besides（此外）不能表达“除非”的例外条件，smooth换成steady（稳定的，可用但非标准表述）；B把exceed换成increase by（增加），“不要超过”变成“不要增加”，动作错译。

question: 当词语之间有不同的连接方式时，就会产生歧义。

options.A: Different meanings occur when words are combined in different ways.
options.B: When words can link up in different ways, ambiguity occurs.
options.C: Misunderstanding happens when words are contained in different modes.

explanation: 【译文】When words can link up in different ways, ambiguity occurs.【词汇】link up=连接，in different ways=以不同方式，ambiguity=歧义，occur=产生。【解析】B正确：link up in different ways=以不同方式连接，ambiguity occurs=产生歧义，条件-结果关系对应。A把ambiguity换成different meanings（不同含义），“歧义现象”没有准确译出；C两处错误：ambiguity换成misunderstanding（误解，属听者层面的不同概念），link up换成contained（包含），连接关系错译。

question: 航道与跑道中心线对齐。

options.A: The fairway and the runway centerline should align .
options.B: The localizer course is aligned with the centerline of the runway.
options.C: The localizer aligns with the center of the runway.

explanation: 【译文】The localizer course is aligned with the centerline of the runway.【词汇】localizer course=航向道（航道），be aligned with=与…对齐，runway centerline=跑道中心线，fairway=航道（水运）。【解析】B正确：localizer course=（仪表着陆系统）航道，is aligned with the centerline of the runway=与跑道中心线对齐。A把localizer换成fairway（水上航道/高尔夫球道），航空导航术语错译；C把centerline换成center（中心），丢失“中心线”这一精确基准线概念。

question: 慢慢地将杆完全伸出，并确保它不接触其它部件。

options.A: Completely retract the rod slowly and ensure not to touch other components.
options.B: Slowly protect the bar and  guarantee not touching other parts.
options.C: Slowly extend the rod fully and make sure that it does not touch other parts.

explanation: 【译文】Slowly extend the rod fully and make sure that it does not touch other parts.【词汇】extend=伸出，retract=缩回，fully=完全地，make sure=确保。【解析】C正确：slowly extend the rod fully=慢慢地将杆完全伸出，does not touch other parts=不接触其它部件。A两处错误：extend换成retract（缩回，方向相反），ensure not to touch结构生硬；B多处错误：extend换成protect（保护，动作错译），rod换成bar（杆件，术语偏差），guarantee not touching语法不规范。

question: 在一节内不要求对各段及分段进行编号。

options.A: The numbering of paragraphs and subparagraphs within a section is not required.
options.B: No numbers of paragraphs and subparagraphs is required in a section.
options.C: The numeral order of the paragraphs and subparagraphs is unnecessary in a section.

explanation: 【译文】The numbering of paragraphs and subparagraphs within a section is not required.【词汇】numbering=编号，paragraph=段，subparagraph=分段，section=节。【解析】A正确：numbering of paragraphs and subparagraphs=对各段及分段的编号，is not required=不要求。B语法错误：No numbers...is required把“编号”行为改成“不需要号码”，主谓搭配错误；C把numbering换成numeral order（数字顺序），“编号”变成“数字排列次序”，概念错译。

question: 本手册中的定义应与联邦航空法规中的定义一致。

options.A: Definitions in this manual shall be conformed with those in the Federal Aviation Legislations.
options.B: Definitions in the handbook shall be consistent with definitions contained in the Federal Aviation Regulations.
options.C: Definitions in the Federal Aviation Regulations shall be consistent with definitions contained in the handbook.

explanation: 【译文】Definitions in the handbook shall be consistent with definitions contained in the Federal Aviation Regulations.【词汇】definition=定义，be consistent with=与…一致，Federal Aviation Regulations=联邦航空法规，handbook=手册。【解析】B正确：以手册中的定义为主语，“与联邦航空法规中的定义一致”，主客方向与题干一致。A两处问题：Regulations换成Legislations（立法，非法规固定名称），be conformed with搭配不当；C主客颠倒：变成“法规中的定义应与手册一致”，方向完全相反。

question: 与可选系统或设备有关的限制可包括在本节或第9节补充中。

options.A: Limitations related to operable systems or equipment may contain in this section or in section 9, supplements.
options.B: The supplements in  this section or section 9 include the limitations associated with selectable systems or equipment.
options.C: Limitations associated with optional systems or equipment may be included in this section or in section 9, supplements.

explanation: 【译文】Limitations associated with optional systems or equipment may be included in this section or in section 9, supplements.【词汇】limitation=限制，optional=可选的，be included in=被包括在，supplement=补充。【解析】C正确：optional systems=可选系统，may be included=可包括，主被动关系正确。A两处错误：optional换成operable（可操作的），may contain缺宾语且语态用错；B把主语换成supplements，逻辑层级与题干不符，selectable也不如optional准确。

question: 这种材料能很好地防止腐蚀。

options.A: This module gives good procession from defect.
options.B: This metal gives good protection from erosion.
options.C: This material gives good protection from corrosion.

explanation: 【译文】This material gives good protection from corrosion.【词汇】material=材料，protection from=防止/防护，corrosion=腐蚀，erosion=侵蚀/冲蚀。【解析】C正确：material=材料，good protection from corrosion=很好地防止腐蚀，术语精确。A多处错误：material换成module（模块），protection换成procession（行列/队伍，形近词错译），corrosion换成defect（缺陷）；B两处错误：material换成metal（材料范围缩小），corrosion换成erosion（冲蚀，腐蚀机理不同）。

question: 剪断并抛弃保险丝。

options.A: Cut and discard the lockwire.
options.B: Snip and remove the lockwire.
options.C: Snip and discard the cable.

explanation: 【译文】Cut and discard the lockwire.【词汇】cut=剪断，discard=抛弃/报废，lockwire=保险丝（保险钢丝），snip=剪。【解析】A正确：cut and discard=剪断并抛弃，lockwire=保险丝，处置动作与对象全对应。B把discard换成remove（拆下），“抛弃/报废”的处置含义丢失；C把lockwire换成cable（钢索），对象错译，且discard虽保留但宾语已变。

question: 更换损坏的部件。

options.A: Remove the failure components.
options.B: Replace the damaged parts.
options.C: Reinstall the damaged components.

explanation: 【译文】Replace the damaged parts.【词汇】replace=更换（以新换旧），damaged=损坏的，part=部件，reinstall=重新安装。【解析】B正确：replace=更换，damaged parts=损坏的部件，动作与对象全对应。A两处偏差：replace换成remove（只拆不换，动作不完整），damaged换成failure（故障的，属性词错译）；C把replace换成reinstall（重新安装），含义变成把损坏件装回去，方向相反。

question: 不要吸入溶剂烟雾。

options.A: Do not smell the compound fumes.
options.B: Do not smell the solvent fames.
options.C: Do not breathe the solvent fumes.

explanation: 【译文】Do not breathe the solvent fumes.【词汇】breathe=吸入/呼吸，solvent=溶剂，fumes=烟雾/蒸气，smell=嗅闻。【解析】C正确：breathe=吸入，solvent fumes=溶剂烟雾，动作与对象全对应。A两处错误：breathe换成smell（嗅闻，主动闻与被动吸入不同），solvent换成compound（化合物，范围扩大）；B两处错误：breathe换成smell，fumes拼写成fames（拼写错误）。

question: 让粘合剂变硬。

options.A: Let the substance become hard.
options.B: Let the adhesive become hard.
options.C: Let the admixture become hard.

explanation: 【译文】Let the adhesive become hard.【词汇】adhesive=粘合剂，become hard=变硬，substance=物质，admixture=掺合料。【解析】B正确：adhesive=粘合剂，become hard=变硬，对象与变化过程全对应。A把adhesive换成substance（物质），过于笼统，丢失“粘合剂”这一特定材料；C把adhesive换成admixture（掺合料/混合物），形近词错译，材料类别不符。

question: 在法兰盘上安装一个新的垫圈。

options.A: Install a new gasket on the flange.
options.B: Install a new washer on the fixture.
options.C: Install a new basket on the fitting.

explanation: 【译文】Install a new gasket on the flange.【词汇】gasket=垫圈/密封垫，flange=法兰盘，fixture=夹具，fitting=接头/配件。【解析】A正确：a new gasket=一个新的垫圈，on the flange=在法兰盘上，零件与安装位置全对应。B两处错误：gasket换成washer（平垫圈，密封件类型不同），flange换成fixture（夹具）；C两处错误：gasket换成basket（篮子，形近词错译），flange换成fitting（接头/管件）。

question: 向相反的方向移动连杆。

options.A: Transfer the rod in the contrary directivity.
options.B: Remove the rod in the contrast direction.
options.C: Move the rod in the opposite direction.

explanation: 【译文】Move the rod in the opposite direction.【词汇】move=移动，rod=连杆，opposite direction=相反方向，remove=拆下。【解析】C正确：move the rod=移动连杆，in the opposite direction=向相反方向，动作与方向全对应。A两处错误：move换成transfer（转移/输送），contrary directivity非规范搭配；B两处错误：move换成remove（拆下，动作完全不同），contrast direction非标准表达。

question: 将张力指示器设为零。

options.A: Set the tension indicator to zero.
options.B: Put the torque indication to zero.
options.C: Put the shear instrument to zero.

explanation: 【译文】Set the tension indicator to zero.【词汇】tension indicator=张力指示器，set...to zero=设为零，torque=扭矩，shear=剪切。【解析】A正确：tension indicator=张力指示器，set to zero=设为零，调零动作用set规范准确。B两处错误：tension换成torque（扭矩，力学量不同），indicator换成indication（指示值）；C把tension indicator换成shear instrument（剪切仪表），物理量与仪表类型均错译。

question: 你给外侧油箱加满油之前，先给内侧油箱加满油。

options.A: Fill the outer tank before you fill the inner tank.
options.B: Fill the inner tank before you fill the outer tank.
options.C: Fill the inboard tank before you drain the overboard tank.

explanation: 【译文】Fill the inner tank before you fill the outer tank.【词汇】inner tank=内侧油箱，outer tank=外侧油箱，fill=加满，drain=放油。【解析】B正确：先fill the inner tank再fill the outer tank，before准确对应“先内侧后外侧”的加油次序。A把inner和outer顺序写反，变成先加外侧油箱；C多处错误：fill换成drain（放油，操作相反），outer换成overboard（机外/舷外），方位词错译。

question: 继续进行电气测试。

options.A: Continue with the electronic adjust.
options.B: Complete with the electronic test.
options.C: Continue with the electrical test.

explanation: 【译文】Continue with the electrical test.【词汇】continue with=继续进行，electrical=电气的，electronic=电子的，complete=完成。【解析】C正确：continue with=继续，electrical test=电气测试（electrical指电气/电源系统类，electronic指电子元器件类）。A两处错误：electrical test换成electronic adjust（电子调整），测试变成调整且electrical误作electronic；B两处错误：continue换成complete（完成，动作含义相反），electrical换成electronic。

question: APU舱右侧接近门后端系留绳断丝。

options.A: The aft lanyard attached to the access door to the right APU compartment is broken.
options.B: The after end of lanyard attached to the access door to the right APU compartment is fractured.
options.C: The lanyard attached to the after end of the right access door to the APU compartment is frayed.

explanation: 【译文】The lanyard attached to the after end of the right access door to the APU compartment is frayed.【词汇】lanyard=系留绳，access door=接近门，after end=后端，frayed=断丝/磨散。【解析】C正确：系留绳位于“APU舱右侧接近门”的后端，frayed对应钢索“断丝”（单丝磨断起毛），位置与损伤类型准确。A两处偏差：aft lanyard把“后端”改作绳自身的定语，位置关系改变，broken（整体断裂）程度过重；B把“后端”误作绳端（after end of lanyard），fractured指完全断裂而非断丝，损伤类型错译。

question: 右大翼机身整流罩前部有几颗螺钉松动。

options.A: Several screws pulled out in front of right wing fuselage fairing.
options.B: Several screws lost in front of right wing fuselage fairing.
options.C: Forward of right wing body fairing has several loose screws.

explanation: 【译文】There are several loose screws forward of the right wing-body fairing.【词汇】forward of=在…前部，wing-body fairing=翼身整流罩，loose screws=松动的螺钉。【解析】C正确：forward of the right wing body fairing=右大翼机身整流罩前部，several loose screws=几颗螺钉松动，缺陷状态准确。A把loose换成pulled out（被拉出），缺陷类型错译；B把loose换成lost（丢失），螺钉从“松动”变成“缺失”，状态程度错译。

question: 杂项类别包含很多种部件或零件，我们选择了其中五种。

options.A: Mixed category consists of many parts and components, five kinds of these parts have been selected.
options.B: Miscellaneous category consists of many parts and components, five kinds of these parts have been selected.
options.C: Complicated category consists of many parts and components, five kinds of these parts have been selected.

explanation: 【译文】The miscellaneous category consists of many parts and components; five kinds of these parts have been selected.【词汇】miscellaneous=杂项的，category=类别，consist of=包含，select=选择。【解析】B正确：miscellaneous category=杂项类别，five kinds have been selected=选择了其中五种，类别名与数量对应。A把miscellaneous换成mixed（混合的），类别名称错译；C把miscellaneous换成complicated（复杂的），类别属性错译，杂项不等于复杂。

question: 燃油样品检查发现有微生物污染。

options.A: Fuel sample was checked for contamination of microorganism.
options.B: Contamination to microorganism was detected in the fuel sample.
options.C: Fuel sample check reveals positive contamination of microorganism growth.

explanation: 【译文】The fuel sample check reveals contamination by microorganism growth.【词汇】fuel sample=燃油样品，reveal=检查显示，contamination=污染，microorganism=微生物。【解析】C正确：check reveals...contamination对应“检查发现存在污染”，positive与growth强调检出微生物滋生，检查结果陈述完整。A只说“燃油样品被检查是否有微生物污染”，漏译“发现有”这一检查结果，要素缺失；B的contamination to microorganism介词错误（应为contamination by），且主语表述不通顺。

question: 试车时，一号发动机滑油压力表指示摆动。

options.A: During engine run, the number 1 engine oil pressure watch swings.
options.B: During engine run, the number 1 engine oil pressure gauge fluctuates.
options.C: During engine run, the number 1 engine oil pressure indication moves.

explanation: 【译文】During engine run, the No. 1 engine oil pressure gauge fluctuates.【词汇】engine run=试车，oil pressure gauge=滑油压力表，fluctuate=摆动/波动，indication=指示值。【解析】B正确：oil pressure gauge=滑油压力表，fluctuates=指示摆动，仪表与故障现象术语规范。A把gauge换成watch（手表/监视），仪表类型错译；C把gauge换成indication（指示值），且moves过于笼统，未体现“摆动”的来回波动特征。

question: 左主起落架备用控制钢索润滑不足。

options.A: Left main landing gear alternate control lanyard is lack of lubrication.
options.B: Left main landing gear alternate control steel wire is not lubricated.
options.C: Left main landing gear alternate control cable has insufficient lubrication.

explanation: 【译文】The left main landing gear alternate control cable has insufficient lubrication.【词汇】main landing gear=主起落架，alternate control cable=备用控制钢索，insufficient lubrication=润滑不足。【解析】C正确：alternate control cable=备用控制钢索，insufficient lubrication=润滑不足。A两处错误：cable换成lanyard（系留绳），is lack of搭配错误；B两处错误：cable换成steel wire（钢丝），insufficient换成not lubricated，程度范围错误。

question: 功能检查左VHF无线电设备发现其有静电干扰及噪音。

options.A: Functional check L VHF radio found statis interference and noise.
options.B: Functional check of L VHF radio shown  turbulence and static noise.
options.C: Functional check of L VHF radio revealed interference of static with noise.

explanation: 【译文】Functional check of the L VHF radio revealed static interference and noise.【词汇】functional check=功能检查，static interference=静电干扰，reveal=发现，noise=噪音。【解析】C正确：functional check、static、interference with noise分别对应功能检查、静电、干扰及噪音，结构完整。A缺of且statis拼写错误（应为static）。B把“发现”译成shown语法不当，静电干扰误译为turbulence（湍流），张冠李戴。

question: L1登机门飞行机组位置救生衣未安装。

options.A: L1 entry door life vests were not installed by flight crew.
options.B: Life vests at L1 entry door flight crew station not install.
options.C: Life vests were not installed at L1 entry door  flight crew station.

explanation: 【译文】Life vests were not installed at the L1 entry door flight crew station.【词汇】life vest=救生衣，entry door=登机门，flight crew station=飞行机组位置，install=安装。【解析】C正确：被动语态were not installed准确表达“未安装”，at...station对应“在……位置”，信息完整。A把位置关系误解为施动者：by flight crew变成“由飞行机组安装”，张冠李戴，原句并未说明安装主体。B语法错误：“not install”缺少助动词，应为were not installed，句子结构不完整。

question: 测量两个零件之间的垂直距离。

options.A: Measure the vertical distance between the two parts.
options.B: Test the vertical clearance between the two components.
options.C: Measure the lateral distance between the two parts.

explanation: 【译文】Measure the vertical distance between the two parts.【词汇】measure=测量，vertical=垂直的，distance=距离，between=在……之间，part=零件。【解析】A正确：measure、vertical、distance、between the two parts逐项对应题干，无任何偏差。B多处错误：measure误译为test（测试），distance误译为clearance（间隙），parts换成components（构件），属词义错译。C把vertical误译为lateral（横向的），垂直变横向，方向相反。

question: 修理所有大于0.05mm的裂缝。

options.A: Make up for all gaps which are larger than 0.05 mm.
options.B: Repair all cracks that are wider than 0.05 mm.
options.C: Overhaul all fissures which are greater than 0.05mm.

explanation: 【译文】Repair all cracks that are larger than 0.05 mm.【词汇】repair=修理，crack=裂缝，wider/larger than=大于（裂缝尺寸按宽度度量），mm=毫米。【解析】B正确：repair对应修理，cracks对应裂缝，wider than 0.05 mm合理表达裂缝宽度超限。A两处错误：repair误译为make up for（弥补），cracks误译为gaps（缝隙、间隙），词义错译。C两处错误：repair误译为overhaul（大修，程度过重），fissures虽可指裂隙但非维修常用术语，不如cracks贴切。

question: 监视无线电高度计指示器。

options.A: Supervise the display of audio altimeter.
options.B: Monitor the media altitude meter display.
options.C: Monitor the radio altimeter indicator.

explanation: 【译文】Monitor the radio altimeter indicator.【词汇】monitor=监视，radio altimeter=无线电高度计，indicator=指示器。【解析】C正确：monitor、radio altimeter、indicator三个术语全部准确对应题干。A两处错误：monitor误译为supervise（监督，多指对人的管理），radio误译为audio（音频），无线电错成音频，张冠李戴。B把radio altimeter误译为media altitude meter：radio（无线电）错成media（媒体），且altitude meter、display叠床架屋，不符合术语规范。

question: 每400个飞行小时检查一次伺服控制。

options.A: Check the servo controls every 400 flight cycles.
options.B: Examine the servo controls at intervals of 400 flight hours.
options.C: Inspect the feedback controls every 400 flight hours.

explanation: 【译文】Check the servo controls at intervals of 400 flight hours.【词汇】servo control=伺服控制，flight hour=飞行小时，at intervals of=每隔……，examine/check=检查。【解析】B正确：examine对应检查，servo controls对应伺服控制，at intervals of 400 flight hours准确表达每400飞行小时的间隔要求。A把flight hours误译为flight cycles（飞行循环），计量单位错误，维修间隔含义完全不同。C把servo controls误译为feedback controls（反馈控制），部件张冠李戴。

question: 使用过滤器去除滑油中不需要的物质。

options.A: Use a filter to remove unwanted material from the oil.
options.B: Use a strainer to remove unused substances from the fluid.
options.C: Use a strainer to filter unnecessary material from the lubrication liquid.

explanation: 【译文】Use a filter to remove unwanted material from the oil.【词汇】filter=过滤器，remove=去除，unwanted material=不需要的物质，oil=滑油。【解析】A正确：filter、remove、unwanted material、oil逐项对应题干，动作和对象完整。B多处错误：filter误译为strainer（滤网/粗滤器），unwanted误译为unused（未使用的），oil误译为fluid（泛指流体），范围放大。C两处错误：同用strainer，oil误译为lubrication liquid（表述冗长不专业），且把remove换成filter作动词，改变句子结构。

question: 如有必要，增加一个垫片。

options.A: If necessary, prepare a gasket.
options.B: If necessary, add a pin.
options.C: Add a washer if necessary.

explanation: 【译文】If necessary, add a washer.【词汇】if necessary=如有必要，add=增加/加装，washer=垫片，gasket=密封垫（易混）。【解析】C正确：add对应增加，washer对应垫片，if necessary后置与原句语序差异不影响语义。A两处错误：add误译为prepare（准备），washer误译为gasket（密封垫，用于密封而非调整间隙），动作和部件均错。B把washer误译为pin（销子），部件张冠李戴。

question: 确保管子没有变形。

options.A: Be sure that the hose is not blocked.
options.B: Make sure that the tubes have no deformation.
options.C: Ensure that the pipes are not damaged.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the tubes have no deformation.【词汇】make sure=确保，tube=管子，deformation=变形，blocked=堵塞（易混）。【解析】B正确：make sure对应确保，tubes对应管子，no deformation准确表达没有变形。A两处错误：tubes误译为hose（软管），deformation误译为blocked（堵塞），管子类型和缺陷类型全错。C两处错误：tubes换成pipes（近义但此处应一致），更把no deformation泛化为not damaged（未损坏），变形只是损坏的一种，范围错误。

question: 该限制适用于该规范的所有版本。

options.A: The limitation applies to all editions of the specification.
options.B: This restriction corresponds to all versions of the specification.
options.C: The limitation responds to all versions of the regulation.

explanation: 【译文】The limitation applies to all editions of the specification.【词汇】limitation=限制，apply to=适用于，edition/version=版本，specification=规范。【解析】A正确：limitation对应限制，applies to对应适用于，all editions of the specification对应规范的所有版本，搭配规范。B把apply to误译为corresponds to（与……对应/相符），动词含义不符，适用≠对应。C两处错误：apply误译为responds to（响应），specification误译为regulation（规章），属词义错译。

question: 描述机身、机翼和尾翼的结构。

options.A: State structure of airframe, wings and tail.
options.B: Present structure of airframe, wings and empennage.
options.C: Describe structure of fuselage, wings, and empennage.

explanation: 【译文】Describe the structure of the fuselage, wings and empennage.【词汇】describe=描述，fuselage=机身，wing=机翼，empennage=尾翼，airframe=机体（范围更大的易混词）。【解析】C正确：describe对应描述，fuselage、wings、empennage三个部件名全部准确。A两处错误：describe误译为state（陈述），fuselage误译为airframe（机体，包含机身机翼等整体结构，范围错误）。B两处错误：describe误译为present（呈现），同样用airframe错指机身。

question: 它取代了前面的版本。

options.A: It supersedes the preceding edition.
options.B: It updates the previous version.
options.C: It takes place of the following version.

explanation: 【译文】It supersedes the preceding edition.【词汇】supersede=取代（手册中表示新版替代旧版的规范用语），preceding=前面的，edition/version=版本。【解析】A正确：supersedes准确表达“取代”，preceding edition对应前面的版本。B把supersede误译为update（更新），取代≠更新——更新不一定废止旧版，词义错译。C两处错误：preceding误译为following（后面的），方向相反；且takes place of缺the，应为takes the place of，语法错误。

question: 将螺纹线连接到新电缆上。

options.A: Attach the threading cord to the new cable.
options.B: Attach the screw's cord to the new cable.
options.C: Attach the screw's wire to the new cable.

explanation: 【译文】Attach the threading cord to the new cable.【词汇】attach...to=把……连接到，threading cord=螺纹线/穿引绳，cable=电缆，screw=螺钉（易混）。【解析】A正确：attach...to对应连接，threading cord是“螺纹线”的规范表达，new cable对应新电缆。B把threading误译为screw's（螺钉的），螺纹线错成螺钉线，词义错译。C两处错误：同B的screw's错误，且cord（绳/线）换成wire（金属丝），与螺纹线含义不符。

question: 按如下方式计算垫片的厚度：t=x-y。

options.A: Accumulate the thickness of the shim as follows: t=x-y.
options.B: Calculate the thickness of the shim as follows: t=x-y.
options.C: Calculate the width of the shim as follows: t=x-y.

explanation: 【译文】Calculate the thickness of the shim as follows: t=x-y.【词汇】calculate=计算，thickness=厚度，shim=垫片，as follows=如下。【解析】B正确：calculate、thickness、shim、as follows全部对应题干，公式表达一致。A把calculate误译为accumulate（累积），计算变累积，词义错译。C把thickness误译为width（宽度），厚度变宽度，几何量张冠李戴。

question: 将带有螺纹的杆端放入接头中。

options.A: Put the end of the rod that has a screw in the fitting.
options.B: Put the end of the rod that has a thread in the adapter.
options.C: Put the end of the rod that has a thread in the fitting.

explanation: 【译文】Put the end of the rod that has a thread into the fitting.【词汇】end of the rod=杆端，thread=螺纹，fitting=接头，adapter=转接头/适配器（易混）。【解析】C正确：that has a thread用定语从句准确表达“带螺纹的”，fitting对应接头。A把thread误译为screw（螺钉），螺纹错成螺钉，词义错译。B把fitting误译为adapter（适配器/转接件），部件名称不符，put...in也不如put...into规范但主要错在adapter。

question: 如果征候再次出现，请拆下装置。

options.A: If the values occur again, remove the unit.
options.B: If the symptoms occur again, remove the unit.
options.C: Remove the unit, until the symptoms occur again.

explanation: 【译文】If the symptoms occur again, remove the unit.【词汇】symptom=征候/症状，occur again=再次出现，remove=拆下，unit=装置。【解析】B正确：symptoms对应征候，occur again对应再次出现，remove the unit对应拆下装置，条件关系准确。A把symptoms误译为values（数值），征候错成数值，词义错译。C把if条件句误改为until时间从句：变成“拆下装置直到征候再次出现”，逻辑完全颠倒，属语法结构错误。

question: 给出继电器、二极管和系统其他部件的符号。

options.A: Gives the symbols for resistors, diodes, and other parts of the system.
options.B: Gives the symbols for relays, resistors, and other parts of the system.
options.C: Gives the symbols for relays, diodes, and other parts of the system.

explanation: 【译文】Give the symbols for relays, diodes, and other parts of the system.【词汇】relay=继电器，diode=二极管，resistor=电阻器（易混考点），symbol=符号。【解析】C正确：relays对应继电器，diodes对应二极管，other parts of the system对应系统其他部件，三类对象齐全。A把relays误译为resistors，继电器错成电阻器，张冠李戴。B保留relays却把diodes误译为resistors，二极管错成电阻器，同样张冠李戴。

question: 您可以同时校准所有罗盘系统。

options.A: You can calibrate all the compass systems at the same time.
options.B: You can fix all the compass systems at the same time.
options.C: You can calibrate all the magnetic needle systems at the same time.

explanation: 【译文】You can calibrate all the compass systems at the same time.【词汇】calibrate=校准，compass system=罗盘系统，at the same time=同时。【解析】A正确：calibrate对应校准，compass systems对应罗盘系统，at the same time对应同时，三处考点全对。B把calibrate误译为fix（修理），校准变修理，词义错译。C把compass systems误译为magnetic needle systems（磁针系统），罗盘系统包含磁针但不限于磁针，范围缩小且非标准术语。

question: 调整卡箍，直到有足够的摩擦力将其固定到位。

options.A: If there is sufficient friction to keep it in position, adjust the clamp.
options.B: Adjust the clip until there is sufficient friction to keep it in position.
options.C: Adjust the clamp until there is sufficient friction to keep it in position.

explanation: 【译文】Adjust the clamp until there is sufficient friction to keep it in position.【词汇】clamp=卡箍，until=直到，sufficient friction=足够的摩擦力，keep in position=固定到位。【解析】C正确：adjust对应调整，clamp对应卡箍，until引导的止点关系、sufficient friction、keep it in position全部对应。A把“调整到产生足够摩擦力”改成“如果有摩擦力就调整”（if条件句），条件与目的逻辑倒置。B把clamp误译为clip（夹子/卡夹），卡箍与卡夹是不同紧固件，部件错译。

question: 工具随后可用于安装程序。

options.A: Tool is adjacently available for the installation procedure.
options.B: Tool is subsequently available for the installation procedure.
options.C: Tool is subsequently available for the installation task.

explanation: 【译文】The tool is subsequently available for the installation procedure.【词汇】subsequently=随后，available=可用的，installation procedure=安装程序。【解析】B正确：subsequently对应随后，available对应可用，installation procedure对应安装程序，全部准确。A把subsequently误译为adjacently（邻近地），形近词错译，时间关系变成空间关系。C把procedure误译为task（任务），“安装程序”是手册固定术语，task泛指任务，术语不对应。

question: 要给刹车系统放气，请全行程地操作手摇泵。

options.A: To depressurize the braking system, operate the hand pump handle through its full travel.
options.B: To inflate the braking system, operate the hand pump handle through its full travel.
options.C: To bleed the braking system, operate the hand pump handle through its full travel.

explanation: 【译文】To bleed the brake system, operate the hand pump handle through its full travel.【词汇】bleed=放气/放泄，brake system=刹车系统，hand pump handle=手摇泵手柄，full travel=全行程。【解析】C正确：bleed是刹车/液压系统放气的标准术语，operate...through its full travel对应全行程操作。A把bleed误译为depressurize（释压），放气是排出系统内空气的工艺，不等于释放压力，词义错译。B把bleed误译为inflate（充气），放气变充气，方向相反。

question: 系统测试通常在大修时执行。

options.A: System test is normally used at minor maintenance time.
options.B: System test is usually done during maintenance and repairs.
options.C: System test is normally used at major maintenance periods.

explanation: 【译文】System test is normally performed at major maintenance periods (overhaul).【词汇】system test=系统测试，normally=通常，major maintenance period=大修期间，overhaul=大修。【解析】C正确：major maintenance periods保留“大修”这一关键限定，normally对应通常；used虽不如performed自然，但三项中唯一体现大修语义。A把大修误译为minor maintenance（小修），维修等级方向相反。B只说maintenance and repairs（维修和修理），把“大修”泛化为一般维修，漏译关键限定，范围错误。

question: 记录测试结果。

options.A: Record the test results.
options.B: Record the check results.
options.C: Test the result on the record.

explanation: 【译文】Record the test results.【词汇】record=记录，test result=测试结果。【解析】A正确：record作动词对应记录，test results对应测试结果，动宾搭配简洁准确。B把test误译为check（检查），测试结果错成检查结果，词义错译。C语序颠倒：变成“在记录上测试结果”（test the result on the record），record被错用为地点状语，动词和名词角色全乱，语法语义均错。

question: 管子的直径太小了。

options.A: The radius of the duct is too small.
options.B: The diameter of the tube is too small.
options.C: The circumference of the pipe is too small.

explanation: 【译文】The diameter of the tube is too small.【词汇】diameter=直径，tube=管子，radius=半径（易混），circumference=周长（易混）。【解析】B正确：diameter对应直径，tube对应管子，too small对应太小，三处准确。A两处错误：diameter误译为radius（半径），tube误译为duct（导管/风道），几何量和部件均错。C两处错误：diameter误译为circumference（周长），tube换成pipe（虽近义但题干统一为tube），测量对象张冠李戴。

question: 将“纬度”旋钮设置为当地纬度。

options.A: Set the "ATT" knob to the local attitude.
options.B: Set the "ALT" knob to the local altitude.
options.C: Set the "LAT" knob to the local latitude.

explanation: 【译文】Set the “LAT” knob to the local latitude.【词汇】LAT=latitude的缩写（纬度），knob=旋钮，latitude=纬度，attitude=姿态（易混），altitude=高度（易混）。【解析】C正确：LAT是latitude的标准缩写，local latitude对应当地纬度，旋钮标识与词义双对。A两处错误：LAT误写为ATT，latitude误译为attitude（姿态），纬度错成姿态。B两处错误：LAT误写为ALT，latitude误译为altitude（高度），纬度错成高度，均属形近缩写混淆。

question: 使用滑石粉来发现外部泄漏。

options.A: Use talcum powder to find external leaks.
options.B: Use titanium powder to detect external leaks.
options.C: Use limestone powder to examine internal leaks.

explanation: 【译文】Use talcum powder to find external leaks.【词汇】talcum powder=滑石粉，find=发现，external=外部的，leak=泄漏，internal=内部的（反义）。【解析】A正确：talcum powder对应滑石粉，find对应发现，external leaks对应外部泄漏，全部准确。B把talcum powder误译为titanium powder（钛粉），材料张冠李戴，且detect不如find贴近“发现”。C两处错误：external误译为internal（内部的），方向相反；talcum powder误译为limestone powder（石灰粉），材料错误。

question: 这个程序这时不适用。

options.A: This program is not available at present.
options.B: This procedure is not applicable at this time.
options.C: This program is not reasonable now.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure is not applicable at this time.【词汇】procedure=程序，applicable=适用的，at this time=此时/这时，available=可用的（易混）。【解析】B正确：procedure对应程序（手册标准术语），not applicable对应不适用，at this time对应这时，三处准确。A两处错误：procedure误译为program（程序/计划，非维修程序术语），not applicable误译为not available（不可用），适用≠可用。C两处错误：同用program，applicable误译为reasonable（合理的），词义错译。

question: 调整纵向配平系统。

options.A: Adjust the longitudinal trim system.
options.B: Adjust the lateral trim system.
options.C: Adjust the vertical balancing system.

explanation: 【译文】Adjust the longitudinal trim system.【词汇】adjust=调整，longitudinal=纵向的，trim system=配平系统，lateral=横向的（易混）。【解析】A正确：adjust对应调整，longitudinal对应纵向，trim system对应配平系统，术语全部准确。B把longitudinal误译为lateral（横向的），纵向变横向，方向相反。C两处错误：longitudinal误译为vertical（垂直的），trim误译为balancing（平衡），配平系统错成平衡系统，术语不准。

question: 确保钢索有张力。

options.A: Make sure that the cables are bent.
options.B: Make sure that there is tension in the cables.
options.C: Make sure that there are twists in the cables.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that there is tension in the cables.【词汇】make sure=确保，tension=张力，cable=钢索，bent=弯曲的，twist=扭结（易混）。【解析】B正确：there is tension in the cables准确表达钢索内存在张力，是检查钢索状态的规范说法。A把tension误译为bent（弯曲的），张力变弯曲，性质完全不同，词义错译。C把tension误译为twists（扭结/扭转），张力是拉力状态而非扭曲形态，张冠李戴。

question: 从滑油箱上拆下磁性排放堵头。

options.A: Remove the magnesium drain plug from the hydraulic reservoir.
options.B: Replace the magnetic drain plug of the oil tank.
options.C: Remove the magnetic drain plug from the oil tank.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the magnetic drain plug from the oil tank.【词汇】remove=拆下，magnetic drain plug=磁性排放堵头，oil tank=滑油箱，magnesium=镁（形近易混）。【解析】C正确：remove、magnetic drain plug、oil tank三个考点全部对应。A两处错误：magnetic误译为magnesium（镁），磁性错成金属镁，形近词错译；oil tank误译为hydraulic reservoir（液压油箱），滑油箱错成液压油箱。B把remove误译为replace（更换），拆下变更换，动作错误。

question: 在维修期间不要给飞机加油。

options.A: Do not refuel the aircraft during maintenance.
options.B: Do not defuel the aircraft in the period of maintenance.
options.C: Stop refueling the aircraft before maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】Do not refuel the aircraft during maintenance.【词汇】refuel=加油，defuel=放油（反义易混），during maintenance=维修期间，aircraft=飞机。【解析】A正确：do not refuel对应不要加油，during maintenance对应维修期间，禁令和时间范围准确。B把refuel误译为defuel（放油），加油变放油，方向相反。C把during误译为before（维修之前），时间关系错译；stop refueling也改变了“不要进行加油”的禁令表达方式。

question: 检查封严是否存在缺陷。

options.A: Examine the seal for defects.
options.B: Check the abnormality of the sealant.
options.C: Inspect whether there are the defaults in the solvent.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the seal for defects.【词汇】examine=检查，seal=封严，defect=缺陷，sealant=密封胶（易混），solvent=溶剂（易混）。【解析】A正确：examine对应检查，seal对应封严，for defects准确表达“是否存在缺陷”的检查目的。B两处错误：seal误译为sealant（密封胶），封严件错成密封材料；defects误译为abnormality（异常），缺陷≠异常，词义错译。C两处错误：seal误译为solvent（溶剂），defects误译为defaults（默认值/违约），对象完全错误。

question: 计算所需垫片的数量。

options.A: Assess the requirements of washers.
options.B: Evaluate the amount of clamps required.
options.C: Calculate the number of shims that are necessary.

explanation: 【译文】Calculate the number of shims that are necessary.【词汇】calculate=计算，number=数量，shim=垫片，necessary=所需的。【解析】C正确：calculate对应计算，number对应数量，shims that are necessary对应所需垫片，三要素完整。A两处错误：calculate误译为assess（评估），且the requirements of washers漏译“数量”，washer虽可指垫片但不如shim贴切此语境。B两处错误：shims误译为clamps（卡箍），部件张冠李戴；evaluate（评估）也不如calculate（计算）准确。

question: 该软件仅与指定的操作系统兼容。

options.A: This software is only acceptable by the assigned handling system.
options.B: This software is compatible only with the specified operating system.
options.C: This software only corresponds to its designed operating system.

explanation: 【译文】This software is compatible only with the specified operating system.【词汇】compatible with=与……兼容，specified=指定的，operating system=操作系统，only=仅。【解析】B正确：compatible only with准确表达仅与……兼容，specified operating system对应指定操作系统。A把compatible误译为acceptable（可接受的），operating system误译为handling system。C把compatible误译为corresponds to（对应），specified误译为designed（设计的），均属词义错译。

question: 将易燃材料与工作区保持至少50英尺的距离。

options.A: Reserve the inflammable material at least 50 inches away from the work area.
options.B: Deposit the explosive substance out of 50 feet with the work area.
options.C: Keep flammable materials at a minimum distance of 50 feet from the work area.

explanation: 【译文】Keep flammable materials at a minimum distance of 50 feet from the work area.【词汇】flammable=易燃的，minimum distance=最小距离，feet=英尺（≠inches英寸），work area=工作区。【解析】C正确：keep...at a minimum distance of 50 feet对应保持至少50英尺距离。A把50 feet误译为50 inches（英寸），单位错误；reserve不如keep贴切。B把flammable误译为explosive（爆炸性的），夸大危险性；deposit和out of 50 feet表达混乱。

question: 给货舱门手柄做润滑。

options.A: Smooth the cargo-compartment door levers.
options.B: Polish the cargo-compartment door wheels.
options.C: Lubricate the cargo-compartment door handles.

explanation: 【译文】Lubricate the cargo-compartment door handles.【词汇】lubricate=润滑，cargo-compartment door=货舱门，handle=手柄。【解析】C正确：lubricate对应润滑，cargo-compartment door handles对应货舱门手柄，动作和部件准确。A两处错误：lubricate误译为smooth（使光滑），润滑工艺错成打磨平滑；handle误译为lever（操纵杆），部件不符。B两处错误：lubricate误译为polish（抛光），handle误译为wheel（轮子），动作部件双错，张冠李戴。

question: 检查轮胎气压，必要时给轮胎充气。

options.A: Do a tire pressure check, and if necessary inflate the tires.
options.B: Check the pressure of a wheel and charge it if necessary.
options.C: Inspect the tire pressure and it's required to refuel.

explanation: 【译文】Do a tire pressure check, and if necessary inflate the tires.【词汇】tire pressure=轮胎气压，if necessary=必要时，inflate=充气，tire=轮胎（≠wheel轮子）。【解析】A正确：tire pressure check对应轮胎气压检查，inflate the tires对应给轮胎充气，if necessary对应必要时，要素完整。B两处错误：tire误译为wheel（轮子），inflate误译为charge（充装/充电，不用于轮胎充气）。C把inflate误译为refuel（加油），充气变加油，动作完全错误，且it's required to refuel句式不通。

question: 对燃油进行微生物污染取样。

options.A: Sample the fluid to contaminate microbiology.
options.B: Do a fuel sampling for microbiological contamination.
options.C: Obtain a demo of oil to determine the microbial pollution.

explanation: 【译文】Do a fuel sampling for microbiological contamination.【词汇】fuel=燃油，sampling=取样，microbiological contamination=微生物污染。【解析】B正确：fuel sampling对应燃油取样，for microbiological contamination表达取样目的。A逻辑颠倒：to contaminate变成去污染流体，fuel也误译为fluid。C把fuel误译为oil（滑油），sampling误译为demo（样品），microbial pollution不如microbiological contamination规范。

question: 在所有孔内涂上特殊材料，特别是在冷凝区。

options.A: Apply special materials in all the holes, specially in the area which can have condensation.
options.B: Paint special materials in all the holes, especially in the freezing area.
options.C: Fill special materials in all the holes, particularly for the frost area.

explanation: 【译文】Apply special material in all the holes, especially in areas that can have condensation.【词汇】apply=涂敷，special material=特殊材料，hole=孔，condensation=冷凝。【解析】A正确：apply、all the holes、condensation全部对应（specially此处同especially，稍欠规范可接受）。B把apply误译为paint（刷漆），condensation误译为freezing（冻结）。C把apply误译为fill（填充），condensation误译为frost（霜冻），工艺和区域均错。

question: 使用多用途磁盘驱动器下载飞行管理数据。

options.A: Use multipurpose plate driver to load flight management data.
options.B: To upload flight management data, you can utilize multi-function disc generator.
options.C: Download the flight management data with the multipurpose disk drive unit.

explanation: 【译文】Download the flight management data with the multipurpose disk drive unit.【词汇】download=下载，flight management data=飞行管理数据，multipurpose disk drive=多用途磁盘驱动器。【解析】C正确：download、flight management data、multipurpose disk drive unit全对。A把download误译为load（装载），disk drive误译为plate driver。B把download误译为upload（上传，方向相反），disk drive误译为disc generator（盘片发生器）。

question: 如果发现裂缝，参阅结构修理手册获取损伤分类和纠正措施。

options.A: If you find cracks,  refer to the structural repair manual for damage classification and corrective action.
options.B: If you find the dents, according to the structural maintenance manual to get the damage group and take the correct action.
options.C: In the event of finding gaps, read the structural maintenance manual to sort the loss and correct the action.

explanation: 【译文】If you find cracks, refer to the structural repair manual for damage classification and corrective action.【词汇】crack=裂缝，structural repair manual=结构修理手册，corrective action=纠正措施。【解析】A正确：cracks、structural repair manual、damage classification、corrective action全对。B把cracks误译为dents（凹坑），repair manual误成maintenance manual。C把cracks误译为gaps（缝隙），damage误译为loss。

question: 此步骤仅在涂面漆时适用。

options.A: This step is applied to primer layer only.
options.B: This step can be only applied when the top is painted.
options.C: This step is applicable only when you apply the top layer of paint.

explanation: 【译文】This step is applicable only when you apply the top layer of paint.【词汇】step=步骤，applicable=适用的，top layer of paint=面漆/面层漆，primer=底漆（易混）。【解析】C正确：is applicable only when对应仅在……时适用，apply the top layer of paint准确表达涂面漆这一工艺。A把面漆误译为primer layer（底漆层），涂层类型张冠李戴；applied to也改变了“适用”的含义。B误译为“顶部被涂漆时”（when the top is painted），把top layer of paint曲解为top被涂，对象和动作均偏离。

question: 气流沿着缝翼的顶部和底部表面流动。

options.A: The airflow goes along the top and bottom surfaces of the slats.
options.B: The airflow can go between the top and bottom of the slats.
options.C: The air flows to the top and bottom of the slats' surfaces.

explanation: 【译文】The airflow goes along the top and bottom surfaces of the slats.【词汇】airflow=气流，go along=沿着……流动，top and bottom surfaces=顶部和底部表面，slat=缝翼。【解析】A正确：goes along对应沿着，top and bottom surfaces对应上下表面，slats对应缝翼，气流路径表达准确。B把“沿上下表面”误译为between the top and bottom（在上下部之间），气流路径变成穿过缝翼中间，方向错误。C的flows to表示流向表面，丢失了“沿表面流动”（along）的含义，flow方向不对应。

question: 当你将控制杆设置在“UP”位时，液压必须下降。

options.A: When the rod moves to "UP", the hydraulic pressure rises together.
options.B: When you set the bar to "UP", the hydraulic temperature goes down.
options.C: When you set the lever to “UP”, the hydraulic pressure must decrease.

explanation: 【译文】When you set the lever to “UP”, the hydraulic pressure must decrease.【词汇】lever=控制杆，set...to=设置到……位，hydraulic pressure=液压，decrease=下降。【解析】C正确：set the lever to “UP”对应控制杆置于UP位，pressure must decrease对应液压必须下降。A把decrease误译为rises（上升），方向相反。B把lever误译为bar，pressure误译为temperature（温度），物理量张冠李戴。

question: 如果移动不是你需要的，要对系统进行测试。

options.A: If you get an unwanted movement, do a test of the system.
options.B: If the move is not set up by you, verify the system.
options.C: If the removal is not what you want, test the system again.

explanation: 【译文】If you get an unwanted movement, do a test of the system.【词汇】unwanted movement=不需要的/非预期的移动，do a test=做测试，system=系统。【解析】A正确：unwanted movement准确概括“不是你需要的移动”，do a test of the system对应对系统进行测试。B两处错误：把unwanted曲解为not set up by you（不是你设置的），“不需要”错成“未设置”；test误译为verify（验证），动作不同。C两处错误：movement误译为removal（拆除/移除），词形相近但词义完全不同；添加again无原文依据。

question: 该格式不应依赖于设备，如推力计算机。

options.A: The layout does not rely on devices that require power such as computers.
options.B: The format should not rely on devices such as a power computer.
options.C: The forms should be independent from any equipment, computers are suitable.

explanation: 【译文】The format should not depend on equipment such as a thrust computer.【词汇】format=格式，rely on=依赖，thrust computer=推力计算机。【解析】B相对最佳：should not rely on devices对应不应依赖设备，结构最贴近；但推力计算机误译为power computer（power≠thrust）。A把format误译为layout（布局），并添译that require power曲解设备。C把format误译为forms（表格），后半句computers are suitable语义脱节。

question: 引气口作动器安装在进气门内侧的后压力舱壁的后部。

options.A: The inlet door actuator is installed aft of the rear pressure bulkhead on the inner side of the air inlet door.
options.B: The air inlet actuator is mounted on the side of the pressure bulkhead behind the intake valve.
options.C: The air release actuator is located on top of the pressure bulkhead inside the intake valve.

explanation: 【译文】The inlet door actuator is installed aft of the rear pressure bulkhead on the inner side of the air inlet door.【词汇】actuator=作动器，aft of=在……后部，rear pressure bulkhead=后压力舱壁，inner side=内侧。【解析】A正确：installed aft of对应安装在后部，rear pressure bulkhead、inner side位置完整。B遗漏inner side，位置误成behind the intake valve。C把作动器误译为air release actuator，aft of误译为on top of。

question: 从支架上除去不需要的密封胶。

options.A: Remove unwanted support from sealant.
options.B: Wipe excess sealant from the lever.
options.C: Remove the unwanted sealant from the bracket.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the unwanted sealant from the bracket.【词汇】remove=除去，unwanted sealant=不需要的密封胶，bracket=支架。【解析】C正确：remove、unwanted sealant、from the bracket三个要素全部对应，密封胶是被除去的对象，支架是来源位置。A宾语关系颠倒：remove unwanted support from sealant变成“从密封胶上除去支架”，支架与密封胶的角色互换。B多处错误：bracket误译为lever（操纵杆），unwanted换成excess（多余≠不需要的），wipe（擦拭）也不如remove贴近“除去”。

question: 说明如何检查它们是否正常运行和如何识别故障。

options.A: Explain how to check them for proper operation and how to recognize a malfunction.
options.B: Describes how to check that they are functioning properly to identify faults.
options.C: Describes how to identify these failures so that these systems can function properly.

explanation: 【译文】Explain how to check them for proper operation and how to recognize a malfunction.【词汇】explain=说明，proper operation=正常运行，recognize=识别，malfunction=故障。【解析】A正确：explain how to check...and how to recognize两个并列目的完整对应。B把检查运行与识别故障揉成目的链（functioning properly to identify faults），逻辑曲解。C因果颠倒：识别故障以便系统正常工作，主次关系错误。

question: 分配系统用于引入和分配空气。

options.A: The distribution system is used to store and distribute air pressure.
options.B: Distribution system is used to induct and distribute air.
options.C: Air inlet system is used to distribute air to all systems.

explanation: 【译文】The distribution system is used to induct and distribute air.【词汇】distribution system=分配系统，induct=引入，distribute=分配，air=空气。【解析】B正确：distribution system对应分配系统，induct and distribute air对应引入和分配空气，两个功能准确。A两处错误：induct误译为store（储存），引入变储存词义错译；air误加pressure变成空气压力。C两处错误：distribution system误译为air inlet system（进气系统），系统名称张冠李戴；to all systems无依据扩大分配范围。

question: 测试仪将自动运行测试。

options.A: The testing machine will run the tests in manual mode.
options.B: The test set will automatically run the tests.
options.C: The test apparatus will give the test parameter automatically.

explanation: 【译文】The test set will automatically run the tests.【词汇】test set=测试仪/测试设备，automatically=自动地，run the tests=运行测试，manual mode=人工模式（反义）。【解析】B正确：test set对应测试仪，automatically对应自动，run the tests对应运行测试，全部准确。A把automatically误译为in manual mode（人工模式），自动变人工，方向相反；testing machine也不如test set规范。C把run the tests误译为give the test parameter（给出测试参数），运行测试错成给出参数，动作张冠李戴。

question: 确信每个电门下方的琥珀色的VALVE CLOSED灯熄灭。

options.A: Ensure you switch off the brown VALVE CLOSED light next to each switch.
options.B: Make sure the amber VALVE CLOSED light below each switch goes off.
options.C: The purple VALVE CLOSED light under each switch is confirmed off.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure the amber VALVE CLOSED light below each switch goes off.【词汇】amber=琥珀色，VALVE CLOSED light=活门关闭灯，below=在……下方，go off=熄灭，switch=电门。【解析】B正确：amber、below each switch、goes off三个考点全部对应，灯自行熄灭的含义准确。A两处错误：amber误译为brown（棕色），below误译为next to（旁边）；switch off（主动关断）也不如goes off（灯熄灭）贴切。C两处错误：amber误译为purple（紫色），颜色错译；confirmed off被动句式与“确信灯熄灭”的语义不对应。

question: 释放高温大翼防冰气体会导致人员受伤。

options.A: The release of high temperature wing anti-ice air will cause injury to persons.
options.B: The opening of high pressure wing anti-ice air will cause injury to persons.
options.C: Injury to persons can be caused by releasing the hot anti-ice liquid.

explanation: 【译文】The release of high-temperature wing anti-ice air will cause injury to persons.【词汇】release=释放，high temperature=高温，wing anti-ice air=大翼防冰气体，cause injury=导致受伤。【解析】A正确：release、high temperature、wing anti-ice air、cause injury全部对应。B把high temperature误译为high pressure（高压），release误译为opening。C把anti-ice air误译为anti-ice liquid（防冰液），介质张冠李戴。

question: 时钟通过CLOCK跳开关从28伏直流热电瓶汇流条中获取电源。

options.A: The clocks get power from the 28v AC hot battery bus and via the CLOCK circuit breaker.
options.B: The clocks get power from the 28v dc hot battery bus through the CLOCK circuit breaker.
options.C: The clocks is through the CLOCK circuit breaker powered from the 28v dc hot battery bus.

explanation: 【译文】The clocks get power from the 28 V dc hot battery bus through the CLOCK circuit breaker.【词汇】28 V dc=28伏直流，hot battery bus=热电瓶汇流条，circuit breaker=跳开关。【解析】B正确：28v dc对应直流，through the CLOCK circuit breaker对应通过跳开关。A把dc误译为AC（交流），电源性质相反，via位置也生硬。C语法错误：clocks is through...powered主谓不一致且语序混乱。

question: 在下次相应定检中做必要的修理。

options.A: Make the necessary repairs during the next applied spot check.
options.B: Make the required repairs during the next applicable preliminary inspection.
options.C: Make the necessary repairs during the next applicable scheduled maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】Make the necessary repairs during the next applicable scheduled maintenance.【词汇】necessary repairs=必要的修理，applicable=相应的，scheduled maintenance=定检。【解析】C正确：next applicable scheduled maintenance准确对应下次相应定检。A把scheduled maintenance误译为spot check（抽查），类型张冠李戴。B把定检误译为preliminary inspection（预检），维修级别错误。

question: 维修人员在维修之前要读服务通告, 了解相关要求。

options.A: The maintenance personnel shall read the Service Notice and comply with the requirements ahead of maintenance.
options.B: Service Bulletin should be read and related requirements should be known prior to maintenance by the maintenance personnel.
options.C: Read Service Bulletin and understand the content of requirements during maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】The maintenance personnel should read the Service Bulletin and know the related requirements before maintenance.【词汇】Service Bulletin=服务通告，prior to maintenance=维修之前，maintenance personnel=维修人员。【解析】B正确：Service Bulletin术语准确，prior to maintenance对应维修之前，主体保留。A把Service Bulletin误译为Service Notice，know误译为comply with（遵守）。C把before误译为during（期间），且丢失主语维修人员。

question: 所有传感器都提供显示的数据。

options.A: All sensors provide implied information.
options.B: All sensors supply indication data.
options.C: All sensors can receive indication data.

explanation: 【译文】All sensors supply indication data.【词汇】sensor=传感器，supply/provide=提供，indication data=显示数据/指示数据。【解析】B正确：sensors对应传感器，supply对应提供，indication data对应显示的数据，三个考点全部准确。A把indication data误译为implied information（隐含的信息），显示数据错成隐含信息，词义错译。C把supply误译为receive（接收），提供变接收，方向相反——传感器是数据源而非接收方。

question: 按照AMM要求维修或更换导线束或套管。

options.A: Repair or replace the wire bundle or conduit per the requirements of AMM.
options.B: Refer to the  requirements of AMM repair or relocate the wire bundle or conduit.
options.C: According to AMM require to repair or change the wire bundle or conduit.

explanation: 【译文】Repair or replace the wire bundle or conduit per the requirements of the AMM.【词汇】repair or replace=维修或更换，wire bundle=导线束，conduit=套管，per=按照。【解析】A正确：repair or replace、wire bundle、conduit、per the requirements of AMM全部对应。B把replace误译为relocate（重新定位），且Refer to...repair句式杂糅。C把replace误译为change，According to AMM require语法错误。

question: 长秒针只与时钟计时功能配合使用。

options.A: The long hand of the clock only goes with the counting function of the clock.
options.B: The sweep second hand only works with the timing function of the clock.
options.C: The second pointer is only used for the chronic function of the clock.

explanation: 【译文】The sweep second hand works only with the timing function of the clock.【词汇】sweep second hand=长秒针，work with=配合使用，timing function=计时功能。【解析】B正确：sweep second hand是长秒针标准术语，timing function对应计时功能。A把sweep second hand误译为long hand（通常指分针），timing误译为counting（计数）。C把长秒针误译为second pointer，timing误译为chronic（慢性的），词义错译。

question: 经批准的修理部分应包括进行修理所需的工艺和技术。

options.A: The approved repair part must contain the skill and technology required to carry up the repair.
options.B: The approved repair portion shall include processes and techniques necessary for performing a repair .
options.C: The necessary workmanship and skills constitute the approval of the repair portion.

explanation: 【译文】The approved repair portion shall include the processes and techniques necessary for performing a repair.【词汇】approved=经批准的，repair portion=修理部分，process=工艺，technique=技术。【解析】B正确：approved repair portion、shall include、processes and techniques、performing a repair全部对应。A把processes误译为skill（技能），perform误译为carry up（搬运）。C逻辑颠倒：工艺技能构成批准，与原句主客关系相反。

question: 对机身下部进行外部区域检查。

options.A: Perform an external zonal inspection of the lower fuselage.
options.B: Inspect the outer area of the lowest fuselage.
options.C: Do the exterior medial check of the fuselage .

explanation: 【译文】Perform an external zonal inspection of the lower fuselage.【词汇】external=外部的，zonal inspection=区域检查，lower fuselage=机身下部，perform=执行/进行。【解析】A正确：external zonal inspection是“外部区域检查”的标准术语，lower fuselage对应机身下部，perform对应进行。B两处错误：zonal inspection误译为outer area（外部区域名词，非检查项目），lower误译为lowest（最下部），比较级错成最高级。C把zonal误译为medial（中间的/内侧的），区域检查错成中间检查，概念完全错误。

question: APU火警系统在驾驶舱内启动与发动机相同的火警警报。

options.A: The APU fire alarm system accumulates the same fire alarm in the flight deck as in the engine.
options.B: The APU fire warning system actuates the same fire warning in the flight compartment as the engines.
options.C: The APU fire warning system activates the same fire warning in the cockpit as for the engines.

explanation: 【译文】The APU fire warning system activates the same fire warning in the cockpit as for the engines.【词汇】APU fire warning system=APU火警系统，activate=启动，cockpit=驾驶舱，as for=与……相同。【解析】C正确：activates对应启动，cockpit对应驾驶舱，same fire warning...as for the engines结构完整。A把activates误译为accumulates（积聚），动作错译。B接近但as the engines缺for，比较结构不完整，flight compartment不如cockpit常用。

question: 滑油的另一个重要作用是保护金属表面不被腐蚀。

options.A: Another important function of lubricating oil is to protect the corroded metal surfaces.
options.B: Another important task of the oil is to protect the metal surfaces from corrosion.
options.C: Preventing the metal surface from further corrosion is the other essential function of the lube.

explanation: 【译文】Another important function of the oil is to protect the metal surfaces from corrosion.【词汇】function=作用，metal surface=金属表面，protect...from corrosion=保护……不被腐蚀。【解析】B正确：protect the metal surfaces from corrosion准确表达保护表面免于腐蚀。A把“不被腐蚀”误译为the corroded metal surfaces（已腐蚀的表面），语义相反。C的further corrosion暗示已腐蚀，范围改变；lube是口语缩写不够正式。

question: 为了确保持续保护，要不时地添加防腐剂。

options.A: Corrosion inhibitor is necessary from time to time to ensure continued protection.
options.B: Corrosion inhibitor is necessary frequently so that protection remains in effective.
options.C: Corrosion protection is necessary but is ineffective for cost reasons.

explanation: 【译文】Corrosion inhibitor must be added from time to time to ensure continued protection.【词汇】corrosion inhibitor=防腐剂，from time to time=不时地，continued protection=持续保护。【解析】A正确：from time to time对应不时地，ensure continued protection对应确保持续保护。B把from time to time误译为frequently（频繁地），频率夸大，且remains in effective语法错误。C语义偏离：ineffective for cost reasons（因成本无效）无中生有。

question: 在你安装软件之前，飞机必须在地面上且关闭发动机。

options.A: Before install the software, the plane has to be on the ground and the engines shut down.
options.B: The airplane must be on the ground with the engines off before you can install software.
options.C: The aircraft should be on the ground and engines power off before you upload the software.

explanation: 【译文】The airplane must be on the ground with the engines off before you install the software.【词汇】on the ground=在地面，engines off=发动机关闭，install=安装，before=在……之前。【解析】B正确：must be on the ground、with the engines off、before install三要素全对应。A语法错误：Before install应为Before installing或Before you install。C把install误译为upload（上传），should也弱于must（必须）。

question: 当你替换一个单词时，一定要确保你选择的替代词不会改变句子的意思。

options.A: When you try to change a word, make sure that the substitute you choose doesn't replace the meaning of the sentence.
options.B: Make sure that the chosen replacement word will not vary the implication of the sentence if you replace a word.
options.C: When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.

explanation: 【译文】When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.【词汇】replace=替换，alternative=替代词，change the meaning=改变意思。【解析】C正确：replace a word、alternative you select、does not change the meaning全对应。A逻辑错误：doesn't replace the meaning把“不改变”错译成“不替换”。B把change误译为vary（变化），meaning误译为implication（暗示）。

question: 确保探头盖工作状态良好，没有损坏的迹象。

options.A: Make sure the probe cover is in good working condition with no evidence of damage.
options.B: Make sure the probe plug is in good condition and there is no signal of damage.
options.C: The probe lid is insured to be in ideal condition and out of damage.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure the probe cover is in good working condition with no evidence of damage.【词汇】probe cover=探头盖，good working condition=工作状态良好，evidence of damage=损坏迹象。【解析】A正确：probe cover、good working condition、no evidence of damage全对应。B把cover误译为plug（堵头），evidence误译为signal（信号）。C把cover误译为lid，insured应为ensured用词错误，ideal condition夸大good condition。

question: 以下程序将预防飞机结构、涂层或系统部件的退化。

options.A: The following procedures will prevent deterioration of aircraft structural coatings or system components.
options.B: The procedures that follow will prevent the deterioration of the airplane structure, finish, or system components.
options.C: The delamination of the airplane structure, finish, or system parts will be blocked by the procedures listed below.

explanation: 【译文】The following procedures will prevent the deterioration of the airplane structure, finish, or system components.【词汇】prevent=预防，deterioration=退化，finish=涂层，component=部件。【解析】B正确：structure、finish、system components三个并列对象清晰对应结构、涂层、系统部件。A把结构和涂层合并为aircraft structural coatings（结构涂层），漏掉结构这一独立对象。C把deterioration误译为delamination（分层），张冠李戴。

question: 皮托探头位于飞机前外部。

options.A: The pitot tube is on the external forward part of the airplane.
