options.B: You may find the pitot probe on the front internal side of the fuselage.
options.C: The pitot probes are located on the forward external part of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】The pitot probes are located on the forward external part of the airplane.【词汇】pitot probe=皮托探头，located on=位于，forward=前部的，external=外部的。【解析】C正确：pitot probes、forward external part全对应。A把pitot probe误译为pitot tube（皮托管），部件不同。B把external误译为internal（内部的），方向相反；You may find句式也不够规范。

question: Remove oil and grease with a degreasing agent.

options.A: Use a degreasing agent to remove oil and grease.
options.B: Draw oil and grease from a degreasing agent.
options.C: Add oil and grease into a degreasing agent.

explanation: 【译文】用除油剂去除油和油脂。【词汇】remove=去除，oil and grease=油和油脂，degreasing agent=除油剂/脱脂剂，with=用（工具）。【解析】A正确：Use a degreasing agent to remove oil and grease是规范的语序调整同义改写，工具（除油剂）、动作（去除）、对象（油和油脂）全部保留。B把“用除油剂去除油脂”误改成“从除油剂中抽出油脂”（draw...from），工具和对象关系颠倒。C误改成“向除油剂中加入油脂”（add...into），去除变加入，动作方向相反。

question: Long sentences are not easy to understand.

options.A: Long sentences are easy to read.
options.B: Long sentences are difficult to read.
options.C: Short sentences are difficult to understand.

explanation: 【译文】长句子不容易理解。【词汇】long sentences=长句，not easy to understand=不容易理解，difficult=困难的，short sentences=短句（干扰项）。【解析】B最佳：not easy to understand（不易理解）与difficult to read（难读）语义最接近，主语long sentences保持一致；read虽不如understand精确，但方向和对象正确。A把not easy误改为easy（容易），难易方向完全相反。C把主语long sentences误改为short sentences（短句），句子长度对象张冠李戴。

question: De-energize the system.

options.A: Provide the pneumatic power for the system.
options.B: Supply the electrical power for the system.
options.C: Remove the electrical power of the system.

explanation: 【译文】切断该系统的电源（使系统断电）。【词汇】de-energize=断电/切断电源（de-前缀表去除），electrical power=电源，pneumatic power=气源（干扰项），remove=去除。【解析】C正确：Remove the electrical power准确表达de-energize“去除电能供给”的含义，energize指通电，de-energize即断电。A两处错误：动作方向相反（provide提供），能源类型也错（pneumatic power气源）。B方向相反：supply electrical power是供电，与断电含义完全相反。

question: When the light comes on, set the switch to NORMAL.

options.A: When the light goes off, set the switch to NORMAL.
options.B: When the light is illuminated, move the switch to NORMAL.
options.C: When the light is extinguished, move the switch to NORMAL.

explanation: 【译文】当灯亮时，将电门置于NORMAL位。【词汇】come on=（灯）亮起，set/move the switch to=将电门置于，NORMAL=正常位，illuminated=点亮的，extinguished=熄灭的（反义）。【解析】B正确：is illuminated与comes on同义表示灯亮，move the switch to NORMAL对应将电门置于NORMAL位，条件动作完整。A把comes on误译为goes off（熄灭），灯亮变灯灭，条件方向相反。C同样误译为is extinguished（熄灭），与A一样把亮灯条件错成灭灯条件，方向相反。

question: The gyroscope will become stable after approximately 15 seconds.

options.A: The gyroscope will become stable before less than 15 seconds.
options.B: The gyroscope will become stable for at least 15 seconds.
options.C: After about 15 seconds, the gyroscope will become stable.

explanation: 【译文】陀螺仪将在约15秒后变得稳定。【词汇】gyroscope=陀螺仪，approximately=大约，become stable=变得稳定，after=在……之后，at least=至少（干扰项）。【解析】C正确：After about 15 seconds对应约15秒后，about是approximately的同义词，become stable保留不变，同义改写准确。A把时间关系误译为before less than 15 seconds（不足15秒之前），after错成before且less than曲解approximately。B把after approximately误译为for at least（至少持续15秒），“约15秒后”错成“至少15秒”，时间逻辑错误。

question: Open this circuit breaker.

options.A: Pull out the circuit breaker.
options.B: Push in the circuit breaker.
options.C: Remove the circuit breaker.

explanation: 【译文】断开这个跳开关。【词汇】open (a circuit breaker)=断开跳开关，pull out=拔出（断开操作），push in=按入（闭合），remove=拆下。【解析】A正确：航空维修语境中open a circuit breaker的标准操作是pull out（拔出跳开关使其断开电路）。B的push in是把跳开关按入使其闭合，与open（断开）方向相反。C的remove是把跳开关整体拆除，远超“断开”的含义——断开后仍可复位，拆除则取下元件，程度错误。

question: The air pressure is above normal.

options.A: The air pressure is almost correct.
options.B: The air pressure is too low.
options.C: The air pressure is too high.

explanation: 【译文】气压高于正常值。【词汇】air pressure=气压，above normal=高于正常，too high=太高，too low=太低（反义）。【解析】C正确：above normal与too high同义，气压高于正常值即气压过高，同义改写准确。A误译为“几乎正确”（almost correct），把“高于正常”曲解为“接近正常”，程度含义完全不符。B误译为“太低”（too low），高于正常变低于正常，方向相反。

question: Release the pressure from the hydraulic system.

options.A: Bleed the hydraulic system.
options.B: Pressurize the hydraulic system.
options.C: Depressurize the hydraulic system.

explanation: 【译文】释放液压系统的压力。【词汇】release the pressure=释放压力，hydraulic system=液压系统，depressurize=释压/降压，pressurize=增压（反义），bleed=放泄（放气/放油，易混）。【解析】C正确：depressurize是“释放系统压力”的标准术语，与release the pressure完全等值。A的bleed指放泄系统内的空气或油液（如刹车放气），不是释放压力本身，动作对象不符。B误译为pressurize（增压），释放压力变增压，方向相反。

question: Write instructions in the imperative form.

options.A: Write instructions in the infinite form.
options.B: Write instructions in the command form.
options.C: Write instructions in the appropriate form.

explanation: 【译文】用祈使句形式书写指令。【词汇】instruction=指令/说明，imperative form=祈使式（语法术语），command form=命令式（同义表达），infinitive=不定式（易混拼写）。【解析】B正确：imperative与command同为“祈使/命令”的语法概念，command form是imperative form的同义改写。A误译为infinite form（无限的形式），imperative错成infinite，形近词错译；不定式也应为infinitive而非infinite。C误译为appropriate form（合适的形式），把具体的“祈使式”泛化为“合适形式”，考点词丢失。

question: These tests shall be self-contained.

options.A: These tests shall be independent.
options.B: These tests shall be self-locking.
options.C: These tests shall be comprehensive.

explanation: 【译文】这些测试应自成体系、独立完整。【词汇】self-contained=自足的/独立的/自成一体的，independent=独立的，self-locking=自锁的（易混），comprehensive=全面的（易混）。【解析】A正确：self-contained在测试语境中指不依赖外部条件、可独立完成的，independent是最贴切的同义表达。B误译为self-locking（自锁的），self-contained与self-locking是两个完全不同的工程术语，形近错译。C误译为comprehensive（全面的），自足独立≠内容全面，词义错译。

question: The new fluid should be checked after thorough mixing.

options.A: Check the fluid prior to mixing.
options.B: Prior to checking the fluid, ensure it has been mixed.
options.C: Never mix the fluid before testing.

explanation: 【译文】新油液应在充分混合后进行检查。【词汇】fluid=油液/流体，thorough mixing=充分混合，after=在……之后，prior to=在……之前，check=检查。【解析】B正确：“检查油液之前确保已混合”（Prior to checking, ensure it has been mixed）与“充分混合后再检查”逻辑等值，先后次序保留。A误译为“混合之前检查”（prior to mixing），把after错成prior to，时间顺序相反。C误译为“测试前绝不要混合”（never mix before testing），把“先混合再检查”的要求改成禁止混合，逻辑完全颠倒。

question: Make sure that there is no blockage in the pipe.

options.A: Make sure that there is something in the pipe.
options.B: Make sure that there is nothing in the pipe.
options.C: Make sure that blockage is in the pipe.

explanation: 【译文】确保管内没有堵塞物。【词汇】blockage=堵塞物，pipe=管子，make sure=确保，nothing=没有东西。【解析】B正确：there is nothing in the pipe（管内没有任何东西）是no blockage最接近的同义改写，管内无物自然无堵塞，语气虽稍绝对但方向正确。A误译为“管内有东西”（there is something），与“无堵塞”的检查目标相反。C误译为“堵塞物在管内”（blockage is in the pipe），把“无堵塞”改成“有堵塞”，方向相反。

question: There is sufficient oil in the tank.

options.A: There is enough oil.
options.B: Some oil must be drained.
options.C: More oil must be added.

explanation: 【译文】油箱中有足够的滑油。【词汇】sufficient=足够的，oil=滑油，tank=油箱，enough=足够的（同义）。【解析】A正确：enough oil与sufficient oil同义，表达油量充足，省略in the tank不影响语义判断。B误译为“必须放掉一些油”（must be drained），暗示油量过多需排放，与“足够”的中性陈述不符。C误译为“必须再加些油”（must be added），暗示油量不足，与sufficient逻辑相反——足够即无需添加。

question: Two methods of refueling are available.

options.A: There are two methods of loading the tank.
options.B: The load is determined in two ways.
options.C: You have to fill the tank twice.

explanation: 【译文】有两种可用的加油方法。【词汇】refueling=加油，method=方法，available=可用的，load the tank=给油箱装油/加油。【解析】A正确：There are two methods对应有两种方法，loading the tank表达给油箱加注，与refueling含义最接近。B误译为“载荷由两种方式决定”（load determined in two ways），把refueling曲解为load载重，词义错译。C误译为“必须给油箱加两次”（fill the tank twice），把“两种方法”错解为“加两次”，数量含义张冠李戴。

question: During the procedure that follows, repair the upper flange first.

options.A: After finishing the following procedure, repair the upper flange.
options.B: Repair the lower flange first during the procedure that follows.
options.C: Repair the upper flange first during the following procedure.

explanation: 【译文】在随后的程序中，先修理上法兰。【词汇】procedure that follows=随后的/下文的程序，repair=修理，upper flange=上法兰，first=首先。【解析】C正确：during the following procedure对应在随后的程序中，repair the upper flange first对应先修理上法兰，时间状语和动作顺序完整。A把时间关系误译为“程序完成之后”（after finishing），during错成after，执行时机错误。B把upper误译为lower（下法兰），上部变下部，位置相反。

question: Get medical aid immediately.

options.A: You must obtain medical help as soon as you can.
options.B: You must obtain medical help as more as you can.
options.C: You must obtain medical instructions as soon as you can.

explanation: 【译文】立即寻求医疗救助。【词汇】medical aid=医疗救助，immediately=立即，as soon as you can=尽快，obtain=获得。【解析】A正确：medical help对应医疗救助，as soon as you can对应立即/尽快，同义改写完整。B语法错误：as more as you can不是正确表达（应为as much as），短语结构错误。C把aid误译为instructions（指示），医疗救助错成医疗指示，词义错译——aid是援助不是指导。

question: Make sure that there is no blockage in the pipe that prevents airflow.

options.A: Make sure that there is airflow in the pipe to hinder .
options.B: Make sure that there is something in the pipe to block the airflow.
options.C: Make sure that there is nothing in the pipe to hinder airflow.

explanation: 【译文】确保管内没有阻碍气流的堵塞物。【词汇】blockage=堵塞物，airflow=气流，hinder=阻碍，prevent=阻止，pipe=管子。【解析】C正确：nothing in the pipe to hinder airflow准确表达“没有阻碍气流的东西”，与原句no blockage...prevents airflow等值。A语义不通：there is airflow in the pipe to hinder变成“气流在管内去阻碍”，主宾关系颠倒，hinder后还缺宾语。B误译为“管内有东西阻塞气流”（something...to block），与“确保无堵塞物”的检查目标完全相反。

question: Each handbook shall have a log of revisions or effective pages.

options.A: Each revision and the effective page should be logged in the logbook.
options.B: Only the effective revisions pages need to be recorded in the manual.
options.C: Each manual shall have a record of revisions or effective pages.

explanation: 【译文】Each handbook shall have a log of revisions or effective pages.【词汇】handbook/manual=手册，log/record=记录，revision=修订，effective page=有效页。【解析】C正确：each manual对应每本手册，record of revisions or effective pages对应修订或有效页记录，同义改写规范。A主客体变形：每次修订应记入日志，改变记录主体。B加入Only缩小范围，且effective revisions pages糅杂并列关系。

question: This section gives you the procedures for the disassembly.

options.A: This procedure gives you the disassembly process.
options.B: You can find the procedures for disassembling in this section.
options.C: The assembly process can be found in this section.

explanation: 【译文】本节给出分解（拆卸）的程序。【词汇】section=章节/节，procedure=程序，disassembly=分解/拆卸，assembly=装配（反义）。【解析】B正确：You can find the procedures for disassembling in this section与“本节给出分解程序”同义，section和disassembly两个考点均保留。A把section误译为procedure，句子主体从“本节”变成“本程序”，且procedures变成process，对象错位。C把disassembly误译为assembly（装配），拆卸变装配，方向相反。

question: The potable water system is used to store and deliver fresh drinking water.

options.A: The function of the portable water system is to store and send drinking water to the passengers.
options.B: The potable water system must keep and transfer the water to the toilet for washing only.
options.C: The purpose of the drinking water system is to store and deliver the water for drinking.

explanation: 【译文】饮用水系统用于储存和输送新鲜饮用水。【词汇】potable water=饮用水（≠portable便携的），store=储存，deliver=输送，fresh drinking water=新鲜饮用水。【解析】C正确：drinking water system对应饮用水系统，store and deliver the water for drinking保留储存和输送饮用水两大功能。A两处错误：potable误译为portable（便携的），形近词错译；添加to the passengers限定用途，缩小范围。B误译为“只输送水到厕所供洗涤”（to the toilet for washing only），饮用水用途完全错误，only更是无依据限制。

question: Limitations associated with optional systems may be included in this section.

options.A: This section includes all the limits of the optional systems and equipment.
options.B: Limitations related to optional systems may be contained in this section.
options.C: Only the limitations which are relevant to optional systems might be including in this section.

explanation: 【译文】与选装系统相关的限制可包括在本节中。【词汇】limitation=限制，associated with=与……相关，optional system=选装系统，may be included=可包括。【解析】B正确：related to对应associated with，optional systems对应选装系统，may be contained对应可包括，情态may保留准确。A扩大范围：includes all the limits加入“所有”限定，且and equipment添译设备，may的语气也变成确定陈述。C两处错误：加入Only（仅）缩小范围，might be including语法错误（应为be included），被动语态残缺。

question: Explain how to use seat belts and shoulder harnesses.

options.A: Describe how to operate the safety belt and wire harnesses.
options.B: Tell the way to use the seat and shoulder belts.
options.C: The seat and shoulder harness should be used by the pilot.

explanation: 【译文】说明如何使用安全带和肩带。【词汇】explain=说明，seat belt=座椅安全带，shoulder harness=肩带/肩部约束带，wire harness=导线束（易混）。【解析】B最佳：tell the way to use对应说明使用方法，seat and shoulder belts保留座椅和肩部两类约束带信息（harness简化为belt略有损失但语义基本保留）。A把shoulder harnesses误译为wire harnesses（导线束），肩带错成线束，张冠李戴。C改变句式：should be used by the pilot变成“应由飞行员使用”的使用规定，丢失“说明如何使用”的原意。

question: Leave landing gear extended for ten minutes.

options.A: Landing gear is left for ten minutes.
options.B: Landing gear should be kept extended for ten minutes.
options.C: Extend landing gear after ten minutes' retraction.

explanation: 【译文】保持起落架放下状态十分钟。【词汇】leave...extended=保持……放下/伸出，landing gear=起落架，for ten minutes=持续十分钟，retract=收上（反义）。【解析】B正确：kept extended for ten minutes准确表达保持放下十分钟，kept对应leave的持续状态含义，extended保留。A漏译extended：Landing gear is left for ten minutes只表达“起落架被留十分钟”，放下状态完全丢失，关键信息缺失。C误译为“收上十分钟后放下”（after ten minutes' retraction），动作顺序和时间关系全部颠倒。

question: Use a calibrated gage to do a check.

options.A: The gage must be lubricated before doing a check.
options.B: Do a check with an adjusted gage.
options.C: The gage is used to do calibration during a check.

explanation: 【译文】用已校准的量规做检查。【词汇】calibrated gage=已校准量规，do a check=做检查，adjusted=已调整的（最接近同义），calibration=校准。【解析】B最佳：adjusted gage表达经调整/校准的量规，do a check with对应用量规做检查，工具用途关系正确。A添加润滑要求：must be lubricated（必须润滑）在原句中没有对应内容，无中生有。C用途颠倒：used to do calibration during a check把“用量规检查”改成“检查时用量规做校准”，量具的用途和动作对象错位。

question: Do not go into the engine test area without approval.

options.A: It is forbidden to go into the engine test area with approval.
options.B: Entering the engine test area must not be approved.
options.C: Approval is a must when entering the engine test area.

explanation: 【译文】未经批准不得进入发动机试车区域。【词汇】approval=批准，engine test area=发动机试车区，do not...without approval=未经批准不得，a must=必备条件。【解析】C正确：Approval is a must when entering（进入时必须获得批准）与“未经批准不得进入”正反等值，禁令含义完整。A误译为“有批准也禁止进入”（forbidden...with approval），把without错成with，逻辑完全相反。B误译为“进入不得被批准”（must not be approved），否定对象从“进入行为”错移到“批准行为”，语法逻辑错误。

question: If the pump is unserviceable, replace it.

options.A: If the pump is not suitable to be used, replace it.
options.B: If the pump is outmoded, replace it.
options.C: If the pump malfunctions, change the location for it.

explanation: 【译文】如果泵不可用，就更换它。【词汇】unserviceable=不可用的/不能使用的，replace=更换，pump=泵，outmoded=过时的（易混）。【解析】A正确：not suitable to be used准确表达unserviceable“不适合使用”的含义，replace保留。B把unserviceable误译为outmoded（过时的），不可用≠过时——过时的设备可能仍可用，词义错译。C两处错误：unserviceable误译为malfunctions（故障），不可用与发生故障程度不同；replace误译为change the location（改变位置），更换变移位，动作错误。

question: Distances shown are based on zero wind.

options.A: Distances shown are based on weak wind.
options.B: Distances shown are developed with no wind.
options.C: Distances shown are on the basis of gentle wind.

explanation: 【译文】所示距离基于零风（无风）条件。【词汇】zero wind=无风/零风，based on=基于，distance=距离，no wind=无风（同义）。【解析】B正确：with no wind与zero wind同义，developed表达“以……得出”与based on最接近。A把zero wind误译为weak wind（弱风），无风≠弱风，气象条件错译。C同样误译为gentle wind（微风），把零风条件错成有风条件，性能数据前提失真。

question: Those units provide a means of preventing it from freezing.

options.A: Those units means that they can prevent it from eroding.
options.B: Those units provide a method of deicing.
options.C: Those units provide a way to prevent the formation of ice.

explanation: 【译文】这些装置提供了一种防止其结冰的手段。【词汇】provide a means=提供手段/方法，prevent...from freezing=防止……结冰，formation of ice=冰的形成，deice=除冰（易混）。【解析】C正确：prevent the formation of ice准确表达防止结冰，provide a way对应provide a means，同义改写完整。A把freezing误译为eroding（侵蚀），结冰错成侵蚀，词义错译；units means主谓也不一致。B把prevent freezing误译为deicing（除冰），防冰（防止结冰）≠除冰（去除已结的冰），概念张冠李戴。

question: This document provides supplemental information to the applicable manual.

options.A: This document provides supplementary information to the applicable manual.
options.B: This document provides primary information to the applicable manual.
options.C: This document provides special information to the applicable manual.

explanation: 【译文】本文件为适用手册提供补充信息。【词汇】supplemental=补充的，supplementary=补充的（同义词），applicable manual=适用手册，primary=主要的（反义考点）。【解析】A正确：supplementary information是supplemental information的标准同义改写，document、applicable manual等其余成分不变。B把supplemental误译为primary（主要的），补充信息错成主要信息，性质定位相反。C误译为special（特殊的），“特殊信息”与“补充信息”含义不同——补充强调附加性，词义偏差。

question: Replace nuts and washers if removed during inspection.

options.A: During inspection, if the nuts and washers are removed, recheck them.
options.B: Take a good place for the nuts and washers removed during inspection.
options.C: If nuts and washers are removed during inspection, install the new ones.

explanation: 【译文】如果在检查期间拆下了螺母和垫圈，则更换它们。【词汇】replace=更换，nut=螺母，washer=垫圈，during inspection=在检查期间，install=安装。【解析】C正确：install the new ones（安装新的）准确传达replace“以新换旧”的含义，条件状语if removed during inspection完整保留。A把replace误译为recheck（重新检查），更换变复查，动作张冠李戴。B语义不通：Take a good place for...变成“给拆下的螺母垫圈找个好地方”，完全曲解replace的含义。

question: Each electrical system has a code to identify it.

options.A: Each electrical system is identified by a code.
options.B: Each code of electrical system is identified.
options.C: Each system is identified by an electrical code.

explanation: 【译文】每个电气系统都有一个代码来标识它。【词汇】electrical system=电气系统，code=代码，identify=标识/识别，be identified by=由……标识。【解析】A正确：is identified by a code是“有代码标识”的被动同义改写，系统仍是被标识的对象，逻辑关系准确。B主宾错位：Each code...is identified变成“每个代码被识别”，identify的对象从系统错换成代码。C误译为“被电气代码识别”（by an electrical code），把electrical错误修饰code——电气的是系统不是代码，修饰关系张冠李戴。

question: Detection system is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.

options.A: Detection system will provide information about how to detect ice.
options.B: Detection system is utilized to find and display ice formation.
options.C: The detection information of ice is from the indication system.

explanation: 【译文】探测系统用于探测并指示冰的形成。【词汇】detection system=探测系统，detect=探测，indicate=指示，formation of ice=结冰/冰的形成，utilize=使用（=use）。【解析】B正确：find and display对应detect and indicate（探测并指示），ice formation对应formation of ice，is utilized对应is used，同义改写准确。A误译为“提供如何探测冰的信息”，把探测和指示两个功能弱化成提供方法说明，动作错位。C主客关系颠倒：detection information...is from the indication system把探测系统和指示信息的关系倒置，语义混乱。

question: Show the date of the revision on each revised page.

options.A: The revision dates need to be displayed at each revision location.
options.B: The revision date needs to be displayed in an obvious place.
options.C: The revision date should be displayed on every revision page.

explanation: 【译文】在每个修订页上标明修订日期。【词汇】show/display=显示/标明，date of the revision=修订日期，each revised page=每个修订页。【解析】C正确：displayed on every revision page准确对应在每个修订页上显示（revised page与revision page同义），页面要求完整。A把“每个修订页”误译为“每个修订位置”（each revision location），页面错成位置，标注范围不符。B误译为“在明显位置”（in an obvious place），漏掉each revised page这一关键要求，位置限定错误。

question: The airplanes were delivered with recommended inspection programs to keep them airworthy.

options.A: The delivery of the aircraft is required to ensure its airworthiness, therefore it is subject to customer inspection procedures.
options.B: The airplanes are airworthy because they were delivered in accordance with advised inspection procedures.
options.C: The airplanes are delivered with mandatory inspection procedures to ensure their airworthiness.

explanation: 【译文】飞机交付时配有推荐的检查大纲，以保持其适航性。【词汇】deliver=交付，recommended inspection program=推荐的检查大纲，airworthy=适航的，mandatory=强制的（≠recommended）。【解析】B相对最佳：advised≈recommended保留“推荐”含义，airworthy保留适航概念；但把“交付时附带检查大纲以保持适航”重构为“因按建议程序交付而适航”的因果关系，逻辑有偏移。C结构最贴近（delivered with...to ensure），但recommended误译为mandatory（强制的），推荐变强制，关键限定词错译。A引入customer inspection procedures（客户检查程序），无中生有。

question: Airplanes modified by STC are not the responsibility of ABC.

options.A: The responsibility of ABC is not to modify the airplanes that belong to STC.
options.B: It is not STC's responsibility to modify ABC's aircraft.
options.C: ABC is not in charge of the aircraft modified by STC.

explanation: 【译文】经STC改装的飞机不属于ABC的责任范围。【词汇】modified by STC=经STC改装（STC=补充型号合格证），responsibility=责任，in charge of=负责。【解析】C正确：ABC is not in charge of对应不由ABC负责，aircraft modified by STC对应STC改装的飞机，责任主体和修饰关系准确。A误译为“ABC的责任不是改装属于STC的飞机”，把“对改装飞机无责任”曲解为“不实施改装”，关系错位。B责任主体颠倒：not STC's responsibility to modify ABC's aircraft变成“改装ABC飞机不是STC的责任”，甲乙双方角色完全互换。

question: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be indicated on the wiring diagram.

options.A:
In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be shown
on the wiring diagram.
options.B: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be installed on the wiring diagram.
options.C: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be explained on the wiring diagram.

explanation: 【译文】在某些情况下，导线用颜色编码，这些应在接线图上标出。【词汇】color coded=颜色编码，indicate=标明/指示，wiring diagram=接线图，shown=标出（同义）。【解析】A正确：shown与indicated同义表达“在图上标出”，其余成分与题干完全一致。B把indicated误译为installed（安装），“被安装在接线图上”语义不通，词义错译。C误译为explained（解释），图上应是“标出”颜色代码而非“解释”，动作不对应——图纸承载标记而非解释说明。

question: Such tests or checks will vary in complexity according to the conditions.

options.A: Such tests or checks will be completed according to the conditions.
options.B: Such tests or checks will be very complex according to the conditions.
options.C: Such tests or checks will be different in complexity according to the conditions.

explanation: 【译文】这类测试或检查的复杂程度将根据条件而不同。【词汇】vary=变化/不同，complexity=复杂程度，according to=根据，conditions=条件。【解析】C正确：different in complexity对应vary in complexity（复杂程度不同），according to the conditions保留，同义改写准确。A把vary误译为completed（完成），动词含义完全无关，词义错译。B误译为“将非常复杂”（very complex），丢失vary“程度有差异”的核心含义——vary表示参差不齐而非一致复杂。

question: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions.

options.A: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide drawback on unairworthy conditions.
options.B: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide response on unairworthy conditions.
options.C: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide recall on unairworthy conditions.

explanation: 【译文】制造商可建立程序，以就不适航状况提供反馈。【词汇】manufacturer=制造商，establish procedures=建立程序，feedback=反馈，unairworthy condition=不适航状况。【解析】B最佳：response（回应/反馈）是feedback最接近的同义表达，句中其余成分与题干一致。A把feedback误译为drawback（缺点/障碍），形近但词义完全不同，提供缺点不合逻辑。C把feedback误译为recall（召回），把信息反馈机制错成产品召回，概念张冠李戴。

question: Attach the two stringers together with rivets.

options.A: Rivets can be used to separate the two stringers.
options.B: You can use two rivets to attach the stringers together.
options.C: Use rivets to connect the two stringers together.

explanation: 【译文】用铆钉把两根桁条连接在一起。【词汇】attach...together=连接在一起，stringer=桁条，rivet=铆钉，connect=连接（同义）。【解析】C正确：connect the two stringers together对应连接两根桁条，use rivets对应用铆钉，two明确修饰stringers。A把attach误译为separate（分开），连接变分离，方向相反。B修饰错位：two rivets把原文“两个桁条”的数量转嫁为“两个铆钉”，two本应限定stringers，铆钉数量无原文依据。

question: Identify the cables with a code.

options.A: Code is useless to identify the cables.
options.B: Put a code on the cables to identify them.
options.C: A tag should be attached to the cables.

explanation: 【译文】用代码标识电缆。【词汇】identify=标识/识别，cable=电缆，code=代码，tag=标签（易混手段）。【解析】B正确：put a code on the cables对应给电缆加代码，to identify them对应以便识别，手段和目的关系完整。A误译为“代码对识别电缆无用”（useless），把“用代码识别”改成代码无用，语义完全相反。C把code误译为tag（标签），标识手段张冠李戴——标签不等于代码，且未体现识别目的。

question: Extend and retract the actuator through three full cycles.

options.A: After three full cycles, extend and retract the actuator.
options.B: You should extend and retract the actuator through three complete cycles.
options.C: Do nothing to the actuator after three complete cycles.

explanation: 【译文】使作动筒伸出并收回，完成三个完整循环。【词汇】extend=伸出，retract=收回，actuator=作动筒，three full cycles=三个完整循环，through=贯穿。【解析】B正确：extend and retract through three complete cycles保留伸缩动作和循环次数，complete对应full，要求含义准确。A时间关系错误：After three full cycles把“经历三个循环完成伸缩”改成“三个循环之后再伸缩”，动作时机错位。C误译为“三个循环后不作任何操作”（do nothing），与原句的动作要求完全相反。

question: When the spring compresses, the valve opens.

options.A: The compressing of the spring can cause the valve to open.
options.B: There is no change of the valve when the spring compresses.
options.C: After compressing of the spring, the valve goes to closed position.

explanation: 【译文】当弹簧压缩时，活门打开。【词汇】spring=弹簧，compress=压缩，valve=活门，open=打开，closed position=关闭位置（反义）。【解析】A正确：compressing of the spring can cause the valve to open表达弹簧压缩导致活门打开，因果方向与when引导的条件关系等值。B误译为“活门没有变化”（no change），否定原文的打开结果。C把valve opens误译为goes to closed position（到关闭位置），打开变关闭，方向相反。

question: Hydraulic fluid is dangerous for your eyes.

options.A: There is no influence on your eyes for hydraulic fluid.
options.B: Hydraulic fluid has no effect on your eyes.
options.C: Hydraulic fluid can cause eye injury.

explanation: 【译文】液压油对眼睛有危险。【词汇】hydraulic fluid=液压油，dangerous=危险的，eye injury=眼部伤害，no effect=无影响（反义）。【解析】C正确：can cause eye injury准确表达“对眼睛有危险”的警告含义，dangerous与cause injury等值。A误译为“对眼睛没有影响”（no influence），否定危险性，与警告语义相反。B同样误译为“对眼睛没有作用”（no effect），把危险提示改成无害声明，方向相反。

question: This procedure is applicable only in digital mode.

options.A: This procedure is only  void in digital mode.
options.B: This procedure is only valid in digital mode.
options.C: This procedure is only  ineffective  in digital mode.

explanation: 【译文】此程序仅在数字模式下适用。【词汇】applicable=适用的，valid=有效的（同义），digital mode=数字模式，void=无效的（反义），ineffective=无效的（反义）。【解析】B正确：only valid in digital mode对应仅在数字模式下适用/有效，valid是applicable的恰当同义词。A把applicable误译为void（无效的），适用变无效，方向相反。C误译为ineffective（无效的），同样把“适用”错成“无效”，与题干含义相反。

question: This document gives the different torque values and the conditions where they are applicable.

options.A: This document verifies the various torque values and the conditions where they are applicable.
options.B: This document verifies the various torque values and the conditions where they are null.
options.C: This document specifies the various torque values and the conditions where they are applicable.

explanation: 【译文】本文件给出了不同的扭矩值及其适用条件。【词汇】torque value=扭矩值，applicable=适用的，specify=规定/说明（≈give），condition=条件，null=无效的（反义）。【解析】C正确：specifies准确表达gives“给出/规定”的含义，various对应different，applicable条件保留完整。A把gives误译为verifies（核实），文件给出数值变成核实数值，动作张冠李戴。B两处错误：同A的verifies错译，且把applicable误译为null（无效的），适用条件错成无效条件。

question: Do a full check of the hydraulic system.

options.A: Do a thorough check of the hydraulic system.
options.B: Do a check of the hydraulic system carefully.
options.C: Do a check of the hydraulic system again.

explanation: 【译文】对液压系统做一次全面检查。【词汇】full check=全面检查，thorough=彻底的（同义），hydraulic system=液压系统，again=再次（干扰项）。【解析】A正确：thorough check是full check的标准同义表达，全面彻底的范围含义完整保留。B误译为“仔细地检查”（carefully），方式副词代替范围限定——检查仔细不等于检查全面，词义错译。C误译为“再次检查”（again），给原句添加重复检查的含义，无中生有。

question: All range distances shall be expressed in nautical miles.

options.A: The unit of all range distances shall be nautical mile.
options.B: We measure all range distances in accurate miles.
options.C: The range of distances shall be calculated in knots.

explanation: 【译文】所有航程距离都应以海里表示。【词汇】range distance=航程距离，express in=以……表示，nautical mile=海里，knot=节（速度单位，易混），accurate=精确的（形近干扰）。【解析】A正确：unit shall be nautical mile对应以海里为单位，all range distances范围保留，规范同义改写。B把nautical误译为accurate（精确的），海里错成精确英里，形近词错译；expressed换成measure尚可但单位已错。C把nautical miles误译为knots（节），距离单位错成速度单位；range of distances也曲解了range distances。

question: Do not exceed this speed in any operation.

options.A: In any process, the velocity is not large.
options.B: Do not increase this speed in any operation.
options.C: In any operation, the speed can not be greater than this value.

explanation: 【译文】在任何操作中都不得超过此速度。【词汇】do not exceed=不得超过，speed=速度，in any operation=任何操作中，greater than=大于。【解析】C正确：can not be greater than this value与do not exceed this speed逻辑等值，“不得超过”即“不能大于”，限制语义完整。A误译为“速度不大”（velocity is not large），漏掉“此速度”的限制值概念，禁令含义丢失。B把exceed误译为increase（增加），“不增加”≠“不超限”——已处于限制速度时不增加仍合规的逻辑不同，词义错译。

question: There are four general classes of fasteners.

options.A: There are only four kinds of fasteners.
options.B: Fasteners is generally divided into four types.
options.C: We classify the fasteners through four dimensions in general.

explanation: 【译文】紧固件一般分为四类。【词汇】general classes=一般类别，fastener=紧固件，be divided into=分为，type=类型（≈class），dimension=维度（易混）。【解析】B正确：generally divided into four types对应一般分为四类，general与generally呼应，classes≈types，同义改写准确（is虽应为are，属小瑕疵）。A加入only（只有），把“四类”变成排他的“仅四类”，原句无排他限定，范围错误。C把classes误译为four dimensions（四个维度），分类错成维度，词义张冠李戴。

question: Vertical pages rather than horizontal are preferred for all types of publication.

options.A: Vertical pages instead of horizontal are preferred for all types of publication.
options.B: Horizontal pages are more preferable for all types of publication than vertical ones.
options.C: Both vertical and horizontal pages are rather preferable for all types of publication.

explanation: 【译文】所有类型的出版物都更适合采用纵向页面而非横向页面。【词汇】vertical=纵向的、竖式的，horizontal=横向的，rather than=而不是（表取舍，连接被否定的选项），be preferred=更受偏爱、被优先采用。【解析】A正确：用instead of替换rather than，保留“取纵向舍横向”的比较关系和preferred的含义，全句等值。B方向相反：把纵向优于横向改写成横向更优于纵向（more preferable...than），恰好颠倒原文取舍。C逻辑错误：用both...and把取舍关系改成两者都更可取，抹掉了rather than的排除意味。

question: The minimum time between checks is two minutes.

options.A: The interval between checks is at least two minutes.
options.B: The lowest limit of checks is two minutes.
options.C: Between two checks, it needs two minutes.

explanation: 【译文】两次检查之间的最短时间是两分钟。【词汇】minimum=最小的、最短的，between checks=两次检查之间，interval=间隔（时间或空间），at least=至少。【解析】A正确：interval准确对应time between（间隔），at least two minutes表达“最少两分钟”的下限含义，语义完整。B词义错译：把time between checks（时间间隔）译成lowest limit of checks（检查的最低限），丢失了“间隔”和“时间”要素。C漏译要素：needs two minutes只说需要两分钟，漏掉minimum/at least的下限含义，变成固定耗时，属于漏译。

question: The taxiing aircraft on the runway belongs to China.

options.A: The aircrft is taxiing to China on the runway.
options.B: The aircrft is running to China on the ramp.
options.C: A Chinese aircrft is taxiing on the runway.

explanation: 【译文】跑道上正在滑行的那架飞机属于中国。【词汇】taxiing aircraft=正在滑行的飞机（taxi指地面滑行），runway=跑道（区别于ramp停机坪），belong to=属于。【解析】C正确：Chinese aircraft对应belongs to China（属于中国即中国飞机），taxiing on the runway完整保留地点和动作。A张冠李戴：把belongs to China误译成taxiing to China（滑向中国），且拼写aircrft有误。B两处错误：把runway误成ramp（停机坪），同样把belongs to误成running to China（跑向中国），动作和地点全错。

question: The nose landing gear was broken in a hard landing.

options.A: There is a hard landing on the broken nose landing gear.
options.B: The  landing gear has affected hard landing.
options.C: The nose landing gear is broken because of hard landing.

explanation: 【译文】前起落架在一次重着陆中损坏了。【词汇】nose landing gear=前起落架，broken=损坏的，hard landing=重着陆（大下降率着陆），in=由于、在……中（表原因）。【解析】C正确：because of hard landing明确表达“因重着陆导致前起落架损坏”的因果关系，nose landing gear保留完整。A结构错译：on the broken nose landing gear把起落架变成着陆的处所，语义不通且因果混乱。B因果倒置：has affected hard landing说成起落架影响了重着陆，把结果和原因颠倒，属于方向相反错误。

question: After flight test, the painted aircraft will be delivered to the customer.

options.A: After flight test, customer will paint aircraft.
options.B: The aircraft which has been painted will fly to customer after flight test .
options.C: We will paint aircraft for customer after flight test.

explanation: 【译文】飞行测试之后，已喷漆的飞机将交付给客户。【词汇】painted aircraft=已喷过漆的飞机（过去分词作定语表完成），flight test=试飞，be delivered to=被交付给，customer=客户。【解析】B正确：which has been painted保留“已喷漆”的完成态，after flight test保留时间顺序，fly to customer近似对应delivered to（交付），是三选项中唯一保留原主被动关系的。A动作主体错误：customer will paint aircraft变成客户给飞机喷漆，原文喷漆早已完成。C同样主体错误：we will paint aircraft说我们为客户喷漆，把交付动作篡改为喷漆动作。

question: What is the position of APU bleed valve if the right engine is shut down?

options.A: If the right engine stops, what position will APU servo valve stop at?
options.B: If the right engine is not running,what position will  APU bleed valve stop at?
options.C: If the right engine stops, will  APU servo valve stop at close position?

explanation: 【译文】如果右发动机关车，APU引气活门处于什么位置？【词汇】APU bleed valve=APU引气活门（区别于servo valve伺服活门），shut down=关断、停车，position=位置。【解析】B正确：is not running对应shut down（不运转），bleed valve用词准确，疑问句式what position与原句一致。A术语错译：把bleed valve换成servo valve（伺服活门），活门类型张冠李戴。C两处错误：同样误作servo valve，且把开放式疑问what position改写成yes/no疑问will...stop at close position，擅自加入“关闭位”这一原文没有的信息。

question: The PA amplifier amplifies the audio input that has the highest priority.

options.A: The audio input with highest priority will be decreased by amplifier.
options.B: The audio input  will be increased by amplifier firstly.
options.C: The audio input that has the highest priority will be enlarged by amplifier.

explanation: 【译文】PA放大器放大优先级最高的音频输入。【词汇】PA amplifier=旅客广播放大器，amplify=放大（信号），audio input=音频输入，highest priority=最高优先级。【解析】C正确：enlarged虽非amplify的最贴切替换，但三选项中唯一完整保留that has the highest priority这一限定成分，且仍表达“被放大”的方向。A方向相反：decreased（减小）与amplifies（放大）意义相反。B两处缺陷：firstly（首先）只表顺序不表“最高优先级”，把priority误作时间先后，且increased用于信号放大不如enlarged贴切，属近义词干扰加漏译。

question: The factory has maintained technical assistance and parts support according to the stated policies.

options.A: The factory's policy of providing consulting remains unchanged.
options.B: The factory has been maintaining technical and component support within the policy scope.
options.C: The factory's policy on providing technical and component support has changed from the past.

explanation: 【译文】该工厂一直按照既定政策提供技术援助和备件支持。【词汇】maintain=持续保持，technical assistance=技术援助，parts support=备件支持，stated policies=既定政策。【解析】B正确：maintaining对应maintained的持续含义，within the policy scope对应according to stated policies。A漏译parts support，只剩consulting，且unchanged把“持续提供”曲解成“政策不变”。C方向相反：has changed说政策已变，与“一贯照办”相反。

question: A small child should use an approved child restraint seat.

options.A: A small child should sit in an unlimited seat.
options.B: A small child needs to sit in a seat with safety device.
options.C: A small child could sit in an adult seat.

explanation: 【译文】幼童应使用经批准的儿童约束座椅。【词汇】approved=经批准的、合格的，child restraint seat=儿童约束座椅（航空安全座椅术语），should=应当（表要求）。【解析】B正确：needs to对应should的义务语气，seat with safety device概括child restraint seat的安全约束本质，是三选项中唯一体现“专用安全座椅”要求的。A词义错译：unlimited seat（不受限制的座椅）与restraint（约束）含义相反。C张冠李戴：adult seat（成人座椅）完全抹掉child restraint的儿童约束属性，改变保护对象。

question: To get the correct clearance, add special shims, as necessary.

options.A: In order to obtain additional clearance, gaskets may be added.
options.B: Additional shims may need to be added to obtain proper clearance.
options.C: Add special shims as necessary may vary the clearance.

explanation: 【译文】为获得正确的间隙，必要时加装专用垫片。【词汇】clearance=间隙，shim=调整垫片，as necessary=必要时，correct=正确的。【解析】B正确：obtain proper clearance对应get the correct clearance，additional shims对应add shims，may need对应as necessary。A两处错误：correct误成additional（额外）；gaskets（密封垫）不是shim（调整垫片）。C把目的状语错译成结果：加垫片是为“获得”正确间隙而非“改变”间隙。

question: Make sure you hear the boarding music when you press the button.

options.A: Make sure you press the switch when you hear the boarding music.
options.B: Make sure you press the switch after you hear the boarding music.
options.C: Make sure that you hear the boarding music after you push the button.

explanation: 【译文】按下按钮时，确认能听到登机音乐。【词汇】press/push the button=按按钮，boarding music=登机音乐，make sure=确保，when=当……时。【解析】C正确：after you push the button保留“按按钮在先、听到音乐在后”的因果顺序，hear the boarding music为验证目标，与原文检测逻辑一致（按钮触发音乐）。A、B共同错误：都把hear the boarding music当作按开关的前提条件（“听到音乐时/后按开关”），把“按按钮→出音乐”的因果方向完全颠倒，属于方向相反错误。

question: Disconnect the connection upstream of the valve.

options.A: Detach the connection of the valve in the direction opposite to the flow.
options.B: Detach the connection of the upstream valve.
options.C: Detach the connection of the valve in the direction identical to the flow.

explanation: 【译文】断开活门上游的连接接头。【词汇】upstream=上游（逆介质流向一侧），downstream=下游，disconnect/detach=断开，connection=连接处、接头。【解析】A正确：opposite to the flow（逆流向）是upstream的准确定义，连接对象为the connection of the valve区域，与原文“活门上游处的连接”一致。B对象错译：upstream valve把upstream修饰到valve头上，变成“上游那个活门”的连接，而原文upstream修饰的是connection的位置。C方向相反：identical to the flow（顺流向）是downstream方向，与upstream正好相反。

question: The valve flaps are semicircular.

options.A: The valve has flaps shaped like a full circle.
options.B: The shape of the valve flaps is a half ring.
options.C: The valve flaps have a shape of half circle.

explanation: 【译文】活门瓣片是半圆形的。【词汇】flap=瓣片、活门片，semicircular=半圆形的（semi-前缀表“半”），shape=形状，half circle=半圆。【解析】C正确：shape of half circle准确对应semicircular，主语valve flaps不变，全句等值。A词义错译：full circle（整圆）与semi-前缀矛盾，形状判断翻倍错误。B近义词干扰：half ring（半环、半圆环状物）是环形体而非“半圆形”，ring强调圈状结构，把平面形状误成立体环件，形状要素不符。

question: Saturate the element for two hours.

options.A: Soak the element for two hours.
options.B: Wet the element for two hours.
options.C: Stove the element for two hours.

explanation: 【译文】将滤芯（元件）浸泡两小时。【词汇】saturate=使浸透、浸透处理，element=元件、滤芯，soak=浸泡，for two hours=持续两小时。【解析】A正确：soak（浸泡使液体完全渗入）与saturate的浸透含义最接近，时间和对象完整对应。B程度不足：wet仅表示“弄湿”表面，达不到saturate要求的饱和浸透程度，属于词义弱化错译。C张冠李戴：stove（用炉子烘烤加热）与浸泡工艺完全无关，是形近/义近干扰项，工艺方法错误。

question: Rinse the basin with water.

options.A: Rub the basin with water.
options.B: Flush the basin with water.
options.C: Fill the basin with water.

explanation: 【译文】用水冲洗槽盆。【词汇】rinse=冲洗、漂洗，basin=盆、槽，flush=冲洗（用水流冲刷），with water=用水。【解析】B正确：flush与rinse同为“以水流冲洗”的操作，with water保留工具方式，操作含义等值。A动作错译：rub是用物体摩擦擦洗，缺少水流冲洗要素，清洗方式不符。C动作相反：fill（注满）是让水留在盆内，而rinse是让水流过并带走污物，一个蓄水一个排水，结果相反。

question: When the engine RPM decreases to 500, stop the engine.

options.A: When stop the engine, make sure that the engine decelerates to 500 RPM.
options.B: If the engine decreases to 500 RPM, you must stop it.
options.C: When the engine RPM decreases 500, you'd better stop the engine.

explanation: 【译文】当发动机转速降到500 RPM时，关停发动机。【词汇】RPM=每分钟转数，decrease to=下降到（某数值），stop the engine=停车、关停发动机，must=必须（指令语气）。【解析】B正确：if...decreases to 500 RPM保留“降到500”的条件，must stop it保持指令强制语气，条件-动作对应准确。A顺序颠倒：when stop the engine把停车作为前提、降速作为确认内容，条件与动作倒置。C两处缺陷：decreases 500漏掉to，变成“减少500”（量值而非终值）；you'd better（最好）把指令降格为建议，语气和数值均错。

question: Note that alterations or repairs to airplane must be accomplished by licensed personnel.

options.A: Only the certified personnel can complete the modification or repair to the aircraft.
options.B: Pay attention that inspections or maintenance work ought to be carried out by mechanics.
options.C: Modifications or repairs to aircraft should be achieved by releasing staff.

explanation: 【译文】注意，对飞机的改装或修理必须由持证人员完成。【词汇】alteration=改装，repair=修理，licensed personnel=持证人员（维修资质），accomplish=完成。【解析】A正确：certified personnel对应licensed personnel，modification or repair对应alterations or repairs，only...can对应must的强制性。B把改装或修理换成inspections or maintenance，工作类别张冠李戴，mechanics也不等于持证人员。C的releasing staff（放行人员）不等于持照人员，资质要素错译。

question: The exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit.

options.A: The exit doors are mainly used for passenger boarding.
options.B: The exit doors are only used for evacuation.
options.C: The exit doors are not only used for the passengers to evacuate from the airplane but also used for normal exit.

explanation: 【译文】这些出口门用于方便应急撤离，平时不作正常出口使用。【词汇】exit door=出口门，facilitate=便于、帮助，evacuation=撤离，normally=正常情况下。【解析】B正确：only used for evacuation概括“专供撤离、平时不作出口”的双重限定，语义最贴近原文（应急出口的专用属性）。A用途错译：mainly used for passenger boarding（主要用于登机）与撤离用途无关。C逻辑相反：not only...but also used for normal exit说也作正常出口，与not normally used for exit直接矛盾，把否定含义反译。

question: Handbooks shall be readily revisable.

options.A: Handbooks shall be revised easily.
options.B: Handbooks should not be revised easily.
options.C: Handbooks should be developed easily.

explanation: 【译文】手册应当便于修订。【词汇】readily=容易地、便捷地，revisable=可修订的，shall=应当（规范用语，表强制要求），handbook=手册。【解析】A正确：revised easily对应readily revisable，shall保留规范要求的强制性，语义等值。B方向相反：should not be revised easily加入否定，变成“不应容易修订”，与原文要求相反。C词义错译：developed（编制、开发）替换revised（修订），手册生命周期动作偷换，且语气从shall降为should。

question: Dry the surface with a towel.

options.A: A towel is not used to dry the surface.
options.B: Use a towel to dry the surface.
options.C: The surface is dried without a towel.

explanation: 【译文】用毛巾把表面擦干。【词汇】dry=使干燥、擦干，surface=表面，towel=毛巾，with=用（工具）。【解析】B正确：use a towel to dry the surface完整保留工具（毛巾）、动作（擦干）、对象（表面）三要素，与原祈使句等值。A否定错译：is not used to dry明确说毛巾不用于擦干表面，与原文指令相反。C双重错误：without a towel否定工具，且变成被动陈述句，把“用毛巾擦干”的操作指令改成“不用毛巾已擦干”的既成事实描述。

question: Clean the filter element with a brush.

options.A: A brush is cleaned by the filter element.
options.B: The filter element and a brush are clean.
options.C: Use a brush to clean the filter element.

explanation: 【译文】用刷子清洁滤芯。【词汇】clean=清洁，filter element=滤芯，brush=刷子，with=用（工具）。【解析】C正确：use a brush to clean the filter element中刷子为工具、滤芯为对象，主被动关系正确，与原祈使句等值。A主客颠倒：brush is cleaned by the filter element把滤芯变成清洁刷子的工具，工具与对象完全互换。B漏译要素：只说二者是干净的（are clean），把操作指令误译成状态描述，丢失“用……清洁……”的动作关系。

question: Disconnect the connection which is downstream of the valve.

options.A: Disconnect the connection. This connection is downstream of the valve.
options.B: Disconnect the connection. The valve is downstream of the connection.
options.C: Disconnect the valve. The valve is downstream of the connection.

explanation: 【译文】断开位于活门下游的那个连接接头。【词汇】downstream=下游（顺介质流向一侧），connection=连接接头，which引导限定性定语从句（修饰connection而非valve）。【解析】A正确：This connection is downstream of the valve忠实还原定语从句的位置关系——连接在活门下游，断开对象仍是connection。B位置错译：The valve is downstream of the connection把活门和连接的上下游关系对调，方向相反。C两处错误：断开对象从connection误成valve，且同样存在valve is downstream of the connection的位置倒置。

question: The disassembly fixture lets you disassemble the module.

options.A: You can use the module to disassemble the disassembly fixture.
options.B: The module that you can use to disassemble is the disassembly fixture.
options.C: You can use the disassembly fixture to disassemble the module.

explanation: 【译文】分解夹具使你能够分解该组件。【词汇】disassembly fixture=分解夹具（dis-分开+assembly装配），lets you=使你能够，module=组件、模块，disassemble=分解。【解析】C正确：use the disassembly fixture to disassemble the module中夹具为工具、组件为操作对象，工具-对象关系与原文let结构等值。A主客颠倒：use the module to disassemble the disassembly fixture把组件当工具去分解夹具，关系完全相反。B逻辑混乱：module...is the disassembly fixture把组件和夹具等同起来，且定语从句结构使语义不可解。

question: The AFDS consists of three separate autopilot channels and a single Mode Control Panel(MCP)

options.A: The AFDS  monitors  three separate autopilot channels and a single Mode Control Panel(MCP)
options.B: The AFDS  constitutes three separate autopilot channels and a single Mode Control Panel(MCP)
options.C: The AFDS contains three separate autopilot channels and a single Mode Control Panel(MCP)

explanation: 【译文】自动飞行指引系统由三个独立的自动驾驶通道和一个模式控制面板（MCP）组成。【词汇】AFDS=自动飞行指引系统，consist of=由……组成，autopilot channel=自动驾驶通道，Mode Control Panel=模式控制面板。【解析】C正确：contains（包含）准确表达“由若干部分组成”的组成关系，主语AFDS与组成要素关系正确。A词义错译：monitors（监控）把静态组成关系误成动态监控动作。B用法错误：constitutes意为“构成、组成”，正确用法是“X channels constitute the AFDS”（部分构成整体），B写成AFDS constitutes channels则主客倒置。

question: Mark and protect the removed parts.

options.A: Mark and protect the parts and then remove the parts.
options.B: Mark and protect the parts that are removed.
options.C: Mark and protect the parts that will be removed.

explanation: 【译文】对已拆下的零件做好标记并加以保护。【词汇】removed parts=已拆下的零件（过去分词表已完成），mark=做标记，protect=保护（防损伤、防混淆）。【解析】B正确：parts that are removed用定语从句还原过去分词的“已拆下”完成态，mark and protect动作完整对应。A顺序错误：then remove the parts把remove放在标记保护之后，原文零件是已拆下的，时序倒置。C时态错误：will be removed（将要拆下）与removed（已拆下）的完成态矛盾，属于时态要素错译。

question: Check all parts for obvious defects in accordance with standard industry practices.

options.A: Check all parts with clear defects in accordance with standard industry practices.
options.B: Check all parts for visible defects in accordance with standard industry practices.
options.C: Check all parts for serious defects in accordance with standard industry practices.

explanation: 【译文】按照标准行业惯例检查所有零件有无明显缺陷。【词汇】obvious defects=明显缺陷，in accordance with=按照、依据，industry practices=行业惯例，check...for=检查有无……。【解析】B正确：visible defects（可见缺陷）与obvious语义一致，check for结构保留“检查是否存在”的检测含义。A结构错译：check all parts with clear defects变成“检查那些有明显缺陷的零件”，把检测目标（找缺陷）误作筛选条件，检查范围改变。C程度错译：serious（严重的）比obvious（明显的）程度高，缺陷判定标准被拔高。

question: English is not often the native language of the readers of technical documentation.

options.A: English is not often the mother language of the readers of technical files.
options.B: English is not often the private language of the readers of technical books.
options.C: English is not often the required language of the readers of technical pamphlet.

explanation: 【译文】技术文件的读者往往不以英语为母语。【词汇】native language=母语，technical documentation=技术文件，often=往往。【解析】A正确：mother language对应native language，technical files对应documentation，核心论断保留。B两处错译：private language（私人语言）与母语无关；technical books范围窄于documentation。C的required language（规定使用的语言）不等于母语，pamphlet（小册子）范围也过窄。

question: Ground service bus has no power with external power available.

options.A: Ground service bus has no power, but the external power can be supplied.
options.B: Ground service bus is not energized with external power.
options.C: Ground service bus is  power off when external power is supplied.

explanation: 【译文】外部电源可用时，地面勤务汇流条却没有电。【词汇】ground service bus=地面勤务汇流条，has no power=无电，external power available=外部电源可用。【解析】C正确：power off对应has no power，when external power is supplied对应with...available的伴随条件，“有外电源却仍无电”的故障描述完整。A只作but转折补充，且can be supplied弱化available，未体现前提条件关系。B的is not energized with external power有歧义（像“不由外电源激励”），无电状态不如C明确。

question: Airplane performance data shall be presented in either graphical or tabular formats.

options.A: Airplane primary data should be displayed neither in graphs and tables.
options.B: Airplane behavior data shall be predicted in both graphical and tabular formats.
options.C: Aircraft performance parameters can be represented graphically or in tables.

explanation: 【译文】飞机性能数据应以图形或表格形式呈现。【词汇】performance data=性能数据，present=呈现，either...or=或……或（择一），tabular=表格的。【解析】C正确：performance parameters对应性能数据，graphically or in tables保留either/or择一格式。A把performance误成primary（主要），neither把肯定要求改成全否定。B把performance误成behavior（行为），both...and（两者都用）与either/or的择一关系矛盾。

question: Describing the steps is a job that may leave much to be desired.

options.A: There is always room for improvement in the effort to describe these steps.
options.B: It is impossible to list all the steps because there is always room for improvement.
options.C: Describing these steps need to do a lot of work.

explanation: 【译文】描述这些步骤这项工作可能仍有许多不尽如人意之处。【词汇】leave much to be desired=仍有许多待改进之处（习语），describe the steps=描述步骤，room for improvement=改进余地。【解析】A正确：room for improvement准确对应该习语，effort对应job，委婉批评语气保留。B过度推断：impossible to list all the steps把“不够完善”夸大为“无法列出全部步骤”。C漏译要素：need to do a lot of work只说工作量大，丢失“尚有不足”的评价含义。

question: Do the troubleshooting procedure to find the cause of the malfunction.

options.A: Troubleshooting can only be performed after the cause of the malfunction has been found out.
options.B: You should perform troubleshooting according to the procedure and find out the technical failure.
options.C: According to the procedure, perform the troubleshooting to solve the cause of the malfunction.

explanation: 【译文】执行排故程序以找出故障原因。【词汇】troubleshooting=排故，procedure=程序，find the cause=找出原因，malfunction=故障。【解析】B正确：perform troubleshooting保留排故动作，according to the procedure对应程序要求，find out the technical failure近似对应找故障原因，“排故→找因”方向正确。A顺序颠倒：说找到原因后才能排故，而排故的目的正是找因。C的solve the cause动宾搭配不当，把“找出原因”误成“解决原因”。

question: The Boeing 747 marked the beginning of a new era in air transport.

options.A: The Boeing 747 symbolizes the beginning of a new era in air transport.
options.B: The Boeing 747 is the first type of airplane in air transport.
options.C: Modern air transport started from the Boeing 747.

explanation: 【译文】波音747标志着航空运输新时代的开端。【词汇】mark=标志（里程碑意义），the beginning of=……的开端，new era=新时代，air transport=航空运输。【解析】A正确：symbolizes对应marked的象征性标志含义，beginning of a new era in air transport逐词对应，史实判断（开启新时代而非第一种飞机）准确。B过度扩大：the first type of airplane把“标志新时代”夸大为“航空运输史上第一种飞机”，事实和语义均超出原文。C程度错译：started from the Boeing 747说现代航空运输自747而始，把“标志开端”改写成绝对起点，推断过度。

question: The operator uses an external joystick and control panel to set the configuration and operate the system.

options.A: In order to set the configuration and operate the system, the operator uses an external joystick and control panel.
options.B: An external joystick and control panel is used to make the configuration and operate the system.
options.C: To operate an external joystick and control panel for the configuration and the system operation.

explanation: 【译文】操作员使用外部操纵杆和控制面板来设置构型并操作该系统。【词汇】operator=操作员，external joystick=外部操纵杆，control panel=控制面板，set the configuration=设置构型。【解析】A正确：in order to明确标出目的关系（用工具来设置构型和操作系统），主语operator保留。B主谓数不一致（panel is），make the configuration动宾搭配不当，且丢失operator。C仅为不定式短语，无谓语不成句，operate an external joystick还把工具误成操作对象。

question: It is not permitted to install more than two washers for each bolt.

options.A: It's not easy to install more than two washers for each bolt.
options.B: It is forbidden to install more than two washers for each bolt.
options.C: Installing one washer for each bolt is forbidden.

explanation: 【译文】每个螺栓不允许安装两个以上的垫圈。【词汇】not permitted=不允许（许可性用语），forbidden=被禁止的，more than=超过，washer=垫圈，bolt=螺栓。【解析】B正确：forbidden与not permitted同为禁止性表达，more than two washers for each bolt数量结构完整对应。A词义错译：not easy（不容易）把许可性禁止改成难度描述，语义类别完全改变。C数量错译：one washer把上限“两个”偷换成“一个”，且把“禁止超两个”变成“禁止装一个”，数值和禁令对象均错。

question: Remove the sleeve to release the sliding tube.

options.A: Remove the sleeve to tighten the sliding tube.
options.B: Remove the sleeve to install the sliding tube.
options.C: Remove the sleeve to free the sliding tube.

explanation: 【译文】拆下套筒以释放滑动管。【词汇】sleeve=套筒，release=释放、松开，sliding tube=滑动管，free=使自由、松开（动词）。【解析】C正确：free作动词表示“使脱离约束”，与release同义，拆套筒→释放滑动管的目的关系完整。A方向相反：tighten（拧紧）与release（释放）动作相反，拆套筒是为松开而非紧固。B词义错译：install（安装）与release含义无关，且拆下套筒的目的不可能是安装滑动管，目的状语逻辑不通。

question: If the hydraulic pump does not give a pressure of 3000 psi, use the electric pump.

options.A: If the hydraulic pump turns to generate pressure of 3000 psi, use the electric pump.
options.B: If the hydraulic pump fails to generate pressure of 3000 psi, use the electric pump.
options.C: If the hydraulic pump turns to supply pressure of 3000 psi, use the electric pump.

explanation: 【译文】如果液压泵不能提供3000 psi的压力，则使用电动泵。【词汇】hydraulic pump=液压泵，does not give=不能提供，fail to=未能，electric pump=电动泵。【解析】B正确：fails to generate pressure准确对应does not give a pressure，否定条件+使用电动泵的备份逻辑完整。A、C共同错误：turns to generate/supply都说泵“转而能生成/提供”3000 psi压力，把原文的否定条件（达不到压力）改成肯定条件，若按此逻辑则无需启用电动泵，属于方向相反错误。

question: Encircle each screw hole with sealant.

options.A: Put sealant around each screw hole.
options.B: Seal each screw hole.
options.C: Put each screw hole into sealant.

explanation: 【译文】在每个螺钉孔周围涂一圈密封胶。【词汇】encircle=环绕、围绕一周，screw hole=螺钉孔，sealant=密封胶，around=在……周围。【解析】A正确：put sealant around each screw hole把“涂胶”与“环绕孔位”两层含义都保留，与encircle...with sealant等值。B漏译要素：seal each screw hole只说密封孔本身，丢失“围绕孔周涂胶”的空间关系，操作方式改变。C方向错误：put each screw hole into sealant把孔放进胶里，施胶与受胶的位置关系颠倒，物理上不通。

question: Check entire system to determine the cause of interference.

options.A: Check such system to determine the cause of interference.
options.B: Examine part of the system to find the cause of the interference.
options.C: Examine all of the system to find the cause of the interference.

explanation: 【译文】检查整个系统以确定干扰的原因。【词汇】entire=整个的、全部的，interference=干扰，determine the cause=确定原因，all of=全部。【解析】C正确：all of the system对应entire system的检查范围，find the cause of the interference对应determine the cause of interference，要素齐全。A范围模糊：such system（这样的系统）既非“整个”又指代不明，丢失范围限定。B范围错误：part of the system（部分系统）与entire（整个）直接矛盾，检查覆盖范围缩小，属于范围错误。

question: Operation of the handle releases the gas, and the slide-raft inflates.

options.A: Through releasing the handle, the gas start to inflate the slide-raft .
options.B: Operation of the handle releases the gas which can inflate the slide-raft.
options.C: The gas handle operates to inflate the slide-raft.

explanation: 【译文】操作手柄会释放气体，滑梯救生筏随即充气。【词汇】operation of the handle=操作手柄，release the gas=释放气体，slide-raft=滑梯救生筏（撤离滑梯兼救生筏），inflate=充气。【解析】B正确：releases the gas which can inflate the slide-raft保留“手柄操作→放气→筏充气”的因果链，定语从句结构清晰表达气体使筏充气。A对象错译：releasing the handle（释放手柄）把动作对象从气体换成手柄，因果起点错误。C结构错译：gas handle（气体手柄）把gas误作handle的定语，且漏掉releases环节，操作机理完全曲解。

question: A small quantity of oil stays in the starter.

options.A: A small amount of oil remains in the starter.
options.B: Little oil is stored in the starter.
options.C: The starter consumes a few oil.

explanation: 【译文】起动机内留有少量滑油。【词汇】a small quantity of=少量（修饰不可数名词），stays/remains=留存，starter=起动机，a small amount of=少量。【解析】A正确：small amount与small quantity同义（均修饰不可数oil），remains对应stays的留存义，全句等值。B词义偏差：stored（被储存）暗含有意存放之意，而stays是被动残留，且little oil独立使用带“几乎没有”的否定色彩。C动作错译：consumes（消耗）与stays（留存）相反，且a few只能修饰可数名词，a few oil本身语法错误。

question: These buses receive power directly from the battery.

options.A: These buses consume power directly from the battery.
options.B: These buses accept the direct current of battery.
options.C: The battery supplies power directly to these buses.

explanation: 【译文】这些汇流条直接从电瓶获得电源。【词汇】bus=汇流条（电系术语），receive power=获得电源，directly from=直接来自，battery=电瓶。【解析】C正确：the battery supplies power directly to these buses把受动句转为主动供电句，供电方向（电瓶→汇流条）与directly要素完整保留，主客关系等值。A词义错译：consume power（消耗电力）与receive power（获得电力）方向相反。B词义错译：the direct current of battery（电瓶的直流电）把副词directly（直接地）误读成形容词direct（直流的），改变原意。

question: Your check may not be accurate if you do not vent the IDG.

options.A: Without venting the IDG, the accuracy of your check will be affected.
options.B: Only if you reset the IDG, your check is effective.
options.C: The ventilation of the IDG accelerates your check.

explanation: 【译文】如果不给IDG通气，你的检查结果可能不准确。【词汇】vent=通气、放气（给IDG通大气散热），IDG=整体驱动发电机，accurate=准确的，accuracy=准确性。【解析】A正确：without venting the IDG对应if you do not vent the IDG的否定条件，accuracy...will be affected对应may not be accurate的结果，因果链完整。B条件错译：reset（复位）替换vent（通气），IDG操作类型张冠李戴，且only if改变条件逻辑。C因果错译：ventilation...accelerates your check说通气会“加快”检查，原文通气是检查准确性的前提而非提速手段，作用关系曲解。

question: If the drain hole is clogged, clean it.

options.A: If the drain hole is blocked, clean it.
options.B: If the drain hole is leaked, clean it.
options.C: If the drain hole is locked, clean it.

explanation: 【译文】如果排放孔堵塞，就清理它。【词汇】drain hole=排放孔，clogged=堵塞的，blocked=阻塞的，clean=清理。【解析】A正确：blocked与clogged同义，drain hole和clean it完全对应，条件-处置结构等值。B词义错译：leaked（泄漏）与堵塞相反——堵塞是流体不通，泄漏是流体跑出，故障形态相反。C词义错译：locked（被锁住）指机械锁闭，与异物堵塞孔道无关，属于形近词干扰。

question: Personnel must obey this procedure.

options.A: Staff must violate this procedure.
options.B: All persons must follow this procedure.
options.C: Personnel must deviate from this procedure.

explanation: 【译文】人员必须遵守本程序。【词汇】personnel=人员，obey=遵守，procedure=程序，follow=遵循，must=必须。【解析】B正确：follow this procedure与obey this procedure同义，all persons对应personnel的集合含义，强制语气must保留。A方向相反：violate（违反）与obey恰好相反，合规性完全颠倒。C方向相反：deviate from（偏离）同样与遵守相反，两个错误选项同属方向相反错误。

question: Use a solution that contains no oil.

options.A: Utilize an oil-free solution.
options.B: Use a solution with oil.
options.C: The oil is not used that contains a solution.

explanation: 【译文】使用不含油的溶液。【词汇】solution=溶液，contains no oil=不含油，oil-free=无油的，utilize=使用（use的同义正式词）。【解析】A正确：oil-free solution简洁准确地对应solution that contains no oil，定语从句转形容词，语义等值。B否定丢失：with oil说溶液含油，与contains no oil直接相反。C语法错误：全句语序混乱不可解（the oil is not used that contains a solution），油和溶液的修饰关系完全错位，句子不成立。

question: Refer to the table that follows for the applicable torque values.

options.A: The table is referred to follow the applicable torque values.
options.B: The applicable torque values are used to obey the table.
options.C: See the table below for the applicable torque values.

explanation: 【译文】适用的扭矩值请参见下表。【词汇】refer to=参见、查阅，the table that follows=下表，applicable=适用的，torque values=扭矩值。【解析】C正确：see the table below准确对应refer to the table that follows，for the applicable torque values保留目的。A把refer to硬套被动，变成“表格被参照以跟随扭矩值”，逻辑不通。B主客颠倒：说扭矩值用来obey the table，查阅关系倒置且搭配不当。

question: If the two indications do not agree, do the test again.

options.A: If there is not a conflict between the two indicators, repeat the test.
options.B: If the two indications are different, do the test again.
options.C: Do the test again unless the two indications are different.

explanation: 【译文】如果两个指示不一致，就重新做该测试。【词汇】indication=指示、读数，agree=一致、相符，do the test again=重做测试，different=不同的。【解析】B正确：are different对应do not agree（不一致），do the test again原文照用，条件-动作逻辑等值。A条件相反：there is not a conflict（没有冲突即一致）把触发条件从“不一致”改成“一致”，重复测试的时机颠倒。C逻辑错误：unless（除非）使句意变成“除非指示不同否则重做”，即一致时也重做，与原文“不一致才重做”相反。

question: This Specification was developed by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association

options.A: This Specification was issued by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association
options.B: This Specification was revised by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association
options.C: This Specification was compiled by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association

explanation: 【译文】本规范由通用航空制造商协会编制。【词汇】Specification=规范、规格，develop=制定、编制（从无到有形成文件），compile=编制、编纂，General Aviation Manufacturers Association=通用航空制造商协会（GAMA）。【解析】C正确：compiled（编纂编制）最贴近developed的“组织制定文件”含义，规范文本的形成动作对应准确。A词义错译：issued（发布、颁布）指正式发布环节，与“编制”是不同的文件生命周期动作。B词义错译：revised（修订）指对已有文件再修改，而developed是从无到有的首次制定，环节错误。

question: The vent scoop and pressure relief valve are on an access door in each surge tank.

options.A: Each surge tank has a vent scoop and pressure relief valve on its access door.
options.B: The vent scoop and pressure relief valve each has an access door in the surge tank.
options.C: The surge tank has a vent scoop and pressure relief valve on each access door.

explanation: 【译文】每个通气油箱的接近门上都装有通气铲斗和释压活门。【词汇】vent scoop=通气铲斗（油箱通气口部件），pressure relief valve=释压活门，access door=接近门，surge tank=通气油箱/缓冲油箱。【解析】A正确：each surge tank has...on its access door准确分配“每个油箱—其接近门—两个部件”的从属关系，each的分配范围正确。B张冠李戴：each has an access door说两个部件各自有接近门，把each错配到部件头上，归属关系混乱。C分配错误：on each access door把“每个油箱的门”改成“每个接近门上都有”，若油箱有多门则语义扩大，each修饰对象错位。

question: Print all pages except wiring diagrams and foldouts on both sides.

options.A: Print all pages besides wiring diagrams and foldouts on both sides.
options.B: Print all pages other than wiring diagrams and foldouts on both sides.
options.C: Print all pages no more than wiring diagrams and foldouts on both sides.

explanation: 【译文】除线路图和折页外，所有页面双面打印。【词汇】except=除……之外（排除在外），other than=除……以外，wiring diagram=线路图，foldout=折页，on both sides=双面。【解析】B正确：other than与except同为排除义，准确表达“线路图和折页不双面打印、其余双面打印”的例外关系。A介词误用：besides意为“除……之外（还有）”，即包括线路图和折页在内也双面打印，与except的排除义相反。C短语错译：no more than意为“仅仅、不超过”，套入后语义不通，完全不表达排除关系。

question: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably adhere to the Specification content and arrangement.

options.A: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably abide by the Specification content and arrangement.
options.B: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably agree with the Specification content and arrangement.
options.C: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably substitute the Specification content and arrangement.

explanation: 【译文】要求各制造商合理遵循本规范的内容和编排。【词汇】adhere to=遵循、遵守（规范、标准），abide by=遵守，is expected to=被期望、应，arrangement=编排结构。【解析】A正确：abide by与adhere to同义（遵守规则），Specification content and arrangement要素完整，强制期望语气保留。B词义弱化：agree with（同意）只表态度赞同，不含实际遵照执行的要求，约束力弱于adhere to。C方向相反：substitute（替代）说制造商可替换规范内容，与“遵循规范”完全相反。

question: Pilots Operating Handbooks are prepared in accordance with "GAMA Specification No.1".

options.A: According to the "GAMA Specification No.1", compile the Pilots Operating Handbooks.
options.B: Prepare Pilots Operating Handbooks through "GAMA Specification No.1".
options.C: Edit "GAMA Specification No.1", in accordance with Pilots Operating Handbooks.

explanation: 【译文】飞行员操作手册是按照《GAMA第1号规范》编制的。【词汇】in accordance with=按照、依照，be prepared=被编制，Pilots Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册（POH），compile=编制。【解析】A正确：according to是in accordance with的准确对应（依照某规范），compile对应prepared的编制义，规范与手册的依从关系正确。B对应不精确：through（通过、借助）把“依照规范”弱化为“以规范为手段/渠道”，依从关系走样；故答案由B改为A。C主次颠倒：Edit GAMA Specification把规范变成被编辑对象、手册变成依据，依据与被依从对象完全倒置。

question: No legal significance or implications should be attached to the rules and terms in this document.

options.A: Legal meaning whatsoever and implications couldn't be enclosed  to the rules and terms in this document.
options.B: No legal significance or meanings should be fixed to the regulations and terms in this document.
options.C: The rules and terms in this document have no legal meaning or imply something.

explanation: 【译文】不应赋予本文件中的规则和术语任何法律意义或法律含义。【词汇】legal significance=法律意义，implication=含义，attach...to=赋予、附加于，rules and terms=规则和术语。【解析】B正确：no legal significance or meanings should be fixed to保留“不应附加法律意义”的结构，regulations对应rules，最接近原句。A搭配错误：enclosed（装入、围住）不能表达attach的“赋予”义，句子不通。C把名词implications拆成动词imply，且变成“规则术语本身无含义”，否定对象错位。

question: Engine-driven pumps are primary pumps which run continuously when they are turned on.

options.A: The engine-driven pump is the major pump that works endless when it is switched on.
options.B: The engine-driven pumps are the main pumps that runs continuously during operation.
options.C: The engine-driven pumps are the secondary pumps that operates infinitely after running.

explanation: 【译文】发动机驱动泵是主泵，接通后连续运转。【词汇】engine-driven pump=发动机驱动泵（EDP），primary pump=主泵，run continuously=连续运转，turn on=接通。【解析】B正确：main pumps对应primary pumps，continuously during operation对应when turned on的连续运转特征（runs单复数虽有小瑕疵，语义仍最佳）。A用单数与原文复数类别描述不符，works endless语法错误。C把primary（主泵）误成secondary（次级泵），等级相反。

question: A word in UPPERCASE letters is approved in STE.

options.A: Words with lowercase letters are allowed in STE.
options.B: STE dictionary is permitted to use the  UPPERCASE letter word.
options.C: In STE, a word in capital letters means that it is approved.

explanation: 【译文】在STE中，以大写字母写出的词表示它已获准使用。【词汇】UPPERCASE letters=大写字母，approved=获准使用的，STE=简化技术英语，capital letters=大写字母。【解析】C正确：capital letters对应UPPERCASE，means that it is approved保留“大写=已批准”的词典约定。A正反颠倒：lowercase（小写）与UPPERCASE相反——STE中小写形式恰为禁用词。B主体错位：说STE词典被允许使用该词，把“词被批准”误成“词典被允许”，批准关系错误。

question: Get the correct tools to open the containers for these materials.

options.A: To open the containers for these materials, suitable tools must be used.
options.B: The appropriate tools should be selected to open the materials, the containers is inside the materials.
options.C: The inappropriate tools should be selected to open the containers, the containers is made in the materials.

explanation: 【译文】备好合适的工具来开启这些材料的容器。【词汇】correct tools=合适的工具，container=容器，for these materials=盛装这些材料的，suitable=合适的。【解析】A正确：suitable tools对应correct tools，containers for these materials保留“材料之容器”关系，must be used保持要求语气。B修饰关系错乱：说容器在材料里面，包裹方向颠倒，且open the materials对象偷换。C两处错误：inappropriate（不合适）与correct相反；made in the materials同样曲解容器与材料关系。

question: The injury to your skin and lungs can occur.

options.A: Your skin and lungs can be protected.
options.B: Your skin and lungs can be harmed.
options.C: Your skin and lungs can be harmed suddenly.

explanation: 【译文】可能会对皮肤和肺部造成伤害。【词汇】injury=伤害、损伤，occur=发生，skin and lungs=皮肤和肺，be harmed=受到伤害。【解析】B正确：can be harmed对应injury can occur（可能发生伤害）的被动表述，皮肤和肺两个受损部位完整。A方向相反：be protected（受到保护）与“发生伤害”完全相反，警示句变成安慰句，安全语义颠倒。C无中生有：suddenly（突然）为原文没有的信息，属于添加要素的过度翻译。

question: The manufacturer supplies the safety procedures.

options.A: The safety procedures are provided by the operators.
options.B: The safety procedures are provided to the manufacturers.
options.C: The safety procedures are provided by the manufacturers.

explanation: 【译文】由制造商提供安全程序。【词汇】manufacturer=制造商，supply=提供，safety procedures=安全程序，be provided by=由……提供（被动对应主动supply）。【解析】C正确：被动转换后主客体一致——安全程序为受事、制造商为提供方，与supplies的施受关系完全对应。A主体错译：by the operators把提供方换成运营人/操作员，责任主体张冠李戴。B方向相反：provided to the manufacturers变成“提供给制造商”，即制造商是接收方而非提供方，供需方向颠倒。

question: The side stay holds the main gear leg.

options.A: The main gear leg could be held by the side stay.
options.B: The main gear leg could be hampered by the side stay.
options.C: The main gear leg could be contained by the side stay.

explanation: 【译文】侧撑杆支撑着主起落架支柱。【词汇】side stay=侧撑杆（起落架支撑构件），hold=支撑、保持住，main gear leg=主起落架支柱。【解析】A正确：be held by the side stay被动化后支撑关系不变，侧撑杆为支撑方、支柱为被支撑方，力传递关系正确。B词义错译：hampered（妨碍、阻碍）把支撑作用改成阻碍作用，功能相反。C词义错译：contained（包含、容纳）指空间包容关系，撑杆并不能“容纳”支柱，机械关系错译。

question: You can write descriptive text in the active voice.

options.A: The description could be pronounced in the active voice.
options.B: Descriptive content can be written in active voice.
options.C: You should read it in voice as you write the descriptive text.

explanation: 【译文】你可以用主动语态来撰写描述性文字。【词汇】descriptive text=描述性文本，active voice=主动语态（语法术语），write=撰写。【解析】B正确：descriptive content can be written in active voice中voice按语法术语处理（语态），can对应许可语气，语义等值。A术语误读：pronounced（发音）把active voice的“语态”误当作“嗓音”，语法概念错解。C张冠李戴：read it in voice（朗读）同样误读voice，且把“写作时的语态要求”曲解成“边写边读”，动作对象全错。

question: Dents are not permitted if they prevent correct operation of the parts.

options.A: Correct operation of the parts does not allow dents to occur.
options.B: Dents that have an influence on the correct operation of the parts are not allowed.
options.C: Dents can prevent correct operation of the parts, so they are not permitted.

explanation: 【译文】凹痕若妨碍零件正常工作则不允许存在。【词汇】dent=凹痕，prevent=妨碍、阻碍，correct operation=正常工作，not permitted/not allowed=不允许。【解析】B正确：dents that have an influence on the correct operation用定语从句保留“仅妨碍正常工作的凹痕不被允许”的条件限定，判定标准准确。A逻辑扭曲：correct operation does not allow dents to occur让“正常工作”作主语去禁止凹痕发生，主体关系生硬且改变原文条件结构。C条件扩大：把所有dents先断言会妨碍正常工作再一概禁止，而原文只禁止“会妨碍工作的那类凹痕”，属于范围错误。

question: Use an equivalent material if the specified one is not available.

options.A: Use the specified one if the  equivalent material is not available.
options.B: Use the available equivalent one if no material is specified.
options.C: If you can not get the specified material, use an equivalent.

explanation: 【译文】如果指定材料无法获得，则使用等效材料。【词汇】equivalent material=等效材料，specified one=指定的（材料），not available=无法获得。【解析】C正确：can not get the specified material对应specified one is not available，use an equivalent对应等效替代方案，条件与措施完整。A条件倒置：把“指定料不可用”误成“等效料不可用”，结论也换成用指定料，逻辑颠倒。B条件错译：no material is specified（未指定材料）与“指定料不可得”是两种情形。

question: Identify the bellcrank and shaft with marks to prevent incorrect installation.

options.A: Use the marks on the bellcrank and shaft to identify them and prevent incorrect installation.
options.B: Mark the bellcrank and shaft so that they'll be identified and incorrect installation will not occur.
options.C: Put marks on the bellcrank and shaft or incorrect installation will occur.

explanation: 【译文】给摇臂和轴做标记以便识别，防止错误安装。【词汇】identify...with marks=用标记标识，bellcrank=摇臂，shaft=轴，prevent incorrect installation=防止错装。【解析】B正确：mark...so that they'll be identified落实“做标记以便识别”，incorrect installation will not occur对应prevent，因果链完整。A前提错置：use the marks把标记当作已有工具，而原文是“先做标记再识别”，时序颠倒。C用or表达“否则就错装”，漏掉识别目的，逻辑生硬。

question: Make sure that the parts are loosely assembled.

options.A: The parts must be assembled tightly.
options.B: Make sure that the parts are attached securely.
options.C: The parts must be assembled loosely.

explanation: 【译文】确保各零件处于松装状态。【词汇】loosely=松弛地、松动地，assemble=装配，make sure=确保，tightly/securely=紧固地（反义干扰）。【解析】C正确：assembled loosely完整对应loosely assembled，must对应make sure的要求语气，装配状态要求等值。A方向相反：tightly（紧固地）与loosely（松地）完全相反，装配要求颠倒。B方向相反：attached securely（牢固连接）同样与松装要求相反，常见于需要后续调整间隙的装配步骤，误译会导致工艺错误。

question: The bottom mark on the board is red.

options.A: The color of the bottom mark on the plate is amber.
options.B: You can see the red bottom mark on the board.
options.C: There is no color of the bottom mark on the board.

explanation: 【译文】板子底部的标记是红色的。【词汇】bottom mark=底部标记，board=板、牌，red=红色。【解析】B正确：the red bottom mark on the board保留底部标记、板、红色三要素，以“可以看到”转述存在句，语义等值。A两处错误：plate（平板/铭牌）虽近board但此处对象有偏，关键是把red误成amber（琥珀色），颜色要素错译。C否定错译：no color说底部标记没有颜色，与is red直接矛盾。

question: Do not refuel the aircraft during maintenance.

options.A: Do not perform any work to the aircraft during maintenance.
options.B: It is forbidden to refuel the aircraft during maintenance.
options.C: You can add fuel to the aircraft at any time.

explanation: 【译文】维修期间不要给飞机加油。【词汇】refuel=加油（re-再+fuel燃油），during maintenance=维修期间，forbidden=被禁止的。【解析】B正确：forbidden对应do not的禁止语气，refuel和during maintenance要素齐全，禁令范围准确。A范围扩大：any work（任何工作）把“禁止加油”扩大成“禁止一切工作”，禁令对象错译。C方向相反：add fuel...at any time说任何时候都可加油，与禁止指令完全相反，安全红线被抹除。

question: Do these checks randomly.

options.A: Perform these checks without any schedule.
options.B: Perform these checks immediately.
options.C: Do these checks regularly.

explanation: 【译文】随机进行这些检查。【词汇】randomly=随机地（无固定计划地），check=检查，without any schedule=不按任何计划。【解析】A正确：without any schedule是randomly的合理解释（不排计划、随机抽查），检查方式对应准确。B词义错译：immediately（立即）是时间紧急性，与随机性无关，形近干扰。C方向相反：regularly（定期地）与randomly恰好相反——定期是有计划的，随机是无计划的。

question: Hydraulic fluid causes fast deterioration of painted surfaces.

options.A: Hydraulic fluid has no effect on painted surfaces.
options.B: Hydraulic fluid has positive influence on painted surfaces.
options.C: Hydraulic fluid has passive influence on painted surfaces.

explanation: 【译文】液压油会使涂漆表面迅速劣化。【词汇】hydraulic fluid=液压油，cause=导致，deterioration=劣化、变质，painted surface=涂漆表面，passive influence=负面影响。【解析】C正确：passive（消极的、负面的）对应deterioration的劣化方向，虽漏译fast的程度但影响性质正确，为三选项中最贴近的。A方向相反：has no effect（无影响）与“导致劣化”矛盾，安全隐患被抹除。B方向相反：positive influence（正面影响）与劣化的负面性质相反。注：三选项均未完整体现fast程度，取语义最接近者。

question: Identify the bell crank and shaft with marks to prevent incorrect installation.

options.A: Put the bell crank and shaft with identification to prevent improper installation.
options.B: Identify the bell crank and shaft with marks to prevent wrong installation.
options.C: Put the bell crank and shaft with identification to prevent wrong installation.

explanation: 【译文】给摇臂和轴做标记以便识别，防止错误安装。【词汇】bell crank=摇臂，shaft=轴，identify...with marks=用标记标识，incorrect/wrong installation=错误安装。【解析】B正确：几乎是原句的直译保留——identify、with marks、prevent、wrong installation全部对应，语义结构无损。A、C共同错误：put the bell crank and shaft with identification中put with搭配生硬，把“用标记识别零件”曲解成“把零件连同标识放（置）”，动词对象关系走样，且identification作名词未体现“做标记以识别”的操作。

question: Light L4 comes on in 5 seconds or less .

options.A: Light L4 illuminates within 5 seconds.
options.B: Light L4 comes on after 5 seconds.
options.C: Light L4 comes on 5 seconds before.

explanation: 【译文】L4灯在5秒或更短时间内点亮。【词汇】come on=（灯）亮、点亮，in 5 seconds or less=在5秒或更短时间内，illuminate=点亮，within=在……之内。【解析】A正确：illuminates对应comes on，within 5 seconds对应in 5 seconds or less（不超过5秒），时间上限准确。B时间相反：after 5 seconds（5秒后亮）与“5秒内亮”方向相反，灯亮时机晚了。C方向相反：5 seconds before（5秒之前）使时间参照完全错位，既不表“之后”也不表“之内”。

question: When the indicator comes into view, stop the pump.

options.A: When the indicator is visible, stop the pump.
options.B: When the indicator comes on , stop the pump.
options.C: Stop the pump unless the indicator comes into view.

explanation: 【译文】当指示器进入视野时，停止泵。【词汇】come into view=进入视野、变得可见，indicator=指示器，stop the pump=停泵，visible=可见的。【解析】A正确：is visible准确对应comes into view（可见状态），when引导的时间条件与停泵动作对应完整。B词义错译：comes on指（灯）点亮发光，而comes into view指（指示器）显现可见，机械指示器并非发光点亮。C逻辑错误：unless使句意变成“除非指示器可见否则停泵”，即不可见时反而停泵，条件完全相反。

question: The units used are those which will be of most value to pilots.

options.A: The units used by pilots are the most valuable.
options.B: The units used are those which are the most expensive for pilots.
options.C: The units are the most useful for the pilots.

explanation: 【译文】所使用的单位是对飞行员最有用的那些单位。【词汇】unit=单位（计量单位），of most value=最有价值的，be useful to=对……有用，pilot=飞行员。【解析】C正确：the most useful for the pilots对应of most value to pilots（对飞行员最有用/最有价值），选用单位的适用性含义保留。A主语错位：units used by pilots（飞行员使用的单位）给units加了使用者限定，原文是说“手册采用的单位”，限定要素偷换。B词义错译：the most expensive（最昂贵的）把value（价值）误作price（价格），语义类别错误。

question: Equivalent substitutes can be used.

options.A: Substitutes with different quality can be used.
options.B: You can not use substitutes with same quantity.
options.C: Equivalent substitutes are permitted to use.

explanation: 【译文】可以使用等效代用品。【词汇】equivalent=等效的，substitute=代用品，can be used=可以使用，be permitted=被允许。【解析】C正确：permitted to use对应can be used的许可含义，equivalent substitutes术语保留，全句等值。A属性错译：different quality（不同质量）与equivalent（等效）相反——等效替代要求性能相当而非质量不同。C的双重干扰：B项not use与same quantity（相同数量）把equivalent（等效）曲解为同量，且加入否定，许可方向和质量要求全错。

question: This document provides supplemental to the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s).

options.A: This document and the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s) complement each other.
options.B: This document may supplement the aircraft maintenance manual(s) as appropriate.
options.C: This document is explanation to the airplane maintenance manual(s).

explanation: 【译文】本文件为适用的飞机维修手册提供补充内容。【词汇】supplement(al)=补充（的），applicable=适用的，airplane maintenance manual=飞机维修手册。【解析】B正确：supplement the aircraft maintenance manual对应provides supplemental to，as appropriate呼应applicable（适用的）一词，补充关系与适用范围完整。A关系夸大：complement each other（互相补充）把单向补充改成双向互补，本文件对手册的从属关系被抬平。C词义错译：is explanation to（是对……的解释）把“补充文件”窄化为“解释说明”，文件性质改变。

question: Note is an operating procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance condition, etc., which is deemed essential to highlight.

options.A: Notes emphasize conditions such as operating procedures, inspection, repair or maintenance, etc., which may be met as appropriate.
options.B: Notes emphasize the conditions of operation procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance, etc., must be followed.
options.C: Conditions for operating procedures, inspection, repair or maintenance, etc. must be emphasized in the notes.

explanation: 【译文】“注”是指认为有必要予以强调的操作程序、检查、修理或维护条件等内容。【词汇】Note=注（手册标注层级），deemed=被认为，essential=必要的，highlight=强调，condition=条件、情形。【解析】A正确：emphasize对应highlight，as appropriate呼应deemed（视情况认为必要），列举的适用情形完整，定义句结构保留。B语气错译：must be followed把“认为有必要强调”的判断改成“必须遵守”的强制要求，定义性质变成指令。C结构偏差：虽大意近似，但把“注是对……的强调”的定义句式改成“条件必须在注中被强调”，deemed essential to highlight的判断意味丢失，定义准确性逊于A。

question: Advisory circular is information provided by FAA that is not mandatory.

options.A: Advisory circular must always be carried out on aircraft.
options.B: Advisory circular is the procedure that must be used when performing maintenance on an aircraft.
options.C: FAA provides advisory circular which is not always carried out on aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】咨询通告是FAA提供的信息，不具强制性。【词汇】advisory circular=咨询通告（AC，FAA发布的指导性文件），mandatory=强制的，carry out=执行。【解析】C正确：FAA provides对应provided by FAA，not always carried out近似表达not mandatory（非强制，不必执行），文件的指导性质保留。A性质相反：must always be carried out说必须执行，与not mandatory直接矛盾。B两处错误：把information换成procedure（程序），文件性质错译；must be used同样违背非强制属性。

question: Remove the caps from the hoses.

options.A: Keep the caps off the hoses.
options.B: Make sure the caps are off from the hoses.
options.C: Take the caps off the flexible pipe.

explanation: 【译文】从软管上取下盖帽。【词汇】cap=盖帽、堵盖，hose=软管，remove...from=从……上取下，flexible pipe=软管。【解析】C正确：take the caps off对应remove the caps from（取下动作），flexible pipe是hose的准确同义替换，动作方向正确。A状态错译：keep the caps off（保持盖帽离开软管）描述的是持续状态而非取下动作，瞬间动词被误成状态维持。B句意模糊：make sure the caps are off强调“确认已取下”的核查，而非执行取下动作，行为类型改变。

question: Be careful when you touch printed circuit boards.

options.A: Be careful when you put your hand onto printed circuit boards.
options.B: Be careful when you get close to printed circuit boards.
options.C: Be careful when you remove printed circuit boards.

explanation: 【译文】接触印刷电路板时要小心。【词汇】touch=触碰，printed circuit board=印刷电路板（PCB），be careful=小心（防ESD静电损伤）。【解析】A正确：put your hand onto（把手放到……上）是touch的具体化表达，小心接触PCB的防静电含义保留。B程度不足：get close to（靠近）不等于touch（触碰），不接触即无静电风险，警告的操作边界放宽。C动作错译：remove（拆卸）把触碰换成拆除，操作类型完全改变。

question: Make sure that the hydraulic fluid is clean.

options.A: Make sure that the hydraulic oil can be cleaned.
options.B: Make sure that there is no dust in the hydraulic fluid.
options.C: Make sure that the hydraulic fluid is uncontaminated.

explanation: 【译文】确保液压油洁净无污染。【词汇】hydraulic fluid=液压油，clean=洁净的、无污染的，make sure=确保，uncontaminated=未受污染的。【解析】C正确：uncontaminated准确对应clean在油液语境下的“无污染”含义，液压油清洁度要求等值。A结构错译：can be cleaned（可以被清洗）把状态要求（保持洁净）误成可清洗性，性质判断变成可能性。B范围过窄：no dust只排除灰尘一种污染物，clean涵盖所有污染物（水分、杂质、其他油液），属于范围错误。

question: Some models have this function, but some do not.

options.A: Every model has this function.
options.B: This function is applicable to all models.
options.C: Not all models have this function.

explanation: 【译文】某些型号具有此功能，而某些型号没有。【词汇】some...but some...not=有些……而有些不……（部分适用），model=型号，function=功能，not all=并非全部。【解析】C正确：not all models have this function准确概括“部分有、部分无”的分布，与原句的部分肯定部分否定等值。A全称错误：every model（每个型号）把部分适用扩大为全部适用。B全称错误：applicable to all models（适用于所有型号）同样把选择性配置说成通用配置，与but some do not矛盾。

question: Make sure that there is an equal distance between the holes.

options.A: Make sure that there is a different distance between the holes.
options.B: Make sure that you space the holes equally.
options.C: The holes should have long distances.

explanation: 【译文】确保各孔之间的距离相等。【词汇】equal distance=相等的距离，between the holes=孔与孔之间，space...equally=等间距布置。【解析】B正确：space the holes equally（等间距排布各孔）准确对应equal distance between the holes，孔距一致性的工艺要求保留。A方向相反：different distance（不同的距离）与equal相反。C属性错译：long distances（长距离）说的是孔距大小，而原句要求的是孔距一致，均布要素错译。

question: Inflate the tire with nitrogen to the specified pressure.

options.A: Deflate the pressure of tire to the certain value.
options.B: Provide pressure with nitrogen to the required value for the tire.
options.C: Depressurize the tire to the demanded value.

explanation: 【译文】用氮气给轮胎充气至规定压力。【词汇】inflate=充气，nitrogen=氮气（机轮充气介质），specified pressure=规定压力，tire=轮胎。【解析】B正确：provide pressure with nitrogen对应inflate...with nitrogen，required value对应specified pressure，充气介质和目标压力完整。A方向相反：deflate（放气）与inflate（充气）相反，且漏掉氮气介质。C方向相反：depressurize（释压降压）同样是放气操作，并漏掉nitrogen要素。

question: A red mark on the pin identifies the lubrication point.

options.A: The location where a red mark is on the pin needs to be lubricated.
options.B: You should identify the red mark on the lubricant point.
options.C: The lubrication point shows that  you can find marks on the pin.

explanation: 【译文】销子上的红色标记标识出润滑点。【词汇】pin=销子，red mark=红色标记，identify=标识、表明，lubrication point=润滑点。【解析】A正确：where a red mark is on the pin对应mark与pin的位置关系，needs to be lubricated揭示红标的功能（标识需润滑的位置），即lubrication point的含义。B对象错译：identify the red mark on the lubricant point变成“识别润滑点上的红标”，标识的主体（红标）与客体（润滑点）倒置。C因果倒置：lubrication point shows that...说润滑点显示标记，把“标记指示润滑点”反成“润滑点显示标记”。

question: Stay away from surfaces that move.

options.A: Please stand near the moving surfaces.
options.B: Never stay near the removed surfaces.
options.C: Do not stay near the moving surfaces.

explanation: 【译文】远离运动中的表面。【词汇】stay away from=远离，surfaces that move=运动表面（舵面、作动面等），near=靠近。【解析】C正确：do not stay near the moving surfaces双重否定式表达“不要靠近运动表面”，与stay away from等值，moving保留运动属性。A方向相反：stand near（站在附近）与安全距离要求相反。B对象错译：removed surfaces（拆下的表面）与surfaces that move（运动表面）完全不同——危险源是运动部件而非已拆下部件。

question: Clean the opaque plastic surfaces.

options.A: Clean the elastic surfaces that are transparent.
options.B: Clean the plastic surfaces that are not transparent.
options.C: Clean the plastic surfaces that are not vague.

explanation: 【译文】清洁不透明的塑料表面。【词汇】opaque=不透明的，plastic surface=塑料表面，transparent=透明的（反义），vague=含糊的。【解析】B正确：not transparent是opaque的准确释义，塑料表面和清洁动作完整。A方向相反：transparent（透明）与opaque相反，还把plastic误成elastic（有弹性的）。C词义错译：not vague（不含糊）把视觉上的不透明曲解为语义上的不含糊，vague描述的是抽象清晰度而非透光性。

question: If the fuel leak originates at the valve, replace the valve seals.

options.A: If the valve is the source of the fuel leak, discard the valve seals and install new ones.
options.B: If the fuel leaks out of the valve, reinstall the valve seals.
options.C: If the fuel leak flows towards the valve, discard the valve seals and install new ones.

explanation: 【译文】如果燃油泄漏源自活门处，则更换活门封严。【词汇】originate at=起源于、源自，fuel leak=燃油渗漏，valve seal=活门封严，replace=更换（弃旧换新）。【解析】A正确：the source of the fuel leak对应leak originates（泄漏源），discard...and install new ones是replace的具体化（弃旧件装新件），处置逻辑完整。B处置错译：reinstall the valve seals（重新装回封严）不是replace——渗漏封严重装无法排除故障，维修措施错误。C方向相反：flows towards the valve（漏向活门）把泄漏源和流向颠倒，源点判断错误。

question: Display a warning notice on the panel prohibiting the operation of the controls.

options.A: Make the panel display a warning notice in order to reveal the operation of the controls.
options.B: Tag a warning notice on the panel to remind the operation of the controls.
options.C: Put a warning notice on the panel to prevent operation of the control.
