options.A: Those units and components  are responsible for storing and delivering fuel to the turbines system, including engine-driven fuel pumps, fuel tanks (airbags), valves, booster pumps, etc. and provide components for dumping fuel overboard.
options.B: Those units and components are used to store and deliver fuel to the engine, including engine-driven fuel pumps,  integral tanks (bladder), valves, boost pumps, etc., and those components which furnish a means of  in-flight fuel dumping .
options.C: Those units and components are designed to store and deliver fuel to the gas engine system, including engine-driven fuel pumps, fuel tanks (airbags), valves, booster pumps, etc. and units to pour fuel to the air.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components are used to store and deliver fuel to the engine, including engine-driven fuel pumps, integral tanks (bladder cells), valves, boost pumps, etc., and those components which provide a means of in-flight fuel dumping.【词汇】integral tanks=整体/结构油箱，bladder=囊式软油箱，boost pump=增压泵，in-flight fuel dumping=空中应急放油，engine-driven fuel pumps=发动机驱动燃油泵。【解析】B正确："store and deliver fuel to the engine"对应"储存燃油并将燃油输送到发动机"，"integral tanks (bladder)"对应"结构油箱（软油箱）"，"in-flight fuel dumping"对应"空中应急放油"。A把"发动机"误译为turbines system（涡轮系统，接收对象范围错误），把"软油箱"误译为airbags（安全气囊，部件张冠李戴），"dumping fuel overboard"尚可但整体失真。C把"发动机"误译为gas engine system（汽油发动机系统，无中生有的限定），airbags同误，"pour fuel to the air"为口语化不专业表述。engine泛指发动机，turbines/gas engine均属窄化错换；bladder指囊式油箱而非安全气囊。

question: 此系统部分用于储存燃油，包括结构油箱密封胶、软油箱、通风系统、软油箱和结构油箱相互连通装置、翼上加油口颈和口盖等。

options.A: That portion of the system  is responsible for the fuel storage components in the system, comprising of storage tank, bag battery, ventilation system, battery and storage tank interconnection device, neck and cover of the wing filler, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to store fuel, including integral tank sealing, bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, over wing filler necks and caps, etc.
options.C: A portion in a system can store fuel. Covering storage tank sealing, bag battery, ventilation system, battery and storage tank interconnection device, overhead neck and cover of the wing filler, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to store fuel, including integral tank sealing, bladder-type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, overwing filler necks and caps, etc.【词汇】integral tank sealing=结构油箱密封，bladder type cells=囊式软油箱，interconnectors=连通装置，overwing filler necks and caps=翼上加油口颈和口盖，ventilating system=通风系统。【解析】B正确：五项列举——integral tank sealing、bladder type cells、ventilating system、cell and tank interconnectors、over wing filler necks and caps——与题干"结构油箱密封胶、软油箱、通风系统、连通装置、翼上加油口颈和口盖"一一对应。A把"软油箱"误译为bag battery（cell被错解为battery电池，术语完全错误），interconnection device中cell又误作battery。C同样两处battery误译，"A portion in a system"弱化That portion的特指，"Covering"开头造成破句，"overhead neck"误译over wing（翼上）。cell在燃油系统语境指油箱单元（软油箱），A、C将cell误作battery是核心错点。列举类题目须逐项核对部件名，cell、tank、interconnector、filler均为固定译法。

question: 相关组件和部件包含：乙醇泵、阀门、存储箱、螺旋桨防冰系统、机翼加热器、水管加热器、空速管加热器、进气道加热器、风挡雨刮，以及风挡防冰中的电防冰和热防冰装置。不包括基本的风挡面板。

options.A: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, alcohol container, propeller anti-icing system, wing warmers, water line warmers, pitot warmers, scoop warmers, windshield wipers and the electrical anti-icing and heated air ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.
options.B: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.
options.C: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, plumbing heaters, air speed tube heaters, intake heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air ice control for windshield. Does not include the basic windshield panel.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers, and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.【词汇】alcohol pump=乙醇泵，pitot heaters=空速管（皮托管）加热器，scoop heaters=进气口加热器，heated air=热防冰，windshield ice control=风挡防冰，Does not include=不包括。【解析】B正确：全部列举完整且术语规范——heaters对应"加热器"，pitot对应"空速管"，"electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control"对应"风挡防冰中的电防冰和热防冰装置"，末尾排除项"Does not include the basic windshield panel"保留。A把heater系列误译为warmers（航空维修中加热器规范译名是heater），"alcohol container"把存储箱窄化为乙醇容器，末尾漏译"风挡"归属。C把"水管加热器"误译为plumbing heaters（管道加热器，范围扩大），"空速管"误译为air speed tube（pitot直译拼凑，术语错误），"intake heaters"对scoop不规范。

question: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止进气道内部或周围积冰，包含动力装置整流罩防冰装置。

options.A: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent ice forming in air exhaust surroundings, including air flow anti-icing on the power plant.
options.B: The portion of the system  is used to get rid of or facilitate the gathering of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant protector ice control.
options.C: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant cowling anti-icing.

explanation: 【译文】The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant cowling anti-icing.【词汇】eliminate or prevent=消除或阻止，formation of ice=积冰形成，air intakes=进气道，power plant cowling=动力装置整流罩，anti-icing=防冰。【解析】C正确："eliminate or prevent the formation of ice"对应"消除或阻止积冰"，"in or around air intakes"对应"进气道内部或周围"，"power plant cowling anti-icing"对应"动力装置整流罩防冰装置"。A把air intakes误译为air exhaust surroundings（进气道→排气周围，部件方向错误），把cowling误译为air flow（整流罩完全丢失）。B把prevent误译为facilitate the gathering of ice（防止结冰变成促进结冰，语义完全相反——属最严重的方向错误），cowling误译为protector（保护器≠整流罩）。B的facilitate属严重反义错误——防冰功能是阻止结冰；intakes为进气道，exhaust为排气。

question: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止所有翼型表面积冰,包括机翼和尾翼的翼面部分。

options.A: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces, including wings and airfoil sections of the empennage.
options.B: The portion of the system  is used to dispel or get rid of ice gathering on some aircraft surfaces, including wings and empennage surfaces.
options.C: The portion of the system is used to eliminate or forbid ice forming on outside parts of all airfoils, including the airfoils of wings and empennage.

explanation: 【译文】The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces, including wing and empennage airfoil sections.【词汇】airfoil surfaces=翼型表面，eliminate or prevent=消除或阻止，empennage=尾翼（固定术语），airfoil sections=翼面部分，formation of ice=积冰形成。【解析】A正确："all airfoil surfaces"对应"所有翼型表面"，"wings and airfoil sections of the empennage"对应"机翼和尾翼的翼面部分"，eliminate or prevent准确对应"消除或阻止"。B把all airfoil surfaces误译为some aircraft surfaces（所有翼型表面→某些飞机表面，范围既缩小又错换对象），"empennage surfaces"漏译airfoil sections限定。C把prevent误译为forbid（禁止，用语不当——规范文本表达阻止用prevent），"outside parts of all airfoils"表述冗赘且"外部"对"表面"偏移，empennage前的airfoils修饰关系松散。all airfoil surfaces强调所有翼型表面，B缩为'某些飞机表面'属范围错误；forbid非规范用语。

question: 该系统中的这一部分能够使飞机在地面上滑行和制动，并在起落架收上后使机轮停止转动，具体包括旋转轴密封装置、防滑装置、压力指示器、管道等。

options.A: That portion of the system  provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as wing illumination, warning light dimming systems, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.C: That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation before retraction, including items such as supply valves, anti-skid devices, pressure warning systems, plumbing, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.【词汇】rolling and stopping=滑行和制动，wheel rotation=机轮转动，after retraction=（起落架）收上后，anti-skid devices=防滑装置，plumbing=管路，swivel glands=旋转轴密封装置。【解析】A正确："after retraction"对应"收上后"（起落架收上后刹住机轮转动），"anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing"对应"防滑装置、压力指示器、管道"，功能与列举均对。B列举项完全错换——wing illumination（机翼照明）和warning light dimming（警告灯调光系统）与题干密封装置、防滑装置毫不相干，属张冠李戴。C把after retraction误译为before retraction（收上后→收上前，时间方向相反），"supply valves"对"旋转轴密封装置"错误，"pressure warning systems"对"压力指示器"也不准确。B列举的照明与调光系统完全偏离刹车防滑主题，属整段张冠李戴。

question: 这些组件和部件能够提供外部和内部照明，包括着陆灯、滑行灯、航行灯、旋转式信号灯、积冰信号灯、主警告灯、乘客阅读灯和机舱顶灯等。

options.A: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, cabin warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.
options.B: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.
options.C: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, navigation, position indicating, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin floor lights, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.【词汇】external and internal illumination=外部和内部照明，position lights=航行灯/位置灯，ice lights=积冰信号灯，master warning lights=主警告灯，cabin dome lights=机舱顶灯，rotating lights=旋转式信号灯。【解析】B正确：八项灯具与题干完整对应——position lights对应"航行灯"，master warning lights对应"主警告灯"（master不可省），cabin dome lights对应"机舱顶灯"。A把master warning lights误译为cabin warning lights（主警告灯→座舱警告灯，master这一等级限定丢失，警告灯级别错误）。C把rotating lights误拆为"navigation, position indicating"（旋转式信号灯被拆解错位），把cabin dome lights误译为cabin floor lights（顶灯→地板灯，方位相反），navigation与position lights重复混乱。master warning lights的master（主）不可省——主警告灯是独立告警等级；dome与floor方位相反。

question: 该系统中的这一部分用来控制飞机在地面上的运动方向，包括作动筒油缸、操纵装置、轮架旋转开锁装置等。

options.A: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft off the ground, including items such as shock strut, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as skid blocks, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
options.C: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.【词汇】on the ground=在地面上，actuating cylinders=作动筒油缸，controls=操纵装置，bogie swivel unlock=轮架旋转开锁装置，direction of movement=运动方向。【解析】C正确："on the ground"对应"在地面上"（前轮转弯等地面操纵功能），"actuating cylinders"对应"作动筒油缸"，"bogie swivel unlock"对应"轮架旋转开锁装置"。A把on the ground误译为off the ground（在地面上→离开地面，介词之差导致语义完全相反——地面方向控制变成离地控制），把actuating cylinders误译为shock strut（减震支柱，部件错误）。B虽on the ground正确，但把actuating cylinders误译为skid blocks（滑块/止动块，作动筒是液压作动部件，张冠李戴）。作动筒油缸是作动部件，shock strut减震支柱、skid blocks滑块均为部件错换；A还把地面改成离地。

question: 着陆和滑行助航设备包括航向道、下滑道、仪表着陆系统、信标、地面制导系统等项目。

options.A: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, ground guidance systems, etc.
options.B: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, sliding way, ILS, markers, landing navigation system, etc.
options.C: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, sliding way, instrumental system, markers, ground lighting system, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, ground guidance systems, etc.【词汇】localizer=航向道（LOC），glide slope=下滑道（G/S），ILS=仪表着陆系统，markers=信标，ground guidance systems=地面制导系统。【解析】A正确：五项助航设备localizer、glide slope、ILS、markers、ground guidance systems与题干"航向道、下滑道、仪表着陆系统、信标、地面制导系统"完全对应，均为标准导航术语。B把glide slope误译为sliding way（下滑道是ILS固定术语glide slope，sliding way为臆造词），把ground guidance systems误译为landing navigation system（地面制导系统≠着陆导航系统）。C同样误译glide slope为sliding way，把ILS泛化为instrumental system（专名丢失），把ground guidance误译为ground lighting system（制导→照明，张冠李戴）。glide slope与ILS为固定术语，sliding way、instrumental system、ground lighting均为不规范替换。助航设备列举须全部使用规范缩写与专名。

question: 相关位置确定包括测距仪、应答机、无线电罗盘、罗兰、甚高频全向信标台、自动定向仪等部件。

options.A: Land navigation includes items such as DM, transponders, fluxgate compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.
options.B: Independent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, DF, etc.
options.C: Dependent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Dependent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.【词汇】Dependent Position Determining=相关（依赖性）位置确定（依赖地面台站定位），DME=测距仪，radio compass=无线电罗盘，LORAN=罗兰（远程导航系统），VOR=甚高频全向信标，ADF=自动定向仪。【解析】C正确：标题Dependent Position Determining对应"相关位置确定"，六项设备DME、transponders、radio compass、LORAN、VOR、ADF与题干完全对应。A把标题误译为Land navigation（陆地导航，定位类别错误），DME漏写为DM（缩写不完整），radio compass误译为fluxgate compass（磁通门罗盘是另一部件）。B把Dependent误译为Independent（依赖性定位→自主式定位，方向相反——依赖地面台的DME/VOR等正是dependent类），ADF误译为DF（自动定向仪规范缩写是ADF）。

question: 发动机功率控制系统可以控制主燃油控制器或调节器，包括涡轮螺旋桨发动机上螺旋桨调速器的控制装置。

options.A: The engine power control system manages and controls the main fuel control or synchronizer, which is inclusive of controls to the propeller modulator on a turboprop engine.
options.B: The engine power control system furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator, which includes controls to the propeller regulator on turbo-prop engines.
options.C: The engine power control system regulates and controls the main oil, coordinator and propeller regulator of a turboprop engine.

explanation: 【译文】The engine power control system furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator, which includes controls to the propeller regulator on turboprop engines.【词汇】furnishes a means of controlling=提供控制手段（可以控制），main fuel control=主燃油控制器，coordinator=调节器/协调器，propeller regulator/governor=螺旋桨调速器，turboprop=涡轮螺旋桨发动机。【解析】B正确："furnishes a means of controlling"对应"可以控制"（提供……的手段），"main fuel control or coordinator"对应"主燃油控制器或调节器"，propeller regulator对应"螺旋桨调速器"。A把coordinator误译为synchronizer（协调器≠同步器，部件术语错误），螺旋桨调速器误译为propeller modulator（调制器，部件错误）。C把"主燃油控制"误译为main oil（燃油fuel→滑油oil，介质完全错误），并把"到螺旋桨调速器的控制装置"压扁成"coordinator and propeller regulator"并列清单，控制指向关系丢失。

question: 涡轮发动机包括控制流经发动机空气流量的压气机引气系统、空气冷却系统、用于发动机防冰的热空气系统和发动机启动系统。

options.A: The turbo engine includes a compressor bleed system, air cooling system, hot air system, and engine starting system. The compressor bleed system can control the airflow through the engine, and the air cooling and hot air systems are used for engine anti-icing.
options.B: The turbo engine includes a compressor exhaust system for controlling the airflow through the engine, a cooling air system for engine icing, and an engine starting system.
options.C: The turbine engines include compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems, heated air systems for engine anti-icing, and engine starting systems.

explanation: 【译文】The turbine engines include compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems, heated air systems for engine anti-icing, and engine starting systems.【词汇】compressor bleed system=压气机引气系统，flow of air through the engine=流经发动机的空气流量，heated air system=热空气系统，engine anti-icing=发动机防冰，cooling air system=空气冷却系统。【解析】C正确：四个系统及修饰关系一一对应——bleed systems"used to control flow of air"对应"控制流经发动机空气流量"，"heated air systems for engine anti-icing"对应"用于发动机防冰的热空气系统"。A错把air cooling和hot air两个系统都归因于engine anti-icing（冷却系统的功能是散热而非防冰，功能归属张冠李戴）。B把compressor bleed误译为compressor exhaust（压气机引气→排气，气流方向相反），把"发动机防冰"误译为for engine icing（防冰→结冰，anti-丢失导致方向相反）。

question: 涡桨发动机控制装置包括到调节器或等效装置的连杆装置和控制装置，以及从调节器或等效装置到螺旋浆调速器、燃油控制组件的连杆装置和控制装置，或其他受控组件。

options.A: The turboprop engine controls include linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent and from the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit, or other units being controlled.
options.B: The control device of a turbojet engine includes a linkage mechanism and control device to a coordinator or equivalent device, as well as a linkage mechanism from a coordinator or equivalent device to a propeller governor, fuel control component, or other controlled components.
options.C: The turboprop engine controls include a coordinator or equivalent device, a linkage mechanism, a control device, a propeller governor, a fuel control component, or other controlled components.

explanation: 【译文】The turboprop engine controls include linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent, and from the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit, or other units being controlled.【词汇】linkages=连杆装置，coordinator or equivalent=调节器或等效装置，propeller governor=螺旋桨调速器，fuel control unit=燃油控制组件，units being controlled=受控组件。【解析】A正确：完整还原双向链路——"linkages and controls to the coordinator"对应"到调节器的连杆装置和控制装置"，"from the coordinator...to the propeller governor, fuel control unit, or other units"对应"从调节器到……"，to...from...方向清晰。B把turboprop误译为turbojet（涡桨→涡喷，发动机类型错误——涡喷没有螺旋桨调速器），其余结构尚可但机型已错。C把方向性连接结构压平为零部件罗列（coordinator、propeller governor等并列成清单），"到……从……到……"的控制链路含义全部丢失。涡桨controls的链路是'到调节器—从调节器到调速器/燃油组件'，A保链路，B错机型，C丢结构。

question: 动力装置是指包括发动机、进气道、安装架、整流罩、勺形进气口、整流罩盖板、冷却隔板等在内的整体动力组合。

options.A: The power plant refers to the overall power package, including engine, air intake, bracket, cowling, nacelle, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.
options.B: The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, scoops, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.
options.C: The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, nacelle caps, fairing flaps, cooling baffles, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, scoops, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.【词汇】power plant=动力装置，overall power package=整体动力组合，mount=安装架，scoops=勺形进气口/进气斗，cowl flaps=整流罩鱼鳞片/盖板，cooling baffles=冷却隔板。【解析】B正确：mount对应"安装架"，scoops对应"勺形进气口"（进气斗是scoop的规范译法），cowl flaps对应"整流罩盖板"，cooling baffles对应"冷却隔板"，七项组成无误。A把mount误译为bracket（支架，动力装置安装架规范术语是mount），把scoops误译为nacelle（发动机短舱，部件完全不同）。C把scoops误译为nacelle caps（短舱盖，臆造部件），把cowl flaps误译为fairing flaps（整流罩鱼鳞片误作整流包皮片，部件错位）。scoop为进气斗、mount为安装架，均属动力装置组成件的固定译名；A、C属部件错换。

question: "Maintenance Practices" which are a combination of servicing, removal/installation, adjustment/test, inspection/check, cleaning/painting, and approved repairs should follow the Troubleshooting Section.

options.A: "Maintenance Practices" include servicing, removal/installation, adjustment/test, inspection/check, cleaning/painting, and approved repairs. "Maintenance Practices" should obey the instructions of the Troubleshooting Section.
options.B: "Maintenance Practices" include servicing, removal/installation, adjustment/test, inspection/check, cleaning/painting, and approved repairs. "Maintenance Practices" should be located after the Troubleshooting Section.
options.C: "Maintenance Practices" include servicing, removal/installation, adjustment/test, inspection/check, cleaning/painting. And approved repairs should be located after the Troubleshooting Section.

explanation: 【译文】"Maintenance Practices" include servicing, removal/installation, adjustment/test, inspection/check, cleaning/painting, and approved repairs, and should be located after the Troubleshooting Section.【词汇】Maintenance Practices=维修实践（章节名），approved repairs=经批准的修理，follow=位于……之后（章节编排顺序义），Troubleshooting Section=故障排除部分，combination=组合。【解析】B正确：follow在手册编排语境中意为"排在……之后"而非"遵守"，"located after the Troubleshooting Section"准确传达章节顺序要求；列举组合完整含approved repairs。A把follow误译为obey the instructions（遵守指示）——A follows B在章节语境中指顺序排列，取错义项导致"维修实践要服从排故章节的指示"这种曲解。C把"and approved repairs"从列举组合中拆出独立成句（approved repairs本是combination的组成部分），破坏六项并列的完整性，逻辑层次错误。

question: The removal/installation portion shall state clearly the sequence of steps required to remove and reinstall a component or unit, along with precautions to be observed.

options.A: The removal/installation portion shall state clearly the sequence of steps required to remove and reinstall a component or unit. This portion shall also state precautions to be obeyed.
options.B: The removal/installation portion shall state clearly the sequence of steps required to remove and reinstall a component or unit. This portion shalln’t include precautions to be obeyed.
options.C: The removal/installation portion shall hardly state the sequence of steps required to move and reinstall a component or unit. This portion shall also include precautions to be watched.

explanation: 【译文】The removal/installation portion shall state clearly the sequence of steps required to remove and reinstall a component or unit, along with precautions to be observed.【词汇】sequence of steps=步骤顺序，reinstall=重新安装，precautions to be observed=应遵守的注意事项，along with=连同，component or unit=组件或部件。【解析】A正确：保留"state clearly""sequence of steps""remove and reinstall"主干，并以"This portion shall also state precautions"补足along with（同时要说明注意事项）的含义，两个信息点齐全。B把along with误译为"shalln't include"（不应包括注意事项），肯定变否定，含义完全相反。C把shall state clearly误译为shall hardly state（几乎不说明，hardly为否定副词，语义相反），把remove误译为move（拆卸→移动，词义错误），observed译作watched偏离"遵守"义项（observe precautions=遵守注意事项）。hardly为否定副词，'几乎不说明'与shall state clearly相反；obey/observe precautions才是遵守注意事项。precautions须译作注意事项且必须保留，B、C在包含关系上均错。

question: The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described as well as the location of the units.

options.A: The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described. The location of the units shouldn’t be described.
options.B: The function, operation and location of each unit in the system should be deleted.
options.C: The function, operation and location of each unit in the system should be described.

explanation: 【译文】The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described, as well as the location of the units.【词汇】function and operation=功能和工作，each unit=每个组件，as well as=以及/同时，location=位置，described=被描述。【解析】C正确："described"统一涵盖function、operation、location三个并列宾语，as well as表示"以及、同样也要"，语义完整无遗漏。A把后半句改成否定——"The location...shouldn't be described"（位置不应被描述），与as well as（位置同样应描述）方向相反，属于关键否定词错置。B把described误译为deleted（描述→删除，反义词替换），整句意思完全颠倒为三项都不应描述。as well as要求位置同样被描述，A在第二句加否定属关键错；B的deleted使整句反义。三项内容（功能、工作、位置）均在应描述之列，否定或删除均错。

question: The emergency procedures check list should be in concise, abbreviated form designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.

options.A: The emergency procedures check list should be in precise form. The list not only tells pilots which items to check, but also provides everything about operation details of systems.
options.B: The emergency procedures check list should be in complicated form. The list tells pilots which systems to be investigated. It also provides operation details of some systems.
options.C: The emergency procedures check list should be in brief form. The list tells pilots which items to be examined. It provides nothing about operation details of any system.

explanation: 【译文】The emergency procedures check list should be in brief form, designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.【词汇】concise, abbreviated form=简明、缩略形式，remind pilots of items to check=提醒飞行员检查项目，without providing details=不提供细节，operation of any system=任何系统的工作。【解析】C正确："brief form"对应"简明形式"（concise, abbreviated的同义改写），"items to be examined"对应检查项目，"provides nothing about operation details"对应"不提供任何系统操作细节"，肯定与否定要素都对。A把concise误译为precise（精确≠简明，词义错译），并用"not only...but also provides everything"把"不提供细节"反向译成"提供一切细节"。B把concise误译为complicated（简明→复杂，反义），"provides operation details"同样与without providing方向相反，"systems to be investigated"对items to check也偏。concise/abbreviated强调简而无细节，A、B既错形式形容词又错把without providing改成提供细节。检查单设计意图是提醒飞行员检查项目而非详述系统，without结构是关键。

question: These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crews.

options.A: These tests need no special equipment or facilities except those installed on the aircraft, and are like the tests performed by flight crews.
options.B: These tests need some special equipment or facilities that are not installed on the aircraft. And these tests are the same to the tests performed by flight crews.
options.C: These tests need special equipment or facilities that are installed on the aircraft, and are identical with the tests performed by flight crews.

explanation: 【译文】These tests require no special equipment or facilities other than that installed on the aircraft, and are comparable to the tests performed by the flight crews.【词汇】no...other than=除……之外不需要，installed on the aircraft=安装在飞机上的，comparable to=与……相当，flight crews=飞行机组，facilities=设施。【解析】A正确："no special equipment or facilities except those installed on the aircraft"以except还原no...other than结构，"like the tests performed by flight crews"对应comparable to（相当、类似）。B把no...other than误译为"need some special equipment...that are not installed"（需要使用未装机的专用设备），否定排除变成肯定需要，语义相反。C错改为"need special equipment...that are installed"（需要装机专用设备——原文是不需要任何专用设备，只需机上已有的），且把comparable拔高为identical（相当≠完全相同，程度过度）。no...other than意为'除机上已有的之外不需要'，B、C均把否定排除误作肯定需要；comparable≠identical。测试设备限制与可比性两个要点缺一不可。

question: In some cases, the Specification is used to prepare a Continuing Airworthiness Program for acceptance by an airworthiness authority other than FAA.

options.A: Sometimes, FAA and other airworthiness authority may accept the Continuing Airworthiness Program that uses the Specification.
options.B: Sometimes, we use the Specification to prepare a Continuing Airworthiness Program that will be accepted by non-FAA airworthiness authority.
options.C: Sometimes, during preparing a Continuing Airworthiness Program, using the Specification may be accepted by FAA and other airworthiness authority.

explanation: 【译文】Sometimes, the Specification is used to prepare a Continuing Airworthiness Program that will be accepted by a non-FAA airworthiness authority.【词汇】in some cases=在某些情况下/有时，acceptance by=被……接受，airworthiness authority=适航当局，other than FAA=FAA以外的（非FAA），Continuing Airworthiness Program=持续适航方案。【解析】B正确："use the Specification to prepare a CAP"以主动态改写被动态但语义一致，"non-FAA airworthiness authority"准确对应other than FAA——方案供FAA以外的适航当局接受。A把other than FAA误译为"FAA and other"（FAA和其他当局——other than是排除FAA，不是并列FAA，逻辑关系完全相反）。C语序混乱：把"规范被用来编制方案"错译成"编制过程中使用规范被FAA和其他当局接受"，主谓宾错位且同样把other than误作并列。other than为排除关系，A、C误作并列含FAA；主动态改写不改变'供非FAA当局接受'的核心语义。

question: The second method does not require pressurization of the pneumatic crossover manifold, but utilizes an external air source connected to the air charging valve manifold to pressurize the reservoirs for ground maintenance.

options.A: Pressurization of the pneumatic crossover manifold and use of an external air source connected to the air charging valve manifold to pressurize the reservoirs for ground maintenance is the second method.
options.B: You can use the second method to pressurize crossover manifold and use  an external air source connected to the air charging valve manifold to pressurize the reservoirs for ground maintenance.
options.C: The second method is that it is not necessary to pressurize the pneumatic crossover manifold but to use an external air source connected to the air charging valve manifold to pressurize the reservoirs for ground maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】The second method does not require pressurization of the pneumatic crossover manifold, but uses an external air source connected to the air charging valve manifold to pressurize the reservoirs for ground maintenance.【词汇】pressurization=增压，pneumatic crossover manifold=气压交输总管，external air source=外部气源，air charging valve=充气活门，reservoirs=储压罐，ground maintenance=地面维护。【解析】C正确："it is not necessary to pressurize...but to use..."完整保留does not require...but utilizes的否定加转折结构——不给交输总管增压，而是用外接气源给储压罐增压，"for ground maintenance"也保留。A把否定结构丢光——译成"给总管增压并使用外部气源是第二种方法"（does not require变成肯定执行，语义相反）。B同样把"不要求增压"误作"用第二种方法给总管增压"（丢失否定，增压对象也错——原文是给reservoirs增压而非manifold）。does not require...but utilizes是否定加替代结构——方法二的要点恰是不给总管增压而改用外源。

question: If one or more blades are missing, make an entry in the engine logbook.

options.A: If one or more blades are broken, make an entry in the engine logbook.
options.B: If one or more blades are in place , make an entry in the engine logbook.
options.C: If one or more blades are absent, make an entry in the engine logbook.

explanation: 【译文】If one or more blades are missing, make an entry in the engine logbook.【词汇】missing=缺失/丢失的，blade=叶片，make an entry=做记录/登记，engine logbook=发动机记录本。【解析】C正确：absent是missing的规范同义替换（缺失、不在位）。A把missing误译为broken（断裂≠缺失，损伤类型错误——叶片断裂可能导致缺失，但原文只说不在位）。B把missing误译为in place（在位，语义完全相反）。missing/absent指不在位，broken只表断裂、in place表在位，三词状态各异——C为唯一等值替换。missing的同义替换是本题唯一考点，后半句记录要求三项相同。发现叶片缺失必须在发动机记录本中登记，缺失数量一片及以上均须记录。

question: Adjust the potentiometer until you do not hear a hum from the loudspeaker.

options.A: If there is hum from the loudspeaker, don't adjust the potentiometer.
options.B: Adjust the potentiometer unless hear a hum from the loudspeaker .
options.C: Adjust the potentiometer until the loudspeaker no longer hums.

explanation: 【译文】Adjust the potentiometer until the loudspeaker no longer hums.【词汇】potentiometer=电位计，until=直到……为止，hum=嗡嗡声，loudspeaker=扬声器。【解析】C正确："until the loudspeaker no longer hums"准确对应"调节到听不到嗡嗡声为止"——until引导动作终止条件。A把until条件错改为if条件加否定指令（"有嗡嗡声就不要调节"），与"调节到无声为止"的操作逻辑相反。B用unless（除非）替换until，变成"除非听到嗡嗡声否则调节"，条件方向相反——原文是持续调节直到声音消失。until引导动作终点（调到无声为止），unless表除外条件，A的if否定句更把操作逻辑颠倒。调节方向是消除嗡嗡声而非停止调节，条件逻辑须判明。

question: The repair limits are not given because special equipment is necessary.

options.A: The repair limits are not permitted as special equipment is required.
options.B: The repair limits are not mentioned as special equipment is required.
options.C: The repair limits are not set as special equipment is required.

explanation: 【译文】The repair limits are not given because special equipment is necessary.【词汇】repair limits=修理限制/修理容限，given=给出/规定，special equipment=专用设备，necessary/required=必需的，because/as=因为。【解析】C正确："are not set"对应"未给出/未规定修理限制"——limits are given在手册语境中指限制值被规定，"as...is required"对应because引导的原因从句（因为需要专用设备所以未给出限制）。A把not given误译为not permitted（不被允许），把"因设备原因未规定"变成"被禁止给出"，主观禁止与客观未给是两回事（词义错译）。B把given误译为mentioned（提及≠给出）——"未提及"指手册没写，原文指没有规定该限制值，侧重点不同。

question: The operational test for the HFS-900D transceivers is a BITE test which does a check of the internal functions of the HF transceiver.

options.A: The operational test of HFS-900D transceivers is an internal functions check of the HF transceiver and it is a BITE test.
options.B: The BITE test for the HFS-900D transceivers is the operation test that does the inner check of the HF transceiver.
options.C: The check of the internal functions of the HF transceiver is a BITE test related to HFS-900D transceivers.

explanation: 【译文】The operational test for the HFS-900D transceivers is a BITE test which does a check of the internal functions of the HF transceiver.【词汇】operational test=操作测试/运转测试，BITE test=机内自检测试（Built-In Test Equipment），internal functions=内部功能，transceiver=收发机。【解析】A正确：保持原句主语operational test不变，"is an internal functions check...and it is a BITE test"两个表语齐全，"对HFS-900D收发机的操作测试是检查HF收发机内部功能的BITE测试"，信息无损。B把主客体颠倒——"The BITE test...is the operation test"（自检测试成了被定义项），原文是操作测试属于BITE测试，属种关系反转。C同样颠换主语——"内部功能检查是BITE测试"，丢失"操作测试"这一被定义主项，"related to"也模糊了等值定义关系。operational test是主项、BITE test是其属性，B、C主谓反转后定义关系全错。

question: To depressurize standby system, the hydraulic system A has to be depressurized to open the rudder hydraulic system selector valve, allowing hydraulic fluid flow to the lower rudder actuator.

options.A: As the depressurization of the alternate system, the hydraulic system A must be released to open the rudder hydraulic system selector valve and permit hydraulic fluid to flow to the rudder actuator below.
options.B: In order to depressurize standby system, the hydraulic system A must be depressurized to open the rudder hydraulic system selector valve and let hydraulic fluid flow to the lower rudder actuator.
options.C: Due to the depressurization of the alternate system, the hydraulic system A must be released to open the rudder hydraulic system selector valve and permit hydraulic fluid to flow to the bottom rudder actuator.

explanation: 【译文】To depressurize the standby system, hydraulic system A must be depressurized to open the rudder hydraulic system selector valve, allowing hydraulic fluid to flow to the lower rudder actuator.【词汇】depressurize=释压，standby system=备用系统，rudder hydraulic system selector valve=方向舵液压系统选择活门，lower rudder actuator=下部方向舵作动器，allowing=从而允许。【解析】B正确："In order to depressurize standby system"准确对应目的状语To depressurize standby system，"must be depressurized"保留原词，"lower rudder actuator"对应"下部方向舵作动器"，全句近乎等值改写。A把表目的的To误译为As（随着/由于——目的变伴随或原因，逻辑关系错误），depressurized弱化为released，"rudder actuator below"语序不当。C把目的状语误译为"Due to the depressurization"（由于释压——目的变原因，因果方向相反），standby误译为alternate（备用系统是standby），depressurized误为released，lower误为bottom。目的状语与词形保留是B胜出的关键；A的As、C的Due to均把目的误作原因，因果相反。

question: Revisions are to be made consistent with the format of the specification using the provisions of FAR 21.50 as a basis.

options.A: By using the basic provisions of FAR 21.50, revisions become consistent with the format of the specification.
options.B: FAR 21.50 provisions are the basic to the revisions which are consistent with the format of the specification.
options.C: To make revisions consistent with the format of the specification, the provisions of FAR 21.50 should be adopted as a basis.

explanation: 【译文】To make revisions consistent with the format of the specification, the provisions of FAR 21.50 should be adopted as a basis.【词汇】consistent with=与……一致，provisions=条款，as a basis=作为依据，FAR 21.50=联邦航空条例第21.50条，revisions=修订。【解析】C正确：把using the provisions of FAR 21.50 as a basis还原为"the provisions...should be adopted as a basis"——以FAR 21.50条款为依据进行修订使其与规范格式一致，"To make revisions consistent"保留目的关系。A把as a basis（作为依据）错析为basic provisions（基本条款），basis从状语降为定语，"依据"的工具格含义变成"基本"修饰，语义偏移。B把"are the basic"与as a basis混淆，语法残破（the basic to用法错误），同样未体现"作为依据"的关系，become consistent对are to be made consistent也不规范。as a basis是工具状语非定语，A、B把basis与basic混淆；C的adopted as a basis准确还原。FAR条款为修订依据，三个选项对依据关系的处理是判分点。

question: The Emergency Procedures check list should be limited to the minimum number of items determined to be essential to aid the pilot in an emergency.

options.A: The items in the Emergency Procedures check list are determined to be essential in aid of the pilot in an emergency and should be limited to the minimum number.
options.B: A limited number of items in the Emergency Procedures check list are determined to be essential to aid the pilot in an emergency.
options.C: To aid the pilot in an emergency, it is determined that the Emergency Procedures check list should contain only essential items.

explanation: 【译文】The items in the Emergency Procedures check list determined to be essential to aid the pilot in an emergency should be limited to the minimum number.【词汇】be limited to=限于，minimum number=最少数量，determined to be essential=确定为必需的，aid the pilot=帮助飞行员，check list=检查单。【解析】A正确：保留两个要点——"items are determined to be essential"（确定为必需的项目）和"should be limited to the minimum number"（数量应限到最少），规范性要求完整。B丢失"should be limited to the minimum"的强制性要求，只剩"a limited number of items are determined to be essential"（有限数量的项目被确定为必需），把"应限到最少"的指令弱化为现状描述。C把minimum number简化为"only essential items"（只含必需项目），丢失"最少数量"这一量化限制标准，且it is determined改变了determined作定语的限定关系。limited to the minimum number强调'限到最少'的强制量限，B、C都弱化了该规范要求。

question: Utilizing an airplane as intended by the manufacturer, combined with sound inspection and maintenance practices, forms the basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.

options.A: The basis for assuring an airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate is to combine the manufacturer's requirements with sound inspection and maintenance practices.
options.B: To ensure airworthiness and safe operation of an airplane, it is essential to follow the manufacturer's instructions in the utilization of airplane, and perform sound inspection and maintenance practices as well.
options.C: Airworthiness and safe operation are fundamental to aircraft utilization as required by  the manufacturer,  so sound inspection and maintenance practices are carried out.

explanation: 【译文】To ensure that the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate, it is essential to utilize the airplane as the manufacturer intended and to apply sound inspection and maintenance practices.【词汇】utilize an airplane as intended by the manufacturer=按制造商意图使用飞机，combined with=结合，sound inspection and maintenance practices=完善的检查和维修实践，forms the basis=构成基础，airworthy=适航的。【解析】B正确："follow the manufacturer's instructions in the utilization of airplane"对应"按制造商意图使用飞机"，"and perform sound inspection and maintenance practices as well"对应combined with结构，"essential"传达basis含义，两要素并重。A丢失"使用飞机"这一核心主体——译成"把制造商的要求与实践相结合"，原文被结合的是"对飞机的规范使用"这一行为（漏译utilizing an airplane）。C因果倒置：把"规范使用+良好维修实践构成适航安全的基础"错译成"适航安全是使用的基础"，主客体完全颠倒，so引出的结论关系错误。

question: The main objective is to show how to maximize ground miles per gallon by careful flight planning and attention to good operating procedures.

options.A: Explaining how to obtain the maximum ground miles per gallon through careful flight planning and attention to good operating procedures is the primary content.
options.B: Display how to achieve the main objective to get the greater ground miles per gallon by careful flight planning and attention to good operating procedures.
options.C: The principal purpose is to show how to increases the ground miles per gallon as much as possible with careful flight planning and attention to good operating procedures.

explanation: 【译文】The main objective is to show how to maximize ground miles per gallon through careful flight planning and attention to good operating procedures.【词汇】main objective=主要目的，maximize=使最大化，ground miles per gallon=每加仑地面英里数（燃油经济性），careful flight planning=细致的飞行计划，attention to good operating procedures=注意良好操作程序。【解析】A正确：完整保留"obtain the maximum ground miles per gallon""careful flight planning""attention to good operating procedures"全部要点，语法正确；"primary content"对main objective略有偏移（objective更准译法为purpose/aim），但信息量最全。B句式残缺——"Display how to achieve the main objective to get..."改成祈使句且objective嵌套错位，把maximize弱化为greater（更大≠最大）。C结构最贴近原文（principal purpose对应main objective），但有语法硬伤"how to increases"（to后应用原形increase），规范性受损，综合比较取A。A、C取舍说明：C结构虽贴近但语法有误，A语义完整且语法正确，故取A为最佳。

question: Open communication should exist with the operator telling the manufacturer as soon as some new kind of situation arises and the manufacturer responding back with solid help to the operator.

options.A: When some new kind of situation occurs, the operator should communicate openly with the manufacturer. The manufacturer should supply the operator solid assistance.
options.B: When the new situation gets worse, it should build the open communication between the operator and manufacturer. The operator claims the situation to get the feedback from the manufacturer.
options.C: When something new happens, open interconnection should exist between the manufacturer and the operator. The operator should report to the manufacturer to obtain effective discount.

explanation: 【译文】When some new kind of situation arises, the operator should communicate openly with the manufacturer, and the manufacturer should respond with solid help to the operator.【词汇】open communication=坦诚/开放的沟通，as soon as...arises=一出现……就，responding back=回应，solid help=切实帮助，operator=运营人。【解析】A正确："communicate openly"对应open communication，"some new kind of situation occurs"对应arises，"supply the operator solid assistance"对应solid help，双向沟通关系完整。B添加"gets worse"（情况恶化，原文无此意——增译改变情形性质），把"responding back with solid help"误译为"claims the situation to get the feedback"（索取反馈≠提供切实帮助，行为方向相反）。C把solid help误译为"effective discount"（切实帮助→有效折扣，help被错解为商业折扣，张冠李戴），open interconnection对communication偏技术化。solid help是制造商向运营人提供切实帮助，B、C把受助方向与help含义均弄反。沟通是双向的——运营人报告、制造商回助，要素须双向对应。

question: These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crews.

options.A: These tests should only use the equipment or facilities installed on the aircraft. These tests should be able to perform by the flight crews.
options.B: These tests should not use the special equipment or facilities that are not installed on the aircraft. These tests should be similar to the tests performed by the flight crews.
options.C: These tests should require the equipment or facilities installed on the aircraft rather than the special ones and should be replaceable by the tests accomplished by the flight crews.

explanation: 【译文】These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that installed on the aircraft, and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crews.【词汇】no...other than=除……之外不需要，installed on the aircraft=安装在飞机上的，comparable to=与……相当/类似，flight crews=飞行机组，similar to=类似于。【解析】B正确："not use the special equipment...not installed on the aircraft"以双重否定还原no...other than结构（不使用机上未装的专用设备），"similar to"对应comparable to，两个分句语义都对。A把comparable to the tests performed by the flight crews误译为"be able to perform by the flight crews"（能被机组执行），既有语法错误（应为be performed）又把"与机组所做测试相当"错解为"由机组来做测试"。C把comparable误译为replaceable（可替代≠相当，词义错译），把no...other than错解为"用机上设备而非专用设备"的取舍关系。no...other than的双重否定结构最易误判；A的主被动错误与C的replaceable词义错误均致命。

question: It is intended that manufacturers retain and exercise reasonable judgement and latitude in the content of their publications with respect to depth and scope of coverage.

options.A: Manufacturers would like to reserve and exercise the right to make reasonable judgments about the depth and scope of the contents of their publications.
options.B: Manufacturers are requested to reserve and exercise the right to judge contents of their publications of reasonable depth and scope.
options.C: Manufacturers are required to reserve the right of sound judgment on the contents of their publications by the bureau.

explanation: 【译文】Manufacturers are intended to retain and exercise reasonable judgment and latitude regarding the depth and scope of coverage in the content of their publications.【词汇】it is intended that=旨在/希望，retain and exercise=保留并行使用，reasonable judgment and latitude=合理的判断和灵活度，depth and scope of coverage=覆盖的深度和范围，publications=出版物。【解析】A正确："reserve and exercise the right to make reasonable judgments"对应retain and exercise reasonable judgement，"depth and scope of the contents"对应with respect to depth and scope of coverage，intended的语气也保留。B漏译latitude（灵活度/自由度这一关键概念），且"judge contents of their publications of reasonable depth and scope"把深度范围错挂成contents的属性（修饰关系错位——原文是对覆盖深度范围行使用判断）。C把"It is intended"误译为"are required"（被强制要求，期望语气变成强制命令），添加"by the bureau"无中生有，latitude同样漏译。latitude（裁量余地）是关键词，B、C均漏；intended表期望而非强制，C的required升级语气。出版物内容的深度与范围归制造商裁量，主体与权限均须对应。

question: For simplicity of presentation and understandability, complex systems should be divided into system-function rather than overall master wiring diagrams. Interconnects to other systems should be plainly noted.

options.A: To simplify the overall master wiring diagram to make it easy to understand, complex systems should be described in terms of functional interconnections.
options.B: The overall master wiring diagrams are too complex to be understandable, so the presentation of the systems shall be simplified and the interconnections should be plainly noted.
options.C: To make the wiring diagrams simplified and understandable, the complex systems should be described in system-functions. The connection of each system shall be presented clearly.

explanation: 【译文】To simplify presentation and improve understandability, complex systems should be divided into system-function diagrams rather than overall master wiring diagrams, and interconnects to other systems should be plainly noted.【词汇】for simplicity and understandability=为简明易懂，divided into=划分为，system-function=系统-功能（图），rather than=而非，interconnects plainly noted=清楚标注交联关系，master wiring diagrams=总布线图。【解析】C正确："described in system-functions"对应divided into system-function diagrams（按系统-功能划分而非画总图），"connection of each system shall be presented clearly"对应Interconnects plainly noted，两句要素齐全。A把"应划分为系统功能图而非总布线图"误译为"简化总布线图"（rather than的取舍关系丢失——恰恰是不画总图），且第二句完全漏译。B把目的状语误译为原因判断"too complex to be understandable"（太复杂看不懂——原文是为简明而划分），同样漏掉system-function核心概念。rather than表取舍——用系统功能图替代总布线图，A、B均未传达该核心取舍关系。

question: The wording given in the approved examples is not mandatory. It shows only one method to write the same information with approved words. You can frequently use different constructions with other approved words to say the same thing.

options.A: The wording given in the approved example is of a suggested nature. It only represents approved words for writing the same information. You can express the same thing with different constructions and other approved words.
options.B: It is necessary to use these terms in the approved example sentences to write standard information. You can choose what to express and how to express it from the approved structure
options.C: The wording must be approved to indicate that the information should be written to the same standard and you can often use similar structures and words to describe the same thing.

explanation: 【译文】The wording given in the approved examples is of a suggested nature, showing only one method to write the same information with approved words; different constructions with other approved words can frequently be used to say the same thing.【词汇】not mandatory=非强制性的，approved examples=批准的示例，approved words=批准的词（规范用词），different constructions=不同的句式结构，one method=一种方法。【解析】A正确："of a suggested nature"准确对应not mandatory（建议性而非强制性），"only represents approved words"对应"仅用批准词表示一种写法"，"different constructions and other approved words"对应末句"可以用不同句式和其他批准词表达同一意思"。B把not mandatory误译为"It is necessary to use"（必须使用，非强制变成强制，方向相反），"choose what to express"偏离"同义换说"的原意。C把not mandatory误译为"The wording must be approved"（否定变肯定），"similar structures and words"丢失approved限定，"to the same standard"曲解one method的含义。not mandatory是核心否定，A以suggested nature准确转述；B、C的necessary/must属方向相反。示例措辞仅示例一种写法，可用其他批准句式表达同一信息。

question: Get the correct tools to open the containers for these materials.If you do not obey these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.

options.A: Use the correct tools to open the containers for these materials.If you do not follow these prerequisites, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.
options.B: Get the corrective tools to open the containers for these materials.If you do not obey these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.
options.C: Get the proper tools to open the containers for these materials.If you do not observe these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.

explanation: 【译文】Get the proper tools to open the containers for these materials. If you do not observe these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.【词汇】correct/proper tools=正确的工具，obey/observe precautions=遵守预防措施，containers=容器，materials=材料，injury to skin and lungs=对皮肤和肺部的伤害。【解析】C正确："proper tools"是correct tools的规范同义替换，"observe these precautions"是obey precautions的规范搭配（observe/follow/obey precautions均为固定用法），"injury to your skin and lungs"原样保留。A把precautions误译为prerequisites（先决条件≠预防措施——precaution是安全预防措施，prerequisite是前提条件，形近词干扰）。B把correct误译为corrective（correct tools是合适的工具，corrective tools是矫正/纠正用的工具，词义错误），后半句虽对但整体失效。correct/proper、obey/observe均为规范同义对；prerequisites与corrective是形近词陷阱。两句为安全指令，工具正确性与遵守预防措施须同时保留。

question: Procedures for handling malfunctions or other abnormalities that are not of emergency nature, or involve a potential emergency that may be deferred may be included in this Section.

options.A: Procedures for handling malfunctions or other abnormalities that are not  emergent, or potentially emergent may be delayed in this section.
options.B: This Section may cover procedures for handling malfunctions or other deviations that are not of emergency nature, or involve a potential emergency that may be handled later.
options.C: This Section may cover procedures for handling malfunctions or other deviations that are not emergent, or involve a potential emergency that may be deterred.

explanation: 【译文】This Section may include procedures for handling malfunctions or other abnormalities that are not of an emergency nature, or that involve a potential emergency which may be deferred.【词汇】not of emergency nature=非应急性质，potential emergency=潜在应急情况，may be deferred=可推迟处理，malfunctions=故障，abnormalities/deviations=异常情况。【解析】B正确："may cover"对应may be included in this Section，"handled later"对应may be deferred（推迟处理），"not of emergency nature"原样保留——非应急或潜在应急但可推迟的程序可纳入本节。A两处错误：把"may be included"（可纳入本节）误译为"may be delayed in this section"（在本节中被推迟——included错成delayed，且推迟的是应急处理不是程序），"not emergent, or potentially emergent"丢失potential的限定层级。C把deferred误译为deterred（推迟处理≠被制止/吓阻，形近词错译）。deferred指可推迟处理，deterred指被吓阻；A更把included错作delayed，谓语全错。可纳入的程序范围包含非应急与可推迟的潜在应急两类。

question: The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III and the necessary information has been included in the Objectives.

options.A: The Preface has been neglected in the sample CAP in Section III and the necessary information has  resumed in the Objectives.
options.B: The Preface has been deleted in the sample CAP in Section III and the necessary information has been excluded in the Objectives.
options.C: The Preface has been canceled in the sample CAP in Section III and the necessary information has been covered in the Objectives.

explanation: 【译文】The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III, and the necessary information has been included in the Objectives.【词汇】omitted=省略/删去，sample CAP=示例持续适航方案，included/covered=纳入/涵盖，Objectives=目标（章节），Preface=前言。【解析】C正确："canceled"≈omitted（删去，可接受的同义替换），"has been covered in the Objectives"对应has been included——前言省略后其必要信息被纳入目标部分。A后半句把included误译为"has resumed in"（已在目标中恢复，resume指中断后继续，词义错译），neglected对omitted也带贬义偏差（omitted是编辑删去不是疏忽）。B把included误译为"has been excluded"（被排除在外，方向完全相反——原文是信息被纳入Objectives而非被排除）。omitted→canceled与included→covered是两组近义对应；B的excluded反义致命。omitted与included是一省一纳的对应关系，须分别核对。

question: If you push the LSK that is adjacent to EXIT, then the BITE will take you out of BITE test and put the airplane back to its usual condition.

options.A: After pressing the LSK next to EXIT, the BITE will take you out of BITE test and the airplane will return to its normal condition.
options.B: The BITE will continue the BITE test and the airplane will go back to its usual condition when you push the LSK next to EXIT.
options.C: The BITE will proceed the BITE test and the airplane will go back to its normal configuration after releasing the LSK that is adjacent to EXIT.

explanation: 【译文】After pressing the LSK adjacent to EXIT, the BITE will take you out of the BITE test and put the airplane back to its usual condition.【词汇】LSK=行选键（Line Select Key），adjacent to=紧邻，take you out of=退出，put back to usual condition=恢复到正常状态，BITE=机内自检。【解析】A正确："pressing the LSK next to EXIT"对应push the LSK adjacent to EXIT，"take you out of BITE test"对应退出自检测试，"return to its normal condition"对应usual condition——按下行选键后退出测试并恢复常态。B把take you out of误译为"continue the BITE test"（退出→继续，方向完全相反——按EXIT键是退出自检）。C同样误译为"proceed the BITE test"（继续进行），且把push（按下）误译为"after releasing"（松开后，动作时序相反），"normal configuration"对condition可接受但已整体失真。EXIT旁行选键的功能是退出测试，B、C的continue/proceed与之相反，release对push亦反。BITE测试退出后飞机恢复正常，条件与结果须顺序对应。

question: Differences in the fuel/water sample and the ability of the detection kits to consistently measure the level of microbial growth make it important to retest and verify test results.

options.A: Retesting and reviewing test results are optional due to discrepancies in the fuel/water sample and the ability of the detection kits to continuously measure the level of microbial growth.
options.B: It is very important to do the test again and confirm test results because of differences in the fuel/water sample and the ability of the detection kits to continuously measure the level of microbial growth.
options.C: It is mandatory to retest and evaluate test results to make sure the differences in the fuel/water sample and the ability of the detection kits to witness the level of microbial growth.

explanation: 【译文】It is important to retest and verify test results because of differences in the fuel/water sample and the ability of the detection kits to consistently measure the level of microbial growth.【词汇】make it important=使……变得重要，retest=重新检测，verify=核实/确认，consistently measure=稳定地测量，microbial growth=微生物滋生，detection kits=检测套件。【解析】B正确："do the test again and confirm test results"对应retest and verify，"very important"对应important，原因状语（样品差异和检测套件测量能力）完整——正因为这些差异才需要复检核实。A把important误译为optional（可选的，重要性变成可有可无，方向相反），verify译作reviewing（复核）语气偏弱，consistently译作continuously尚可。C把important拔高为mandatory（强制的，程度过度——important不等于mandatory），verify误译为evaluate（评估≠核实），measure误译为witness（见证≠测量），"to make sure the differences"句式残缺。important介于optional与mandatory之间，A过弱C过强；verify为核实结果而非评估。

question: Move the IDG forward until the input shaft is free of the accessory gearbox and QAD ring, then move the IDG outboard and away from the power plant.

options.A: Move the IDG forward and outboard until it is away from the accessory gearbox, QAD ring and power plant.
options.B: Move the IDG towards the forward position until the input shaft is away from the accessary gearbox and QAD ring, then move the IDG towards outboard and free of the power plant.
options.C: After moving the IDG towards the forward position, then it is free of the accessary gearbox, QAD and the power plant.

explanation: 【译文】Move the IDG forward until the input shaft is free of the accessory gearbox and QAD ring, then move the IDG outboard and away from the power plant.【词汇】IDG=整体驱动发电机，input shaft=输入轴，free of=脱离，accessory gearbox=附件齿轮箱，QAD ring=快卸环，outboard=向外侧，power plant=动力装置。【解析】B正确：还原两个连续动作——先向前移动到输入轴脱离附件齿轮箱和QAD环（until条件），再向外侧移动远离动力装置，"towards outboard and free of the power plant"对应outboard and away。A把两步压缩为同时动作"forward and outboard"（向前且向外一起移），丢失"until输入轴脱离后再向外"的先后操作顺序——维修步骤顺序是关键。C把"then move...away from the power plant"漏译大半，且把until条件误作结果状态"then it is free of...the power plant"（脱离对象错挂到动力装置上，原文先脱离齿轮箱再离开动力装置）。

question: They include the tail assembly ,the structures at the rear of the airplane that serve to control and maneuver the aircraft and structures forming part of and attached to the wing.

options.A: They comprise the three parts as follows:tail assembly,the structures at the rear of the airplane ,structures forming part of and attached to the wing.
options.B: They include three parts,one of them is tail assembly,one of them is the structures part at the rear of the airplane,one of them is structures part that forming part of and attached to the wing.
options.C: They include two parts,one of them is tail assembly  at the rear of the airplane that serve to control and maneuver the aircraft,another of them is structures part that forming part of and attached to the wing.

explanation: 【译文】They include two parts: one is the tail assembly—the structures at the rear of the airplane that serve to control and maneuver the aircraft; the other is the structures forming part of and attached to the wing.【词汇】tail assembly=尾翼组件，serve to control and maneuver=用于操纵和控制，forming part of and attached to the wing=构成机翼一部分并连接于机翼的，rear=后部。【解析】C正确：正确解析句子层次——"the tail assembly"与"the structures at the rear of the airplane"是同位关系（尾翼组件即机尾用于控制操纵的结构），故共两大部分而非三个独立项，"serve to control and maneuver"对应"用于控制操纵"。A把同位语误读为并列，数出"three parts"（三部分，层次划分错误——rear structures是tail assembly的解释而非独立第三项）。B同样误判为三部分，"one of them is..."的罗列堆叠未识别同位关系，结构层次全错。同位结构识别是关键——tail assembly即后部操纵结构，故为两部分；三部分属层次误读。

question: The auxiliary battery and auxiliary battery charger connects in parallel with the main battery during non-normal conditions to help supply power.

options.A: The auxiliary battery and auxiliary battery charger and the main battery connect together during non-normal conditions to help supply power.
options.B: In normal conditions,the auxiliary battery and auxiliary battery charger should be disconnected.
options.C: In non-normal conditions,the auxiliary battery and auxiliary battry charger should be disconnected.

explanation: 【译文】The auxiliary battery and auxiliary battery charger are connected in parallel with the main battery during non-normal conditions to help supply power.【词汇】auxiliary battery=辅助电瓶，battery charger=电瓶充电器，in parallel=并联，non-normal conditions=非正常状况，main battery=主电瓶，supply power=供电。【解析】A正确："connect together"概括connects in parallel with the main battery（辅助电瓶及充电器与主电瓶并联接通），"during non-normal conditions to help supply power"完整保留——非正常状况下并联辅助供电。B两处错误：把non-normal误译为normal（非正常→正常，否定丢失），把connect误译为disconnected（连接→断开，方向完全相反）。C把connects in parallel误译为should be disconnected（并联接通→应断开，方向相反——原文是非正常时接通辅助电源），"battry"为拼写瑕疵。in parallel为并联，disconnected方向相反；non-normal条件不能丢non-。辅助电瓶系统在非正常时并联供电，连接状态与时机是考点。

question: An “emergency” however, almost always involves a failure that requires immediate and rapid response, such as a total powerplant failure, fire or smoke, or rapid cabin decompression.

options.A: However, an “emergency” almost always entails a failure that requires to respond immediately and rapidly, for example, the situations that a total powerplant fails, the fire or smoke occurs, or the cabin are depressurized rapidly.
options.B: An “emergency” however, almost always causes a malfunction that requests immediate and rapid response, such as the whole powerplant failure, fire or smoke, or rapid cabin pressurization.
options.C: However, an “emergency” is often related to a failure that demands respond simultaneously, such as the complete failure of the powerplant, fire or smoke, or rapid cabin warming.

explanation: 【译文】However, an "emergency" almost always involves a failure that requires immediate and rapid response, such as a total powerplant failure, fire or smoke, or rapid cabin decompression.【词汇】involves/entails=涉及/意味着，immediate and rapid response=立即快速响应，total powerplant failure=动力装置完全失效，rapid cabin decompression=座舱快速释压，emergency=应急情况。【解析】A正确："entails"≈involves（必然涉及），"requires to respond immediately and rapidly"对应immediate and rapid response，三个例子含depressurized（释压）均正确——紧急情况几乎总意味着需要立即响应的失效。B把involves误译为causes（涉及→导致，逻辑关系改变——应急是包含失效而非导致失效），把decompression误译为pressurization（释压→增压，方向相反），requests用语不规范。C把immediate and rapid误译为simultaneously（同时≠迅速立即），把decompression误译为cabin warming（释压→座舱加温，完全张冠李戴），"often"对almost always程度偏弱。decompression/pressurization、involves/causes、immediate/simultaneously是三组判题关键。

question: Where possible, examples, associated conditions and technique should be presented on the same page as the chart. If space is not sufficient to include the necessary information, then the page facing the chart should be used.

options.A: Present the examples, associated conditions and technique on the possible page of the chart and use the page including the chart to concise the necessary information if the space is insufficient.
options.B: Present the chart, examples, associated conditions and technique on the same page if possible and use the page facing the chart if the space is insufficient for the necessary information.
options.C: Try to place the examples, associated conditions and technique on the same page as the chart if possible and use another page including the chart to describe the necessary information when the space is not sufficient.

explanation: 【译文】Where possible, the examples, associated conditions and technique should be presented on the same page as the chart; if space is insufficient, the page facing the chart should be used.【词汇】where possible=如有可能，associated conditions=相关条件，on the same page as=与……在同一页，the page facing the chart=图表对开的页面，space is not sufficient=空间不足。【解析】B正确："on the same page if possible"对应Where possible的条件，"the page facing the chart"准确对应原文对开页含义（放不下时用图表对面页），"space is insufficient"对应If space is not sufficient。A把Where possible误译为"on the possible page"（可能的页面，possible修饰对象错乱——原文是"在可能的情况下"），把facing page误译为"the page including the chart"（恰是原文要避免的同一页），"to concise"语法错误。C把the page facing the chart误译为"another page including the chart"（另一含图表的页，对开页关系丢失——应为图表对面的空白页）。facing page是图表对面页而非同一页或另一含图页——排版方位是本题考点。

question: The trailing edge flaps up limit switch sends flap position data to SMYD1.The SMYD1 uses this during yaw damping to limit rudder movement when flaps are up.

options.A: The SMYD1 will limit rudder movement when flaps are up if trailing edge flaps receive data from up limit switch of SMYD1 during yaw damping.
options.B: The SMYD1 will limit rudder movement after receiving data from up limit switch of trailing edge flaps during yaw damping when flaps are up.
options.C: The SMYD1 will limit yaw damping to reduce rudder movement when flaps are up If trailing edge flaps receive data from up limit switch of SMYD1.

explanation: 【译文】The SMYD1 receives flap position data from the trailing-edge-flaps up-limit switch and uses it during yaw damping to limit rudder movement when the flaps are up.【词汇】trailing edge flaps=后缘襟翼，up limit switch=收上位限制电门，flap position data=襟翼位置数据，yaw damping=偏航阻尼，rudder movement=方向舵运动，SMYD=失速管理偏航阻尼器。【解析】B正确：数据流向正确——限位电门把襟翼位置数据发给SMYD1（receiving data from up limit switch of trailing edge flaps），SMYD1在偏航阻尼中、襟翼收上时限制方向舵运动，因果关系与原文一致。A把数据流向反转——"trailing edge flaps receive data from up limit switch of SMYD1"（襟翼从SMYD1的电门收数据，方向相反，且电门属于襟翼不属于SMYD1）。C除同样的流向反转外，还把limit rudder movement during yaw damping误译为"limit yaw damping to reduce rudder movement"（限制对象由方向舵错换为偏航阻尼）。数据自电门流向SMYD1是判题核心，A、C流向反转；C还把限制对象错成偏航阻尼本身。

question: The mach trim actuator also causes the elevator to be in a more nose down position during takeoff which allows the pilots to move the stabilizer to a more nose up position.

options.A: Pilots have more opportunity to move stabilizer to nose up position during takeoff thanks to the mach trim actuator who commands elevator to a more nose down position.
options.B: During takeoff, pilots have more opportunity to move elevator to nose up position  thanks to the mach trim actuator who commands stabilizer to a more nose down position.
options.C: During takeoff, pilots have more opportunity to move elevator to nose down position  thanks to the mach trim actuator who commands stabilizer to a more nose up position.

explanation: 【译文】The mach trim actuator also drives the elevator to a more nose-down position during takeoff, which allows the pilots to move the stabilizer to a more nose-up position.【词汇】mach trim actuator=马赫配平作动器，elevator=升降舵，nose down=低头位置，stabilizer=水平安定面，nose up=抬头位置，during takeoff=起飞期间。【解析】A正确：作用链与原文一致——作动器使elevator更低头（commands elevator to a more nose down position），从而让飞行员能把stabilizer移向更抬头位置，两个操纵面的角色和方向都对。B把两个操纵面角色互换——"move elevator to nose up""commands stabilizer to nose down"，飞行员动的是安定面不是升降舵，升降舵与安定面张冠李戴。C方向与角色全错——飞行员move elevator to nose down、作动器commands stabilizer to nose up，两个面的操纵对象和俯仰方向均与原文相反。作动器动elevator（低头）、飞行员动stabilizer（抬头），B、C角色与方向互换。

question: The purpose of the autopilot actuator is to change electrical commands from the FCC into a hydraulically controlled mechanical output.The outputs of the actuators become inputs to the aileron and the elevator power control units(PCU).

options.A: The actuator receives a hydraulically controlled mechanical command from FCC who sends an electrical commands and the aileron and the elevator power control units(PCU) will carry out this command.
options.B:
FCC sends an electrical order to autopilot actuator. The actuator converts it to a hydraulically controlled mechanical command.
The aileron and the elevator power control units(PCU) will carry out this command.
options.C:
FCC sends an electrical commands to autopilot actuator. The actuator receive it to a hydraulically controlled unit .
The aileron and the elevator power control units(PCU) will carry out this command from hydraulically controlled unit.

explanation: 【译文】The purpose of the autopilot actuator is to convert the electrical commands from the FCC into a hydraulically controlled mechanical output, whose outputs become inputs to the aileron and elevator power control units (PCU).【词汇】autopilot actuator=自动驾驶作动器，FCC=飞行控制计算机，electrical commands=电指令，hydraulically controlled mechanical output=液压控制的机械输出，power control unit (PCU)=动力控制组件，aileron=副翼。【解析】B正确："FCC sends an electrical order""converts it to a hydraulically controlled mechanical command"对应"把FCC的电指令转换成液压控制的机械输出"，PCU执行指令对应输出成为副翼和升降舵PCU的输入，信号链完整。A把信号性质弄反——"receives a hydraulically controlled mechanical command from FCC"（FCC发出的是电指令而非液压机械指令，输入输出信号类型混淆）。C把mechanical output误译为"a hydraulically controlled unit"（机械输出信号变成液压控制组件，输出物变成设备本身），"receive it to"语法错误。电指令进、液压机械输出出，A把输入信号类型弄错；C把output错成unit。

question: This is the minimum concentration of flammable vapors in air below which propagation of flame does not occur on contact with a source of ignition.

options.A: This is the maximum portion of flammable vapors in air. If the portion is bigger, when an ignition source touched the gas, it would cause the fire to be diffused.
options.B: This is the minimum volume of flammable vapors. If the volume is lower, when the gas contacted with an ignition source, the fire would not come out.
options.C: This is the minimum density of flammable vapors in air. If the density was lower, when an ignition source touched the gas, it would not cause the spread of flame.

explanation: 【译文】This is the minimum concentration of flammable vapors in air below which flame propagation does not occur upon contact with an ignition source.【词汇】minimum concentration=最低浓度（可燃下限lower flammable limit），flammable vapors=可燃蒸气，propagation of flame=火焰传播，source of ignition=点火源，below which=低于该值时。【解析】C正确："minimum density"是三选项中最贴近concentration的表述（浓度以密度度量），"would not cause the spread of flame"对应propagation does not occur，below which的临界条件译作"If the density was lower"，定义结构完整。A两处错误：把minimum误译为maximum（最低→最高，可燃下限变成上限，方向相反），"portion"对concentration也不准确。B把concentration误译为volume（浓度→体积，物理量错误），"the fire would not come out"（火出不来）为口语化失真表述——propagation是火焰传播蔓延。minimum concentration是燃爆下限，A的最高值方向相反，B的volume物理量错误。低于下限浓度遇火源不传播——定义要件为'最低'与'不传播'。

question: This data sheet prescribes conditions and limitations under which the product for which the type certificate was issued meets the airworthiness requirements.

options.A: This data sheet defines that the product, published by the type certificate, satisfies the airworthiness necessities complying with the conditions and limitations.
options.B: The product, for which the type certificate was approved, should reach the airworthiness requirements within conditions and limitations stipulating by this data sheet.
options.C: This data sheet regulates conditions and limitations of the airworthiness demands that the product, which has the qualified type certificate, should fulfill.

explanation: 【译文】This data sheet prescribes the conditions and limitations under which the product for which the type certificate was issued meets the airworthiness requirements.【词汇】data sheet=数据单，prescribes=规定，type certificate=型号合格证，meets the airworthiness requirements=满足适航要求，conditions and limitations=条件和限制。【解析】A正确：保持data sheet作主语，"satisfies the airworthiness necessities"对应meets the airworthiness requirements，"complying with the conditions and limitations"对应under which的定语关系——数据单规定产品满足适航要求的条件和限制；"published"对issued略有瑕疵但语义最近。B把主语换成product（数据单规定→产品应达到），"stipulating by this data sheet"语法错误（应为stipulated by），prescribes的动作主体丢失。C把"产品在这些条件下满足适航要求"误析为"conditions and limitations of the airworthiness demands"（条件限制错挂到适航要求上，修饰对象错位），regulates对prescribes尚可但结构失真。under which从句限定'产品满足适航要求的条件'，B换主语、C错挂修饰对象。

question: The airworthiness concern requires prompt action, based on the potential for having similar or more severe corrosion on any other airplane in the operator's fleet, prior to the next scheduled inspection of that area.

options.A: The airworthiness problem needs to be resolved by the way any other airplane does in the operator's fleet has equal or more damaging corrosion, and it has to be done before the regular check of that zone.
options.B: The airworthiness problem needs immediate action ahead of the next planning inspection of that zone, because it would probably occur on another plane in the operator's fleet, causing equivalent or more serious corrosion.
options.C: Due to any other airplane in the operator's fleet could have the comparable or more vital corrosion, the airworthiness problem should be investigated immediately before the next periodic inspection of that zone.

explanation: 【译文】The airworthiness concern requires prompt action, prior to the next scheduled inspection of that area, because of the potential for similar or more severe corrosion on any other airplane in the operator's fleet.【词汇】airworthiness concern=适航关注问题，prompt action=迅速行动，similar or more severe corrosion=类似或更严重的腐蚀，operator's fleet=运营人机队，prior to the next scheduled inspection=在下一次计划检查之前，potential=可能性。【解析】B正确："needs immediate action ahead of the next planning inspection"对应requires prompt action...prior to the next scheduled inspection，原因从句"机队中其他飞机可能出现类似或更严重腐蚀"传达potential for similar or more severe corrosion。A句式残缺——"resolved by the way any other airplane does"语义破碎（the way从句无法解读），腐蚀程度比较关系错乱。C把requires prompt action弱化为"should be investigated"（立即行动→应被调查，行动级别降级），"vital corrosion"误译severe（severe是严重的，vital是至关重要的），periodic对scheduled尚可。prompt action与prior to inspection是时限要点，C降级为investigated；A句式不可解读。立即行动、下次检查前完成、机队潜在腐蚀三要素须齐备。

question: Remove the test cap on the control pressure sense line from the Precooler Control Valve to the 3908 sensor and make sure air flows out of the test port.

options.A: Remove the test cap between the Precooler Control Valve and the 3908 sensor on the control pressure sense line and ensure that there is air flowing out of the port.
options.B: From precooler control valve to 3908 sensor, remove the sense line test cap, make certain that the air flows from the test hub.
options.C: The purpose of the test cap removal from the Precooler Control Valve to the 3908 sensor is to guarantee that there is airflow at the test port.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the test cap on the control pressure sense line between the Precooler Control Valve and the 3908 sensor, and make sure that air flows out of the test port.【词汇】test cap=测试堵帽，control pressure sense line=控制压力传感管路，Precooler Control Valve=预冷器控制活门，test port=测试口，sense line=传感管路。【解析】A正确：保留祈使句Remove...and make sure结构，"on the control pressure sense line"归属正确（堵帽装在连接预冷器控制活门和3908传感器的传感管路上），"air flowing out of the port"对应air flows out of the test port。B把test port误译为test hub（测试口→测试毂，部件名错误），语序倒装"From...to...remove"造成管路归属歧义。C把祈使句整体改造成目的陈述句（"The purpose of...is to guarantee"），操作指令动作丢失——原文是维修操作步骤（拆堵帽并确认气流）而非目的说明（句型误用）。祈使句型不可改为目的陈述；test port为测试口，B的hub、C的句型均错。

question: The selection of data by the handbook producer, to be included in this Section shall be governed by the concepts contained in the preface of this Specification.

options.A: The selection of data by manual producers which are included in this section shall be restrained by the concepts contained in the preface of this specification.
options.B: The selection of data by manual producers included in this section shall be governed by the concepts contained in the preamble to this specification.
options.C: In this selection, the producer's choice of data should be bound by concepts contained in the preamble of this specification.

explanation: 【译文】The handbook producer's selection of data to be included in this Section shall be governed by the concepts contained in the preface of this Specification.【词汇】selection of data=数据选取，shall be governed by=应由……约束/指导，concepts=原则/理念，preface/preamble=前言，handbook producer=手册编制方。【解析】B正确："shall be governed by"保留原词（受……指导/约束），"preamble"是preface的规范同义词，"included in this section"正确修饰data——纳入本节的数据选取应受规范前言原则的约束。A把governed误译为restrained（限制/束缚≠指导规范，语气和词义均偏），"which are included"错挂到producers上（被纳入本节的是数据而非编制者，定语修饰对象错误）。C把shall be governed降格为"should be bound"（受束缚，强制性和词义双偏），"In this selection"改变句子主语，丢失handbook producer的行为主体。governed是'受……指导约束'，restrained/bound均偏消极；preamble=preface为规范同义。

question: The Federal Aviation Regulations require the use of "maximum continuous power", during certification of an airframe and engine combination, to show compliance with certain standards.

options.A: The Federal Aviation Regulations require "maximum continuous power" to be used during airframe and engine combination certification to show obedience with certain criteria.
options.B: Federal aviation regulations require "maximum continuing power" to be used during the certifying of the airframe and engine to meet certain criteria.
options.C: Federal aviation regulations, in combination of airframe and engine certification process, the use of "maximum continuous power", are used to show compliance with certain standards.

explanation: 【译文】The Federal Aviation Regulations require the use of "maximum continuous power" during certification of an airframe and engine combination, to show compliance with certain standards.【词汇】Federal Aviation Regulations=联邦航空条例（FAR），maximum continuous power=最大连续功率（固定术语），airframe and engine combination=机体与发动机组合，show compliance with=表明符合，certification=合格审定。【解析】A正确：保留require "maximum continuous power" to be used结构，"airframe and engine combination certification"对应机体发动机组合的审定，"show obedience with certain criteria"对compliance虽有词汇偏差（obedience对compliance略偏）但结构忠实。B把"maximum continuous power"误译为"maximum continuing power"（continuous→continuing，规范术语被破坏——最大连续功率是固定术语）。C语法结构崩坏——"Federal aviation regulations,...the use of..., are used to show compliance"（条例被用来表明符合，主语错位，combination从定语变成插入语，句子不成立）。maximum continuous power为固定术语不可换continuing；C主语错位致全句不成立。术语引用须原样保留（引号内的最大连续功率）。

question: Solenoid valves shall be shown with a notation indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.

options.A: Solenoid valves shall be shown with a notation. The notation indicates the spring is loaded by the valve to the open or closed position.
options.B: Solenoid valves shall be shown with a symbol. The valve indicates whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.
options.C: Solenoid valves shall be shown with a mark. The mark indicates whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.

explanation: 【译文】Solenoid valves shall be shown with a mark indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.【词汇】solenoid valves=电磁阀，notation=标记/注释，spring-loaded to the open or closed position=弹簧加载到开位或关位，whether=是否，mark=标记。【解析】C正确："a mark indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded"——mark对应notation（标记/注明），whether从句完整，主语正确（是标记在表明阀门弹簧加载到开位还是关位）。A把"the valve is spring-loaded"误译为"the spring is loaded by the valve"（弹簧被阀门加载——阀门被弹簧加载与弹簧被阀门加载主被动关系完全颠倒）。B把主语换成"the valve indicates"（变成阀门在表明，而原文是notation在表明阀门状态，行为主体错误），symbol对notation尚可但句式已错。spring-loaded描述阀门被弹簧加载的位置状态，A颠倒加载关系，B换错行为主体。

question: This Specification is designed to provide guidance for the preparation of Handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes originally certificated at maximum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or less.

options.A: This Specification is designed to provide guidance for the development of Handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes. These airplanes are originally certificated at minimum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or more.
options.B: This specification is intended to provide guidance for the development of Handbooks for all types of general aviation aircraft, which are initially certificated at maximum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or less.
options.C: This specification is intended to provide guidance for the preparation of Handbooks. For all types of general aviation aircraft, their maximum take-off weight is more than 12,500 pounds.

explanation: 【译文】This specification is intended to provide guidance for the preparation of Handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes originally certificated at maximum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or less.【词汇】general aviation airplanes=通用航空飞机，originally certificated=最初取得合格证的，maximum takeoff weights=最大起飞重量，12,500 pounds or less=12500磅及以下，provide guidance for=为……提供指导。【解析】B正确："maximum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or less"与原文"最大起飞重量12500磅及以下"完全一致（or less=及以下），"initially certificated"对应originally certificated，development对preparation属可接受的同义替换。A把"最大12500磅及以下"误译为"minimum takeoff weights of 12,500 pounds or more"（最小起飞重量及以上，量限和比较方向双重相反）。C把"12500磅或以下"误译为"more than 12,500 pounds"（超过12500磅，适用范围完全相反——小飞机规范被改成大飞机规范，属严重错误）。'or less'对'or more'是适用范围的分界点，A、C双重方向错误；原答案C有误，B唯一正确。

question: Section 1 of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall present basic data and information of general interest to the pilot which is useful in loading, sheltering, handling, and routine preflight checking of the airplane.

options.A: Section 1 of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall introduce basic data and information of general interest to the pilot. The data and information is useful in loading, sheltering, handling, and routine preflight checking of the airplane.
options.B: Section 1 of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall present basic data and information of general interest to the pilot. The general interest is useful in loading, sheltering, handling, and routine preflight checking of the airplane.
options.C: Section 1 of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall present basic data and information of general interest to the pilot. The pilot is useful in loading, sheltering, handling, and routine preflight checking of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】Section 1 of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall present basic data and information of general interest to the pilot, which is useful in loading, sheltering, handling, and routine preflight checking of the airplane.【词汇】of general interest to the pilot=飞行员普遍关心的，loading=装载，sheltering=停放/遮蔽存放，handling=搬运操作，routine preflight checking=例行飞行前检查，present=提供。【解析】A正确："introduce"≈present（提供/介绍），关键在第二句主语用"The data and information"（数据和信息有用），正确还原which is useful的指代对象——有用的是数据和信息。B把定语从句主语错为"The general interest"（普遍兴趣有用，指代错误——原文是数据信息有用而非"兴趣"有用）。C把主语错为"The pilot"（飞行员有用——which指代错误导致荒谬语义），四个用途动名词虽保留但句子已不成立。which定语从句的先行词是data and information，B、C错认先行词导致语义荒谬。

question: In order to achieve the objectives of this Specification (enhance safety, reduce efforts, minimize costs), each manufacturer is expected to reasonably adhere to the Specification content and arrangement.

options.A: Each manufacturer is expected to abide by the Specification content and arrangement without any deviation in order to reasonably achieve the objectives of this Specification (enhance safety, reduce efforts, minimize costs).
