options.B: It is mandatory that each manufacturer  adhere to the Specification content and arrangement to achieve the objectives of this Specification (enhance safety, reduce efforts, minimize costs).
options.C: Each manufacturer is expected to adhere to the Specification content and arrangement reasonably so as to enhance safety, reduce efforts, and minimize costs which are the objectives of this Specification.

explanation: 【译文】In order to achieve the objectives of this Specification—enhance safety, reduce efforts, minimize costs—each manufacturer is expected to reasonably adhere to the Specification content and arrangement.【词汇】achieve the objectives=实现目标，reasonably adhere to=合理遵循，enhance safety=提高安全性，reduce efforts=减少工作量，minimize costs=降低成本，expected to=被期望/应。【解析】C正确："expected to adhere...reasonably"对应is expected to reasonably adhere（合理遵循而非绝对遵守），三项目标enhance safety, reduce efforts, minimize costs完整列出并标明是规范目标。A把reasonably adhere误译为"abide by...without any deviation"（不得有任何偏离）——reasonably恰是允许灵活度，"毫无偏离"把弹性要求升格为绝对强制，语气错误。B把is expected to误译为"It is mandatory"（强制性的——expected是期望不是强制命令），同样丢失reasonably限定，语气升级过度。expected与reasonably共同限定为'合理遵循的期望'，A、B均把弹性要求绝对化。

question: Transfer of hydraulic fluid between hydraulic system A and B is caused by improper operation of system controls or worn equipment.

options.A: Uncontrolled system or old equipment cause hydraulic fluid flow from hydraulic system A to B.
options.B: If you fail to operate the system control properly or the equipment is damaged, the hydraulic fluid will be transferred between hydraulic system A and B.
options.C: Flow of hydraulic fluid between hydraulic system A and B result in accidental operation of system controls or damaged  equipment.

explanation: 【译文】If the system controls are not operated properly or the equipment is worn, hydraulic fluid will be transferred between hydraulic systems A and B.【词汇】transfer of hydraulic fluid=液压油转移，improper operation=不当操作，worn equipment=磨损的设备，between A and B=在A和B之间，caused by=由……引起。【解析】B正确：因果方向正确——"fail to operate properly or the equipment is damaged"（系统控制操作不当或设备磨损）是原因，"fluid will be transferred between A and B"是结果，对应is caused by结构。A把improper operation of system controls误译为Uncontrolled system（失控系统≠操作不当，把人为操作错误变成系统失控），"from A to B"把between误作单向流动（A到B单向≠A、B之间相互转移，范围方向错误）。C把因果倒置——"Flow of hydraulic fluid...result in accidental operation"（液压油流动导致误操作），原文明明是误操作/磨损导致油液转移，因果方向完全相反。is caused by要求果在前因在后，C用result in把因果倒置；A还漏误操作主体。

question: A reporting system, consistent with the system employed by the ABC Service Organization, has been established and incorporated into this document.

options.A: A reporting system, conherent with the system applied by the ABC Service Organization, has been established and included in this document.
options.B: A reporting system, compliance with the system used by the ABC Service Organization, has been established and comprised of this document.
options.C: A reporting system, constituent with the system employed by the ABC Service Organization, has been established and accomplished in this document.

explanation: 【译文】A reporting system, consistent with the system employed by the ABC Service Organization, has been established and incorporated into this document.【词汇】reporting system=报告制度，consistent with=与……一致，employed=所采用的，incorporated into=纳入/并入，established=已建立。【解析】A正确："conherent"虽有拼写瑕疵（应为coherent），但与consistent语义最接近（一致的）；"applied by"对应employed by，"included in this document"对应incorporated into，两个谓语都对。B把consistent误译为compliance（compliance是"遵守/符合"的名词，不能直接作"与……一致"的形容词性短语，词性用法错误），incorporated into误译为"comprised of"（被纳入文件≠文件由其组成，主客体颠倒）。C把consistent误译为constituent（组成部分，形近词错译——consistent with是与……一致，constituent是成分），incorporated误译为accomplished（完成≠纳入）。consistent=与……一致，constituent=成分、compliance=遵从，三词形近义殊。两个分句——与ABC制度一致、已纳入文件——均须对应。

question: For Unscheduled Maintenance Checks, the manufacturer will have the option to include Time Limits/Inspections and Maintenance Checks in a separate manual, providing they are also placed in the Maintenance Manual.

options.A: The manufacturer may choose to include information on Unscheduled Maintenance Checks, including Time Limits/Inspections and Maintenance Checks, in a separate manual. Reference points must be listed in the maintenance manual.
options.B: For Unscheduled Maintenance Checks, the manufacturer will have the choice to separate the information of Time Limits/Inspections and Maintenance Checks in manuals. The manual can be the Maintenance Manual.
options.C: The information on Unscheduled Maintenance Checks should be provided in the Maintenance Manual including Time Limits/Inspections and Maintenance Checks. Whether to include these information in an other manual is at the manufacturer's option.

explanation: 【译文】For Unscheduled Maintenance Checks, the manufacturer may choose to include Time Limits/Inspections and Maintenance Checks in a separate manual, provided that the information is also placed in the Maintenance Manual.【词汇】Unscheduled Maintenance Checks=非计划维修检查，have the option to=可以选择，Time Limits/Inspections=时限/检查项目，separate manual=单独手册，provided that=前提是，Maintenance Manual=维修手册。【解析】C正确：准确还原"信息必须也在维修手册中+制造商可选择另设单独手册"的逻辑——"should be provided in the Maintenance Manual"对应providing they are also placed in the MM的附带条件，"at the manufacturer's option"对应have the option to include in a separate manual。A把条件句误译为"Reference points must be listed in the maintenance manual"（参考点必须列出——原文要求是信息本身也放入MM而非仅列参考点，条件失真）。B把"可选择放入单独手册"误译为"在手册中分开信息"，并把必要条件弱化为"The manual can be the Maintenance Manual"（可以是维修手册，逻辑层次全乱）。原答案A有误，C语义最完整。

question: Where chapters have been eliminatd through combining with other chapters,  the original chapter heading will be listed in the table of contents in the front of the manual and  a reference given  as  to  where  the  material is now located.

options.A: If a chapter is deleted by merging with other chapters, the original chapter title will be listed in the table of contents at the front of the manual and the location will be indicated in the reference materials.
options.B: Where chapters have been eliminatd through combining with other chapters,  the original chapter title will be listed in the table of contents at the front of the manual,and  the  material will be located in the original chapter.
options.C: If a chapter is deleted by other chapters, the original chapter title will be listed in the table of contents at the front of the manual and the location will be indicated in the reference materials.

explanation: 【译文】If a chapter has been eliminated by combining it with other chapters, the original chapter title will still be listed in the table of contents at the front of the manual, with a reference given as to where the material is now located.【词汇】eliminated through combining=通过合并被撤销，original chapter heading=原章标题，table of contents=目录，a reference given as to where the material is now located=注明材料现所在位置的出处。【解析】A正确："deleted by merging with other chapters"对应combining with other chapters（与其他章合并而撤销），"the location will be indicated in the reference"对应注明材料新位置的出处——目录保留原章名并注明材料去向。B把"a reference given as to where the material is now located"误译为"the material will be located in the original chapter"（材料仍在原章——与合并后材料已移走的事实相反）。C把combining with other chapters误译为"deleted by other chapters"（被其他章删除——撤销方式是通过合并而非被其他章删除，方式错误）。章被合并后材料已移位，目录须注明新位置；B、C对combining与材料去向均误读。

question: Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as with engines removed, aircraft damaged, etc. for short or long terms in extremes of weather conditions.

options.A: Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as with engines removed, aircraft damaged, etc.neither short-term nor long-term.
options.B: Instructions required for parking or storing the aircraft under normal or abnormal conditions, such as engine removal, aircraft damage, etc., which are used for short-term or long-term under extreme weather conditions.
options.C: Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as with engines removed, aircraft damaged, etc.either short-term or long-term.

explanation: 【译文】Those instructions necessary to park or store the aircraft under normal or abnormal conditions, such as with engines removed or aircraft damaged, for short or long terms in extremes of weather conditions.【词汇】park or store=停放或封存，abnormal conditions=非正常状况，engines removed=发动机已拆下，short or long terms=短期或长期，extremes of weather conditions=极端天气条件。【解析】B正确：要素最全——parking or storing、normal or abnormal conditions、engine removal、aircraft damage、short-term or long-term、under extreme weather conditions六项全部保留。A把"for short or long terms"误译为"neither short-term nor long-term"（既非短期也非长期，方向完全相反——原文是短期或长期均可），且漏译extremes of weather。C虽保留"either short-term or long-term"，但整句漏译"in extremes of weather conditions"（极端天气条件要素缺失），完整性不及B。原答案C遗漏关键要素，B为最佳。短/长期与极端天气是两组并列条件，A方向相反，C漏天气要素；B最全故改选B。列举项取舍直接决定正误，B覆盖最完整故改选。

question: Always make sure that you know what you want to say and that the words that you use give the meaning that you want.

options.A: To know what you want to say and to use the words that give the wanted meaning shall always be assured.
options.B: In order to express the meaning that you want, always make sure that you know what you want to say and you use the words.
options.C: Always make sure that you use what you want to say to express the words with the meaning that you want.

explanation: 【译文】Always make sure that you know what you want to say and that the words you use convey the meaning you intend.【词汇】make sure=确保，what you want to say=你想表达的内容，give the meaning that you want=传达你想要的含义，always=始终，convey=传达。【解析】A正确："shall always be assured"对应Always make sure（始终要确保），两个并列宾语从句"know what you want to say"和"use the words that give the wanted meaning"完整对应——知道想说什么+用词达意。B把第二个从句截断为"and you use the words"（你使用这些词——丢失give the meaning that you want的语义核心：用词要达意），且"In order to express"前置改写改变了句子的祈使强调结构。C把"words give the meaning"错解为"use what you want to say to express the words"（用想说的内容去表达词——主客体完全颠倒，语义混乱）。make sure后接两个并列从句，B截断第二从句、C颠倒用词与达意关系。

question: CAP supplements the airplane's maintenance manual (or Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness) which is the primary document containing the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of the airplane.

options.A: The supplements of CAP are the airplane's maintenance manual (or Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness). The CAP is the primary document containing the aircraft's continuous airworthiness procedures.
options.B: The airplane's maintenance manual (or Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness) serves as the main document that contains the procedures to ensure the continuing airworthiness of the airplane. CAP is a supplementation to the manual.
options.C: CAP supplements the airplane's maintenance manual (or Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness). The supplements are the major document and involve in the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】The airplane's maintenance manual (or Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness) is the primary document containing the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of the airplane, and the CAP supplements it.【词汇】CAP=持续适航方案，supplements=补充（谓语，主语是CAP），primary document=首要文件，Instructions for Continuing Airworthiness=持续适航说明（ICA），continuing airworthiness=持续适航。【解析】B正确：厘清主从关系——维修手册是primary document（首要文件，包含持续适航程序），CAP是其supplementation（补充），与原文"CAP supplements the manual which is the primary document"完全对应。A把关系反转——"The CAP is the primary document"（CAP成了首要文件——原文是手册为首要文件、CAP为补充，主客体颠倒）。C同样错认主体——"The supplements are the major document"（补充件成了主要文件），把补充关系完全弄反。手册是primary、CAP是supplement，A、C把主次关系互换。supplement作谓语表示补充关系，不可转作名词主项。

question: You can do the test in two different ways -- either with the Central Maintenance Computer System via the MCDU, like you have probably learned already, or with a test switch on the VOR receiver in the avionics compartment.

options.A: Two controversial ways can be chosen to do the test, either with the Central Maintenance Computer System through a the MCDU, like you have probably learned already, and with a test switch on the VOR receiver in the avionics compartment.
options.B: You can do the test following procedures -- with the Central Maintenance Computer System by the MCDU, you have probably learned already, and  with a test switch on the VOR receiver in the avionics compartment.
options.C: The test can be done in either way below-- using the Central Maintenance Computer System via the MCDU, as you have probably already learned, or using a test switch on the VOR receiver in the avionics compartment.

explanation: 【译文】The test can be done in either of two ways—using the Central Maintenance Computer System via the MCDU, as you have probably already learned, or using a test switch on the VOR receiver in the avionics compartment.【词汇】in two different ways=以两种不同方式，either...or=或者……或者，Central Maintenance Computer System=中央维护计算机系统，via the MCDU=通过多功能控制显示组件，avionics compartment=电子设备舱，test switch=测试电门。【解析】C正确："either way below""using...or using..."保留两种测试途径的并列选择结构，"as you have probably already learned"对应插入语like you have probably learned already。A把different误译为controversial（不同的→有争议的，词义错译——两种方式只是不同并非有争议），把either...or的选择关系误译为"and"（并列相加）。B丢失"two ways"的数量与either...or结构，"following procedures"表述笼统无法对应two different ways，插入语位置断裂使句子支离破碎。two ways与either...or构成'二选一'结构，A的controversial与and、B的笼统表述均破坏该结构。

question: This organization was asked to investigate the readability of maintenance documentation in the civil aviation industry and find a solution to simplify the language used to write such documentation.

options.A: This organization was asked to look into the readability of maintenance documentation in the civil aviation industry and find a resolution to simplify the language used to write such documentation.
options.B: This organization was asked to research the legibility of maintenance documentation in the civil aviation industry and get a way to simplify the language used to write such documentation.
options.C: This organization was asked to study the readability of maintenance documentation in the civil aviation industry and find a method to single out the language used to write such documentation.

explanation: 【译文】This organization was asked to investigate the readability of maintenance documentation in the civil aviation industry and find a solution to simplify the language used to write such documentation.【词汇】investigate/look into=调查/研究，readability=可读性（区别于legibility字迹清晰度），maintenance documentation=维修文件，solution=解决方案，simplify=简化。【解析】A正确："look into"是investigate的规范同义替换（调查），"readability"保留不变，"resolution"对应solution（解决方案），"simplify the language used to write such documentation"对应"简化编写此类文件所用的语言"。B把readability误译为legibility（可读性→字迹/印刷清晰度，近形词干扰——readability指文字易读程度），"get a way"为口语化不规范搭配。C把simplify误译为"single out"（挑出≠简化，词义完全走样），"find a method to single out the language"语义破碎——原文是简化语言而非挑选语言。readability（文字可读性）与legibility（字迹清晰度）为近形辨析；simplify≠single out。

question: Water displacing corrosion inhibiting compound has been applied during construction on certain airplanes in the locations shown in this figure. Periodic reapplication in these, and other locations, is required to maintain effectiveness of this protection.

options.A: At the location shown in the figure,  waterproof corrosion inhibiting compound has been used on certain aircraft construction. To keep the effectiveness of this protection, reapply the compound in these and other locations periodically.
options.B: Water displaying corrosion inhibiting compound has applied on certain airplanes structure in the locations in this figure. Periodic reapplication must be applied in these and other locations, so as to maintain effectiveness of this protection.
options.C: Water displacing anti-seize compound has been applied on certain airplanes construction in the locations in this figure. Periodic reapplication should be utilized in these and other locations, in order to keep effectiveness of the protection.

explanation: 【译文】Water-displacing corrosion-inhibiting compound has been applied during construction on certain airplanes in the locations shown in this figure; periodic reapplication is required to maintain effectiveness of this protection.【词汇】water displacing=排水型/驱水的，corrosion inhibiting compound=缓蚀化合物/防腐剂，during construction=制造/装配期间，periodic reapplication=定期再次涂敷，maintain effectiveness=保持有效性。【解析】A正确："waterproof corrosion inhibiting compound"对water displacing略有偏差（驱水型近似为防水型），但保住了corrosion inhibiting compound这一术语核心——缓蚀剂；"reapply periodically""keep the effectiveness"均对应。B把displacing误译为displaying（排水→显示，形近词错译），"has applied"语法残缺（应为has been applied被动）。C把corrosion inhibiting误译为anti-seize（缓蚀剂→防咬合剂/防卡剂，化合物类型完全不同——防卡剂用于螺纹润滑，缓蚀剂用于防腐），术语核心错误比A更严重。corrosion inhibiting compound（缓蚀剂）为术语核心，C的anti-seize为化学品错换，重于A的偏差。

question: Although this specification conforms to recognized industry practices , it is written in broad general terms and it is recognized that problems will arise which are not treated adequately by the specification.

options.A: Even though this specification is conformed to recognized industry practices , it is prepared in broad genuine terms and it is recognized that problems will occur which are not handled enough by the specification.
options.B: Although this specification coheres with recognized industry practices , it is written in vast general terms and it is asserted that problems will appear which are not treated sufficiently by the specification.
options.C: Though this specification complies with accepted industry practice, it is compiled in wide generic terms and it is recognized that problems which are not treated adequately by the specification will arise.

explanation: 【译文】尽管本规范符合公认行业惯例，但它以宽泛的通用术语编写，人们认识到会出现规范未涵盖的问题。【词汇】conform to=符合，recognized industry practices=公认行业惯例，broad general terms=宽泛通用术语，adequately=充分地。【解析】C正确：complies with≈conforms to，accepted≈recognized，wide generic≈broad general，核心词全对应。A两处错：is conformed to被动误用；genuine（真正的）≠general（通用的）。B两处错：coheres with（黏合）≠conforms to；vast（巨大）≠broad（宽泛）。

question: The check list may be followed by additional information  to provide pilots with a better understanding of the reasons for actions in the check list.

options.A: Additional information may follow the check list to make the check list easier for the pilots to understand it.
options.B: The additional information should be followed by the pilots to make better understanding the check list.
options.C: The additional information is followed the check list, to make the pilots better understanding the check list the pilots should read it in sequence.

explanation: 【译文】检查单后可附补充信息，以便飞行员更好理解检查单中各项操作的理由。【词汇】be followed by=后接，additional information=补充信息，reasons for actions=操作的理由。【解析】A正确：把被动be followed by转为主动“补充信息可跟在检查单之后”，目的状语保留。B方向错误：错成“被飞行员遵循”（followed by the pilots），主客颠倒且make better understanding语法不通。C两处错：is followed the check list缺by，被动残缺；read it in sequence为添加信息。

question: Emergency Procedures and other pertinent information necessary for safe operations shall be provided for emergencies peculiar to a particular airplane design, operating or handling characteristics.

options.A: Based on different airplane design, the Emergency Procedures and other pertinent information necessary for safe operation should only be provided for some airplane.
options.B: Based on the particular airplane design, operating or handling distinguishing feature, Emergency Procedures and related information must  be provided.
options.C: The Emergency Procedures and other special information necessary for safe operation shall be provided for emergencies that is common to all airplane design, operating or handling characteristics.

explanation: 【译文】应针对特定飞机的设计、运行或操纵特性所特有的紧急情况，提供应急程序和其他安全运行所需的有关信息。【词汇】pertinent=相关的，peculiar to=为…所特有，particular=特定的，handling characteristics=操纵特性。【解析】B正确：particular design、distinguishing feature对应peculiar characteristics，must对应shall。A要素弱化：把“特定机型特性”弱化为some airplane，only为多余限定。C方向相反：peculiar to a particular（特定机型特有）错成common to all（所有机型共有）。

question: When there is an "emergency" situation, it is usually a failure that requires an immediate and quick response, such as an entire engine failure, fire or smoke, or perhaps a rapid drop in cabin pressure.

options.A: For "emergency", the related failure should be responded immediately, for example, the total engine failure, fire or smoke, sudden cabin pressure lost.
options.B: An "Emergency" almost including a serious failure that requires later response, such as a total engines failure, flame out or smoke, or rapid cabin pressurization.
options.C: For "emergency", the related failure should be treated immediately, for example, the total engine is not malfunctioning, fire or smoke, sudden cabin pressure lost.

explanation: 【译文】“紧急”情况通常指需立即快速反应的故障，如发动机完全失效、火警或烟雾、座舱压力骤降。【词汇】emergency=紧急情况，immediate response=立即反应，entire engine failure=发动机完全失效，cabin pressure=座舱压力。【解析】A正确：immediately对应immediate and quick，发动机失效、火警烟雾、座舱失压三例全对。B方向相反：later response与immediate相反；rapid cabin pressurization（增压）与pressure drop（失压）相反。C否定错误：engine is not malfunctioning（发动机无故障）与“完全失效”相反。

question: Due to frequent changes in, or varying combinations of, some types of equipment such as avionics and instrumentation, one or more separate documents for these products may be required.

options.A: One or more separate documents for some types of equipment such as avionics and instrumentation may be required because they change frequently or they have various combinations.
options.B: Some types of equipment such as avionics and instrumentation are changed regularly or combined in different forms, requiring to have one or more separate documents.
options.C: Some types of equipment such as avionics and instrumentation are often revised or combined differently to require one or more separate documents.

explanation: 【译文】由于某些设备（如航电和仪表）变更频繁或组合多样，可能需要为其编制一份或多份单独文件。【词汇】frequent changes=频繁变更，varying combinations=多样组合，avionics=航空电子设备，separate documents=单独文件。【解析】A正确：change frequently、various combinations分别对应两考点，may保留或然语气。B两处错：regularly（定期）≠frequently（频繁）；requiring to have搭配不当且丢失may。C词义错：revised（修订）≠changed（变更），combined differently to require句式不通。

question: In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to compromise between detail that is necessary to make the diagram self-explanatory, and simplicity that is essential for ease of reading and understanding.

options.A: Schematic diagram designers may make a compromise so as to add more details to make the diagram self-explanatory and  keep its simplicity at the same time for ease of reading and understanding.
options.B: In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to pay attention to both detail that is necessary to make the diagram self-explanatory, and simplicity that is essential for ease of reading and understanding.
options.C: Detail makes the diagram self-explanatory. Simplicity makes it easy to read and understand. It is necessary to consider both of them and make a compromise if needed when designing schematic diagrams.

explanation: 【译文】设计原理图时，可能需要在使图自明所必需的细节与便于阅读所必需的简洁之间折中。【词汇】schematic diagram=原理图，compromise=折中，self-explanatory=自明的，simplicity=简洁。【解析】C正确：detail、simplicity两要素与核心动词compromise全部保留，consider both and make a compromise完整对应。B丢核心概念：仅译pay attention to both（兼顾），“折中”这一关键动作消失。A逻辑扭曲：把“在细节与简洁间折中”错成“为增加细节而折中”，折中对象被篡改。

question: Utilizing an airplane as intended by the manufacturer, combined with sound inspection and maintenance practices , forms the basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.

options.A: The airworthiness and safe operation of an airplane is assured if it's used as its original design purpose, properly inspected and carefully maintained.
options.B: The manufacturer is intended to utilize an airplane with sound inspection and maintenance practices because that is the basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.
options.C: The airplane is designed to be used as the manufacturer's intention. Users shall properly inspect the airplane and do sufficient maintenance to assure its airworthiness and operation safety.

explanation: 【译文】按制造商预期用途使用飞机并结合完善的检查维护做法，是确保飞机保持适航和安全运行的基础。【词汇】as intended by=按…的预期用途，sound=完善的，inspection and maintenance=检查维护，airworthy=适航的。【解析】A正确：used as its original design purpose对应as intended，properly inspected and carefully maintained对应sound practices。B主语错置：使用主体被错成manufacturer。C句式篡改：把“构成基础”改成“用户应当（shall）”的义务句，原意走样。

question: Each Handbook shall have an "Airplane Weighing Form" that includes an airplane side view showing the location of weighing points (using jacking points or undercarriage) relative to the datum line.

options.A: An  "Airplane Weighing Form" shall be included in each handbook and the form shall contain an airplane side view that shows the location of weighing points (using jacking points or landing gear) relative to the datum line.
options.B: Each handbook shall provide an aircraft side view that is included in an "Airplane Weighing Form" to show the position of weighing points (using jacking points or landing gear) related to the datum line.
options.C: An airplane three view that shows the weighing points ((using jacking points or undercarriage) relative to the datum line shall be excluded in an "Airplane Weighing Form" of each handbook.

explanation: 【译文】每本手册应有“飞机称重表”，含飞机侧视图，标示称重点（用顶起点或起落架）相对基准线的位置。【词汇】weighing form=称重表，side view=侧视图，weighing point=称重点，datum line=基准线。【解析】A正确：form含side view的从属关系、称重点相对基准线两要点保留。B从属颠倒：错成“侧视图被包含在表中供手册提供”，结构混乱。C两处错：three view（三视图）≠side view；excluded（排除）与included方向相反。

question: The purpose of STE is to give technical writers guidelines on how to write technical texts in a clear, simple and unambiguous manner that readers throughout the world will find easy to understand.

options.A: The aim of STE is that readers all over the world can easily understand the technical texts and that writers who are responsible for preparing technical texts know how to prepare them in a easy method.
options.B: The objective of STE is to provide writers with general principles on how to prepare technical documents in a clear, simple and distinct manner that readers all over the world can easily understand.
options.C: The function of STE is to describe how to prepare technical texts in a easy, clear and specific way and to allow readers all over the world to understand difficultly.

explanation: 【译文】STE旨在为技术写作人员提供指南，以清晰、简明、无歧义的方式编写技术文本，使全球读者易于理解。【词汇】guidelines=指南，unambiguous=无歧义的，technical writers=技术写作人员。【解析】B正确：general principles对应guidelines，clear, simple and distinct对应三特性，读者易理解保留。A漏关键词：三特性只剩含糊的easy method，无歧义未体现。C方向相反：understand difficultly（难以理解）与“易于理解”相反。

question: This letter also provides procedures that can be used to help mitigate moisture ingress into the connector cavity until such time that the moisture problem can be resolved and a service bulletin is available to correct the problem.

options.A: If there is a available service bulletin to correct the problem of moisture ingress into the connector cavity,the letter then will be useless.
options.B: Refer to this letter to  help mitigate moisture ingress into the connector cavity even if there is a available service  bulletin to correct the problem.
options.C: If there is a available service bulletin to correct the problem that moisture ingress into the connector cavity, the letter then will provide procedures .

explanation: 【译文】本信函还提供了可用于帮助减缓湿气进入插头内腔的程序，直至湿气问题得以解决并且有服务通告可用于纠正该问题。【词汇】mitigate=减缓、减轻，moisture ingress=湿气侵入，connector cavity=插头/连接器内腔，service bulletin=服务通告，until such time=直至…之时。【解析】C最佳：保留了“信函提供程序”和“服务通告纠正湿气进入插头内腔问题”两个核心事实，是三个选项中唯一同时包含两要素的。A语义错误：useless（无用）完全违背原意——信函在服务通告可用之前提供缓解程序而非变得无用。B逻辑连词错误：even if（即使）把until（直到）的时间条件错成让步关系，暗示有通告也要用信函，与原文相反。

question: Although this specification conforms to recognized industry practices, it is written in broad general terms and it is recognized that problems will arise which are not treated adequately by the specification.

options.A: If this specification is written in professional terms, the problems won't arise.
options.B: This specification agrees with recognized industry practices, and the problems can't be avoided according to this specification.
options.C: If this specification is written in professional terms, the problems will be treated adequately.

explanation: 【译文】本信函还提供了帮助减缓湿气进入插头内腔的程序，直至问题解决并有服务通告可纠正该问题。【词汇】mitigate=减缓，moisture ingress=湿气侵入，connector cavity=插头内腔，service bulletin=服务通告。【解析】C最佳：唯一同时保留“信函提供程序”和“服务通告纠正湿气入腔问题”两要素的选项。A语义错误：useless违背原意，信函在通告可用前提供缓解程序。B逻辑错：even if（即使）把until（直到）错成让步，暗示有通告仍用信函。

question: Utilizing an airplane as intended by the manufacturer, combined with sound inspection and maintenance practices, forms the basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.

options.A: Utilizing an airplane as intended by the manufacturer and sound inspection and maintenance practices is basis that assures the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.
options.B: One of the basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate is sound inspection and maintenance practices and forms.
options.C: Utilizing an airplane as intended by the manufacturer is the only basis for assuring the airplane remains airworthy and safe to operate.

explanation: 【译文】按制造商的预期用途使用飞机并结合完善的检查和维护做法，是确保飞机保持适航和安全运行的基础。【词汇】combined with=与…结合，sound practices=完善的做法，basis=基础，assure=确保，remain airworthy=保持适航。【解析】A正确：把combined with改为and并列两个基础要素（按预期使用+完善检查维护），is basis that assures完整保留“是…的基础”的核心判断。B两处错误：One of the basis把唯一基础说成“之一”，且结尾“and forms”属拼接残句。C绝对化错误：the only basis（唯一基础）为原文没有的限定，且漏掉inspection and maintenance这一并列要素。

question: The cover title and applicable airplane designation shall be prominently displayed on the cover or spine of the Handbook. Other information may be displayed on the cover.

options.A: On the cover page, there should be the title and corresponding aircraft name displayed on the spine of the Handbook. Some other information may also be shown on the cover.
options.B: The title and corresponding aircraft name should be prominently displayed on the cover page or on the spine of the manual. Other information can also be displayed on the cover.
options.C: On the cover page, the title and the applicable aircraft name shall be prominently displayed or on the spine of the Handbook. Other information can also be displayed on the cover.

explanation: 【译文】封面标题和适用的飞机型号应醒目显示在手册封面或书脊上，其他信息可显示在封面。【词汇】cover title=封面标题，applicable airplane designation=适用的飞机型号，prominently=醒目地，spine=书脊。【解析】C正确：applicable与强制语气shall保留，“封面或书脊”两位置齐全，行文虽欠流畅但要素最全。A漏位置：只写on the spine，丢“封面或”。B语气弱化：shall错成should，corresponding不如applicable贴切。

question: This document shall specify, for a crack inspection, the minimum size crack expected to be discovered or, if no minimum is defined, a statement to this effect.

options.A: This document shall clearly states the minimum size crack you may discover in a crack inspection. If no minimum is defined, it shall have a statement that has the same effect.
options.B: This document shall specify the minimum allowed crack size expected to be discovered for a crack inspection or, if no minimum is defined, an equally valid standard.
options.C: The minimum crack size you are going to discover during a crack inspection shall be included in this document. However, if you could not set forth a standard, a statement shall take place.

explanation: 【译文】本文件应规定裂纹检查中预期可发现的最小裂纹尺寸；未规定最小值时应附同等含义的说明。【词汇】crack inspection=裂纹检查，minimum size=最小尺寸，to this effect=同等含义，specify=规定。【解析】A正确：minimum size crack you may discover对应expected to be discovered，statement that has the same effect对应to this effect。B两处错：minimum allowed为多余限定；equally valid standard≠同等含义的说明。C逻辑混乱：a statement shall take place误译目的关系。

question: It shall be made clear that when the subject system or equipment is installed, the associated Supplement must be in the Pilot's Operating Handbook at all times.

options.A: Apparently, the Supplement about the subject system or equipment, if installed, must be in the Pilot's Operating Handbook whenever applicable.
options.B: You shall know clearly that when the subject system or equipment is installed, the Pilot's Operating Handbook must always contain the related Supplement.
options.C: When the subject system or equipment is installed, you need to clearly identify the associated Supplement in the Pilot's Operating Handbook at all times.

explanation: 【译文】必须明确：所述系统或设备装机后，相关补充资料必须始终收录在《飞行员操作手册》中。【词汇】be made clear=必须明确，associated supplement=相关补充资料，at all times=始终。【解析】B正确：know clearly对应be made clear，POH must always contain the Supplement准确还原。A两处错：Apparently（显然）弱化强制要求；whenever applicable（适用时）≠at all times（始终）。C动词错译：错成identify the Supplement（识别补充资料），要求实质改变。

question: These inspection features are mandatory and cannot be changed or deleted without the approval of the FAA Oversight Office that is responsible for the airplane model Type Certificate.

options.A: If there is no approval of the FAA Oversight Office that manages the airplane model Type Certificate, anyone cannot change or delete these inspection  features that are compulsive.
options.B: These inspection features can be changed or deleted if they don't get approval of the FAA Oversight Office that is responsible for the airplane model Type Certificate because they are mandatory.
options.C: If changing or deleting of these inspection features is approved by the FAA Oversight Office that manages the airplane model Type Certificate, they are mandatory.

explanation: 【译文】这些检查项目是强制的，未经负责该机型型号合格证的FAA监管办公室批准不得更改或删除。【词汇】mandatory=强制的，approval=批准，Type Certificate=型号合格证。【解析】A正确：If there is no approval…cannot change or delete还原“未经批准不得改”。B条件颠倒：错成“未获批准就可以改”，逻辑相反。C因果错乱：“若获批更改则是强制的”，批准与强制性关系搞反。

question: If you use alternative tools or equipment, it is the operator's responsibility to make sure that they give the same results and are as safe to the parts and personnel as the tools or equipment specified in the procedure.

options.A: It is the responsibility of the operator to ensure that alternative tools or equipment can work well and are dangerous to the parts and personnel as the ones specified in the procedure if you use them.
options.B: If alternative tools or equipment are used, the operator must ensure that they can play the same role and are as safe as the tools or equipment specified in the procedure to the parts and personnel.
options.C: If the manufacturer can make sure that alternative tools or equipment can meet the requirement and are as safe to the parts and equipment as the ones specified in the procedure,  you can use them.

explanation: 【译文】若使用替代工具或设备，操作者有责任确保其效果相同且对部件和人员的安全性与规定工具设备相同。【词汇】alternative tools=替代工具，give the same results=产生相同效果，as safe as=与…同样安全。【解析】B正确：play the same role对应same results，as safe as…to the parts and personnel对象完整。A方向相反：are dangerous to与as safe as相反。C两处错：责任主体换成manufacturer；personnel被错成equipment。

question: When it is necessary to order any wire bundles from Boeing, operators should provide the base wire bundle number (61-30396 in this case) and tail number of the airplane where the bundle is to be installed on.

options.A: If ordering any wire bundles from Boeing is mandatory, operators has the right to purchase the bundles from  other supplier and ask them to provide the base wire bundle number (61-30396 in this case) and tail number of the airplane.
options.B: It is a necessity for the operators to provide the base wire bundle number (61-30396 in this case) and tail number of the airplane on which the bundle is to be installed if ordering any wire bundles from Boeing is necessary.
options.C: Operators should provide the number(61-30396 in this case) of the airplane where the bundles are to be installed on if ordering any wire bundles from Boeing is necessary.

explanation: 【译文】向波音订购导线束时，运营人应提供导线束基础件号（本例61-30396）及拟装机飞机的机尾号。【词汇】wire bundle=导线束，base wire bundle number=基础件号，tail number=机尾号。【解析】B正确：基础件号与机尾号两号码均保留，the airplane on which the bundle is to be installed准确表达拟装机飞机。C要素合并：两号码被压成the number of the airplane，丢失区分。A无中生有：has the right to purchase from other supplier原文没有。

question: Detailed information on more complex and specialized subjects may either be included in the basic Maintenance Manual or made available as separate documents at the option of the manufacturer and to the extent the manufacturer determines appropriate.

options.A: Manufacturer determines specific range properly to describe sophisticated and professional information. The information can be put in Maintenance Maunal or other documents.
options.B: Detailed information on more intricate and specific subjects can be written in two ways: Maintenance Manual or individual documents. The two ways are dependent on manufacturer's option properly.
options.C: It is up to the manufacturer to decide where and to what extent to include detailed information about more sophisticated and professional topics, either in the common Maintenance Manual or in another new documents.

explanation: 【译文】更复杂、更专业主题的详细信息可由制造商选择并视其认为适当的程度纳入基础维护手册或单独文件。【词汇】specialized subjects=专业主题，at the option of=由…选择，to the extent=在…程度上，separate documents=单独文件。【解析】C最佳：where and to what extent同对应option与extent两限定，两个载体齐全。B要素不全：two ways与option保留，但漏掉to the extent程度限定。A语句不通：determines specific range properly结构混乱，主干不完整。

question: This specification provides for the preparation and issuance of less complex manuals for less complex airplanes than those operated by the large scheduled airlines while achieving industry wide standardization of nomenclature and format.

options.A: This specification provides for the preparation and insurance of more complex manuals for less complex aircraft than aircraft operated by large scheduled airlines, while achieving industry-wide standardization of naming and formatting.
options.B: The specification is used to prepare and release simpler manuals for less complicated aircraft rather than the aircraft operated by large scheduled airlines while achieving industry-wide standardization of terminology and format.
options.C: This specification specifies the preparation and release of less complex manuals for aircraft that are less complex and operated by large scheduled airlines, and realizes the industry wide standardization of terms and formats.

explanation: 【译文】本规范规定为比大型定期航空公司运营飞机复杂度更低的飞机编制发布较简单手册，同时实现全行业术语格式标准化。【词汇】preparation and issuance=编制与发布，less complex=复杂度较低，scheduled airlines=定期航空公司，nomenclature=术语。【解析】B正确：prepare and release、simpler manuals for less complicated aircraft、terminology对应准确。A两处错：more complex与less complex相反；insurance（保险）系issuance误拼。C关系错置：错成“较简单飞机由大航空公司运营”，比较关系被破坏。

question: Use white paper with good strength characteristics and of sufficient weight and substance to eliminate excessive show-through when printed on both sides.

options.A: Use white paper with good strength characteristics and enough weight and substance to eliminate excessive print leakage when printing on both sides.
options.B: Use good white paper with high strength quality and of adequate weight  to delete excessive show-through when printed on both sides.
options.C: Use white paper with good strength and of sufficient weight and substance to prevent overmuch ink show-through the paper when printed on both sides.

explanation: 【译文】用强度好、有足够克重厚度的白纸，消除双面印刷时的过度透印。【词汇】strength characteristics=强度特性，show-through=透印，weight and substance=克重厚度，eliminate=消除。【解析】A正确：enough对应sufficient，print leakage对应show-through（背面透显）。B动词错：delete（删除）≠eliminate（消除）。C结构错：ink show-through the paper缺介词，overmuch用法陈旧不规范。

question: Format and layout is to be determined by the CAP producer, recognizing that it is desirable that the format and layout should be similar to the producer's existing documents

options.A: The CAP compiler should determine the format and layout, it is desirable that the format and layout should be similar to the compiler's current documents.
options.B: The format and layout should be determined by the CAP producer, it is intended that the format and layout shall be similar to the producer's existing files.
options.C: The format and layout should be determined by the CAP producer, recognized that it is desirable the format and layout should be the same as the producer's existing documentaries.

explanation: 【译文】格式版式由CAP编制者确定，但最好与编制者现有文件保持一致。【词汇】format and layout=格式与版式，it is desirable that=最好是，existing documents=现有文件。【解析】A正确：compiler对应producer，current documents对应existing documents，desirable保留。B两处偏：it is intended≠desirable；files不如documents贴切且shall语气过强。C三处错：recognized that语法不通；documentaries意为纪录片；the same as强于similar to。

question: Sometimes you must break long sentences into shorter ones, delete information which is not necessary, or ask an engineer for further explanation.

options.A: Sometimes you have to change long sentences to shorter ones, remove unnecessary information, or ask an engineer to get further explanation.
options.B: Some time you have to incorporate long sentences into shorter ones, decrease unnecessary information, or require an engineer for further instruction.
options.C: Sometime you must illuminate long sentences into shorter ones, ignore information which is not necessary, or order an engineer for further definition.

explanation: 【译文】有时须把长句拆成短句、删去不必要的信息或请工程师进一步解释。【词汇】break…into=拆分为，delete=删除，ask…for further explanation=请…进一步解释。【解析】A正确：change to shorter ones、remove、ask an engineer三动作齐全对应。B词义全错：incorporate（合并）≠break；decrease（减少）≠delete；instruction（指示）≠explanation。C逐词错译：illuminate（照亮）、ignore（忽视）、order（命令）、definition（定义）全偏。

question: Using the wet wing concept, all fuel is stored in three tanks, main tank 1, main tank 2, and center tank, which are constructed of the primary wing structure.

options.A: Using the wet wing concept, all fuel is stored in three tanks. These three tanks include main tank 1, main tank 2 and center tank. Center tanks are made up of the main wing structure.
options.B: Using the wet wing concept, all fuel is stored in three tanks. These three tanks include main tank 1, main tank 2 and center tank. These three tanks are made up of the main wing structure.
options.C: Using the wet wing concept, all fuel is stored in three tanks. These three tanks include main tank 1, main tank 2 and center tank. The primary wing structure consists of main tank 2 and center tank.

explanation: 【译文】采用湿翼概念时全部燃油存于三个油箱——1号主油箱、2号主油箱和中央油箱，均由机翼主结构构成。【词汇】wet wing=湿翼，center tank=中央油箱，primary wing structure=机翼主结构。【解析】B正确：These three tanks are made up of the main wing structure表达三油箱均由机翼主结构构成。A范围缩小：只译Center tanks，缩小为仅中央油箱。C颠倒且漏项：反转成“机翼结构由2号主油箱和中央油箱组成”，且漏1号主油箱。

question: The positive pressure relief valves are fail safe devices that bleed fuselage pressure overboard if the aft outflow valve fails closed.

options.A: The positive pressure relief valves are fail safe devices. If the aft outflow valve cann’t be closed, these positive pressure relief valves bleed fuselage pressure overboard.
options.B: The positive pressure relief valves are fail safe devices. If the positive pressure relief valves fails closed, these aft outflow valve bleed fuselage pressure overboard.
options.C: The positive pressure relief valves are fail safe devices. If the aft outflow valve fails closed, these positive pressure relief valves bleed fuselage pressure overboard.

explanation: 【译文】正压释压活门是故障安全装置，后外流活门故障关闭时将机身压力排出机外。【词汇】fail safe=故障安全，bleed overboard=排出机外，aft outflow valve=后外流活门，fails closed=故障关位。【解析】C正确：条件主语aft outflow valve与动作主语relief valves与原文一致。A条件错：can't be closed（无法关）≠fails closed（故障停在关位）。B主客颠倒：两活门角色互换，错成“释压活门故障→外流活门排气”。

question: A clogged air filter causes low flow through the equipment cooling supply system. Replacement of the air filter on a regular maintenance schedule is necessary. Release the quick release tabs on the air filter housing cover to get access to the filters.

options.A: Air filter needs to be replaced on regular maintenance schedule, because it often causes low flow through the equipment cooling supply system. Quickly release the tabs on the air filter housing cover to reach the filters.
options.B: Low flow through the equipment cooling supply system is caused by a contaminated air filter, therefore regular replacement is necessary, release the quick release tabs on the air filter housing cover to approach to the filters.
options.C: A blocked air filter which causes low flow through the equipment cooling supply system needs replacement on a regular maintenance schedule. Release the quick release tabs on the air filter housing cover to reach the filters.

explanation: 【译文】堵塞的空气滤芯会使设备冷却供气系统流量降低，须按定期维护计划更换。松开滤壳体盖上的快卸卡扣即可接近滤芯。【词汇】clogged=堵塞的，low flow=流量低，quick release tabs=快卸卡扣，get access to=接近。【解析】C正确：blocked、low flow、regular schedule、quick release tabs、reach the filters全对应。A两处错：often为添加；Quickly release the tabs把“快卸卡扣”误读为“快速松开卡扣”。B两处瑕疵：approach to搭配不当；contaminated（污染）不如clogged（堵塞）准确。

question: When accumulated revisions, including back-up pages, total over 60% of the total pages in the manual, a reissue of the manual should be prepared.

options.A: When the cumulative revised pages (including back-up pages) exceeds 60% of the total pages of the manual, a reissue should be prepared.
options.B: If the updated pages, including back-up pages, were less than 60% of the total page of the manual, a new manual should be copied.
options.C: Up to 60% of total pages (including back-up pages) were accumulated by mistake, the manual should be rewritten.

explanation: 【译文】当累积修订页（含备用页）总数超过手册总页数60%时，应准备重新发布手册。【词汇】accumulated revisions=累积修订，back-up pages=备用页，reissue=重新发布。【解析】A正确：cumulative pages、exceeds 60%、reissue全对应。B方向相反：less than 60%与over 60%相反；copied≠reissue。C三处错：Up to 60%含混；by mistake无中生有；rewritten（重写）≠reissue（改版）。

question: Space permitting, legends shall be spelled out within the diagram rather than abbreviated by numerals to a list of legends at the bottom or on an adjacent page.

options.A: It is permitted to show the legends within the diagram instead of listing at the bottom or on an adjacent page by the abbreviation number.
options.B: Legends shall be explained in a simple way within the diagram at the bottom or on an adjacent page  except for abbreviation with numbers in a list.
options.C: If the space is enough, the legends shall be stated within the diagram and do not list them by numerical abbreviations at the bottom or on an adjacent page.

explanation: 【译文】空间允许时，图例应在图内完整拼写标注，而非用数字缩写在图底部或相邻页列表。【词汇】space permitting=空间允许，legend=图例，spell out=完整拼写，abbreviated by numerals=用数字缩写。【解析】C正确：If the space is enough对应Space permitting，stated within the diagram与“不用数字缩写列表”均对应。A误读状语：Space permitting错成It is permitted（被允许）。B逻辑错置：except for abbreviation把否定对象变成例外，意思相反。

question: If the clearance dimension is out of tolerance, adjust the clearance dimension between the extend proximity sensor [44A] and the target [45]. Some of the ducts in the air distribution system are wrapped with insulation material.

options.A: If the clearance dimension is not accurate, adjust the clearance dimension between the extend proximity sensor [44A] and the target [45]. Some of the ducts in the air distribution system are wrapped with insulation material.
options.B: Adjust the clearance dimension between the extend proximity sensor [44A] and the target [45] in case of the clearance dimension is out of tolerance. Some of the ducts in the air distribution system are wrapped with non-conductive material .
options.C: Adjust the clearance dimension between the extend proximity sensor [44A] and the target [45] until the clearance dimension is out of range. Some of the ducts in the air distribution system are wrapped with compound material.

explanation: 【译文】间隙尺寸超差时，调整伸出式接近传感器[44A]与靶标[45]间的间隙。气源分配系统部分导管包有绝缘材料。【词汇】clearance dimension=间隙尺寸，out of tolerance=超差，proximity sensor=接近传感器，insulation material=绝缘材料。【解析】A正确：not accurate近似out of tolerance，传感器、靶标、insulation material保留。B材料错：non-conductive仅指电绝缘，原文insulation泛指隔热绝缘，范围缩窄。C两处错：until out of range把调整目的说反；compound material≠insulation。

question: As necessary, use the applicable SAFETY BARRIERS, specified by the operator's instructions and your local regulations. These communications are subjected to atmospheric disturbances and difficult to understand.

options.A: As necessary, use the applicable SAFETY BARRIERS, classified by the operator's instructions and your local regulations. These communications are subjected to atmospheric interference and difficult to understand.
options.B: Use the applicable SAFETY BARRIERS, specified by the operator's instructions and your local regulations if necessary. These communications are affected by the atmosphere and difficult to understand.
options.C: Use the applicable SAFETY BARRIERS, classified by the operator's instructions and your local regulations if necessary. These communications are subjected to atmospheric interference and difficult to understand.

explanation: 【译文】必要时使用运营人说明和当地法规规定的适用安全屏障。这些通信受大气扰动影响难以理解。【词汇】safety barriers=安全屏障，specified by=由…规定，atmospheric disturbances=大气扰动。【解析】B正确：specified by保留，if necessary对应as necessary，affected by the atmosphere对应subjected to disturbances。A动词错：classified by（分类）≠specified by（规定）。C同错：仍用classified by，与A同类词义错译。

question: The Check List may be arranged by "Challenge" and "Response" headings for two pilot airplanes or by "Item" and "Condition" headings for single pilot Airplanes.

options.A: The Check List may be designed by "Challenge" and "Response" headings or by "Item" and "Condition" headings for two pilot airplanes or for single pilot Airplanes.
options.B: The Check List for the pilot may be set by "Challenge" and "Response" headings for two  airplanes or by "Item" and "Condition" headings for single Airplane.
options.C: For two pilot airplanes, "Challenge" and "Response" headings may be used on the Check List. For single pilot Airplanes, "Item" and "Condition" headings may be used.

explanation: 【译文】检查单可按“提问/回答”栏编排（双飞行员飞机）或按“项目/状态”栏编排（单飞行员飞机）。【词汇】Challenge/Response=提问/回答，Item/Condition=项目/状态，headings=栏目标题。【解析】C正确：两组标题与两机型对应关系明确拆开，映射无误。A关系含糊：两种标题与两机型混列，未体现各自对应。B漏要素：two airplanes、single Airplane丢pilot，暗示成双发/单发飞机。

question: This Section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall clearly and precisely describe the recommended procedures for the conduct of normal operations.

options.A: This section of the pilot's manual should clearly and confusedly provide recommended procedures for conducting normal operations.
options.B: The recommended procedures for conducting normal operations shall be described in this Section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook clearly and accurately.
options.C: The recommended procedures shall be stated in this Section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook clearly and fuzzily for the conduct of normal operations.

explanation: 【译文】《飞行员操作手册》本节应清晰准确地描述正常运行推荐的操作程序。【词汇】clearly and precisely=清晰准确地，recommended procedures=推荐程序，normal operations=正常运行。【解析】B正确：clearly and accurately对应clearly and precisely，程序、本节、正常运行要素全。A自相矛盾：clearly and confusedly（清晰且混乱）语义冲突。C关键错词：fuzzily（模糊地）与precisely方向相反。

question: Rafts passing tests and inspections may remain in service indefinitely since the inflation tests and material inspections will identify and condemn rafts having more than minor installation defects.

options.A: Because the inflation tests and material inspections can identify and condemn rafts which have more than minor installation defects, rafts which pass the tests and inspections may be in service for a period time with no fixed limit.
options.B: As the inflation tests and material inspections can affirm and declare the minor installation defects of the rafts, rafts checked by tests and inspections may come into service with no definition.
options.C: Rafts succeed in tests and inspections may keep the service indefinitely from a time that the inflation tests and material inspections identified and announced the rafts with many minor installation defects.

explanation: 【译文】通过测试检查的救生筏可无限期服役，因充气测试和材料检查会识别并报废缺陷超轻微限度的救生筏。【词汇】raft=救生筏，indefinitely=无限期，identify and condemn=识别报废，minor defects=轻微缺陷。【解析】A正确：no fixed limit对应indefinitely，more than minor defects保留限度。B弱化：affirm and declare≠identify and condemn；with no definition（无定义）≠indefinitely。C逻辑错：from a time that…identified时态错置，announced≠condemned。

question: On schematic diagrams with a large number of listed items, the items shall be presented in a logical order, such as the sequence of the arrangement of the items in the airplane.

options.A: The schematic diagrams need to list a lot of instructions, so the items listed are ordered according to certain rules, this is the order in which the items are placed on the plane.
options.B: There are schematics which need to list a lot of items, so the items listed should be sorted according to certain rules, such as the order in which the items are placed on the plane.
options.C: List a large number of schematics in logical order, such as the position of the items on the plane.

explanation: 【译文】列项很多的原理图应按逻辑顺序排列项目，如按其在飞机上布置的顺序。【词汇】listed items=列项，logical order=逻辑顺序，sequence=顺序，such as=例如。【解析】B正确：sorted according to rules对应logical order，such as保留举例关系。A举例关系丢失：such as错成this is（这就是）；instructions≠items。C主宾错置：List schematics把“列项”错成“列原理图”，修饰对象张冠李戴。

question: As per Boeing Docs, related ADs, changing the size of the thrust reverser upper locking actuator lock sensor target could delay or prevent detection of the failure of the locking mechanism of a thrust reverser upper locking actuator.

options.A: According to Boeing Docs and associated ADs, changing the dimension of the thrust reverser upper locking actuator lock sensor target can result in slow detection of the failure or undetected failure.
options.B: Based on the Boeing Docs and the associated ADs, if the size of the thrust reverser upper locking actuator lock sensor target is increased, it may result in delayed or undetected the  actuator failure.
options.C: As described in Boeing Docs and the associated ADs, if the orientation of the locking actuator on the thrust reverser locking sensor target changes, the actuator failure will be delayed or undetected.

explanation: 【译文】据波音文件和相关适航指令，改变反推上锁作动筒锁传感器靶标尺寸可能延迟或阻碍对锁紧机构故障的探测。【词汇】thrust reverser=反推装置，locking actuator=锁作动筒，sensor target=传感器靶标，prevent detection=阻碍探测。【解析】A正确：dimension对应size，slow detection or undetected failure对应delay or prevent detection。B两处错：is increased（增大）≠changing；undetected the failure语法残缺。C对象错：orientation of the actuator≠size of the target，改动对象张冠李戴。

question: For purposes of this specification, "airplane" refers to the airframe and related components specified in the Type Certificate or made available as options by the airplane manufacturer.

options.A: For purposes of this specification, "aircraft" means the relevant optional parts of the airframe and parts specified in the type certificate or supplied by the aircraft manufacturer
options.B: For the intention of this specification, " airplane" is know as the airframe selective components set forth in the Type Certificate or provided by the airplane producer.
options.C: For purposes of this specification, "aircraft" means the airframe and parts specified in the Type Certificate or the related optional parts supplied by the aircraft manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】就本规范而言，“飞机”指机体及型号合格证规定的或制造商作为选装项提供的相关部件。【词汇】airframe=机体，related components=相关部件，Type Certificate=型号合格证，options=选装项。【解析】C正确：airframe and parts specified in the TC or optional parts supplied两类部件齐全。A结构错乱：optional parts of the airframe and parts specified in the TC层次被破坏。B两处错：airframe selective components概念错误；is know as语法错误。

question: Recommended Fuel Conservation Information shall be integrated into this section to show the pilot how to minimize fuel usage during operation of the airplane.

options.A: Suggested Fuel Conservation Information shall be incorporated into this section to show the pilot how to reduce the fuel usage to a minimum.
options.B: In order to show the pilot how to take full advantage of fuel during operation of the airplane, Suggested Fuel Conservation Information shall be merged into this section.
options.C: Approved Fuel Conservation Information shall be merged into this section so as to show the pilot the fuel usage during operation of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】应将推荐的节油信息纳入本节，向飞行员表明运行中如何将油耗降至最低。【词汇】Fuel Conservation=节油，integrated into=纳入，minimize fuel usage=油耗降至最低。【解析】A正确：Suggested、incorporated、reduce…to a minimum三考点全对应。B语义扭曲：take full advantage of fuel把“最小化油耗”错成“充分利用燃油”。C两处错：Approved≠Recommended；丢掉minimize核心要求。

question: The rules contained in this specification shall serve as guides for format, style and method of presentation for all material included in Maintenance Manuals prepared by manufacturers.

options.A: The function of the rules in this specification is to direct the revising of all materials that are contained in Maintenance Manuals prepared by manufacturers.
options.B: With respect to format, style and method of presenting for all materials which are contained in Maintenance Manuals prepared by manufacturers, you can refer to the rules that are included in this specification.
options.C: When presenting format, style and method for rules of this specification, all materials of Maintenance Manuals prepared by manufacturers shall be accorded with.

explanation: 【译文】本规范所载规则应作为制造商编制的维护手册中所有材料的格式、文体和表述方法指南。【词汇】serve as guides=作为指南，method of presentation=表述方法，Maintenance Manuals=维护手册。【解析】B正确：refer to the rules对应serve as guides，三要素与材料范围齐全。A动宾错配：direct the revising把“表述指南”错成“指导修订材料”。C主被动颠倒：materials shall be accorded with把“规则指导材料”反转为“材料须符合规则”。

question: Limitations contained in this Section shall be clearly noted and cross-referenced to the appropriate paragraph in Section 2 of the Handbook.

options.A: This Section shall be clearly stated and cross-referenced to the proper paragraph in Section 2 of the Handbook which consists of limitations.
options.B: This Section contains limitations which shall be clearly stated and cross-referenced to the proper paragraph in Section 2 of the Handbook.
options.C: The proper paragraph in Section 2 of the Handbook shall describe and cross-reference this Section included in this limitations.

explanation: 【译文】本节包含的限制应明确标注，并交叉引用到手册第2节的相应段落。【词汇】limitations=限制，clearly noted=明确标注，cross-referenced to=交叉引用到，Section=节。【解析】B正确：limitations…stated and cross-referenced to the proper paragraph in Section 2方向要素均对。A偷换主语：错成“本节被陈述引用”，且误说Section 2由limitations组成。C方向相反：让第2节段落去引用本节，引用方向反转。

question: In addition to this example of style and format for a CAP, a manufacturer may use its publication style manual or another appropriate style manual.

options.A: 编写CAP手册时除参考本规范的样式和格式外，制造商也可以使用自己出版物的格式或其他适当格式。
options.B: 除了这个CAP的风格和格式的例子外，制造商可以使用其出版风格手册或其他适当的风格手册。
options.C: 除了CAP的样式和格式示例外，制造商还可以使用其出版物样式手册或其他适当的样式手册。

explanation: 【译文】除这种CAP样式格式示例外，制造商还可使用其出版物样式手册或其他适当的样式手册。【词汇】in addition to=除…外，style and format=样式和格式，publication style manual=出版物样式手册。【解析】C正确：CAP样式格式示例与出版物样式手册对应准确。A两处错：本规范为添加信息；出版物的格式把style manual弱化为格式。B偏正错位：这个CAP的例子把for a CAP错成“CAP的”，风格不及样式贴切。

question: NOTE: The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III and the necessary information has been included in the Objectives.

options.A: 注：在本规范CAP III节的样例中，“前言”省略了，必要的信息已经包含在“目标”中了。
options.B: 注：第三节的CAP样本中省略了“前言”，“目标”中包含了必要的信息。
options.C: 注：CAP样例的第III节“前言”部分并未包含任何内容，相关必要信息已包含在“目标”部分中。

explanation: 【译文】注：第三节的CAP样例中省略了“前言”部分，必要信息已包含在“目标”中。【词汇】Preface=前言，omit=省略，sample CAP=CAP样例/样本，Section III=第三节，Objectives=目标。【解析】B正确：第三节的CAP样本对应the sample CAP in Section III，省略了前言对应has been omitted，目标中包含了必要的信息完整对应。A定语错位：本规范CAP III节的样例把in Section III错断为“本规范CAP的III节”，且添加了“本规范”。C结构误读：CAP样例的第III节“前言”部分并未包含任何内容，把“前言被省略”错成“第III节前言部分无内容”，被动关系译错。

question: Both digits of Chapter Number in the Continuing Airworthiness Program lnspection number are determined by GAMA Specification No. 2 Numbering System.

options.A: 《持续适航维修大纲》检查文件编号中系统代号的两位数字应使用GAMA第2号规范的编号体系。
options.B: 在《持续适航维修大纲》检查文件编号中，代表章号的两位数字应遵循GAMA 第2号规范的编号体系。
options.C: 《持续适航维修大纲》检查文件编号中的两个数字应由GAMA第2号规范中的编号系统决定。

explanation: 【译文】《持续适航维修大纲》检查编号中表章号的两位数字由GAMA第2号规范编号体系确定。【词汇】Chapter Number=章号，both digits=两位数字，numbering system=编号体系。【解析】B正确：代表章号的两位数字对应Both digits of Chapter Number，限定完整。C漏限定：两个数字丢of Chapter Number，范围被扩大。A术语偏：系统代号是解释性说法，不如“章号”直接对应。

question: This reporting system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.

options.A: 这一报告系统并非用于取代《持续适航维修大纲（CAP）》未涵盖项目的常规沟通渠道。
options.B: 这个系统并不取代正常的沟通渠道，进而处理《持续适航维修大纲（CAP）》不涉及的项目。
options.C: 该报告系统不会阻碍《持续适航维修大纲（CAP）》未涵盖项目的正常交流。

explanation: 【译文】本报告系统并不取代CAP未涵盖项目的正常沟通渠道。【词汇】reporting system=报告系统，supersede=取代，channels of communication=沟通渠道，items covered by=涵盖的项目。【解析】A正确：并非用于取代对应does not supersede，常规沟通渠道对应normal channels of communication，未涵盖项目对应not covered by the CAP。B结构扭曲：进而处理把原句否定判断改写成目的承接，加了“处理”动作且supersede未译出“取代”。C词义错译：不会阻碍把supersede（取代）错译为hinder（阻碍），动词词义错误。

question: The operator may use standard ABC Condition Report form(s) or an equivalent containing the same information.

options.A: 运营人可以使用标准的ABC“状况报告表”或包含相同信息的同等表格。
options.B: 运营人可使用ABC公司标准的“状况报告表”或其他等效表格。
options.C: 飞行员可以使用标准的ABC“条件报告表”或包含相同信息的同等表格。

explanation: 【译文】运营人可以使用标准的ABC状况报告表或包含相同信息的等效表格。【词汇】operator=运营人，Condition Report=状况报告，form=表格，equivalent=等效物/同等表格，containing the same information=包含相同信息。【解析】A正确：运营人对应operator，标准的ABC状况报告表与包含相同信息的同等表格两处定语齐全。B两处错误：ABC公司标准的把ABC误作公司名修饰；其他等效表格漏译containing the same information这一限定。C两处错误：飞行员≠operator（运营人）；条件报告表对Condition Report的译法不如“状况报告”贴切。

question: Vertical Stabilizer Tip Rib Modification

options.A: 垂直安定面上翼肋改装
options.B: 垂直安定面翼尖翼梁改装
options.C: 垂直安定面翼尖缘条改装

explanation: 【译文】垂直安定面翼尖肋改装。【词汇】Vertical Stabilizer=垂直安定面，Tip Rib=翼尖肋/端肋，Modification=改装，spar=翼梁（干扰项），flange=缘条（干扰项）。【解析】A正确：垂直安定面对应Vertical Stabilizer，翼肋对应rib，是三个选项中唯一把rib译对的（“上”字指示翼尖位置）。B构件错译：翼梁对应spar而非rib，把肋材错成梁材。C构件错译：缘条对应flange而非rib，同样是构件张冠李戴。

question: Additional weight and balance and related information may be provided.

options.A: 可以提供额外的重量和平衡数据以及相关信息。
options.B: 应当提供与额外的重量和平衡相关的信息。
options.C: 可以提供额外的配重和配平以及相关信息。

explanation: 【译文】可以提供额外的重量与平衡信息及相关信息。【词汇】additional=额外的，weight and balance=重量与平衡，related information=相关信息，may be provided=可以提供。【解析】A正确：重量和平衡对应weight and balance，可以提供保留may的或然语气，相关信息对应related information。B两处错误：应当提供把may（可以）错成shall（应当）的强制语气；且把“重量和平衡数据+相关信息”重组为“与额外重量平衡相关的信息”，信息范围变窄。C术语错译：配重和配平是配载调整操作，weight and balance规范译名为“重量与平衡”，概念被偷换。

question: The manufacturer should use formats appropriate to the specific airplane and the size of the Pilot's Operating Handbook.

options.A: 制造商应使用适合于特定飞行器和《飞行员操作手册》尺寸的格式。
options.B: 制造商应使用格式来适合特定飞机和《飞行员操作手册》尺寸。
options.C: 制造商使用的格式应与具体的飞机以及《飞行员操作手册》尺寸相适合。

explanation: 【译文】制造商应使用适合特定飞机和《飞行员操作手册》幅面尺寸的格式。【词汇】format=格式，appropriate to=适合于，specific airplane=特定飞机，size=尺寸/幅面，Pilot's Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册。【解析】A正确：适合于特定飞行器和手册尺寸的格式完整保留appropriate to的两个对象，应使用对应should use。B句式杂糅：使用格式来适合把appropriate to的定语关系错成目的关系，“用格式来适合”表达不通。C语体偏差：制造商使用的格式应与…相适合把主动“使用适合的格式”改成对格式的被动描述，且“与具体飞机相适合”搭配生硬。

question: This paragraph describes the procedure for establishing weight and moment (relative to reference datum) of the empty airplane.

options.A: 本段描述了建立空机重量和力矩（相对于参考基准面）的程序。
options.B: 本段描述了确定空机重量和力矩（相对于基准点）的程序。
options.C: 本段描述了确定空机重量和力矩（与参考基准面有关）的程序。

explanation: 【译文】本段描述确定空机重量和力矩（相对于参考基准面）的程序。【词汇】establishing=确定/建立，weight and moment=重量和力矩，reference datum=参考基准面，empty airplane=空机，procedure=程序。【解析】A正确：建立对应establishing，空机重量和力矩与相对于参考基准面两个要素准确，datum译“基准面”符合配载术语。B术语不准：基准点把datum（基准面/基准线）译成“点”，配载计算中的基准是平面而非点。C措辞欠准：与参考基准面有关把relative to（相对于）弱化为“有关”，基准的参照关系表达含糊。

question: The calculation procedures and “basic empty weight” data used in loading calculations shall be explained.

options.A: 应说明载荷计算中使用的配载程序和“基本空重”考量。
options.B: 应说明配载计算时使用的计算程序和“基本空重”数据。
options.C: 应说明需在载荷计算中使用计算程序和“操作空重”数据。

explanation: 【译文】应说明配载计算中使用的计算程序和“基本空重”数据。【词汇】calculation procedures=计算程序，basic empty weight=基本空重，loading calculations=配载计算，data=数据，be explained=予以说明。【解析】B正确：计算程序和基本空重数据两个并列要素对应准确，配载计算对应loading calculations。A两处错译：配载程序把calculation procedures错成loading procedures；考量≠data（数据）。C两处错误：需在载荷计算中使用计算程序句式杂糅；操作空重≠basic empty weight（基本空重），重量类型张冠李戴。

question: Equipment without significant effect on the weight or balance of the airplane need not be listed.

options.A: 对改变飞机重量或平衡有显著效果的设备不需要列出。
options.B: 对飞机重量或平衡无显著影响的设备无须包含在此清单中。
options.C: 对飞机重量或平衡没有显著影响的设备需要列出。

explanation: 【译文】对飞机重量或平衡无显著影响的设备不必列出。【词汇】significant effect=显著影响，weight or balance=重量或平衡，need not=不必，be listed=被列出。【解析】B正确：无显著影响对应without significant effect，无须包含在清单中对应need not be listed，否定与范围均对。A范围错误：对改变飞机重量或平衡有显著效果的设备把without（无）译成“有”，恰恰列出相反的对象。C情态译反：没有显著影响的设备需要列出把need not（不必）译成“需要”，要求方向相反。

question: Describe each equipment list item and show its weight and airplane location, with respect to the datum.

options.A: 描述每条设备列表条目，并显示其重量和相对于飞机基准面的位置。
options.B: 描述每个设备清单项，并显示其有关基准面的重量和飞机位置。
options.C: 逐一描述清单中的每项设备，并显示其重量和相对于飞机基准点的位置。

explanation: 【译文】描述设备清单中的每一个条目，并给出其重量以及相对于基准面的机上位置。【词汇】equipment list item=设备清单条目，airplane location=机上位置，with respect to the datum=相对于基准面，describe=描述，weight=重量。【解析】A正确：每条设备列表条目对应each item，其重量和相对于基准面的位置对应its weight and airplane location with respect to the datum，基准面译法正确。B修饰错位：其有关基准面的重量和飞机位置把“相对于基准面”错挂到重量上，变成重量与基准面有关。C术语偏差：基准点把datum（基准面）错译成点，配载基准为平面而非点。

question: In the description of the airplane's Flight Controls, operating mechanism shall be described, and if necessary, sketches shall be provided.

options.A: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应描述运行机构、提供示意图。
options.B: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应描述操纵原理，如必要，还应提供示意图。
options.C: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应描述所有的操作机械，并在必须要时提供平面图。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明其操纵机构的工作原理，必要时还应提供示意图。【词汇】Flight Controls=飞行控制系统，operating mechanism=操纵机构/工作原理，if necessary=必要时，sketches=示意图，be provided=应提供。【解析】B正确：操纵原理对应operating mechanism（操纵机构工作原理），如必要对应if necessary，示意图对应sketches，条件要素齐全。A漏译条件：应描述运行机构、提供示意图丢掉if necessary（必要时）这一前提，且“运行机构”不如操纵原理贴切。C两处错误：所有的操作机械添加“所有”且机械一词生硬；平面图≠sketches（示意图），图纸类型错。

question: In the description of the airplane's Flight Controls, trimming arrangements shall be explained.

options.A: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明平衡设置。
options.B: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应对相应的配平装置进行描述。
options.C: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应解释配平安排。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应对配平装置进行说明。【词汇】trimming arrangements=配平装置/配平设置，be explained=应予以说明，Flight Controls=飞行控制系统，arrangement=装置/布局。【解析】B正确：配平装置对应trimming arrangements，进行描述对应shall be explained，术语“配平”准确。A术语不准：平衡设置把trimming（配平）错成balancing（平衡），配平与平衡是不同概念。C措辞生硬：配平安排按arrangement字面直译，“安排”不用于描述机械装置，且“解释”不如“描述/说明”符合手册语体。

question: In the description of the airplane's Flight Controls, any interconnect arrangement shall be explained.

options.A: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明任何交叉连接设置。
options.B: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明任何互联装置。
options.C: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明任何内部连接设置。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机飞行控制系统时，应说明任何交联（交叉连接）设置。【词汇】interconnect arrangement=交联/互联设置，be explained=应予以说明，any=任何，Flight Controls=飞行控制系统。【解析】A正确：交叉连接对应interconnect（如左右驾驶杆、脚蹬的交联），设置对应arrangement，两个词素均有落实。B部件译名偏差：互联装置把arrangement（设置/布局）译成“装置”（device），由抽象布局变成具体设备，语义偏移。C词素错译：内部连接把interconnect（系统间互连）错成“内部连接”（intra-connect），inter-前缀含义译反。

question: In the description of the airplane's Flight Controls, if controls are boosted, the revelant systems shall be explained.

options.A: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，如果操作增强，说明系统。
options.B: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，用系统说明操纵增强。
options.C: 描述飞机飞行控制系统时，如果安装了控制增强系统，应对相应的系统进行描述。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机飞行控制系统时，如果操纵面采用助力（增强）操纵，应对相应的系统进行说明。【词汇】controls are boosted=操纵面助力/增强操纵，relevant systems=相应系统，be explained=应予以说明，boosted=助力的、增强的。【解析】C正确：如果安装了控制增强系统把boosted的条件含义完整译出，相应的系统对应relevant systems。A多处压缩：如果操作增强把controls（操纵面/操纵）译成“操作”，说明系统丢掉relevant和shall be explained的语体。B句式混乱：用系统说明操纵增强把条件句错成方式状语，原句“如果…则应说明系统”的逻辑关系被破坏。

question: In the description of the airplane's Baggage Compartments, tips on loading shall be given.

options.A: 在描述飞机行李舱时，应给出装载提示。
options.B: 在描述飞机行李舱时，应给出压力提示。
options.C: 在描述飞机行李舱时，应给出加载提示。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机行李舱时，应给出装载方面的提示。【词汇】Baggage Compartments=行李舱，tips on loading=装载提示，shall be given=应给出，loading=装载。【解析】A正确：装载对应loading（货物行李的装载），提示对应tips，简洁准确。B词义错译：压力提示把loading（装载）错成pressure（压力），关键词完全译错。C用词欠准：加载提示中“加载”多指计算机载入或结构载荷，行李装载的规范用语为“装载”。

question: In the description of the airplane's Lighting Systems, the various interior and exterior lighting systems shall be described.

options.A: 描述飞机打光系统时，应描述各种内部和外部打光系统。
options.B: 描述飞机灯光系统时，应描述飞机的各个内部和外部灯光系统。
options.C: 描述飞机灯光系统时，应描述各种向内和向外的应急灯光系统。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机灯光系统时，应描述各种内部和外部灯光系统。【词汇】Lighting Systems=灯光系统，interior and exterior=内部和外部，various=各种，be described=应描述。【解析】B正确：灯光系统对应lighting systems，内部和外部对应interior and exterior，各个对应various。A术语错译：打光系统把lighting（照明）错成舞台“打光”，非航空术语。C两处错误：应急灯光为原文没有的限定（emergency属添加）；向内和向外按interior/exterior字面错译成方向副词。

question: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, construction shall be described.

options.A: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述其相应的结构（构件）。
options.B: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述其建设。
options.C: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述施工方法。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机起落架时，应描述其结构（构造）。【词汇】Landing Gear=起落架，construction=结构/构造，be described=应描述，corresponding=相应的。【解析】A正确：结构（构件）对应construction（机械构造含义），表述准确。B词义错译：其建设把construction（构造）错成“建设”（建造活动），语境完全不符。C词义错译：施工方法把名词construction错译成method（方法），静态构造被偷换成动态过程。

question: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, retraction mechanism, if provided, shall be described.

options.A: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述收回方法（如有）。
options.B: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述撤回机构（如有）。
options.C: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述起落架收上机制（如有）。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机起落架时，如装有收放机构，应对起落架收上机构进行描述。【词汇】retraction mechanism=收放/收上机构，if provided=如装有，be described=应描述，retraction=收上（起落架收起）。【解析】C正确：起落架收上机制对应retraction mechanism，收上是起落架回缩的规范术语，（如有）对应if provided。A构件错译：收回方法把mechanism（机构）错成method（方法），实体机构被偷换成抽象做法。B用词不准：撤回机构中“撤回”指撤销撤退（如撤军），起落架收起的术语是“收上/收放”，不是“撤回”。

question: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, shock absorption system shall be described.

options.A: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述减震系统。
options.B: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述放重装系统。
options.C: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述冲击避免系统。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机起落架时，应描述减震系统。【词汇】shock absorption=减震/缓冲，system=系统，Landing Gear=起落架，be described=应描述。【解析】A正确：减震系统对应shock absorption system，是起落架缓冲装置的规范术语。B词义错译：放重装系统系对shock absorption的胡乱拆解，无任何对应关系。C词义错译：冲击避免系统把absorption（吸收缓冲）错成avoidance（避免），减震是吸收冲击而非避免冲击。

question: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, wheel brakes shall be described.

options.A: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述前轮制动。
options.B: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述机轮刹车。
options.C: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述机轮停车。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机起落架时，应描述机轮刹车。【词汇】wheel brakes=机轮刹车/机轮制动，Landing Gear=起落架，be described=应描述，brake=刹车。【解析】B正确：机轮刹车对应wheel brakes，术语准确。A范围错误：前轮制动把wheel（机轮，泛指）限定成“前轮”，范围被缩窄为仅前起落架机轮。C词义错译：机轮停车把brakes（刹车）错成parking（停车），刹车装置与停机动作混淆。

question: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, its emergency extension system shall be explained.

options.A: 描述飞机起落架时，应说明应急展开系统。
options.B: 描述飞机起落架时，应描述起落架应急放出系统。
options.C: 描述飞机起落架时，应说明应急逃生系统。

explanation: 【译文】描述飞机起落架时，应对其应急放出系统进行说明。【词汇】emergency extension system=应急放出系统，be explained=应予以说明，Landing Gear=起落架，extension=放出（起落架放下）。【解析】B正确：起落架应急放出系统完整对应，extension在起落架语境指“放出/放下”，术语规范。A术语欠准：应急展开系统中“展开”（deploy）多用于伞具、翼面等，起落架放下的规范说法是“放出”。C张冠李戴：应急逃生系统把extension system（放起落架的系统）错成escape system（逃生系统），系统功能完全译错。

question: If the flap extension does not agree with the position of the flap control lever, do the rigging procedure again.

options.A: 如果襟翼的伸出量与控制杆的位置不一致，重复校装程序。
options.B: 如果襟翼的放出量和襟翼手柄位置不一致，再做一次测试程序。
options.C: 如果襟翼扩大的幅度与襟翼手柄位置不一致，重复一次测试程序。

explanation: 【译文】如果襟翼放出量与襟翼操纵手柄位置不一致，应重新执行校装程序。【词汇】flap extension=襟翼放出量，agree with=与…一致，flap control lever=襟翼操纵手柄，rigging procedure=校装程序，do again=重新做。【解析】A正确：伸出量对应extension，与控制杆位置不一致对应does not agree with，校装程序对应rigging（操纵系统校装），考点全对。B术语错译：测试程序把rigging（校装/校调）错成test（测试），程序性质完全不同。C两处错误：扩大的幅度把extension错译成“扩大”；测试程序同样把rigging错译成测试。

question: The charts, diagrams, and text show the area, dimensions, stations, access doors and physical locations, of the structural members of the aircraft.

options.A: 飞机结构件的面积、尺寸、站位、接近门以及物理位置由表、图和文本表示。
options.B: 飞机结构件的面积、尺寸、纵剖面、接近门以及物理位置由表、图和文本表示。
options.C: 飞机结构件的面积、尺寸、水位线、接近门以及物理位置由表、图和文本表示。

explanation: 【译文】这些图表、图示和文字标明了飞机结构构件的区域、尺寸、站位、接近口盖和实际位置。【词汇】charts/diagrams=图表/图示，stations=站位（机身站位基准），access doors=接近口盖/检修门，structural members=结构构件，physical locations=实际位置。【解析】A正确：站位对应stations（飞机结构定位术语），接近门对应access doors，五个要素齐全。B术语错译：纵剖面把stations（站位）错成剖面图概念，站位是纵向定位基准线而非剖面。C术语错译：水位线把stations错成water lines，与机身站位无关，属张冠李戴。

question: The section 12-10 of AMM describes replenishing. It provides instructions necessary for the  replenishment of fuel , oil , hydraulic fluid , water, other fluids , tire pressure, etc…

options.A: AMM 的第 12章第10节是关于补给的。它提供了添加燃油、滑油、液压油、水、其他液体和轮胎充气等所需的说明。
options.B: AMM 的第 12章第10节是关于补液的。它提供了补给燃油、滑油、液压油、水、其他液体和轮胎压力等所需的说明。
options.C: AMM 的第 12章第10节是关于补液的。它提供了补给液压油、滑油、燃油、水、其他液体和轮胎压力等所需的说明。

explanation: 【译文】AMM第12-10节描述的是补给（勤务）内容，提供了加注燃油、滑油、液压油、水、其他液体以及轮胎充气等所需的说明。【词汇】replenishing=补给/补充加注，replenishment=补充加注，hydraulic fluid=液压油，tire pressure=轮胎气压（充气），AMM=飞机维护手册。【解析】A正确：补给对应replenishing，燃油滑油液压油的列举顺序一致，轮胎充气把tire pressure的动作含义准确译出。B两处偏差：补液把replenishing范围缩窄为仅液体补充；轮胎压力直译没有体现“充气”这一勤务动作。C同类错误：补液范围偏窄，且列举顺序改为液压油在前，与原文燃油在前的顺序不符。

question: The procedure that follows contains information as specified in the IATA Guidance Material on Standard Into-Plane Fueling Procedures.

options.A: 以下程序包含 IATA 关于标准飞机加油程序的指导材料中指定的信息。
options.B: 以下程序包含 IATA 关于标准飞机平面内加油程序的指导材料中指定的信息。
options.C: 以下程序包含 IATA 关于标准加油口加油程序的指导材料中指定的信息。

explanation: 【译文】下述程序包含IATA《标准进机加油程序指导材料》中规定的信息。【词汇】IATA=国际航空运输协会，Guidance Material=指导材料，Into-Plane Fueling=进机加油（直接向飞机油箱加油），specified=规定的，procedure=程序。【解析】A正确：标准飞机加油程序准确传达Into-Plane Fueling Procedures（向飞机内加油的程序），指导材料中指定的信息结构完整。B字面对译荒谬：飞机平面内加油把Into-Plane（进入飞机油箱）按plane的字面“平面”错译，语义不通。C缩窄范围：加油口加油把into-plane（进机）错成“加油口”，加油对象被偷换。

question:
"Scheduled Servicing" includes internal cleaning, etc. Shall not include lubrication procedures
required for the accomplishment of maintenance practices.

options.A: 计划性勤务包括内部清理等工作。不包括维修工作实施所要求的润滑程序。
options.B: 计划性勤务包括内部清理等工作。不包括润滑程序，这是维修工作实施所要求的。
options.C: 计划性勤务包括内部整理等工作。不包括润滑程序，这是维修工作实施所要求的。

explanation: 【译文】“计划勤务”含内部清洁等工作，不含完成维修工作所需的润滑程序。【词汇】Scheduled Servicing=计划勤务，internal cleaning=内部清洁，lubrication procedures=润滑程序。【解析】A正确：内部清理对应internal cleaning，维修工作实施所要求的润滑程序限定关系完整。B修饰割裂：句尾“这是维修工作实施所要求的”悬置，限定对象不清。C两处偏：内部整理≠cleaning（清洁）；句尾同样割裂。

question: "Unscheduled Servicing" includes instructions such as those for ice and snow removal from parked aircraft, preoiling of radial engines after extended shutdown, etc.

options.A: “非计划性勤务”包括对于停放的飞机进行除冰除雪、在过长时间的停车后对星型发动机进行预先润滑等方面的说明。
options.B: “非计划性勤务”包括对于停放的飞机进行除冰除雪、在长时间停车后对活塞发动机进行预先润滑等方面的说明。
options.C: “非计划性勤务”包括对于停放的飞机进行除冰除雪、在过长时间的停车后对活塞发动机进行润滑等方面的说明。

explanation: 【译文】“非计划勤务”含清除停放飞机冰雪、长期停车后对星形发动机预润滑等说明。【词汇】Unscheduled Servicing=非计划勤务，preoiling=预润滑，radial engines=星形发动机，extended shutdown=长期停车。【解析】A正确：星型发动机、预先润滑、过长时间停车三考点全对。B泛化：活塞发动机丢“星形”构型特征。C两处偏：活塞发动机泛化；润滑丢pre-（预）的时间限定。

question: Environment control system is composed of those units and components which furnish a means of pressurizing, heating, cooling, moisture controlling, filtering and treating the air used to  ventilate  the areas of the fuselage within the pressure seals.

options.A: 环境控制系统的这些单元和组件提供了一种加压、加热、冷却、湿度控制、过滤和处理通风区域内用于通风的空气的手段，包括压力密封部分内的区域。
options.B: 环境控制系统由具有提供座舱增压、加热、冷却、湿度控制、过滤和处理用来在机身密封舱内的通风空气功能的组件和部件构成。
options.C: 环境控制系统由具有提供座舱增压、加热、冷却、湿度控制、过滤和处理用来在机身密封舱内的循环空气功能的组件和部件构成。

explanation: 【译文】环境控制系统由这样一些组件部件组成：提供对机身气密区各舱段通风空气进行增压、加热、冷却、湿度控制、过滤和处理的功能。【词汇】environment control system=环境控制系统，pressurizing=增压，ventilate=通风，pressure seals=气密区。【解析】B正确：增压对应pressurizing，密封舱内通风空气对应air to ventilate the areas within pressure seals。A结构乱：修饰关系打乱，within the pressure seals归属错置。C词义错：循环空气把ventilate（通风）错成recirculate（循环）。

question: Speech communication utilizes voice modulated electro-magnetic waves to transmit and/or receive messages from air-to-air or air-to-ground installations.

options.A: 语音通信利用语音调制电磁波来从空对空或空对地的设备传输和/或接收消息。
options.B: 语音通信利用调频的电磁波来从空对空或空对地的设备传输和/或接收消息。
options.C: 语音通信利用调幅的电磁波来从空对空或空对地的设备传输和/或接收消息。

explanation: 【译文】语音通信利用话音调制电磁波向/从空对空或空对地设施发送和接收信息。【词汇】voice modulated=话音调制的，electro-magnetic waves=电磁波，air-to-ground=空对地。【解析】A正确：语音调制电磁波对应voice modulated。B术语错：调频=frequency modulated（FM），与话音调制不同。C术语错：调幅=amplitude modulated（AM），同属调制方式张冠李戴。

question: Audio Integrating controls the output of communications and navigation receivers into the flight crew headphones and speakers, and the output of the flight crew microphones into the communications transmitters.

options.A: 音频整合功能控制通信和导航接收机的输出，将其整合到飞行员的耳机和扬声器中，同时将飞行员麦克风的输出整合到通信传感器中。
options.B: 音频整合功能控制通信和导航接收机的输出，将其整合到飞行员的耳机和扬声器中，同时将飞行员麦克风的输出整合到通信发射机中。
options.C: 音频整合功能控制通信和导航接收机的输出，将其整合到飞行员的耳机和话筒中，同时将飞行员麦克风的输出整合到通信传感器中。

explanation: 【译文】音频综合系统控制通信导航接收机向机组耳机扬声器的输出，及机组话筒向通信发射机的输出。【词汇】Audio Integrating=音频综合，headphones=耳机，communications transmitters=通信发射机。【解析】B正确：耳机对应headphones，发射机对应transmitters，两输出路径完整。A术语错：通信传感器把transmitters错成sensor，收发译反。C两处错：话筒错译headphones；传感器错译transmitters。

question: Electrical Power system is about units and components which generate, control and supply AC and/or DC electrical power for other systems, including generators and relays, inverters, batteries, etc.

options.A: 电源系统讲的是发电、控制和向其他系统提供交流或直流电的组件和部件，包括发电机、继电器、变流器、电瓶等。
options.B: 电源系统讲的是发电、控制和向其他系统提供交流或直流电的组件和部件，包括发电机、继电器、整流器、电瓶等。
options.C: 电源系统讲的是发电、控制和向其他系统提供交流或直流电的组件和部件，包括发电机、继电器、静变流器、电瓶等。

explanation: 【译文】电源系统是指为其他系统产生、控制和提供交流和/或直流电源的组件与部件，包括发电机、继电器、变流器、电瓶等。【词汇】Electrical Power system=电源系统，generate=发电，AC/DC=交流/直流，generators=发电机，relays=继电器，inverters=变流器/逆变器，batteries=电瓶。【解析】A正确：变流器对应inverters（直流变交流的机上设备），发电机、继电器、电瓶列举全对。B术语错译：整流器是rectifier（交流变直流），与inverter功能恰好相反。C范围偏差：静变流器（static inverter）只是inverter的一种，把泛指变流器缩窄为特定类型，列举项范围被限定。

question: AC GENERATION includes items such as inverters, AC generators, control and regulating components, indicating systems, etc., all wiring to but not including main buses, as applicable.

options.A: 交流发电系统包括变流器、交流发电机、控制和调节组件， 指示系统，连到主汇流条的导线，但主汇流条不包括在内。
options.B: 交流发电系统包括变流器、交流发电机、控制和调节组件， 指示系统，连到上述部件的导线，但主汇流条不包括在内。
options.C: 交流发电系统包括整流器、交流发电机、控制和调节组件， 指示系统，连到上述部件的导线，但主汇流条不包括在内。

explanation: 【译文】交流发电含变流器、交流发电机、控制调节组件、指示系统及连到但不含主汇流条的所有导线。【词汇】AC GENERATION=交流发电，inverters=变流器，main buses=主汇流条，wiring to=连到…的导线。【解析】A正确：连到主汇流条的导线但主汇流条不包括在内对应wiring to but not including。B终点错：连到上述部件把导线终点“主汇流条”错成“上述部件”。C两处错：整流器≠inverters；导线终点同错。

question: The AC electrical power distribution on board is carried out in several steps: from the different sources towards the main AC busbars; then, from the main AC busbars, either directly towards important consumers (pumps, galleys...), or towards the associat

options.A: 飞机上的交流配电分几个步骤进行：从不同电源到主交流汇流条;然后，从主交流汇流条直接到重要的负载（泵，厨房......），或向相关的子汇流条;从这些子汇流条分配到不同的交流负载。
options.B: 交流配电分几个步骤进行：从不同电源到主交流汇流条;然后，从主交流汇流条直接到重要的负载（泵，厨房......），或向相关的子汇流条;从这些子汇流条分配到不同的交流负载。
options.C: 交流配电分几个步骤进行：从不同电源到主交流汇流条;然后，从交流转换汇流条直接到重要的负载（泵，厨房......），或向相关的子汇流条;从这些子汇流条分配到不同的交流负载。

explanation: 【译文】机上交流配电分几步：从不同电源到主交流汇流条；再从主汇流条直接到重要负载或相关子汇流条；再分配到各交流负载。【词汇】AC power distribution=交流配电，main AC busbars=主交流汇流条，sub-busbars=子汇流条，on board=机上。【解析】A正确：飞机上对应on board，配电层次完整。B漏要素：丢on board（机上）范围限定。C汇流条错：交流转换汇流条把main busbars错成transfer bus。

question:
"Electrical Power" describes those electrical units and components which generate, control and supply
AC and/or DC electrical power for other systems, including generators and relays, inverters, batteries, etc. , through the busses.

options.A: 电源系统描述的是发电、控制和通过汇流条向其他系统提供交流/直流电的电气组件和部件，包括发电机、继电器、变流器、电瓶等
options.B: 电源系统描述的是发电、控制和通过汇流条向其他系统提供交流/直流电的电气组件和部件，包括发电机、接触器、变流器、电瓶等
options.C: 电源系统描述的是发电、控制和通过汇流条向其他系统提供交流/直流电的电气组件和部件，包括发电机、接触器、整流器、电瓶等

explanation: 【译文】“电源”一章描述通过汇流条为其他系统产生、控制和提供交流和/或直流电源的电气组件与部件，包括发电机、继电器、变流器、电瓶等。【词汇】electrical units and components=电气组件与部件，generators=发电机，relays=继电器，inverters=变流器，batteries=电瓶，busses=汇流条。【解析】A正确：继电器对应relays，变流器对应inverters，通过汇流条对应through the busses，列举与限定全部准确。B术语错译：接触器是contactor，与relay（继电器）虽近义但在手册术语中有区分，属近义词干扰。C两处错译：接触器同上；整流器≠inverters（变流器），功能方向相反。

question: It is under the tilte "Towing and Taxiing" that the instructions necessary to tow and taxi the aircraft in any of the probable conditions to which it may be subjected.

options.A: 航空器拖动和滑行时任何可能遇到的情况的说明在”拖动与滑行”这个标题下。
options.B: 航空器在任何可能遇到的情况下如何拖动和滑行的说明在”拖动与滑行”这个标题下。
options.C: 航空器应该服从什么样的条件进行滑行和拖动的说明在”拖动与滑行”这个标题下。
