explanation: 【译文】将温度计校准到摄氏刻度。【词汇】calibrate=校准（使仪表读数符合标准），thermometer=温度计，Celsius scale=摄氏刻度（华氏为Fahrenheit）。【解析】C正确："校准"=calibrate，"摄氏刻度"=Celsius scale，关键词一一对应。A两处错误：把calibrate误译为"计算"，又擅自添加原文没有的"热电偶"（thermocouple），属词义错译加添译。B两处错误：把Celsius（摄氏）错译为"华氏"（Fahrenheit，温标方向相反的干扰），同样添加"热电偶"这一多余要素。

question: Fill the space between the patch and the adjacent structure with sealant.

options.A: 用密封剂填充补片及相邻结构之间的缝隙。
options.B: 用密封剂填充补片的缝隙，并粘接相邻结构。
options.C: 在附近的密封结构和补片之间留出空隙。

explanation: 【译文】用密封剂填充补片与相邻结构之间的缝隙。【词汇】patch=补片、修补片，adjacent structure=相邻结构，sealant=密封剂，fill the space=填充缝隙。【解析】A正确："补片及相邻结构之间"准确对应between the patch and the adjacent structure，"填充缝隙"对应fill the space...with sealant。B把填充对象改成"补片的缝隙"，又凭空添加"粘接相邻结构"这一动作，属添译要素。C两处错误：把adjacent弱化为"附近的"且将sealant错译成"密封结构"，"留出空隙"与fill的填充义方向相反。

question: Polish the window with a circular movement.

options.A: 沿四周向内对窗户进行抛光。
options.B: 以圆周运动方式擦拭窗户。
options.C: 呈垂直方向给窗户镀膜。

explanation: 【译文】以圆周运动的方式抛光窗户。【词汇】polish=抛光、打磨（使表面光滑发亮），circular movement=圆周运动，window=窗户、窗面。【解析】B正确："圆周运动"准确对应circular movement，"擦拭"虽稍弱于"抛光"但三个选项中最贴近原意。A把circular movement误译为"沿四周向内"，"向内"是凭空添加，圆周轨迹被错成向心轨迹，属方向错误。C两处错误：把polish错译为"镀膜"（镀膜应为coat），又把circular误译为"垂直方向"，工艺和方向全错。

question: Turn the adjuster five clicks counterclockwise.

options.A: 逆时针转动调整器5圈。
options.B: 依次转动调节器的5个旋钮。
options.C: 逆时针转动调节器5个单位。

explanation: 【译文】将调节器逆时针转动5个咔嗒位（档位）。【词汇】adjuster=调节器、调整器，click=咔嗒位、棘轮档位（调节机构每转一格的落位，不是"圈"也不是"旋钮"），counterclockwise=逆时针。【解析】C正确："5个单位"对应five clicks的计量含义，"逆时针"对应counterclockwise。A把five clicks误译为"5圈"，click是档位而非整圈（整圈应为turn/revolution），属词义错译。B两处错误：把clicks误译为"旋钮"（实物名词），又添加原文没有的"依次"，属词义错译加添译。

question: In a high concentration, this material is poisonous.

options.A: 这种物质在高浓度时是有毒的。
options.B: 在高度浓缩后，这种材料会有毒。
options.C: 这种材料在高温下会易燃。

explanation: 【译文】这种物质在高浓度状态下是有毒的。【词汇】concentration=浓度，in a high concentration=处于高浓度（状态状语），poisonous=有毒的。【解析】A正确："在高浓度时"忠实对应in a high concentration，"有毒"对应poisonous。B把concentration按动词义误译为"高度浓缩后"，将存在的状态错成加工处理的过程，属词义错译。C两处错误：把concentration错译为"高温"（temperature），把poisonous错译为"易燃"（flammable），两个考点词全错。

question: First try to install the adaptor with the shortest threaded area.

options.A: 首先尝试安装有最短的螺纹区域的转接头。
options.B: 首先尝试安装带有最短螺纹的芯轴。
options.C: 首先尝试在最窄的区域内安装接头。

explanation: 【译文】首先尝试安装螺纹区域最短的转接头。【词汇】adaptor=转接头、适配器，threaded area=螺纹区域，shortest=最短的，install=安装。【解析】A正确："最短的螺纹区域"对应shortest threaded area，"转接头"对应adaptor，语序自然准确。B两处错误：把adaptor误译为"芯轴"（mandrel/spindle，张冠李戴），又把threaded area压缩成"螺纹"，漏译"区域"。C把threaded area误译为"最窄的区域"，将"螺纹"这一关键属性完全丢失，属漏译要素。

question: Apply mineral hydraulic fluid to the surface of parts that touch the seals.

options.A: 在密封的零件表面涂抹磷酸酯基液压油。
options.B: 在接触封严的零件表面涂抹矿物液压油。
options.C: 在零件与封严相连接的地方涂抹液压油。

explanation: 【译文】在与封严接触的零件表面涂抹矿物液压油。【词汇】mineral hydraulic fluid=矿物基液压油（区别于磷酸酯基Skydrol），seals=封严、密封件，parts that touch the seals=与封严接触的零件。【解析】B正确："矿物液压油"对应mineral hydraulic fluid，"接触封严"对应touch the seals，定语从句修饰关系准确。A把mineral错译为"磷酸酯基"（phosphate-ester，属张冠李戴），且"密封的零件"把零件与封严的接触关系译反。C漏译mineral这一关键限定，又把"零件表面"涂抹错成"相连接的地方"涂抹，范围与位置均不准。

question: Do not stretch the seals more than necessary when you install them.

options.A: 安装时非必要不要拉伸封严。
options.B: 不要过度拉伸已安装的必要封严。
options.C: 在安装封严件时不要过度拉伸。

explanation: 【译文】安装封严件时，不要超过必要的程度拉伸它们。【词汇】stretch=拉伸，more than necessary=超过必要程度（即"过度"），seals=封严件，install=安装。【解析】C正确："不要过度拉伸"准确对应more than necessary的实质含义，"在安装封严件时"对应when you install them。A虽译出"非必要不要拉伸"，但"非必要不要"语义偏向"不必要就一点都不能拉"，与"不超过必要限度"有偏差，且them的回指未体现。B把when you install them误译为"已安装的"，又把necessary错当成seals的定语（"必要封严"），语法关系全错。

question: The PI shows the remaining time to make the copy of the data.

options.A: PI 上显示完成数据复制所需的剩余时间。
options.B: PI显示的是复制数据所需要的时间。
options.C: PI上显示剩余时间以便完成数据的复制。

explanation: 【译文】PI上显示完成数据复制所需的剩余时间。【词汇】PI=进程指示（progress indication），remaining time=剩余时间，make the copy of the data=完成数据复制。【解析】A正确："剩余时间"对应remaining time，"完成数据复制"对应make the copy，"所需的"准确体现不定式的定语修饰关系。B漏译remaining，把"剩余时间"说成"所需要的时间"，丢失"剩余"这一关键限定。C把to make the copy误译为"以便完成"，将不定式的定语关系错成目的状语，逻辑关系错误。

question: Do not use solvents that contain chlorine to clean parts with a Rilsan coating.

options.A: 不要让清洁剂接触带有瑞尔森（Rilsan）涂层的零件。
options.B: 不要使用含氯的溶剂清洁带有瑞尔森（Rilsan）涂层的零件。
options.C: 不可以使用含氯的瑞尔森（Rilsan）溶液清洁带有涂层的零件。

explanation: 【译文】不要使用含氯的溶剂来清洁带瑞尔森（Rilsan）涂层的零件。【词汇】solvent=溶剂，contain chlorine=含氯，Rilsan coating=瑞尔森（尼龙11）涂层。【解析】B正确："含氯的溶剂"对应solvents that contain chlorine，"清洁"对应clean，定语从句译法准确。A两处错误：漏译contain chlorine（含氯）这一关键限定，又把use...to clean错译为"让清洁剂接触"，改变了原句的操作指令性质。C把Rilsan coating（涂层）错译为"瑞尔森溶液"，涂层与溶液张冠李戴，且"带有涂层的零件"的限定关系被模糊。

question: If you cannot remove a bolt because of corrosion, apply penetrating oil.

options.A: 如果因出现腐蚀而不得不拆除螺栓，则涂抹润滑油。
options.B: 如果因腐蚀而不能拆卸螺栓，则涂抹渗透润滑油。
options.C: 出现腐蚀时不可以拆卸螺栓，需要先涂抹防蚀剂。

explanation: 【译文】如果因腐蚀而无法拆下螺栓，则涂抹渗透润滑油。【词汇】penetrating oil=渗透润滑油、除锈渗透剂（渗入锈蚀螺纹助拆），corrosion=腐蚀，remove=拆卸。【解析】B正确："因腐蚀而不能拆卸"对应cannot remove...because of corrosion，"渗透润滑油"对应penetrating oil。A把cannot remove误译为"不得不拆除"，否定变肯定，属方向相反错误；"润滑油"也漏掉penetrating的"渗透"义。C两处错误：把条件句错译为"不可以拆卸"的禁令，又把penetrating oil错译为"防蚀剂"（corrosion inhibitor），词义错译。

question: Give temporary protection to areas of bare metal.

options.A: 对裸露的金属区域进行临时保护。
options.B: 对铁质金属区域进行必要保护。
options.C: 对有色金属区域涂抹临时保护涂层。

explanation: 【译文】对裸露的金属区域给予临时保护。【词汇】temporary protection=临时保护，bare metal=裸露金属（无漆层/防护层的基体金属），give protection to=对……给予保护。【解析】A正确："裸露的金属区域"对应areas of bare metal，"临时保护"对应temporary protection。B两处错误：把bare（裸露的）误译为"铁质"，又把temporary误译为"必要"，两个考点词全错。C把bare metal误译为"有色金属"（non-ferrous metal），bare指无覆盖层而非金属种类，并添加"涂抹……涂层"的具体方式，属词义错译加添译。

question: If the filler bonds to the tool, make the tool moist with cold water.

options.A: 如果填充剂粘在工具上，用冷水湿润工具。
options.B: 如果使用工具时需用封圈辅助，用冷水先清洗工具。
options.C: 如果需要使用填充剂粘接工具，用冷水浸泡工具。

explanation: 【译文】如果填充剂粘到工具上，就用冷水把工具润湿。【词汇】filler=填充剂，bond to=粘附、粘结于，make...moist=使……湿润，cold water=冷水。【解析】A正确："填充剂粘在工具上"对应filler bonds to the tool，"用冷水湿润"对应make moist with cold water。B把filler bonds误译为"需用封圈辅助"，bond（粘结）被错成"辅助"，又添加"清洗"（clean），属词义错译加添译。C两处错误：把粘附的结果译成"需要使用填充剂粘接工具"的目的，把make moist（润湿）错译为"浸泡"（soak），逻辑与程度均有错误。

question: Make a selection from the available shims to get the correct thickness.

options.A: 选择适用的垫圈，确定恰当的尺寸。
options.B: 挑选适用的调整片以确保厚度合适。
options.C: 从可用的垫片中进行选择，以获得正确的厚度。

explanation: 【译文】从现有可用的垫片中选择，以获得正确的厚度。【词汇】make a selection from=从……中作出选择，shim=调整垫片、填隙片（薄垫片，区别于垫圈washer），correct thickness=正确厚度。【解析】C正确："从可用的垫片中进行选择"逐词对应make a selection from the available shims，"获得正确的厚度"对应get the correct thickness。A两处错误：把shim误译为"垫圈"（washer，词义错译），把thickness误译为"尺寸"（dimension，丢失"厚度"参数）。B把shim误译为"调整片"，且漏译"从可用的……中"这一选择范围，"确保厚度合适"也弱化了correct的确定性。

question: Table 1 gives alternative adhesives which you can use.

options.A: 表1中列出的研磨剂是备选的，你可以选择使用。
options.B: 表1给出了可以使用的替代粘合剂。
options.C: 你只能使用表1中列出的等效粘合剂。

explanation: 【译文】表1给出了可供选用的替代粘合剂。【词汇】alternative adhesives=替代粘合剂（可代用的粘接材料，不是"等效"也不是"研磨剂"），gives=给出、列出，which you can use=可供使用的。【解析】B正确："替代粘合剂"对应alternative adhesives，"可以使用"对应which you can use，简洁准确。A把adhesives（粘合剂）误译为"研磨剂"（abrasive），词义完全错位。C把alternative（替代的、可选用的）误译为"只能使用的等效"，alternative强调有替代选择余地，"只能"恰好方向相反，且"等效"为添译。

question: The external diameter must be concentric to the internal diameter.

options.A: 外圆周长必须与内圆周长相匹配。
options.B: 外侧半径必须与内侧半径等比例。
options.C: 外径必须与内径同心。

explanation: 【译文】外径必须与内径同心。【词汇】external diameter=外径，internal diameter=内径，concentric=同心的（共轴心，常与to/with连用）。【解析】C正确："外径"对应external diameter，"同心"对应concentric，几何公差术语完全对应。A两处错误：把diameter（直径）误译为"圆周长"（circumference），把concentric（同心）误译为"相匹配"，词义错译。B两处错误：把diameter误译为"半径"（radius），把concentric误译为"等比例"（proportional），尺寸属性和几何关系全错。

question: Examine the opening for cracks that start at its corners.

options.A: 检查开口是否从边角开始出现裂纹。
options.B: 检查角落位置是否出现开口裂纹。
options.C: 在拐角处开始检查开口是否有裂纹。

explanation: 【译文】检查开口处是否有从其边角起始的裂纹。【词汇】examine...for=检查……是否有，opening=开口、孔洞，cracks that start at its corners=起始于边角的裂纹（start修饰cracks而非examine）。【解析】A正确："从边角开始出现裂纹"准确表达cracks that start at its corners中裂纹起始位置与开口的从属关系。B把关系错成"角落位置是否出现开口裂纹"，裂纹的起始属性丢失，修饰关系混乱。C把定语从句start at its corners误译为"在拐角处开始检查"，将裂纹的起始点错当成检查动作的起点，属语法结构错译。

question: Identify the assembly with the correct color.

options.A: 给组件涂上正确的颜色。
options.B: 用合适的颜色识别组件。
options.C: 对配件进行颜色编码。

explanation: 【译文】用正确的颜色标识该组件。【词汇】identify=识别、标识，assembly=组件、装配件，with the correct color=用正确的颜色（识别手段）。【解析】B正确："用合适的颜色识别"对应identify...with the correct color，"组件"对应assembly。A把identify with（用颜色加以识别）误译为"给组件涂上颜色"，识别目的变成涂色动作，属逻辑方向错误。C两处错误：把assembly误译为"配件"，又把identify误译为"颜色编码"（color-code是对部件实施编码标识，与identify...with语义不同），词义不准。

question: If the damage is only to the middle treads, the tire is serviceable.

options.A: 如果仅仅损坏了轮胎中间表面，轮胎还是可用的。
options.B: 如果损伤是胎间见线，轮胎需要更换。
options.C: 如果损伤只局限于胎面中部，轮胎是可用的。

explanation: 【译文】如果损伤只限于中部胎面花纹，则该轮胎仍可继续使用。【词汇】tread=胎面花纹、胎面，serviceable=可用的、可继续服役的（维修用语，指满足放行标准），damage to=对……的损伤。【解析】C正确："只局限于胎面中部"对应only to the middle treads，"可用的"对应serviceable。A把middle treads弱化为"轮胎中间表面"，tread专指胎面花纹区域，"表面"范围过大，属范围错误。B两处错误：把treads误译为"胎间见线"（见线指磨损标记露出），又把serviceable误译为"需要更换"，结论方向完全相反。

question: This material causes corrosion of surfaces with no protection.

options.A: 如果不实施保护，这种材料会导致表面腐蚀。
options.B: 在没有保护的情况下，这种材料的表面会出现腐蚀。
options.C: 这种材料会腐蚀未受保护的表面。

explanation: 【译文】这种材料会腐蚀未加保护的表面。【词汇】cause corrosion=造成腐蚀，surfaces with no protection=无保护的表面（with短语作后置定语修饰surfaces），material=材料。【解析】C正确："腐蚀未受保护的表面"忠实对应causes corrosion of surfaces with no protection，受腐蚀的客体是"表面"。A把句子结构译成条件句"如果不实施保护"，改变了原句的陈述结构，且未点明被腐蚀的客体是谁。B把surfaces with no protection错解为"这种材料的表面"，造成是材料自身腐蚀的歧义，属修饰关系错译。

question: To make the curing process slower, decrease the heat that you apply to the compound.

options.A: 为减慢固化过程，减少对化合物的加热。
options.B: 为减缓损耗，降低复合材料承受的热量。
options.C: 减少施加的热量会导致制作工序减慢。

explanation: 【译文】为减慢固化过程，减少对化合物施加的热量。【词汇】curing process=固化过程，decrease the heat=减少热量，compound=化合物。【解析】A正确："减慢固化过程"对应make the curing process slower，"减少对化合物的加热"对应decrease the heat applied to the compound。B两处错误：把curing误译为"损耗"，把compound误译为"复合材料"，词义错译。C漏译目的状语To make slower，译成因果陈述句，又把curing误译为"制作工序"，结构与词义均有错。

question: Remove all the rigging pins and equipment that prevent free movement of the control surfaces.

options.A: 拆除所有阻止操纵舵面自由移动的校装销和设备。
options.B: 拆下所有的插钉和设备使操纵舵面自由移动。
options.C: 拆下所有的开口销，并移走防止操纵舵面自由移动的设备。

explanation: 【译文】拆下所有妨碍操纵舵面自由活动的校装销和设备。【词汇】rigging pin=校装销（校装定位销，区别于开口销cotter pin），control surfaces=操纵舵面，prevent free movement=妨碍自由活动。【解析】A正确："校装销"对应rigging pins，"阻止自由移动"对应prevent free movement，that从句修饰范围准确。B两处错误：把rigging pins误译为"插钉"，又把"阻止自由移动"译成"使自由移动"，方向相反。C把rigging pins误译为"开口销"（张冠李戴），且拆句后prevent只修饰equipment，改变原意。

question: Tighten the turnbuckle until you have the correct tension in the cable.

options.A: 拧紧松紧螺套，直到钢索具有合适的张力。
options.B: 在电缆的尺寸符合要求后，才能停止拧紧卡箍。
options.C: 拧紧搭扣才能使钢索具有正确的拉力。

explanation: 【译文】拧紧松紧螺套，直到钢索达到正确的张力。【词汇】turnbuckle=松紧螺套（花篮螺栓，调节钢索张力），tension=张力，until=直到……为止，cable=钢索。【解析】A正确："松紧螺套"对应turnbuckle，"直到具有合适的张力"对应until you have the correct tension，终止条件关系准确。B多处错误：把turnbuckle误译为"卡箍"（clamp），把tension误译为"尺寸"，把until"直到"关系错译成"符合要求后才能停止"，逻辑全乱。C两处错误：把turnbuckle误译为"搭扣"（latch），把tension译成"拉力"不如"张力"准确（tension为静态拉紧力）。

question: Before disassembly, make sure that you release all the nitrogen pressure from the shock absorber.

options.A: 装配之前，确保适当减少减震器里的压力。
options.B: 拆卸之前，确保释放减震器里的初始压力。
options.C: 分解之前，确保减震器里的所有氮气压力已释放。

explanation: 【译文】分解之前，确保释放减震器中所有的氮气压力。【词汇】disassembly=分解、拆卸（反义为assembly装配），release=释放，nitrogen pressure=氮气压力，shock absorber=减震器。【解析】C正确："分解之前"对应Before disassembly，"所有氮气压力已释放"对应release all the nitrogen pressure，要素齐全。A两处错误：把disassembly误译为"装配"（assembly，方向相反），把release all（全部释放）弱化为"适当减少"，又漏译nitrogen。B漏译nitrogen（氮气）和all（所有），"初始压力"属添译，关键要素不全。

question: 按这个顺序执行称重程序。

options.A: Do the weighing procedure in this sequence.
options.B: In this order to perform the swapping procedure.
options.C: In this sequence to do the analysis procedure.

explanation: 【译文】Do the weighing procedure in this sequence.【词汇】weighing procedure=称重程序，in this sequence=按此顺序，do=执行。【解析】A正确：weighing对应"称重"，in this sequence对应"按这个顺序"，祈使句符合指令语体。B两处错误：把"称重"误译为swapping（交换）；介词短语开头缺主句，句子不完整。C两处错误：把weighing误译为analysis（分析）；"In this sequence to do"同样缺主句，语法错误。

question: 此工具是可选的。

options.A: This tool is mandatory.
options.B: This tool is optional.
options.C: This tool is necessary.

explanation: 【译文】This tool is optional.（该工具是选用件/非必需的。）【词汇】optional=可选的、选装的（非强制），mandatory=强制的，necessary=必需的。【解析】B正确：optional准确对应"可选的"，指该工具可用可不用。A把"可选"误译为mandatory（强制性的），与"可选"含义恰好相反，属方向相反错误。C把"可选"误译为necessary（必要的、必需的），necessary指必须配备，与optional语义对立，属词义错译。

question: 以60度增量逆时针转动调节器。

options.A: Turn the adjuster clockwise to increase 60 Deg.
options.B: Turn the adjuster counterclockwise in increments of 60 Deg.
options.C: Decrease 60 Deg. to turn the adjuster counterclockwise.

explanation: 【译文】Turn the adjuster counterclockwise in increments of 60 degrees.【词汇】counterclockwise=逆时针，in increments of=以……为增量，adjuster=调节器。【解析】B正确：counterclockwise对应"逆时针"，in increments of对应"以60度增量"。A两处错误：把"逆时针"误译为clockwise（顺时针，方向相反）；把in increments误译为to increase（增加）。C把"增量"误译为Decrease（减少），方向相反，且语序把转动与减量关系颠倒。

question: 在每根管子的开口端放一个堵头。

options.A: Put a plug on the open end of each pipe.
options.B: On the opening of each pipe, put a cover.
options.C: Put a cover on the loose end of the pipe.

explanation: 【译文】Put a plug on the open end of each pipe.（在每根管子的开口端装一个堵头。）【词汇】plug=堵头、塞子，open end=开口端，each pipe=每根管子。【解析】A正确：plug对应"堵头"，open end of each pipe对应"每根管子的开口端"，要素齐全。B两处错误：把plug误译为cover（盖子/盖板，非堵头），词义错译；open end简化为opening，丢失"端部"含义。C两处错误：把plug误译为cover，把open end误译为loose end（松脱端），且each漏译成the pipe单数，数量不准。

question: 不要安装厚度大于0.1毫米的填隙片。

options.A: Do not install 0.1 mm thick shims.
options.B: Do not install shims which are more than 0.1 deep.
options.C: Do not install shims that are more than 0.1 mm thick.

explanation: 【译文】Do not install shims that are more than 0.1 mm thick.（不得安装厚度超过0.1毫米的填隙片。）【词汇】shim=填隙片、调整垫片，more than...thick=厚度大于……（thick表厚度，deep表深度）。【解析】C正确：more than 0.1 mm thick准确对应"厚度大于0.1毫米"，定语从句限定shims。A两处错误：0.1 mm thick shims把"大于0.1毫米"变成"恰为0.1毫米厚"，临界值含义改变，属范围错误。B两处错误：把thick（厚度）误译为deep（深度），量纲属性错；又漏译单位mm，0.1后无单位不完整。

question: 冲洗管道以清除污染。

options.A: Clear the pipes in order to remove corrosion.
options.B: Wash the pipes so as to remove dust.
options.C: Flush the pipes to remove contamination.

explanation: 【译文】Flush the pipes to remove contamination.（冲洗管路以去除污染物。）【词汇】flush=冲洗（用流体冲净系统管路，非一般水洗wash），contamination=污染（物），pipes=管路。【解析】C正确：flush对应"冲洗"这一系统清洁专业术语，remove contamination对应"清除污染"。A两处错误：把flush误译为clear（清理），把contamination误译为corrosion（腐蚀），污染与腐蚀词义错译。B两处错误：把flush弱化为wash（水洗），冲洗系统用flush才规范；把contamination误译为dust（灰尘），污染范围缩窄。

question: 确保管子没有变形。

options.A: Ensure that there is no corrosion on the tubes.
options.B: Make sure that the tubes have no deformation.
options.C: Make sure that the tubes have no crack.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the tubes have no deformation.（确保管子无变形。）【词汇】make sure=确保，deformation=变形，tube=管子，corrosion=腐蚀（干扰项）。【解析】B正确：make sure对应"确保"，no deformation对应"没有变形"，宾语从句结构完整。A把deformation误译为corrosion（腐蚀），检查对象从变形变成腐蚀，属词义错译。C把deformation误译为crack（裂纹），裂纹不等于变形，且crack为可数名词应说no cracks，词义错译加语法瑕疵。

question: 更换故障的增压泵。

options.A: Replace the defective booster pump.
options.B: Remain the present booster pump.
options.C: Recharge the failed booster pump.

explanation: 【译文】Replace the defective booster pump.（更换有故障的增压泵。）【词汇】replace=更换，defective=有故障的、有缺陷的，booster pump=增压泵。【解析】A正确：replace对应"更换"，defective对应"故障的"，booster pump对应"增压泵"，术语规范。B把"更换"误译为remain（保留、保持），意思变成"保留现有增压泵"，与原意方向相反；remain作及物动词亦属语法错误。C把"更换"误译为recharge（再充电/重新充注），换件与充填是不同操作，词义错译。

question: 真空设备将空气从化合物中去除。

options.A: The space equipment releases the air from the compound.
options.B: The vacuum equipment decreases the air from the compound.
options.C: The vacuum equipment removes the air from the compound.

explanation: 【译文】The vacuum equipment removes the air from the compound.（真空设备除去化合物中的空气。）【词汇】vacuum equipment=真空设备，remove=去除，compound=化合物，air=空气。【解析】C正确：vacuum equipment对应"真空设备"，removes the air from对应"将空气从……中去除"，remove...from搭配规范。A两处错误：把vacuum误译为space（空间设备），把removes误译为releases（释放），设备类型和动作方向全错。B两处错误：decrease（减少）不等于"去除"，且decrease不与air这样搭配，语义和搭配均不当。

question: 在标签上，看一下上次检查的日期。

options.A: On the label, read the date of the last inspection.
options.B: Check the date of latest inspection on the log.
options.C: On the label, make sure the date of last check.

explanation: 【译文】On the label, read the date of the last inspection.【词汇】label=标签，read=查看，last inspection=上次检查（inspection为定检术语）。【解析】A正确：On the label对应"在标签上"，read对应"看一下"，last inspection对应"上次检查"。B两处错误：把label误译为log（记录本）；latest与last微偏。C两处错误：把read误译为make sure（确认）；last check不如last inspection规范。

question: 持续监控速度指示，直到测试结束。

options.A: IAS shall be monitored continuously until the end of the test.
options.B: Monitor the speed indication as long as the test continues.
options.C: Monitor the speed indication continuously until the end of the test.

explanation: 【译文】Monitor the speed indication continuously until the end of the test.【词汇】monitor continuously=持续监控，speed indication=速度指示，until the end of=直到……结束。【解析】C正确：monitor continuously对应"持续监控"，until the end of the test对应"直到测试结束"。A两处错误：把"速度指示"限定为IAS，范围缩窄；被动语体不同。B两处错误：as long as the test continues未点明"结束"；漏译continuously。

question: 如果说明中有关于危险压力的警告，不要打开容器。

options.A: Do not open the container if you are instructed that high pressure is dangerous.
options.B: If it states on the container that the pressure inside is high, do not open it.
options.C: If the instructions give a warning about dangerous pressure, do not open the container.

explanation: 【译文】If the instructions give a warning about dangerous pressure, do not open the container.【词汇】instructions=说明书，give a warning=给出警告，dangerous pressure=危险压力。【解析】C正确：the instructions give a warning对应"说明中有警告"，条件从句结构完整。A把条件从句译为"被告知高压危险"，警告主体错位，dangerous pressure也变成high pressure is dangerous。B把警告主体移到容器上，并把内容错译为"内部压力高"，漏译警告与危险两要素。

question: 确保能够通过观测计看见滑油油位。

options.A: Make sure that you can see the oil level through the sight gauge.
options.B: Make sure that the oil quantity is shown on the oil level indicator.
options.C: You can read the oil level on the oil level gauge.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that you can see the oil level through the sight gauge.【词汇】sight gauge=观测计、视液计，oil level=滑油油位，through=通过。【解析】A正确：through the sight gauge对应"通过观测计"，see the oil level对应"看见油位"。B两处错误：把sight gauge误译为oil level indicator（术语不同）；quantity（油量）不等于level（油位）。C两处错误：漏译"确保"指令义；oil level gauge与sight gauge术语不准，through的手段含义丢失。

question: 当从后面看这个泵时，这个螺栓位于两点钟位置。

options.A: The bolt will be at the 2 o’clock position when you look at the pump from the rear.
options.B: The rivet is installed on the 2 o'clock position of the pump when looking from rear to front.
options.C: Look at the bolt installed on the pump from rear to front at the 2 o'clock position.

explanation: 【译文】The bolt is at the 2 o'clock position when you look at the pump from the rear.【词汇】2 o'clock position=两点钟位置，from the rear=从后方，bolt=螺栓（区别于rivet铆钉）。【解析】A正确：2 o'clock position对应"两点钟位置"，when...from the rear对应"当从后面看泵时"。B两处错误：把bolt误译为rivet；from rear to front添加方向。C译成祈使句"Look at the bolt"，句式错误；from rear to front同样失真，位置修饰关系含糊。

question: 清洁时，为防止损坏地毯，不要对毛刷施加过大的力。

options.A: Do not put too much force on the brush when cleaning the carpet which can be easily damaged.
options.B: To prevent damage to the carpet when you clean it, do not use too much force on the brush.
options.C: Using too much force on the brush when cleaning the carpet will cause damage to it.

explanation: 【译文】To prevent damage to the carpet when you clean it, do not use too much force on the brush.【词汇】prevent damage to=防止损坏，too much force=过大的力，brush=毛刷。【解析】B正确：To prevent damage对应"为防止损坏"，祈使句与原文一致。A把"防止损坏"译成定语从句which can be easily damaged（易损的地毯），目的状语变修饰语。C译成陈述句"will cause damage"，警告指令变成因果陈述，丢失"不要"的禁止义。

question: 你可以调节水平安定面的安装角。

options.A: You can reassemble the horizontal stabilizer.
options.B: You can trim the horizontal stabilizer to the right angle.
options.C: You can adjust the incidence of the horizontal stabilizer.

explanation: 【译文】You can adjust the incidence of the horizontal stabilizer.（你可以调节水平安定面的安装角。）【词汇】incidence=安装角（翼面相对机身的安装迎角），horizontal stabilizer=水平安定面，adjust=调节。【解析】C正确：adjust对应"调节"，incidence对应"安装角"，horizontal stabilizer对应"水平安定面"，术语精准。A把"调节安装角"误译为reassemble（重新装配），动作完全不同，词义错译。B两处错误：trim是"配平/修整"，调节安装角不称trim；right angle是"直角"而非"合适的角度"，产生歧义，词义错译。

question: 确保溶剂没在发动机尾喷管附近。

options.A: Make sure that chemical compound are not near the engine nozzle.
options.B: Make sure that solvents are not near the engine exhaust.
options.C: Make sure that there's no isopropyl alcohol near the engine exhaust port.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that solvents are not near the engine exhaust.【词汇】solvent=溶剂，engine exhaust=发动机尾喷/排气区域，near=在……附近。【解析】B正确：solvents对应"溶剂"，engine exhaust对应"发动机尾喷管"，否定位置正确。A两处错误：把solvents误译为chemical compound（化合物），范围扩大且单复数错；nozzle不如exhaust涵盖尾喷区。C把solvents限定为isopropyl alcohol（异丙醇），范围缩窄，exhaust port也不准确。

question: 压力超过7000千帕时停止测试。

options.A: The test will stop when the pressure is larger than 7000 kpa.
options.B: Stop the test if the pressure reaches 7000 pa.
options.C: Stop the test when the pressure is more than 7000 kpa.

explanation: 【译文】Stop the test when the pressure is more than 7000 kPa.【词汇】more than=超过，kPa=千帕（Pa=帕），stop the test=停止测试（指令句）。【解析】C正确：祈使句Stop the test对应"停止测试"，more than 7000 kpa对应"超过7000千帕"。A两处错误：译成"The test will stop"陈述句，丢失指令义。B两处错误：把7000 kPa误译为7000 pa，单位差千倍；reaches（达到）与"超过"条件不同。

question: 指针沿刻度垂直移动。

options.A: The needle moves horizontally along the gage.
options.B: The pointer moves vertically along the scale.
options.C: The indicator moves longitudinally along the edge.

explanation: 【译文】The pointer moves vertically along the scale.（指针沿刻度垂直移动。）【词汇】pointer=指针（needle多指探针/磁针），vertically=垂直地，scale=刻度（盘）。【解析】B正确：pointer对应"指针"，vertically对应"垂直"，along the scale对应"沿刻度"，三要素全对。A两处错误：把vertically误译为horizontally（水平地，方向相反）；gage指量具/表具整体，刻度应用scale，词义错译。C两处错误：把vertically误译为longitudinally（纵向地），把scale误译为edge（边缘），指示对象和方向全错。

question: 改变频率并记录结果。

options.A: Record the results if the frequency changes.
options.B: Alter the phase and record the results.
options.C: Change the frequency and record the results.

explanation: 【译文】Change the frequency and record the results.（改变频率并记录结果。）【词汇】change=改变，frequency=频率，record the results=记录结果（并列祈使结构）。【解析】C正确：change对应"改变"，frequency对应"频率"，and record对应"并记录"，并列结构准确对应中文"并"。A把并列关系误译为条件句if the frequency changes（如果频率变化），主动操作变客观条件，逻辑关系错误。B把frequency误译为phase（相位），频率与相位是不同的电气参数，词义错译。

question: 如果冲压空气涡轮已收起。

options.A: If the rush air turbine has been extracted.
options.B: If the Ram Air Turbine (RAT) is retracted.
options.C: If the pushed air turbin has been extended.

explanation: 【译文】If the Ram Air Turbine (RAT) is retracted.（如果冲压空气涡轮已收起。）【词汇】Ram Air Turbine (RAT)=冲压空气涡轮（应急动力装置），retracted=已收起的（伸出为extended/deployed）。【解析】B正确：Ram Air Turbine是"冲压空气涡轮"规范术语并附缩写RAT，is retracted对应"已收起"。A两处错误：把Ram误译为rush（急冲），术语错；extracted（拔出/抽出）不等于retracted（收进舱内）。C两处错误：turbin为turbine拼写错误，extended（伸出/放下）与"收起"方向相反。

question: 当你通过接近盖板接近后机身时。

options.A: When you access to the rear fuselage through the access panel.
options.B: When you get to the aft aircraft body through the control panel.
options.C: As you reach to the aft part of the aircraft by the visit door.

explanation: 【译文】When you gain access to the rear fuselage through the access panel.【词汇】access panel=接近盖板（检修口盖），rear fuselage=后机身，access=接近（维修术语）。【解析】A正确：rear fuselage对应"后机身"，through the access panel对应"通过接近盖板"。B两处错误：把access panel误译为control panel（控制面板）；aft aircraft body不如fuselage规范。C两处错误：把access panel误译为visit door（舱门）；aft part of the aircraft术语不准。

question: 报告必须包含一个组件的三视图。

options.A: The paper must include a three-looking picture of the unit.
options.B: The report must inclue a three- view drawing of the unit.
options.C: The diagram must include a three-side drawing of the unit.

explanation: 【译文】The report must include a three-view drawing of the unit.【词汇】three-view drawing=三视图（制图术语），report=报告，unit=组件。【解析】B正确：three-view drawing是"三视图"标准译法，must include对应"必须包含"（inclue为笔误不影响）。A把"三视图"误译为three-looking picture（中式直译）；paper也不如report对应"报告"。C两处错误：把report误译为diagram（图表）；three-side drawing非三视图规范表达。

question: 航向道对准了跑道的中心线。

options.A: The localizer beam is aligned with the centerline of the runway.
options.B: The localizer way is misaligned with the centerline of the runway.
options.C: The localizer course is aligned with the centerline of the runway.

explanation: 【译文】The localizer course is aligned with the centerline of the runway.【词汇】localizer course=航向道（ILS航向引导航道），aligned with=与……对准，centerline=中心线。【解析】C正确：localizer course是"航向道"规范术语，aligned with对应"对准"。A用localizer beam（航向信标波束），beam指信号波束而非航道本身，精度不如course。B两处错误：localizer way非规范术语；misaligned（未对准）与"对准了"方向相反。

question: 下滑道路径是与跑道的端头成一个固定的角度。

options.A: The glideslope path is at a constant angle to the threshold of the runway.
options.B: The glideslope path is at a variable angle to the first end of the runway.
options.C: The vertical course path is at a fixed angle to the threshold of the runway.

explanation: 【译文】The glideslope path is at a constant angle to the threshold of the runway.【词汇】glideslope=下滑道，threshold=跑道入口端头，constant angle=固定角度。【解析】A正确：glideslope path对应"下滑道路径"，constant angle对应"固定角度"，threshold对应"跑道端头"。B两处错误：把constant误译为variable（可变，方向相反）；first end不如threshold规范。C把glideslope误译为vertical course（垂直航道），词义错译。

question: 使发射机中的电流发生了变化。

options.A: It changed the volts in the transmitter
options.B: It changes the electrical currents in the transmitter.
options.C: It changed the electronic currents in the reciever.

explanation: 【译文】It changes the electrical currents in the transmitter.【词汇】electrical current=电流，transmitter=发射机（receiver=接收机），changes=使变化。【解析】B正确：electrical currents对应"电流"，transmitter对应"发射机"。A两处错误：把"电流"误译为volts（电压），电气量张冠李戴；changed the volts搭配不成立。C两处错误：把transmitter误译为reciever（接收机，拼写亦有误），方向相反；electronic currents不如electrical currents规范。

question: 作动筒与液压回油管路连通

options.A: The operation rods are connected to the hydraulic feedback.
options.B: The operation barrels are connected to the hydraulic return.
options.C: The actuators are connected to the hydraulic return.

explanation: 【译文】The actuators are connected to the hydraulic return.【词汇】actuator=作动筒，hydraulic return=液压回油（管路），connected to=与……连通。【解析】C正确：actuators对应"作动筒"，hydraulic return对应"液压回油"。A两处错误：把作动筒误译为operation rods（操作杆）；return误译为feedback（反馈）。B两处错误：把作动筒误译为operation barrels（工作筒），barrel指筒体而非作动筒术语。

question: 使用标牌来标识分解后的部件。

options.A: Identify the disassembled parts with tags.
options.B: To notice the removed parts with the lable.
options.C: To mark the assembled parts with the cards.

explanation: 【译文】Identify the disassembled parts with tags.（用标牌标识分解后的部件。）【词汇】tag=标牌、标签，disassembled parts=分解后的部件，identify=标识、识别。【解析】A正确：Identify对应"标识"，disassembled parts对应"分解后的部件"，with tags对应"使用标牌"，祈使句结构符合指令语体。B两处错误：notice（注意到）不等于"标识"；lable为label拼写错误，且不定式开头缺主句，语法不完整。C两处错误：把disassembled（分解后）误译为assembled（装配好的，方向相反），tags误译为cards（卡片），词义错译。

question: 使用祈使语气来书写指令。

options.A: Write the instructions in the mandatory mode.
options.B: Write the instructions in the imperative form.
options.C: Write the instructions in the active mode.

explanation: 【译文】Write the instructions in the imperative form.（用祈使语气书写指令。）【词汇】imperative form=祈使语气/祈使形式（语法术语），instructions=指令、说明，mandatory=强制的（干扰）。【解析】B正确：imperative form是"祈使语气"的标准语法术语，write the instructions对应"书写指令"。A把"祈使语气"误译为mandatory mode（强制模式），mandatory描述指令的强制性而非语法语气，词义错译。C把"祈使语气"误译为active mode（主动语态），active voice是语态概念，与祈使语气是不同的语法范畴，张冠李戴。

question: 从马达的法兰盘上拆下3个螺钉。

options.A: Remove the 3 screws from the flap of the motor assembly.
options.B: Remove the 3 nuts from the flange of the motor assembly.
options.C: Remove the 3 screws from the flange of the motor assembly.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the 3 screws from the flange of the motor assembly.（从马达组件的法兰盘上拆下3个螺钉。）【词汇】flange=法兰盘（flap=襟翼/盖板，形近易混），screw=螺钉（nut=螺母），motor assembly=马达组件。【解析】C正确：3 screws对应"3个螺钉"，flange对应"法兰盘"，motor assembly对应"马达组件"，要素齐全。A把flange误译为flap（襟翼/盖板），形近词干扰，法兰与盖板是完全不同的部件。B把screws误译为nuts（螺母），螺钉与螺母是配套但不同的紧固件，词义错译。

question: 有关特定选装系统或设备的信息可包含在本节或第9节“补充”中。

options.A: Information on specific optional systems or equipment may be included in this section or in Section 9, Supplementary.
options.B: Information about noncompulsory systems or equipment may be included in this section or in Section 9, Supplements.
options.C: Information on specific optional systems or equipment may be included in this Section or in Section 9, Supplements.

explanation: 【译文】Information on specific optional systems or equipment may be included in this Section or in Section 9, Supplements.【词汇】optional systems=选装系统，specific=特定的，Supplements=补充（章节固定名）。【解析】C正确：specific optional对应"特定选装"，Section 9, Supplements对应第9节"补充"。A把章节名Supplements误写为Supplementary（形容词），专有名称词形错误。B把specific optional误译为noncompulsory（非强制的），语义偏移。

question: 飞机性能数据应以图或表显示。

options.A: Airline performance data shall be presented in either graphical or tabular formats.
options.B: Airplane performance data shall be presented in either graphical or tabular formats.
options.C: Airplane restriction data shall be presented in either graphical or tabular shapes.

explanation: 【译文】Airplane performance data shall be presented in either graphical or tabular formats.【词汇】airplane performance=飞机性能（airline=航空公司，形近易混），graphical or tabular formats=图或表形式。【解析】B正确：Airplane performance data对应"飞机性能数据"，graphical or tabular formats对应"图或表"。A把Airplane误译为Airline（航空公司），一字之差意义全变。C两处错误：把performance误译为restriction（限制）；formats误译为shapes（形状）。

question: 本文件为相应的飞机维护手册提供补充信息。

options.A: This document compliments informaiton to the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s).
options.B: This document provides necessary informaiton to the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s).
options.C: This document provides supplemental informaiton to the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s).

explanation: 【译文】This document provides supplemental information to the applicable airplane maintenance manual(s).【词汇】supplemental information=补充信息，applicable=适用的，maintenance manual=维护手册。【解析】C正确：supplemental information对应"补充信息"，applicable对应"相应的"。A把supplemental误译为compliments（赞美/赠送），形近但词义完全不同。B把"补充信息"误译为necessary information（必要信息），词义错译。三项informaiton均为拼写笔误，不影响判断。

question: 应使用应重量力矩包线图来描述飞机的重心限制。

options.A: A Weight and Moment Limit diagram shall be used to describe the c.g. limits.
options.B: The maximum weight moment envelope diagram should be used to describe the c.g. limit of the aircraft.
options.C: A Weight and Moment Limit diagram shall be used to describe the maximum c.g. limit.

explanation: 【译文】A Weight and Moment Limit diagram shall be used to describe the c.g. limits.【词汇】Weight and Moment Limit diagram=重量力矩（限制）图，c.g.=重心，limits=限制（含前后限）。【解析】A正确：diagram名对应"重量力矩包线图"，c.g. limits对应"重心限制"，shall对应"应"。B把diagram改为envelope diagram并添加maximum，固定表达被破坏，"最大"属添译。C把c.g. limits误译为maximum c.g. limit，重心限制含前后限，"最大"范围错误。

question: 在描述飞机起落架的部分，应说明警告系统的工作原理。

options.A: When describing the airplane's Landing Gear, how its indication system functions shall be explained.
options.B: When describing the airplane's Landing Gear, how its emergency response system functions shall be explained.
options.C: In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, how its warning system functions shall be explained.

explanation: 【译文】In the description of the airplane's Landing Gear, how its warning system functions shall be explained.【词汇】warning system=警告系统，Landing Gear=起落架，how it functions=工作原理。【解析】C正确：warning system对应"警告系统"，how...functions对应"工作原理"。A把warning system误译为indication system（指示系统），不同功能系统。B把warning system误译为emergency response system（应急反应系统），无中生有。

question: 格式可以完全或部分使用此格式。

options.A: This format may be used in integra  or in part.
options.B: This format may be used in its entirety or in part.
options.C: This format may be used in its tacticallity or in part.

explanation: 【译文】This format may be used in its entirety or in part.（此格式可整体使用或部分使用。）【词汇】in its entirety=完整地、全部地，in part=部分地，format=格式。【解析】B正确：in its entirety or in part是"完全或部分"的规范固定搭配，entirety词形正确。A把entirety误写为integra，词形错误不成词，"完全"的含义无法表达。C把entirety误写为tacticallity（生造词），同样词形错误。本题实为考查entirety的正确词形，A、C均以错误拼写干扰。

question: 描述飞机发动机时，应描述点火系统。

options.A: When describing the airplane's Engine, spark plug system shall be described.
options.B: When describing the airplane's Engine, starter system shall be described.
options.C: In the description of the airplane's Engine, ignition system shall be described.

explanation: 【译文】In the description of the airplane's Engine, the ignition system shall be described.【词汇】ignition system=点火系统，Engine=发动机，shall be described=应予以描述。【解析】C正确：ignition system对应"点火系统"，被动语态shall be described对应"应描述"。A把ignition system误译为spark plug system（火花塞系统），点火系统范围大于火花塞。B误译为starter system（起动系统），点火与起动是不同系统，张冠李戴。

question: 卡箍应该间隔不超过24英寸。应该选择适合的卡箍，以便紧密贴合而不夹住导线。

options.A: Clamps should be spaced at intervals not exceeding 24 inches. Clamps on wire bundles should be selected so that they have a snug fit without pinching wires.
options.B: Pins should be spaced at intervals not exceeding 24 inches. Pins on harness should be selected so that they have a snug fit without pinching wires.
options.C: Pins should be spaced at intervals not exceeding 24 inches. Pins on harness should be selected so that they have a snug fit without scratching wires.

explanation: 【译文】Clamps should be spaced at intervals not exceeding 24 inches and selected to fit snugly without pinching the wires.【词汇】clamp=卡箍，not exceeding=不超过，snug fit=紧密贴合，pinch=夹伤。【解析】A正确：Clamps对应"卡箍"，not exceeding 24 inches对应"不超过24英寸"，snug fit without pinching对应"紧密贴合而不夹住"。B把clamps误译为Pins（销钉），张冠李戴。C除Pins误译外，又把pinching误译为scratching（划伤），双重词义错译。

question: 预防措施之一是使易燃物远离工作区至少50英尺。

options.A: One of the safety precautions is to keep the combustible material from the work area at distance of 50ft at least.
options.B: One of the safety precautions is to keep the flammable material from the work area at distance of 50ft at least.
options.C: One of the safety precautions is to keep the combustible material from the work area at a minimum distance of 50ft.

explanation: 【译文】One of the safety precautions is to keep flammable material at least 50 ft away from the work area.【词汇】flammable material=易燃物，safety precautions=安全预防措施，at least=至少。【解析】B正确：flammable material对应"易燃物"，keep...from the work area对应"远离工作区"，at least对应"至少"。A把flammable误译为combustible（可燃的），燃烧等级用词不同。C同样用combustible；minimum distance虽可用，但术语错误使其不如B。

question: 对拧动工具做硬度测试。

options.A: Do a hardness test for turning tool.
options.B: Conduct a hardness test for the carbide insert.
options.C: Take a hardness test for the chuck.

explanation: 【译文】Do a hardness test on the turning tool.（对拧动工具做硬度测试。）【词汇】hardness test=硬度测试，turning tool=拧动工具/车削工具，do a test=做测试。【解析】A正确：hardness test对应"硬度测试"，turning tool对应"拧动工具"，do a test对应"做测试"。B两处错误：把"拧动工具"误译为carbide insert（硬质合金刀片），具体化了原文未指的部件，词义错译。C两处错误：把"拧动工具"误译为chuck（卡盘），测试对象张冠李戴；take a test是"参加考试"的口语搭配，用于检测不如do/conduct规范。

question: 如果两个表上读数不一致， 再做一次测试。

options.A: If the two indications do not agree, do the test again.
options.B: If there is a conflict between the two indications, repeat the test.
options.C: If the two indicators show any conflict, repeat the test.

explanation: 【译文】If the two indications do not agree, do the test again.【词汇】indication=读数、指示值，do not agree=不一致（agree=相符），do the test again=再做一次。【解析】A正确：two indications对应"两个表上读数"，do not agree对应"不一致"。B两处偏差：conflict（冲突）偏重矛盾，读数不一致用do not agree贴切；repeat不如do again直接。C把indications误译为indicators（指示器本体），读数与仪表张冠李戴。

question: 移除传感器以便接近传感器相邻的结构。

options.A: To gain entry to the nearby structure, take out the sensor.
options.B: Remove the sensor to get access to the adjacent structure.
options.C: Disassemble the sensor to get access to the adjacent structure.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the sensor to get access to the adjacent structure.【词汇】remove=移除、拆下，get access to=接近（维修标准用语），adjacent structure=相邻结构。【解析】B正确：Remove对应"移除"，get access to对应"接近"，adjacent对应"相邻"。A两处偏差：gain entry to不如get access to规范；nearby不如adjacent准确。C把remove误译为disassemble（分解），拆整体件用remove，disassemble指解体，词义错译。

question: 制造商推荐的时间限制、计划性维修和非计划性维修的检查检验在第五章。

options.A: Manufacturers' recommended time limits, maintenance checks and inspections (both planned and unplanned) are arranged in Chapter 5.
options.B: Manufacturers' recommended time limits, maintenance checks and tests (both scheduled and unscheduled) are arranged in Chapter 5.
options.C: Manufacturers' recommended time limits, maintenance checks and inspections (both scheduled and unscheduled) are arranged in Chapter 5.

explanation: 【译文】Manufacturers' recommended time limits, maintenance checks and inspections (both scheduled and unscheduled) are in Chapter 5.【词汇】time limits=时间限制，scheduled/unscheduled=计划性/非计划性（维修标准术语），inspections=检验。【解析】C正确：scheduled and unscheduled对应"计划性和非计划性"标准术语，inspections对应"检验"。A把scheduled误译为planned，非手册标准术语，规范性不如C。B把inspections误译为tests（测试），检查与测试词义错译。

question: 外部标牌和标记用于地面勤务说明、检查、警戒、警告等。

options.A: Exterior Placards and Markings are required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings.
options.B: Exterior Labels and Markings are required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings.
options.C: Exterior Placards and Markings are required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, warnings, cautions.

explanation: 【译文】Exterior Placards and Markings are required for ground servicing instructions, inspections, cautions, warnings.【词汇】Placards and Markings=标牌和标记，ground servicing instructions=地面勤务说明，cautions=警戒，warnings=警告。【解析】A正确：Placards and Markings对应"标牌和标记"，列表顺序与原文"说明、检查、警戒、警告"一致。B把Placards误译为Labels（标签），词义错译。C把cautions, warnings顺序颠倒为warnings, cautions，要素顺序错误。

question: 内部标牌和标记用于一般性的和应急性的信息、说明、警戒、警告等。

options.A: Interior Labels and Signs are required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings, etc.
options.B: Interior Placards and Markings are required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings, etc..
options.C: Interior Placards and Signs are required for interior general and emergency information, instructions, warnings, cautions, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Interior Placards and Markings are required for general and emergency information, instructions, cautions, warnings.【词汇】Placards and Markings=标牌和标记，emergency information=应急信息，general=一般性的。【解析】B正确：Placards and Markings对应"标牌和标记"，信息与警戒警告顺序和原文一致。A把Placards and Markings误译为Labels and Signs，两术语均偏离。C把Markings误译为Signs，且warnings, cautions顺序颠倒，双重偏差。

question: 空调系统将机身增压舱的空气保持在正确的压力、温度和新鲜度。

options.A: The air conditioning system keeps the air in the pressurized fuselage compartments at the correct pressure, temperature and freshness.
options.B: The air conditioning system keeps the air in the pressurizing cabin of the fuselage at the correct pressure, temperature and freshness.
options.C: The air conditioning system keeps the air in the pressurized cabin of the fuselage at the correct pressurization, temperature and freshness.

explanation: 【译文】The air conditioning system keeps the air in the pressurized fuselage compartments at the correct pressure, temperature and freshness.【词汇】pressurized compartment=增压舱，freshness=新鲜度。【解析】A正确：pressurized fuselage compartments对应"机身增压舱"，correct pressure对应"正确的压力"。B把pressurized误成pressurizing（正在增压），词形错误。C把pressure（压力）误译为pressurization（增压），词义错译。

question: 空调的冷却系统向座舱提供冷却空气，包括冷却组件、与冷却器工作相关的指示系统等。

options.A: The air conditioning cooling system supplies cooled air to the cabin. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, etc.
options.B: The air conditioning cooling system supplies cold air to the passenger cabin. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, etc.
options.C: The air conditioning cooling system supplies cooled air to the passenger cabin. Includes items such as the cooling pack, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The air conditioning cooling system supplies cooled air to the cabin (cooling unit, related indicating systems, etc.).【词汇】cooled air=冷却空气，cooling unit=冷却组件，cabin=座舱。【解析】A正确：cooled air对应"冷却空气"，cooling unit对应"冷却组件"，cabin对应"座舱"。B把cabin限定为passenger cabin范围缩窄，cold air不如cooled air精确。C同样限定passenger cabin，并把cooling unit误译为cooling pack。

question: 注意：制造商可以选择将线路图放在第24章、第91章或放在一本独立的线路图手册中。

options.A: NOTE: The manufacturer may have the option of including wiring schematic in Chapter 24, Chapter 91, or establish a separate Wiring Diagram Manual.
options.B: NOTE: The manufacturer may have the option of including wiring schematic in Chapter 24, Chapter 91, or establish a separate Wiring Schematic Manual.
options.C: NOTE: The manufacturer may have the option of including wiring diagrams in Chapter 24, Chapter 91, or establish a separate Wiring Diagram Manual.

explanation: 【译文】NOTE: The manufacturer may include wiring diagrams in Chapter 24 or 91, or a separate Wiring Diagram Manual.【词汇】wiring diagrams=线路图（复数规范），Wiring Diagram Manual=线路图手册（WDM）。【解析】C正确：wiring diagrams对应"线路图"统称，手册名Wiring Diagram Manual规范。A用wiring schematic（单数且schematic指原理图）不如diagrams。B两处错误：同样schematic单数；手册名误为Wiring Schematic Manual，专有名称错误。

question: ”拖动和滑行”中应包括在地面转弯技巧、刹车的使用、电源连接等程序。

options.A: "Towing and Taxiing" shall include procedures to be used such as ground turning techniques, use of parking brakes, connection of electrical power, etc..
options.B: "Towing and Taxiing" shall include procedures to be used such as ground steering techniques, use of chocks, connection of electrical power, etc..
options.C: "Towing and Taxiing" shall include procedures to be used such as ground turning techniques, use of brakes, connection of electrical power, etc..

explanation: 【译文】"Towing and Taxiing" shall include ground turning techniques, use of brakes, connection of electrical power, etc.【词汇】Towing and Taxiing=拖动和滑行，ground turning techniques=地面转弯技巧，use of brakes=刹车的使用。【解析】C正确：ground turning对应"地面转弯"，use of brakes对应"刹车的使用"（泛指）。A把brakes限定为parking brakes（停留刹车），范围缩窄。B两处错误：把turning误译为steering（转向）；brakes误译为chocks（轮挡），张冠李戴。

question: 收集所有件号为PNxxxx的维修记录。

options.A: Collect all maintenance records for the part PNxxxx.
options.B: Compile all maintenance logs for the component PNxxxx.
options.C: Collect all flight logs for the component PNxxxx.

explanation: 【译文】Collect all maintenance records for part number PNxxxx.【词汇】maintenance records=维修记录，collect=收集，part number/PN=件号。【解析】A正确：Collect对应"收集"，maintenance records对应"维修记录"，part对应"件号"。B两处错误：把collect误译为compile（汇编）；maintenance logs不如records对应，component不如part。C两处错误：把maintenance records误译为flight logs（飞行记录），张冠李戴。

question: 这个接触器有32个触点。

options.A: The connector has 32 contacting points.
options.B: The contact has 32 contactors.
options.C: The contactor has 32 contacts.

explanation: 【译文】The contactor has 32 contacts.（这个接触器有32个触点。）【词汇】contactor=接触器（电磁开关器件），contact=触点，connector=连接器（易混）。【解析】C正确：contactor对应"接触器"，contacts对应"触点"，主宾关系准确——接触器包含触点。A把contactor误译为connector（连接器），接触器与连接器是不同器件；contacting points也不如contacts规范。B两处错误：把contactor误写为contact（触点），把contacts误写为contactors（接触器），主宾关系完全颠倒，语义荒谬。

question: 额定马力以及螺旋桨转速

options.A: Horsepower Radius and Engine Revolving Speed
options.B: Horsepower Ratings and Propeller Rotational Speed
options.C: Horsepower Values and Propeller Turning Speed

explanation: 【译文】Horsepower Ratings and Propeller Rotational Speed【词汇】horsepower ratings=额定马力（rating=额定值），propeller=螺旋桨，rotational speed=转速。【解析】B正确：Ratings对应"额定"（功率额定值标准术语），Propeller Rotational Speed对应"螺旋桨转速"。A两处错误：Ratings误译为Radius（半径），形近干扰；Engine Revolving Speed与"螺旋桨"张冠李戴。C两处偏差：Values不如Ratings体现"额定"；Turning Speed不如Rotational Speed规范。

question: 任何情况下都不要超过这个速度或马赫数。

options.A: Do not exceed this dimension or Mach in any operation.
options.B: Do not exceed the regulated flight speed or Mach Number in any operation.
options.C: Do not exceed this speed or Mach Number in any operation.

explanation: 【译文】Do not exceed this speed or Mach Number in any operation.【词汇】exceed=超过，Mach Number=马赫数，in any operation=在任何情况下，this speed=这个速度。【解析】C正确：Do not exceed对应"不要超过"，this speed对应"这个速度"，in any operation对应"任何情况下"。A把speed误译为dimension（尺寸），词义错译；Mach也漏译Number。B把this speed改写成the regulated flight speed，添加"规定""飞行"等原文未有限定，属添译。

question: “非正常程序检查单”应简明扼要。

options.A: The Unusual Procedures Check List should be in concrete, abbreviated form.
options.B: The Emergency Procedures Check List should be in constant, abbreviated form.
options.C: The Abnormal Procedures Check List should be in concise, abbreviated form.

explanation: 【译文】The Abnormal Procedures Check List should be in concise, abbreviated form.【词汇】Abnormal Procedures=非正常程序（emergency=应急，unusual=不寻常），concise=简明的，abbreviated form=扼要形式。【解析】C正确：Abnormal对应"非正常"（标准章节名），concise, abbreviated对应"简明扼要"。A两处错误：Abnormal误译为Unusual；concrete（具体的）与"简明"无关。B两处错误：Abnormal误译为Emergency（应急，另一检查单类别）；constant（恒定的）词义错译。

question: 控制后缘襟翼位置和移动的系统部分。

options.A: That section of the systems which controls the position and rotation of the trailing edge flaps.
options.B: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the trailing edge flaps.
options.C: That part of the systems which controls the position and rotation of the flaps.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the trailing edge flaps.【词汇】trailing edge flaps=后缘襟翼，position and movement=位置和移动，portion=部分（定义体规范用词）。【解析】B正确：trailing edge flaps对应"后缘襟翼"，movement对应"移动"，portion为规范用词。A把movement误译为rotation（旋转），襟翼运动不全是旋转。C两处错误：漏译trailing edge，仅译flaps范围扩大；movement同样误译为rotation。

question: 用来探测和指示积冰情况的系统部分。

options.A: The section of the system which is used to sense and signal the formation of ice.
options.B: The portion of the system which is used to detect and display the condition of ice.
options.C: The portion of the system which is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.

explanation: 【译文】The portion of the system which is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.【词汇】detect=探测，indicate=指示，formation of ice=积冰（冰的形成），portion=部分。【解析】C正确：detect and indicate对应"探测和指示"（标准动词），formation of ice对应"积冰"。A两处偏差：sense and signal不如detect and indicate规范对应。B两处错误：把formation误译为condition（状况），过程变状态；display不如indicate对应"指示"规范。

question: 涡轮能够利用排气能量，并与曲轴相连。

options.A: The turbines are used to extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.
options.B: The turbines can drive energy to exhaust gas and connects crankshaft.
options.C: The turbines can extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive the crankshaft.

explanation: 【译文】The turbines are used to extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.【词汇】extract energy from=从……提取能量，exhaust gases=排气，coupled to=与……相连，crankshaft=曲轴。【解析】A正确：extract energy对应"利用排气能量"，coupled to对应"与……相连"。B两处错误：drive energy to exhaust gas（给排气输能）方向相反；connects单复数语法错。C把coupled to误译为drive the crankshaft（驱动曲轴），连接变驱动，超出原意。

question: 发动机系统中包含螺旋桨轴和减速器的部分。

options.A: The section of the engine system which contains the turbine shafts and reduction gears.
options.B: The section of the engine system which contains the propeller shafts and reduction gears.
options.C: The section of the engine system which contains the connection shafts and reduction gears.

explanation: 【译文】The section of the engine system which contains the propeller shafts and reduction gears.【词汇】propeller shaft=螺旋桨轴，reduction gears=减速器，engine system=发动机系统。【解析】B正确：propeller shafts对应"螺旋桨轴"，reduction gears对应"减速器"。A把propeller shafts误译为turbine shafts（涡轮轴），不同轴系张冠李戴。C误译为connection shafts（连接轴），部件名无中生有。

question: 用于指示滑油油量、温度和压力的系统部分。

options.A: That portion of the system is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to indicate the quality, temperature and pressure of the oil.
options.C: That portion of the system is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the fuel.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil.（该系统部分用于指示滑油油量、温度和压力。）【词汇】quantity=油量、数量（quality=质量，形近易混），oil=滑油（fuel=燃油，干扰），indicate=指示。【解析】A正确：quantity对应"油量"，oil对应"滑油"，temperature and pressure对应"温度和压力"，三项参数齐全。B把quantity误译为quality（质量），一字之差词义全变，指示对象是油量而非质量。C把oil误译为fuel（燃油），滑油参数与燃油参数张冠李戴，指示对象错误。

question: 该系统部分可在起动过程中用于驱动曲轴。

options.A: That portion of the system is used to perform the cranking portion of the starting operation.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to perform the igniting portion of the starting operation.
options.C: That portion of the system is used to perform the cranking portion of the igniting operation.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to perform the cranking portion of the starting operation.【词汇】cranking=盘车、转动曲轴，starting operation=起动过程，portion=环节。【解析】A正确：cranking portion对应"驱动曲轴"环节，starting operation对应"起动过程"。B把cranking误译为igniting（点火），起动过程的不同环节词义错译。C把starting operation误译为igniting operation，所属过程整体错译。

question: 起动系统指用于起动发动机的装置、部件及相关系统。

options.A: Starting system refers to those units, components and associated systems used for igniting the engine.
options.B: Starting system refers to those units, components and associated systems used for idling the engine.
options.C: Starting system refers to those units, components and associated systems used for starting the engine.

explanation: 【译文】Starting system refers to those units, components and associated systems used for starting the engine.【词汇】starting system=起动系统，units, components and associated systems=装置、部件及相关系统，starting=起动。【解析】C正确：starting the engine对应"起动发动机"，refers to对应"指"。A把starting误译为igniting（点火），不同功能词义错译。B误译为idling（慢车/怠速），怠速是运转状态非起动动作，词义错译。

question: 动力装置或通过排气或转动螺旋桨产生推力。

options.A: The power plant uses an air vent or propeller to produce power.
options.B: The power plant develops thrust either through the exhaust or through a propeller.
options.C: The power plant generates propulsion with the aid of the exhaust or a propeller.

explanation: 【译文】The power plant develops thrust either through the exhaust or through a propeller.【词汇】power plant=动力装置，develops thrust=产生推力，exhaust=排气，either...or=或……或。【解析】B正确：develops thrust对应"产生推力"，either...or对应"或……或"。A两处错误：thrust误译为power（功率）；air vent（通气口）不等于exhaust。C两处偏差：propulsion近义但thrust是标准对应；with the aid of弱化直接关系，精度不如B。

question: 在动力装置表面或其周围安装有阻热隔板或封严层。

options.A: The fire-proof materials and seals are mounted on or about the power unit.
options.B: The fire-resistant partitions and seals are mounted on the power unit.
options.C: The fire-resistant partitions or seals are mounted on or about the power package.

explanation: 【译文】Fire-resistant partitions or seals are mounted on or about the power package.【词汇】fire-resistant partitions=阻热隔板，power package=动力装置，on or about=在……上或周围。【解析】C正确：partitions对应"阻热隔板"，or seals对应"或封严层"，on or about对应"表面或其周围"。A两处错误：partitions误译为materials（材料）；power unit不如power package，"或"变"和"。B两处错误：漏译or about的"或其周围"；"或"也误成"和"，范围错误。

question: 发动机可以把功率传给螺旋桨轴。

options.A: The power is transmitted from the propeller to the engine.
options.B: The engine is used to transmit power to the propeller shaft.
options.C: The power is transmitted to the shaft by the engine cable.

explanation: 【译文】The engine is used to transmit power to the propeller shaft.【词汇】transmit power to=传递功率给，propeller shaft=螺旋桨轴，engine=发动机。【解析】B正确：transmit power to对应"把功率传给"，方向正确。A把方向译反：from the propeller to the engine（从螺旋桨传给发动机），方向相反。C两处错误：by the engine cable添加cable无中生有；propeller漏译。

question: 替代燃油和经批准的添加剂

options.A: substituted oil and authorized addings
options.B: alternate fuels and approved additives
options.C: replaceable fuels and accepted additives

explanation: 【译文】Alternate fuels and approved additives【词汇】alternate fuels=替代燃油，approved additives=经批准的添加剂。【解析】B正确：alternate对应"替代"（燃油语境标准词），approved对应"经批准的"。A多处错误：fuels误译为oil（滑油）；substituted不等于alternate；addings非规范词。C两处偏差：replaceable侧重可替换而非"替代"；accepted不如approved体现"批准"。

question: 超过此速度时不要放出或收上起落架。

options.A: Do not extend or retract landing gear above this speed.
options.B: Do not expand or retract landing gear at this speed.
options.C: Do not put down or retract landing gear by more than this speed.

explanation: 【译文】Do not extend or retract the landing gear above this speed.【词汇】extend=放出（起落架），retract=收上，above this speed=超过此速度。【解析】A正确：extend or retract对应"放出或收上"（标准动词），above this speed对应"超过此速度"。B两处错误：extend误译为expand（膨胀）；at this speed（在此速度时）条件不同。C两处错误：put down不规范；by more than this speed搭配错误。

question: 确保指示不超过400节。

options.A: Make sure that the scale is not more than 400 knots.
options.B: Make sure that the indication is not more than 400 knots.
options.C: Make sure that the indication is not more than 400 miles.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the indication does not exceed 400 knots.（确保指示不超过400节。）【词汇】indication=指示（值），not more than=不超过，knots=节（海里/小时），miles=英里（干扰）。【解析】B正确：indication对应"指示"，not more than对应"不超过"，400 knots对应"400节"，单位正确。A把indication误译为scale（刻度），指示读数与刻度尺是不同对象，词义错译。C把knots（节）误译为miles（英里），航空速度单位为节，单位张冠李戴且未换算。

question: 保留所有可用的部件，并丢弃那些损坏的部件。

options.A: Keep all the parts that are serviceable and discard those that are broken.
options.B: Retain the parts that are functional and discard those that are of poor condition.
options.C: Keep all the parts that are operational and drop those that are contaminated.

explanation: 【译文】Keep all the parts that are serviceable and discard those that are broken.【词汇】serviceable=可用的（放行标准术语），discard=丢弃，broken=损坏的。【解析】A正确：serviceable对应"可用的"，discard对应"丢弃"，broken对应"损坏的"。B两处偏差：functional不如serviceable规范；of poor condition不如broken对应"损坏"。C多处错误：operational不准；drop（掉落）不等于discard；contaminated（污染）与"损坏"错译。

question: 如果用了很大的力来打开组件，则检查控制连杆。

options.A: If you must apply a strike to open the unit, examine the control linkage.
options.B: If you must apply an unusual force to open the unit, examine the turnbuckle.
options.C: If you must apply an unusual force to open the unit, examine the control linkage.

explanation: 【译文】If you must apply an unusual force to open the unit, examine the control linkage.【词汇】unusual force=异常大的力，control linkage=控制连杆，examine=检查。【解析】C正确：unusual force对应"很大的力"，control linkage对应"控制连杆"。A把force误译为strike（敲击），apply a strike搭配不成立，词义错译。B把control linkage误译为turnbuckle（松紧螺套），检查对象张冠李戴。

question: 如果胎压特别高，打开活门。

options.A: If the tire temperature is unusually high, open the valve.
options.B: If the tyre pressure is insufficiently high, open the valve.
options.C: If the tire pressure is unusually high, open the valve.

explanation: 【译文】If the tire pressure is unusually high, open the valve.（如果胎压异常高，打开活门。）【词汇】tire pressure=胎压（temperature=温度，干扰），unusually high=特别高、异常高，valve=活门。【解析】C正确：tire pressure对应"胎压"，unusually high对应"特别高"（异常地高），open the valve对应"打开活门"。A把pressure误译为temperature（温度），胎压与胎温是不同参数，词义错译。B把unusually误译为insufficiently（不足地），"insufficiently high"（不够高）与"特别高"方向相反，逻辑不通。

question: 不要在垫圈上涂抹过多的粘合剂。

options.A: Do not apply too much composite on the blanket.
options.B: Do not apply too much adhesive on the gasket.
options.C: Do not apply too much compound on the gasket.

explanation: 【译文】Do not apply too much adhesive on the gasket.（不要在垫圈上涂过多粘合剂。）【词汇】adhesive=粘合剂，gasket=垫圈/垫片，apply=涂抹，too much=过多。【解析】B正确：adhesive对应"粘合剂"，gasket对应"垫圈"，Do not apply too much对应"不要涂抹过多"。A两处错误：把adhesive误译为composite（复合材料），粘合剂与复材不同；gasket误译为blanket（毡垫/覆盖层），垫圈对象错。C把adhesive误译为compound（化合物/混合料），compound泛指混合物而非专用粘合剂，词义不精确。

question: 用力过大会损坏密封件。

options.A: Too much force can cause damage to the sealing components.
options.B: Excessive force may damage the seal.
options.C: Too much force can cause damage to the contact surface.

explanation: 【译文】Excessive force may damage the seal.（过大的力可能损坏密封件。）【词汇】excessive force=过大的力，may damage=可能损坏，seal=密封件/封严。【解析】B正确：Excessive force对应"用力过大"（excessive=过量的），damage the seal对应"损坏密封件"，简洁规范。A两处偏差：Too much force可用但excessive更规范；sealing components（密封部件）为复数泛称，原文"密封件"即seal，A把概念扩大为组件集合。C把seal误译为contact surface（接触表面），损坏对象从密封件变成接触面，张冠李戴。

question: 交换1、2号计算机，然后再做测试。

options.A: Replace the No. 1 and No. 2 computers. Then do the test again.
options.B: Interchange the No. 1 and No. 2 computers. Then do the test again.
options.C: Repair the No. 1 and No. 2 computers. Then do the test again.

explanation: 【译文】Interchange the No. 1 and No. 2 computers, then do the test again.（对调1号和2号计算机，然后再做测试。）【词汇】interchange=交换、对调（两设备互换位置），replace=更换（用新件替换），do the test again=再做测试。【解析】B正确：Interchange对应"交换"（两台计算机位置对调，排故常用手段），No. 1 and No. 2 computers对应"1、2号计算机"。A把"交换"误译为Replace（更换），replace是用备件换下故障件，不是两台互换，词义错译。C把"交换"误译为Repair（修理），交换与修理是完全不同的排故操作，词义错译。

question: 这个步骤不包括拆除活塞。

options.A: This procedure does not include the removal of the cylinder.
options.B: This procedure does not exclude the removal of the piston.
options.C: This procedure does not include the removal of the piston.

explanation: 【译文】This procedure does not include the removal of the piston.（本程序不包括拆卸活塞。）【词汇】does not include=不包括，removal=拆除、拆卸（remove名词化），piston=活塞（cylinder=气缸/作动筒，易混）。【解析】C正确：does not include对应"不包括"，removal of the piston对应"拆除活塞"。A把piston误译为cylinder（气缸/作动筒），活塞与气缸配套但不同部件，词义错译。B把does not include误译为does not exclude（不排除），双重否定变成"包含"之意，逻辑方向相反。

question: 确保在滑油中没有金属粒子。

options.A: Make sure that there are no foreign particles in the oil.
options.B: Make sure that there are no metal particles in the oil.
options.C: Make sure that there are exempt metal particles in the oil.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that there are no metal particles in the oil.（确保滑油中没有金属粒子。）【词汇】metal particles=金属粒子、金属屑（磨损检测用语），no=没有，in the oil=在滑油中。【解析】B正确：metal particles对应"金属粒子"，no对应"没有"，in the oil对应"在滑油中"。A把metal误译为foreign（外来物），foreign particles泛指一切异物，比"金属粒子"范围扩大，词义不准。C把no误译为exempt（豁免的），"exempt metal particles"语法不通，否定意义完全丢失，方向相反。

question: 注意不要让酸接触皮肤。

options.A: Be careful not to get acid on your skin.
options.B: Prohibit not to get acid on your skin.
options.C: Be careful not to get alcohol on your skin.

explanation: 【译文】Be careful not to get acid on your skin.（注意不要让酸接触皮肤。）【词汇】be careful not to=注意不要，acid=酸（alcohol=酒精，干扰），get...on skin=沾到皮肤。【解析】A正确：Be careful not to对应"注意不要"，acid对应"酸"，on your skin对应"接触皮肤"。B两处错误：Prohibit not to（禁止不要）双重否定语法错误，意为"必须接触"；prohibit后不接not to do结构，语法不通。C把acid误译为alcohol（酒精），腐蚀性酸液与酒精是不同物质，安全警示对象错误。

question: 不要对后法兰施加力。

options.A: Do not alleviate pressure to the aft flange.
options.B: Do not apply pressure to the aft flange.
options.C: Do not apply pressure to the aft screw bolt.

explanation: 【译文】Do not apply pressure to the aft flange.（不要对后法兰施加力。）【词汇】apply pressure to=对……施加力/压力，aft flange=后法兰，alleviate=减轻（干扰）。【解析】B正确：apply pressure对应"施加力"，aft flange对应"后法兰"，否定祈使结构准确。A把apply误译为alleviate（减轻/缓解），施加与减轻方向相反，alleviate pressure意为减压而非施压。C把flange误译为screw bolt（螺栓），法兰与螺栓是不同部件，词义错译。

question: 戴上氧气面罩呼吸。

options.A: Exhale into the oxygen mask.
options.B: Breathe into the oxygen mask.
options.C: Breathe into the gas mask.

explanation: 【译文】Breathe into the oxygen mask.（戴着氧气面罩呼吸。）【词汇】oxygen mask=氧气面罩（gas mask=防毒面具，干扰），breathe=呼吸，exhale=呼气（仅呼出）。【解析】B正确：Breathe into对应"通过……呼吸"，oxygen mask对应"氧气面罩"，呼吸动作完整。A把breathe误译为Exhale（呼气），呼吸包含吸与呼，仅呼气范围缩窄，词义错译。C把oxygen mask误译为gas mask（防毒面具），氧气面罩供氧与防毒面具滤毒功能不同，张冠李戴。

question: APU排气是危险的。

options.A: The exhaust from the Auxiliary Power Unit is dangerous.
options.B: The exhaust from the nozzle unit is dangerous.
options.C: The exhaust from the Auxiliary Power Unit inlet is dangerous.

explanation: 【译文】The exhaust from the Auxiliary Power Unit is dangerous.（APU的排气是危险的。）【词汇】Auxiliary Power Unit (APU)=辅助动力装置，exhaust=排气（inlet=进气口，干扰），dangerous=危险的。【解析】A正确：Auxiliary Power Unit对应"APU"全称，exhaust对应"排气"，dangerous对应"危险"。B把APU误译为nozzle unit（喷管组件），辅助动力装置与喷管是完全不同的设备，张冠李戴。C把exhaust误译为APU inlet（APU进气口），排气与进气位置相反，方向相反错误。

question: 利用风扇排气。

options.A: Use a fan to suck the gases.
options.B: Use a turbine fan to remove the gases.
options.C: Use a fan to remove the gases.

explanation: 【译文】Use a fan to remove the gases.（用风扇排走气体。）【词汇】fan=风扇，remove=排除、清除，gases=气体，turbine fan=涡轮风扇（干扰）。【解析】C正确：Use a fan对应"利用风扇"，remove the gases对应"排（除）气"，remove为规范动词。A把remove误译为suck（吸），"排气"是吹除/排走，suck强调吸入，用词不规范。B把fan限定为turbine fan（涡轮风扇），原文仅"风扇"未指明涡轮型，添加限定范围缩窄。

question: 释放蓄压器内的液压力。

options.A: Release the hydraulic pressure in the accumulator.
options.B: Release the power pressure in the accumulator.
options.C: Release the hydraulic pressure in the actuator.

explanation: 【译文】Release the hydraulic pressure in the accumulator.（释放蓄压器内的液压力。）【词汇】hydraulic pressure=液压（力），accumulator=蓄压器/蓄能器（actuator=作动筒，干扰），release=释放。【解析】A正确：hydraulic pressure对应"液压力"，accumulator对应"蓄压器"，release对应"释放"。B把hydraulic误译为power（动力/功率），power pressure是生造搭配，液压与动力词义错译。C把accumulator误译为actuator（作动筒），蓄压器储能、作动筒作动，不同部件张冠李戴。

question: 第2.0段中给出了测试条件的详尽表。

options.A: The toxic conditions are given in Paragraph 2.0.
options.B: All the test result are given in Paragraph 2.0.
options.C: All the test conditions are given in Paragraph 2.0.

explanation: 【译文】All the test conditions are given in Paragraph 2.0.（第2.0段中给出了全部测试条件。）【词汇】test conditions=测试条件（toxic=有毒的，形近干扰），given in=在……中给出，Paragraph 2.0=第2.0段。【解析】C正确：test conditions对应"测试条件"，All...are given对应"详尽表/全部给出"，Paragraph 2.0对应"第2.0段"。A把test误译为toxic（有毒的），形近词干扰，测试条件与毒性条件词义错译。B两处错误：把conditions误译为result（结果），条件与结果不同概念；test result单复数也不一致，词义错译加语法错。

question: 确保所有紧急出口没有不需要的物品。

options.A: Make sure that all the emergency exits are clear of unwanted objects.
options.B: Make sure that all the exits are clear of foreign objects.
options.C: Make sure that all the emergency entrance are freee of unwanted objects.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that all the emergency exits are clear of unwanted objects.【词汇】emergency exits=紧急出口（entrance=入口），clear of=无……阻碍，unwanted objects=不需要的物品。【解析】A正确：emergency exits对应"紧急出口"，clear of unwanted objects对应"没有不需要的物品"。B两处错误：漏译emergency；foreign objects与"不需要的"不完全对应。C两处错误：exits误译为entrance（入口）方向相反；freee为拼写错误。

question: 如果温度有可能降到-20摄氏度，拆下电瓶。

options.A: When it is unlikely that the temperature decreases to -20 ℃, remove the batteries.
options.B: If it is possible that the temperature will decrease to -20 ℃, remove the batteries.
options.C: If it is possible that the temperature will decrease to -20 ℃,  cut the cells.

explanation: 【译文】If it is possible that the temperature will decrease to -20°C, remove the batteries.【词汇】it is possible=有可能（unlikely=不大可能），decrease to=降到，batteries=电瓶。【解析】B正确：it is possible对应"有可能"，decrease to -20℃对应"降到-20℃"，remove the batteries对应"拆下电瓶"。A两处错误：possible误译为unlikely（方向相反）；When不如If对应"如果"。C两处错误：batteries误译为cells（电芯）；cut不等于remove。

question: 如果误差超过3度，校正罗盘。

options.A: If the error is more than 3 degrees, calibrate the glide slope.
options.B: If the error is more than 3 degrees, calibrate the compass.
options.C: If the error is more than 3 degrees, calibrate the gyroscope.

explanation: 【译文】If the error is more than 3 degrees, calibrate the compass.（如果误差超过3度，校正罗盘。）【词汇】error=误差，more than=超过，calibrate=校正/校准，compass=罗盘。【解析】B正确：error对应"误差"，more than 3 degrees对应"超过3度"，calibrate the compass对应"校正罗盘"。A把compass误译为glide slope（下滑道），校正对象从罗盘变成下滑道，张冠李戴。C把compass误译为gyroscope（陀螺仪），罗盘与陀螺虽相关但是不同设备，词义错译。

question: 评估所需要的数量。

options.A: Make an estimate of the necessary quantity.
options.B: Evaluate on the quantity available.
options.C: Approximate the scale of the quality.

explanation: 【译文】Make an estimate of the necessary quantity.（评估所需的数量。）【词汇】make an estimate=评估、估算，necessary quantity=所需数量（quality=质量，形近干扰）。【解析】A正确：Make an estimate对应"评估"，necessary quantity对应"所需要的数量"，动宾搭配规范。B两处错误：Evaluate on搭配不当（evaluate为及物动词）；把necessary误译为available（可用的），所需与可用词义错译。C两处错误：把quantity误译为quality（质量），形近词错译；Approximate作动词为"接近"，scale of the quality语义不通。

question: 阻尼器可以防止操纵面突然移动。

options.A: The damper prevents abnormal movement of the control.
options.B: The control is protected from unusual movements by the damper.
options.C: The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.

explanation: 【译文】The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.（阻尼器防止操纵面突然运动。）【词汇】damper=阻尼器，sudden movement=突然移动（abnormal=异常的，干扰），control=操纵面/控制面。【解析】C正确：damper对应"阻尼器"，prevents对应"防止"，sudden movement对应"突然移动"。A把sudden误译为abnormal（异常的），突然侧重时间突发性、异常侧重性质反常，词义偏差。B用被动结构is protected from，意思近似但unusual movements（异常运动）同样不如sudden对应"突然"，且句式转换改变了原句主语地位。

question: 若支架未损坏，则继续执行此程序。

options.A: If the brackets are not damaged, continue the procedure.
options.B: In the absence of damage to the brackets, recall the process.
options.C: When bracket damage occurs, recall the procedure.

explanation: 【译文】If the brackets are not damaged, continue the procedure.【词汇】bracket=支架，not damaged=未损坏，continue the procedure=继续执行程序。【解析】A正确：brackets对应"支架"，are not damaged对应"未损坏"，continue对应"继续执行"。B两处错误：recall the process（召回/回想）不等于"继续执行"，词义错译；in the absence of语气迂回。C把条件译反：damage occurs（损坏时）与"未损坏"方向相反，recall同样错。

question: 确保不要操作相邻的控制器。

options.A: Ensure that you do activate the control adjacent to it.
options.B: Adjust the adjacent control for optimal results.
options.C: Make sure that you do not operate the adjacent control.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that you do not operate the adjacent control.（确保不要操作相邻的控制器。）【词汇】adjacent control=相邻控制器，do not operate=不要操作，make sure=确保。【解析】C正确：do not operate对应"不要操作"，adjacent control对应"相邻的控制器"，否定位置准确。A两处错误：漏掉not变成do activate（确实要激活），否定变肯定方向相反；adjacent to it添加的代词it指代不明。B把祈使句误译为Adjust...for optimal results（为最佳效果调节），"不要操作"变成"调节"，否定指令完全丢失，逻辑相反。

question: 确保客舱内的压力差不多为零。

options.A: Make sure that the pressure in the cabin is almost zero.
options.B: Verify that the cabin pressure is not above zero.
options.C: Ensure that the pressure in the cabin is completely zero.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the pressure in the cabin is almost zero.（确保客舱内压力几乎为零。）【词汇】almost zero=几乎为零/差不多为零（completely=完全，干扰），cabin=客舱，pressure=压力。【解析】A正确：pressure in the cabin对应"客舱内的压力"，almost zero对应"差不多为零"（接近但未必恰为零）。B把almost zero误译为not above zero（不高于零），"不高于零"物理上不可能且与"几乎为零"含义不同，逻辑错误。C把almost误译为completely（完全地），几乎与完全程度不同，"完全为零"过于绝对，程度错误。

question: 如果固态样品中有金属屑，则更换泵。

options.A: If there are metal fragments in the liquid sample, replace the pump.
options.B: If there are only small metal particles in the solid sample, replace the pump.
options.C: If there are metal particles in the sample solids, replace the pump.

explanation: 【译文】If there are metal particles in the sample solids, replace the pump.【词汇】metal particles=金属屑，sample solids=（样品中的）固态物，replace=更换。【解析】C正确：metal particles对应"金属屑"，sample solids对应"固态样品"，replace对应"更换"。A把solid误译为liquid（液体样品），固液方向相反。B两处偏差：添加only small限定属添译；solid sample词序虽自然但多余限定失真。

question: 发动机及所有附件使用同一种滑油。

options.A: The engine and all additional facilities use indifferent lubricants.
options.B: The engine uses multiple types of lubricants for different purposes.
options.C: The engine and all auxiliary equipment use the same lubricant.

explanation: 【译文】The engine and all auxiliary equipment use the same lubricant.【词汇】auxiliary equipment=附件、辅助设备，same lubricant=同一种滑油，use=使用。【解析】C正确：auxiliary equipment对应"附件"，the same lubricant对应"同一种滑油"。A两处错误：additional facilities（附加设施）不如auxiliary equipment；indifferent lubricants（无差别的）词义错译。B把含义译反：multiple types...different purposes与"同一种"方向相反。

question: 在紧急情况下，一次性电瓶可提供直流电源。

options.A: In an emergency, the one-shot battery supplies DC power.
options.B: The one-act battery supplies AC power during emergencies.
options.C: The one-side battery provides DC power during emergency situations.

explanation: 【译文】In an emergency, the one-shot battery supplies DC power.（紧急情况下，一次性电瓶提供直流电源。）【词汇】one-shot battery=一次性电瓶（单次激活电池），in an emergency=在紧急情况下，DC power=直流电源（AC=交流）。【解析】A正确：one-shot battery对应"一次性电瓶"（标准术语），supplies DC power对应"提供直流电源"，In an emergency对应"在紧急情况下"。B两处错误：one-act battery非规范术语；把DC误译为AC（交流），电源类型方向相反。C两处错误：one-side battery词形错误非术语；核心术语错误使其不如A。

question: 给减速板液压系统泄压。

options.A: Decrease the pressure in the hydraulic system.
options.B: Bleed the speedbrake hydraulic system.
options.C: Disconnect the speedbrake hydraulic system.

explanation: 【译文】Bleed the speedbrake hydraulic system.【词汇】bleed=泄压/排放（系统内压力或气体），speedbrake hydraulic system=减速板液压系统，decrease the pressure=降低压力，disconnect=断开。【解析】B正确：bleed对应“泄压”，speedbrake hydraulic system完整保留“减速板液压系统”两个限定词。A两处错误：漏译speedbrake（漏译要素），且decrease the pressure仅表示“降低压力”，不包含维修中主动排放的操作含义（词义错译）。C把“泄压”误译为disconnect（断开），泄压是排放压力，断开是切断管路连接，动作完全不同（词义错译）。

question: 喷油嘴堵塞会导致错误的操作。

options.A: A blocked oil jet cannot enhance performance.
options.B: Incorrect operation is caused by a blocked oil tank.
options.C: A blocked oil jet can cause incorrect operation.

explanation: 【译文】A blocked oil jet can cause incorrect operation.【词汇】oil jet=喷油嘴（滑油喷嘴），blocked=堵塞的，can cause=会导致，incorrect operation=错误的操作，enhance performance=提高性能。【解析】C正确：a blocked oil jet、can cause、incorrect operation三处考点全部对应。A把“会导致错误的操作”误译为cannot enhance performance（不能提高性能），因果要素完全丢失（漏译要素）。B把oil jet误译为oil tank（油箱），部件张冠李戴；且is caused用一般现在时被动，弱化了“会导致”的可能性语气。

question: 如果供压停止，请取消测试。

options.A: Carry on with the test if the pressure supply is not available.
options.B: Ignore the test if the pressure supply is strengthened.
options.C: If the pressure supply stops, cancel the test.

explanation: 【译文】If the pressure supply stops, cancel the test.【词汇】pressure supply=供压/压力供给，stop=停止，cancel the test=取消测试，carry on with=继续进行，ignore=忽略。【解析】C正确：if引导的条件句对应“如果”，stops对应“停止”，cancel the test对应“取消测试”，语序语义全对。A两处错误：carry on with the test意为“继续测试”，与“取消”方向相反；not available表示“不可用”，未表达“停止”这一状态变化。B两处错误：ignore the test误译为“忽略测试”；strengthened是“增强”，与“停止”词义完全不符。

question: 顺时针旋转调节器使显示器更亮。

options.A: Turn the adjuster clockwise to make the display brighter.
options.B: Turn the adjuster clockwise to make the display dimmer.
options.C: Adjust the brightness of the display by turning the adjuster.

explanation: 【译文】Turn the adjuster clockwise to make the display brighter.【词汇】clockwise=顺时针地，adjuster=调节器，brighter=更亮，dimmer=更暗。【解析】A正确：turn the adjuster clockwise对应“顺时针旋转调节器”，to make the display brighter以不定式表目的“使显示器更亮”。B把brighter误译为dimmer（更暗），亮度方向相反（方向相反错误）。C漏译clockwise，丢失“顺时针”的操作方向，且只说调节亮度未体现“更亮”的结果（漏译要素）。

question: 用柔软的干布快速摩擦表面。

options.A: Vigorously scrub the surface with a rough, dry cloth.
options.B: Polish the surface with a soft, damp cloth.
options.C: Rub the surface quickly with a soft, dry cloth.

explanation: 【译文】Rub the surface quickly with a soft, dry cloth.【词汇】rub=摩擦，quickly=快速地，soft, dry cloth=柔软的干布，scrub=用力擦洗，damp=潮湿的。【解析】C正确：rub...quickly对应“快速摩擦”，soft, dry cloth两个修饰词全部对应。A两处错误：把“柔软”误译为rough（粗糙的，方向相反）；vigorously scrub语义过重，scrub是用力刷洗而非普通摩擦（词义错译）。B两处错误：把“干布”误译为damp cloth（湿布，方向相反）；polish是“抛光打蜡”而非“摩擦”（词义错译）。

question: 燃油和氧气的混合物能引起爆炸。

options.A: A mixture of fuel and oxygen can cause an explosion.
options.B: Fuel and oxygen react with each other to cause explosion.
options.C: A mixture of fluid and oxygen can be set on fire.

explanation: 【译文】A mixture of fuel and oxygen can cause an explosion.【词汇】mixture=混合物，fuel=燃油，explosion=爆炸，fluid=流体（易与fuel混淆），set on fire=点燃。【解析】A正确：a mixture of对应“……的混合物”，fuel and oxygen与can cause an explosion全部对应。B两处错误：用react with each other替换mixture结构，“混合物”要素丢失（漏译）；cause explosion缺冠词、表达不规范。C两处错误：把fuel误译为fluid（流体，词义错译），把“引起爆炸”误译为set on fire（点燃），爆炸不等于点燃。

question: 金属会引起磁干扰。

options.A: Metal objects attract magnetic interference.
options.B: Magnetic interference can occur to the metal objects.
options.C: Metal objects can cause magnetic interference.

explanation: 【译文】Metal objects can cause magnetic interference.【词汇】metal objects=金属物体，cause=引起，magnetic interference=磁干扰，attract=吸引，occur=发生。【解析】C正确：metal objects作主语对应“金属”，can cause对应“会引起”，magnetic interference术语准确。A把“引起”误译为attract（吸引），“金属吸引磁干扰”逻辑不通（词义错译）。B把因果关系倒置：变成“磁干扰会发生在金属物体上”，原句中金属是干扰源，B中金属成了受扰对象，主宾关系颠倒（方向相反）。

question: 选择要增压的液压系统。

options.A: Select the specific system that you will apply pressure to.
options.B: Select the hydraulic system that you will pressurize.
options.C: Identify the hydraulic system that you will bleed.

explanation: 【译文】Select the hydraulic system that you will pressurize.【词汇】select=选择，hydraulic system=液压系统，pressurize=增压，bleed=泄压，identify=识别。【解析】B正确：select、hydraulic system、you will pressurize三处考点全部对应。A两处错误：漏译hydraulic只译作the specific system（漏译要素）；apply pressure to表达泛化，不如pressurize术语化。C两处错误：把select误译为identify（识别），把pressurize误译为bleed，增压与泄压方向相反。

question: 由于液位不准确，系统无法工作。

options.A: Due to the incorrect level of pressure, the system will not work.
options.B: As long as the fluid level remains unstable, the system will fail.
options.C: Because the fluid level is incorrect, the system will not operate.

explanation: 【译文】Because the fluid level is incorrect, the system will not operate.【词汇】fluid level=液位，incorrect=不准确的，operate=工作/运转，as long as=只要，unstable=不稳定的。【解析】C正确：because引出“由于”的原因，fluid level is incorrect对应“液位不准确”，will not operate对应“无法工作”。A把fluid level误译为the level of pressure（压力水平），液位变压力（张冠李戴）。B两处错误：as long as意为“只要”，把因果改成条件（结构错译）；unstable是“不稳定”，与“不准确”词义不符。

question: 离心泵向组件提供液压油。

options.A: A centrifugal pump supplies hydraulic fluid to the unit.
options.B: The unit is isolated from hydraulic fluid through a centrifugal pump.
options.C: A centrifugal pump withdraws hydraulic fluid from the unit.

explanation: 【译文】A centrifugal pump supplies hydraulic fluid to the unit.【词汇】centrifugal pump=离心泵，supply...to=向……提供，hydraulic fluid=液压油，withdraw...from=从……抽出，isolated from=与……隔离。【解析】A正确：centrifugal pump、supplies、hydraulic fluid、to the unit四要素全部对应“向组件提供液压油”。B把supplies...to误译为is isolated from（被隔离），供油变成隔离，方向相反。C把“向组件提供”误译为withdraws...from（从组件抽出），供油方向完全相反（方向相反错误）。

question: 如果出现故障，齿轮将自动脱开。

options.A: The gears will automatically engage if a malfunction occurs.
options.B: If there is proper functioning, the gears will automatically engage.
options.C: If there is a malfunction, the gears will automatically disengage.

explanation: 【译文】If there is a malfunction, the gears will automatically disengage.【词汇】malfunction=故障，automatically=自动地，disengage=脱开，engage=啮合（与disengage相反），proper functioning=正常工作。【解析】C正确：if there is a malfunction对应“如果出现故障”，automatically disengage对应“自动脱开”。A把disengage误译为engage（啮合），故障时应脱开而非啮合，动作方向相反。B两处错误：把malfunction误译为proper functioning（正常工作，条件相反），且同样误用engage。

question: 当安装分配器时，不要移动计时器。

options.A: When installing the distributor, refrain from changing the timing.
options.B: Ensure that you do not adjust the timing to install the distributor.
options.C: Do not move the timing when you install the distributor.

explanation: 【译文】Do not move the timing when you install the distributor.【词汇】distributor=分配器，timing=正时/计时位置，move=移动，refrain from=避免，adjust=调整。【解析】C正确：do not move the timing对应“不要移动计时（正时）”，when you install the distributor对应“当安装分配器时”。A把move弱化为changing（改变），“移动”与“改变设定”不同（词义错译），refrain from也不如祈使句直接。B把when条件改为“不要为安装而调整正时”的目的关系，move改为adjust，条件结构与动作词均偏离（结构错译）。

question: 可以把排放管分成三大类。

options.A: You can combine the drains into three primary categories.
options.B: You can divide the drains into three primary groups.
options.C: Dividing the drains into three primary groups is an ill-advised option.

explanation: 【译文】You can divide the drains into three primary groups.【词汇】divide...into=把……分成，drains=排放管，primary=主要的，group=类别，combine=合并，ill-advised=不明智的。【解析】B正确：divide...into对应“分成”，drains对应“排放管”，three primary groups对应“三大类”。A把divide误译为combine（合并），“分成”变“合并”，方向相反。C虽用了divide和three primary groups，但an ill-advised option意为“不明智的做法”，给原文附加了否定评价，把中性陈述变为否定建议（语气错译）。

question: 当对灭火瓶进行维护时，请使用护目镜。

options.A: Use protective goggles when you do work on fire extinguishers.
options.B: Ensure that you wear protective clothes while performing tasks on fire extinguishers.
options.C: Use protective gloves when working on fire extinguishers

explanation: 【译文】Use protective goggles when you do work on fire extinguishers.【词汇】protective goggles=护目镜，do work on=对……进行维护作业，fire extinguisher=灭火瓶，gloves=手套。【解析】A正确：protective goggles对应“护目镜”，when you do work on fire extinguishers对应“对灭火瓶进行维护时”。B把goggles误译为protective clothes（防护服），防护用品张冠李戴。C把goggles误译为protective gloves（防护手套），同属护具混淆。

question: 在收上测试期间监控指示器的指示。

options.A: During the retraction test, keep a close watch on the monitor.
options.B: Continuously observe the indications after the retraction test.
options.C: Monitor the indications during the retraction test.

explanation: 【译文】Monitor the indications during the retraction test.【词汇】monitor=监控（作动词），indication=指示/指示值，retraction test=收上测试，during=在……期间，keep a close watch on=密切注视。【解析】C正确：monitor the indications对应“监控指示器的指示”，during the retraction test对应“在收上测试期间”。A把indications误译为monitor本身（监视器），变成“密切注视监视器”，监控对象错译（张冠李戴）。B两处错误：把during误译为after（测试之后，时间相反）；continuously为添加的修饰成分（增译）。

question: 该系统是电力控制、液压作动。

options.A: The system is pneumatically operated and mechanically controlled.
options.B: Hydraulic power drives the system, while electricity is connected.
options.C: The system is hydraulically operated and electrically controlled.

explanation: 【译文】The system is hydraulically operated and electrically controlled.【词汇】hydraulically operated=液压作动，electrically controlled=电力控制，pneumatically=气动的。【解析】C正确：两个“副词+过去分词”结构分别对应“液压作动”“电力控制”。A两处错误：液压误作pneumatically（气动），电力误作mechanically（机械），张冠李戴。B只写液压驱动、电“被连接”（is connected），未表达“电力控制”（漏译要素）。

question: 阻尼器可以防止操纵面突然移动。

options.A: The damper prevents abnormal movement of the control.
options.B: The control is protected from unusual movements by the damper.
options.C: The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.

explanation: 【译文】The damper prevents sudden movement of the control.【词汇】damper=阻尼器，prevent=防止，sudden=突然的，control=操纵面，abnormal=异常的。【解析】C正确：damper、prevents、sudden movement、control四要素全部对应。A把sudden误译为abnormal（异常的），“突然”强调时间性，“异常”强调性质，词义错译。B两处错误：unusual仍是“不寻常”而非“突然”；且改被动结构is protected from，弱化“防止突然移动”的主动防护关系。

question: 将修理补片准确地贴在损坏的部位。

options.A: Put the repair patch accurately on the damaged area.
options.B: Put the repair patch on the correct damaged area.
options.C: Correctly put the repair sealant on the damaged parts.

explanation: 【译文】Put the repair patch accurately on the damaged area.【词汇】repair patch=修理补片，accurately=准确地，damaged area=损坏部位，sealant=密封胶，correctly=正确地。【解析】A正确：repair patch对应“修理补片”，accurately修饰“贴”对应“准确地贴”，damaged area对应“损坏的部位”。B把“准确地（贴）”移位修饰damaged area，变成“正确的损坏部位”，副词修饰对象错译（结构错译）。C两处错误：把patch误译为sealant（密封胶，材料张冠李戴），把area误译为parts（部件），部位范围不符。

question: 将汽缸提升到其安装位置的上方。

options.A: Rise the cylinder up its install position.
options.B: Lift the cylinder above its installed position.
options.C: Lift the bushings above its installing position.

explanation: 【译文】Lift the cylinder above its installed position.【词汇】lift=提升，cylinder=汽缸，above=在……上方，installed position=安装位置，bushing=衬套。【解析】B正确：lift the cylinder对应“提升汽缸”，above its installed position对应“其安装位置上方”。A两处错误：rise是不及物动词不能带宾语the cylinder（语法错误）；install position应为installed。C把cylinder误译为bushings（衬套，部件张冠李戴），installing position语法亦错。

question: 有关电路跳开关位置的数据，请参考导线清单。

options.A: For data about the location of circuit breakers, refer to the wiring list.
options.B: Refer to the wiring list about the adapters location data.
options.C: For data about the location of circuit breakers, refer to the wiring diagram.

explanation: 【译文】For data about the location of circuit breakers, refer to the wiring list.【词汇】circuit breaker=电路跳开关，refer to=参考，wiring list=导线清单，wiring diagram=线路图。【解析】A正确：location of circuit breakers对应“电路跳开关位置”，refer to the wiring list对应“参考导线清单”。B两处错误：circuit breakers误作adapters（适配器，张冠李戴）；语序混乱。C把wiring list误译为wiring diagram（线路图），资料类型错译。

question: 设置控制器以获得最大推力。

options.A: Preset the control to get maximum thrust.
options.B: Set the control to get maximum thrust.
options.C: Reset the control to get the maximum force .

explanation: 【译文】Set the control to get maximum thrust.【词汇】set=设置，control=控制器，maximum thrust=最大推力，preset=预设，reset=重置，force=力。【解析】B正确：set the control对应“设置控制器”，to get maximum thrust对应“以获得最大推力”。A把set误译为preset（预先设置），增加了“预先”这一时序限定（词义错译）。C两处错误：reset是“重置”而非“设置”（词义错译）；把thrust（推力）误译为force（力），航空术语中thrust专指发动机推力，force范围过宽。

question: 一台发电机可以为所有系统提供电力。

options.A: A motor can power all the systems.
options.B: One generator can power for all the systems.
options.C: One generator can supply power for all the systems.

explanation: 【译文】One generator can supply power for all the systems.【词汇】generator=发电机，supply power=提供电力，system=系统，motor=电动机/马达，power作动词=为……供电（直接接宾语）。【解析】C正确：one generator对应“一台发电机”，supply power for all the systems对应“为所有系统提供电力”，主语与供电关系完整。A把generator误译为motor（电动机），动力装置张冠李戴。B的power作及物动词后直接接for all the systems属语法错误，power作动词不能带for宾语结构（语法错误）。

question: 向化合物中加入5毫升硬化剂。

options.A: Add 5 ml of hardener to the compound.
options.B: Add 5 ml of adhesive to the compound.
options.C: Put 5 ml of hardener to the component.
