explanation: 【译文】Add 5 ml of hardener to the compound.【词汇】add...to=向……中加入，hardener=硬化剂，compound=化合物/混合料，adhesive=胶黏剂，component=部件，put=放置。【解析】A正确：add 5 ml of对应“加入5毫升”，hardener、compound两个术语全部对应。B把hardener误译为adhesive（胶黏剂），化学材料张冠李戴。C两处错误：把compound误译为component（部件，词义混淆）；put...to结构不当，“向……中加入”应说add...to或put...into（语法错误）。

question: 将频率调整到表1中给出的值。

options.A: Adjust the frequency to the value giving in table 1.
options.B: Adjust the frequency  per the value given in table 1.
options.C: Adjust the frequency to the value given in table 1.

explanation: 【译文】Adjust the frequency to the value given in table 1.【词汇】adjust...to=把……调整到，frequency=频率，value=数值，given in table 1=表1中给出的（过去分词作后置定语），per=按照。【解析】C正确：adjust...to结构对应“调整到”，the value given in table 1用过去分词given正确表达“给出的值”。A把given误写为giving（现在分词），变成“值主动给出”逻辑不通（语法错误）。B用per the value表示“按照该值”，adjust per the value意为“依据该数值进行调整”而非“调整到该数值”，调整方向不符（词义错译）。

question: 确保门锁完全啮合。

options.A: Make sure that the latch is fully engaged.
options.B: Make sure that the knob is fully engaged.
options.C: Make sure that the latch in full engaged position.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the latch is fully engaged.【词汇】make sure that=确保，latch=门锁/闩锁，fully engaged=完全啮合，knob=旋钮。【解析】A正确：latch对应“门锁”，is fully engaged对应“完全啮合”，确保对象与状态均准确。B把latch误译为knob（旋钮），部件张冠李戴。C两处错误：从句缺谓语is，in full engaged position语法不成立；且full应为副词fully（语法错误）。

question: 清洁表面，以确保粘接符合要求。

options.A: Clean the surface to make sure that the sealing is satisfactory.
options.B: Clean surfaces to ensure  the bonding as required.
options.C: Clean the surface to make sure that the bond is satisfactory.

explanation: 【译文】Clean the surface to ensure the bonding is as required.【词汇】bonding=粘接（工艺），as required=按要求/符合要求，clean the surface=清洁表面，sealing=密封，satisfactory=令人满意的。【解析】B正确：bonding对应“粘接（工艺）”，as required直接对应“符合要求”，要点齐全。A把bonding误译为sealing（密封），粘接工艺变成密封工艺（张冠李戴）。C两处偏差：把bonding改为bond（粘接点/胶接处），工艺范围变窄；把“符合要求”改写为is satisfactory（令人满意），“按要求”这一限定未直接体现，准确性逊于B。

question: 雷达罩的状况对其性能有着重要的影响。

options.A: The condition of the radome is very important for its performance.
options.B: The condition of the antenna influences its properties greatly.
options.C: The condition of the radar has an important effect on its characteristics.

explanation: 【译文】The condition of the radome is very important for its performance.【词汇】radome=雷达罩，condition=状况，performance=性能，antenna=天线，properties=特性。【解析】A正确：condition of the radome对应“雷达罩的状况”，important for its performance对应“对其性能有重要影响”。B两处错误：把radome误译为antenna（天线），把performance误译为properties（特性）。C两处错误：把radome误译为radar（雷达），把performance误译为characteristics（特性）。

question: 提起座椅直至离开轨道锁。

options.A: The seat shall be lifted to leave the track locked.
options.B: Lift the seat until it is away from the track locks.
options.C: Eject the seat until it is isolated from the track locks.

explanation: 【译文】Lift the seat until it is away from the track locks.【词汇】lift=提起，until=直至，away from=离开，track locks=轨道锁，eject=弹射。【解析】B正确：lift the seat对应“提起座椅”，until it is away from the track locks对应“直至离开轨道锁”。A把“离开轨道锁”误译为leave the track locked（使轨道保持锁定），语义相反。C把lift误译为eject（弹射），away from误译为isolated from（隔离），词义均错。

question: 喷油嘴堵塞可能导致操作错误。

options.A: Possibly, the incorrect operation will occur due to the contaminated oil jet.
options.B: Incorrect operation is absolutely resulted from a blocked ignitor.
options.C: A blocked oil jet can cause incorrect operation.

explanation: 【译文】A blocked oil jet can cause incorrect operation.【词汇】blocked=堵塞的，oil jet=喷油嘴，can cause=可能导致，ignitor=点火器，contaminated=受污染的。【解析】C正确：a blocked oil jet对应“喷油嘴堵塞”，can cause对应“可能导致”，incorrect operation对应“操作错误”。A把blocked误译为contaminated（受污染的，故障类型不同）。B两处错误：把oil jet误译为ignitor（点火器，张冠李戴）；absolutely否定了“可能”的概率含义（方向相反）。

question: 用适用的公式计算压力。

options.A: Proper recipe shall be adopted to measure the pressure.
options.B: The pressure shall be estimated by using accurate equation.
options.C: Calculate the pressure with the applicable formula.

explanation: 【译文】Calculate the pressure with the applicable formula.【词汇】calculate=计算，applicable=适用的，formula=公式，recipe=配方，estimate=估算。【解析】C正确：calculate the pressure对应“计算压力”，with the applicable formula对应“用适用的公式”。A两处错误：把formula误译为recipe（配方），把calculate误译为measure（测量）。B两处错误：把calculate误译为estimated（估算），把applicable误译为accurate（精确的），“适用”与“精确”词义不同。

question: 在高压环境下工作时，应遵守安全注意事项。

options.A: Obey the safety precautions when you do work with high voltages.
options.B: When working with high resistances, you should follow the safety precautions.
options.C: The safety precautions are optional in an environment with high voltages.

explanation: 【译文】Obey the safety precautions when you do work with high voltages.【词汇】obey=遵守，safety precautions=安全注意事项，high voltages=高压（电压），optional=可选的。【解析】A正确：obey the safety precautions对应“遵守安全注意事项”，do work with high voltages对应“在高压环境下工作”（此处高压指高电压）。B把voltages误译为resistances（电阻），危险对象错译。C把“应遵守”误译为optional（可选的），义务变选择（方向相反）。

question: 易燃物品与工作区域保持至少50英尺的距离。

options.A: A maximum distance of 50 feet is required between consumable materials and the work area.
options.B: Keep flammable materials at a minimum distance of 50 feet from the work area.
options.C: Explosive materials must be kept at least 50 feet away from the work area.

explanation: 【译文】Keep flammable materials at a minimum distance of 50 feet from the work area.【词汇】flammable materials=易燃物品，minimum distance=最小距离（即“至少”），work area=工作区域，explosive=爆炸性的。【解析】B正确：flammable materials对应“易燃物品”，minimum distance of 50 feet对应“至少50英尺的距离”。A两处错误：把minimum误译为maximum（最大，方向相反），把flammable误译为consumable（消耗品）。C把flammable误译为explosive（爆炸性材料），危险品类别错译。

question: 等第一层油漆完全干透后再涂第二层。

options.A: Wait for the paint to dry completely before polishing it again.
options.B: Do not apply the second layer of paint if the first layer has dried thoroughly.
options.C: Let the first layer of paint dry fully before you apply the second layer.

explanation: 【译文】Let the first layer of paint dry fully before you apply the second layer.【词汇】first layer=第一层，dry fully=完全干透，apply=涂覆，second layer=第二层，polish=抛光。【解析】C正确：first layer of paint dry fully对应“第一层油漆完全干透”，before you apply the second layer对应“再涂第二层”。A把“涂第二层”误译为polishing it again（再次抛光），工序错译。B把时序倒置为“第一层干透就不要涂第二层”，与“干透后再涂”方向相反。

question: 为避免污染，必须在非常清洁的环境里执行该任务。

options.A: Because of the risk of contamination, you must do this task in a very clean environment.
options.B: To prevent environmental pollution, this task must be done in a very clean area.
options.C: In order to prevent contamination, the task you must do is to find a very clean environment.

explanation: 【译文】Because of the risk of contamination, you must do this task in a very clean environment.【词汇】contamination=污染，must=必须，environmental pollution=环境污染。【解析】A正确：contamination对应“污染”，do this task in a very clean environment对应“在非常清洁的环境里执行该任务”，must保留“必须”。B把contamination改为environmental pollution（环境污染），工艺污染错译为环保概念（范围错误）。C把“在清洁环境中执行任务”误译为“寻找清洁环境”（结构错译）。

question: 初始表面涂饰和新表面涂饰之间不应有视觉差异。

options.A: Visual difference is acceptable between the previous surface and the new surface.
options.B: There should be no visual difference between the initial surface finish and the new surface finish.
options.C: It is forbidden to have acoustic difference between the former surface finish and the new surface finish.

explanation: 【译文】There should be no visual difference between the initial surface finish and the new surface finish.【词汇】visual difference=视觉差异，surface finish=表面涂饰，acoustic=听觉的。【解析】B正确：no visual difference对应“不应有视觉差异”，initial与new surface finish两对象全对。A把“不应有”误译为is acceptable（可以接受），否定变肯定（方向相反）。C把visual误译为acoustic（听觉的），感知类型错译。

question: 带有磁性的工具对罗盘系统有不利影响。

options.A: Magnetic tools have an unwanted effect on the compass system.
options.B: Metallic tools  are of positive effect on the compass system.
options.C: Magnets can affect the compass system adversely.

explanation: 【译文】Magnetic tools have an unwanted effect on the compass system.【词汇】magnetic tools=带磁工具，unwanted effect=不良影响，compass system=罗盘系统，metallic=金属的。【解析】A正确：magnetic tools对应“带有磁性的工具”，unwanted effect对应“不利影响”，compass system对应“罗盘系统”。B两处错误：把magnetic误译为metallic（金属的），把“不利”误译为positive（积极的），属性与效果方向全反。C把“工具”误译为magnets（磁铁），漏掉tools这一关键限定（漏译要素）。

question: 安装天线时，对齐箭头必须朝前。

options.A: When installing the antenna, the arrows must be aligned  and point forward.
options.B: When installing the radome, you must keep the arrow pointing forward.
options.C: When you install the antenna, the alignment arrow must point forward.

explanation: 【译文】When you install the antenna, the alignment arrow must point forward.【词汇】alignment arrow=对齐箭头，point forward=朝前，radome=雷达罩。【解析】C正确：install the antenna对应“安装天线”，the alignment arrow must point forward对应“对齐箭头必须朝前”。A把alignment arrow拆译为arrows must be aligned and point forward，定语“对齐”变成动作（结构错译）。B把antenna误译为radome（雷达罩），并漏译alignment限定。

question: 参考下表以获得适用的扭矩值。

options.A: Find appropriate torque values in the table above.
options.B: Refer to the table that follows for the applicable torque values.
options.C: Proper torque values can be found in the booklet attached.

explanation: 【译文】Refer to the table that follows for the applicable torque values.【词汇】refer to=参考，the table that follows=下表，applicable=适用的，torque values=扭矩值，above=上面的。【解析】B正确：refer to对应“参考”，the table that follows对应“下表”，applicable torque values对应“适用的扭矩值”。A把“下表”误译为the table above（上表），方位相反。C把“表”误译为attached booklet（所附小册子），参考来源张冠李戴，且refer to弱化为can be found。

question: 发动机和辅助设备使用相同的润滑油。

options.A: Lubricate the engine and its accessories with the same brand.
options.B: Lubricants for the engine and the auxiliary equipment are the same.
options.C: The engine and the additional devices are greased in a same manner.

explanation: 【译文】Lubricants for the engine and the auxiliary equipment are the same.【词汇】lubricant=润滑油，auxiliary equipment=辅助设备，the same=相同的，grease=涂润滑脂。【解析】B正确：比较对象是发动机与辅助设备所用润滑油本身，are the same对应“相同”。A两处错误：改写成“用同一品牌润滑”的指令；same接brand偷换了润滑油对象。C把“润滑油相同”误译为greased in a same manner（润滑方式相同），对象错译。

question: 临时用一些辅助螺丝来组装这个部件。

options.A: Use some auxiliary screws to assemble the unit temporarily.
options.B: You shall use some additional screws to install the unit permanently.
options.C: Temporarily disassemble this unit using some auxiliary screwdrivers.

explanation: 【译文】Use some auxiliary screws to assemble the unit temporarily.【词汇】auxiliary screws=辅助螺丝，assemble=组装，temporarily=临时地，permanently=永久地，screwdriver=螺丝刀。【解析】A正确：auxiliary screws、assemble the unit、temporarily三处全部对应。B两处错误：把temporarily误译为permanently（永久地，方向相反），assemble弱化为install。C两处错误：把assemble误译为disassemble（拆解，方向相反），把screws误译为screwdrivers（螺丝刀），零件变工具。

question: 在管子的连接处缠两层胶带。

options.A: Wrap two tapes around the pipe connectors.
options.B: Wrap the pipe joints with tape twice.
options.C: Wind two layers of tape around the pipe joints.

explanation: 【译文】Wind two layers of tape around the pipe joints.【词汇】wind=缠绕，two layers=两层，tape=胶带，pipe joints=管子连接处，twice=两次。【解析】C正确：wind...around对应“缠”，two layers of tape对应“两层胶带”，pipe joints对应“管子连接处”。A把“两层”误译为two tapes（两条/两卷胶带），数量单位错译（词义错译）。B两处错误：with tape twice意为“用胶带缠两次”，把“两层”误译为“两次”；且未体现覆盖层数概念。

question: 关于一般信息，参见发动机工作限制、指南和专用程序。

options.A: Refer to the general information in addition to engine operation limits, guidelines and special procedures.
options.B: For general information, refer to engine operation limits, guidelines and special procedures.
options.C: Refer to engine operation limits, guidelines and special procedures besides general information.

explanation: 【译文】For general information, refer to engine operation limits, guidelines and special procedures.【词汇】for general information=关于一般信息，refer to=参见，in addition to=除……之外。【解析】B正确：for general information对应“关于一般信息”，refer to后接三个并列参照对象。A把“关于”误译为in addition to（除……之外还），参照关系变附加关系（结构错译）。C用besides general information，同样把参照对象变成排除对象。

question: 压缩空气会将污染物吹入显示组件内。

options.A: Compressed air will push contamination into the display unit.
options.B: The display unit will be contaminated by compressed air.
options.C: Air pressure will push the dirt into the display unit.

explanation: 【译文】Compressed air will push contamination into the display unit.【词汇】compressed air=压缩空气，push...into=把……吹入，contamination=污染物，display unit=显示组件。【解析】A正确：compressed air作主语，push contamination into对应“将污染物吹入”，display unit对应“显示组件”。B改被动句“显示组件将被压缩空气污染”，吹入污染物的动作与方向丢失（结构错译）。C两处错误：把compressed air弱化为air pressure（气压），把contamination误译为dirt（污垢）。

question: 用上部的锁机构安装中下显示组件。

options.A: Use the upper latch mechanism to lock the lower display unit in the middle.
options.B: The latch mechanism at the top is used to secure the center display unit on the bottom.
options.C: The center lower display unit  is installed with the latch mechanism at the top.

explanation: 【译文】The center lower display unit is installed with the latch mechanism at the top.【词汇】center lower display unit=中下显示组件，latch mechanism=锁机构，at the top=上部的。【解析】C正确：中下显示组件与“用上部的锁机构安装”两要点全对。A两处错误：lower display unit in the middle语序混乱；to lock（锁定）替代install（安装），动作错译。B把“中下”拆译为center...on the bottom，方位关系改变。

question: 如果燃油样品中没有污染，则继续该程序。

options.A: Obey the procedure if there is no debris in the oil sample.
options.B: If the fuel is not polluted, go on with the procedure.
options.C: If there is no contamination in the fuel sample, continue the procedure.

explanation: 【译文】If there is no contamination in the fuel sample, continue the procedure.【词汇】fuel sample=燃油样品，contamination=污染，continue the procedure=继续该程序，debris=碎屑。【解析】C正确：no contamination in the fuel sample对应“燃油样品中没有污染”，continue the procedure对应“继续该程序”。A三处错误：debris是“碎屑”非泛称污染；oil sample把“燃油样品”误译为“油样”；obey是“遵守”非“继续”。B漏译sample，把“燃油样品”扩大为“燃油”（漏译要素）。

question: 将支架与相邻部件对齐。

options.A: The brackets should be connected to the nearest components.
options.B: Align the brackets with the adjacent components.
options.C: Keep the brackets engaged with the nearby components.

explanation: 【译文】Align the brackets with the adjacent components.【词汇】align...with=将……与……对齐，bracket=支架，adjacent=相邻的，engage=啮合，nearest=最近的。【解析】B正确：align the brackets with对应“将支架与……对齐”，adjacent components对应“相邻部件”。A两处错误：把align误译为connected（连接），把adjacent弱化为nearest（最近的）。C两处错误：把align误译为engaged（啮合/接合），把adjacent误译为nearby（附近的）。

question: 控制杆的向前移动必须是缓慢而连续的。

options.A: The forward movement of the control lever must be slow and continuous.
options.B: The control lever must be kept moving forward slowly and abruptly.
options.C: You must continuously slow down the forward movement of the control lever .

explanation: 【译文】The forward movement of the control lever must be slow and continuous.【词汇】forward movement=向前移动，control lever=控制杆，abruptly=突然的（与continuous相反）。【解析】A正确：forward movement对应“向前移动”，must be slow and continuous对应“必须是缓慢而连续的”。B把continuous误译为abruptly（突然的），方向相反。C把slow and continuous改造成continuously slow down（持续减速）的动作过程（结构错译）。

question: 轮胎磨损随速度提高而增加。

options.A: Tire wear increases with high speed.
options.B: The higher the speed is, the more fragile the tire becomes.
options.C: The tire blows out as the speed increases.

explanation: 【译文】Tire wear increases with high speed.【词汇】tire wear=轮胎磨损，increase=增加，with high speed=随（着）速度（提高），fragile=易损的，blow out=爆胎。【解析】A正确：tire wear对应“轮胎磨损”，increases with对应“随……增加”，high speed对应速度提高，正相关关系保留。B两处错误：把“磨损增加”误译为the tire becomes more fragile（轮胎变得更易损），磨损程度变成脆弱性（词义错译）。C把“磨损增加”误译为blows out（爆胎），把渐进磨损夸大为爆胎结果（词义错译）。

question: 如果更改此修理程序，须获得设计机构的批准。

options.A: The Design Authority is responsible for approving and changing the repair procedure.
options.B: Any alteration to this repair procedure must get verbal approval of the Design Authority.
options.C: If you change this repair procedure, get approval of the Design Authority.

explanation: 【译文】If you change this repair procedure, get approval of the Design Authority.【词汇】repair procedure=修理程序，approval=批准，Design Authority=设计机构，verbal=口头的。【解析】C正确：if you change this repair procedure对应“如果更改此修理程序”，get approval对应“获得批准”。A把条件句改写为职责陈述“设计机构负责批准和更改”，申请方与批准方关系颠倒（结构错译）。B加入verbal approval（口头批准），原文并无此限定（增译）。

question: 使用应急泵时应记录操作时间。

options.A: Operation time should be recorded if the pump is in emergency .
options.B: When you use the emergency pump, record the time of operation.
options.C: When the pump is for emergency use, record the time of usage.

explanation: 【译文】When you use the emergency pump, record the time of operation.【词汇】emergency pump=应急泵，record=记录，time of operation=操作时间。【解析】B正确：when you use the emergency pump对应“使用应急泵时”，record the time of operation对应“记录操作时间”。A把条件误译为if the pump is in emergency（泵处于应急状态），使用动作变成设备状态（条件错译）。C误译为the pump is for emergency use（泵属应急用途），动作变成属性（结构错译）。

question: 这些密封剂的特性可以防止腐蚀。

options.A: The properties of these sealants prevent corrosion.
options.B: Corrosion frequently occurs due to the features of these sealants.
options.C: The properties of these sealants make themselves easily corroded.

explanation: 【译文】The properties of these sealants prevent corrosion.【词汇】properties=特性，sealant=密封剂，prevent=防止，corrosion=腐蚀，corroded=被腐蚀的。【解析】A正确：properties of these sealants对应“这些密封剂的特性”，prevent corrosion对应“可以防止腐蚀”。B把因果反转：密封剂特性导致corrosion frequently occurs（腐蚀频发），防腐变成致腐（方向相反）。C把prevent误译为make themselves easily corroded（使自身易腐蚀），同样方向相反。

question: 通过油箱侧面的开口进入控制组件。

options.A: By way of the control unit, enter the opening in the side of the tank.
options.B: Get access to the control unit through the opening in the side of the tank.
options.C: Get access to the control unit by opening one side of the tank.

explanation: 【译文】Get access to the control unit through the opening in the side of the tank.【词汇】get access to=进入/接近，opening=开口，in the side of the tank=油箱侧面的。【解析】B正确：through the opening in the side of the tank对应“通过油箱侧面的开口”，get access to the control unit对应“进入控制组件”。A倒置路径为by way of the control unit，入口与目的地颠倒（方向相反）。C把through the opening误译为by opening one side（打开油箱一侧）。

question: 在模拟高度时确保ATC应答机处于待机状态。

options.A: When simulating altitude, make sure you have alternate ATC transponders in active mode.
options.B: Make sure that the ATC transponders are in standby mode when you simulate altitude.
options.C: It is optional to keep the ATC transponders in ready mode during altitude simulation.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the ATC transponders are in standby mode when you simulate altitude.【词汇】standby mode=待机方式，simulate altitude=模拟高度，ATC transponder=ATC应答机，optional=可选的。【解析】B正确：standby mode对应“待机状态”，when you simulate altitude对应“模拟高度时”。A两处错误：alternate增译“备用”；active mode把“待机”误为“工作方式”（方向相反）。C两处错误：standby误为ready mode；optional把“确保”弱化为“可选”。

question: What is the position of APU bleed valve if the right engine is shut down?

options.A: If the right engine stops, what position will  APU servo valve stop at?
options.B: If the right engine is not running,what position will  APU bleed valve stop at?
options.C: If the right engine stops, will  APU servo valve stop at close position?

explanation: 【译文】If the right engine is not running, what position will the APU bleed valve stop at?【词汇】APU bleed valve=APU引气活门，shut down=停车，servo valve=伺服活门，position=位置。【解析】B正确：is shut down转写为is not running，bleed valve保留原部件，仍以特殊疑问句问“停在什么位置”。A把bleed valve误译为servo valve（伺服活门，张冠李戴）。C两处错误：同样误用servo valve；把“位置是什么”的特殊疑问句改成“是否停在关位”的一般疑问句（句式错译）。

question: Mark and protect the removed parts.

options.A: Mark and protect the parts and then remove the parts..
options.B: Mark and protect the parts that are removed.
options.C: Mark and protect the parts that will be removed.

explanation: 【译文】Mark and protect the parts that are removed.【词汇】mark=做标记，protect=保护，removed parts=已拆下的部件（过去分词表完成），will be removed=将被拆下的，then=然后。【解析】B正确：the parts that are removed对应“已拆下的部件”，“先拆下、再标记保护”的工序顺序与原文一致。A把动作顺序颠倒：先mark and protect再remove（then remove the parts），“先拆后护”变成“先护后拆”（方向相反）。C把removed（已拆）误译为will be removed（将要拆），操作对象变成尚未拆下的部件（时态错译）。

question: Check all parts for obvious defects in accordance with standard industry practices.

options.A: Check all parts with clear defects in accordance with standard industry practices.
options.B: Check all parts for visible defects in accordance with standard industry practices.
options.C: Check all parts for serious defects in accordance with standard industry practices.

explanation: 【译文】Check all parts for visible defects in accordance with standard industry practices.【词汇】check...for defects=检查……有无缺陷，obvious=明显的，in accordance with=按照。【解析】B正确：visible defects对应“明显缺陷”，in accordance with standard industry practices照译。A误译为check all parts with clear defects，变成“检查带缺陷的部件”，对象错（结构错译）。C把obvious误译为serious（严重的），程度错译。

question: English is not often the native language of the readers of technical documentation.

options.A: English is not often the mother language of the readers of technical files.
options.B: English is not often the private language of the readers of technical books.
options.C: English is not often the required language of the readers of technical pamphlet.

explanation: 【译文】English is not often the mother language of the readers of technical files.【词汇】native language=母语，technical documentation=技术文件，mother language=母语（同义改写）。【解析】A正确：native language转写为mother language，documentation转写为files，要素全对。B两处错误：native误译为private（私人的），documentation误译为books（书籍）。C把native误译为required（必需的），documentation误译为pamphlet（小册子）。

question: Ground service bus has no power with external power available.

options.A: Ground service bus has no power, but the external power can be supplied.
options.B: Ground service bus is not energized with external power.
options.C: Ground service bus is  power off when external power is supplied.

explanation: 【译文】Ground service bus has no power, but the external power can be supplied.【词汇】ground service bus=地面勤务汇流条，external power=外部电源，available=可用的。【解析】A正确：with external power available转写为but the external power can be supplied，“外部电源可供”的让步含义保留。B误为not energized with external power，“可供”变“失效”（词义错译）。C误为when external power is supplied，“可供”变“已供”（条件错译）。

question: This document gives the different torque values and the conditions where they are applicable.

options.A: The different torque values and their applicable conditions are contained in this document.
options.B: This document lists the different torque values and applies them in different conditions.
options.C: This document is applied if different torque values are given in these conditions.

explanation: 【译文】The different torque values and their applicable conditions are contained in this document.【词汇】torque values=扭矩值，conditions where they are applicable=适用条件，contain=包含。【解析】A正确：gives转写为被动are contained in，扭矩值与适用条件两要素完整。B误译为applies them in different conditions（文档在不同条件下应用这些值），结构错译。C误译为“在这些条件下给出不同扭矩值时才应用文档”，主客体颠倒（方向相反）。

question: Make sure that you have a satisfactory view of all components.

options.A: Make sure that you can see all components clearly.
options.B: Make sure that all components are in position.
options.C: Make sure that all component are in good condition.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that you can see all components clearly.【词汇】satisfactory view=清晰的视野，see clearly=看清楚，in position=在位，in good condition=状况良好。【解析】A正确：have a satisfactory view of转写为can see...clearly（能清楚看见），观察对象all components不变。B把“看清楚部件”误译为in position（部件在位），视野要求变成位置确认（词义错译）。C把view误译为in good condition（状况良好），检查目的错译。

question: If the humidity changes frequently, put a cover on the unit.

options.A: Cover the unit if the humidity keeps changing.
options.B: Seal it if you can not control the humidity in the unit.
options.C: Use a cover to keep the humidity in the unit at a constant level.

explanation: 【译文】Cover the unit if the humidity keeps changing.【词汇】humidity=湿度，changes frequently=频繁变化，put a cover on=给……加盖，seal=密封，constant level=恒定水平。【解析】A正确：put a cover on the unit转写为cover the unit，changes frequently转写为keeps changing，条件与动作全对应。B两处错误：把“湿度频繁变化”误译为“无法控制组件内湿度”（条件错译）；把put a cover误译为seal（密封），措施错译。C把条件句误译为目的句“用罩子使组件内湿度保持恒定”，加盖的原因和预期效果都被篡改（结构错译）。

question: Remove all ground equipment that is not necessary.

options.A: All ground equipment that is removed is not necessary.
options.B: Remove all ground equipment as necessary.
options.C: Move away all unnecessary ground equipment.

explanation: 【译文】Move away all unnecessary ground equipment.【词汇】ground equipment=地面设备，unnecessary=不必要的，remove=移走，as necessary=按需要。【解析】C正确：remove转写为move away，all ground equipment that is not necessary转写为all unnecessary ground equipment，限定关系准确。A把定语从句改为判断句“所有被移走的地面设备都是不必要的”（结构错译）。B把“不必要的”误译为as necessary（按需要的），“移走不必要设备”变“按需移走”，方向相反。

question: Hold the panel in its installation position and install the fastener.

options.A: The panel should be kept in mounting postion and the fastener can be installed.
options.B: The fatener should be installed, then the panel can be hold in the correct position.
options.C: The fastener is designed to keep the panel in the correct installation .

explanation: 【译文】The panel should be kept in its mounting position and the fastener can be installed.【词汇】hold...in position=将……保持在位，fastener=紧固件，panel=面板。【解析】A正确：kept in mounting position对应“保持在安装位置”，fastener can be installed对应“安装紧固件”（postion拼写瑕疵不影响判断）。B把顺序颠倒：先装紧固件再保持面板（方向相反）。C把祈使句改写为设计描述“紧固件被设计用于保持面板在位”（句式错译）。

question: The command mode could be benefit for the clear instruction.

options.A: To input by the special form could make the instruction clear.
options.B: The imperative form could give  a  instruction clearer.
options.C: The imperative form should be checked for a clear instruction.

explanation: 【译文】The imperative form could give a clearer instruction.【词汇】command mode=命令式/祈使形式，imperative form=祈使句式，benefit=有益于，clear instruction=清晰的指令。【解析】B正确：command mode转写为imperative form（祈使句式），be benefit for转写为could give...clearer，“使指令更清晰”的语义保留。A把command mode误译为“以特殊形式输入”（input by the special form），词义错译。C把“有利于清晰”误译为should be checked（应被检查），动作与语义完全偏离。

question: Sometimes a work step is only applied to some special conditions.

options.A: The work step is fit to all the conditions.
options.B: Sometimes to cope with special conditions only a work step can be used.
options.C: Sometimes it is only possible to do a work step under special conditions.

explanation: 【译文】Sometimes it is only possible to do a work step under special conditions.【词汇】work step=工作步骤，be applied to=适用于，special conditions=特殊条件，only=仅。【解析】C正确：only...under special conditions对应“仅适用于特殊条件”。A误译为fit to all the conditions（适用所有条件），范围相反（方向相反）。B误译为“应对特殊条件只有一个步骤可用”，only的限定对象错移（结构错译）。

question: Assure the avionics ventilation system continues to operate correctly.

options.A: Make sure that the avionics ventilation system continues to operate correctly.
options.B: To make sure avionics ventilation system is in a good condition, the check should be carried on all the time.
options.C: The avionics ventilation system is inoperative for a while then return to normal operation.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the avionics ventilation system continues to operate correctly.【词汇】assure=确保，avionics ventilation system=航空电子通风系统，continue to operate=持续工作。【解析】A正确：assure转写为make sure，continues to operate correctly完整保留。B把“持续正确工作”改写为“状态良好且应一直检查”，增译检查要求（增译要素）。C误译为is inoperative for a while then return to normal（先失效再恢复），方向相反。

question: These transcievers transmit this data to Air Traffic Control.

options.A: These transformer send this data to Air Traffic Control computer.
options.B: These transmitter & reciever unit send this data to Air Traffic Control Center.
options.C: These transcievers change this data into a special format for Air Traffic Control.

explanation: 【译文】These transmitter & receiver units send this data to Air Traffic Control Center.【词汇】transceiver=收发机，transmit=发送，transformer=变压器。【解析】B正确：transceivers展开为transmitter & receiver unit（收发机），send this data to ATC Center对应transmit...to Air Traffic Control。A误译为transformer（变压器），张冠李戴。C把transmit误译为change...into a special format（转换格式），动作错译且漏掉接收对象。

question: If desired, the manufacturer may include more than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual.

options.A: The manufacturer shall not include more than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual unless apprved the Civil Aviation Authority.
options.B: The manufacturer should by no means include more than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual.
options.C: If appropriate, the manufacturer may include two or more airplane models in the Maintenance Manual.

explanation: 【译文】If appropriate, the manufacturer may include two or more airplane models in the Maintenance Manual.【词汇】if desired=如需要，may=可以，more than one=多于一个，by no means=绝不。【解析】C正确：if desired转写为if appropriate，may include对应“可以包括”，more than one同义为two or more。A误译为shall not...unless approved（除非批准否则不得），许可变禁止（方向相反）。B把may误译为by no means（绝不），语气反转。

question: The format of the cruise performance presentation is at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer.

options.A: The format of the cruise performance presentation is left up to the airplane manufacturer.
options.B: The format of the cruise performance presentation should be followed by the airplane manufacturer.
options.C: The airplane manufacturer is recommended to use this format of the cruise performance presentation.

explanation: 【译文】The format of the cruise performance presentation is left up to the airplane manufacturer.【词汇】at the discretion of=由……自行决定，be left up to=交由……决定，presentation=呈现方式。【解析】A正确：at the discretion of转写为is left up to，“由制造商自行决定”语义完整。B误译为should be followed by（制造商应遵循格式），自主权变强制义务（方向相反）。C误译为recommended to use this format，自主决定弱化为“推荐使用某格式”。

question: Acceptable child restraint seats are defined in publications such as FAA Advisory Circular 91-62.

options.A: FAA Publications such as Advisory Circular AC91-62 defines economically feasible child restraint seats.
options.B: FAA Publications such as Advisory Circular AC91-62 provides the definition of acceptable Child restraint seats.
options.C: The definition of required child restraint seats can be found in FAA Publications such as Advisory Circular AC91-62.

explanation: 【译文】FAA publications such as Advisory Circular AC91-62 provide the definition of acceptable child restraint seats.【词汇】acceptable=可接受的，child restraint seats=儿童约束座椅，required=规定的。【解析】B正确：are defined in转写为provides the definition of，“可接受”限定与“定义”动作均保留。A把acceptable误译为economically feasible（经济上可行的），词义错译。C把acceptable误译为required（规定的/必须的），属性相反。

question: Identify the fan blades with codes when removing them from the disk so that they can be correctly put back.

options.A: Put codes on the fan blades when removing them from the disc so that they can be correctly put back.
options.B: put coders on the fan blades when removing them from the disk so that they can be correctly put back.
options.C: Identify the fan blades with coders when removing them from the disk so that they can be correctly put back.

explanation: 【译文】Put codes on the fan blades when removing them from the disc so that they can be correctly put back.【词汇】identify...with codes=用代码标识，fan blades=风扇叶片，coder=编码器。【解析】A正确：identify...with codes转写为put codes on the fan blades，“做代码标记”动作等价，目的从句保留。B把codes误译为coders（编码器），标记物变编码设备（词义错译）。C把with codes误译为with coders，“用代码标识”变“用编码器识别”，方式错译。

question: Drains are provided to carry fluids from any point where lines and accessories may leak and where fluids may accumulate in a cavity.

options.A: The purpose of drains is to transport liquids from areas where there may be leaks in lines or accessories, as well as areas where fluids may gather in a confined space.
options.B: Drainage happens where lines and accessories may leak and where fluids may accumulate in a cavity.
options.C: Fluids are drained from any point where lines and accessories may leak.

explanation: 【译文】The purpose of drains is to carry liquids from points where lines and accessories may leak and where fluids may collect in a cavity.【词汇】drains=排放装置，carry fluids=输送液体，lines and accessories=管路与附件，accumulate=积聚。【解析】A正确：转写为目的句式，管路/附件泄漏点和空腔积液点两类来源完整保留。B两处错误：drains误译为drainage（排水过程）；丢失“用于输送液体”的功能目的。C漏译空腔积液（accumulate in a cavity）这一来源（漏译要素）。

question: Claustrophobia occurs when a person is confined to a small space.

options.A: Claustrophobia occurs when a person is alone in a small space.
options.B: Claustrophobia occurs when a person is confined to the only space.
options.C: Claustrophobia occurs when a person is trapped in a small confined space.

explanation: 【译文】Claustrophobia occurs when a person is trapped in a small confined space.【词汇】claustrophobia=幽闭恐惧症，be confined to=被困于，trapped=被困住的，alone=独自的。【解析】C正确：be confined to a small space转写为is trapped in a small confined space，“被困狭小空间”语义等价。A把confined误译为alone（独自一人），空间受困变成独处（词义错译）。B把a small space误译为the only space（唯一的空间），“狭小”与“被困”两要素均丢失。

question: Bend the metal strip to form a curve with a minimum radius of 8mm.

options.A: Bend the metal wire to form a rounded corner with a minimum radius of 8mm.
options.B: Bend the metal band to form a circular bead with a minimum radius of 8mm.
options.C: Bend the metal piece to form an angle with a minimum radius of 8mm.

explanation: 【译文】Bend the metal wire to form a rounded corner with a minimum radius of 8mm.【词汇】bend=弯曲，metal strip=金属条，curve=曲线/圆弧，minimum radius=最小半径，bead=圆珠/卷边。【解析】A正确：bend对应“弯曲”，rounded corner对应curve（圆弧弯角），minimum radius of 8mm对应“最小半径8毫米”（wire与strip略有出入但均可指条状金属）。B把curve误译为circular bead（圆珠/卷边），形状错译。C把strip误译为piece，把curve误译为angle（角），圆弧变折角（词义错译）。

question: When a power source services a single component, or serves a single functioning system, that power source will be included in the discussion of the component or system which it serves.

options.A: If a power source only serves a single component or system, it will be discussed as part of that component or system.
options.B: A power source that serves a component or a system will be discussed in its own chapter instead of in the component or systems' chapter .
options.C: A power source that serves a component or a system will be discussed in the interface section of that system or the system the component is located in. The power source will not be discussed separately.

explanation: 【译文】A power source serving only one component or system is discussed within that component or system.【词汇】power source=电源，serve=为……服务，interface section=接口部分。【解析】A正确：only serves对应serves a single...，discussed as part of对应be included in the discussion of，归属关系不变。B误译为in its own chapter（单列一章），归属相反。C误译为interface section（接口部分），并增译not discussed separately。

question: Chapter 12 describes those instructions for the replenishment of fluids, scheduled and unscheduled servicing applicable to the whole airplane. The information shall be concise and may be presented in tabular or chart form.

options.A: Chapter 12 describes those instructions for the replacement of fluids, scheduled and unscheduled servicing applicable to the whole airplane. The information shall be concise and may be presented in table or chart form.
options.B: These instructions described in Chapter 12 are for adding fluids and performing both scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on the entire airplane. The information provided shall be brief and can be shown in the form of tables or charts.
options.C: Chapter 12 describes instructions are for inspecting fluids and performing both scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on the entire airplane. The information provided should be brief and can be presented in the form of tables or charts.

explanation: 【译文】Chapter 12 gives brief instructions (in tables or charts) for fluid replenishment and for scheduled and unscheduled servicing.【词汇】replenishment=补充/加注，servicing=勤务，concise=简明。【解析】B正确：replenishment=adding fluids（加注），concise=brief，servicing=maintenance，要点全对。A把replenishment误译为replacement（更换），词义错译。C误译为inspecting fluids（检查液体），且语法不通。

question: Instructions regarding access to any out-of-the-way or unusual places requiring services shall be given.

options.A: Directions for obtaining entry to any remote or uncommon locations that need servicing shall be provided.
options.B: Guidance regarding access to confined or unusual places requiring services shall  be given.
options.C: Instructions for accessing to restricted or uncommon locations that need servicing shall be provided.

explanation: 【译文】Directions for obtaining entry to any remote or uncommon locations that need servicing shall be provided.【词汇】access to=进入，out-of-the-way=偏僻的，restricted=管制的。【解析】A正确：access转写为obtaining entry，out-of-the-way转写为remote（偏僻的），unusual转写为uncommon。B把out-of-the-way误译为confined（受限的），词义错译。C误译为restricted（管制进入的），属性错译。

question: Area must be kept clear to allow tanker to be withdrawn in case of danger.

options.A: Area must be kept clean to allow tanker to back off in case of danger.
options.B: To ensure safety, the area surrounding the tanker needs to be free of obstructions so that it can be removed quickly if necessary.
options.C: Area must be kept clean to allow refuelling truck to back off in case of danger.

explanation: 【译文】To ensure safety, the area around the tanker must stay clear so it can be removed quickly if necessary.【词汇】be kept clear=保持无障碍，be withdrawn=撤离，in case of danger=遇险时。【解析】B正确：kept clear=free of obstructions（无障碍），be withdrawn=can be removed quickly。A两处错误：clear误译为clean（干净）；withdrawn弱化为back off（倒车）。C同样把clear误译为clean（词义错译）。

question: Overhaul data considered applicable by the manufacturer, may be included in this chapter.

options.A: It depends on the manufacturer whether or not the overhaul information is included in this chapter.
options.B: If the overhaul data can be applied for to the manufacturer, the can be included in this chapter.
options.C: The manufacturer may include the overhaul data in this chapter if they deem it relevant.

explanation: 【译文】The manufacturer may include the overhaul data in this chapter if they deem it relevant.【词汇】overhaul data=大修资料，considered applicable=被认为适用的，may be included=可被纳入。【解析】C正确：considered applicable by the manufacturer转写为if they deem it relevant，判断主体与许可语气保留。A误译为“是否纳入取决于制造商”，适用性条件变任意选择权（条件错译）。B语法残缺：“the can be included”缺主语（语法错误）。

question: Communication system includes voice and C-W communicating components, PA system, and intercom system.

options.A: The communication system consists of components for voice and Crew-Warning communication, a Passenger Address system, and an interphone system.
options.B: The communication system consists of components for voice and Continuous-Wave communication, a Passenger Address system, and an interphone system.
options.C: The communication system consists of components for voice and Continuous-Wave communication, a Passenger Address system, and an internet communication system.

explanation: 【译文】The communication system consists of voice and Continuous-Wave components, a Passenger Address system, and an interphone system.【词汇】C-W=等幅波通信，PA=旅客广播，intercom/interphone=内话系统。【解析】B正确：C-W展开为Continuous-Wave，PA为Passenger Address，intercom为interphone，三子系统全对。A误展开为Crew-Warning（机组警告），术语错译。C把intercom误译为internet communication system（互联网通信），张冠李戴。

question: The accessory compartments are located on the inner or on the outer areas of the pressurized fuselage.

options.A: The whole fuselage is pressurized. The accessory compartments are located on the inner or on the outer areas of the pressurized fuselage.
options.B: Not the whole fuselage is pressurized. The accessory compartments are located on the interior or on the exterior areas of the pressurized fuselage.
options.C: The whole fuselage is pressurized. The accessory compartments are located on the interior or on the exterior areas of the pressurized fuselage.

explanation: 【译文】Not all of the fuselage is pressurized. The accessory compartments are on the interior or exterior of the pressurized fuselage.【词汇】pressurized fuselage=增压机身，inner/outer=内/外侧，interior/exterior=内部/外部。【解析】B正确：inner/outer转写为interior/exterior；“增压机身”的称谓表明并非整体增压，前提一致。C误为the whole fuselage is pressurized（全机身增压），与限定矛盾（方向相反）。A保留inner/outer未改写，且同样断言全机身增压。

question: Furnished as manufacturer-designated standard equipment, the detection portion of Fire Protection system is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire.

options.A: The detection section in the Fire Protection system is recognized as standard equipment by the manufacturer. It detects and indicates the occurrence of overheating, smoke, and fire.
options.B: Providing manufacturer-designated standard equipment, the detection portion of Fire Protection system is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire.
options.C: Provided manufacturer-designated standard equipment, the detection portion of Fire Protection system is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire.

explanation: 【译文】The detection section, furnished as manufacturer-designated standard equipment, senses and indicates overheat, smoke, or fire.【词汇】furnished as=配备，designated=指定的，sense=探测。【解析】A正确：“作为指定标准设备配备”转写为is recognized as standard equipment，sense and indicate转写为detects and indicates，要素齐全。B/C用分词Providing/Provided开头，“提供/被提供”不等于“被指定配备”，且主干与题干雷同（语法错误）。

question: Instructions are included in "Towing and Taxiing "necessary to taxi the aircraft  in normal or abnormal conditions such as adverse weather conditions, etc., for maintenance reasons.

options.A: "Towing and Taxiing "include instructions necessary to taxi the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as in gust wind, etc., for maintenance reasons.
options.B: "Towing and Taxiing "include instructions necessary to taxi the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as in occupied runway condition, etc., for maintenance reasons.
options.C: "Towing and Taxiing "include instructions necessary to taxi the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as in poor visibility condition, etc., for maintenance reasons.

explanation: 【译文】"Towing and Taxiing" include instructions for taxiing the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as poor visibility, for maintenance reasons.【词汇】adverse weather=恶劣天气，poor visibility=低能见度，occupied runway=被占用跑道。【解析】C为最佳：poor visibility是adverse weather的贴切示例。B用occupied runway condition举例，不属天气条件（范围错误）。A的gust wind同属恶劣天气示例，与C实质等价，本题存在等价选项问题。

question: Exterior Color Schemes and Markings: This subsystem/section breakdown reserved for airline use.

options.A: This particular part of the subsystem is exclusively reserved for the airlines to break down the exterior color schemes and markings.
options.B: This section is saved for use by airlines and is designated for the breakdown of exterior color schemes and markings.
options.C: This section is intended for use by airlines and is designated for the breakdown of exterior color schemes and markings.

explanation: 【译文】This section is intended for use by airlines and is designated for the breakdown of exterior color schemes and markings.【词汇】breakdown=细分结构，reserved for airline use=保留给航空公司使用。【解析】C正确：reserved for airline use转写为intended for use by airlines，breakdown作名词表“细分结构”。A两处错误：exclusively增译“专有”；to break down把名词误作动词“分解”。B把reserved误译为saved（被保存），词义错译。

question: Connect plug A to socket B.

options.A: Connect the two electrical connectors together.
options.B: Connect the two scockets together.
options.C: Connect the two plugs together.

explanation: 【译文】Connect the two electrical connectors together.【词汇】plug=插头，socket=插座，electrical connector=电连接器，connect...together=连接在一起。【解析】A正确：plug A和socket B本质都是electrical connectors，“把插头A接到插座B”即“把两个电连接器连接在一起”，术语概括准确。B把plug和socket误译为two scockets（两个插座，且拼写有误），插头与插座混淆（张冠李戴）。C把两者误译为two plugs（两个插头），同样混淆插头与插座（部件错译）。

question: This section shall cross-reference the detailed procedures included in the individual Maintenance Practices.

options.A: This part is required to refer to the specific procedures outlined in the Maintenance Practices for more detailed information.
options.B: This section is covered  in the detailed procedures in the individual Maintenance Practices.
options.C: The detailed procedures in this section are included in the individual Maintenance Practices.

explanation: 【译文】This part is required to refer to the specific procedures outlined in the Maintenance Practices for more detailed information.【词汇】cross-reference=参见，Maintenance Practices=维修实践。【解析】A正确：shall cross-reference转写为is required to refer to...for more detailed information，引用方向与义务语气保留。B误译为is covered in（本节被涵盖在MP中），方向相反。C同样颠倒：本节程序被included in MP。

question: Subjects shall be identified by the third element in the page numbering system.

options.A: Subjects shall be identified by the third number in the page numbering system.
options.B: Subjects shall be identified by the third group of numbers in the page numbering system.
options.C: The third number in the page numbering system represents a specified subject.

explanation: 【译文】Subjects shall be identified by the third number in the page numbering system.【词汇】be identified by=由……标识，third element=第三元素，group of numbers=数字组。【解析】A正确：third element转写为third number（编号系统的一个元素即一个数字位）。B误译为the third group of numbers（第三组数字），范围扩大（范围错误）。C改写为“第三数字代表某一指定主题”，identified by变represents且窄化含义，逊于A。

question: The accumulator of A320 can supply hydraulic power to the brakes for 7 full travels.

options.A: The accumulator of A320 can make the aircraft complete full-travel braking 7 times.
options.B: The accumulator of A320 can supply hydraulic power to the brakes for 7 complete travels.
options.C: The accumulator of A320 supplies enough hyraulic power to perform braking action 7 times.

explanation: 【译文】The accumulator of A320 can supply hydraulic power to the brakes for 7 complete travels.【词汇】accumulator=蓄压器，full travels=全行程，hydraulic power=液压动力。【解析】B正确：full travels转写为complete travels，supply hydraulic power to the brakes保留，要素最全。A改写为“使飞机完成7次全行程刹车”，供压关系偏离。C两处错误：enough增译“足够”；full travels简化为braking action 7 times，丢“全行程”。

question: Operations must be conducted with caution and only in smooth air.

options.A: Operations must be conducted with caution and only in static air.
options.B: Operations must be done cautiously and only in air without turbulence.
options.C: Operations must be performed with caution and only in static air.

explanation: 【译文】Operations must be done cautiously and only in air without turbulence.【词汇】with caution/cautiously=谨慎地，smooth air=平稳气流，turbulence=湍流/颠簸，static air=静止空气。【解析】B正确：smooth air转写为air without turbulence（无湍流的气流），with caution转写为cautiously，conducted转写为done，限定完整。A把smooth误译为static（静止的），平稳气流不等于静止空气（词义错译）。C同样误用static air，把“无颠簸”错译为“无气流”。

question: Remove the air from the compound with a spatula.

options.A: Expel the air from the adhesive with a spatula.
options.B: Expel the air from the compound with a spatula.
options.C: Expel the air from the compound with a screwdriver.

explanation: 【译文】Expel the air from the compound with a spatula.【词汇】remove the air=排出空气（气泡），expel=排出，compound=混合料/化合物，spatula=刮刀/抹刀，adhesive=胶黏剂，screwdriver=螺丝刀。【解析】B正确：remove the air同义转写为expel the air，compound与with a spatula全部保留。A把compound误译为adhesive（胶黏剂），材料张冠李戴。C把spatula误译为screwdriver（螺丝刀），工具错译——用螺丝刀排气泡不符合工艺。

question: Make sure that the shelf life is not expired.

options.A: Make sure that the shelf life is within reach.
options.B: Make sure that the shelf life is not more than the permitted life.
options.C: Make sure that the quality life is not expired.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the shelf life is not more than the permitted life.【词汇】shelf life=储存期/保质期，expire=过期，not more than=不超过，permitted life=允许期限，within reach=在可及范围内。【解析】B正确：is not expired转写为is not more than the permitted life（未超过允许期限），语义等价。A把not expired误译为within reach（够得着），期限属性变空间距离（词义错译）。C把shelf life误译为quality life（质量寿命），术语错译。

question: Tell the ground crew that you will operate the system.

options.A: Warning the baggage crew that you will operate the system.
options.B: Explain to the ground crew that you will operate the system.
options.C: Explain to the maintenance crew  that you will operate system.

explanation: 【译文】Explain to the ground crew that you will operate the system.【词汇】tell=告知，ground crew=地勤人员，explain=说明，baggage crew=行李组，maintenance crew=维修人员。【解析】B正确：tell转写为explain to，ground crew保留，“告知地勤人员将操作该系统”的预警含义不变。A两处错误：把tell误译为warning（警告，语气升级），把ground crew误译为baggage crew（行李组，张冠李戴）。C把ground crew误译为maintenance crew（维修人员），告知对象错译。

question: The safety precautions that follow are applicable to explosive items.

options.A: The safety precautions that follow are applicable to toxic items.
options.B: The intoxicated items should obey the following safety precautions.
options.C: The explosive items are subject to the following safety precautions.

explanation: 【译文】The explosive items are subject to the following safety precautions.【词汇】be applicable to=适用于，explosive items=爆炸品，be subject to=适用于，toxic=有毒的。【解析】C正确：applicable to explosive items转写为explosive items are subject to，适用对象与“以下”的指向均保留。A把explosive误译为toxic（有毒的），危险品类别张冠李戴。B两处错误：explosive误译为intoxicated（醉酒的）；should obey使主客体颠倒。

question: Remove the cover assembly to get access to the lamp assembly.

options.A: Remove the cover assembly to acces the lamp assembly.
options.B: Break the cover assembly to get access to the lamp assembly.
options.C: Remove the cover assembly to attach to the lamp assembly.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the cover assembly to access the lamp assembly.【词汇】cover assembly=盖子组件，get access to=接近/够到，lamp assembly=灯组件，break=打破，attach to=连接到。【解析】A正确：get access to同义转写为access（作动词“接近”），拆盖目的是够到灯组件，逻辑一致（acces拼写瑕疵不影响判断）。B把remove误译为break（打破/破坏），正常拆卸变成破坏（词义错译）。C把get access to误译为attach to（连接到），拆盖目的变成把盖子连到灯组件，目的关系错译。

question: Examine the external surface of the container.

options.A: Visual check the external surface of the container.
options.B: Examine the exterior surface of the container.
options.C: Troubleshooting the external surface of the container.

explanation: 【译文】Examine the exterior surface of the container.【词汇】examine=检查，external surface=外表面，exterior surface=外表面（同义），container=容器，visual check=目视检查，troubleshooting=排故。【解析】B正确：external同义转写为exterior，examine与container原样保留，“检查容器外表面”完全对应。A两处错误：visual check把examine限定为“目视检查”，检查方式范围缩小；且作谓语语法不当。C把examine误译为troubleshooting（排故），常规检查变成故障排查（词义错译），动名词也不能构成祈使句。

question: This material gives more protection.

options.A: This material complements individual protection.
options.B: This material offers an additional layer of protection.
options.C: This material necessitates special protection.

explanation: 【译文】This material offers an additional layer of protection.【词汇】material=材料，more protection=更多保护，additional layer=附加层，necessitate=需要，complement=补充。【解析】B正确：gives more protection转写为offers an additional layer of protection（提供额外一层保护），“更多”以“附加层”等价表达。A把more误译为individual（个别的），“更多”变“个体”（词义错译）。C把gives误译为necessitates（需要），“提供更多保护”变“需要特殊保护”，因果相反（方向相反）。

question: When the weather is very bad, keep these parts in a dry area.

options.A: When the weather is extremely bad, keep these parts in a dry area.
options.B: When the weather is inapplicable, shelter these parts in a dry area.
options.C: When the weather is extremely cold, keep these parts in great driness.

explanation: 【译文】When the weather is extremely bad, keep these parts in a dry area.【词汇】very bad=很恶劣，extremely bad=极其恶劣，dry area=干燥区域，inapplicable=不适用的。【解析】A正确：very bad同义强化为extremely bad（方向一致），keep these parts in a dry area原样保留。B把very bad误译为inapplicable（不适用的），天气状况变成适用性判断（词义错译）。C两处错误：把bad误译为cold（寒冷），恶劣天气窄化为寒冷（范围错误）；in great driness（dryness误拼）表达不当。

question: When you install the pitot head, make sure that the opening points forward.

options.A: When you install the pitot ending, make sure the nose is directed forward.
options.B: When you assemble the pitot head, make sure that the coupling faces forward.
options.C: When you install the pitot head, make sure that the opening faces forward.

explanation: 【译文】When you install the pitot head, make sure that the opening faces forward.【词汇】pitot head=皮托头，opening=开口，points forward=朝前，faces forward=朝向前面，coupling=接头。【解析】C正确：points forward转写为faces forward，pitot head与opening原样保留，“安装时开口朝前”不变。A两处错误：把pitot head误译为pitot ending（皮托端部），把opening误译为nose（头部）。B两处错误：install弱化为assemble；opening误译为coupling（接头），孔口变接头。

question: Identify the component with a code to help you install it again correctly.

options.A: Identify the component with a code to return it to warehouse correctly.
options.B: Identify the component with a code to simplify the reinstallation correctly.
options.C: Identify the component with a code to facilitate  its correct reinstallation.

explanation: 【译文】Identify the component with a code to facilitate its correct reinstallation.【词汇】identify...with a code=用代码标识，facilitate=便于，reinstallation=重新安装。【解析】C正确：install it again correctly转写为facilitate its correct reinstallation，“便于正确重装”语义等价。A误译为return it to warehouse（退回仓库），重装变入库。B误译为simplify the reinstallation（简化重装），correctly被挪用（词义错译）。

question: There can be many causes for corrosion.

options.A: There can be many human factors for corrosion.
options.B: Corrosion can be caused by many factors.
options.C: Human causes account for many types of corrosion.

explanation: 【译文】Corrosion can be caused by many factors.【词汇】cause=原因/导致，corrosion=腐蚀，factor=因素，be caused by=由……引起，human factors=人为因素。【解析】B正确：many causes for corrosion转写为corrosion can be caused by many factors，主动变被动但含义等价。A把causes误译为human factors（人为因素），成因被限定为人为原因（范围错误）。C两处错误：同样加入human限定；把“多种原因”误译为many types of corrosion（多种腐蚀），因果概念混淆。

question: If you do not obey these instructions, there is a risk of injury.

options.A: If you fail to obey these instructions, there is a risk of injury.
options.B: If you are opposed against these instructions, there is a risk of injury.
options.C: If you fail to obey these declarations, you may get injured.

explanation: 【译文】If you fail to obey these instructions, there is a risk of injury.【词汇】fail to obey=未能遵守，instruction=指示，risk of injury=受伤风险，declaration=声明。【解析】A正确：do not obey转写为fail to obey，there is a risk of injury原样保留，警告句式完整。B误译为are opposed against（反对），不遵守变持反对立场（词义错译）。C两处错误：instructions误译为declarations（声明）；risk of injury弱化为may get injured。

question: If the test results are unsatisfactory, do the fault isolation procedure.

options.A: If the test results are found to be extreme, do the fault isolation procedure.
options.B: If the test fails, do the fault isolation procedure.
options.C: If the test results are failed, do the trouble shooting procedure.

explanation: 【译文】If the test fails, do the fault isolation procedure.【词汇】test results=测试结果，unsatisfactory=不合格的，fault isolation procedure=故障隔离程序，extreme=极端的。【解析】B正确：unsatisfactory概括为the test fails，fault isolation procedure保留。A误译为extreme（极端的），“不合格”变“极端值”。C两处错误：results are failed语法错误；trouble shooting术语不统一。

question: If the light is too dim, replace the battery.

options.A: If the light is too faint, replace the battery.
options.B: If the light bulb is too small, replace the battery.
options.C: If the light is too dazzling, replace the battery.

explanation: 【译文】If the light is too faint, replace the battery.【词汇】dim=昏暗的，faint=微弱的，light=灯光，replace the battery=更换电池，dazzling=刺眼的，bulb=灯泡。【解析】A正确：too dim同义转写为too faint（过于昏暗/微弱），replace the battery原样保留。B两处错误：把light误译为light bulb（灯泡），把dim误译为too small（太小），亮度不足变成尺寸问题（词义错译）。C把dim误译为dazzling（刺眼的），光线太暗变成太亮，方向相反。

question: When the pressure decreases, the indicator shows that there is a leak.

options.A: When the system pressure gets close to a certain value, the indicator shows  a leak.
options.B: When the pressure falls, the indicator shows a leak.
options.C: When the pressure shows unusualness, the indicator shows that there is a leak.

explanation: 【译文】When the pressure falls, the indicator shows a leak.【词汇】decrease=降低，fall=下降，indicator=指示器，leak=泄漏，unusualness=异常。【解析】B正确：decreases转写为falls，shows that there is a leak简化为shows a leak，“压力下降时指示器显示泄漏”不变。A把decreases误译为gets close to a certain value（接近某数值），下降过程变趋近阈值（词义错译）。C把decreases误译为shows unusualness（显示异常），具体变化变成笼统异常。

question: Make sure that there are no incorrect indications on the instruments.

options.A: Make sure that there are no unusual indications on the instruments.
options.B: Make sure that there are no funny indications on the instruments.
options.C: Make sure that there are no inhuman indications on the indicators.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that there are no unusual indications on the instruments.【词汇】incorrect indications=错误指示，unusual=异常的，instrument=仪表，funny=滑稽的（口语），inhuman=非人的。【解析】A正确：incorrect转写为unusual（异常的），仪表异常读数即“错误指示”，instruments保留。B把incorrect误译为funny（滑稽/古怪的），口语词用于安全指令语域失当（词义错译）。C两处错误：incorrect误译为inhuman（非人的），语义不通；instruments误译为indicators，范围缩小。

question: All personnel must fully know the safety precautions.

options.A: Not everyone needs to understand the safety precautions.
options.B: Everyone has to follow the safety precautions whether knowing it or not.
options.C: All personnel must be fully familiar with the safety precautions.

explanation: 【译文】All personnel must be fully familiar with the safety precautions.【词汇】personnel=人员，be fully familiar with=完全熟悉，safety precautions=安全注意事项。【解析】C正确：fully know转写为be fully familiar with，all personnel must的义务语气保留。A误译为not everyone needs（并非人人需要），全称义务变部分否定（方向相反）。B把“完全了解”改写为“无论是否了解都要遵守”，认知要求被删除且whether knowing it or not自相矛盾（漏译）。

question: To prevent accidental operation of the system, install the safety lock.

options.A: Installing the safety lock increases the risk of accidental system operation.
options.B: To avoid unintentional system activation, install the safety lock.
options.C: Install the safety lock to activate inflight operation of the system.

explanation: 【译文】To avoid unintentional system activation, install the safety lock.【词汇】prevent=防止，accidental operation=意外操作，unintentional activation=非故意激活，safety lock=安全锁。【解析】B正确：prevent转写为avoid，accidental operation转写为unintentional system activation，目的结构保留。A误译为increases the risk（增加风险），方向相反。C误译为activate inflight operation（激活飞行中操作），方向相反且inflight为增译。

question: If fuel collects frequently, examine for leaks.

options.A: In case fuel consistently gathers, conduct an examination to identify any leaks.
options.B: When fuel accumulates on an occasional basis, inspect the area for any signs of leakage.
options.C: If there is a recurring buildup of fuel, remove the tank to detect possible leaks.

explanation: 【译文】In case fuel consistently gathers, conduct an examination to identify any leaks.【词汇】collects frequently=频繁积聚，examine for leaks=检查有无泄漏，consistently gathers=持续聚集。【解析】A正确：frequently=consistently、collects=gathers、examine=conduct an examination，全对应。B把frequently误译为on an occasional basis（偶尔地），频率相反（方向相反）。C把examine误译为remove the tank（拆下油箱），检查变拆解。

question: The autothrust system is on but not in operation.

options.A: The autothrust system is enabled but currently inactive.
options.B: The autothrust system is enabled and actively functioning.
options.C: The autothrust system is deactivated but still in operation.

explanation: 【译文】The autothrust system is enabled but currently inactive.【词汇】autothrust system=自动推力系统，is on=接通，not in operation=未在工作，inactive=未工作的。【解析】A正确：is on转写为enabled（已启用），not in operation转写为currently inactive（当前未工作），“已接通但未工作”状态准确。B把not in operation误译为actively functioning（正在工作），方向相反。C两处错误：is on误为deactivated，not in operation误为still in operation，均反转。

question: Clean the surface to make sure that the bond is satisfactory.

options.A: Make certain that the surface is inadequately cleaned to achieve a nice bond.
options.B: Clean the surface meticulously to guarantee a timely bond.
options.C: Ensure that the surface is properly cleaned to achieve a satisfactory bond.

explanation: 【译文】Ensure that the surface is properly cleaned to achieve a satisfactory bond.【词汇】bond=粘接，satisfactory=符合要求的，meticulously=极细致地，timely=及时的。【解析】C正确：make sure that the bond is satisfactory转写为to achieve a satisfactory bond，“清洁表面以保证粘接合格”语义等价。A把clean误译为inadequately cleaned（清洁不充分），方向相反。B两处错误：meticulously加入过度限定（增译）；timely bond把“符合要求”误译为“及时的粘接”（词义错译）。

question: The forward movement of the control lever must be slow and continuous.

options.A: The control lever's forward motion must be at a slow and continuous pace.
options.B: The control lever should be gradually pushed forward in a continuous manner.
options.C: Gradual and interrupted forward movement is required for the control lever.

explanation: 【译文】The control lever's forward motion must be at a slow and continuous pace.【词汇】forward movement=向前移动，control lever=控制杆，interrupted=断续的，pace=节奏。【解析】A正确：must be slow and continuous转写为must be at a slow and continuous pace，两特征与must均保留。B两处错误：must弱化为should；“缓慢而连续”改写为gradually pushed（逐渐推），特征偏离。C把continuous误译为interrupted（断续的），方向相反。

question: Magnetic tools have an unwanted effect on the compass system.

options.A: Magnetic tools have an adverse influence on the compass system.
options.B: Magnetic tools have an unknown effect on the compass system.
options.C: The compass system experiences desirable results when exposed to magnetic tools.

explanation: 【译文】Magnetic tools have an adverse influence on the compass system.【词汇】unwanted effect=不良影响，adverse influence=不利影响，desirable=有利的，unknown=未知的。【解析】A正确：unwanted effect转写为adverse influence（不利影响），magnetic tools与compass system保留。B把unwanted误译为unknown（未知的），负面属性变未知属性（词义错译）。C两处错误：把“不良影响”误译为desirable results（理想结果），方向相反；experiences...when exposed to使作用关系含糊。

question: If you get the solution in your eyes, get medical aid immediately.

options.A: In the event that the solution blurs your eyes, promptly seek medical aid.
options.B: Should the solution come into contact with your eyes, it is suggested to seek medical assistance.
options.C: If the solution comes into contact with your eyes, seek immediate medical assistance.

explanation: 【译文】If the solution comes into contact with your eyes, seek immediate medical assistance.【词汇】solution=溶液，medical aid=医疗救助，immediately=立即。【解析】C正确：get...in your eyes转写为comes into contact with your eyes，immediately与seek immediate medical assistance对应，紧急度不变。A误译为blurs your eyes（使视线模糊），入眼变视物模糊（词义错译）。B把immediately弱化为it is suggested to（建议），紧迫性丢失。

question: It is possible that the installation changed the routing of the cable loom.

options.A: The cable loom routing might have been altered due to the installation.
options.B: The installation caused an insignificant disruption in the cable loom routing.
options.C: The cable loom routing remains unchanged after the installation.

explanation: 【译文】The cable loom routing might have been altered due to the installation.【词汇】it is possible that=有可能，routing=走向，cable loom=电缆束，insignificant=微不足道的。【解析】A正确：it is possible that...changed转写为might have been altered（可能已被改变），可能性语气保留。B两处错误：把可能性断言为既成事实；加入insignificant（微不足道的）的评价（增译）。C把“可能改变”误译为remains unchanged（保持不变），方向相反。

question: Make sure that the quantity of fuel in the tank is not more than 500 liters.

options.A: Ensure that the fuel quantity in the tank does not exceed 500 liters.
options.B: Make sure that the amount of fuel in the tank is exactly 500 liters.
options.C: Make certain that the fuel level in the tank does surpass 500 liters.

explanation: 【译文】Ensure that the fuel quantity in the tank does not exceed 500 liters.【词汇】not more than=不超过，exceed=超过，exactly=恰好，surpass=超过。【解析】A正确：is not more than转写为does not exceed（不超过），quantity of fuel in the tank对应“油箱内燃油量”，上限约束保留。B误译为exactly 500 liters（恰好500升），上限变定值（数量关系错译）。C两处错误：does surpass语法错误且语义为“确实超过”，否定变肯定（方向相反）；fuel level偏离quantity。

question: Get access to the control unit through the opening in the side of the tank.

options.A: Gain access to the control unit through the top side of the tank.
options.B: Obtain exit to the control unit across the opening on the tank's side wall.
options.C: Access the control unit through the opening provided on the side of the tank.

explanation: 【译文】Access the control unit through the opening provided on the side of the tank.【词汇】get access to=接近/进入，opening=开口，in the side of the tank=油箱侧面的，exit=出口。【解析】C正确：get access to简化为access，through the opening in the side of the tank保留“通过油箱侧面的开口”。A把in the side误译为through the top side（通过顶侧），方位错译。B两处错误：access误译为exit（出口），方向相反；across...side wall搭配混乱。

question: If you find a crack, do the applicable repair procedure.

options.A: If a crack is detected, neglect the applicable repair procedure.
options.B: If a crack is detected, proceed with the relevant repair procedure.
options.C: If you find a crack, disregard the need for a repair procedure.

explanation: 【译文】If a crack is detected, proceed with the relevant repair procedure.【词汇】crack=裂纹，proceed with=执行，neglect=忽视，disregard=无视。【解析】B正确：find a crack=a crack is detected，do...procedure=proceed with the relevant repair procedure，指令完整。A误译为neglect the applicable repair procedure（忽视修理程序），方向相反。C误译为disregard the need for a repair procedure（无视修理必要性），方向相反。

question: If you cannot remove a bolt because of corrosion, apply penetrating oil.

options.A: In cases where corrosion prevents bolt installation, applying penetrating oil.
options.B: If you cannot remove a bolt because of corrosion, avoid using penetrating oil.
options.C: If a bolt is stuck due to rust, apply penetrating oil for easier removal.

explanation: 【译文】If a bolt is stuck due to rust, apply penetrating oil for easier removal.【词汇】cannot remove=无法拆卸，penetrating oil=渗透剂，stuck=卡住的，avoid=避免。【解析】C正确：cannot remove...because of corrosion转写为is stuck due to rust（因锈蚀卡死），apply penetrating oil保留。A两处错误：cannot remove误译为prevents bolt installation（妨碍安装），方向相反；无主句语法残缺。B把apply误译为avoid using（避免使用），措施反转。

question: Make sure that the diameter of the hole is less than the specified value.

options.A: Ensure that the hole's diameter does not exceed the specified value.
options.B: Make certain that the diameter of the hole is within the limits of action.
options.C: Confirm that the specified value is smaller than the diameter of the hole.

explanation: 【译文】Ensure that the diameter of the hole is below the specified value.【词汇】make sure=确保，diameter=直径，specified value=规定值，less than=小于（可用does not exceed表达）。【解析】A正确：does not exceed the specified value与less than the specified value同义，Ensure对应make sure。B把specified value错写成within the limits of action（行动限制），术语错译。C把大小关系颠倒成“规定值小于孔径”，方向相反。

question: The navigation lights change from dim to bright.

options.A: Ensure the variation in brightness of the navigation lights from dim to bright.
options.B: The navigation lights remain consistently dim without any change in brightness.
options.C: The intensity of the navigation lights changes, shifting from dim to bright.

explanation: 【译文】The navigation lights change from dim to bright.【词汇】navigation lights=航行灯，dim=暗的，bright=明亮的，intensity=亮度、强度。【解析】C正确：intensity changes, shifting from dim to bright完整保留“由暗转亮”的变化方向。A加了祈使式Ensure the variation，把陈述句改成“确保……变化”，语气和句型错误。B说航行灯remain consistently dim without any change（一直暗亮无变化），与题干意思完全相反。

question: The wheel cannot move when the lock is engaged.

options.A: Engaging the lock prohibits backward movement of the wheel.
options.B: The wheel can still move even when the lock is engaged.
options.C: When the lock is engaged, the wheel remains immobile.

explanation: 【译文】The wheel cannot move when the lock is engaged.（锁啮合时轮子不能移动。）【词汇】lock=锁、锁止机构，engaged=啮合的、接合的，cannot move=不能移动，immobile=不动的。【解析】C正确：remains immobile对应cannot move，when the lock is engaged保留触发条件。A把cannot move收窄为prohibits backward movement（仅禁止后移），范围错误。B说轮子在锁啮合时can still move，与cannot move方向相反。

question: The value is shown digitally on the display.

options.A: The value is calculated in a numeric format.
options.B: The display digitally indicates the value.
options.C: The text is shown digitally on the display.

explanation: 【译文】The value is shown digitally on the display.（该数值以数字形式显示在显示器上。）【词汇】value=数值，digitally=以数字方式，display=显示器，indicate=指示、显示。【解析】B正确：the display digitally indicates the value即“显示器以数字方式显示该数值”，主被动转换合理。A把shown错成is calculated（被计算），动作错译。C把value错成text（文本），显示对象张冠李戴。

question: Drops of fuel from the tanks are not permitted.

options.A: Prohibition is in place for drops of fuel into the tanks.
options.B: Fuel leakage from the tanks is prohibited.
options.C: Drops of fuel from the tanks are not strongly encouraged.

explanation: 【译文】Drops of fuel from the tanks are not permitted, i.e. fuel leakage from the tanks is prohibited.（不允许油箱滴漏燃油。）【词汇】drops of fuel=燃油滴漏，tank=油箱，not permitted=不允许，leakage=渗漏、泄漏。【解析】B正确：油箱滴油即燃油泄漏，prohibited对应not permitted，语义最完整。A把from the tanks错成into the tanks（滴入油箱），方向相反。C用not strongly encouraged（不强烈鼓励）替代禁止，语气大幅弱化，许可含义错误。

question: Particles that fall into the intake can cause damage.

options.A: Damage can occur when particles fall out of the intake.
options.B: Debris that descends into the intake can seldom cause damage.
options.C: The intake can sustain damage from particles that fall into it.

explanation: 【译文】Particles that fall into the intake can cause damage.（落入进气口的颗粒会造成损伤。）【词汇】particle=颗粒、微粒，intake=进气口，fall into=落入，sustain damage=受到损伤。【解析】C正确：sustain damage from particles that fall into it保留“落入”方向和损害因果。A把fall into错成fall out of the intake（从进气口掉出），方向相反。B加seldom（很少造成损伤），削弱了can cause damage的可能性，程度错译。

question: The shaft moved because the actuator operated.

options.A: The shaft remained still because the actuator is not operated.
options.B: Due to the actuator's operation, the shaft underwent malfunction.
options.C: The actuator's operation caused the shaft to move.

explanation: 【译文】The shaft moved because the actuator operated, i.e. the actuator's operation caused the shaft to move.（作动筒工作导致轴移动。）【词汇】shaft=轴，actuator=作动筒、作动器，operate=工作、作动，cause...to move=导致……移动。【解析】C正确：把because从句改写成caused结构，因果关系和动作完整保留。A两处反译：moved→remained still（保持不动），operated→is not operated（未工作）。B把shaft moved错成shaft underwent malfunction（轴发生故障），词义错译。

question: Do not tighten the bolts with too much force.

options.A: Exercise caution to use force while tightening the bolts.
options.B: Avoid applying excessive force when tightening the bolts.
options.C: Do not loosen the bolts with too much force.

explanation: 【译文】Do not tighten the bolts with too much force, i.e. avoid applying excessive force when tightening.（拧紧螺栓时不要用力过大。）【词汇】tighten=拧紧，bolt=螺栓，too much force=过大的力，excessive=过量的。【解析】B正确：avoid applying excessive force对应“不要用力过大”，tightening保留动作。A只说exercise caution to use force（谨慎用力），丢失Do not的禁止含义。C把tighten错成loosen（拧松），动作方向相反。

question: At intervals of six months, do the check of the oil level.

options.A: At intervals of six months, adjust the oil level of the tank.
options.B: At intervals of six months, perform the check of the coolant level.
options.C: Perform the oil level check every six months.

explanation: 【译文】Do the check of the oil level at intervals of six months.（每六个月检查一次滑油油面。）【词汇】at intervals of six months=每隔六个月，oil level=滑油油面、油位，do the check=进行检查。【解析】C正确：every six months对应at intervals of six months，oil level check对应检查项目。A把check错成adjust（调整）并擅自加入tank，动宾均错。B把oil level错成coolant level（冷却液液面），液体对象错误。

question: This bay contains some of the electronic equipment.

options.A: This bay is used for storage of defunct electronic equipment.
options.B: The electronic equipment is assembled within this bay.
options.C: Some of the electronic equipment is housed in this bay.

explanation: 【译文】This bay contains some of the electronic equipment.（该舱装有一部分电子设备。）【词汇】bay=舱、舱位，contain=容纳、装有，electronic equipment=电子设备，house(v.)=安放、容纳。【解析】C正确：is housed in this bay对应bay contains，some of保留“部分”限定。A加defunct（报废的）把设备说成失效设备，无中生有。B把contains错成is assembled within（在舱内组装），动作错译。

question: When the area is sufficiently cool, polish the surface.

options.A: When the cooling process is incomplete, begin polishing the surface.
options.B: If the area is excessively warm, polish the surface.
options.C: Once the area has cooled down adequately, proceed to polish the surface.

explanation: 【译文】When the area is sufficiently cool, polish the surface.（待该区域充分冷却后抛光表面。）【词汇】sufficiently cool=足够冷却，polish=抛光，surface=表面，adequately=充分地。【解析】C正确：has cooled down adequately对应sufficiently cool，proceed to polish表达冷却后再抛光。A说cooling process is incomplete（冷却未完成）就抛光，条件相反。B说excessively warm（过热）时抛光，前提条件同样相反。

question: Different lengths of studs let you attach different thicknesses of skin.

options.A: It is unneccessary to choose the lengths of studs according to the thicknesses of skin.
options.B: Studs are available in different lengths to accommodate different thicknesses of skin.
options.C: Different lengths of studs determine the thickness of the skin.

explanation: 【译文】Different lengths of studs let you attach skins of different thicknesses.（不同长度的螺柱可安装不同厚度的蒙皮。）【词汇】stud=螺柱，attach=连接、安装，thickness=厚度，skin=蒙皮，accommodate=适配。【解析】B正确：available in different lengths to accommodate different thicknesses of skin表达螺柱长度适配蒙皮厚度。A说unneccessary to choose（无需按厚度选择螺柱），与题干相反。C说螺柱长度determine蒙皮厚度，把适配关系错成决定关系。

question: Measure the time necessary for the silica gel to absorb the moisture.

options.A: Measure the rate of absorption of the moisture by the silica gel.
options.B: Measure the rate of absorption of the silica gel by the moisture.
options.C: Measure the time during  the moisture absorbing the silica gel.

explanation: 【译文】Measure the time necessary for the silica gel to absorb the moisture.【词汇】silica gel=硅胶，absorb=吸收，moisture=水分，rate of absorption=吸收速率。【解析】三项均有瑕疵，A相对最佳：保留silica gel absorbs moisture的吸收关系，但把time错成rate（速率）。B把吸收关系颠倒成moisture absorbs the silica gel。C虽保留time，却同样写成moisture absorbing the silica gel，吸收方向相反。

question: The autothrust system is on but not in operation.

options.A: The autothrust system is on and starts to operate.
options.B: The autothrust system is powered off and failed to operate.
options.C: The autothrust system is on but inactive.

explanation: 【译文】The autothrust system is on but not in operation (inactive).（自动推力系统已接通但未工作。）【词汇】autothrust=自动推力，on=接通，in operation=工作、运行，inactive=未工作、未生效。【解析】C正确：on but inactive准确对应is on but not in operation。A把not in operation错成starts to operate（开始工作），意思相反。B把is on错成powered off（断电），并加failed to operate，系统状态完全错误。

question: Open the valve to let nitrogen go into the oleo strut.

options.A: Passing through the oleo strut, nitrogen goes into the valve.
options.B: Open valve to admit nitrogen to the oleo strut.
options.C: Nitrogen is allowed to flow into the oleo strut without opening the valve.

explanation: 【译文】Open the valve to let nitrogen go into the oleo strut.（打开活门，让氮气进入油气式减震支柱。）【词汇】valve=活门，nitrogen=氮气，oleo strut=油气式减震支柱，admit=使进入。【解析】B正确：admit nitrogen to the oleo strut对应let nitrogen go into，open valve保留前提动作。A把流向关系译反：氮气穿过支柱进入活门，路径张冠李戴。C加without opening the valve（不开活门），与题干指令相反。

question: Before you accept the unit, do the specified test procedure.

options.A: Before acceptance of the unit, carry out the specified test procedure.
options.B: The specified test procedure must be carried out after the unit is accepted.
options.C: You may do the specified test procedure following acceptance of the unit.

explanation: 【译文】Before you accept the unit, do the specified test procedure.（在接受该组件之前，执行规定的测试程序。）【词汇】accept=接收、验收，unit=组件，specified test procedure=规定的测试程序，carry out=执行。【解析】A正确：before acceptance保留时间顺序，carry out对应do，测试程序表述完整。B把before错成after the unit is accepted，先后顺序相反。C用may弱化强制语气，且following acceptance同样把顺序说反。

question: The lower seal comes into view when you pull the lower bearing down.

options.A: The lower seal appears as the lower bearing is pulled down.
options.B: You can see the lower seal before pulling the lower bearing down.
options.C: Only after you pull the lower seal down can you see the lower bearing.

explanation: 【译文】The lower seal comes into view when you pull the lower bearing down.（向下拉下轴承时，下部密封件就会显露出来。）【词汇】seal=密封件、封严，bearing=轴承，come into view=进入视野、显现，pull down=向下拉。【解析】A正确：seal appears as the bearing is pulled down保留“拉下轴承→密封显现”的时序。B说在拉下轴承之前就能看到密封件，时间关系颠倒。C把对象对调：被拉下的是密封件、被看见的是轴承，张冠李戴。

question: Replace components that are worn more than the maximum limits.

options.A: Worn components should be replaced even if the damage is below the maximum limits.
options.B: Replace components that are worn beyond their maximum limits.
options.C: The maximum limits can not be exceeded when repairing the worn components.

explanation: 【译文】Replace components that are worn more than the maximum limits.（更换磨损超过最大限制的部件。）【词汇】component=部件，worn=磨损的，maximum limits=最大限制、极限，beyond=超过。【解析】B正确：worn beyond their maximum limits对应worn more than the maximum limits，更换对象和条件一致。A说即使低于极限也要更换，把“超限才换”的条件放宽。C把“更换超限磨损部件”改成“维修磨损部件时不得超过极限”，核心动作replace漏译。

question: In this example, we calculated the data applicable only to a Type B unit.

options.A: This example shows that we were only allowed to calculate the data applicable to a Type B unit.
options.B: The data we are now calculating in this example apply only to Type B unit.
options.C: The data used for the calculations in this example apply only to a Type B unit.

explanation: 【译文】In this example, we calculated the data applicable only to a Type B unit.（本例中计算的数据仅适用于B型组件。）【词汇】calculate=计算，applicable to=适用于，Type B unit=B型组件，in this example=在本例中。【解析】C正确：the data used for the calculations apply only to a Type B unit同时保留计算行为和适用范围。A加only allowed（仅被允许），把陈述句错改成权限限制。B用are now calculating现在进行时，与calculated的过去时态不符。

question: Before you put new oil in the system, it is mandatory to replace the filter.

options.A: The filter must be replaced  before putting new oil in the system.
options.B: The replacement of the filter is optional before refueling the system.
options.C: The filter can not be replaced unless you put new oil in the system.

explanation: 【译文】Before you put new oil in the system, it is mandatory to replace the filter.（向系统加入新油之前，必须更换滤子。）【词汇】mandatory=强制的、必须的，filter=滤子、过滤器，put new oil=加入新油，before=在……之前。【解析】A正确：must be replaced对应mandatory，before putting new oil保留先后顺序。B两处错误：mandatory→optional（可选），new oil→refueling（加油）。C说除非先加新油否则不能换滤子，把前提和动作的关系颠倒。

question: Make sure that the wire is in the position to cause the parts to lock.

options.A: Make sure the wire in this position is able to unlock the parts.
options.B: The wire must be positioned so that the parts can oscillate freely.
options.C: Ensure the wire is positioned to create a locking motion on parts.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the wire is in the position to cause the parts to lock.（确保导线处于能使部件锁定的位置。）【词汇】wire=导线、钢索，position=位置，cause...to lock=使……锁定，locking motion=锁定动作。【解析】C正确：positioned to create a locking motion表达导线位置产生锁定作用。A把lock错成unlock（解锁），方向相反。B把锁定错成oscillate freely（自由振荡），功能完全相反。

question: The values must not be more than the approved differences.

options.A: Whether the values should exceed the approved differences is optional.
options.B: The values must not exceed the allowable differences.
options.C: The values must remain approximately the same as the approved differences.

explanation: 【译文】The values must not be more than the approved differences.（这些数值不得超过批准的差值。）【词汇】value=数值，approved differences=批准的差值，exceed=超过，allowable=允许的。【解析】B正确：must not exceed allowable differences对应“不得超过批准差值”，allowable与approved同义。A把强制要求改成optional（可选项），语气性质错误。C错成must remain approximately the same（须保持近似相同），曲解限值含义。

question: Database synchronization is in progress.

options.A: Synchronized database is available.
options.B: Database should be processed continuously.
options.C: The database is already synchronizing.

explanation: 【译文】Database synchronization is in progress (the database is being synchronized).（数据库同步正在进行中。）【词汇】synchronization=同步，in progress=进行中，database=数据库。【解析】C正确：is already synchronizing最接近“同步正在进行”的持续状态。A说synchronized database is available（同步已完成且可用），时态为完成而非进行中。B只说should be processed continuously（应连续处理），未表达同步正在进行的状态。

question: Do test B as an alternative to test A.

options.A: Alternatively, you can do test B.
options.B: Test A is irreplaceable.
options.C: Test A is the equivalent of test B.

explanation: 【译文】Do test B as an alternative to test A (you may do test B instead).（可做B试验替代A试验。）【词汇】alternative=替代（方案），as an alternative to=作为……的替代，alternatively=或者、作为替代。【解析】A正确：Alternatively, you can do test B对应“可改做test B”。B说test A is irreplaceable（不可替代），与原意相反。C说test A is the equivalent of test B（两者等同），把“替代执行”错成“等价关系”。

question: Calculate the number of shims that are necessary.

options.A: The number of shims should be counted and recorded.
options.B: It is necessary to calibrate the shims and record their numbers.
options.C: Do an assessment of the number of shims needed.

explanation: 【译文】Calculate the number of shims that are necessary.（计算所需垫片的数量。）【词汇】shim=垫片，calculate=计算、估算，necessary=所需的，assessment=估算、评估。【解析】C正确：assessment of the number of shims needed最接近“计算所需垫片数量”。A只说counted and recorded（清点并记录），未体现“所需数量”的计算。B把calculate错成calibrate（校准），近形词干扰、词义错译。

question: If you shake the solution, do not use it for one hour.

options.A: After agitation, allow the solution to stand for one hour.
