options.A: You can use all standard English parentheses except the colon.
options.B: You can use all standard English contraction marks except the hyphen.
options.C: You can use all standard English punctuation marks except the semicolon.

explanation: 【译文】You can use all standard English punctuation marks except the semicolon.【词汇】standard English punctuation marks=标准英语标点符号，except=除了……之外，semicolon=分号（；）。【解析】C正确："标点符号"对应punctuation marks，"除了分号之外"对应except the semicolon，例外关系准确。A两处错误：punctuation marks误译为parentheses（圆括号），semicolon误译为colon（冒号），两个术语全错。B把punctuation marks误译为contraction marks（缩写符号），semicolon误译为hyphen（连字符），术语错译。

question: 此系统用于消除或防止天线或雷达罩上冰的形成。

options.A: This system is used to assist or avoid the formation of ice on masts and fairings.
options.B: This system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on antennas and radomes.
options.C: This system is used to get rid of or escape the formation of ice on probes and domes.

explanation: 【译文】This system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on antennas and radomes.【词汇】eliminate or prevent=消除或防止，formation of ice=冰的形成，antennas=天线，radomes=雷达罩。【解析】B正确："消除或防止"对应eliminate or prevent，"天线或雷达罩"对应antennas and radomes，"冰的形成"对应formation of ice。A两处错误：eliminate误译为assist（协助，语义弱化且偏离），antennas and radomes误译为masts and fairings（桅杆和整流罩），对象错译。C把prevent误译为escape（逃避），antennas and radomes误译为probes and domes（探头和圆罩），术语双错。

question: 失速恢复期间最大高度损失约800英尺。

options.A: Maximum altitude loss during stall recovery is approximately 800 feet.
options.B: Maximum altimeter loss during spin recovery is about 800 feet.
options.C: Maximum weight loss during stall recovery is nearly 800 feet.

explanation: 【译文】Maximum altitude loss during stall recovery is approximately 800 feet.【词汇】maximum altitude loss=最大高度损失，stall recovery=失速恢复，approximately=约/大约，800 feet=800英尺。【解析】A正确："最大高度损失"对应maximum altitude loss，"失速恢复期间"对应during stall recovery，"约800英尺"对应approximately 800 feet。B两处错误：altitude（高度）误译为altimeter（高度表），stall（失速）误译为spin（螺旋），双重术语错译。C把altitude loss（高度损失）误译为weight loss（重量损失），高度变重量且与feet（英尺）单位矛盾，词义错译。

question: 电磁阀应该包括一个标志，表明阀门是弹簧加载到开启或关闭位置。

options.A: Solenoid switches shall indicate whether the valve is solenoid-loaded to the open or closed positon.
options.B: Electromagnetic valves shall include a marking indicating whether the valve is coil-loaded to the open or closed positon.
options.C: Solenoid valves shall include a notation indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed positon.

explanation: 【译文】Solenoid valves shall include a notation indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.【词汇】solenoid valves=电磁阀，notation=标志/标注，indicating=表明，spring-loaded=弹簧加载，whether…or=是……还是。【解析】C正确："电磁阀"对应solenoid valves，"一个标志"对应a notation，"弹簧加载到开启或关闭位置"对应spring-loaded to the open or closed position。A两处错误：valves误译为switches（开关），spring-loaded误译为solenoid-loaded（电磁加载）。B把solenoid valves误译为electromagnetic valves（非手册标准术语），spring-loaded误译为coil-loaded（线圈加载），加载方式错译。

question: 此工作必须依据维护手册中的说明执行。

options.A: The work must be completed according to the boss instructions.
options.B: The work must be done in compliance with the instructions in the Maintenance Manual.
options.C: The work must be done according to the Maintenance Manual ahead of time.

explanation: 【译文】The work must be done in compliance with the instructions in the Maintenance Manual.【词汇】must be done=必须执行，in compliance with=依据/遵照，instructions=说明/指示，Maintenance Manual=维护手册。【解析】B正确："依据维护手册中的说明执行"对应done in compliance with the instructions in the Maintenance Manual，依据关系与对象完整。A把Maintenance Manual（维护手册）误译为boss instructions（老板指示），张冠李戴。C以according to the Maintenance Manual表达"依据维护手册"尚可，但擅自添加ahead of time（提前）这一原文没有的时间要求，属添译。

question: 动力装置仪表标记的说明应紧跟着动力装置限制的说明。

options.A: The sequence of the explanation should be powerplant instrument markings, then powerplant limitations.
options.B: An explanation of powerplant instrument markings shall immediately follow the presentation on powerplant limitations.
options.C: Presentation on powerplant limitations shall come after the explanation of powerplant instrument markings.

explanation: 【译文】An explanation of powerplant instrument markings shall immediately follow the presentation on powerplant limitations.【词汇】powerplant instrument markings=动力装置仪表标记，immediately follow=紧接着跟在……之后，presentation=说明/介绍，powerplant limitations=动力装置限制。【解析】B正确："紧跟着动力装置限制的说明"对应immediately follow the presentation on powerplant limitations，shall体现规范语气，先后顺序准确。A把shall immediately follow的命令式表述弱化为sequence should be的描述句式，规范性降低，非最佳。C把先后顺序完全颠倒：原句是标记说明跟在限制说明之后，C译成限制说明跟在标记说明之后。

question: 确保新地板面板的构型和尺寸与已拆下的相同。

options.A: Make sure that the material and dimensions of the new floor panel are the same with the removed one.
options.B: Make sure that contour and design of the new floor panel have no difference with the removed one.
options.C: Make sure that the new floor panel has the same contour and dimensions as the removed floor panel.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure that the new floor panel has the same contour and dimensions as the removed floor panel.【词汇】floor panel=地板面板，contour=构型/外形轮廓，dimensions=尺寸，same…as=与……相同，removed floor panel=已拆下的地板面板。【解析】C正确："构型和尺寸"对应contour and dimensions，"与已拆下的相同"对应the same…as the removed floor panel，比较结构完整规范。A把contour（构型/外形）误译为material（材料），且same with为非规范搭配。B两处错误：dimensions（尺寸）误译为design（设计），同一属性被偷换；have no difference with为不规范表达。

question: 设备清单应包括交付时在特定飞机上安装的所有必须或可选装的设备。

options.A: The equipment list shall include all needed or auxiliary equipment installed in the particular airplane when delivered.
options.B: All needed or optional equipment installed in the particular airplane when transported shall be contained in the equipment list.
options.C: The equipment list shall contain all required or optional equipment installed in the particular airplane when delivered.

explanation: 【译文】The equipment list shall contain all required or optional equipment installed in the particular airplane when delivered.【词汇】equipment list=设备清单，required or optional equipment=必须或可选装的设备，installed in the particular airplane=安装在特定飞机上的，when delivered=交付时。【解析】C正确："必须或可选装的设备"对应required or optional equipment，"交付时"对应when delivered，shall体现规范语气。A两处错误：required误译为needed（需要），optional误译为auxiliary（辅助的），"可选装"概念丢失。B把delivered（交付）误译为transported（运输），needed代required亦不够准确。

question: 显示器左上角的数字表示相关的页面。

options.A: A number in the bottom left corner of the display means a related page.
options.B: A number in the top left corner of the display refers to a related page.
options.C: A number in the top left corner of the display is the irrelevant page.

explanation: 【译文】A number in the top left corner of the display refers to a related page.【词汇】top left corner=左上角，display=显示器，refers to=表示/指的是，related page=相关的页面。【解析】B正确："显示器左上角"对应top left corner of the display，"表示相关的页面"对应refers to a related page。A把top（上）误译为bottom（下），左上角变左下角，方位相反。C把related（相关的）误译为irrelevant（无关的），词义完全相反，is the…page的表述也不如refers to准确。

question: 给定襟翼设置时，不要超过此速度。

options.A: Do not reach this speed with a given flap setting.
options.B: Do not exceed this speed with a give flap setting.
options.C: Do not exceed this speed with a given flap setting.

explanation: 【译文】Do not exceed this speed with a given flap setting.【词汇】do not exceed=不要超过（exceed为手册限速标准用语），this speed=此速度，given flap setting=给定襟翼设置。【解析】C正确："不要超过此速度"对应Do not exceed this speed，"给定襟翼设置"对应a given flap setting，语法与术语均正确。A把exceed（超过）弱化为reach（达到），"不要超过"变"不要达到"，限制含义改变。B存在语法错误：a give flap setting中give应为过去分词given，属语法错误选项。

question: 如果风速高得危险，请不要打开货仓门。

options.A: Do not open the entry door if the wind-speed is dangerously high.
options.B: Do not open the cargo door unless there is dangerous wind.
options.C: Do not open the cargo door if the wind-speed is dangerously high.

explanation: 【译文】Do not open the cargo door if the wind speed is dangerously high.【词汇】cargo door=货舱门，wind-speed=风速，dangerously high=高得危险，do not open=不要打开。【解析】C正确："货仓门"对应cargo door，"风速高得危险"对应wind-speed is dangerously high，if条件句与中文"如果"对应。A把cargo door（货舱门）误译为entry door（登机门/入口门），舱门对象错译。B两处错误：if（如果）误译为unless（除非），条件逻辑改变；dangerously high简化为dangerous wind，丢失"高"的程度义。

question: 在你移动副翼之前，告诉所有人离开机翼。

options.A: Before you move the spoilers, tell all persons to get off the wings.
options.B: Before telling all persons to get off the wings, you move the ailerons.
options.C: Before you move the ailerons, tell all persons to get off the wings.

explanation: 【译文】Before you move the ailerons, tell all persons to get off the wings.【词汇】before you move=在你移动……之前，ailerons=副翼，tell all persons=告诉所有人，get off the wings=离开机翼。【解析】C正确："移动副翼之前"对应before you move the ailerons，"告诉所有人离开机翼"对应tell all persons to get off the wings，时间状语与主句语序准确。A把ailerons（副翼）误译为spoilers（扰流板），操纵面对象错译。B把before引导的时间从句错译成先move ailerons再telling，动作顺序颠倒：原句是先告知后移动，B是先移动后告知。

question: 这是用来产生、调节、控制和指示交流电的系统的一部分。

options.A: This is the portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electrical power.
options.B: Here is that portion of the systems used to generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electronic power.
options.C: That is the portion of the systems used to generate, increase, control, and indicate AC electrical power.

explanation: 【译文】This is part of the system used to generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electrical power.【词汇】portion of the systems=系统的一部分，generate=产生，regulate=调节，control and indicate=控制和指示，AC electrical power=交流电。【解析】A正确："产生、调节、控制和指示交流电"对应generate, regulate, control, and indicate AC electrical power，四个动词完整无缺。B把electrical power（电能）误译为electronic power（电子功率），交流电源属性错译。C把regulate（调节）误译为increase（增加），调节变单向增加，词义错译。

question: 当插图可以简化、缩短或使文本更容易理解时，应使用插图。

options.A: Illustrations should be used when they will simplify, shorten or make the text easier to understand.
options.B: When illustrations can simple, shorten or make the text easy for understanding, they may be used.
options.C: Whenever diagrams can simple, shorten or make the content easy to understand, they could be used.

explanation: 【译文】Illustrations should be used when they will simplify, shorten or make the text easier to understand.【词汇】illustrations=插图，simplify=简化，shorten=缩短，make the text easier to understand=使文本更容易理解，should be used=应使用。【解析】A正确："当插图可以简化、缩短或使文本更容易理解时"对应when they will simplify, shorten or make the text easier to understand，三个并列谓语完整。B存在语法错误：can simple中simple为形容词不能作谓语（应为simplify）；should弱化为may。C同样can simple语法错误，且把illustrations误译为diagrams，text误译为content，should误译为could。

question: 推荐或要求的时寿件的使用时间在页面右侧适当的位置（空间）。

options.A: Recommending or requiring life limited components is on the right side of the page in an appropriate margin.
options.B: Recommended or required retirement time of life limited parts is on the right side of the page in an appropriate space.
options.C: The required retirement time of life limited components is located on the right side of  an appropriate space.

explanation: 【译文】The recommended or required retirement time of life-limited parts is on the right side of the page in an appropriate space.【词汇】recommended or required=推荐或要求的，retirement time=使用时限/退役时间，life limited parts=时寿件（寿命受限部件），right side of the page=页面右侧，appropriate space=适当的位置。【解析】B正确："推荐或要求的时寿件的使用时间"对应recommended or required retirement time of life limited parts，主语是"时间"而非部件，"页面右侧适当的位置"对应right side of the page in an appropriate space。A主语错成recommending…components（推荐部件这件事），丢失"使用时间"核心概念。C漏译recommended（"推荐或要求"只译了required），且on the right side of an appropriate space表达不通。

question: 本系统并不会取代不包括在CAP内的项目的正常通讯渠道。

options.A: This system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.
options.B: This system will not change the normal ways of communication for items not listed by the CAP.
options.C: The normal methods of communication for items contained in the CAP will not be shifted.

explanation: 【译文】This system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.【词汇】supersede=取代，normal channels of communication=正常通讯渠道，items not covered by the CAP=不包括在CAP内的项目。【解析】A正确："并不会取代"对应does not supersede，"不包括在CAP内的项目的正常通讯渠道"完整对应normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP。B两处偏差：supersede弱化为change（改变），not covered误译为not listed（未列出）。C把not covered（未包括）误译为contained（已包括），范围相反，且主客结构混乱。

question: 如果你不遵守这些预防措施，你的皮肤和肺可能会受伤。

options.A: If you do not obey these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.
options.B: It will cause damage to your skin and liver unless you follow the cautions.
options.C: If you understand the instructions, you body will not be hurt.

explanation: 【译文】If you do not obey these precautions, injury to your skin and lungs can occur.【词汇】obey these precautions=遵守这些预防措施，injury to skin and lungs=皮肤和肺受伤，can occur=可能发生，if you do not=如果不。【解析】A正确："不遵守这些预防措施"对应do not obey these precautions，"皮肤和肺可能会受伤"对应injury to your skin and lungs can occur，条件与结果均准确。B把lungs（肺）误译为liver（肝），器官错译；unless结构对应"如果不"也不如if…not直接。C把do not obey these precautions误译为understand the instructions（理解说明），否定条件变成肯定理解，语义全变。

question: 缓慢并完全伸出冲压空气涡轮，并确保它不触碰其他部件。

options.A: Rapidly and fully retract Ram Air Turbine and make sure that it doesn't attach to other parts.
options.B: Slowly and fully extend Ram Air Turbine and make sure that it doesn't touch other parts.
options.C: Make sure that the Ram Air Turbine is completely opened and it doesn't touch the other unit.

explanation: 【译文】Slowly and fully extend the Ram Air Turbine and make sure that it does not touch other parts.【词汇】slowly and fully extend=缓慢并完全伸出，Ram Air Turbine=冲压空气涡轮（RAT），touch other parts=触碰其他部件，make sure=确保。【解析】B正确："缓慢并完全伸出"对应slowly and fully extend，"不触碰其他部件"对应doesn't touch other parts。A三处错误：slowly误译为rapidly（快速），extend误译为retract（收回），touch误译为attach to（连接），几乎处处相反。C漏译slowly（缓慢），extend简化为opened，other parts误译为the other unit（另一组件），范围缩小。

question: 如果过滤器发生堵塞，应送去实验室分析污染情况。

options.A: If the filters become clogged, send them to the laboratory for analysis of the contamination.
options.B: If the filters are surged, send them to laboratory for contamination analysis.
options.C: If the contaminant is blocking the filter, the material should be sent to the laboratory for analysis.

explanation: 【译文】If the filters become clogged, send them to the laboratory for analysis of the contamination.【词汇】filters=过滤器/滤芯，become clogged=发生堵塞，laboratory=实验室，analysis of the contamination=污染情况分析。【解析】A正确："过滤器发生堵塞"对应filters become clogged，"送去实验室分析污染情况"对应send them to the laboratory for analysis of the contamination，送检对象是过滤器本身。B把clogged（堵塞）误译为surged（涌动/喘振），状态错译。C把送检对象从filters偷换成the material/contaminant（污染物/材料），送什么去实验室完全改变，主语错译。

question: 反推用来改变排气方向以实现反向推力。

options.A: Use backthrust to change the direction of the exhaust to achieve contrary thrust.
options.B: Thrust reverser is used to change the direction of the exhaust gases for reverse thrust.
options.C: To change the direction of the exhaust nozzle, the thrust reverser is used to obtain the opposite thrust.

explanation: 【译文】The thrust reverser is used to change the direction of the exhaust gases for reverse thrust.【词汇】thrust reverser=反推（装置），change the direction of the exhaust gases=改变排气方向，reverse thrust=反向推力，is used to=用来。【解析】B正确："反推"对应thrust reverser，"改变排气方向"对应change the direction of the exhaust gases，"实现反向推力"对应for reverse thrust，术语均为规范用法。A术语错误：反推误作backthrust（非标准词），reverse thrust误作contrary thrust。C把exhaust gases（排气燃气）缩译为exhaust nozzle（排气喷管），改变排气方向变成改变喷管方向，对象错译。

question: 如果不进行改装，这个组件的使用寿命就有可能比平时短。

options.A: If the unit is not modified, its service life will be possibly shorter.
options.B: Without the modification of the unit, its service life is likely shorter than present.
options.C: Without the modification, it is possible that the service life of this unit will be shorter than usual.

explanation: 【译文】Without the modification, it is possible that the service life of this unit will be shorter than usual.【词汇】without the modification=如果不进行改装，service life=使用寿命，it is possible that=有可能，shorter than usual=比平时短，unit=组件。【解析】C正确："如果不进行改装"对应without the modification，"使用寿命有可能比平时短"对应it is possible that the service life…shorter than usual，推测语气与比较对象完整。A漏译than usual（比平时），will be possibly shorter语序生硬且丢失比较基准。B把than usual（比平时）误译为than present（比现在），"平时"指通常情况而非现在，词义错译。

question: 飞机起飞前，检查左发内侧大翼前缘是否有损伤和凹坑。

options.A: Check left engine inboard wing leading edge if have damage and dent before the aircraft takes off.
options.B: Check wing leading edge inboard left engine for damage and dent before the aircraft takes off.
options.C: Check the wing leading edge of left engine inboard for damage and dent before the aircraft takes off.

explanation: 【译文】Before the aircraft takes off, check the wing leading edge inboard of the left engine for damage and dents.【词汇】wing leading edge=机翼前缘/大翼前缘，left engine inboard=左发内侧，damage and dent=损伤和凹坑，before the aircraft takes off=飞机起飞前，check…for=检查……是否有。【解析】C正确："左发内侧大翼前缘"以the wing leading edge of left engine inboard表达，"是否有损伤和凹坑"对应for damage and dent，check…for结构正确。A语法错误：if have damage缺主语不合法，left engine inboard wing leading edge名词堆砌易歧义。B语序inboard left engine后置修饰位置不当，大翼前缘与左发内侧的所属关系表达不清。

question: 供压时，人员和设备要远离所有操纵面和起落架。

options.A: When hydraulic power is supplied, keep persons and equipment away from all control surfaces and landing gear.
options.B: When supplying power to the hydraulic system, persons and equipment should be away from all control surfaces and landing gear.
options.C: Persons and equipment shall be away from all hydraulic system control surfaces and landing gear when supply pressure.

explanation: 【译文】When hydraulic pressure is supplied, keep persons and equipment away from all control surfaces and the landing gear.【词汇】hydraulic power is supplied=供压（液压供给时），keep…away from=使……远离，persons and equipment=人员和设备，control surfaces=操纵面，landing gear=起落架。【解析】A正确："供压时"对应when hydraulic power is supplied，"人员和设备要远离所有操纵面和起落架"对应keep persons and equipment away from all control surfaces and landing gear，keep away结构准确。B表达生硬：should be away不如keep…away符合手册祈使文体。C两处错误：when supply pressure语法残缺，all hydraulic system control surfaces把液压系统错作操纵面的定语，修饰关系改变。

question: 如果这一步不足以阻止泄漏，更换作动器。

options.A: If this step can not stop the leakage, remove the actuator.
options.B: If this step is not enough to stop the leakage, change the motor.
options.C: If this step is not sufficient to stop the leakage, replace the actuator.

explanation: 【译文】If this step is not sufficient to stop the leakage, replace the actuator.【词汇】not sufficient=不足够/不足以，stop the leakage=阻止泄漏/止漏，replace=更换，actuator=作动器/作动筒。【解析】C正确："不足以阻止泄漏"对应not sufficient to stop the leakage，"更换作动器"对应replace the actuator。A把replace（更换）误译为remove（拆卸/移除），更换是以新换旧，remove只是拆下，词义错译。B两处错误：actuator误译为motor（电机/马达），作动器概念被偷换；change虽可表更换但motor错译使整句不成立。

question: 如果在泵中发现金属颗粒，找到它们的来源并修复有缺陷的部分。

options.A: If you find metal particles in the reservoir, find their source and repair the broken part.
options.B: If you find metal particles in the pump, find their source and repair the defective part.
options.C: If you find material particles in the pump, find their source and repair the damaged part.

explanation: 【译文】If you find metal particles in the pump, find their source and repair the defective part.【词汇】metal particles=金属颗粒，in the pump=在泵中，find their source=找到其来源，repair the defective part=修复有缺陷的部件。【解析】B正确："在泵中"对应in the pump，"金属颗粒"对应metal particles，"有缺陷的部分"对应defective part，条件与两个动作完整。A把pump（泵）误译为reservoir（油箱/储液罐），检查部位错译；defective译为broken亦有偏差。C把metal（金属）误译为material（材料），范围扩大；defective（有缺陷的）译为damaged（受损的）也不够准确。

question: 如果需要，数据可通过附加特征或特征的简要描述来补充。

options.A: The data may be supplemented by brief descriptions of additional characteristics or features if desired.
options.B: If necessary, the detail may supplement some simple descriptions of additional characteristics or properties.
options.C: If desired, the data may be added by simple presentations of additional values or properties.

explanation: 【译文】If necessary, the data may be supplemented by brief descriptions of additional characteristics or features.【词汇】data=数据，may be supplemented by=可通过……补充，brief descriptions=简要描述，additional characteristics or features=附加特征或特性，if desired/necessary=如果需要。【解析】A正确："数据可通过……简要描述来补充"对应data may be supplemented by brief descriptions，"附加特征或特征"对应additional characteristics or features，被动语态准确。B两处错误：data误译为detail（细节），被动supplemented误译为主动supplement，主客体颠倒。C把supplemented（补充）误译为added（添加），characteristics or features误译为values or properties（数值或属性），simple亦不如brief贴切。

question: 巡航性能介绍的格式由飞机制造商自行决定。

options.A: The form of the climb performance presentation is decided by the airplane manufacturer.
options.B: The format of the cruise performance presentation is at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer.
options.C: The form of the cruise performance presentation is at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】The format of the cruise performance presentation is at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer.【词汇】format=格式，cruise performance presentation=巡航性能介绍，at the discretion of=由……自行决定/酌情决定，airplane manufacturer=飞机制造商。【解析】B正确："巡航性能介绍的格式"对应format of the cruise performance presentation，"由飞机制造商自行决定"对应at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer，术语规范。A两处错误：cruise（巡航）误译为climb（爬升），飞行阶段错译；form不如format贴切"格式"义。C基本对应但form偏"形式"义，"格式"用format更准确，故B最优。

question: 这些咨询通告提供了关于制造商和所有者/运营商持续适航要求的具体信息。

options.A: These  airworthiness directives provide detailed information about continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.
options.B: These service bulletins provide detailed information regarding continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.
options.C: These advisory circulars provide specific information regarding continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.

explanation: 【译文】These advisory circulars provide specific information regarding continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.【词汇】advisory circulars=咨询通告（AC），specific information=具体信息，continued airworthiness requirements=持续适航要求，manufacturer and owner/operator=制造商和所有者/运营商。【解析】C正确："咨询通告"对应advisory circulars，"持续适航要求"对应continued airworthiness requirements，"具体信息"对应specific information。A把advisory circulars误译为airworthiness directives（适航指令AD），文件类型错译。B把advisory circulars误译为service bulletins（服务通告SB），同样张冠李戴。

question: 驾驶舱语音记录器记录飞行过程中四个音频输入的信号。

options.A: The cockpit voice recorder records signals from four audio inputs during the flight.
options.B: The cockpit voice indicator records four audio inputs in the flight.
options.C: There are four cockpit voice recorders recording in-flight audio input.

explanation: 【译文】The cockpit voice recorder records signals from four audio inputs during the flight.【词汇】cockpit voice recorder=驾驶舱语音记录器（CVR），records signals=记录信号，four audio inputs=四个音频输入，during the flight=飞行过程中。【解析】A正确："四个音频输入的信号"对应signals from four audio inputs，"飞行过程中"对应during the flight，单数recorder与records呼应。B两处错误：recorder误译为indicator（指示器），signals from被简化为直接记录four audio inputs。C把"一台记录器记录四路输入"误译为four cockpit voice recorders（四台记录器），数量概念错译。

question: 利用简化的原理图和图纸来解释系统的操作方法，包括使用过程中的警告装置和控制特点。

options.A: Use schematics and drawings to briefly explain the operation of the system, including warning devices and control features during use.
options.B: Making use of simplified schematics and drawings explain how this system operates, including warning devices and control features in use.
options.C: The simplified diagrams and drawings are the indication of the system operation, including warning devices and control features in use.

explanation: 【译文】Use simplified schematics and drawings to explain how the system operates, including warning devices and control features in use.【词汇】simplified schematics=简化的原理图，drawings=图纸，explain how the system operates=解释系统如何操作/操作方法，warning devices=警告装置，control features=控制特点，in use=使用过程中。【解析】B正确："简化的原理图和图纸"对应simplified schematics and drawings，"解释系统的操作方法"对应explain how this system operates，"使用过程中"对应in use，要素齐全。A漏译simplified（简化的），并擅加briefly（简要地），漏译加添译。C把"用图纸解释操作方法"误译为diagrams and drawings are the indication（图纸是系统操作的指示），手段变判断，语义错译。

question: 站位是指机身沿线距离参考基准面以英寸计的位置。

options.A: Station shows the height along the fuselage between the reference datum and the position in inches.
options.B: Station is the distance of a point of fuselage to the location of reference datum along the centerline in centimeters.
options.C: Station means a position along the fuselage measured in inches from the reference datum.

explanation: 【译文】Station means a position along the fuselage measured in inches from the reference datum.【词汇】station=站位，position along the fuselage=沿机身的位置，measured in inches=以英寸计量的，reference datum=参考基准面。【解析】C正确："机身沿线的位置"对应position along the fuselage，"以英寸计"对应measured in inches，"距离参考基准面"对应from the reference datum，定义句式准确。A两处错误：position误译为height（高度），from简化为between造成"基准面与位置之间"的错误表述。B把inches（英寸）误译为centimeters（厘米），单位错译，并擅加centerline（中线）。

question: 驾驶舱在地板之上，位于前客舱隔板和前压力隔框之间。

options.A: The flight deck is located between the pressure dome and the front passenger door, and it is above the floor.
options.B: Cockpit is on the floor panel and between the pressure dome and the rear passenger partition.
options.C: Flight compartment is above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome.

explanation: 【译文】The flight compartment is above the floor and located between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure bulkhead.【词汇】flight compartment=驾驶舱，above the floor=在地板之上，forward passenger partition=前客舱隔板，forward pressure dome/bulkhead=前压力隔框。【解析】C正确："在地板之上"对应above the floor，"前客舱隔板和前压力隔框之间"对应between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome，方位关系准确。A把forward passenger partition误译为front passenger door（前客舱门），隔板变舱门。B三处错误：above the floor误译为on the floor panel（在地板面板上），forward误译为rear（前变后），方位相反。

question: CAP样例的第三部分序言被省略，必要的信息已经包括在目标的描述中。

options.A: The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section Ill and the necessary information has been included in the Objectives.
options.B: The Objectives of third CAP sample is omitted and the necessary information is included in the Preface description.
options.C: The necessary information has been included in the sample description, so the CAP III omitted the Objectives in the Preface.

explanation: 【译文】The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III, and the necessary information has been included in the description of the Objectives.【词汇】Preface=序言，omitted=省略，sample CAP=CAP样例，Section III=第三部分，necessary information included in the Objectives=必要信息已包含在目标中。【解析】A正确："第三部分序言被省略"对应Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III（原文Ill为III的字体显示），"必要信息已包括在目标的描述中"对应included in the Objectives。B把省略对象从Preface偷换成Objectives，信息归属反转。C逻辑混乱：CAP III omitted the Objectives in the Preface把三者关系错位拼接，因果表述反置。

question: 当用千斤顶顶升飞机时，保持重心在限制范围内。

options.A: When you lift the aircraft on racks, keep the center of the aircraft between these limits.
options.B: When you lift the aircraft on jacks, keep the center of gravity between these limits.
options.C: When you lift the aircraft on jacks, the gravity of the aircraft shall be limited.

explanation: 【译文】When you lift the aircraft on jacks, keep the center of gravity within these limits.【词汇】lift the aircraft on jacks=用千斤顶顶升飞机，center of gravity=重心（CG），between/within these limits=在限制范围内，keep=保持。【解析】B正确："用千斤顶顶升飞机"对应lift the aircraft on jacks，"重心在限制范围内"对应keep the center of gravity between these limits。A两处错误：jacks误译为racks（架子/吊架），center of gravity误译为center of the aircraft（飞机中心），重心概念丢失。C把keep the center of gravity between these limits错译为the gravity of the aircraft shall be limited，语法别扭且"限制重力"语义不通。

question: 在钻孔之前，要确保钻头的尖端是锋利的。

options.A: Before drill the hole, make sure that the point of the drill head is sharp.
options.B: Prior to drill the hole, make sure that the point of the drill bit is sharp.
options.C: Before you make the hole, make sure that the point of the drill bit is sharp.

explanation: 【译文】Before drilling the hole, make sure that the point of the drill bit is sharp.【词汇】drill the hole=钻孔，drill bit=钻头（bit为钻头本体），point=尖端，sharp=锋利，prior to=在……之前。【解析】B正确："钻头的尖端"对应the point of the drill bit，"锋利"对应sharp，"钻孔之前"对应prior to drill the hole（介词后本应为drilling，小瑕疵但术语全对）。A两处错误：before drill语法不合法（应为before drilling），drill bit误译为drill head（钻床头，术语不准）。C语法正确但把"钻孔"弱化为make the hole（做个孔），钻削动作丢失，术语不如B准确。

question: 在此期间使用经济型功率设置可能会对发动机的寿命有损害。

options.A:
During this
period,if you use economy power settings, the engine may be damaged.
options.B:
The use of economy power settings during this
period may be detrimental to the engine life.
options.C:
The use of economy power settings during this
period may reproduce the engine life.

explanation: 【译文】The use of economy power settings during this period may be detrimental to engine life.【词汇】economy power settings=经济型功率设置，during this period=在此期间，be detrimental to=对……有损害，engine life=发动机寿命。【解析】B正确："使用经济型功率设置"对应the use of economy power settings，"对发动机的寿命有损害"对应be detrimental to the engine life，损害对象是"寿命"而非发动机本体。A把detrimental to engine life（损害寿命）简化为the engine may be damaged（发动机可能损坏），损害对象从寿命变成发动机本身。C把detrimental（有害的）误译为reproduce（复制/再现），词义完全错译，语义不通。

question: 根据43部法规,持证的飞行员有权利执行有限的预防性维修。

options.A: A pilot with certification authorized by Part 43 of the regulation can perform limited preventive maintenance.
options.B: According to Part 43 of the regulation, A  pilot is certificated to perform limited preventative maintenance.
options.C: A certificated pilot is authorized by Part 43 of the regulation to perform limited preventive maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】A certificated pilot is authorized by Part 43 of the regulation to perform limited preventive maintenance.【词汇】certificated pilot=持证飞行员，authorized by=经……授权，Part 43=（联邦航空条例）第43部，limited preventive maintenance=有限的预防性维修。【解析】C正确："持证的飞行员"对应certificated pilot，"根据43部法规有权利"对应is authorized by Part 43 of the regulation，"执行有限的预防性维修"对应perform limited preventive maintenance。A表达别扭：a pilot with certification authorized by Part 43把授权对象错位为认证本身。B两处问题：a pilot is certificated to perform用法不当（certificated应作pilot的前置定语），A pilot大小写空格亦有瑕疵。

question: 简述和说明任何新型飞行仪表的工作原理。

options.A: Briefly describe and explain principle of operation of any new kinds of flight instruments.
options.B:
Briefly introduce the operation principal of 
any new kinds of flight apparatus.
options.C:
Briefly describe and explain the operation principle of 
any new kinds of flight displays.

explanation: 【译文】Briefly describe and explain the principle of operation of any new type of flight instrument.【词汇】briefly describe and explain=简述和说明，principle of operation=工作原理（principle原理，勿拼作principal），new kinds of flight instruments=新型飞行仪表。【解析】A正确："简述和说明"对应briefly describe and explain，"工作原理"对应principle of operation，"新型飞行仪表"对应new kinds of flight instruments。B两处错误：instruments误译为apparatus（装置），principle误拼为principal（意为"主要的/校长"），词形错译。C把flight instruments（飞行仪表）误译为flight displays（飞行显示器），对象错译。

question: 制造商可以建立程序，对于在执行程序时发现的不适航情况提供反馈。

options.A: The manufacturer may set up steps and feedback the airworthy conditions discovered when complying.
options.B: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered when complying.
options.C: The manufacturer may establish procedures and comply regulations to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions.

explanation: 【译文】The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions discovered when performing them.【词汇】manufacturer=制造商，establish procedures=建立程序，provide feedback on=对……提供反馈，unairworthy conditions=不适航情况，discovered when complying=执行（程序）时发现的。【解析】B正确："建立程序"对应establish procedures，"对不适航情况提供反馈"对应provide feedback on unairworthy conditions，"执行程序时发现"对应discovered when complying。A把unairworthy（不适航）误译为airworthy（适航），词义完全相反，属最严重错译。C漏译"发现"这一关键信息，并擅加comply regulations（遵守法规），目的关系表达不清。

question: CAP的意图并非是更改或替换适用的飞机维修手册或服务信函的任何部分。

options.A: The CAP is not  intended to change or replace any portion of the applicable Airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.
options.B: The CAP is developed to change or place some part of the applicable Airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.
options.C: Revising or replacing any part of the serviceable Airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Bulletin is not the main purpose of the CAP.

explanation: 【译文】The CAP is not intended to change or replace any portion of the applicable Airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.【词汇】is not intended to=意图并非/并非意在，change or replace=更改或替换，any portion=任何部分，applicable=适用的，Service Letters=服务信函。【解析】A正确："意图并非"对应not intended to，"更改或替换……任何部分"对应change or replace any portion，"适用的飞机维修手册或服务信函"对应applicable AMM or Service Letters。B把not intended（并非意图）误译为is developed to（旨在），否定变肯定，完全相反。C两处错误：Service Letters误译为Service Bulletin（服务通告），applicable误译为serviceable（可使用的），句式重组亦偏离原意。

question: 对现有的分析进行了核查，以确定可能表现出较低安全裕度的部件和区域。

options.A: In order to locate lower margins of safety components and areas, current records were reviewed.
options.B: To find components and areas where have showed lower margins of safety, existing results were examined.
options.C: Existing analyses were reviewed to identify components and areas that may have exhibited lower margins of safety.

explanation: 【译文】Existing analyses were reviewed to identify components and areas that may have exhibited lower margins of safety.【词汇】existing analyses=现有分析，were reviewed=进行了核查/审查，identify=确定，components and areas=部件和区域，lower margins of safety=较低安全裕度。【解析】C正确："对现有的分析进行了核查"对应existing analyses were reviewed，"可能表现出较低安全裕度的部件和区域"完整对应定语从句that may have exhibited lower margins of safety。A两处错误：analyses误译为records（记录），identify弱化为locate（定位）。B语法错误：where have showed应为which/that had shown；existing analyses误译为existing results（结果）。

question: 空速可提高操作安全性，应作为常规程序章节的序言。

options.A: To improve the safety operations, airspeeds shall be a preface to the Normal Procedures Section.
options.B: The airspeeds shall be provided as an introduction to enhance the safety operations.
options.C: The airspeeds which may enhance the safety of operations shall be provided as a preface to the Normal Procedures Section.

explanation: 【译文】The airspeeds which may enhance the safety of operations shall be provided as a preface to the Normal Procedures Section.【词汇】airspeeds=空速（各档速度值），enhance the safety of operations=提高操作安全性，provided as a preface=作为序言提供，Normal Procedures Section=常规程序章节。【解析】C正确："可提高操作安全性的空速"用定语从句which may enhance the safety of operations表达，"作为常规程序章节的序言"对应as a preface to the Normal Procedures Section，要素完整。A表达生硬：airspeeds shall be a preface不如provided as a preface自然，the safety operations搭配别扭。B漏译Normal Procedures Section（常规程序章节），"序言"所修饰的对象丢失，属漏译要素。

question: 如果你在泵中发现金属颗粒，找到它们的来源并修理有缺陷的部件。

options.A: If you find metal particles in the pump, find their source and repair the defective part.
options.B: If magnetic particles are found in the  pump, locate their location and repair the affected part.
options.C: Locate their source and disassemble the defective part if you find metal objects.

explanation: 【译文】If you find metal particles in the pump, find their source and repair the defective part.【词汇】metal particles=金属颗粒，in the pump=在泵中，find their source=找到其来源，repair the defective part=修理有缺陷的部件。【解析】A正确："在泵中发现金属颗粒"对应find metal particles in the pump，"修理有缺陷的部件"对应repair the defective part。B多处偏差：metal误译为magnetic（磁性颗粒），source误为locate their location（语义重复），defective误为affected（受影响的）。C三处错误：metal particles误译为metal objects（金属物体），漏译in the pump，repair误译为disassemble（分解），修理变拆解。

question: 移除螺钉、垫片和螺帽来断开链接到这个结构上的圆箍。

options.A: Remove the bolt, washer, and nut to disconnect the bend clamp from the structure.
options.B: Remove the screw, washer, and nut to disconnect the short clamp from the structure.
options.C: Remove the screw, washer, and nut to disconnect the loop clamp from the structure.

explanation: 【译文】Remove the screw, washer and nut to disconnect the loop clamp from the structure.【词汇】screw=螺钉，washer=垫片/垫圈，nut=螺帽/螺母，loop clamp=圆箍/环形卡箍，disconnect…from the structure=从结构上断开。【解析】C正确："螺钉、垫片和螺帽"对应screw, washer, and nut，"圆箍"对应loop clamp，"断开链接到结构上的"对应disconnect…from the structure。A两处错误：screw误译为bolt（螺栓），loop clamp误译为bend clamp（弯形卡箍）。B把loop clamp误译为short clamp（短卡箍），环形特征丢失。

question: 三台电脑收集数据并且汇集数据链到显示组件。

options.A: Three computers collect data and put them together on the data link to the display unit.
options.B: Three computers collect data and put them together on the data upload to the display unit.
options.C: Three computers collect data and put them together on the data conveyed to the display unit.

explanation: 【译文】Three computers collect data and combine them onto the data link to the display unit.【词汇】three computers=三台计算机/电脑，collect data=收集数据，put them together=汇集，data link=数据链，display unit=显示组件。【解析】A正确："收集数据并且汇集"对应collect data and put them together，"数据链到显示组件"对应the data link to the display unit，data link术语准确。B把data link（数据链）误译为data upload（数据上传），传输介质变上传动作。C把data link误译为data conveyed（被传送的数据），"数据链"这一固定术语丢失，属词义错译。

question: 基本控制和操作信息，描述如何控制飞机部件及其操作，包括任何特殊程序和适用的限制。

options.A: Basic control and operation information describing how the airplane components are controlled and how they operate, including any special procedures, and limitations that apply.
options.B: Basic control and operation information describing how the airplane components are controlled and operated, including any special procedures, and limitations that apply.
options.C: Basic control and operation information describing how the airplane components control and operate, including any special procedures and limitations that apply.

explanation: 【译文】Basic control and operation information describing how the airplane components are controlled and operated, including any special procedures and limitations that apply.【词汇】basic control and operation information=基本控制和操作信息，airplane components=飞机部件，controlled and operated=被控制和（被）操作，special procedures=特殊程序，limitations that apply=适用的限制。【解析】B正确："如何控制飞机部件及其操作"对应how the airplane components are controlled and operated，被动式体现部件受控受操作，"任何特殊程序和适用的限制"对应any special procedures and limitations that apply。A拆成are controlled and how they operate，operate变主动"自行运转"，与"对其操作"的含义略有偏差但仍接近，B更紧凑贴合。C的components control and operate缺被动，部件变成施动者，语法与语义均错。

question: 在这种情况下，简介应注意手册中所涵盖的系统，制造商也可选择在产品简单性允许的情况下对相关系统进行分组

options.A: In such cases, the introduction  should  notice  the  systems related in the manual，manufacturers may also choose to group related systems  where  the  simplicity of the product permits.
options.B: In such cases, the introduction  should  note  the  systems  covered in the manual，manufacturers may also choose to group related systems  where  the  simplicity of the product permits.
options.C: In such cases, the introduction  should  note  the  systems  comprised in the manual，manufacturers may also choose to divide related systems  if the product is simple enough.

explanation: 【译文】In such cases, the introduction should note the systems covered in the manual; manufacturers may also choose to group related systems where the simplicity of the product permits.【词汇】introduction=简介/引言，note=注意/说明，systems covered in the manual=手册所涵盖的系统，group related systems=对相关系统分组，where the simplicity of the product permits=在产品简单性允许的情况下。【解析】B正确："所涵盖的系统"对应systems covered in the manual，"分组"对应group related systems，"产品简单性允许"对应where the simplicity of the product permits。A把covered（涵盖）误译为related（相关的），手册涵盖关系变成相关关系，词义错译。C两处错误：covered误译为comprised（用法亦不当），group（分组/归类）误译为divide（划分），合组变拆分，方向相反。

question: 系统/章节、子系统/段落和主题编号、页码和发行日期将显示在左边页面的左下角，而修订日期在右下角。

options.A: The System/Chapter, sub-System/Section and  Subject Number, the page  number  and  date  of  issue  will  disappear  in  the lower  left-hand  corner,  on  the  left-hand  pages  and   the   review date   in   the   lower  right-hand  corner.
options.B: The System/Chapter, sub-System/Section and  Subject Number, the page  number  and  date  of  issue  will  appear  in  the lower  left-hand  corner,  on  the  left-hand  pages  and   the review    date   in   the   lower  right-hand  corner.
options.C: The System/Chapter, sub-System/Section and  Subject Number, the page  number  and  date  of  public  will  appear  in  the lower  left-hand  corner, on  the  left-hand  pages  and   the   revision date   in   the   lower  right-hand  corner.

explanation: 【译文】The System/Chapter, Sub-system/Section and Subject Number, the page number and date of issue will appear in the lower left-hand corner on the left-hand pages, and the revision date in the lower right-hand corner.【词汇】System/Chapter=系统/章节，Subject Number=主题编号，date of issue=发行日期，lower left-hand corner=左下角，left-hand pages=左边页面，revision date=修订日期。【解析】B为现有选项中最佳：will appear对应"显示"，date of issue对应"发行日期"，左/右下角方位完整；瑕疵是把"修订日期"译成review date（应为revision date），属小误差。A把appear误译为disappear（消失），方向相反。C把date of issue误译为date of public（语法残缺，应为publication），虽revision date译对，但综合比较B的正确要素更多，故选B。

question: 如果风速超过20英里/小时，不要用千斤顶顶起飞机。

options.A: Do not lift the aircraft on jacks if the wind speed is more than 20 MPH.
options.B: Do not hoist the aircraft on chocks if the wind speed is more than 20 MPH.
options.C: Do not raise the aircraft on jacks if the wind speed is more than 20 km/h.

explanation: 【译文】Do not lift the aircraft on jacks if the wind speed is more than 20 mph.【词汇】lift the aircraft on jacks=用千斤顶顶起飞机，wind speed=风速，more than 20 MPH=超过20英里/小时，do not=不要。【解析】A正确："用千斤顶顶起飞机"对应lift the aircraft on jacks，"风速超过20英里/小时"对应wind speed is more than 20 MPH。B两处错误：jacks误译为chocks（轮挡），lift误译为hoist（吊装），顶升工具错译。C把MPH（英里/小时）误译为km/h（公里/小时），速度单位错译，数值含义完全改变。

question: 超过此速度请不要收放起落架。

options.A: Do not extend or retract landing gear above this speed.
options.B: Do not lower or retract landing gear exceed this speed.
options.C: Do not lower or lift landing gear within this speed.

explanation: 【译文】Do not extend or retract the landing gear above this speed.【词汇】extend or retract=放出或收起（收放），landing gear=起落架，above this speed=超过此速度/在此速度以上。【解析】A正确："收放起落架"对应extend or retract landing gear，"超过此速度"对应above this speed，above表速度上限准确。B两处错误：extend误译为lower（放下），above this speed误为exceed this speed（语法错误，应为exceeding或above）。C把extend/retract误译为lower/lift，专业术语错位；above误译为within（在……以内），限制关系相反。

question: 把车辆挪到你可以使用标准程序的安全区域。

options.A: Tow the plane to a safe area where you can use the standard process.
options.B: Pull the vehicle to a safe area where you can use the standard procedures.
options.C: Taxi the car to a safe area where you can use the normal procedures.

explanation: 【译文】Move the vehicle to a safe area where you can use the standard procedures.【词汇】vehicle=车辆，pull/tow=拖/挪动，safe area=安全区域，standard procedures=标准程序，where you can use=你可以使用的。【解析】B正确："把车辆挪到"对应Pull the vehicle to，"可以使用标准程序的安全区域"对应a safe area where you can use the standard procedures。A两处错误：vehicle误译为plane（飞机），standard procedures误为standard process（标准过程）。C把vehicle窄化为car（轿车），standard procedures误译为normal procedures（正常程序），两处词义偏差。

question: 如果你决定不更换部件，请监控其温度至少15个循环。

options.A: If your decision is not to change the unit, monitor its temperature at least 15 rotations.
options.B: If you decide not to renew the unit, supervise its temperature at least 15 periods.
options.C: If your decision is not to replace the unit, monitor its temperature for a minimum of 15 cycles.

explanation: 【译文】If you decide not to replace the unit, monitor its temperature for a minimum of 15 cycles.【词汇】decide not to replace=决定不更换，monitor its temperature=监控其温度，a minimum of 15 cycles=至少15个循环，unit=部件/组件。【解析】C正确："决定不更换部件"对应decision is not to replace the unit，"监控其温度至少15个循环"对应monitor its temperature for a minimum of 15 cycles，cycles为循环标准用语。A把cycles（循环）误译为rotations（转数/旋转），计量概念错译；replace弱化为change尚可。B两处错误：replace误译为renew（翻新），cycles误译为periods（期间），15个循环变15个时期。

question: 不要操作刹车来降低蓄压器中的压力。

options.A: Do not operate the brakes to decrease the pressure in the accumulators.
options.B: Do not control the brakes to increase the pressure in the accumulators.
options.C: Do not maneuver the brakes for augmentation of the pressure in the reservoir.

explanation: 【译文】Do not operate the brakes to decrease the pressure in the accumulators.【词汇】operate the brakes=操作刹车，decrease the pressure=降低压力，accumulators=蓄压器（储能器，勿混reservoir油箱），do not=不要。【解析】A正确："操作刹车"对应operate the brakes，"降低蓄压器中的压力"对应decrease the pressure in the accumulators，目的不定式结构准确。B两处错误：operate弱化为control尚可，但decrease（降低）误译为increase（增加），方向完全相反。C把decrease误译为augmentation（增大），accumulators误译为reservoir（储液箱），maneuver亦不如operate规范，多处错译。

question: 扰流板和副翼类似，它们也辅助并提供飞机滚转操纵。

options.A: The spoilers are similar to the ailerons in that they are assisting and providing control of the airplane about the longitudinal axis.
options.B: The ailerons are similar to the spoilers in that they are resisting and providing control of the airplane about the longitudinal axis.
options.C: The ailerons are similar to the spoilers in that they are resisting and providing control of the airplane about the roll axis.

explanation: 【译文】The spoilers are similar to the ailerons in that they also assist in providing roll control of the airplane.【词汇】spoilers=扰流板，ailerons=副翼，similar to=与……类似，assist and provide=辅助并提供，about the longitudinal axis=绕纵轴（即滚转操纵）。【解析】A正确："扰流板和副翼类似"对应spoilers are similar to the ailerons，"辅助并提供滚转操纵"对应assisting and providing control about the longitudinal axis（滚转即绕纵轴运动）。B主客体颠倒：变成ailerons are similar to spoilers，且assisting误译为resisting（抵抗），方向相反。C同样主客体颠倒并把assisting误译为resisting；roll axis虽更直接但其余全错。

question: 通常称之为“电传操纵系统”。

options.A: Normally, it is named “fly by electrical control system”.
options.B: Normally, we name it “fly by electrical  system”.
options.C: This is commonly referred to as “the flight by wire system”.

explanation: 【译文】This is commonly referred to as the "fly-by-wire" system.【词汇】commonly referred to as=通常称之为，fly-by-wire system=电传操纵系统（固定术语），commonly=通常。【解析】C正确："通常称之为"对应commonly referred to as，"电传操纵系统"对应flight by wire system（即fly-by-wire规范术语），被动称谓句式地道。A术语错误：fly by electrical control system为杜撰表达，电传操纵标准术语是fly-by-wire；named亦不如referred to as规范。B漏译"操纵"（control）要素，fly by electrical system同样是非规范表达，术语残缺。

question: 充过电的电容器就像一个辅助电瓶。

options.A: The charged resister acts as a primary battery.
options.B: The discharged resister acts as a secondary battery.
options.C: The charged capacitor behaves as a secondary battery.

explanation: 【译文】The charged capacitor acts like a secondary battery.【词汇】charged capacitor=充过电的电容器，behaves as/acts as=表现得像/相当于，secondary battery=辅助电瓶（二次/辅助电源）。【解析】C正确："充过电的电容器"对应charged capacitor，"像一个辅助电瓶"对应behaves as a secondary battery，比喻关系准确。A两处错误：capacitor误译为resister（电阻器，且拼写错误应为resistor），secondary误译为primary（主电瓶），辅助变主要。B把charged（充过电的）误译为discharged（放过电的），方向相反；resister同样错译capacitor。

question: 手工工具基本分成四大类：敲击工具、夹持工具、切割工具、扭转工具。

options.A: Hand tools can be divided to four basic categories: kicking tools, holding tools, cutting tools, bending tools.
options.B: Hand tools can be divided to four basic categories:kicking tools, clutching tools, cutting tools, rolling tools.
options.C: Hand tools will fall into four basic categories: pounding tools，holding tools， cutting tools and turning tools.

explanation: 【译文】Hand tools fall into four basic categories: pounding tools, holding tools, cutting tools and turning tools.【词汇】hand tools=手工工具，four basic categories=四大类，pounding tools=敲击工具，holding tools=夹持工具，cutting tools=切割工具，turning tools=扭转工具。【解析】C正确：四类工具pounding/holding/cutting/turning与"敲击、夹持、切割、扭转"一一对应，fall into four categories译"分成四大类"。A两处错误：pounding误译为kicking（踢），turning误译为bending（弯曲），敲击与扭转动作错译。B三处错误：pounding误kicking，holding误clutching，turning误rolling（滚动）。

question: 雷达的用途就是获得、处理和显示图形信息。

options.A: The purpose of radar is to obtain, process and display image information.
options.B: Grasping, processing and displaying grafic information is the function of radom.
options.C: The purpose of radar is to transmit, process and caculate image information.

explanation: 【译文】The purpose of radar is to obtain, process and display graphic information.【词汇】purpose of radar=雷达的用途，obtain=获得，process=处理，display=显示，image/graphic information=图形信息。【解析】A正确："获得、处理和显示"对应obtain, process and display三个并列不定式，"图形信息"对应image information。B多处错误：obtain误译为grasping（抓住），radar误拼为radom（radome雷达罩），graphic误拼为grafic。C把obtain误译为transmit（发射），display误译为caculate（calculate计算，且拼写错误），获取与显示功能全错。

question: 建议改装以下部件，其他部件的使用可以根据在役经验。

options.A: The following components are recommended for alteration. The swap of other components can be made on condition.
options.B: The following parts are recommended to be refurbished. Other parts can be plated according to on wing status.
options.C: The following parts are recommended for modification. Utilization of other parts can be by in-service experience.

explanation: 【译文】The following parts are recommended for modification; the use of other parts may be based on in-service experience.【词汇】following parts=以下部件，recommended for modification=建议改装，utilization of other parts=其他部件的使用，in-service experience=在役经验。【解析】C正确："建议改装"对应recommended for modification，"其他部件的使用可以根据在役经验"对应utilization of other parts can be by in-service experience，两处分句关系准确。A两处错误："使用"误译为swap（交换），"在役经验"误译为on condition（有条件），核心信息全偏。B把modification误译为refurbished（翻新），utilization误译为plated（电镀），in-service experience误译为on wing status（在翼状态），术语连环错。

question: 改版、增补和删除的内容，应在页面外划出一条垂直黑线，与被更改的部分相对应。

options.A: Modifications, additions and omissions, a black line should be drawn vertically at the footer outside of the page parallel to the part of the change.
options.B: Revisions, additions and deletions shall be identified by a vertical black line along the outside of the page opposite only that portion of the printed matter that was changed.
options.C: Alterations, substitutions and eliminates should be marked with a black slash outside the scope of the page to coincide with the section being changed.

explanation: 【译文】Revisions, additions and deletions shall be identified by a vertical black line along the outside of the page opposite only that portion of the printed matter that was changed.【词汇】revisions, additions and deletions=改版、增补和删除，vertical black line=垂直黑线，outside of the page=页面外侧，opposite=与……相对/对应，portion that was changed=被更改的部分。【解析】B正确："划出一条垂直黑线"对应a vertical black line，"与被更改的部分相对应"对应opposite only that portion…that was changed，shall体现规范语气。A多处错误：outside of the page误为at the footer（页脚），opposite误为parallel to（平行于），对应关系错译。C把三个术语误译为alterations/substitutions/eliminates，vertical black line误为black slash（斜线），outside误为outside the scope，连环错译。

question: 有些环境因素在制造商或运营商的控制范围内，例如：电池舱的位置。

options.A: There are some environmental reasons of the manufacturers or operators such as the location of battery compartments.
options.B: Some environmental factors are within the control of the manufacturer or the operator such as the location of battery compartments.
options.C: It is the manufacturer or the operator's environmental factors, such as the location of the battery compartments.

explanation: 【译文】Some environmental factors are within the control of the manufacturer or the operator, such as the location of the battery compartments.【词汇】environmental factors=环境因素，within the control of=在……的控制范围内，manufacturer or operator=制造商或运营商，battery compartments=电池舱。【解析】B正确："在制造商或运营商的控制范围内"对应within the control of the manufacturer or the operator，"例如电池舱的位置"对应such as the location of battery compartments。A两处错误：factors误译为reasons（原因），within the control误为of the manufacturers，控制关系丢失。C句式错误：It is the…environmental factors把"在控制范围内"错译成"是制造商的因素"，所有关系混乱，语法不通。

question: 这个制度并不取代CAP没有包括的正常沟通渠道。

options.A: This system does not include the usual channels of communication available to CAP.
options.B: This system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.
options.C: The usual channels of communication in this system cannot be replaced by the introduction of CAP.

explanation: 【译文】This system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.【词汇】supersede=取代/替代，normal channels of communication=正常沟通渠道，items not covered by the CAP=CAP没有包括的项目。【解析】B正确："并不取代"对应does not supersede，"CAP没有包括的（项目的）正常沟通渠道"完整对应normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP，not covered限定关系准确。A两处错误：supersede误译为include（包括），not covered误译为available to CAP（CAP可用的），取代与涵盖关系全错。C主客体颠倒：usual channels…cannot be replaced by the introduction of CAP把制度不取代渠道错译为渠道不能被CAP引入所取代。

question: 此文件包含了附录G中描述的持续性适航的适当说明。

options.A: This document lists appropriate description of Continuous Airworthiness as indicated in Appendix G.
options.B: This document marks the Appendix G as an appropriate descriptions of Continuous Airworthiness.
options.C: This document contains appropriate instructions for Continued Airworthiness as described in Appendix G.

explanation: 【译文】This document contains appropriate instructions for Continued Airworthiness as described in Appendix G.【词汇】document=文件，contains=包含，appropriate instructions=适当说明，Continued Airworthiness=持续适航（固定术语），as described in Appendix G=如附录G所述。【解析】C正确："包含"对应contains，"持续性适航的适当说明"对应appropriate instructions for Continued Airworthiness，"附录G中描述的"对应as described in Appendix G。A两处错误：contains误译为lists（列出），instructions误译为description（描述），Continuous亦不如Continued贴合术语。B把"包含附录G描述的说明"错译为"把附录G标记为说明"，句子结构完全扭曲。

question: 使用特殊曲柄，顺时针旋转卷筒组件轴，以从卷轴上展开线束组件。

options.A: Use special crank to rotate shaft of reel assembly clockwise to unwind the harness assembly from the spool.
options.B: Use special handle to turn the roller of spool assembly clockwise to wind the harness assembly from the reel.
options.C: Use special crank to rotate the spool of reel assembly clockwise to unfold the harness assembly from the shaft.

explanation: 【译文】Using the special crank, turn the shaft of the reel assembly clockwise to unwind the harness assembly from the spool.【词汇】special crank=特殊曲柄，shaft of reel assembly=卷筒组件轴，clockwise=顺时针，unwind=展开/退绕（wind的反义），harness assembly=线束组件，spool=卷轴/卷筒。【解析】A正确："旋转卷筒组件轴"对应rotate shaft of reel assembly，"从卷轴上展开"对应unwind…from the spool，轴与卷轴的关系及展开方向准确。B多处错误：crank误译为handle（手柄），unwind误译为wind（缠绕），展开变缠绕方向相反；reel与spool的搭配关系也混乱。C把shaft（轴）误译为spool of reel assembly，"从卷轴上展开"误译为unfold…from the shaft，unwind误为unfold，部件关系与动作双错。

question: 如果驾驶舱显示有发动机过热警告，不要给飞机加油。

options.A: Do not fuel the aircraft if the flight deck displays an engine overhead warning.
options.B: Do not refuel the aircraft if an engine overheat warning is displayed on the flight deck.
options.C: Do not replenish the aircraft if the flight deck displays an engine overheat warning.

explanation: 【译文】Do not refuel the aircraft if an engine overheat warning is displayed on the flight deck.【词汇】refuel=给……加油（re-前缀），engine overheat warning=发动机过热警告，displayed on the flight deck=显示在驾驶舱（上）。【解析】B正确："不要给飞机加油"对应Do not refuel the aircraft，"驾驶舱显示有发动机过热警告"对应an engine overheat warning is displayed on the flight deck，条件关系准确。A两处错误：refuel简化为fuel尚可，但overheat（过热）误译为overhead（头顶的），警告性质错译。C把refuel误译为replenish（补充/补给），加油专用动词丢失，且被动词序不如B清楚。

question: 确保飞控舵面的行程范围是无障碍物的。

options.A: Make sure that the movement limits of the flight control surfaces are free.
options.B: Make sure that the travel ranges of the flight control surfaces are clear.
options.C: Make sure that the travel limits of the flight control rudders are clean.

explanation: 【译文】确保飞控舵面的行程范围内无障碍物。【词汇】travel range=行程范围，flight control surface=飞控舵面，clear=无障碍的（指无阻挡、无杂物，区别于free“自由”和clean“清洁”）。【解析】B正确：“travel ranges”对应“行程范围”，“are clear”对应“无障碍物”，舵面译surfaces准确。A两处错误：“movement limits”指运动限位值而非行程范围，“free”意为自由而非无障碍，词义错译。C两处错误：把surfaces误译为rudders（方向舵仅为舵面一种，范围缩小），把clear误译为clean（清洁），均属词义错译。

question: 每根线由文本和数字组成的编码来识别，由2位字母后跟2位数字构成。

options.A: Each wire is comprised by an alphabetical code following 2 alpha digits and 2 numerical digits.
options.B: Each wire is identified by an alphanumerical code comprising 2 alpha digits followed by 2 numerical digits.
options.C: Each wire consists of an alphanumerical code following 2 alpha digits and 2 numerical digits.

explanation: 【译文】每根导线由一个字母数字编码识别，该编码由2位字母后跟2位数字构成。【词汇】identify=识别，alphanumerical code=字母数字编码，comprise=由……构成，followed by=后跟。【解析】B正确：“identified by”对应“由……识别”，“code comprising 2 alpha digits followed by 2 numerical digits”完整表达编码构成顺序。A两处错误：“is comprised by”搭配错误（应为is composed of），且following置于句尾使“字母后跟数字”的逻辑关系颠倒。C把“识别”误作“consists of”（由……组成），混淆了wire与code的主从关系，属结构错译。

question: 在燃油加放油的过程中，不允许进行氧气勤务。

options.A: Filling with oxygen is not permitted during defueling and refueling.
options.B: Servicing with oxygen is not allowed during refueling and defueling.
options.C: Servicing with oxygen is not prohibited during fueling and defueling.

explanation: 【译文】在燃油加油和放油的过程中，不允许进行氧气勤务。【词汇】service with oxygen=氧气勤务，not allowed=不允许，refueling and defueling=加油和放油，permit=允许。【解析】B正确：“Servicing”对应“勤务”，“not allowed”对应“不允许”，加放油列举顺序无碍原意。A把“勤务”误译为“Filling”（加注），氧气勤务是维护作业而非加注氧气，词义错译。C方向相反：“not prohibited”（不禁止=允许）与“不允许”含义相反，且fueling仅指加油、漏掉放油，属方向相反加漏译。

question: 根据制造商的选择，静压系统的描述和讨论可以结合第7.49段的皮托管压力系统。

options.A: At the manufacturer's option, static pressure systems description and discussion may be combined with Paragraph 7.49, Pitot Pressure Systems.
options.B: The manufacturer could combine the description and discussion of the dynamic pressure systems in Paragraph 7.49, Pitot Pressure Systems.
options.C: The manufacturer decides to insert static pressure systems description and discussion into Paragraph 7.49, Pitot Pressure Systems.

explanation: 【译文】根据制造商的选择，静压系统的描述和讨论可以与第7.49段“皮托管压力系统”合并。【词汇】at the manufacturer's option=根据制造商的选择，static pressure system=静压系统，may be combined with=可以合并。【解析】A正确：选项、静压、合并、段落号四要素全对。B两处错误：static误译dynamic（动压），张冠李戴；漏译“at the manufacturer's option”前提。C两处错误：“decides to insert”把“可以合并”误作“决定插入”，同漏前提。

question: 一些服务报告被用于选择在应用、设计和加载方面类似的项目来做检查。

options.A: Some service reports were used to select items that are similar in application design and downloading to do the check.
options.B: Some sevice reports are used to select items that are similar in application, design and loading to do the inspection.
options.C: In order to do the inspection, some service reports used to choose programs similar in apply, design and loading.

explanation: 【译文】一些服务报告被用来选择在应用、设计和加载方面类似的项目进行检查。【词汇】service report=服务报告，be used to select=被用于选择，loading=加载/载荷，inspection=检查。【解析】B正确：“reports are used to select items”与“application, design and loading”均对应（sevice为service小疵）。A一处错误：loading误译downloading（下载），词义错译。C多处错误：“programs”误译items，“in apply”词性错误，“used to choose”语法不通。

question: 很难确定腐蚀的影响，但是如果收到持续适航大纲检查报告，检查时间将根据任何严重的问题进行调整。

options.A: It is very difficult to determine the effects of corrosion but, as the reports from the CAP inspections are received, the inspection times will be adjusted for any severe problems.
options.B: It is not easy to decide the affection of corrosion, when the reports from the CAP inspections are received, the inspection duration will be changed for any serious problems.
options.C: It is very hard to make the decision of the corrosion effects but, if the reports from the CAP inspections are obtained, the inspection times will be arranged in accordance with the severest problem.

explanation: 【译文】很难确定腐蚀的影响，但随着持续适航大纲（CAP）检查报告的收到，检查时间将根据任何严重问题调整。【词汇】effects of corrosion=腐蚀的影响，CAP=持续适航大纲，inspection times=检查时间，severe problems=严重问题。【解析】A正确：“as the reports…are received”表达报告陆续收到，“adjusted for”对应“根据……调整”。B两处错误：“affection”（喜爱）误译“影响”（effects），“duration”不及times对应“检查时间”。C两处错误：“the severest problem”把“任何严重问题”误作“最严重问题”（范围错误），“arranged”误译“调整”。

question: 你可以从ABC的经销商或工厂的客户服务代表那里获得适当的表格副本和需要填写的条目的说明。

options.A: Copies of the appropriate forms and a description of the entries to be completed are available to you from an ABC dealer or Factory Customer Service Representative.
options.B: Copies of the proper forms and a description of the items to be completed are available to you from an ABC trader or Production Customer Service Representative.
options.C: The ABC trader or Production Customer Service Representative could provide the proper form copies and the description of the items to be accomplished available.

explanation: 【译文】你可以从ABC经销商或工厂客户服务代表处获得适当表格副本及需填写条目的说明。【词汇】appropriate forms=适当表格，entries to be completed=需填写的条目，dealer=经销商，Customer Service Representative=客户服务代表。【解析】A正确：entries、dealer、Factory Representative与“are available”均对应。B两处错误：dealer误译trader（贸易商），Factory误译Production，张冠李戴。C两处错误：trader/Production同误，“could provide…available”句式杂糅。

question: 对于词汇表，只有主要的变化被突出显示，对各种已批准和未批准的示例的微小更改没有突出显示。

options.A: For vocabulary, only main alternation are highlighted, minor alternations to many approved and not approved examples are not highlighted.
options.B: For wordlist, only major changes are highlighted, minor changes to various approved and not approved examples are not highlighted.
options.C: For vocabulary, only main alternation are prominent, minor alternations to many approved and not approved examples are not prominent.

explanation: 【译文】对于词汇表，只有主要更改被突出显示；对各种已批准和未批准示例的微小更改不予突出显示。【词汇】wordlist=词汇表，major changes=主要更改，highlight=突出显示，minor changes=微小更改。【解析】B正确：“major/minor changes”与“highlighted”均对应。A两处错误：“alternation”（交替）误译“更改”，“main alternation are”主谓不一致。C两处错误：同用alternation，“prominent”（显著的）未表达“被突出显示”的被动。

question: 缓慢地把RAT完全放出，并确保它不接触其他部件。

options.A: Slowly and fully extend the RAT and make sure that it does not touch other parts.
options.B: Quickly and fully retract the RAT and make sure that it does not touch other parts.
options.C: Slowly and carefully extend the RAT and make sure that it does not attach to other parts.

explanation: 【译文】缓慢地将RAT完全放出，并确保它不接触其他部件。【词汇】RAT=冲压空气涡轮（Ram Air Turbine），extend=放出/展开（对应retract收上），fully=完全地，touch=接触。【解析】A正确：“slowly and fully extend”对应“缓慢完全放出”，“does not touch”对应“不接触”。B两处错误：“quickly”与“缓慢”相反，“retract”（收上）与“放出”方向相反，RAT指令中方向至关重要。C两处错误：把fully误译为carefully（小心地），漏译“完全”；把touch误译为attach to（附着于），词义错译。

question: 如果划痕没穿透保护层，这个装置是可使用的。

options.A: If the scratch does not go through the protective layer, the unit is serviceable.
options.B: If the nick does not go through the primary surface, the unit is serviceable.
options.C: If the scratch does not go through the protective surface, the unit is movable.

explanation: 【译文】如果划痕没有穿透保护层，该装置是可使用的。【词汇】scratch=划痕，go through=穿透，protective layer=保护层，serviceable=可使用的/可继续服役的。【解析】A正确：scratch、go through、protective layer、serviceable四处考点全部对应。B两处错误：把scratch误译为nick（缺口/刻痕，近义词干扰），把protective layer误译为primary surface（主要表面），术语与部位均错。C两处错误：把layer误译为surface，把serviceable误译为movable（可移动的），“可使用”与“可移动”含义完全不同，词义错译。

question: 确保液压油箱内的液压油高于最低液面。

options.A: Make sure that the oil in the hydraulic tank is above the minimum lever.
options.B: Make sure that the fluid in the hydraulic reservoir is above the minimum level.
options.C: Make sure that the fluid in the fuel reservoir is below the maximum level.

explanation: 【译文】确保液压油箱内的液压油高于最低液面。【词汇】hydraulic reservoir=液压油箱，fluid=液压油/油液，above the minimum level=高于最低液面，tank=油箱。【解析】B正确：reservoir、fluid、above、minimum level四处考点均对应。A两处错误：“lever”（操纵杆）为level的误拼/误用，“oil in the hydraulic tank”虽可理解但术语不如fluid/reservoir规范。C三处错误：把hydraulic误译为fuel（燃油），把above误译为below，把minimum误译为maximum，后两处均为方向相反错误。

question: 修订意味着对现有手册中的信息进行修改。

options.A: A version means modifying the information in the existing manual.
options.B: A revise explains correcting information in an old manual.
options.C: A revision means a modification of information in an existing manual.

explanation: 【译文】修订是指对现有手册中的信息进行修改。【词汇】revision=修订（名词），means=意味着/是指，modification=修改，existing manual=现有手册。【解析】C正确：revision、modification、existing manual三个考点全部对应，系表结构准确。A一处关键错误：“version”（版本）误译“修订”（revision），概念张冠李戴。B两处错误：“revise”是动词不能作主语（语法错误），“old manual”误译“现有手册”（existing≠old），且“explains correcting”动宾搭配不当。

question: 逆时针转动旋钮，以降低光的强度。

options.A: Turn the knob clockwise to decrease the intensity of the light.
options.B: Turn the knob counterclockwise to decrease the intensity of the light.
options.C: In order to turn the knob clockwise, decrease the intensity of the light.

explanation: 【译文】逆时针转动旋钮，以降低光的强度。【词汇】counterclockwise=逆时针（clockwise为顺时针），turn the knob=转动旋钮，decrease=降低，intensity of the light=光强。【解析】B正确：counterclockwise与decrease两个考点全对，“to decrease”正确表达目的关系。A方向相反：把逆时针误译为clockwise（顺时针），操作方向完全相反。C两处错误：同样误用clockwise，且“In order to turn the knob”把目的关系颠倒成“为了转动旋钮而降低光强”，逻辑倒置。

question: 请勿更换电池。只有经批准的服务提供商才能更换。

options.A: You can not remove the battery. Only an approved service provider can replace it.
options.B: Do not replace the battery. Only an approved service provider can replace it.
options.C: Do not replace the battery. Only an approval of a service provider can replace it.

explanation: 【译文】请勿更换电池。只有经批准的服务提供商才能更换。【词汇】replace=更换，remove=拆卸，approved service provider=经批准的服务提供商，only…can=只有……才能。【解析】B正确：“Do not replace”对应“请勿更换”，前后两句replace一致。A一处关键错误：第一句把replace误译为remove（拆卸），导致“不能拆卸”与后句“才能更换”逻辑矛盾。C一处关键错误：“an approval of a service provider”（对服务商的批准）把“经批准的服务商”误作“批准”本身，主语无法执行replace动作，语法与语义均错。

question: 所有页面上必须有制造商的报头，出版物标题，飞机型号，发行或修订日期

options.A: The manufacturer's marks, publication title, airplane model, and issue or revision date must shown on all pages.
options.B: The manufacturer's headline, publication title, airplane model, and issue or revision date must print on all pages.
options.C: The manufacturer's masthead, publication title, airplane model, and issue or revision date must appear on all pages.

explanation: 【译文】所有页面上必须出现制造商的刊头、出版物标题、飞机型号以及发行或修订日期。【词汇】masthead=刊头/报头（出版物标识栏），publication title=出版物标题，issue or revision date=发行或修订日期，appear=出现/显示。【解析】C正确：masthead为“刊头”标准译法，“must appear”语法语义均对。A两处错误：“marks”（标记）不如masthead准确，“must shown”缺be动词（语法错误）。B两处错误：“headline”（标题/头条）误译刊头，“must print”同样缺be动词且主动语态不当。

question: 将所有装有不同金属螺套或有较深盲孔的金属零件在烤箱中干燥至少一小时，烤箱温度为225到275华氏度(107 to 135°C)。

options.A: Dry all metal parts that have different metal inserts or deep blind holes in an oven at 225 to 275°F (107 to 135°C) for a minimum of one hour.
options.B: Put all different metal inserts or deep blind holes metal parts in an oven at 225 to 275°F (107 to 135°C) for a maximum of one hour.
options.C: All metal parts that have different metal inserts or deep blind holes are dry in an oven of 225 to 275°F (107 to 135°C) for a minimum of one hour.

explanation: 【译文】将所有带有异种金属衬套或较深盲孔的金属零件放入烤箱，在225至275°F（107至135°C）下干燥至少一小时。【词汇】metal insert=金属螺套/嵌件，blind hole=盲孔，dry in an oven=在烤箱中干燥，a minimum of=至少。【解析】A正确：定语从句限定零件范围，“minimum of one hour”对应“至少一小时”。B两处错误：minimum误译maximum（方向相反），定语堆叠结构混乱。C两处错误：“are dry”被动语法错误，祈使句误作陈述句。

question: 正确的标点符号是很重要的，因为它显示了文本的不同部分是如何相互关联的，并防止了歧义。

options.A: Correct punctuation is important because it shows that the different parts of the text are reconnected and prevents miscomprehension.
options.B: Correct punctuation is important because it shows how the different parts of the text are independent and prevents accumulation.
options.C: Correct punctuation is important because it shows how the different parts of the text are related and prevents ambiguity.

explanation: 【译文】正确的标点符号很重要，因为它显示文本的不同部分如何相互关联，并防止歧义。【词汇】punctuation=标点符号，be related=相互关联，prevent=防止，ambiguity=歧义。【解析】C正确：“how the different parts…are related”对应“如何相互关联”，“prevents ambiguity”对应“防止歧义”。A两处错误：“that…are reconnected”把“如何关联”误作“被重新连接”（词义与句式错译），“miscomprehension”（误解）不及ambiguity对应“歧义”。B两处错误：“independent”（相互独立）与“相互关联”方向相反，“accumulation”（积累）误译“歧义”，词义错译。

question: 组件损坏严重，修理费用超过总价的60%，车间建议报废。

options.A: The component was damaged badly, the repairing cost is over 60% of the total price. The workshop suggests reporting as an unserviceable part.
options.B: The component was damaged heavily; the repairing cost is over 60% of the total price. The workshop suggests scrapping.
options.C: The component was destroyed heavily; the repairing cost is  60% of the total price. The workshop suggests segregation.

explanation: 【译文】该组件损坏严重，修理费用超过总价的60%，车间建议报废。【词汇】damaged heavily/badly=损坏严重，repairing cost=修理费用，over 60% of the total price=超过总价的60%，scrap=报废。【解析】B正确：“suggests scrapping”直接对应“建议报废”，“over 60%”未漏译。A一处关键错误：“reporting as an unserviceable part”（报告为不可用件）不等于报废，报废是拆解废弃，词义错译。C三处错误：“destroyed”（被毁）程度过重，漏译over使“60%”变成整价（漏译要素），“segregation”（隔离）误译“报废”。

question: 确保氧气管是完全清洁的。氧气和滑油或油脂聚在一起会形成爆炸性混合物。爆炸会造成人员伤亡。

options.A: Ensure the oxygen tubes are completely clear. If oxygen is mixed with oil or compound together, it will form an explosives. Explosion can cause damage to equipment or injury to personnel.
options.B: Make sure that the oxygen tubes are fully clean. Oxygen and oil or grease make an explosive mixture. An explosion can cause injury or death to personnel.
options.C: Guarantee the oxygen tubes are completely free of dirts. Oxygen, oil and  grease can combine to form an explosive oxides. Explosions can cause casualties.

explanation: 【译文】确保氧气管完全清洁。氧气与滑油或油脂混合会形成爆炸性混合物。爆炸会造成人员伤亡。【词汇】oxygen tube=氧气管，grease=油脂，explosive mixture=爆炸性混合物，injury or death=伤亡。【解析】B正确：“fully clean”“explosive mixture”“injury or death”均对应。A三处错误：grease误译compound（化合物），“an explosives”语法错误，“damage to equipment”为增译。C两处错误：“explosive oxides”误译“混合物”，“dirts”用法错误。

question: 制造商可以省略对该产品不适用的系统/章节，或者在可行的情况下合并系统/章节。

options.A: Systems/Chapters that are not applicable to the product by the manufacturers may be omitted or, where possible, omitted.
options.B: Manufacturers may omit Systems/Chapters that do not apply to the product, or omit such Systems/Chapters where feasible.
options.C: Manufacturers may omit System/Chapters that are not applicable to the product or combine System/Chapters where it is feasible.

explanation: 【译文】制造商可以省略对该产品不适用的系统/章节，或在可行的情况下合并系统/章节。【词汇】omit=省略，not applicable to=对……不适用，combine=合并，where it is feasible=在可行的情况下。【解析】C正确：omit与combine两个动作分列，“where it is feasible”对应“可行的情况下”。A一处关键错误：后半“where possible, omitted”重复“省略”，把combine误作omit（漏译要素）。B一处关键错误：同样用“omit…where feasible”收尾，combine整词漏译，合并信息完全缺失。

question: 用于感应和指示过热、烟雾或火灾情况的检测系统，如果被制造商指定为标准设备配置，则是消防系统的一部分。

options.A: Detection is that portion of the fire protection system which is used to sense and indicate the presence of overheat, smoke, or fire, if furnished as manufacturer-designated standard equipment.
options.B: If specified as standard equipment by the manufacturer, such equipment is that portion of the fire protection system. Detection equipment includes systems for transmitting and indicating conditions of overheating, smoke or fire.
options.C: If the equipment is part of a fire protection system and is designated as standard equipment by the manufacturer, the detection equipment includes the sensing and indication of overheat, smoke or fire.

explanation: 【译文】探测系统是消防系统中用于感应和指示过热、烟雾或火情存在的部分——条件是作为制造商指定的标准设备提供。【词汇】detection=探测系统，sense and indicate=感应和指示，overheat/smoke/fire=过热/烟雾/火情。【解析】A正确：“that portion of the fire protection system”定义句式对应“消防系统一部分”，if条件恰当。B两处错误：“transmitting”误译“感应”（sense），结构拆散。C错误：“属于消防系统”与“标准设备”被并列化，includes与used to结构不符。

question: 设备冷却系统通过主设备中心和驾驶舱的设备散热。

options.A: The equipment refrigeration system exchanges the key equipment cabinets and the equipment in the compartment.
options.B: The equipment cooling system removes heat from the equipment in the main equipment center and the flight compartment.
options.C: The equipment exchange system removes heat from the lower equipment center and the aft cargo compartment.

explanation: 【译文】设备冷却系统将主设备中心和驾驶舱内设备的热量带走。【词汇】equipment cooling system=设备冷却系统，remove heat from=散热，main equipment center=主设备中心，flight compartment=驾驶舱。【解析】B正确：cooling system、removes heat、两处地点均对应。A两处错误：“refrigeration”（制冷）误译“冷却”，“exchanges”误译“散热”。C多处错误：“exchange system”误译冷却系统，“lower equipment center”“aft cargo compartment”地点张冠李戴。

question: 任何异常均应通过情况报告系统向ABC报告，以便在必要时对CAP进行补充和/或修订。

options.A: Any anomaly should be reported to ABC, through the Condition Reporting System, so that additions and/or revisions can be made to the CAP where deemed necessary.
options.B: Report any abnormality to ABC by the Condition Reporting System to verify supplement and/or revisions needed as necessary to the CAP.
options.C: ABC shall receive the anomalies report from the Condition Reporting System for CAP to add and/or revise as necessary.

explanation: 【译文】任何异常都应通过情况报告系统报告给ABC，以便在认为必要时对CAP进行补充和/或修订。【词汇】anomaly=异常，Condition Reporting System=情况报告系统，additions and/or revisions=补充和/或修订。【解析】A正确：“should be reported”对应“均应报告”，“so that…can be made”表达目的。B两处错误：“verify supplement needed”把“进行补充修订”误作“核实所需修订”，主句被动缺失。C错误：“ABC shall receive”改变报告主体，“for CAP to add”语法不通，漏译“必要时”。

question: 如需更改维修方案，应获得设计部门的批准。

options.A: Get the approval of the design authority,whatever it is necessary to change the repair scheme.
options.B: Change the repair scheme, until getting the approval of the design authority.
options.C: If it is necessary to change the repair scheme, get the approval of the design authority.

explanation: 【译文】如需更改维修方案，应获得设计部门的批准。【词汇】if it is necessary=如有必要，repair scheme=维修方案，design authority=设计部门/设计批准机构，get the approval=获得批准。【解析】C正确：if条件句对应“如需”，“get the approval of”对应“获得……批准”，条件与动作顺序正确。A一处关键错误：“whatever it is necessary”（无论是否必要）误译条件句，把“如需”改成让步且语法不通。B方向相反：“until getting the approval”表达“更改直到获批为止”，把“先批准后更改”译成“边更改边等批准”，逻辑相反。

question: 当交互供油系统打开时，一个燃油泵可以向两台发动机供油。

options.A: When the crossfeed system is open, it is possible for one fuel pump to supply fuel to the two engines.
options.B: When the supplying system is open, it is possible for one fuel pump to supply fuel to the two engines.
options.C: One fuel pump can supply fuel to two engines,as the supplying system is open.

explanation: 【译文】当交互供油系统打开时，一台燃油泵可以向两台发动机供油。【词汇】crossfeed system=交互供油系统/交输系统，fuel pump=燃油泵，supply fuel to=向……供油，is open=（系统/活门）打开。【解析】A正确：crossfeed为“交互供油”标准术语，“it is possible for one fuel pump to supply”对应“一个燃油泵可以供油”。B一处关键错误：“supplying system”（供油系统）误译“交互供油系统”，丢失crossfeed核心术语。C两处错误：同样误作supplying system，且用as引导原因状语，把“当……时”误作“因为”，逻辑关系改变。

question: 两台发动机泵的吸入管路中有电动阀。

options.A: There are electrically-operated valves in the ejection lines to the two engine pumps.
options.B: There are electronic-operated valves in the ejection lines to the two engine pumps.
options.C: There are electrically-operated valves in the suction lines to the two engine pumps.

explanation: 【译文】两台发动机泵的吸入管路中装有电动阀。【词汇】electrically-operated valve=电动阀，suction line=吸入管路，engine pump=发动机泵，there are=有/装有。【解析】C正确：electrically-operated与suction lines两个核心考点全对。A一处关键错误：把suction（吸入）误译为ejection（排出/喷射），油路方向相反。B两处错误：同样误用ejection lines，且把electrically（电动的）误译为electronic（电子的），电动与电子概念不同，术语错译。

question: 每个门的结构接口处都有柔性密封件，可保护金属接口免受气流的损坏。

options.A: Each door has flexible seals at its structure interface which protect the metal interfaces from damage by the airflow.
options.B: Each door has flexible seals at its structure interface which protect the metal interfaces from no damage by the airflow.
options.C: Each door has formalist seals at its structure interface which protect the metal interfaces from damage by the airflow.

explanation: 【译文】每个舱门的结构接口处都装有柔性密封件，可保护金属接口免受气流损伤。【词汇】flexible seal=柔性密封件，structure interface=结构接口，protect…from damage=保护……免受损伤，airflow=气流。【解析】A正确：flexible seals、structure interface、protect from damage by the airflow全部对应。B一处关键错误：“from no damage”多出否定词no，变成“免受无损伤之害”，语法与逻辑双重错误。C一处关键错误：“formalist seals”（形式主义的密封件）误译“柔性密封件”（flexible），词义错译。

question: 飞机导航系统向机组人员提供飞行所需的数据，并满足最适当的安全要求。

options.A: The aircraft navigation systems provide the flight which is required by the crew,and meet the the most provisionally safety requirements.
options.B: The aircraft navigation systems provide the flight which is required by the crew,and meet the the most appropriate safety requirements.
options.C: The aircraft navigation systems provide the crew with the data required for flight within the most appropriate safety requirements.

explanation: 【译文】飞机导航系统向机组人员提供飞行所需的数据，并满足最恰当的安全要求。【词汇】provide sb with sth=向某人提供某物，data required for flight=飞行所需的数据，appropriate=恰当的。【解析】C正确：“provide the crew with the data required for flight”准确表达“向机组提供数据”。A两处错误：“provide the flight”把“提供数据”误作“提供飞行”（张冠李戴），“the the”重复且“provisionally”误译“适当”。B同样flight/data张冠李戴并有“the the”语法错误。

question: 如果过滤器在异常短的时间后堵塞，将它们送到实验室进行污染分析。

options.A: If the filters become clogged after an unusually short time, send them to the laboratory for analysis of the contamination.
options.B: When the filters become clogged in an abnormal short time, send them to the library to analyze the contamination.
options.C: When the filters become blocked unconventionally after a very short time , send them to the lab for calculation of the contamination.

explanation: 【译文】如果过滤器在异常短的时间内堵塞，应将其送实验室进行污染分析。【词汇】filter=过滤器，become clogged=堵塞，unusually short time=异常短的时间，laboratory=实验室。【解析】A正确：clogged、laboratory、analysis三考点全对。B两处错误：“in an abnormal short time”语序不当，laboratory误译library（图书馆）。C三处错误：“blocked unconventionally”不自然且漏“短时间”，“calculation”误译analysis。

question: 面板边缘与隔板之间的距离不得大于0.05 mm。

options.A: The maximum distance between the plate edge and the frame is inferior to 0.05 mm.
options.B: The clearance between the boundary of the panel and the bay can not exceed 0.05 mm.
options.C: The distance between the edge of the panel and the partition must not be more than 0.05 mm.

explanation: 【译文】面板边缘与隔板之间的距离不得大于0.05 mm。【词汇】edge of the panel=面板边缘，partition=隔板，distance=距离，must not be more than=不得大于。【解析】C正确：“the edge of the panel and the partition”两个部位准确，“must not be more than”对应“不得大于”。A两处错误：“plate”（平板）误译“面板”（panel），“inferior to”（劣于/低于）误译“不得大于”，比较关系表达错误。B三处偏差：“boundary”（边界）不如edge准确，“bay”（舱间/隔舱）误译“隔板”（partition），clearance可用但整体术语偏差大。

question: 当通风空气温度升至27℃时，排气阀打开。

options.A: When the temperature of vent rises to 27℃, the exhaust pipe opens.
options.B: When the ventilation temperature is above 27℃, the drain mast opens.
options.C: When the temperature of the ventilation air increases to 27 °c, the discharge valve opens.

explanation: 【译文】当通风空气温度升至27°C时，排气阀打开。【词汇】ventilation air=通风空气，increase to=升至，discharge valve=排气阀。【解析】C正确：“temperature of the ventilation air”“discharge valve”均对应（°c小写为小疵）。A两处错误：“temperature of vent”误译“通风空气温度”，“exhaust pipe”误译“排气阀”。B三处错误：“is above”与“升至”不符，“drain mast”误译“排气阀”，漏译“空气”。

question: 操作调光器电门，确保光强发生变化。

options.A: Operate the dimmer switch and make sure that the intensity of the light changes.
options.B: Control the light knob to ensure that the light strength changes.
options.C: Turn the light regulator on to adjust the luminous intensity.

explanation: 【译文】操作调光器电门，确保光强发生变化。【词汇】dimmer switch=调光器电门，operate=操作，make sure=确保，intensity changes=光强变化。【解析】A正确：dimmer switch与intensity changes两考点全对。B两处错误：“light knob”误译“调光器电门”（术语错误），“light strength”不及intensity。C两处错误：“adjust”把“确保变化”误作“调节光强”，动作错译且漏译“确保”。

question: 当输入杆在5毫米到10毫米之间时，测量活塞的伸长。

options.A: When the movement of input rod is ranged from 5 to 10 mm, measure the piston retraction.
options.B: When the input lever is between 5 and 10 mm, measure the piston extension.
options.C: When the interval of input shaft changes between 5 and 10 mm,  measure the expansion of the piston.

explanation: 【译文】当输入杆处于5至10毫米之间时，测量活塞的伸长量。【词汇】input lever/rod=输入杆，between 5 and 10 mm=在5-10毫米之间，piston extension=活塞伸长。【解析】B正确：输入杆与extension两考点全对。A一处错误：“retraction”（收进）与“伸长”方向相反。C两处错误：“input shaft”误译“输入杆”，“expansion”（膨胀）误译“伸长”（extension），术语不准。

question: 在高压电环境下工作时，请遵守安全注意事项。

options.A: Obey the safety precautions when you do work with high voltages.
options.B: Obey the safety warnings when you do work with high impedance.
options.C: Obey the safety cautions when you do work with high capacitance.

explanation: 【译文】在高压电环境下工作时，请遵守安全注意事项。【词汇】safety precaution=安全注意事项，high voltage=高压电，do work with=在……环境下工作，obey=遵守。【解析】A正确：precautions与high voltages两个考点全对。B两处错误：“warnings”（警告）与“注意事项”（precautions）层级不同，“high impedance”（高阻抗）误译“高压电”，物理量张冠李戴。C两处错误：“cautions”（警示语）不及precautions对应“注意事项”，“high capacitance”（高电容）误译“高压电”，物理量错译。

question: 用软布对表面抛光，直到它变得有光泽。

options.A: Grind the surface with a soft cloth after it becomes light.
options.B: Rub the surface with a soft cloth when it becomes brightness.
options.C: Polish the surface with a soft cloth until it becomes shiny.

explanation: 【译文】用软布抛光表面，直到它变得有光泽。【词汇】polish=抛光，soft cloth=软布，until=直到，shiny=有光泽的。【解析】C正确：polish、until、shiny三个考点全对，时间与目的关系准确。A两处错误：“grind”（磨削）误译“抛光”（polish），“after”（在……之后）误译“until”（直到），逻辑关系错误且light不及shiny对应“有光泽”。B两处错误：“rub”（擦拭）不如polish准确，“when it becomes brightness”语法错误（名词brightness不能作表语形容词），when亦误译until。

question: STE句子使用被批准的单词，以不同的方式清楚地给出相同的信息。

options.A: The STE sentence uses approved words to give the same information clearly in a different way.
options.B: The STE sentences use the approved different words to vaguely show the same information.
