options.C: STE sentences use different words in approved means to obviously express the same information.

explanation: 【译文】STE句子使用经批准的单词，以不同的方式清楚地给出相同的信息。【词汇】approved words=经批准的单词，in a different way=以不同的方式，clearly=清楚地。【解析】A正确：approved words、same information、clearly、different way均对应。B两处错误：“approved different words”修饰错位，“vaguely”（含糊地）与“清楚地”方向相反。C两处错误：“approved means”语序错误，“obviously”误译clearly。

question: 确保油箱里的燃油不超过500升。

options.A: Make sure that the quality of fuel in the reservoir is not more than 500 liters.
options.B: Make sure that the quantity of fuel in the tank is not more than 500 liters.
options.C: Make sure that the quality of oil in the tank is not more than 500 liters.

explanation: 【译文】确保油箱中的燃油量不超过500升。【词汇】quantity=数量（quality为质量，形近易混），fuel=燃油，tank=油箱，not more than=不超过。【解析】B正确：“quantity of fuel”对应“燃油量”，“tank”对应“油箱”，not more than对应“不超过”。A两处错误：“quality”（质量）误译“quantity”（数量），“reservoir”不如tank对应油箱。C三处错误：quality同误，且把fuel（燃油）误译为oil（滑油），两处词义错译叠加。

question: 如需变更维修方案，须经设计部门批准。

options.A: If the repair scheme must be changed, the approval of the design authority is hardly got.
options.B: If the design authority need change the repair scheme, it can get the approval.
options.C: If it is necessary to change the repair scheme, get the approval of the design authority.

explanation: 【译文】如需变更维修方案，必须获得设计部门的批准。【词汇】repair scheme=维修方案，design authority=设计部门/设计批准当局，if it is necessary=如有必要，get the approval=获得批准。【解析】C正确：条件从句与“获得批准”的动作关系与原文一致（与2738题同义，译文亦同）。A一处关键错误：“the approval…is hardly got”（批准几乎得不到）与“须经批准”含义相反，hardly误用致方向相反。B两处错误：把“需要变更方案”的主体换成design authority（张冠李戴），“it can get the approval”逻辑混乱。

question: 该规范的目的是为了将通用航空飞机所有者和运营人以及维修人员的成本降到最低。

options.A: The specification is designed to cut off the cost to general aviation airplane owners and operators and maintenance personnel.
options.B: The target of the specification is to reduce the cost of general aviation airplane owners and operators and maintenance personnel.
options.C: The objective of the specification is to minimize the cost to general aviation airplane owners and operators and maintenance personnel.

explanation: 【译文】本规范的目的是将通用航空飞机所有者和运营人以及维修人员的成本降至最低。【词汇】objective=目的，minimize=降到最低，general aviation=通用航空，owners and operators=所有者和运营人。【解析】C正确：“objective…minimize the cost to”完整对应。A一处错误：“cut off”（切断）误译minimize，词义错译。B两处偏差：“reduce”弱于“降到最低”，“cost of…personnel”介词不当。

question: 纵桁和上翼面蒙皮构成通风通道。通风通道在中央油箱内有排放浮子活门。

options.A: Stringers and the upper wing skin are called vent channels. The vent channels go through drain float valves in the center tank.
options.B: Stringers and the upper wing skin are compose of the vent channels. The vent channels got exhaust float valves from the center tank.
options.C: Stringers and the upper wing skin make the vent channels. The vent channels have drain float valves in the center tank.

explanation: 【译文】纵桁和上翼面蒙皮构成通风通道。通风通道在中央油箱内设有排放浮子活门。【词汇】stringer=纵桁，upper wing skin=上翼面蒙皮，vent channel=通风通道，drain float valve=排放浮子活门。【解析】C正确：“make the vent channels”表“构成”，“have drain float valves”对应“有活门”。A两处错误：“are called”误译“构成”，“go through”误译“有”。B两处错误：“are compose of”语法错误，“exhaust float valves”不准。

question: 当燃油油面低于活门时，通风导管内的排放浮子活门和通风通道使通风系统内的燃油排放到油箱。

options.A: The drain float valves in the vent tubes and the vent channels dilute the fuel in the vent system to drain out of the tank when the fuel face is lower than the valve.
options.B: The drain float valves in the vent tubes and the vent channels permit fuel in the vent system to drain into the tank when the fuel level is lower than the valve.
options.C: The drain float valves in the vent tubes and from the vent channels allow the fuel in the vent system to drain into the tank when the fuel quantity is lower than the valve.

explanation: 【译文】当燃油油面低于活门时，通风导管的排放浮子活门和通风通道允许通风系统内的燃油排入油箱。【词汇】drain float valve=排放浮子活门，fuel level=燃油油面，drain into=排入。【解析】B正确：“permit fuel…to drain into the tank”对应“排入油箱”，“fuel level”对应“油面”。A两处错误：“dilute”（稀释）误译，“drain out of”与“排入”方向相反。C两处错误：“from the vent channels”介词错误，“fuel quantity”误译“油面”。

question: 正常操作时,确保释压活门关闭。释压活门打开表示燃油通气系统出现问题。

options.A: For normal operations, make sure the pressure relief valve is closed. An open pressure relief valve is a symptom of a problem in the fuel vent system.
options.B: For normal operations, make sure the shutoff relief valve works. If you open pressure relief valve, that indicates a problem in the fuel vent system.
options.C: For normal operations, make sure you close the pressure relief valve. If you leave it open, a problem will be shown in the fuel vent system.

explanation: 【译文】正常操作时，确保释压活门关闭。释压活门打开是燃油通气系统问题的征兆。【词汇】pressure relief valve=释压活门，symptom=征兆，fuel vent system=燃油通气系统。【解析】A正确：“is closed”对应“应关闭”，“a symptom of a problem”对应“表示问题”。B两处错误：“shutoff relief valve works”误译“释压活门关闭”，“If you open”误作操作指令。C两处错误：“make sure you close”混淆状态与动作，“shown”不及symptom。

question: 当油箱内正压或负压力过大时释压活门可防止机翼结构损坏。

options.A: When there are too many positive or subtractive pressure in the fuel tanks,the pressure relief valve eliminates damage to the wing structure.
options.B: When there is too much plus or minus pressure in the fuel tanks,the pressure relief valve previews damage to the wing structure.
options.C:
The pressure relief valve prevents damage to the wing structure when there
is too much positive or negative pressure in the fuel tanks.

explanation: 【译文】当油箱内正压或负压过大时，释压活门可防止机翼结构损坏。【词汇】positive/negative pressure=正压/负压，prevent damage=防止损坏，wing structure=机翼结构。【解析】C正确：正负压术语标准，“prevents damage”对应“防止损坏”。A两处错误：“subtractive pressure”误译“负压”，“eliminates”误译“防止”。B三处错误：“plus or minus pressure”术语错误，“previews”（预览）误译prevents。

question: 同一词“base",当它在不同的语境中具有不同的含义时，可以归为不同的技术名称类别。

options.A: The same word “base” can go into different technical name categories when it is used with different meanings in different contexts.
options.B: The same word "base", when it has different meanings in different environment, it can be divided into different technical name categories.
options.C: When the word "base" can be divided into different technical noun categories, it has different meanings in different language environment.

explanation: 【译文】同一个词“base”在不同语境中具有不同含义时，可以归入不同的技术名称类别。【词汇】context=语境，technical name category=技术名称类别，go into=归入。【解析】A正确：“different meanings in different contexts”与“go into…categories”均对应。B两处错误：“environment”误译“语境”（context），双it主语冗余。C两处错误：“language environment”误译语境，且因果倒置——原文“含义不同→归类不同”，C译反。

question: 如果液体在厨房内溅出，必须立即清除所有液体的痕迹，并使受污染区域完全干燥。

options.A: If liquid spills in the kitchen, all traces of the liquid must be cleaned promptly and the concerned area must be completely dry.
options.B: If liquids are spilled inside the galley, you must remove all signs of liquid and fully dry the areas of contamination immediately.
options.C: If liquid spills in the galley, all marks of the liquid must be removed at once and the polluted area must be completely dried.

explanation: 【译文】如果液体在厨房内溅出，必须立即清除所有液体痕迹，并使受污染区域完全干燥。【词汇】galley=（飞机）厨房，spill=溅出，traces/marks=痕迹，polluted area=受污染区域。【解析】C正确：galley为航空“厨房”标准术语，“marks removed at once”“polluted area dried”均对应。A两处错误：“kitchen”不如galley规范，“concerned area”误译“受污染区域”。B两处偏差：“signs”不及marks，“areas of contamination”复数与原文不符。

question: 本规范中包含的规则应作为制造商编写的维修手册中所有资料的格式、风格和展示方法的指南。

options.A: The rules containing in this specification shall provide a guide to the formatting, type and method of all present documents in the manufacturer's maintenance manual.
options.B: The rules in this specification are served as a guide for the format, style and way of representation for all materials contained in manufacturer's maintenance manual.
options.C: The rules contained in this specification shall serve as guides for format, style and method of presentation for all material included in maintenance manuals prepared by manufacturers.

explanation: 【译文】本规范中包含的规则应作为制造商编写的维修手册中所有资料的格式、风格和展示方法的指南。【词汇】rules contained in=包含在……中的规则，serve as=作为，method of presentation=展示方法，prepared by manufacturers=制造商编写的。【解析】C正确：“contained”过去分词定语正确，“serve as guides”“method of presentation”均对应。A两处错误：“containing”分词误用（语法错误），“type”误译“风格”、“present documents”误译“资料”。B两处错误：“are served as”被动误用，“way of representation”不规范。

question: 有些工作或流程由几个基本操作组成，每个操作下面有若干小步骤或工作项。

options.A: Some jobs or processes consist of several basic operations, with a number of minor steps or work items under each.
options.B: Some basic operations with a few small steps or work items are included in some work or processes.
options.C: Some jobs or processes constitute a few basic operations, with several minor steps or work items under each.

explanation: 【译文】有些工作或流程由几个基本操作组成，每个操作下面有若干小步骤或工作项。【词汇】consist of=由……组成，basic operation=基本操作，minor step=小步骤，work item=工作项。【解析】A正确：“consist of”对应“由……组成”，“under each”表达隶属。B一处错误：主宾颠倒，变成“操作被包含于工作中”（结构错译）。C一处错误：“constitute”把“由……组成”方向译反，与consist of混淆。

question: 厨房地板上方的水分可以通过地板表面的小洞渗入，肉眼是看不到的。

options.A: Water above the kitchen floor can seep in through small holes in the floor surface, invisible to the naked eye.
options.B: Eyes cannot see the vapor which may penetrate through small holes of the floor surface in the galley.
options.C: Moisture above the galley floor can go through small holes in the floor surface area and stay out of view.

explanation: 【译文】厨房地板上方的水分可通过地板表面的小洞渗入，肉眼无法看到。【词汇】seep=渗入，naked eye=肉眼，moisture=水分，galley=（飞机）厨房。【解析】A正确：“seep in”对应“渗入”，“invisible to the naked eye”对应“肉眼看不到”。B三处错误：“vapor”窄化“水分”，漏译“地板上方”，句式别扭。C三处偏差：“go through”不及seep，“stay out of view”未表达“肉眼”，“surface area”冗余。

question: 如果一个词仅有极少的人在一个特定的技术领域能理解，就会对交流造成干扰。

options.A: If a word is only understood by a very small number of people in a specific technical area, it will cause interference in communication.
options.B: If a word is only understood by a very small number of people in a specific technical area, it will cause disturbing in negotiations..
options.C: If a word is only understood by a very small number of people in a special skill area, it will cause interference in communication.

explanation: 【译文】如果一个词在特定技术领域只有极少数人能够理解，就会对交流造成干扰。【词汇】a very small number of people=极少数人，specific technical area=特定技术领域，cause interference in communication=对交流造成干扰。【解析】A正确：人数少、特定技术领域、交流干扰三个考点全部对应。B一处关键错误：“interference in negotiations”（谈判中的干扰）把communication误作negotiations，词义错译。C两处偏差：“special skill area”（特殊技能领域）不如“specific technical area”对应“特定技术领域”，后半虽同A但前半关键短语失准。

question: 技术动词必须遵守与STE中其他被批准动词相同的规则

options.A: Scientific verbs must disobey the same rules as other approved verbs in STE.
options.B: Technical verbs must obey the same rules as other approved verbs in STE.
options.C: Mechanical verbs must violate the same rules as other approved verbs in STE.

explanation: 【译文】技术动词必须遵守与STE中其他经批准动词相同的规则。【词汇】technical verb=技术动词，obey the same rules=遵守相同规则，approved verbs=经批准的动词，the same…as=与……相同的。【解析】B正确：technical、obey、same rules as三处考点全对。A两处错误：“scientific verbs”（科学动词）误译“技术动词”，“disobey”（不遵守）与“必须遵守”方向相反。C两处错误：“mechanical verbs”（机械动词）误译“技术动词”，“violate”（违反）与“遵守”方向相反。

question: 如果你发现断了的电线，就把它们修好。

options.A: If you find damaged lines, restore them.
options.B: If you find loosen cables, fix them.
options.C: If you find broken wires, repair them.

explanation: 【译文】如果发现断了的电线，就把它们修好。【词汇】broken wire=断了的电线，repair=修理，restore=恢复，damaged=损坏的。【解析】C正确：“broken wires”对应“断了的电线”，“repair”对应“修好”，最简洁准确。A两处偏差：“damaged lines”（损坏的线路）范围过宽且lines不如wires准确，“restore”（恢复）不及repair对应“修好”。B两处错误：“loosen cables”（松动的电缆）误译“断了的电线”（词义错译），fix可用但前半已错。

question: 不要使用笼统和含糊的动词。

options.A: Do not use verbs that are general and vague.
options.B: Do not use verbs that are normal and mixed.
options.C: Do not use verbs that are usual and blended..

explanation: 【译文】不要使用笼统而含糊的动词。【词汇】general=笼统的/泛泛的，vague=含糊的，verb=动词，do not use=不要使用。【解析】A正确：“general and vague”精确对应“笼统和含糊”两个并列形容词。B一处关键错误：“normal and mixed”（正常和混合的）与原文词义完全不符，词义错译。C一处关键错误：“usual and blended”（通常和混合的）同样偏离原意，mixed/blended为近形干扰，属词义错译。

question: 将孔的直径扩至8.00±0.003mm。

options.A: Drill the hole until it has a radius of 8.00 +/- 0.003 mm.
options.B: Ream the hole until it has a diameter of 8.00 +/- 0.003 mm.
options.C: Trim the hole until it has a width of 8.00 +/- 0.003 mm.

explanation: 【译文】将孔铰扩至直径8.00±0.003mm。【词汇】ream=铰孔/扩孔（精加工），diameter=直径（radius为半径），drill=钻孔，±0.003mm=公差。【解析】B正确：“ream”对应“扩”（扩孔至精密尺寸用ream），“diameter”对应“直径”，公差表达正确。A两处错误：“drill”是钻孔初加工，“扩至”精密尺寸应用ream；“radius”（半径）误译“直径”，尺寸概念错误。C两处错误：“trim”（修整）不是孔的精加工方式，“width”（宽度）误译“直径”，几何量错误。

question: 检查排放孔周围区域有无腐蚀迹象。

options.A: Examine the area that is around the drain holes for signs of corrosion.
options.B: Check the scavenge hole and areas around it for corrosion.
options.C: Make sure that there's no corrosion around the drain hole.

explanation: 【译文】检查排放孔周围区域是否有腐蚀迹象。【词汇】examine=检查，area around the drain holes=排放孔周围区域，signs of corrosion=腐蚀迹象。【解析】A正确：“the area that is around”对应“周围区域”，“signs”对应“迹象”。B两处错误：“scavenge hole”误译“排放孔”（drain hole），漏译“迹象”。C两处错误：“make sure there's no corrosion”把“检查有无”误作“确保没有”，漏译范围与迹象。

question: 如果一个动力源同时给两个或两个以上系统提供动力，该动力源应在相应的章节标题下分别进行讨论。

options.A: The power source that are discussed respectively under the appropriate chapter heading shall provide power to at least two systems.
options.B: When two or more systems are served by a single power source, that power source will be discussed separately under the appropriate chapter heading.
options.C: The system that is powered by two or more power sources shall be discussed separately under the appropriate chapter heading.

explanation: 【译文】当两个或以上系统由一个动力源提供动力时，该动力源应在相应章节标题下分别讨论。【词汇】power source=动力源，be served by=由……供能，discuss separately=分别讨论。【解析】B正确：“systems are served by a single power source”表达“一源供多系统”。A一处错误：译成“被讨论的动力源应供能多系统”，条件倒置。C一处错误：“powered by two or more power sources”变成“多源供一系统”，方向相反。

question: 校装包括设置钢索张力，调节飞控舵面的行程限位和设置行程止动点。

options.A: Setting cable tension, flight control surfaces travel limits  and stops are the main tasks of rigging.
options.B: Cable tension set, flight controls travel limits adjustment and travel stops set are the rigging procedures.
options.C: Rigging involves setting cable tension, adjusting travel limits of flight controls, and setting travel stops.

explanation: 【译文】校装包括设置钢索张力、调节飞控舵面行程限位以及设置行程止动点。【词汇】rigging=校装，cable tension=钢索张力，travel limit=行程限位，travel stop=行程止动点。【解析】C正确：三个动名词并列对应。A两处偏差：“main tasks”增译“main”，漏译“调节”（adjusting）。B两处错误：“Cable tension set”等名词堆叠不合英文表达（语法错误）。

question: 重复拆装会导致自锁螺母自锁功能失效。

options.A: The self-locking function decays after several removal and installation.
options.B: Repeated removal and installation causes the self-locking nut to lose its locking feature.
options.C: Avoid repeated removal and installation of the self-locking nut to protect its locking feature.

explanation: 【译文】重复拆装会导致自锁螺母失去其自锁功能。【词汇】repeated removal and installation=重复拆装，self-locking nut=自锁螺母，lose its locking feature=失去自锁功能。【解析】B正确：拆装、螺母、失效三考点全对。A两处错误：“self-locking function”漏译“螺母”，“decays”不及lose。C一处错误：“Avoid…to protect”把陈述句误作建议句，句式语义均变。

question: 不锈钢接触镁、铝或镉金属时会导致它们腐蚀。

options.A: CRES causes magnesium, aluminum, or cadmium to corrode when it touches these metals.
options.B: Stainless steel corrodes once touching magnesium, aluminum, or chromium metals.
options.C: Magnesium, aluminum, or chromium metals shall be protected from the corrosion caused by CRES.

explanation: 【译文】不锈钢接触镁、铝或镉金属时会使它们发生腐蚀。【词汇】CRES=corrosion-resistant steel耐腐蚀钢（手册中指不锈钢），magnesium/aluminum/cadmium=镁/铝/镉，corrode=腐蚀，touch=接触。【解析】A正确：“CRES causes…to corrode when it touches”完整表达不锈钢使这些金属腐蚀的因果关系。B两处错误：“cadmium”（镉）误译为chromium（铬），金属名称张冠李戴；主语变为“Stainless steel corrodes”（不锈钢自身腐蚀），腐蚀方向相反。C两处错误：同样把cadmium误作chromium，且“shall be protected”为增译，改变陈述事实的语气。

question: 在非STE的例句中，安全指令给出的是“注意”，但是如果了解氧气系统的话，也应知道氧气会造成爆炸。

options.A: In the STE example, this safety description is given as a caution, but if you know about oxygen systems, you also know that oxygen can occur explosions.
options.B: In the non-STE example, this safety instruction is given as a caution, but if you know about oxygen systems, you also know that oxygen can cause explosions.
options.C: In the non-STE example, caution is given in this safety description. But if you know about nitrogen systems, you also know that nitrogen can cause flames.

explanation: 【译文】在非STE例句中，这条安全指令以“注意”形式给出；但了解氧气系统的话，也应知道氧气会引起爆炸。【词汇】non-STE=非STE，safety instruction=安全指令，caution=注意，cause explosions=引起爆炸。【解析】B正确：四考点全对。A两处错误：“STE example”漏译“非”，“occur explosions”误译“造成爆炸”（cause）。C两处错误：“nitrogen”误译“氧气”，“flames”误译“爆炸”。

question: 词典包括一些未经批准的词，如果能把这些词归在适用的技术名称类别中，它们可以是技术名称。

options.A: The dictionary includes some unapproved words that can be technical names if you can put them in the applicable technical name category.
options.B: Some approved words are included in the dictionary, they can be technical names if they belong to applicable technical name category.
options.C: The dictionary contains some unapproved words, which can be put in separate technical name category, they can be technical names.

explanation: 【译文】词典包含一些未经批准的词，若能归入适用的技术名称类别，就可成为技术名称。【词汇】unapproved word=未经批准的词，technical name=技术名称，applicable category=适用的类别。【解析】A正确：unapproved、applicable category与if条件均对应。B一处错误：“approved”与“未经批准”方向相反。C两处错误：“separate”误译“适用的”（applicable），定语从句与主句杂糅。

question: 如果一个词在一个特定的技术领域只有非常少的人理解，就会对交流造成干扰。

options.A: Misunderstanding will occur if a word is only understood by a large amount of people in a special technical area.
options.B: If a word is only known by quite a small amount of people in a special technical field,  there will be communication interference.
options.C: If a word is only understood by a very small number of people in a specific technical area, it will cause interference in communication.

explanation: 【译文】如果一个词在特定技术领域只有非常少的人理解，就会对交流造成干扰。【词汇】very small number of people=非常少的人，specific technical area=特定技术领域，interference in communication=交流干扰。【解析】C正确：人数与领域两考点标准对应。A一处错误：“large amount of people”与“非常少的人”方向相反。B两处偏差：“amount of people”搭配错误，“special technical field”“known”不及specific/understood准确。

question: 此测试或检查的复杂性和严格性将根据装置运行的条件而有所不同。

options.A: The complexity and stringency of this test or check are different from the operation conditions of the unit.
options.B: The test or check will change in complexity and stringency no matter what the conditions under which the unit operates.
options.C: Such tests or checks will vary in complexity and stringency according to the conditions under which the unit functions.

explanation: 【译文】此测试或检查的复杂性和严格性将根据装置运行条件而有所不同。【词汇】vary in=在……方面不同，complexity and stringency=复杂性和严格性，according to=根据。【解析】C正确：“vary in…according to”完整对应。A一处错误：“are different from”把“随条件变化”误作“与条件不同”，关系混淆。B一处错误：“no matter what”把“根据条件”误作让步，逻辑错误。

question: 然而，制造商可能会省略不适用于该产品的系统/章，或者在可行的情况下合并系统/章。

options.A: However, manufacturers may omit System/Chapters that are not applicable to the product or combine Systems/Chapters where it is feasible.
options.B: However, manufacturers may adopt Systems/Chapters that are not applicable to the product or constitute Systems/Chapters when necessary.
options.C: However, operators may omit Systems/Chapters applicable to the product or constitute Systems/Chapters where practical.

explanation: 【译文】但是，制造商可以省略不适用于该产品的系统/章，或在可行的情况下合并系统/章。【词汇】however=但是/然而，omit=省略，not applicable to=不适用于，combine=合并，where it is feasible=可行的情况下。【解析】A正确：However与2734题同句对应，omit与combine两动作完整。B两处错误：“adopt”（采用）与“省略”方向相反，“constitute”（构成）误译“合并”（combine）。C三处错误：“operators”（运营人）误译“制造商”（主体错误），“applicable”漏译否定（变成“适用的”），“constitute”同误。

question: 语音记录器组件的外壳具有以下特性：防水，耐冲击和耐热。

options.A: The housing for the voice recorder unit has these properties: water tolerance, shock resistant and heat resistant.
options.B: The container for the voice recorder unit has these properties: watertproof, spin resistant and heat resistant.
options.C: The container for the voice recorder unit has these properties: watertight, shock resistant and heat resistant.

explanation: 【译文】语音记录器组件的外壳具有以下特性：防水、耐冲击和耐热。【词汇】voice recorder=语音记录器，watertight=防水的，shock resistant=耐冲击，heat resistant=耐热。【解析】C正确：三项特性标准对应，并列整齐。A两处错误：“water tolerance”误译“防水”（watertight），与resistant不并列。B三处错误：“watertproof”拼写错误，“spin resistant”误译“耐冲击”。

question: 如果飞机停在斜坡上，请确保放好轮挡处。

options.A: If the aircraft is parked on the ground, make sure that wheel chocks are placed.
options.B: If the aircraft is parked on the ground, make sure that wheel chocks are in position.
options.C: If the aircraft is parked on a slope, make sure that wheel chocks are in position.

explanation: 【译文】如果飞机停在斜坡上，确保轮挡放置到位。【词汇】slope=斜坡，wheel chock=轮挡，in position=就位/放好，park=停（机）。【解析】C正确：“parked on a slope”对应“停在斜坡上”，“chocks are in position”对应“放好轮挡”。A两处错误：“on the ground”（在地面上）误译“斜坡”（slope，关键条件丢失），“are placed”可用但不及in position。B一处关键错误：同样把slope误作ground，核心条件译错，尽管in position正确仍不成立。

question: 升降舵的行程受升降舵动力控制组件的行程限制。

options.A: Elevator move is limited by the move of the elevator power control units.
options.B: Elevator trip is limited by the move of the elevator power control units.
options.C: Elevator travel is limited by the stroke of the elevator power control units.

explanation: 【译文】升降舵的行程受升降舵动力控制组件行程的限制。【词汇】elevator=升降舵，travel=（舵面）行程，stroke=（作动/机械）行程，power control unit=动力控制组件，be limited by=受……限制。【解析】C正确：舵面行程用travel、作动器行程用stroke，术语区分专业准确。A两处错误：“Elevator move”（move作名词不表行程）术语错误，两处move重复使用词不当。B两处错误：“trip”（跳闸/旅程）误译“行程”，“move”同误，整句术语失准。

question: 空气涡轮机启动器的故障会触发发动机过热和火警信号。

options.A: Failure of the air turbine starter can trigger the engine overheat and fire indications.
options.B: The air turbine starter fails to trigger the engine overheat and fire indications.
options.C: Failure of the air turbine starter can cause the engine overheat and fire indications.

explanation: 【译文】空气涡轮启动器的故障可触发发动机过热和火警信号。【词汇】air turbine starter=空气涡轮启动器，failure=故障，trigger=触发，overheat and fire indications=过热和火警信号。【解析】A正确：“Failure of…can trigger”对应“……的故障会触发”，indications对应“信号/指示”。B一处关键错误：“fails to trigger”（未能触发）与“会触发”含义相反，fails to为否定结构。C一处偏差：cause（导致）可用，但trigger与“触发”精确对应，A更贴合原文动词，故取A。

question: 喷气式发动机的基本原理很简单，其结构也非常简单。

options.A: Not only the basic principle of the reciprocating engine is simple, and also the assembly.
options.B: The basic principle of a jet engine is simple, and so is its construction.
options.C: The basic principle of the propeller driven engine is simple, as well as the installation.

explanation: 【译文】喷气式发动机的基本原理很简单，其结构也非常简单。【词汇】jet engine=喷气式发动机，basic principle=基本原理，construction=结构，and so is=……也同样如此（倒装结构）。【解析】B正确：“jet engine”对应“喷气式发动机”，“and so is its construction”用倒装简洁表达“结构也简单”。A两处错误：“reciprocating engine”（活塞式发动机）误译“喷气式发动机”（机型张冠李戴），“assembly”（组件）误译“结构”。C两处错误：“propeller driven engine”（螺旋桨发动机）同误，“installation”（安装）误译“结构”（construction）。

question: 在更正栏中，列出部件故障纠正措施涉及的所有注意事项或要点。

options.A: In the correction column, list any notes or key points involved in correcting the trouble in the unit.
options.B: List any notes or key points involved in corrective actions for units faults during correction.
options.C: List all corrective actions, any notes or key points related to a unit failure when you do the Correction.

explanation: 【译文】在更正栏中，列出纠正部件故障所涉及的所有注意事项或要点。【词汇】correction column=更正栏，notes or key points=注意事项或要点，correct the trouble=纠正故障。【解析】A正确：位置与内容要素一一对应。B两处错误：缺“In the correction column”（漏译要素），“corrective actions for units faults”结构混乱。C两处错误：“list all corrective actions”把宾语误作“纠正措施”，column漏译。

question: 对只包含一个章节的CAP页码按顺序编号，并标明章节。

options.A: Only number CAP pages that contain one chapter in sequence and identify the chapters.
options.B: Number the pages of CAPs containing only one section in sequence with section identification.
options.C: For the CAP pages that contain only a chapter in sequence, mark the chapters.

explanation: 【译文】对只包含一个章节的CAP页码按顺序编号，并标明章节。【词汇】number the pages=对页码编号，in sequence=按顺序，section identification=章节标识，contain only one section=只含一个章节。【解析】B正确：“Number the pages of CAPs containing only one section in sequence”对象与方式完整，“with section identification”对应“标明章节”。A一处偏差：句首Only使限定关系易误读，“one chapter in sequence”结构歧义。C一处错误：“mark the chapters”漏译“按顺序编号”的主干动作。

question: 在使用工具/设备前后，使用者应进行目视或功能性检查并确认是否处于可用状态。

options.A: Prior to and aft use the tool / equipment, the user shall make a visual check or operational test to confirm the utility.
options.B: Before or after using the tool / equipment, the user shall make a visual check or functional test to confirm the serviceability.
options.C: Before or aft of using the tool / equipment, the user shall make a spot check or functional test to inform the usability.

explanation: 【译文】使用工具/设备前后，使用者应进行目视检查或功能测试以确认可用状态。【词汇】visual check=目视检查，functional test=功能测试，serviceability=可用状态。【解析】B正确：三个术语均标准对应。A两处错误：“prior to and aft use”搭配错误，“utility”不及serviceability。C三处错误：“aft of using”误译“之后”，“spot check”误译“目视检查”，“inform the usability”误译“确认”。

question: 如果机身制造商以任何方式更改部件制造商的文本或插图，那么他应使用自己的刊头发行。

options.A: If the airframe manufacturer makes any alteration to the component of the text or illustrations, the component manufacturer will use its own masthead.
options.B: If the airframe manufacturer changes the component manufacturer's text or illustration in any way, he shall apply his own masthead.
options.C: If the airframe manufacturer alters the text or illustrations of the component manufacturer's in any way, it's own masthead shall be used.

explanation: 【译文】如果机身制造商以任何方式更改部件制造商的文本或插图，则应使用自己的刊头发行。【词汇】airframe manufacturer=机身制造商，component manufacturer=部件制造商，in any way=以任何方式，masthead=刊头。【解析】B正确：所有格与方式状语完整对应。A两处错误：“alteration to the component of the text”误作“文本的部件”（所有格错位），“component manufacturer will use”主语错误。C一处错误：“it's own…shall be used”被动使责任主体缺失。

question: 各大翼油箱给中央油箱的燃油供油流量一致。

options.A: The wing tanks and the center tank have the same rate of supply of fuel.
options.B: The rate of supply of fuel from the wing tanks to the center tank is equal.
options.C: The fuel supply rate from all wing tanks and the center tank is the same.

explanation: 【译文】各大翼油箱向中央油箱的燃油供给流量一致。【词汇】wing tank=大翼油箱，center tank=中央油箱，rate of supply=供给流量，from…to…=从……向……。【解析】B正确：“from the wing tanks to the center tank”明确供油方向，“is equal”对应“一致”。A一处错误：“have the same rate”丢失供油方向关系。C一处错误：“from all wing tanks and the center tank”把中央油箱误列供油源。

question: 使用未经批准的清洁剂的警告信息以及使用经批准的清洁剂的潜在风险都应包含在内。

options.A: Caution notes regarding possible hazards of using authorized and unauthorized cleaning agents shall be included.
options.B: Caution notes regarding use of unauthorized cleaning agents and possible hazards of using authorized ones shall be included.
options.C: Caution notes regarding use of authorized cleaning agents and possible hazards of use of unauthorized ones shall be included.

explanation: 【译文】关于使用未经批准清洁剂的警示说明，以及使用经批准清洁剂的潜在风险，均应包含在内。【词汇】caution notes=警示说明，unauthorized=未经批准的，authorized=经批准的，possible hazards=潜在风险。【解析】B正确：警示对象与风险对象与原文一致。A一处错误：两类清洁剂都归入“风险”，对应关系混淆。C一处错误：警示给authorized、风险给unauthorized，与原文恰好相反（张冠李戴）。

question: 请注意，飞机的改装或修理工作必须由持照人员完成。

options.A: Please designate licensed personnel to do modification or maintenance to airplane.
options.B: Alterations or repairs to airplane shall be accomplished and noted by licensed personnel.
options.C: Please note that alterations or repairs to airplane must be accomplished by licensed personnel.

explanation: 【译文】请注意，飞机的改装或修理工作必须由持照人员完成。【词汇】please note=请注意，alterations or repairs=改装或修理，be accomplished by=由……完成，licensed personnel=持照人员。【解析】C正确：三要素全对。A两处错误：“designate”把陈述误作指派动作，“maintenance”不等于“修理”。B两处偏差：“and noted by”增译“并记录”，缺“请注意”对应。

question: 手册应从联邦航空法规43部获取飞行员可以执行的项目清单。

options.A: The Handbook should refer to FAR Part 43 for list of things the pilot may do.
options.B: FAR Part 43 has a list of things the pilot may do.
options.C: FAR Part 43 recommends a manual that contains a list of things the pilot may do.

explanation: 【译文】手册应参照联邦航空法规第43部获取飞行员可以执行的项目清单。【词汇】refer to=参照/查阅，FAR Part 43=联邦航空法规第43部，list of things the pilot may do=飞行员可执行项目的清单，handbook=手册。【解析】A正确：“The Handbook should refer to FAR Part 43 for the list”准确表达“手册向43部获取清单”的主从关系。B一处关键错误：只陈述“43部有清单”，漏译“手册应参照”的主体行为（漏译要素）。C一处关键错误：“FAR Part 43 recommends a manual”把参照关系颠倒成“法规推荐手册”，逻辑错误。

question: 应按照适用的飞机服务手册或维修手册完成预防性维修。

options.A: Maintenance should be accomplished preventively in accordance with the airplane service or maintenance manual.
options.B: Appropriate airplane service or maintenance manual shall be developed for the accomplishment of preventive maintenance.
options.C: Preventive maintenance should be accomplished in accordance with the appropriate airplane service or maintenance manual.

explanation: 【译文】应按照适用的飞机服务手册或维修手册完成预防性维修。【词汇】preventive maintenance=预防性维修，in accordance with=按照，appropriate=适用的，accomplish=完成。【解析】C正确：“accomplished in accordance with the appropriate…manual”完整对应。A两处错误：“Maintenance…preventively”把“预防性”作副词修饰完成方式（应作定语），漏译appropriate。B一处错误：“manual shall be developed for the accomplishment”把“按手册完成维修”误作“为维修编手册”，主客体颠倒。

question: 确保地面勤务车的排气不会造成错误的指示。

options.A: Verify that the bleed air of the ground car can not lead to a wrong information.
options.B: Make sure that the exhaust from the ground cart does not cause an incorrect indication.
options.C: Make sure that the wrong indication is caused by the exhaust from the ground cart.

explanation: 【译文】确保地面勤务车的排气不会造成错误的指示。【词汇】ground cart=地面勤务车，exhaust=排气，incorrect indication=错误指示，does not cause=不会造成。【解析】B正确：exhaust与incorrect indication对应，否定保留。A两处错误：“bleed air”（引气）误译“排气”，“a wrong information”语法错误。C一处错误：肯定句“is caused by”与“不会造成”方向相反。

question: 螺栓头顶部一定不要超过钢板上方5毫米。

options.A: The tops of the bolt heads must not be more than 5 MM above the plate.
options.B: The bottoms of the bolt heads can be more than 5 MM above the plate.
options.C: 5 MM is permitted for the tops of the bolt heads below the plate.

explanation: 【译文】螺栓头顶部不得高出钢板表面5毫米以上。【词汇】tops of the bolt heads=螺栓头顶部，must not be more than=不得超过，above the plate=在钢板上方，5 mm=5毫米。【解析】A正确：“tops of the bolt heads must not be more than 5 MM above the plate”完整对应。B两处错误：“bottoms”（底部）误译“顶部”（tops），“can be more than”（可以超过）与“不得超过”方向相反。C两处错误：“is permitted”（被允许）弱化禁止语气且数值表述错位，“below the plate”（钢板下方）与“上方”方向相反。

question: 损伤容限设计原理已成功地运用到新一代飞机的设计上。

options.A: The operation of new generation aircraft has adopted the operation method of damage tolerance.
options.B: The damage tolerance design method is applicable to the new type aircraft.
options.C: The design concept of damage tolerance was successfully applied to the design of new generation aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】损伤容限设计原理已成功应用于新一代飞机的设计。【词汇】damage tolerance=损伤容限，design concept=设计原理，apply to=应用于，new generation aircraft=新一代飞机。【解析】C正确：“design concept”“successfully applied to the design”均对应。A两处错误：“operation”误译“设计”（design），“operation method”误译“设计原理”。B两处偏差：“is applicable to”只表适用，漏译“已成功运用”。

question: 保证营运人维修单位保留每架航空器所要求的维修/改装/检查记录。

options.A: The operator's maintencance organization must make sure that each aircraft has all inspection records.
options.B: Make sure that the required repair/alteration/inspection documents of each aircraft must be kept by maintenance organization of the operator.
options.C: Ensure that the operator's maintenance organization has retained the required maintenance/alteration/inspection records for each aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】确保营运人的维修单位保留每架航空器所要求的维修/改装/检查记录。【词汇】operator's maintenance organization=营运人维修单位，retain=保留，required records=所要求的记录，each aircraft=每架航空器。【解析】C正确：“retained the required…records for each aircraft”三类记录与范围完整。A两处错误：“maintencance”拼写错误，“all inspection records”漏译维修和改装两类。B两处偏差：“documents”不及records，“repair”不等于“维修”。

question: 波音777飞机与先前的波音系列飞机的不同之处主要在于波音777飞机是电传操纵的。

options.A: The Boeing-777 airplanes are different from the previous Boeing series ones mainly in that they are flown by wires.
options.B: The difference between the Boeing-777 airplanes and the subsequent Boeing series is that they are operated by wires.
options.C: Fly-by-wire is the main difference between Boeing-777 airplanes and the subsequent Boeing series.

explanation: 【译文】波音777与先前波音系列飞机的不同之处主要在于采用电传操纵。【词汇】previous=先前的（subsequent为随后的），be different from=与……不同，flown by wires=电传操纵。【解析】A正确：“previous Boeing series”与“flown by wires”均对应。B一处错误：“subsequent”（随后的）与“先前”方向相反。C一处错误：同误subsequent。

question: 如果交流电路仅由电阻组成，则阻抗值与电阻值相同.

options.A: If an AC circuit consists of resistance only, the value of the impedance is the same as the resistance.
options.B: If an AC circuit consists of impedance only, the value of the capacitance is the same as the impedance.
options.C: If an DC circuit has capacitance only, the value of the resistance is the same as the capacitance.

explanation: 【译文】如果交流电路仅由电阻组成，则阻抗值与电阻值相同。【词汇】AC circuit=交流电路，consist of resistance only=仅由电阻组成，impedance=阻抗，the same as=与……相同。【解析】A正确：“consists of resistance only”对应“仅由电阻组成”，“impedance…the same as the resistance”对应“阻抗值与电阻值相同”。B两处错误：把电路组成成分误作impedance（应为resistance，张冠李戴），并引入capacitance（电容）这一原文没有的元件。C两处错误：“DC circuit”（直流电路）误译“交流”（AC），“capacitance”误译且比较对象错误。

question: 单向活门是液压或气动部件，允许流体在一个方向上完全流动，但阻止所有反向流动。

options.A: Check valve, that allows fluid blows in one direction completely but blocks all flow in the other direction, is a pneumatic or hydraulic system component.
options.B: Oneway valve is a hydro or gaseous system component that allows fluid flows in one direction freely but blocks all flow in the opposite direction.
options.C: Check valve is a hydraulic or pneumatic system component that allows full flow of fluid in one direction but blocks all flow in the opposite direction.

explanation: 【译文】单向活门是液压或气动系统部件，允许流体单向完全流动，但阻止反向流动。【词汇】check valve=单向活门，hydraulic or pneumatic=液压或气动，full flow=完全流动，block opposite direction=阻止反向。【解析】C正确：部件属性与流向均对应。A两处错误：“fluid blows”误译“流动”（flows），语序混乱。B两处错误：“Oneway valve”写法不规范，“hydro or gaseous”误译“液压或气动”。

question: 用扳手转动关闭辅助组件的主体，将两个反推门拉到一起，直到你可以连接门底部的锁扣为止。

options.A: Turn the body of the closure assist assembly with a wrench to pull the two thrust reverser doors together until you can engage the latches at the bottom of the doors.
options.B: Turn the main body of the closing aid with a crowfoot and pull the two throttle reverser doors together until you can connect the bolts at the bottom of the door.
options.C: Use a wrench to turn the main body of the closing auxiliary assembly and pull the two reverse doors together until you can attach the locks at the bottom of the door.

explanation: 【译文】用扳手转动关闭辅助组件的主体，将两扇反推门拉拢，直到能啮合门底部的锁扣。【词汇】closure assist assembly=关闭辅助组件，wrench=扳手，thrust reverser door=反推门，engage the latch=啮合锁扣。【解析】A正确：四个术语全部对应。B三处错误：“crowfoot”（爪形扳手头）误译wrench，“throttle reverser”误译thrust reverser，“bolts”误译“锁扣”。C两处偏差：“closing auxiliary assembly”不规范，“reverse doors”漏译thrust，locks不及latches。

question: 两个活门上的旋转螺母都与内部阀杆上的螺纹啮合，从而使阀杆松开或拉紧到金属阀座。

options.A: The swivel nuts on both valves engage threads on an internal stem that loosens or draws tight the valve stem to a metal seat.
options.B: The rotating nuts on both valves are meshed with the threads on the inner valve stud, so that the valve stud is loosened or tightened to a metal valve base.
options.C: The swing nuts on both valves engage with the threads on the internal spool, allowing the spool to loosen or tighten to the metal seat.

explanation: 【译文】两个活门上的旋转螺母都与内部阀杆上的螺纹啮合，使阀杆松开或紧定到金属阀座。【词汇】swivel nut=旋转螺母，engage threads=与螺纹啮合，internal stem=内部阀杆，metal seat=金属阀座。【解析】A正确：三个核心术语准确。B两处偏差：“valve stud”不及stem对应“阀杆”，“valve base”不及seat对应“阀座”。C两处错误：“swing nuts”误译“旋转螺母”，“spool”误译“阀杆”（stem），张冠李戴。

question: 扰流板用于增加飞行中的飞机阻力，或在着陆期间以及中断起飞的情况下破坏升力。

options.A: Spoilers are used to increase the drag of the aircraft in flight, or to interrupt lift during landing and during rejected take-off.
options.B: Spoilers are used to enhance aircraft resistance in flight or to disrupt boost during landing and when take-off is canceled.
options.C: Spoilers are used to increase the aircraft drag in flight, or destroy the lift during landing and in case of aborted take-off.

explanation: 【译文】扰流板用于在飞行中增加飞机阻力，或在着陆及中断起飞时破坏升力。【词汇】spoiler=扰流板，increase drag=增加阻力，destroy lift=破坏升力，aborted take-off=中断起飞。【解析】C正确：“destroy the lift”“aborted take-off”对应准确。A一处偏差：“interrupt lift”弱于“破坏升力”（destroy）。B两处错误：“resistance”不及drag，“disrupt boost”误译“破坏升力”。

question: 句子形式应该简单直接，除对实际理解和应用有必要外，省略对理论的讨论。

options.A: Sentence forms shall be simple and direct ,omitting discussions of theory except where essential for practical understanding and application.
options.B: The sentence form should be easy and direct, avoiding discussion of theory except when practical understanding and application are necessary.
options.C: The form of a sentence should be simple and direct, and the discussion of theory should be omitted in addition to practical understanding and application.

explanation: 【译文】句子形式应简单直接，除对实际理解和应用确有必要外，省略理论讨论。【词汇】simple and direct=简单直接，omit discussions of theory=省略理论讨论，except where essential=除非必要之处。【解析】A正确：“omitting…except where essential for practical understanding and application”完整表达例外条件。B两处偏差：“easy”不及simple对应“简单”，“avoiding”弱于omitting，shall情态丢失。C一处错误：“in addition to”（除……还有）与except含义相反，逻辑错误。

question: 本节必须列出型号合格审定所需的每个强制更换时间、结构检验间隔和相关的结构检查程序。

options.A: This section must list the relevant structural inspection procedures required for each mandatory replacement time, structural inspection interval and model qualification validation.
options.B: This section must provide the corresponding structural inspection procedures required for each mandatory replacement time , structural inspection interval and type qualification.
options.C:
This section must set forth each mandatory replacement time, structural
inspection interval, and related structural inspection procedure required for type certification.

explanation: 【译文】本节必须列出型号合格审定所要求的每个强制更换时间、结构检验间隔和相关结构检查程序。【词汇】set forth=列出，mandatory replacement time=强制更换时间，structural inspection interval=结构检验间隔，type certification=型号合格审定。【解析】C正确：三项内容与type certification限定关系正确。A两处错误：“model qualification validation”误译“型号合格审定”，required for限定范围错乱。B两处错误：“type qualification”同误，provide不及set forth。

question: 在正常或异常的情况下，这些指令是必需的，例如从柔软的地面、湿滑的或结冰的表面上拖拽飞机并且在发动机被拆除或飞机损坏的状况下。

options.A: These instructions are required for towing aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions, such as from soft ground, wet or icy surfaces and in the case of engine is removing or aircraft is damaging.
options.B: These instructions are necessary for towing the aircraft under normal or abnormal conditions, such as from a wet or icy surface on a soft ground and when the engine is removed or the aircraft is damaged.
options.C: These instructions are necessary to tow or push the aircraft in normal or abnormal conditions such as towing from soft ground and slippery or icy surfaces, with engines removed, or aircraft damaged.

explanation: 【译文】在正常或异常情况下需要这些指令，例如从松软地面、湿滑或结冰表面拖拽飞机，以及发动机已拆除或飞机受损时。【词汇】tow=拖拽，soft ground=松软地面，slippery or icy surfaces=湿滑或结冰表面，engines removed=发动机被拆除，aircraft damaged=飞机损坏。【解析】C正确：各场景要素完整、并列清晰（push为顺承增译）。A两处错误：“wet or icy”漏译“湿滑”（slippery），“engine is removing or aircraft is damaging”语法错误（被动误作进行时）。B两处错误：“a wet or icy surface on a soft ground”把并列场景杂糅成地点修饰，关系全乱。

question: 封面标题应为“飞行员操作手册”或“飞行员操作手册和FAA批准的飞机飞行手册”。

options.A: The cover title shall be "Pilot's Operating Handbook" or "Pilot's Operating Handbook and FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual".
options.B: The topic cover shall be "Pilot's Controlling Manual" or "Pilot's Controlling Manual and FAA Accepted Airplane Flight Manual".
options.C: The page topic shall be "Pilot's Managing Handbook" or "Pilot's Managing Handbook and FAA Authorized Airplane Flight Manual".

explanation: 【译文】封面标题应为“飞行员操作手册”或“飞行员操作手册暨FAA批准的飞机飞行手册”。【词汇】cover title=封面标题，Pilot's Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册，FAA Approved=FAA批准的。【解析】A正确：两个手册标准名称完整。B两处错误：“Controlling Manual”误译Operating Handbook，“Accepted”误译Approved。C三处错误：“Managing Handbook”同误，“Authorized”误译Approved，“page topic”非“封面标题”。

question: 使用单词前，应先阅读字典中“经批准词义”栏中的定义。

options.A: Before you use a word, read its definition in the approved meaning column of the dictionary.
options.B: Before you use a word, read its approved meaning in the definition column of the dictionary.
options.C: Before you use a word, read its meaning in the approved column of the dictionary definition.

explanation: 【译文】使用单词前，应先阅读该词在词典“经批准词义”栏中的定义。【词汇】approved meaning column=经批准词义栏，definition=定义，before you use=使用前。【解析】A正确：“its definition in the approved meaning column”所属关系准确。B一处错误：“approved meaning in the definition column”栏名与词义张冠李戴。C一处错误：“approved column of the dictionary definition”修饰关系混乱。

question: 永远记住，STE的主要目的是让读者立即理解他们所读的每句话。

options.A: Always remember that the main subject of STE is for readers to hardly grasp each sentence they read.
options.B: Always remember that the major function of STE is to let readers comprehend every sentence they read barely.
options.C: Always remember that the primary objective of STE is that readers immediately understand each sentence that they read.

explanation: 【译文】永远记住，STE的主要目的是让读者立即理解他们所读的每一句话。【词汇】primary objective=主要目的，immediately=立即，understand each sentence=理解每句话。【解析】C正确：目的与立即理解两考点全对。A两处错误：“main subject”误译“目的”，“hardly grasp”（几乎不能）与“立即理解”方向相反。B两处错误：“major function”弱于“目的”，“barely”（几乎不）使understand带否定含义。

question: 在技术文本中，你可以使用缩略语使句子更短，更容易阅读。

options.A: In technical texts, you can use abstractions to make sentiments shorter and easier to read.
options.B: In technical texts, you can use abbreviations to make sentences shorter and easier to read.
options.C: In technical texts, you can use abstractions to make sentences shorter and easier to understand.

explanation: 【译文】在技术文本中，你可以使用缩略语使句子更短、更容易阅读。【词汇】technical text=技术文本，abbreviation=缩略语（abstraction为抽象），easier to read=更易阅读。【解析】B正确：四要素全对。A两处错误：“abstractions”误译“缩略语”，“sentiments”（情感）误译“句子”。C两处错误：abstractions同误，“understand”偏离“read”。

question: 字母数字标识符是标识某物的字母和数字的组合。

options.A: An alphanumeric identifier is an assembly of characters and numbers. It can recognize something.
options.B: An symbolic-numeric identifier is an assembly of symbols and numbers. It can identifies something.
options.C: An alphanumeric identifier is a combination of letters and numbers that identifies something.

explanation: 【译文】字母数字标识符是由字母和数字组成的、用于标识某物的组合。【词汇】alphanumeric identifier=字母数字标识符，combination=组合，letters and numbers=字母和数字，identify something=标识某物。【解析】C正确：“a combination of letters and numbers that identifies something”定语从句准确表达“标识某物的组合”。A两处偏差：“characters”（字符）宽于“letters”（字母），“recognize”（认出）误译“标识”（identify）。B两处错误：“symbolic-numeric”误译“字母数字”，“can identifies”语法错误。

question: 根据标准施工手册及AMM更换了机身站位360处损坏的卡箍，消除了导线束与该处地板梁切口相磨的情况。

options.A: Replace broken clamp with new clamp  with reference to standard practices and AMM and relieve rubbing with the bundle at floor bar cut at body station 360.
options.B: Replaced broken clamp with a new clamp diminishing rubbing at floor beam cutout at body station 360 with reference to standard practices and AMM.
options.C: According to the standard practices and AMM, the damaged clamp at the body station 360 was replaced to eliminate the friction between the wire bundle and the cutout of the floor beam at this place.

explanation: 【译文】依据标准施工手册及AMM，更换了机身站位360处损坏的卡箍，消除了导线束与该处地板梁切口相磨的情况。【词汇】standard practices and AMM=标准施工手册及AMM，body station 360=机身站位360，wire bundle=导线束，floor beam cutout=地板梁切口。【解析】C正确：依据、站位、卡箍、导线束、切口五要素完整，“eliminate the friction”对应“消除相磨”。A三处错误：“broken”窄化“damaged”，“floor bar cut”误译“地板梁切口”，漏译“导线束”。B两处错误：“diminishing”弱化“eliminate”，漏译导线束。

question: 机械员拆下钢索滑轮，详细检查周围区域，没有发现其他缺陷。

options.A: The mechanic removed the cable roller and examined the surrounded area in detail. No other defects were found.
options.B: The mechanic removes the cable rotor and examines the adjacent area in detail. No other defects are noted.
options.C: The mechanic removed pulley and inspected the surrounding area in detail with no other defects found.

explanation: 【译文】机械员拆下钢索滑轮，详细检查了周围区域，未发现其他缺陷。【词汇】mechanic=机械员，pulley=滑轮，surrounding area=周围区域，in detail=详细地。【解析】C正确：removed pulley、surrounding area、no defects found三要素对应。A两处错误：“cable roller”误译“滑轮”（pulley），“surrounded area”分词误用。B两处错误：“cable rotor”误译滑轮，现在时态与“拆下”不符。

question: 右后轮舱的控制机构里的右内襟翼控制钢索走向错误，且有扭结。

options.A: Right wing inboard flap control cable at control mechanism located in right rear wheel well is incorrectly routed and kinked.
options.B: The right rear wheel well right inner flap control mechanism controls the wrong alignment and is knotted.
options.C: Right wing inner flap control cable at control mechanism after right wheel well is incorrectly moved and twisted.

explanation: 【译文】位于右后轮舱控制机构中的右内襟翼控制钢索走向错误，且有扭结。【词汇】inboard flap=内襟翼，control cable=控制钢索，wheel well=轮舱，kinked=扭结的。【解析】A正确：control cable、right rear wheel well、incorrectly routed and kinked全部对应。B多处错误：主客体混乱，“knotted”不及kinked。C两处错误：“after right wheel well”误译“轮舱内”，“moved and twisted”误译routed and kinked。

question: 飞行记录本第908701页驾驶员报告：当飞机从11000英尺下降时，飞机左侧有抖动的声音。

options.A: Pilot reports on flight logbook of  908701 pages fluttering sound from left side of airplane during descend beginning at 11000 feet.
options.B: Pilot reports trembling sound from left side of airplane during ascend at 11000 feet on flight logbook 908701 page.
options.C: Pilot reports on flight logbook page 908701 fluttering sound from left side of airplane during descend beginning at 11000 feet.

explanation: 【译文】飞行记录本第908701页驾驶员报告：飞机从11000英尺开始下降时左侧有抖动声。【词汇】flight logbook=飞行记录本，fluttering sound=抖动声，descend=下降。【解析】C正确：“logbook page 908701”正确表达页码归属，“beginning at 11000 feet”对应“从11000英尺”。A一处错误：“logbook of 908701 pages”把页码误作总页数。B两处错误：“trembling”不及fluttering，“ascend”（上升）与“下降”相反。

question: 螺旋桨的大修必须在一个合格的车间按照螺旋桨制造商提供的资料来完成。

options.A: Propellers must be overhauled in a satisfactory shop which should be supplied by the propeller manufacturer in accordance with data.
options.B: Overhaul of propellers and the shop must meet the data of the propeller manufacturer.
options.C: Overhaul of propellers must be accomplished in a qualified shop in accordance with data supplied by the propeller manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】螺旋桨的大修必须由合格车间按照制造商提供的资料完成。【词汇】overhaul=大修，qualified shop=合格车间，in accordance with=按照，data supplied by=提供的资料。【解析】C正确：qualified shop与in accordance with限定关系均对。A两处错误：“satisfactory shop”误译“合格”，“should be supplied by”把“按资料”误作“由制造商提供车间”。B一处错误：“and the shop”把车间列为大修对象，并列错误。

question: 在开启舱门前，请确保客舱压差为零。

options.A: Make sure that the cabin differential pressure is zero before you unlock the door.
options.B: Be sure that the variance of the cabin pressure is zero before you open the door.
options.C: Make certain that the difference of the compartment compression is zero before you open the door.

explanation: 【译文】在开启舱门前，确保客舱压差为零。【词汇】cabin differential pressure=客舱压差，zero=零，unlock/open the door=开启舱门。【解析】A正确：“differential pressure”为“压差”标准术语，“unlock”为开门前动作可接受。B一处错误：“variance”非“压差”规范术语。C两处错误：“compartment compression”术语全误，compartment不及cabin。

question: 应使用识别和编码系统以便于排故、电路修理和组件更换。

options.A: Detection and coding systems shall be used so that it's easy to isolate faults, repair routes and replace the components.
options.B: You should use the detecting and coding system that can help to remove faults, repair lines and change the components.
options.C: To facilitate troubleshooting, repair of circuits, and replacement of components, an identification and coding system should be used.

explanation: 【译文】应使用识别和编码系统，以便于排故、电路修理和组件更换。【词汇】identification and coding system=识别和编码系统，facilitate=便于，troubleshooting=排故，repair of circuits=电路修理，replacement of components=组件更换。【解析】C正确：目的状语三个并列名词短语与原文一一对应。A两处错误：“Detection systems”（探测）误译“识别”（identification），“routes”误译“电路”（circuits）。B两处偏差：“detecting”同误，“repair lines”“change the components”口语化且lines误译“电路”。

question: 警告、注意和注释可用来突出或强调要点。

options.A: Warnings, cautions and notes may be used to highlight or emphasize important points.
options.B: Highlight or underline the key points with alerts, attentions and comments.
options.C: Alerts, cautions and comments can be used to protrude or underline the key points.

explanation: 【译文】警告、注意和注释可用于突出或强调要点。【词汇】warning/caution/note=警告/注意/注释（手册三级提示语），highlight=突出，emphasize=强调，important points=要点。【解析】A正确：warnings/cautions/notes为标准三级提示语，“highlight or emphasize”对应“突出或强调”。B两处错误：“alerts, attentions and comments”非标准三级提示语对应（张冠李戴），“underline”（划线）误译“强调”（emphasize）。C两处错误：“alerts, comments”同误，“protrude”（凸起/伸出）误译“突出”（highlight），词义错译。

question: 巡航性能显示的格式由飞机制造商决定。

options.A: The format of the cruise capacity display is determined by the aircraft vendor.
options.B: The form of the climb performance display is decided by the aircraft manufacturer.
options.C: The format of the cruise performance presentation is at the discretion of the airplane manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】巡航性能显示的格式由飞机制造商决定。【词汇】cruise performance=巡航性能，presentation=显示，at the discretion of=由……决定，manufacturer=制造商。【解析】C正确：“cruise performance presentation”“at the discretion of”均对应。A两处错误：“capacity”误译“性能”（performance），“vendor”误译“制造商”。B一处错误：“climb”误译“巡航”（cruise）。

question: 设备清单应包括交付时安装在特定飞机上的所有必需或可选设备。

options.A: All essential or alternating equipment installed on a particular plane when provided shall be in the equipment list.
options.B: The equipment list shall include all necessary or alternative equipment installed on a particular aircraft when delayed.
options.C: The equipment list shall contain all required or optional equipment installed in the particular airplane when delivered.

explanation: 【译文】设备清单应包含交付时安装在特定飞机上的所有必需或可选设备。【词汇】equipment list=设备清单，required or optional=必需或可选，when delivered=交付时。【解析】C正确：required or optional与when delivered全对。A两处错误：“alternating”误译“可选”（optional），“provided”误译“交付”（delivered）。B两处错误：“alternative”不及optional，“delayed”误译“delivered”。

question: 注：此试验旨在确保襟翼位置指示系统处于零能量状态。

options.A: NOTE: This tryout is to make sure that the flap position indicating system is in a zero energy state.
options.B: NOTE: This test is to make sure that the flap position indicating system is in a zero condition.
options.C: CAUTION: This test is to make sure that the flap position indicating system is in a zero condition.

explanation: 【译文】注：本试验旨在确保襟翼位置指示系统处于零能量状态。【词汇】NOTE=注（CAUTION为注意/警示，级别不同），flap position indicating system=襟翼位置指示系统，zero energy state=零能量状态，make sure=确保。【解析】A正确：NOTE对应“注”，“zero energy state”完整保留“零能量状态”这一安全关键术语（tryout为小疵，test更佳但瑕不掩瑜）。B一处关键错误：“zero condition”（零状态）漏译“能量”（energy），安全术语不完整。C两处错误：“CAUTION”误译“注”（NOTE，警示级别张冠李戴），“zero condition”同B漏译energy。

question: 松开减压器[7]上的转动螺母[10]和大气压力过滤器组件[1]两端的旁通阀[8]。

options.A: Loosen the cross nuts [10] on reducer [7] and standby valve [8] on each end of air pressure filter assembly [1].
options.B: Loosen the swivel nuts [10] on reducer [7] and bypass valve [8] on each end of air pressure filter assembly [1].
options.C: Loosen the cotter nuts [10] on reducer [7] and bypass valve [8] on each end of air pressure filter assembly [1].

explanation: 【译文】松开减压器[7]上的转动螺母[10]和大气压力过滤器组件[1]两端的旁通阀[8]。【词汇】swivel nut=转动螺母，reducer=减压器，bypass valve=旁通阀，filter assembly=过滤器组件。【解析】B正确：三个部件名均标准。A两处错误：“cross nuts”误译“转动螺母”，“standby valve”误译“旁通阀”。C一处错误：“cotter nuts”误译“转动螺母”，张冠李戴。

question: 该构型具有所有惯性和空气数据功能的三重冗余数据。

options.A: This configuration has three rest data for all the inertial and air data functions.
options.B: This configuration has triple redundant data for all the inertial and air data functions.
options.C: This configuration has three rest data for all the interface and air data functions.

explanation: 【译文】该构型具有所有惯性和大气数据功能的三重冗余数据。【词汇】configuration=构型，triple redundant=三重冗余，inertial function=惯性（导航）功能，air data function=大气数据功能。【解析】B正确：“triple redundant data”对应“三重冗余数据”，“inertial and air data functions”对应“惯性和空气数据功能”。A一处关键错误：“three rest data”（三份剩余数据）误译“三重冗余”（triple redundant），术语错译。C两处错误：“three rest data”同误，“interface”（接口）误译“惯性”（inertial），功能对象张冠李戴。

question: 气动系统从气动气源获取压缩空气，并通过管道向用户系统供应压缩空气。

options.A: The pneumatic system gets compressed air from the pneumatic air sources and supplies the compressed air through ducts to the user systems.
options.B: The pneumatic system gets compressed air from the pneumatic air sources and supplies the compressed air through manifold to the user systems.
options.C: The pneumatic system gets comprised air from the pneumatic air sources and supplies comprised the  air through ducts to the user systems.

explanation: 【译文】气动系统从气动气源获取压缩空气，并通过管道向用户系统供气。【词汇】pneumatic system=气动系统，compressed air=压缩空气，through ducts=通过管道，user system=用户系统。【解析】A正确：四要素全对。B一处错误：“manifold”（歧管）误译“管道”（ducts）。C两处错误：“comprised air”误译“压缩空气”，语法不通。

question: 确保零件或表面层干燥且无污染。

options.A: Make sure that the parts or surface layer are dry and free from uncontamination.
options.B: Make sure that the parts or surface layer are dry and free from contamination.
options.C: Make sure that the parts or surface lamination are dry and free from contamination.

explanation: 【译文】确保零件或表面层干燥且无污染。【词汇】surface layer=表面层，dry=干燥，free from contamination=无污染，parts=零件。【解析】B正确：“dry and free from contamination”精确对应“干燥且无污染”。A一处关键错误：“free from uncontamination”（免于无污染）双重否定，变成“有污染”之意，且uncontamination非规范用词，逻辑错误。C一处错误：“surface lamination”（表面层压结构）误译“表面层”（surface layer），lamination指层压工艺或分层缺陷，词义错译。

question: 如果压力迅速下降，锁扣上的剪切销就会断裂。

options.A: If the pressure decreases quickly, the shear pins in the latch will break.
options.B: If the pressure reduces gradually, the shear pins in the lock will break.
options.C: If the pressure drops radically, the alignment pin in the lock will damages.

explanation: 【译文】如果压力迅速下降，锁扣上的剪切销就会断裂。【词汇】pressure decreases quickly=压力迅速下降，shear pin=剪切销，latch=锁扣，break=断裂。【解析】A正确：decreases quickly、shear pins、latch、break四考点全对。B两处错误：“reduces gradually”（逐渐降低）与“迅速下降”相反，“lock”（锁）不如latch对应“锁扣”。C两处错误：“radically”（根本地）程度副词误用（应为rapidly/quickly），“alignment pin”（定位销）误译“剪切销”（shear pin），且“will damages”语法错误。

question: EEC接收来自燃油滤压差电门的模拟信号。

options.A: The EEC processes the simulated signal from the fuel filter differential pressure bulb.
options.B: The fuel filter differential pressure sensor sends an modulated signal to the EEC.
options.C: The EEC receives the analog signal from the fuel filter differential pressure switch.

explanation: 【译文】EEC接收来自燃油滤压差电门的模拟信号。【词汇】analog signal=模拟信号，differential pressure switch=压差电门，receive=接收。【解析】C正确：三要素全对。A三处错误：“processes”误译“接收”，“simulated”误译“模拟”（analog），“bulb”误译“电门”。B两处错误：“sensor”误译“电门”（switch），“modulated”误译“analog”。

question: 滑油来自供油系统，用于润滑和冷却发动机内部部件。

options.A: Oil comes from the supply system to lubricate and cool internal components in the engine.
options.B: Oil coming from the scavenge system will supply lubrication and cooling for the internal components of the engine.
options.C: The oil supply system will give lubrication and cooling for the internal components of the engine.

explanation: 【译文】滑油来自供油系统，用于润滑和冷却发动机内部部件。【词汇】oil=滑油，supply system=供油系统，lubricate and cool=润滑和冷却，internal components=内部部件，scavenge system=回油系统。【解析】A正确：“comes from the supply system”对应“来自供油系统”，“to lubricate and cool”对应“用于润滑和冷却”。B一处关键错误：“scavenge system”（回油/收油系统）误译“供油系统”（supply system），油路方向相反。C一处关键错误：主语变成“The oil supply system”，把“滑油来自供油系统”误作“供油系统提供润滑冷却”，主体张冠李戴。

question: 在发动机集油槽和齿轮箱之间也有内部连接。

options.A: The engine sump and gearboxes are connected internally.
options.B: There are also internal connections between the engine sumps and gearboxes.
options.C: Internal arrangement of wires exist between the engine sump and gearboxes.

explanation: 【译文】发动机集油槽与齿轮箱之间也存在内部连接。【词汇】engine sump=集油槽，gearbox=齿轮箱，internal connections=内部连接，also=也。【解析】B正确：“also internal connections between…and…”完整对应。A两处偏差：“are connected internally”可用但漏译“也”，单复数不符。C一处错误：“arrangement of wires”误译“内部连接”（connections）。

question: 滑油供油滤和三个磁性探测器位于润滑组件中。

options.A: The oil supply element and the three magnetic particle testing detectors are in the lubrication unit.
options.B: The oil supply filter and the three chip detectors are in the lubrication unit.
options.C: Position the oil supply filter assembly and the three magnetic chip detectors in the lubrication unit.

explanation: 【译文】滑油供油滤和三个磁性探测器位于润滑组件中。【词汇】oil supply filter=供油滤，chip detector=磁性屑末探测器（磁堵），lubrication unit=润滑组件。【解析】B正确：filter、chip detectors、are in均对应。A两处错误：“element”误译“filter”，“magnetic particle testing detectors”（磁粉探伤器）误译chip detectors。C两处错误：“Position”祈使句误作操作指令，增译assembly。

question: 干燥的喷涂层可以用细砂纸打磨以获得更光滑的表层。

options.A: The arid welding coat may be polished with thin abrasive paper to hold a smoother layer.
options.B: The waterless painting coat may be worn with precise abrasive paper for a smoother surface.
options.C: The dried spray coat may be sanded with fine sandpaper to obtain a smoother finish.

explanation: 【译文】干燥的喷涂层可用细砂纸打磨以获得更光滑的表层。【词汇】dried spray coat=干燥的喷涂层，sand=打磨，fine sandpaper=细砂纸，smoother finish=更光滑的表层。【解析】C正确：四要素全对。A三处错误：“arid”（干旱的）误译“干燥的”，“welding coat”误译“喷涂层”，“hold”误译“获得”。B三处错误：“waterless”误译“干燥”，“painting coat”不及spray coat，“worn”误译“打磨”且precise误译fine。

question: 用于修理层状结构的材料必须保持原有组件的强度、重量、气动特性或电气特性。

options.A: Materials used to repair layered structures must keep the rigidity, gravity, aerodynamic or electronic properties of the original assembly.
options.B: The materials used in the repair of laminate structures must preserve the strength, weight, aerodynamic characteristics, or electrical properties of the original assembly.
options.C: Materials that are used for fixing the layer structures must maintain the intensity, weight, aerodynamic or electrical properties of the original assembly.

explanation: 【译文】用于修理层压结构的材料必须保持原有组件的强度、重量、气动或电气特性。【词汇】laminate structure=层压结构，preserve=保持，strength=强度，electrical properties=电气特性。【解析】B正确：laminate与四属性全对。A三处错误：“rigidity”误译“强度”，“gravity”误译“重量”，“electronic”误译“电气”。C两处错误：“intensity”不及strength，“fixing”不及repair。

question: 应急照明是用于主电源失效时提供照明的独立子系统。

options.A: Emergency Lighting is a independent subsystem used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure.
options.B: Urgency Lights that supply the lights when the major electronic power fails is a separate subsystem.
options.C: Ambulance Lights is used to supply lights if the main electrical sources malfunctions as an independent subsystem.

explanation: 【译文】应急照明是在主电源失效时提供照明的独立子系统。【词汇】emergency lighting=应急照明，independent subsystem=独立子系统，primary electrical power failure=主电源失效，illumination=照明。【解析】A正确：“a independent”虽有冠词小误（应为an），三个考点均对应。B三处错误：“Urgency Lights”误译“应急照明”，“major electronic power”误译“主电源”，定语从句语法混乱。C三处错误：“Ambulance Lights”（救护车灯）误译应急照明（张冠李戴），“main electrical sources”不及power failure，句式破碎。

question: 制造商可以建立程序，当相符时，对发现的不适航情况提供反馈。

options.A: The vendor can build programs to supply response to worthless conditions found in compliance with regulations.
options.B: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered when complying.
options.C: The manufacturer may create a process to give feedback on abnormal conditions when it's conformed.

explanation: 【译文】The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered when complying.【词汇】manufacturer=制造商（vendor=供应商/厂商），establish procedures=建立程序，feedback=反馈，unairworthy=不适航的，comply=符合、相符。【解析】B正确：manufacturer对应“制造商”，unairworthy conditions对应“不适航情况”，establish procedures对应“建立程序”，when complying对应“当相符时”。A两处错误：vendor把制造商窄化为供应商，worthless（无价值的）≠unairworthy（不适航的），词义错译。C两处错误：abnormal（异常的）≠不适航，it's conformed语态错误且表达生硬，条件关系不通。

question: 飞机性能的每个项目都应包括与数据相关的重要条件的说明。

options.A: Each item of Airplane Performance shall include a statement of significant conditions associated with the data.
options.B: Each significant item in Airplane Performance should include conditions and instructions related to the data.
options.C: Each important aspect of Airplane Performance is the conditions and specifications associated with the data.

explanation: 【译文】Each item of Airplane Performance shall include a statement of significant conditions associated with the data.【词汇】item=项目，shall=应，statement=说明，significant conditions=重要条件，associated with=与…相关。【解析】A正确：each item对应“每个项目”，a statement of significant conditions对应“重要条件的说明”，associated with the data对应“与数据相关”。B两处错误：把significant移位修饰item（变成“重要项目”），且把statement错换成conditions and instructions，漏译“说明”。C句式错译：“Each important aspect…is the conditions”把“应包括说明”变成“方面是条件”，主谓关系完全失真，且漏译shall include。

question: 一般来说，希望在所有的手册中都统一地、最大限度地遵循下列章节的安排和细分。

options.A: Generally speaking, there are separate arrangements and chapter breakdown in each manual, full unification is difficult to achieve.
options.B: In general, it is mandatory for all manuals to be uniform and follow chapter arrangements and breakdown to the maximum extent.
options.C: In general, it is desired that the following chapter arrangements and breakdown be followed uniformly and to the maximum extent practicable in all manuals.

explanation: 【译文】In general, it is desired that the following chapter arrangements and breakdown be followed uniformly and to the maximum extent practicable in all manuals.【词汇】in general=一般来说，it is desired that=希望（虚拟语气），chapter arrangements and breakdown=章节安排和细分，uniformly=统一地，to the maximum extent practicable=在切实可行的最大限度内。【解析】C正确：desired对应“希望”语气准确，uniformly and to the maximum extent对应“统一地、最大限度地”，下列=following。A语义相反：说各手册安排各自独立、难以统一，与“希望统一遵循”相反。B把desired错换成mandatory（强制的），“希望”变“强制”，语气过强，且漏译following。

question: 当电源仅为一个组件或单一功能系统提供服务时，该电源将同它所服务的组件或系统一同讨论。

options.A: If a power supply system is independent to provide service to only one component or single-function system, it will be discussed together with the components or systems it serves.
options.B: When a power source services a single  component, or serves a single functioning system, that power source will be included in the discussion of the component or system which it serves.
options.C: When a power supply is a complete component or single-function system, the device it serves is discussed separately from its own component or system.

explanation: 【译文】When a power source services a single component or a single-function system, that power source will be included in the discussion of the component or system which it serves.【词汇】power source=电源，service=为…提供服务，single-function system=单一功能系统，be included in the discussion=被纳入讨论、一同讨论。【解析】B正确：services对应“提供服务”，included in the discussion of对应“一同讨论”，定语从句which it serves准确还原“它所服务的”。A两处偏差：independent to provide（独立提供）是原文没有的要素，属增译；句式别扭。C逻辑错误：说电源本身是组件或系统，把“为组件服务”误作“本身是组件”，且separately（分开讨论）与“一同讨论”方向相反。

question: 程序应在每一章内按参考编号顺序编写，并有适当的主、次标题，而不必从新的一页顶部开始每个程序。

options.A: Instead of starting each program at the top of a new page, procedures should be prepared in chapter numbering sequence, with appropriate primary and secondary headings.
options.B: Each Chapter of the procedure shall be prepared in reference number order with appropriate, hierarchical headings. The beginning of a new section of the procedure does not need to start a new page.
options.C: Procedures shall be prepared in reference number sequence within each Chapter with proper major and minor subject heads, without the necessity of each procedure starting at the top of a new page.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures shall be prepared in reference number sequence within each Chapter, with proper major and minor subject heads, without the necessity of each procedure starting at the top of a new page.【词汇】reference number sequence=参考编号顺序，within each Chapter=在每一章内，major and minor subject heads=主、次标题，without the necessity of=不必。【解析】C正确：within each Chapter、reference number sequence、major and minor subject heads、starting at the top of a new page四要素全部对应。A两处错误：漏译within each Chapter（只在章序中编排），且把procedures写成programs（程序计划），词义错译。B拆成两句后语义改变：“每个章的程序按参考编号准备”修饰错位，且new section≠each procedure，漏译“每个程序”限定。

question: 当动作的顺序对安全至关重要，在紧急程序章节中就应在开始时提供一份动作顺序检查单。

options.A: The Emergency Procedures Section shall include at the beginning a check list with regard to order of action when sequence is essential to safety.
options.B: When the sequence of actions affects safety, a list of Safety Precautions should be provided at the beginning of an Emergency Procedure Section.
options.C: The sequence of actions is critical to flight safety, so a safety checklist should be provided at the beginning of an Emergency Procedure Section.

explanation: 【译文】The Emergency Procedures Section shall include at the beginning a check list with regard to order of action when sequence is essential to safety.【词汇】Emergency Procedures Section=紧急程序章节，check list=检查单，order/sequence of action=动作顺序，essential to safety=对安全至关重要，at the beginning=在开头。【解析】A正确：主语为紧急程序章节，在开头包含动作顺序检查单，essential to safety对应“至关重要”。B两处错误：把check list错换成Safety Precautions（安全注意事项），文件类型张冠李戴；essential弱化为affects（影响）。C把“提供检查单”错改成“提供safety checklist”且前半句改写成“顺序对飞行安全关键”的独立断言，漏译order of action与check list的对应，句式失真。

question: 以下首字母缩略词在本节中可互换使用，它们分别代表同一系统和设备。

options.A: The following synonyms are used interchangeably throughout this section and they are the sample of one system and device respectively.
options.B: The following antonyms are used interchangeably throughout this section and they present the same system and device partly.
options.C: The following acronyms are used interchangeably throughout this section and they represent the same system and device respectively.

explanation: 【译文】The following acronyms are used interchangeably throughout this section and they represent the same system and device respectively.【词汇】acronym=首字母缩略词，synonym=同义词（干扰项），antonym=反义词（干扰项），interchangeably=可互换地，respectively=分别地。【解析】C正确：acronyms准确对应“首字母缩略词”，represent the same…respectively对应“分别代表同一系统和设备”。A两处错误：synonyms（同义词）≠缩略词，the sample（样本）≠the same，词义错译。B三处错误：antonyms（反义词）完全相反，present…partly（部分呈现）≠represent…respectively，关键术语全错。

question: 如果哈龙（卤代烷）灭火瓶上的手柄锁销丢失，你必须给灭火瓶称重来确认它是否充满。

options.A: If the Halon extinguisher has its lever lock pin lost, you must scale the extinguisher to make sure if it is full.
options.B: If the hand lock pin on the Halon fire flask is not there, you must weight the extinguisher to see if it is full.
options.C: If the handle lock pin on the Halon extinguisher is not there, you must weigh the extinguisher to find if it is full.

explanation: 【译文】If the handle lock pin on the Halon extinguisher is not there, you must weigh the extinguisher to find out if it is full.【词汇】handle lock pin=手柄锁销，Halon extinguisher=哈龙灭火瓶，weigh=称重（动词），full=充满的。【解析】C正确：handle lock pin、weigh（动词“称重”）、find if it is full三处对应。A两处偏差：lever（操纵杆）≠handle（手柄）；scale作动词多指“攀登/去鳞”，称重应用weigh。B三处错误：hand lock pin（手锁销）术语不准，fire flask非灭火瓶规范词，weight是名词不能作谓语动词，属语法错误。

question: 当出现低流量或冷却不充分情况时，低流量传感器向驾驶舱发出警告信号做为警示。

options.A: When showing a low flow or not sufficient cooling condition, the low flow sensor produces an alarm signal of the flight compartment for warning.
options.B: When a low flow or under cooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor provides an alarm signal to the cabin compartment for alert.
options.C: When a low flow or not sufficient cooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor supplies an alarm signal to the flight compartment for annunciation.

explanation: 【译文】When a low flow or insufficient cooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor supplies an alarm signal to the flight compartment for annunciation.【词汇】low flow=低流量，insufficient cooling=冷却不充分，sensor=传感器，alarm signal=警告信号，flight compartment=驾驶舱，annunciation=信号显示/警示。【解析】C正确：condition occurs对应“情况出现时”，supplies…to the flight compartment对应“向驾驶舱发出”，annunciation对应“警示”。A语法错误：alarm signal of the flight compartment介词用错，应为to（信号发给驾驶舱而非属于驾驶舱）。B两处错误：under cooling（在冷却中）≠冷却不充分；cabin compartment（客舱）≠flight compartment（驾驶舱），位置张冠李戴。

question: 三轴式加速计提供沿垂直、横向和纵向轴的加速度数据。飞行数据记录器系统传感器将有关飞行舵面位置和飞行控制的数据发送给FDAU。

options.A: A three-axis accelerometer gives acceleration data of the horizontal, lateral, and longitudinal axis. The flight data recorder system sensors send data about the position of the flight surfaces and controls the FDAU.
options.B: A three-axis accelerometer gives accelerating data with the vertical, parallel, and longitudinal axis. The flight data recorder system sensors send data and the position of the flight surfaces and controls to the FDAU.
options.C: A three-axis accelerometer gives acceleration data along the vertical, lateral, and longitudinal axis. The flight data recorder system sensors send data about the position of the flight surfaces and controls to the FDAU.

explanation: 【译文】A three-axis accelerometer gives acceleration data along the vertical, lateral, and longitudinal axes. The flight data recorder system sensors send data about the position of the flight surfaces and controls to the FDAU.【词汇】three-axis accelerometer=三轴式加速计，vertical/lateral/longitudinal=垂直/横向/纵向，flight data recorder=飞行数据记录器，send…to=发送给。【解析】C正确：三个轴向译名全对，send data…to the FDAU对应“发送给FDAU”。A两处错误：horizontal（水平）≠vertical（垂直）；controls the FDAU变成“控制FDAU”，把controls（操纵面）名词误当动词，语法语义双错。B两处错误：parallel（平行）≠lateral（横向）；send data and the position结构松散，漏译about关系。

question: 如果MAT上显示的通过或不通过提示与维修页面上的提示不一致，请忽略MAT上的提示。

options.A: If the passed or failed indication that shows on the MAT does not agree with the indication on the maintenance page, ignore the indication on the MAT.
options.B: If the pass or fail prompt displayed on MAT is inconsistency with the prompt on the maintenance page, please ignore the prompt on MAT.
options.C: Neglect the instruction on MAT, whether the passing or failure sign shown on the MAT or not.

explanation: 【译文】If the pass or fail indication that shows on the MAT does not agree with the indication on the maintenance page, ignore the indication on the MAT.【词汇】pass or fail=通过或不通过，indication=提示/指示，does not agree with=与…不一致，maintenance page=维修页面，ignore=忽略。【解析】A正确：does not agree with准确对应“不一致”，ignore the indication对应“忽略提示”。B语法错误：is inconsistency with中inconsistency是名词，应为is inconsistent with或is in disagreement with。C逻辑混乱：whether…or not变成“不管是否提示都忽略”，丢失“两者不一致”的比较条件，且neglect the instruction漏译比较关系。

question: 如果不使用隔页签，应提供一种识别方法，便于确定每个系统或章节的位置。

options.A: If no tabs are used, an identification method should be supplied to facilitate the location of each system or section.
options.B: If tab dividers are not used, a method of identification shall be provided to permit easy location of each System or Chapter.
options.C: An identification way should be offered to locate the system and chapter easily if the dividers are improper.

explanation: 【译文】If tab dividers are not used, a method of identification shall be provided to permit easy location of each System or Chapter.【词汇】tab divider=隔页签，method of identification=识别方法，shall be provided=应提供，permit easy location=便于定位。【解析】B正确：tab dividers为“隔页签”规范译法，permit easy location对应“便于确定位置”。A两处偏差：tabs泛指标签页不如tab dividers精确；should弱于题干“应”（shall）。C两处错误：if the dividers are improper（如果隔页签不合适）≠if not used（如果不使用），条件错译；identification way不如method of identification规范。

question: 再版是指手册的第二版或后面的版本，它取代了以前的版本。

options.A: A reprint is a second or executive version of a manual that replaces a previous version.
options.B: A reprint is a succeeding or pursuant version of a manual that supersedes the former version.
options.C: A reissue is a second or subsequent edition of a manual which supersedes the preceding edition.

explanation: 【译文】A reissue is a second or subsequent edition of a manual which supersedes the preceding edition.【词汇】reissue=再版，reprint=重印（易混：仅加印不更新），edition=版本，supersede=取代，preceding=先前的。【解析】C正确：reissue对应“再版”，second or subsequent对应“第二版或后面的”，supersedes对应“取代”。A两处错误：reprint（重印）不含更新改版之义；executive（行政的）完全无关，疑似subsequent误植。B同样用reprint错译再版，且pursuant（依照的）≠subsequent（后续的），词义错译。

question: 警告是一项操作程序、检查、修理或维修实践，如不正确执行，可能会导致人身伤害或生命损失。

options.A: Warning is an operating procedure, inspection , repair or maintenance practice , which if not correctly followed, could result in personal injury , or loss of life.
options.B: You should obey the warning in an operation procedure, check, repair or maintenance practice, otherwise person injury or death will happen.
options.C: Warning in an operation procedure, inspection , repair or maintenance practice should be followed seriously,  whereas may involve in personal injury , or loss of life .

explanation: 【译文】Warning is an operating procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance practice which, if not correctly followed, could result in personal injury or loss of life.【词汇】warning=警告（手册警示级别定义），operating procedure=操作程序，maintenance practice=维修实践，if not correctly followed=如不正确执行，result in=导致。【解析】A正确：保持定义句型（警告是一项…），could result in对应“可能导致”，personal injury or loss of life全对应。B改写成“你应该遵守警告，否则会伤亡”，丢失定义结构，且will happen语气过绝对（原文could）。C句式残缺：Warning in…缺谓语，whereas may involve语法不通，定义关系混乱。

question: 在此修订生效日期之后，新制造飞机的飞行员操作手册必须是FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。

options.A: After the valid date of this amendment,  a newly produced aircraft's pilot's manual must be approved by FAA.
options.B: After this revision date, FAA must approve a newly produced aircraft's pilot's manual .
options.C: After the effective date of this revision, Pilot's Operating Handbooks for newly manufactured airplanes must be FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manuals.

explanation: 【译文】After the effective date of this revision, Pilot's Operating Handbooks for newly manufactured airplanes must be FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manuals.【词汇】effective date=生效日期，newly manufactured=新制造的，Pilot's Operating Handbook（POH）=飞行员操作手册，FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual=FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。【解析】C正确：POH must be FAA Approved AFM完整对应“必须是FAA批准的飞机飞行手册”。A两处错误：漏译“飞机飞行手册”这一关键名词，且must be approved by FAA≠must be FAA批准的AFM（前者是被批准，后者是具备该身份）。B语序颠倒：变成“FAA必须批准手册”，主客体关系错误。

question: 如果空速值可以适用于一种以上的配置，则应使用更保守的IAS值。

options.A: If the airspeed values are necessary to more than one configuration, the more restrictive IAS shall be used.
options.B:
Where the airspeed values may be applicable to more than one 
configuration, the more conservative IAS value shall be used.
options.C: The more accurate IAS value should be used where the airspeed values are mandatory to less than one configuration.

explanation: 【译文】Where the airspeed values may be applicable to more than one configuration, the more conservative IAS value shall be used.【词汇】airspeed value=空速值，be applicable to=适用于，configuration=构型/配置，conservative=保守的，IAS=指示空速。【解析】B正确：applicable to对应“适用于”，more conservative对应“更保守的”，more than one configuration对应“一种以上”。A两处偏差：necessary to（对…必要）≠applicable to（适用于）；restrictive（限制性的）≠conservative（保守的）。C两处错误：mandatory（强制的）改变语态含义；less than one configuration（少于一种）与“一种以上”方向相反。

question: 系统的该部分是用来消除或防止在螺旋桨上结冰。

options.A:
That portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the 
formation of ice on propellers.
options.B: The function of that part of the system is to decelerate or prevent the deformation of ice on propellers.
options.C: The usage of the system portion is to accelerate or facilitate the formation of ice on propellers.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on propellers.【词汇】that portion of the system=系统的该部分，eliminate=消除，prevent=防止，formation of ice=结冰，propeller=螺旋桨。【解析】A正确：eliminate or prevent对应“消除或防止”，formation of ice on propellers对应“在螺旋桨上结冰”。B三处错误：decelerate（减速）≠eliminate，deformation（变形）≠formation，语义全偏。C方向相反：accelerate/facilitate（加速/促进）结冰，与“消除或防止”完全相反，属危险错译。

question: 系统的该部分用于飞机在地面时支撑飞机的机头。

options.A: The system part is used to support the head of the aircraft when the aircraft is on the ground.
options.B: The part of the system is to keep the aircraft nose on the ground.
options.C:
That portion of the system supports the nose of the aircraft 
while the aircraft is on the ground.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system supports the nose of the aircraft while the aircraft is on the ground.【词汇】portion=部分，support=支撑，nose=机头，on the ground=在地面。【解析】C正确：supports the nose对应“支撑机头”，while…on the ground对应“在地面时”。A两处偏差：the head of the aircraft用head（头部）不如nose（机头）规范；support the head语义生硬。B语义错译：keep the aircraft nose on the ground意为“使机头保持在地面/压住机头”，与“飞机在地面时支撑机头”的结构关系完全不同。

question: 应急照明是指单独的、独立的子系统，在主电源故障的情况下提供照明。

options.A: Emergency illumination refers to an individual and dependent subsystem which is used to provide lighting when the main electrical power fails.
options.B: Emergency lighting can provide illumination for an individual and independent subsystem in case of main electrical power failure.
options.C:
Emergency lighting is the separate and independent 
subsystem used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure.

explanation: 【译文】Emergency lighting is the separate and independent subsystem used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure.【词汇】emergency lighting=应急照明，separate and independent=单独且独立的，subsystem=子系统，in case of=在…情况下，primary electrical power=主电源。【解析】C正确：separate and independent对应“单独的、独立的”，primary electrical power failure对应“主电源故障”。A方向相反：dependent（依赖的）≠independent（独立的），与题干“独立”恰好相反。B逻辑错乱：变成“应急照明为一个子系统提供照明”，子系统成了照明受益对象，且漏译“独立的”。

question: 紧急出口是指用于方便疏散的出口门，通常不用于出口。

options.A: Emergency Exit means the exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit.
options.B: Emergency Exit is usually used as exit whose function is convenient for evacuation.
options.C: Emergency Exit stands for the exit doors but not the exit which is used to facilitate evacuation.

explanation: 【译文】Emergency Exit means the exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit.【词汇】emergency exit=紧急出口，facilitate evacuation=方便疏散，normally=通常，not used for exit=不用于出口。【解析】A正确：used to facilitate evacuation对应“用于方便疏散”，not normally used对应“通常不使用”，两处限定全对。B方向相反：usually used as exit（通常用作出口）与“通常不用于出口”完全相反。C结构混乱：stands for the exit doors but not the exit使定义自相矛盾（出口门不是出口），but not从句修饰关系错误。

question: The Maintenance Manual is furnished to the Purchaser at the time of aircraft delivery.

options.A: The Maintenance Manual is supplied by the manufacturer at the time of aircraft delivery.
options.B: When delivering the aircraft, the Maintenance Manual is provided to the buyer.
options.C: The Maintenance Manual is prepared by the manufacturer before the aircraft is delivered.

explanation: 【译文】维修手册在飞机交付时提供给购买方。【词汇】furnish=提供（正式用语，=provide/supply），Purchaser=购买方、买方，at the time of aircraft delivery=在飞机交付时。【解析】B正确：provided to the buyer对应“提供给购买方”，when delivering对应“交付时”，要素齐全。A两处偏差：主动语态加the manufacturer是原文没有的施动者（增译），且漏译to the Purchaser这一接收对象。C语义错误：prepared before delivery意为“交付前准备好”，把“交付时提供”错改为“交付前准备”，时间和动作均不符。

question: Outside Air Temperature is adjusted for instrument error and compressibility effects.

options.A: According to instrument error and compressibility effects, Outside Air Temperature is corrected.
options.B: Outside Air Temperature is set to avoid instrument error and compressibility effects.
options.C: Due to instrument error and compressibility effects, Outside Air Temperature is modified.

explanation: 【译文】外界大气温度按仪表误差和压缩性影响进行修正。【词汇】Outside Air Temperature（OAT）=外界大气温度，adjust for=针对…进行修正/调整，instrument error=仪表误差，compressibility effects=压缩性影响。【解析】A正确：is corrected对应adjusted（修正），according to引出修正依据，整体语义等价。B错译：is set to avoid意为“被设置以避免误差”，把“对误差进行修正”改成“避免误差”，动作目的错译。C两处偏差：Due to（由于）表因果而非“针对…修正”；modified（修改）不如corrected准确，属词义不到位。

question: EGT indicators identify the lean fuel flow mixtures for various power settings.

options.A: The lean fuel flow mixtures will be provided by the EGT indicators under different engine powers.
options.B: EGT indicators constantly monitor the lean fuel flow mixtures wherever the thrust lever is.
options.C: The lean fuel flow mixtures are induced by the EGT indicators to various powerplants.

explanation: 【译文】EGT指示器用于识别各种功率设置下的贫油燃油流量混合气。【词汇】EGT indicator=排气温度指示器，identify=识别/确定，lean fuel flow mixture=贫油燃油流量混合气，power setting=功率设置。【解析】B为最佳：monitor（监测）最接近identify的仪表功能，wherever the thrust lever is以油门杆位置意译various power settings，虽不完美但语义最贴近。A两处错误：provided（提供）把“识别”错成“供给”，指示器不提供混合气；engine powers≠power settings。C词义错译：induced（诱导/产生）完全改变功能，to various powerplants（各种动力装置）也偏离“功率设置”。

question: That portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces.

options.A: Restrictions on use of cabin pressurization during Takeoff, landing, or in flight shall be noted
options.B: That portion of the system is used to de-ice all airfoil surfaces once ice is formed.
options.C: All airfoil surfaces are equipped with that portion of the system to stop ice formation.

explanation: 【译文】系统的该部分用于消除或防止所有翼型表面上的结冰。【词汇】that portion of the system=系统的该部分，eliminate or prevent=消除或防止，formation of ice=结冰，airfoil surface=翼型表面。【解析】B为三者中最佳：de-ice对应“除冰/消除结冰”，all airfoil surfaces对应“所有翼型表面”，核心语义保留，但漏译prevent（防止）且加once ice is formed限定，并不完整。A与题干完全无关——内容为座舱增压使用限制，属选项错位。C句式错译：把“系统的该部分用于除冰”改成“翼型表面装有该系统部分”，主客体关系颠倒，且stop ice formation只对应“防止”而漏“消除”。

question: Restrictions on use of cabin pressurization during Takeoff, landing, or in flight shall be noted.
