options.C: 门包括可拆卸的单元用于连接进口和出口，也用于连接与机身相关的其他结构。包括乘客和机组人员门、货舱门、紧急出口等，视具体情况考虑是否包括与门控制相关的电力和液压系统。

explanation: 【译文】舱门指用于进出的以及封闭机身内部所含其他结构的可拆卸组件，包括旅客和机组舱门、货舱门、应急出口等。与舱门操纵相关的电气和液压系统视情包括在内。【词汇】removable unit=可拆卸组件，entrance or exit=进或出，enclosing=封闭/围护，fuselage=机身，passenger/crew/cargo doors=旅客/机组/货舱门，emergency exits=应急出口，associated with door control=与舱门操纵相关的。【解析】A正确：entrance or exit译“进、出”，enclosing other structure译“封闭其他结构”，as appropriate译“如恰当/视情”，定义结构完整。B两处错误：“连接进口和出口”把进出功能错成连接功能；“阻断与机身相连”把enclosing within the fuselage关系译乱。C同样两处错误：“连接进口和出口”同错；“连接与机身相关的其他结构”使封闭关系变成连接关系。

question: The engine power control system furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator, which includes controls to the propeller regulator on turbo-prop engines.

options.A: 发动机功率控制系统可以控制主燃油控制器或调节器，包括涡轮螺旋桨发动机上螺旋桨调速器的控制装置。
options.B: 发动机功率控制是控制主燃油控制器或协调器装置的系统部分，包括涡桨发动机螺旋桨调节器的控制装置。
options.C: 发动机功率控制系统提供了一种控制主燃油控制或协调器的方法，包括对涡桨发动机螺旋桨调节器的控制。

explanation: 【译文】发动机功率控制系统指提供操纵主燃油控制器或协调器手段的系统部分，包括涡轮螺旋桨发动机上螺旋桨调节器的操纵装置。【词汇】engine power control system=发动机功率控制系统，furnish a means of controlling=提供操纵…的手段，main fuel control=主燃油控制器，coordinator=协调器，propeller regulator=螺旋桨调节器，turbo-prop engine=涡轮螺旋桨发动机。【解析】B正确：coordinator译“协调器”，propeller regulator译“螺旋桨调节器”，controls译“控制装置”，关键名词完整规范。A词义错误：“主燃油控制器或调节器”把coordinator错成regulator（调节器），与后文propeller regulator撞车且丢失协调器概念。C偏差：“控制主燃油控制”缺“器”字，名词不完整；“对…调节器的控制”用control作名词略生硬，虽整体可读但术语完整性不如B，故取B。

question: The anti-icing system of the engine eliminates and prevents ice formation by bleed air in all parts of the engine (excluding power cowling), and is inclusive of several components such as valves, plumbing, regulators, etc.

options.A: 发动机防冰系统能消除和防止因引气产生的发动机部件结冰（不包括整流罩），包含活门、管路、调节器等零件。
options.B: 发动机防冰系统包括活门、管路、调节器等部件，能通过引气消除和预防发动机所有部件结冰（不包括整流罩）。
options.C: 发动机防冰系统是用于消除和防止发动机所有部件结冰的系统部分（不包括整流罩），包括活门、管路、调节器等项目。

explanation: 【译文】发动机防冰系统通过引气消除和防止发动机所有部件（不包括动力装置整流罩）结冰，该系统包括活门、管路、调节器等若干部件。【词汇】anti-icing system=防冰系统，bleed air=引气，ice formation=结冰，excluding power cowling=不包括整流罩，valves/plumbing/regulators=活门/管路/调节器。【解析】B正确：“通过引气”对应by bleed air，“消除和预防结冰”对应eliminates and prevents ice formation，部件列举齐全。A把by bleed air错解为结冰原因，译成“因引气产生的结冰”，因果关系颠倒；C把防冰系统译成“系统部分”，且完全漏译引气这一除冰手段，功能要素缺失。

question: The turbine engines include compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems, heated air systems for engine anti-icing, and engine starting systems.

options.A: 涡轮发动机包括用于控制通过发动机空气流量的压缩机排气系统，用于发动机除冰的冷却空气系统，以及发动机启动系统。
options.B: 涡轮发动机包括压气机引气系统、空气冷却系统、热空气系统、发动机启动系统，其中压气机引气系统能控制通过发动机的空气流量，空气冷却系统和热空气系统用于发动机防冰。
options.C: 涡轮发动机包括控制通过发动机空气流量的压气机引气系统、空气冷却系统、用于发动机防冰的热空气系统和发动机启动系统。

explanation: 【译文】涡轮发动机包括用于控制通过发动机的空气流量的压气机引气系统、空气冷却系统、用于发动机防冰的热空气系统以及发动机启动系统。【词汇】compressor bleed system=压气机引气系统，cooling air system=空气冷却系统，heated air system for anti-icing=用于防冰的热空气系统，starting system=启动系统。【解析】C正确：四项系统并列关系及各自用途与原句一一对应，只有heated air systems挂接防冰用途。A把heated air systems漏译，并让cooling air承担“除冰”功能，张冠李戴；B把cooling air systems也归入“用于发动机防冰”，扩大了原句防冰修饰的范围。

question: Engine fuel systems include coordinator or equivalent, engine driven fuel pump and filter assembly, main and thrust augmentor fuel controls, electronic temperature datum control, temperature datum valve, fuel manifold, fuel nozzles, fuel enrichment system, speed sensitive switch, relay box assembly, solenoid drip valve, burner drain valve, etc.

options.A: 发动机燃油系统包括协调器或与其不同作用的装置、发动机泵和滤清器总成、主和推力增强器、燃油控制装置、电子温度基准控制装置、温度基准阀、燃油歧管、燃油喷嘴、燃油浓缩系统、转速传感开关、继动箱总成、电磁滴水阀、燃烧器排水阀等。
options.B: 飞机燃油系统包括协调器或同等作用的装置、温度基准阀、燃油歧管、燃油喷嘴、燃油浓缩系统、转速传感开关、继动箱总成、电磁滴水阀、燃烧器排水阀等。
options.C: 发动机燃油系统包括调节器或同等装置、发动机驱动的燃油泵和油滤组件、主燃烧室和加力燃烧室燃油控制装置、电子温度基准控制装置、温度基准阀、燃油总管、燃油喷嘴、富油系统、转速敏感电门、继电器组件、电磁滴油阀、燃烧室排油阀等。

explanation: 【译文】发动机燃油系统包括调节器或同等装置、发动机驱动的燃油泵和油滤组件、主燃烧室和加力燃烧室燃油控制装置、电子温度基准控制装置、温度基准阀、燃油总管、燃油喷嘴、富油系统、转速敏感电门、继电器组件、电磁滴油阀、燃烧室排油阀等。【词汇】coordinator or equivalent=调节器或同等装置，engine driven fuel pump and filter assembly=发动机驱动燃油泵和油滤组件，thrust augmentor=加力燃烧室，fuel enrichment system=富油系统，fuel manifold=燃油总管。【解析】C正确：equivalent=同等装置、enrichment=富油，术语规范且部件清单完整。A把equivalent译成“与其不同作用”，意思相反，并把主燃油控制与加力燃油控制拆开罗列，结构错位；B把engine fuel systems误为“飞机燃油系统”，范围错误，还漏掉调节器、燃油泵、温度控制等多数部件。

question: For reciprocating engines, those units and components which deliver metered fuel and air to the engine. The fuel portion includes the carburetor, master control from the inlet side to the discharge nozzle(s), injection pumps, carburetor, injection nozzles and fuel primer.

options.A: 对于活塞式发动机，向发动机输送计量燃油和空气的装置和部件。燃油部分包括化油器、从进气侧到排气喷口的主控、喷油泵、化油器、喷油嘴和启动喷油装置。
options.B: 对于往复式发动机，向发动机输送燃料和燃气的装置和部件。燃料部分包括从出气侧到排气喷嘴、喷油泵、化油器、喷油嘴和燃油底火的化油器控制。
options.C: 对于往复式发动机，向发动机输送燃料和空气的装置和部件。燃料部分不包括从进气侧到排气喷嘴、喷油泵、化油器、喷油嘴和燃油底火的化油器控制。

explanation: 【译文】对于活塞式发动机，这些装置和部件向发动机输送计量的燃油和空气。燃油部分包括化油器、从进气侧到排油喷嘴的主控制器、喷油泵、喷油嘴和燃油注油装置。【词汇】reciprocating engines=活塞式/往复式发动机，metered fuel=计量燃油，discharge nozzle=排油喷嘴，injection pumps=喷油泵，fuel primer=启动注油泵。【解析】A正确：metered fuel and air=计量燃油和空气，各部件及“从进气侧到排气喷口的主控”对应完整，fuel primer译“启动喷油装置”可接受。B把air误译为“燃气”，漏译“计量”，且master control结构被拆乱；C把includes误译成“不包括”，方向相反，fuel primer又误为“燃油底火”。

question: That portion of the system from the main quick disconnect to the engine, which distributes fuel to the engine burner section and the thrust augmentor. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, temperature regulators, valves, filters, manifold, nozzles, etc. Does not include the main or thrust augmentor fuel control.

options.A: 从主快速断开装置到发动机的系统部分，能够将燃油分配到发动机燃烧室和加力燃烧室。该部分包括管路、泵、温度调节器、阀门、油滤、总管、喷嘴等。不包括主燃烧室或加力燃烧室控制装置。
options.B: 从主快速断开装置到发动机的系统部分，将燃料分配到发动机燃烧器部分和推力增强器，包括泵、温度调节器、阀门、过滤器、歧管、喷嘴等。不包括推力增强器燃料控制。
options.C: 从主快速断开装置到发动机的系统部分，将燃料分配到发动机燃烧器部分和推力增强器，包括泵、泵、温度调节器、阀门、过滤器、歧管、喷嘴等。包括主或推力增强器燃料控制。

explanation: 【译文】该系统从主快速断开接头到发动机的部分，把燃油分配到发动机燃烧室段和加力燃烧室，包括管路、泵、温度调节器、活门、油滤、总管、喷嘴等，但不包括主燃油控制器或加力燃烧室燃油控制器。【词汇】main quick disconnect=主快速断开装置，burner section=燃烧室段，thrust augmentor=加力燃烧室，manifold=总管，does not include=不包括。【解析】A正确：分配对象、部件清单（含plumbing管路）和“不包括主或加力燃烧室燃油控制”的排除项均完整。B漏译管路，并把排除项只写成“推力增强器燃料控制”，漏掉main fuel control；C重复列出“泵”，且把Does not include误译成“包括”，排除关系方向相反。

question: Those units and components are used to generate, control, distribute electrical current to ignite the fuel air mixture in the cylinders of reciprocating engines or in the combustion chambers or thrust augmentors of turbine engines.

options.A: 这些组件和部件产生、控制、分配和点燃部件的燃料气缸，为活塞式发动机或涡轮发动机的燃烧室或推力增强器中的空气混合物提供电流。
options.B: 这些组件和部件能够产生、控制、分配用于点燃活塞发动机的气缸以及涡轮发动机的燃烧室或加力燃烧室中的油气混合气所需的电流。
options.C: 这些单元和部件产生、控制、分配和点燃部件的燃料气缸，为涡喷式发动机或涡轮发动机的燃烧室或推力增强器中的空气混合物提供电流。

explanation: 【译文】这些装置和部件用于产生、控制和分配电流，以点燃活塞式发动机气缸内或涡轮发动机燃烧室、加力燃烧室内的油气混合气。【词汇】generate/control/distribute electrical current=产生、控制、分配电流，ignite=点燃，fuel-air mixture=油气混合气，reciprocating engines=活塞发动机，combustion chambers=燃烧室。【解析】B正确：“用于点燃……所需的电流”准确体现electrical current作ignite的工具，点火部位列举齐全。A把ignite的对象错搭成“燃料气缸”，点燃关系混乱，且“提供电流”语序颠倒；C同样点燃对象错乱，并把reciprocating engines误译成“涡喷式发动机”，发动机类型张冠李戴。

question: Collector/ Nozzle includes items such as collector rings, exhaust and thrust augmentor ducts, variable nozzles, actuators, plumbing, linkages, position indicators, warning systems, etc.

options.A: 集气器/喷嘴环包含集气环、排气管道和加力燃烧室管道、可调喷嘴、作动筒、管路、连接装置、位置指示器、告警系统等。
options.B: 排气系统包含集气环、废气和推力增强管道、可调喷管、作动筒、管路、连动装置、位置指示器、告警系统等。
options.C: 集气器/喷嘴包含集气环、废气和推力增强管道、固定喷管、作动筒、管路、连动装置、位置指示器、告警系统等。

explanation: 【译文】集气器/喷管包括集气环、排气和加力燃烧室管道、可调喷管、作动筒、管路、连杆机构、位置指示器、告警系统等。【词汇】collector rings=集气环，thrust augmentor ducts=加力燃烧室管道，variable nozzles=可调喷管，actuators=作动筒，linkages=连杆机构。【解析】A正确：标题Collector/Nozzle对应“集气器/喷嘴”，variable=可调，部件清单完整对应。B把标题改成“排气系统”，范围被偷换，“推力增强管道”也不如“加力燃烧室管道”规范；C把variable nozzles误译成“固定喷管”，与“可调”意思相反。

question: Propeller system includes the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, governor, alternators, and those units and components external to or integral with the engine used to control the propeller blade angel.

options.A: 螺旋桨系统包括完整的机械或电气驱动螺旋桨、泵、马达、调速器、交流发电机，以及用于控制桨叶角的发动机外部或与发动机一体的组件和部件。
options.B: 螺旋桨系统包括完整的机械或电动螺旋桨、泵、马达、调速器、交流发电机是用来控制桨叶角的发动机外部或整体的组件和部件。
options.C: 螺旋桨系统包括完整的机械或电动螺旋桨、泵、马达、调速器、交流发电机和那些组件和部件，都位于发动机外部，或者与发动机是一个整体，用于控制桨叶角。

explanation: 【译文】螺旋桨系统包括完整的机械式或电动螺旋桨、泵、马达、调速器、交流发电机，以及发动机外部或与发动机一体的、用于控制桨叶角的装置和部件。【词汇】propeller system=螺旋桨系统，governor=调速器，alternators=交流发电机，external to or integral with the engine=发动机外部或与发动机一体，blade angle=桨叶角。【解析】A正确：external to or integral with限定those units and components的关系清楚，桨叶角对应blade angle。B句子断裂，“交流发电机是用来控制……”把并列部件错接成控制主体，语法错误；C把限定关系说成所有部件“都位于”发动机外部或一体，修饰范围扩大且结构松散。

question: This section in the maintenance manual shall cover subjects such as engine changes, run-up, externally-mounted spare power plants, etc., while in the overhaul manual, it shall cover subjects such as power plant build-up, teardown, etc.

options.A: 维护手册中的这一部分内容涵盖发动机更换、试车、内部安装的动力装置零件等主题，而在大修手册中，将涵盖动力装置的安装、拆卸等主题。
options.B: 维护手册中的这一部分应涵盖发动机更换、试车、外部安装的动力装置备份等内容，而大修手册中应涵盖动力装置装配和拆解等节。
options.C: 维护手册中的这一部分内容将涵盖发动机更换、测试、外部安装的零用动力装置等主题，而在大修手册中，将涵盖动力装置的制造、拆卸等主题。

explanation: 【译文】维修手册本节应涵盖发动机更换、试车、外挂备用动力装置等内容；大修手册则应涵盖动力装置组装、分解等内容。【词汇】maintenance manual=维修手册，run-up=试车，externally-mounted spare power plants=外挂备用动力装置，overhaul manual=大修手册，build-up/teardown=组装/分解。【解析】B正确：run-up=试车、externally-mounted=外部安装、build-up/teardown=装配与拆解，两手册范围对应清楚。A把externally-mounted误译成“内部安装”，方向相反；C把run-up译成泛化的“测试”，build-up译成“制造”，均偏离原文含义。

question: Engine mounts refer to the framework, either of build-up construction or forgings, which support the engine and attach it to the nacelle or pylon.

options.A: 发动机支架用于支撑发动机，固定机舱或塔架上的框架，要么是组装式结构，要么是锻造件。
options.B: 发动机支架要么是积木式结构，要么是锻造件，用来支撑发动机并将其固定在机舱或塔架上。
options.C: 发动机支架指支撑发动机并将其固定在短舱或吊架上的框架，要么是装配结构，要么是锻造件。

explanation: 【译文】发动机安装架指支撑发动机并将其连接到短舱或吊架的框架，可以是组装结构，也可以是锻件。【词汇】engine mounts=发动机安装架，framework=框架，build-up construction=组装结构，forgings=锻件，nacelle/pylon=短舱/吊架。【解析】C正确：framework是主语中心词，either…or…说明框架的两种制造形式，“支撑并固定到短舱或吊架”关系清楚。A语序错乱，变成支架“固定机舱或塔架上的框架”，支撑对象关系颠倒；B把build-up construction直译成“积木式结构”，属望文生义的词义错译，规范译法为“组装/装配结构”。

question: The control section controls the pitch of the propeller blades, but does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly.

options.A: 控制部分控制螺旋桨叶片俯仰，但不包括任何与螺旋桨组件一起旋转的部件。
options.B: 控制部分能够控制螺旋桨桨叶的桨距，但不包括任何与螺旋桨组件一起旋转的部件。
options.C: 控制部分控制螺旋桨叶角度，包括任何与螺旋桨组件一起旋转的部件。

explanation: 【译文】控制部分控制螺旋桨桨叶的桨距，但不包括任何随螺旋桨组件一起旋转的部件。【词汇】pitch=桨距（螺旋桨语境，非俯仰），propeller blades=螺旋桨桨叶，does not include=不包括，rotate with the propeller assembly=随螺旋桨组件旋转。【解析】B正确：pitch在此指桨叶桨距，“不包括随螺旋桨组件旋转的部件”与否定结构对应。A把pitch误译为“俯仰”，螺旋桨术语应为桨距，词义错译；C把does not include反译为“包括”，排除关系方向相反，“螺旋桨叶角度”表述也不规范。

question: Engine system includes the components and units used to control and direct the flow of lubrication through the engine from the inlet fitting to the outlet fitting.

options.A: 发动机系统包含元件和部件用于控制和改变润滑剂在发动机入口和出口的流动。
options.B: 发动机系统包含控制和引导润滑油从进口流向出口的组件和部件。
options.C: 润滑剂靠发动机的元件和部件的控制和引导在发动机里产生流动。

explanation: 【译文】发动机（润滑）系统包括用于控制和引导润滑油从进口接头到出口接头流过发动机的组件和部件。【词汇】lubrication=润滑油（润滑），direct the flow=引导流动，inlet fitting/outlet fitting=进口/出口接头，components and units=组件和部件。【解析】B正确：“控制和引导润滑油从进口流向出口”准确对应control and direct the flow…from inlet to outlet。A把direct误译为“改变”，并只说“入口和出口的流动”，介词范围丢失；C把系统部件变成被动控制者，主被动关系颠倒，且漏译进出口起止点。

question: The air inlet section through which the air enters the compressor section includes items such as guide vanes, shrouds and cases.

options.A: 进气道指空气进入压气机前所经过的部分，包括导向叶片、罩环和机匣。
options.B: 空气进入压缩机部分的进气口部分包括导向叶片、护罩和箱子等项目。
options.C: 空气进入压缩机部分的进气口部分包括导向叶片、横桅索和箱子等项目。

explanation: 【译文】进气段是空气进入压气机段所经过的部分，包括导向叶片、罩环和机匣等。【词汇】air inlet section=进气段，compressor section=压气机段，guide vanes=导向叶片，shrouds=罩环，cases=机匣。【解析】A正确：air inlet section译为“进气道/进气段”，发动机语境中cases指机匣、shrouds指罩环，术语规范。B把compressor译成“压缩机”（航空发动机规范术语为压气机），cases误译为“箱子”；C除“箱子”外还把shrouds误译为“横桅索”，属字面错译。

question: The minimum jack closed height must be less than the distance between the fitting and the ground when the aircraft is on its wheels.

options.A: 当飞机离地时，最小的千斤顶的高度必须小于接头和地面之间的距离。
options.B: 给飞机安装轮子时，千斤顶的最低闭合高度不能超过顶块和地面之间的距离。
options.C: 在顶起飞机之前，最小的顶升高度必须小于顶块和地面之间的距离。

explanation: 【译文】当飞机停在机轮上（未顶起）时，千斤顶的最小闭合高度必须小于顶升接头与地面之间的距离。【词汇】jack closed height=千斤顶闭合高度，fitting=（顶升）接头/顶块，on its wheels=在机轮上（即未被顶起），less than=小于。【解析】C正确：“在顶起飞机之前”合理表达了aircraft on its wheels的未顶升状态，尺寸关系“小于顶块与地面的距离”对应准确。A把on its wheels误译为“离地时”，状态恰好相反（方向相反）；B把on its wheels误译为“安装轮子时”，完全改变了适用时机，条件错译。

question: Airbus recommends that you use jacks and a safety stay with a capacity of more than the maximum load that is permitted at the fittings.

options.A: 空客建议，使用千斤顶和辅助千斤顶时，其负载能力应大于顶块允许的最大载荷。
options.B: 空客建议，使用千斤顶和安全顶座时，顶块的负载能力应大于允许的最大载荷。
options.C: 在顶块的负载能力大于允许的最大载荷的情况下，空客建议使用千斤顶和安全支架。

explanation: 【译文】空客建议使用承载能力大于顶块处允许最大载荷的千斤顶和安全撑杆。【词汇】jacks=千斤顶，safety stay=安全撑杆/安全支座，capacity=承载能力，maximum load permitted at the fittings=顶块允许的最大载荷。【解析】A正确：capacity的归属对象是jacks和safety stay（“其负载能力”），大于顶块允许载荷的比较关系正确。B把“负载能力”错挂到“顶块”头上，比较主体张冠李戴；C把“顶块的负载能力大于允许的最大载荷”当成建议的前提条件，逻辑关系倒置，且主体同样错位。

question: This Section shall describe the airplane in a manner considered by the manufacturer to be most informative to the kind of pilot considered most likely to operate the airplane.

options.A: 根据制造商的意见，本章节描述飞机时提供了最有用的信息给最有可能驾驶飞机的飞行员。
options.B: 本章节将按照制造商考虑的方式描述飞机，以使最有可能操作该飞机的飞行员获得最多的信息。
options.C: 制造商考虑在本章节中描述飞机时提供更多的信息，以帮助飞行员更有效地操作飞机。

explanation: 【译文】本节应以制造商认为能向最可能驾驶该飞机的那类飞行员提供最多信息的方式来描述飞机。【词汇】manner considered by the manufacturer=制造商认为的方式，most informative=信息量最大的，the kind of pilot most likely to operate=最可能驾驶该飞机的飞行员。【解析】B正确：完整保留“制造商考虑的方式”和“最可能操作该飞机的飞行员获得最多信息”两层限定。A“根据制造商的意见”弱化了considered…to be most informative的判断结构；C把most informative泛化成“提供更多信息”，且漏译“最可能操作该飞机的飞行员”这一限定，要素不全。

question: A certificated pilot who owns or operates an airplane not used as an air carrier is authorized by FAR Part 43 to perform limited preventive maintenance on his airplane.

options.A: 根据FAR 43部的要求，持证飞行员可以拥有或驾驶载客飞机，并可以对其飞机实施限制范围内的预防维护。
options.B: 持有或驾驶航空器的持证飞行员由FAR 43部授权对其进行特定的预防维护。
options.C: 如果持证飞行员拥有或驾驶的飞机不用于航空承运目的，他可以按照FAR 43部授权，对飞机进行有限的预防性维护。

explanation: 【译文】拥有或驾驶不作为航空承运人使用的飞机的持证飞行员，经FAR第43部授权可对其飞机实施有限的预防性维修。【词汇】certificated pilot=持证飞行员，air carrier=航空承运人，FAR Part 43=联邦航空条例第43部，preventive maintenance=预防性维修，limited=有限的。【解析】C正确：“不用于航空承运目的”准确对应not used as an air carrier，“有限的预防性维护”保留limited限定。A把not used as an air carrier完全反译成“载客飞机”，条件方向相反；B漏译“不作为航空承运人”的适用条件和“有限”的范围限定，要素缺失。

question: The airplane general arrangement shall be illustrated with a scale line drawing consisting of plan, side and front views presented in a vertical sequence upon a single page.

options.A: 应使用比例尺图对飞机的总体布局进行说明，该比例尺图由平面图、侧视图和正面视图组成，并在单页上以垂直顺序展示。
options.B: 应使用气动布局图对飞机总体安排进行说明，说明内容包括计划、侧面图和正面图，并以垂直顺序在单页上列出。
options.C: 应在单页上以横向顺序的呈现方式对飞机总体布局和示意图进行说明，包括平面图、侧视图和正面视图。

explanation: 【译文】飞机总体布局应用一幅比例线图表示，由平面图、侧视图和正视图组成，按竖直顺序排布在同一页上。【词汇】general arrangement=总体布局，scale line drawing=比例线图，plan/side/front views=平面/侧视/正视图，vertical sequence=竖直顺序，single page=同一页。【解析】A正确：比例尺图、三视图组成及单页垂直排序全部对应。B把scale line drawing误为“气动布局图”，plan误译为“计划”，两处词义错译；C把vertical sequence误译为“横向顺序”，方向错误，并把line drawing泛化成“示意图”。

question: This method is recommended as minimizing errors of distribution, and also informs owners of the availability of systems and equipment.

options.A: 为了减少分配误差，推荐使用该方法，同时将系统和设备的功能特性告知所有者。
options.B: 为使辨别时产生的误差最小化，推荐使用该方法，同时对所有者说明系统和设备的使用方式。
options.C: 建议采用该方法，以最大程度地减少分配出错，同时使所有者获知系统和设备的可用性。

explanation: 【译文】建议采用这种方法，因为它能最大限度地减少分发差错，同时告知所有人系统和设备的可获得性。【词汇】minimizing errors=最大程度减少差错，distribution=分发/分配，informs owners=告知所有人，availability=可获得性/可用性。【解析】C正确：“最大程度地减少分配出错”对应minimizing errors of distribution，“使所有者获知可用性”对应informs owners of the availability。A把availability误译为“功能特性”，词义错译；B把distribution误译为“辨别”、availability误译为“使用方式”，两个关键名词均错。

question: Revisions, additions and deletions shall be identified by a vertical black line along the outside of the page opposite only that portion of the printed matter that was changed.

options.A: 用黑色字体在页面外侧对改版、补充和删除进行说明，对应于已经更改的部分打印内容。
options.B: 应在书页外侧以垂直黑线标记修订、增加和删除之处，仅对应于印刷件中已更改的内容。
options.C: 对于经过修订和增删的文字，沿书页外侧用粗黑直线加以标识，并仅打印修改内容部分。

explanation: 【译文】修订、增加和删除应用竖直黑线在页外侧标出，只与印刷内容中实际改动的部分相对。【词汇】revisions/additions/deletions=修订/增加/删除，vertical black line=竖直黑线，outside of the page=页外侧，opposite=与……相对（对应），printed matter that was changed=已更改的印刷内容。【解析】B正确：竖直黑线的标记方式、位置（书页外侧）及“仅对应已更改内容”的范围限定完整。A把vertical black line误译为“黑色字体”，标记方式错译；C把opposite理解为“仅打印修改内容部分”，把对应标记关系错改成打印范围，语义偏差大。

question: These ALIs are mandatory and cannot be changed or deleted without the approval of the FAA office that is responsible for the airplane model Type Certificate, or applicable regulatory agency.

options.A: 这些ALIs 是强制性的，未经负责飞机型号证书的FAA 办公室或适用的监管机构的批准，不能更改或删除。
options.B: 这些ALIs 是指令性的，未经FAA办公室批准不得更改或删除。FAA办公室负责飞机型号证书，或发布适用的管理规章。
options.C: 这些ALIs 是非常必要的，任何更改或删除必须获得FAA办公室批准，或者其他可以颁发飞机型号证书的监管机构的批准。

explanation: 【译文】这些ALI是强制性的，未经负责该飞机型号合格证的FAA办公室或相应监管机构批准，不得更改或删除。【词汇】ALI（Airworthiness Limitation Items）=适航限制项目，mandatory=强制性的，Type Certificate=型号合格证，applicable regulatory agency=相应监管机构。【解析】A正确：mandatory=强制性，批准主体“负责型号证书的FAA办公室或适用监管机构”完整。B把mandatory译为“指令性的”尚可，但把applicable regulatory agency误拆成“发布适用的管理规章”，职责表述走样；C把mandatory译成“非常必要的”弱化强制性，并把监管机构说成“可以颁发型号证书的”，职责张冠李戴。

question: The backside of the title page should be left blank to avoid the need for revision and potential loss of the inserted airplane serial and registration numbers.

options.A: 标题页的背面应留白，以避免版本更新以及插入的飞机生产线号和注册号丢失的情况。
options.B: 标题页的背面应留白，以免需要改版，以及可能遗漏插入的飞机序列号和注册号。
options.C: 在标题页的背面留空以便于修订需要，同时避免丢失插入的飞机序列号和生产线号。

explanation: 【译文】扉页背面应留空，以免需要修订以及插入的飞机序列号和注册号可能丢失。【词汇】title page=扉页/标题页，left blank=留空，serial number=序列号（非生产线号），registration number=注册号，loss=丢失。【解析】B正确：“以免需要改版”对应avoid the need for revision，“可能遗漏”对应potential loss，serial=序列号准确。A把serial误译为“生产线号”，serial number标准译法是序列号，词义错译；C把registration误译为“生产线号”，且“以便于修订需要”把避免修订译成了方便修订，逻辑相反。

question: Format and layout is to be determined by the CAP producer, recognizing that it is desirable that the format and layout be similar to the producer's existing documents.

options.A: 格式和布局应由CAP编写者决定，且应与CAP编写者现有文件的格式和布局相似。
options.B: CAP编写者决定格式和排版，并认可与编写者现有文件格式类似的格式和排版。
options.C: 确认与CAP编写者的现有文件相似后，由CAP编写者批准确定表格和设计。

explanation: 【译文】格式和布局由CAP编制者决定，但应认识到其格式和布局最好与编制者现有文件相似。【词汇】format and layout=格式和布局，CAP producer=CAP编制者，desirable=所期望的/最好，existing documents=现有文件，recognizing that=认识到。【解析】A正确：“由CAP编写者决定”对应determined by the CAP producer，“应与现有文件相似”传达desirable的期望语气。B把recognizing误译为“认可”，desirable的期望义也未体现；C把format and layout误译为“表格和设计”，determined误译为“批准确定”，术语和程序均错。

question: Warnings and cautions shall precede the text to which each applies, but notes may precede or follow applicable text depending on the material to be highlighted.

options.A: 警告和注意事项中的文字将标为粗体，而注释可以在适用的文本之后，取决于要重点突出的材料。
options.B: 为了突出材料的重点，警告和注意事项应在其适用的文本之前，但注释可以在适用文本之前或之后。
options.C: 警告和注意事项应在其适用的文本之前，但注释可以在适用文本之前或之后，具体取决于要突出显示的材料。

explanation: 【译文】警告和注意应位于各自适用文字之前，而注释可视要突出的内容位于适用文字之前或之后。【词汇】warnings and cautions=警告和注意，precede=位于……之前，notes=注释，follow=位于……之后，material to be highlighted=要突出显示的内容。【解析】C正确：warnings/cautions必须前置、notes可前可后、取决于突出材料的完整逻辑都保留。A把shall precede the text误译为“文字将标为粗体”，位置要求变成格式要求，完全错译；B把条件从句译成目的状语“为了突出材料的重点”，depending on的逻辑归属发生改变，不如C严谨。

question: If contamination causes a blockage of more than 50 percent of the holes, then clean the holes on the rear of the display units.

options.A: 如果超过50%的污染物造成孔堵塞，则要清理显示组件背面的孔。
options.B: 如果污染物造成孔堵塞超过 50%，就要清洁显示组件后面的孔。
options.C: 如果50%的孔被污染物堵塞，则要清理显示组件底部的孔。

explanation: 【译文】如果污染物造成超过50%的孔堵塞，则应清洁显示组件后部的孔。【词汇】contamination=污染物，blockage=堵塞，more than 50 percent of the holes=超过50%的孔，rear=后部/背面，display units=显示组件。【解析】B正确：“孔堵塞超过50%”中50%修饰被堵的孔，rear of the display units译“后面”可接受。A把50%错挂到“污染物”上（“超过50%的污染物”），限定对象错位；C把rear误译为“底部”，位置错译，且“50%的孔”限定表述也不如B完整。

question: This information should be included in vendor publications where applicable and included in the aircraft maintenance manual where vendor data has been integrated as part of the aircraft manual.

options.A: 如适用，该信息应包含在供应商出版物中。如果供应商数据已并入为飞机手册的一部分，则该信息同时包含在飞机维修手册中。
options.B: 这些信息包含在适用的供应商出版物中，并包含在飞机维护手册中，手册中也包括了部分相关的供应商数据。
options.C: 这类信息不仅包含在供应商出版物的适当位置，还包含在飞机维修手册中，同时部分供应商数据也合并入飞机手册中。

explanation: 【译文】在适用情况下，该信息应纳入供应商出版物；当供应商数据已被并入并构成飞机手册的一部分时，也应纳入飞机维修手册。【词汇】vendor publications=供应商出版物，where applicable=在适用情况下，aircraft maintenance manual=飞机维修手册，integrated=并入/整合。【解析】A正确：两个“包含”的条件结构（如适用、供应商数据已并入手册时）对应清楚。B把“供应商数据已并入为手册一部分”的条件弱化成“手册中也包括了部分相关数据”，逻辑限定走样；C用“不仅……还……”把两个where条件关系改成递进关系，条件限定丢失。

question: Some airplanes, particularly relatively simple airplanes, may not need CAPs because adequate information to maintain their continuing airworthiness throughout their useful lives is contained in the airplane's maintenance manual.

options.A: 一些飞机，尤其是相对简单的飞机，可以不需要CAP，因为飞机维修手册中包含了足够的信息，可以确保飞机在整个使用寿命中保持持续适航。
options.B: 一些飞机，即一些特别简单的飞机，可能不需要CAP，因为关于这些飞机的有效信息可以确保飞机在整个使用寿命中持续适航，这些信息包含在飞机维修手册中。
options.C: 一些飞机，特别是相对简单的飞机，可能不需要CAP，因为有充足的信息保持飞机在整个使用过程中持续适航，它们的使用寿命包含在飞机维修手册中。

explanation: 【译文】有些飞机，特别是相对简单的飞机，可能不需要CAP，因为飞机的维修手册中已包含足够信息，可在其整个使用寿命内保持持续适航。【词汇】particularly=特别是，relatively simple=相对简单，continuing airworthiness=持续适航，useful lives=使用寿命，adequate information=足够信息。【解析】A正确：particularly=尤其，adequate information对应“足够的信息”，information contained in maintenance manual的归属关系正确。B把particularly误译为“即”，解释关系错误，adequate也被弱化成“有效的”；C把information contained in the manual错接成“它们的使用寿命包含在手册中”，定语修饰对象张冠李戴。

question: 维修资料需要持续更新。出现新情况时，运营人应立即与制造商进行坦诚沟通，而制造商应向运营人提供有力协助。只有双方均做好各自工作，整个机队才能保持适航状态。

options.A: Maintenance information needs to be continuously updated. The operator should communicate openly with the manufacturer about new situations, who should provide solid assistance to the operator. Only when both parties do their jobs can the entire fleet remain completely safe.
options.B: Maintenance information needs to be continually updated. Open communication should exist with the operator telling the manufacturer as soon as some new kind of situation arises and the manufacturer responding back with solid help to the operators. Only when both ends do their job can an entire fleet of airplanes remain continuously airworthy.
options.C: Maintenance information needs to be continuously updated. When a new situation arises, the operator should immediately communicate openly with the manufacturer, and the manufacturer should provide strong assistance to the operator. Only when both parties do their respective jobs can the entire fleet maintain airworthiness.

explanation: 【译文】Maintenance information needs to be continuously updated. When a new situation arises, the operator should immediately communicate openly with the manufacturer, and the manufacturer should provide strong assistance to the operator. Only when both parties do their respective jobs can the entire fleet maintain airworthiness.【词汇】maintenance information=维修资料，communicate openly=坦诚沟通，respective jobs=各自工作，airworthy=适航状态，fleet=机队。【解析】C正确：When a new situation arises对应“出现新情况时”，immediately+openly对应“立即”“坦诚”，maintain airworthiness对应“保持适航状态”。A把“适航状态”误译成completely safe，概念错译，且who从句指代松散；B基本达意但“as soon as some new kind of situation arises”拖沓，“both ends”指代双方不规范，整体对应度不如C。

question: 经FAA批准的“适航限制”应作为单独文件，除需包含在《维护手册》中外，还需纳入《飞行员操作手册》的“限制部分”中。

options.A: The FAA-Approved Airworthiness Limitations shall be prepared as a separate document for inclusion in the Maintenance Manual and for insertion in the “Limitations Section” of the Pilot's Operating Handbook.
options.B: FAA-approved Airworthiness Restrictions should be prepared as a separate document and included in the “Restrictions Section” of the Maintenance Manual and the Pilot’s Operating Manual.
options.C: The airworthiness restrictions approved by FAA should be prepared as separate documents and included in the "Limitations" section of the Maintenance Manual and the "Pilot Operations Manual".

explanation: 【译文】The FAA-Approved Airworthiness Limitations shall be prepared as a separate document for inclusion in the Maintenance Manual and for insertion in the “Limitations Section” of the Pilot's Operating Handbook.【词汇】Airworthiness Limitations=适航限制，separate document=单独文件，Maintenance Manual=维护手册，Pilot's Operating Handbook（POH）=飞行员操作手册，Limitations Section=限制部分。【解析】A正确：Airworthiness Limitations和Limitations Section均为标准术语，“包含在维护手册中”+“纳入飞行员操作手册限制部分”两层关系清楚。B把Limitations误为Restrictions，且把“限制部分”错挂到维护手册上；C同样用restrictions错译术语，结构改成维护手册的“Limitations”部分，归属关系全乱。

question: 制造商在交付飞机时提供的建议性检查程序有助于保证其适航性。由于飞机执行的任务、给予的维护以及使用年限和使用率存在差异，ABC公司已根据检查、测试和分析确定，认为有必要提供额外的检查要求，以进一步确保飞机能够继续在初始审定的设计载荷下运行。

options.A: The recommended inspection procedure provided by the manufacturer when delivering the aircraft helps to ensure its airworthiness throughout its life. Due to differences in the tasks performed, maintenance provided, service life, and usage rate of the aircraft, ABC Company has determined through inspection, testing, and analysis that it is necessary to provide additional inspection requirements to further ensure that the aircraft can continue to operate under the initial approved design load.
options.B: The recommended inspection procedures provided by the manufacturer at the time of delivery of the aircraft help ensure its airworthiness. Due to differences in the missions performed, maintenance given and the age and utilization of the aircraft, ABC has determined, based on inspections, testing and analysis, that additional inspection requirements are deemed necessary to further ensure that the aircraft can continue to operate at the initially validated design loads.
options.C: The airplanes were delivered with recommended inspection programs to keep them airworthy. Because of the varied missions the airplanes performed, type of care given, and age and utilization rates, ABC has determined, based on inspections, tests, and analyses, that it is necessary to provide additional inspection requirements to further ensure that the airplanes can continue to carry the design loads it was originally certified for.

explanation: 【译文】The recommended inspection procedures provided by the manufacturer at the time of delivery of the aircraft help ensure its airworthiness. Due to differences in the missions performed, maintenance given and the age and utilization of the aircraft, ABC has determined, based on inspections, testing and analysis, that additional inspection requirements are deemed necessary to further ensure that the aircraft can continue to operate at the initially validated design loads.【词汇】inspection procedures=检查程序，at the time of delivery=交付时，missions=任务，utilization=使用率，initially validated design loads=初始审定的设计载荷。【解析】B正确：missions对应“任务”、age and utilization对应“使用年限和使用率”、validated对应“审定”，句式紧凑。A多出throughout its life这一原文没有的信息，approved也不如validated贴切“审定”；C把“维护”译成type of care given过于随意，“carry the design loads”动宾搭配不如operate at the design loads规范。

question: 操作测试：这个过程仅需要确定系统或单元是可工作的。这些测试不应需要除已安装在飞机上外的任何特殊设备或设施，应该与机组人员执行的测试相当。操作测试不要求满足针对翻修或重大修理制定的规范和容错要求。

options.A:
Operational Test: That procedure required to ascertain only that
a system or unit is operable. These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that are installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crew. It is not intended that the  operational test of the unit shall meet the specifications and tolerances ordinarily
established for overhaul, or major maintenance periods.
options.B:
Operational Test: That procedure required to  ascertain only that
a system or unit is operable. These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that are installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crew. It is not intended that the  operational test of the unit shall meet the specifications and errors ordinarily established for overhaul, or significant maintenance periods.
options.C:
Operational Test: That procedure required to ascertain only that
a system or unit is operable. These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that are installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crew. It is not intended that the  operational test of the unit shall meet the specifications and tolerances ordinarily established for overhaul, or significant maintenance periods.

explanation: 【译文】Operational Test: That procedure required to ascertain only that a system or unit is operable. These tests should require no special equipment or facilities other than that are installed on the aircraft and should be comparable to the tests performed by the flight crew. It is not intended that the operational test of the unit shall meet the specifications and tolerances ordinarily established for overhaul, or major maintenance periods.【词汇】ascertain=确定，operable=可工作的，special equipment or facilities=特殊设备或设施，flight crew=机组人员，specifications and tolerances=规范和容差，overhaul/major maintenance periods=翻修/重大修理。【解析】A正确：tolerances对应“容错要求”、major maintenance periods对应“重大修理”，全部要素齐备。B把tolerances误为errors，specifications and errors不成规范术语；C把major误为significant，major maintenance在维修间隔语境中对应“重大修理”，significant用词不精确。

question: 在有座舱增压的飞机上，座舱空气的分配是由一系列管路实现的，管路连接到增压空气源遍及整个座舱。空气被引导到飞机飞机顶板的通风口并从那里释放出来.

options.A: On pressurized aircraft, the cabin air is distributed with a system of air ducts leaded from the pressurization source into and throughout the cabin. Typically, air is ducted to and released from ceiling ventilation.
options.B: Distribution of cabin air on pressurized aircraft is managed with a system of air ducts leading from the pressurization source into and throughout the cabin. Typically, air is ducted to and released from ceiling vents.
options.C: On pressurized aircraft cabin air is distributed with a system of air ducts leaded from the pressurization source into and throughout the cabin. Typically, air is ducted to and released from ceiling flap.

explanation: 【译文】Distribution of cabin air on pressurized aircraft is managed with a system of air ducts leading from the pressurization source into and throughout the cabin. Typically, air is ducted to and released from ceiling vents.【词汇】pressurized aircraft=有座舱增压的飞机，air ducts=空气管路，leading from=从……引出/连接，ceiling vents=顶板通风口，is ducted to=被引导到。【解析】B正确：leading（现在分词）表示管路从增压源引出并贯穿座舱，ceiling vents准确对应“顶板的通风口”。A用leaded（lead的过去分词为led且此处需主动引导义），语法错误，ceiling ventilation指“顶板通风”而非“通风口”；C同样leaded错误，并把vents误译为flap（盖板/襟翼），术语完全错误。

question: 临界迎角是液体或气流从表面开始分离，导致流体效率降低的角度。临界迎角是设计空气动力学表面时的重要考虑因素，例如飞机机翼、涡轮叶片等，因为它决定着不会导致升力或推力损失的最大攻角大小。

options.A: Crucial angle of attack is the angle at which a stream or air flow begins to split from a surface,causing a decrease in efficiency. It is important for designing dynamic surfaces ,such as airplane wings,turbine blades,as it determines the maximum attack angle that can be achieved without causing loss of lift or thrust.
options.B: Crutial angle of attack is the angle at which a stream or air flow begins to seperate from a surface,causing a decrease in efficiency. It is important for designing aerodynamic surfaces ,such as airplane airfoils,turbine blades,as it determines the maximum attack angle that can be achieved without causing loss of lift or thrust.
options.C: Critical angle of attack is the angle at which a fluid or air flow begins to separate from a surface, causing a reduction in the efficiency of the flow. The critical attack angle is an important consideration in the design of aerodynamic surfaces, such as airplane wings, turbine blades, as it determines the maximum angle of attack that can be achieved without causing a loss of lift or propulsion.

explanation: 【译文】Critical angle of attack is the angle at which a fluid or air flow begins to separate from a surface, causing a reduction in the efficiency of the flow. The critical attack angle is an important consideration in the design of aerodynamic surfaces, such as airplane wings, turbine blades, as it determines the maximum angle of attack that can be achieved without causing a loss of lift or propulsion.【词汇】critical angle of attack=临界迎角，separate from a surface=从表面分离，aerodynamic surfaces=空气动力学表面，angle of attack=攻角/迎角，loss of lift or propulsion=升力或推力损失。【解析】C正确：Critical为“临界”标准术语，separate对应“分离”，aerodynamic surfaces对应“空气动力学表面”。A把critical误为crucial（关键的）、separate误为split（劈开），dynamic surfaces漏掉aero-；B拼写错误（Crutial/seperate），且用airfoils替代“空气动力学表面”，范围变窄。

question: 封面题名应为《飞行员操作手册》或《飞行员操作手册及经联邦航空局批准的飞机飞行手册》。

options.A: The cover title shall be "Pilot's Operating Handbook" or "Polit's Operating Handbook and FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual."
options.B: The name of the book might be "Pilot's Operating Handbook" or "FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual."
options.C: The cover could be named as "Pilot's Operation Instruction" or "Pilot's Operation Instruction and FAA Approved Airplane Flight Instruction."

explanation: 【译文】The cover title shall be "Pilot's Operating Handbook" or "Pilot's Operating Handbook and FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual."【词汇】cover title=封面题名，Pilot's Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册，FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manual=经联邦航空局批准的飞机飞行手册，shall=应（规范用语）。【解析】A正确：完整保留“或”连接的两种题名形式及组合标题结构，shall对应“应”。B把“封面题名”弱化为name of the book，且漏掉复合题名中“飞行员操作手册及…”的前半部分，might也不如shall规范；C把Operating Handbook误译为Operation Instruction（操作说明）、Flight Manual误译为Flight Instruction（飞行教学），手册术语全部走样。

question: 最大操作限制速度是指在正常飞行操作中不得故意超过的速度限制。V用节表示，M用马赫数表示。

options.A: Maximum Limiting speed Unsticks is the speed restrain which will not be intentionally surpassed in typical flight operations. V is communicated in knots and M in Mach Number.
options.B: Maximum Restriction Speed is the fastest a plane can fly without breaking the rules in normal flight. The speed is measured in knots and Mach Number.
options.C: Maximum Operating Limit Speed is the speed limit that may not be deliberately exceeded in normal flight operations. V is expressed in knots and M in Mach Number.

explanation: 【译文】Maximum Operating Limit Speed is the speed limit that may not be deliberately exceeded in normal flight operations. V is expressed in knots and M in Mach Number.【词汇】Maximum Operating Limit Speed=最大操作限制速度，deliberately exceeded=故意超过，normal flight operations=正常飞行操作，knots=节，Mach Number=马赫数。【解析】C正确：术语Maximum Operating Limit Speed、deliberately、expressed in全部规范对应。A术语破碎（Maximum Limiting speed Unsticks不知所云），restrain/surpassed用词不当；B是口语化改写，“fastest a plane can fly without breaking the rules”完全丢失“操作限制速度”术语和规范语体。

question: 地面慢车功率指满足飞机以最小推力在地面尽可能慢地运行，但足以保证发动机、发动机附件和飞机正常运行所需的发动机功率。

options.A: Ground Idle Power refers to the power required to run an engine on the ground, as slowly as possible, yet sufficient to ensure satisfactory engine, engine accessory, and airplane operation with a minimum of thrust.
options.B: Ground Idle Power refers to the power required to run an engine as slowly as appropriate on the ground while still ensuring satisfactory airplane operation with a maximum of thrust of engine and engine accessory.
options.C: For Ground Idle Power, it determines the minimum power necessary to initiate and maintain safe airplane operation, engine accessory function, and satisfactory engine performance while limiting the degree of thrust utilized.

explanation: 【译文】Ground Idle Power refers to the power required to run an engine on the ground, as slowly as possible, yet sufficient to ensure satisfactory engine, engine accessory, and airplane operation with a minimum of thrust.【词汇】Ground Idle Power=地面慢车功率，as slowly as possible=尽可能慢，sufficient to ensure=足以保证，minimum of thrust=最小推力，engine accessories=发动机附件。【解析】A正确：on the ground+as slowly as possible对应“在地面尽可能慢地运行”，minimum of thrust对应“最小推力”，satisfactory…operation对应“正常运行”。B把minimum of thrust误为maximum of thrust（最大推力），方向相反；C用initiate and maintain（启动并维持）替换了“以最小推力满足运行”的含义，定义结构失真。

question: 在某些涡轮螺旋桨驱动的飞机上，状态杆是发动机启动和停车的主要控制装置。在其它类型的飞机上，状态杆主要用来控制设置发动机和螺旋桨速度。

options.A: On some turbopropeller powered airplanes, the condition lever is the primary control for starting and stopping the engine. On others, it is the primary control used to set engine and propeller speed.
options.B: On some piston powered airplanes, the condition lever is the secondary control for starting and shutting the engine. On others, it is the secondary control used to set engine and piston speed.
options.C: On some turbopropeller powered airplanes, the status lever is the secondary control for starting and shutting the engine. On others, it is the secondary control used to set engine and propeller speed.

explanation: 【译文】On some turbopropeller powered airplanes, the condition lever is the primary control for starting and stopping the engine. On others, it is the primary control used to set engine and propeller speed.【词汇】turbopropeller powered=涡轮螺旋桨驱动，condition lever=状态杆，primary control=主要控制装置，starting and stopping=启动和停车，set engine and propeller speed=设置发动机和螺旋桨速度。【解析】A正确：turbopropeller、condition lever、primary control、starting and stopping全部对应准确。B把turbopropeller误为piston powered（活塞动力），primary误为secondary（次要），propeller speed误为piston speed，三处错；C把condition误为status（术语错误），primary两处均误为secondary，主次关系颠倒。

question: “加速-停止距离”是指飞机加速到某一特定速度，并假设刚获得该速度的瞬间一发失效，将飞机停止所需要的距离。

options.A: Accelerated Stopping Distance is the distance required to decelerate an aircraft to a particular speed and, assuming one of the engines fails at the instant that speed is reached, bring the aircraft to a stop
options.B: Accelerate-Stop Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a specified speed and, assuming failure of an engine at the instant that speed is attained, to bring the airplane to a stop.
options.C: Accelerate-Stop Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a required speed and, assuming failure of two engines alternatively when a speed is reached, to bring the airplane to a stop.

explanation: 【译文】Accelerate-Stop Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a specified speed and, assuming failure of an engine at the instant that speed is attained, to bring the airplane to a stop.【词汇】Accelerate-Stop Distance=加速-停止距离，specified speed=特定速度，failure of an engine=一发失效，at the instant=在……瞬间，bring to a stop=使停止。【解析】B正确：accelerate对应“加速到”，an engine对应“一发”，attained对应“获得该速度”，术语规范。A把accelerate误为decelerate（减速），方向相反，Accelerated Stopping Distance术语也不规范；C把an engine误为two engines alternatively（两台发动机交替），数量错误，required speed也不如specified贴切。

question: 发动机运行限制包括起飞功率限制、最大连续功率限制以及最大正常运行功率限制。

options.A: Engine Operating Limits include Limits for Take off Power, Maximum Continuous Power, and Maximum Cruising Power.
options.B: Engine Operating Limits include limits for Take off Thrust, Maximum Cruise Power, and Maximum Normal Operating Power.
options.C: Engine Operating Limits include limits for Take off Power, Maximum Continuous Power, and Maximum Normal Operating Power.

explanation: 【译文】Engine Operating Limits include limits for Takeoff Power, Maximum Continuous Power, and Maximum Normal Operating Power.【词汇】Engine Operating Limits=发动机运行限制，Takeoff Power=起飞功率，Maximum Continuous Power=最大连续功率，Maximum Normal Operating Power=最大正常运行功率。【解析】C正确：三项功率限制名称与中文一一对应，无增无减。A把“最大正常运行功率”误译为Maximum Cruising Power（最大巡航功率），第三项张冠李戴；B把“起飞功率”误为Takeoff Thrust（起飞推力，推力≠功率），第二项又译成Maximum Cruise Power，两处术语错位。

question: 飞机型号数据单内列出的最大连续功率用来表明符合相应的适航标准，同时这个数值也会呈现在《飞行员操作手册》中。

options.A: The maximum continuous power listed in the Airplane Type Data Sheet is used to show compliance with the applicable airworthiness standards and is the value shown in the Pilot's Operating Handbook.
options.B: The maximum continuous power listed in the Airplane Type certificate is often used to show compliance with the applicable airworthiness standards and is the value shown in the Pilot's Operating Handbook.
options.C: The maximum continuous power listed in the Airplane Type Data Sheet is used to show compliance with the applicable airworthiness regulations and is beyond the value shown in the Pilot's Operating Handbook.

explanation: 【译文】The maximum continuous power listed in the Airplane Type Data Sheet is used to show compliance with the applicable airworthiness standards and is the value shown in the Pilot's Operating Handbook.【词汇】maximum continuous power=最大连续功率，Airplane Type Data Sheet=飞机型号数据单，show compliance with=表明符合，airworthiness standards=适航标准，Pilot's Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册。【解析】A正确：Type Data Sheet对应“型号数据单”，standards对应“标准”，is the value shown对应“也会呈现”。B把Data Sheet误为Type certificate（型号合格证，证件≠数据单），又加了原文没有的often；C把standards弱化成regulations，并把“是同一数值”反译为beyond the value（超出该数值），关系错误。

question: 对于光洁巡航构型和着陆构型，应提供以加速度g表示的机动限制载荷系数。对于获准螺旋或特技飞行的飞机，还应提供襟翼收上时的负限制载荷系数。

options.A: For clean configuration of landing, the limit load factor in g unit should be provided. For spinning and aerobatic aircraft, the load factor of flaps down should be provided as well.
options.B: The limit maneuvering load factors, in g units of acceleration, for clean cruise and landing configurations, shall be given. The negative g limit, flaps up, should be given for aircraft approved for spinning or aerobatics.
options.C: The flight maneuver load factor limit in the unit of g should be given for the smooth configuration of aircraft cruising and landing. For aircraft approved for spin or aerobatics, load limits should also be provided when flaps are opened.

explanation: 【译文】The limit maneuvering load factors, in g units of acceleration, for clean cruise and landing configurations, shall be given. The negative g limit, flaps up, should be given for aircraft approved for spinning or aerobatics.【词汇】limit maneuvering load factors=机动限制载荷系数，g units of acceleration=以加速度g表示，clean cruise and landing configurations=光洁巡航和着陆构型，negative g limit=负限制载荷系数，flaps up=襟翼收上。【解析】B正确：clean cruise and landing两种构型、negative g limit及flaps up均准确对应。A漏译cruise构型，把flaps up误为flaps down（襟翼放下），方向相反，且未译“负”载荷系数；C把flaps up误为flaps are opened（襟翼打开），smooth configuration也不如clean规范，negative要素缺失。

question: 针对飞机类别适合的机动飞行，应提供以下信息：(a)获准的机动飞行以及合适的进入速度的相关信息；(b)未获授权的机动飞行的相关信息；(c)已获准或未获准或不适合进行螺旋训练的相关信息。

options.A: The following information on maneuvers appropriate to the Airplane Category shall be given: (a) A Statement of Authorized Maneuvers and Appropriate Entry Speeds (b) A Statement of Unauthorized Maneuvers (c) A Statement that the airplane is Approved for Spins, Unapproved for Spins, or is characteristically incapable of spinning.
options.B: The following information should be provided to the maneuver flight as appropriate: (a) A Statement of Entry Speed for Authorized Maneuvers (b) A Statement of Unauthorized Maneuvers (c) A Statement that aircraft is Unapproved or not suitable for Spinning.
options.C: The following appropriate information should be provided to the aircraft maneuvers: (a) A Statement of Appropriate Entry Speed for maneuvers flight (b) A Statement of Unauthorized maneuvers (c) A Statement that aircraft has been unapproved for Spins, or is characteristically incapable of spinning.

explanation: 【译文】The following information on maneuvers appropriate to the Airplane Category shall be given: (a) a statement of authorized maneuvers and appropriate entry speeds; (b) a statement of unauthorized maneuvers; (c) a statement that the airplane is approved for spins, unapproved for spins, or is characteristically incapable of spinning.【词汇】Airplane Category=飞机类别，authorized maneuvers=获准的机动飞行，entry speeds=进入速度，unauthorized=未获授权的，characteristically incapable of spinning=特性上不能进行螺旋。【解析】A正确：(a)(b)(c)三项并列内容与中文完全对应，spins三种状态表述完整。B的(a)漏掉authorized maneuvers本身，(c)漏掉approved情形，要素缺失；C把“获准的机动飞行”误为maneuvers flight，(c)漏掉已获准情形，且appropriate to the aircraft maneuvers语序错误。

question: 所有单发飞机，除那些已被证明“典型无法螺旋”的飞机外，其手册应包含从螺旋中改出的程序。

options.A: Manuals for all single engine aircraft, except those that have been shown to be "critically unable to stall", should have procedures for recovering from a stall.
options.B: Handbooks for all single engine airplanes, other than for those airplanes which have been shown to be "characteristically incapable of spinning" shall contain procedures for recovery from spins.
options.C: Manuals for single engine aircraft, otherwise these that have been proved to be "featured unable to spin", should include steps for recovering from a spiral.

explanation: 【译文】Handbooks for all single engine airplanes, other than for those airplanes which have been shown to be "characteristically incapable of spinning" shall contain procedures for recovery from spins.【词汇】single engine airplanes=单发飞机，other than=除……外，characteristically incapable of spinning=典型无法螺旋，recovery from spins=从螺旋中改出。【解析】B正确：spin/spinning全程对应“螺旋”，other than例外结构和procedures for recovery均准确。A把spinning误为stall（失速），“无法螺旋”误为“无法失速”，关键概念张冠李戴；C用featured unable to spin不规范，spiral（盘旋下降）与spin（尾旋）是不同概念，steps也不如procedures规范。

question: 如果飞机尚未进行螺旋特性和改出方法的测试，（手册）应包含防止进入螺旋和可能的最佳改出技术的讨论，并附带说明飞机未进行任何相关测试、螺旋改出技术是基于制造商的最佳判断。

options.A: If the airplane has not been tested for twirl characteristics and recovery methods, a discussion shall be included on the limited conditions for preventing spins and the possible best recovery techniques, and it shall be stated that no testing has been conducted and that the recovery techniques are based on the manufacturer's best comment.
options.B: If the airplane has not been tested for spin characteristics and recovery methods, a discussion of prevention of spins and probable best recovery techniques will be included with a notation that no tests were made and the recovery techniques are based on the best judgment of the manufacturer.
options.C: If the aircraft has not been expanded for spin features and recovery ways, prevention of spin and possible best recovery techniques are discussed and it is determined that no exams have been performed and that recovery techniques are based on the manufacturer's best judgment.

explanation: 【译文】If the airplane has not been tested for spin characteristics and recovery methods, a discussion of prevention of spins and probable best recovery techniques will be included with a notation that no tests were made and the recovery techniques are based on the best judgment of the manufacturer.【词汇】spin characteristics=螺旋特性，recovery methods/techniques=改出方法/技术，prevention of spins=防止进入螺旋，notation=附带说明，best judgment=最佳判断。【解析】B正确：tested for spin characteristics、prevention of spins、notation、best judgment均与中文准确对应。A把spin误为twirl（旋转，非尾旋术语），best judgment误为best comment（最佳评论），两处词义错译；C把tested误为expanded，exams替代tests，features/ways等非规范用词使句意失真。

question: 本节中所使用的空速应为指示空速——即假设仪表误差为零——以使信息尽可能直接可用。

options.A: Airspeeds used in this Section shall be specified in Indicated Airspeed, assuming zero instrument error, in order to make the information as directly usable as possible.
options.B: This Section shall use Indicated Airspeed as Airspeed, i.e. the instrument is mostly accurate, so the information can be used directly.
options.C: Airspeed used in this Section shall be defined as Indicated Airspeed, that is, the instrument is almost right, so as to make the information possibly be used directly.

explanation: 【译文】Airspeeds used in this Section shall be specified in Indicated Airspeed, assuming zero instrument error, in order to make the information as directly usable as possible.【词汇】Indicated Airspeed=指示空速，assuming zero instrument error=假设仪表误差为零，as directly usable as possible=尽可能直接可用，specified in=以……规定。【解析】A正确：zero instrument error严格对应“仪表误差为零”，as…as possible对应“尽可能”。B把zero instrument error弱化成the instrument is mostly accurate（仪表基本准确），程度完全改变；C同样用almost right弱化零误差假设，possibly be used directly语序和程度均失真。

question: 这些组件和部件能够储存燃油并将燃油输送到发动机，包括发动机驱动的燃油泵、结构油箱（软油箱）、阀门、增压泵等，以及实施空中应急放油的部件。

options.A: Those units and components  are responsible for storing and delivering fuel to the turbines system, including engine-driven fuel pumps, fuel tanks (airbags), valves, booster pumps, etc. and provide components for dumping fuel overboard.
options.B: Those units and components are used to store and deliver fuel to the engine, including engine-driven fuel pumps,  integral tanks (bladder), valves, boost pumps, etc., and those components which furnish a means of  in-flight fuel dumping .
options.C: Those units and components are designed to store and deliver fuel to the gas engine system, including engine-driven fuel pumps, fuel tanks (airbags), valves, booster pumps, etc. and units to pour fuel to the air.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components are used to store and deliver fuel to the engine, including engine-driven fuel pumps, integral tanks (bladder), valves, boost pumps, etc., and those components which furnish a means of in-flight fuel dumping.【词汇】store and deliver fuel=储存和输送燃油，engine-driven fuel pumps=发动机驱动燃油泵，integral tanks (bladder)=结构油箱（软油箱），boost pumps=增压泵，in-flight fuel dumping=空中应急放油。【解析】B正确：deliver fuel to the engine对应“输送到发动机”，integral tanks (bladder)对应“结构油箱（软油箱）”，in-flight fuel dumping对应“空中应急放油”。A把engine误为turbines system，bladder误为airbags（气囊）；C把engine误为gas engine system，airbags同样错误，pour fuel to the air口语化且不专业。

question: 此系统部分用于储存燃油，包括结构油箱密封胶、软油箱、通风系统、软油箱和结构油箱相互连通装置、翼上加油口颈和口盖等。

options.A: That portion of the system  is responsible for the fuel storage components in the system, comprising of storage tank, bag battery, ventilation system, battery and storage tank interconnection device, neck and cover of the wing filler, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to store fuel, including integral tank sealing, bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, over wing filler necks and caps, etc.
options.C: A portion in a system can store fuel. Covering storage tank sealing, bag battery, ventilation system, battery and storage tank interconnection device, overhead neck and cover of the wing filler, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to store fuel, including integral tank sealing, bladder type cells, ventilating system, cell and tank interconnectors, over wing filler necks and caps, etc.【词汇】integral tank sealing=结构油箱密封胶，bladder type cells=软油箱，ventilating system=通风系统，interconnectors=相互连通装置，over wing filler necks and caps=翼上加油口颈和口盖。【解析】B正确：cell在此指（软）油箱囊，interconnectors对应“相互连通装置”，filler necks and caps对应“加油口颈和口盖”。A把cell误译为battery（电池），sealing漏“胶”义，bag battery不成立；C句子不成完整定义句式，bag battery、overhead neck等术语多处错译。

question: 相关组件和部件包含：乙醇泵、阀门、存储箱、螺旋桨防冰系统、机翼加热器、水管加热器、空速管加热器、进气道加热器、风挡雨刮，以及风挡防冰中的电防冰和热防冰装置。不包括基本的风挡面板。

options.A: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, alcohol container, propeller anti-icing system, wing warmers, water line warmers, pitot warmers, scoop warmers, windshield wipers and the electrical anti-icing and heated air ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.
options.B: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.
options.C: Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, plumbing heaters, air speed tube heaters, intake heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air ice control for windshield. Does not include the basic windshield panel.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components include alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel.【词汇】alcohol pump=乙醇泵，wing/water line/pitot/scoop heaters=机翼/水管/空速管/进气道加热器，windshield wipers=风挡雨刮，electrical and heated air portion=电和热空气部分，windshield ice control=风挡防冰。【解析】B正确：heaters系列对应“加热器”，the electrical and heated air portion准确表达“电防冰和热防冰装置”所属部分。A把heaters全部译成warmers（取暖器），规格降低，container替代tanks也不够规范，portion未译出；C把water line误为plumbing，pitot误为air speed tube，scoop误为intake，术语不统一且漏译portion。

question: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止进气道内部或周围积冰，包含动力装置整流罩防冰装置。

options.A: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent ice forming in air exhaust surroundings, including air flow anti-icing on the power plant.
options.B: The portion of the system  is used to get rid of or facilitate the gathering of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant protector ice control.
options.C: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant cowling anti-icing.

explanation: 【译文】The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant cowling anti-icing.【词汇】eliminate or prevent=消除或阻止，formation of ice=积冰/结冰，air intakes=进气道，power plant cowling=动力装置整流罩，anti-icing=防冰。【解析】C正确：formation of ice对应“积冰”，in or around air intakes对应“内部或周围”，cowling anti-icing对应“整流罩防冰”。A把air intakes误为air exhaust surroundings（排气周围），cowling误为air flow，防冰对象全错；B把prevent（阻止）反译为facilitate（促进），意思相反，protector也误代cowling。

question: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止所有翼型表面积冰,包括机翼和尾翼的翼面部分。

options.A: The portion of the system  is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces, including wings and airfoil sections of the empennage.
options.B: The portion of the system  is used to dispel or get rid of ice gathering on some aircraft surfaces, including wings and empennage surfaces.
options.C: The portion of the system is used to eliminate or forbid ice forming on outside parts of all airfoils, including the airfoils of wings and empennage.

explanation: 【译文】The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces, including wings and airfoil sections of the empennage.【词汇】airfoil surfaces=翼型表面，empennage=尾翼，airfoil sections=翼面部分，wings=机翼，prevent the formation of ice=阻止积冰。【解析】A正确：all airfoil surfaces对应“所有翼型表面”，empennage对应“尾翼”，wings and airfoil sections of the empennage结构准确。B把all airfoil surfaces缩窄为some aircraft surfaces（一些飞机表面），范围错误，且漏译“翼面部分”；C把prevent误为forbid（禁止，语气不当），outside parts不如surfaces准确。

question: 该系统中的这一部分能够使飞机在地面上滑行和制动，并在起落架收上后使机轮停止转动，具体包括旋转轴密封装置、防滑装置、压力指示器、管道等。

options.A: That portion of the system  provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as wing illumination, warning light dimming systems, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.C: That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation before retraction, including items such as supply valves, anti-skid devices, pressure warning systems, plumbing, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction, including items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.【词汇】rolling and stopping=滑行和制动，stopping wheel rotation=使机轮停止转动，after retraction=收上后，swivel glands=旋转轴密封装置，anti-skid devices=防滑装置。【解析】A正确：after retraction对应“收上后”，swivel glands和anti-skid devices对应部件清单。B把swivel glands、anti-skid devices替换成wing illumination、warning light dimming systems（照明类），部件张冠李戴；C把after retraction误为before retraction（收上前），方向相反，swivel glands误为supply valves。

question: 这些组件和部件能够提供外部和内部照明，包括着陆灯、滑行灯、航行灯、旋转式信号灯、积冰信号灯、主警告灯、乘客阅读灯和机舱顶灯等。

options.A: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, cabin warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.
options.B: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.
options.C: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, navigation, position indicating, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin floor lights, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, master warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.【词汇】external and internal illumination=外部和内部照明，landing/taxi/position lights=着陆/滑行/航行灯，rotating lights=旋转式信号灯，ice lights=积冰信号灯，master warning lights=主警告灯，cabin dome lights=机舱顶灯。【解析】B正确：灯具清单逐项对应，master warning lights和cabin dome lights术语准确。A把master warning lights误为cabin warning lights（座舱警告灯），警告主体张冠李戴；C把rotating/position lights拆分重组成navigation、position indicating，并将cabin dome lights误为cabin floor lights（地板灯）。

question: 该系统中的这一部分用来控制飞机在地面上的运动方向，包括作动筒油缸、操纵装置、轮架旋转开锁装置等。

options.A: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft off the ground, including items such as shock strut, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as skid blocks, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.
options.C: That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground, including items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.【词汇】direction of movement=运动方向，on the ground=在地面上，actuating cylinders=作动筒油缸，controls=操纵装置，bogie swivel unlock=轮架旋转开锁装置。【解析】C正确：on the ground对应“地面上”，actuating cylinders对应“作动筒油缸”。A把on the ground误为off the ground（离地），方向相反，actuating cylinders误为shock strut（减震支柱）；B把actuating cylinders误为skid blocks（滑块），部件错译。

question: 导航和皮托管/静压系统指那些提供飞机导航信息的组件和部件，包括甚高频全向信标、皮托管、静压管、仪表着陆系统、飞行指引仪、罗盘、指示器等。

options.A: Navigation and full/static pressure systems refer to those units and components that provide aircraft navigation information, covering OOMB, pitot, static, ILS, flight guides, binnacles, indicators, etc.
options.B: Navigation and pitot/static systems refer to those units and components which provide aircraft navigational information, including VOR, pitot, static, ILS, flight director, compasses, indicators, etc.
options.C: Navigation and pitot/static systems refer to those units and components that provide aircraft navigation information, including VOR, pitot, still tubes, instrumental system, flight manual, compasses, indicator, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Navigation and pitot/static systems refer to those units and components which provide aircraft navigational information, including VOR, pitot, static, ILS, flight director, compasses, indicators, etc.【词汇】pitot/static systems=皮托管/静压系统，VOR=甚高频全向信标，ILS=仪表着陆系统，flight director=飞行指引仪，compasses=罗盘，indicators=指示器。【解析】B正确：pitot/static、VOR、ILS、flight director、compasses全部为标准缩写和规范术语。A把pitot误为full，VOR误拼为OOMB，flight director误为flight guides；C把static误为still tubes，ILS误为instrumental system（仪表系统≠仪表着陆系统），flight director误为flight manual（飞行手册）。

question: 着陆和滑行助航设备包括航向道、下滑道、仪表着陆系统、信标、地面制导系统等项目。

options.A: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, ground guidance systems, etc.
options.B: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, sliding way, ILS, markers, landing navigation system, etc.
options.C: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, sliding way, instrumental system, markers, ground lighting system, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, ground guidance systems, etc.【词汇】Landing and Taxiing Aids=着陆和滑行助航设备，localizer=航向道，glide slope=下滑道，markers=信标，ground guidance systems=地面制导系统。【解析】A正确：localizer、glide slope、markers、ground guidance systems逐项对应。B把glide slope误为sliding way（滑动道），ground guidance误为landing navigation system（着陆导航系统）；C除sliding way错误外，还把ILS误为instrumental system，ground guidance误为ground lighting system（地面照明系统）。

question: 相关位置确定包括测距仪、应答机、无线电罗盘、罗兰、甚高频全向信标台、自动定向仪等部件。

options.A: Land navigation includes items such as DM, transponders, fluxgate compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.
options.B: Independent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, DF, etc.
options.C: Dependent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Dependent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.【词汇】Dependent Position Determining=相关（非自主）位置确定，DME=测距仪，transponders=应答机，radio compass=无线电罗盘，LORAN=罗兰，ADF=自动定向仪。【解析】C正确：Dependent对应“相关”（依赖地面台），DME和ADF均为标准缩写，部件清单齐全。A把标题误为Land navigation（陆地导航），DME误拼为DM，部件也有出入；B把Dependent反译为Independent（自主式），概念相反，ADF漏写A变成DF。

question: 发动机功率控制系统可以控制主燃油控制器或调节器，包括涡轮螺旋桨发动机上螺旋桨调速器的控制装置。

options.A: The engine power control system manages and controls the main fuel control or synchronizer, which is inclusive of controls to the propeller modulator on a turboprop engine.
options.B: The engine power control system furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator, which includes controls to the propeller regulator on turbo-prop engines.
options.C: The engine power control system regulates and controls the main oil, coordinator and propeller regulator of a turboprop engine.

explanation: 【译文】The engine power control system furnishes a means of controlling the main fuel control or coordinator, which includes controls to the propeller regulator on turbo-prop engines.【词汇】engine power control system=发动机功率控制系统，furnishes a means of controlling=提供控制手段，main fuel control=主燃油控制器，coordinator=调节器，propeller regulator=螺旋桨调速器，turbo-prop engines=涡轮螺旋桨发动机。【解析】B正确：control or coordinator对应“控制器或调节器”，controls to the propeller regulator对应“到螺旋桨调速器的控制装置”。A把coordinator误为synchronizer（同步器），regulator误为modulator（调制器）；C把fuel control误为main oil（主滑油），控制链路关系也表达混乱。

question: 涡轮发动机包括控制流经发动机空气流量的压气机引气系统、空气冷却系统、用于发动机防冰的热空气系统和发动机启动系统。

options.A: The turbo engine includes a compressor bleed system, air cooling system, hot air system, and engine starting system. The compressor bleed system can control the airflow through the engine, and the air cooling and hot air systems are used for engine anti-icing.
options.B: The turbo engine includes a compressor exhaust system for controlling the airflow through the engine, a cooling air system for engine icing, and an engine starting system.
options.C: The turbine engines include compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems, heated air systems for engine anti-icing, and engine starting systems.

explanation: 【译文】The turbine engines include compressor bleed systems used to control flow of air through the engine, cooling air systems, heated air systems for engine anti-icing, and engine starting systems.【词汇】turbine engines=涡轮发动机，compressor bleed systems=压气机引气系统，control flow of air=控制空气流量，cooling air systems=空气冷却系统，heated air systems for anti-icing=用于防冰的热空气系统。【解析】C正确：四项系统并列清晰，只有heated air systems挂接for engine anti-icing，修饰范围正确。A把cooling和heated air都写成用于anti-icing，扩大了防冰修饰范围；B把bleed误为exhaust（排气），anti-icing误为icing（结冰），且漏译热空气系统。

question: 涡桨发动机控制装置包括到调节器或等效装置的连杆装置和控制装置，以及从调节器或等效装置到螺旋浆调速器、燃油控制组件的连杆装置和控制装置，或其他受控组件。

options.A: The turboprop engine controls include linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent and from the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit, or other units being controlled.
options.B: The control device of a turbojet engine includes a linkage mechanism and control device to a coordinator or equivalent device, as well as a linkage mechanism from a coordinator or equivalent device to a propeller governor, fuel control component, or other controlled components.
options.C: The turboprop engine controls include a coordinator or equivalent device, a linkage mechanism, a control device, a propeller governor, a fuel control component, or other controlled components.

explanation: 【译文】The turboprop engine controls include linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent and from the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit, or other units being controlled.【词汇】turboprop engine controls=涡桨发动机控制装置，linkages=连杆装置，coordinator or equivalent=调节器或等效装置，propeller governor=螺旋桨调速器，fuel control unit=燃油控制组件。【解析】A正确：to the coordinator和from the coordinator to…两层方向关系完整保留“到”和“从”的控制链路。B把turboprop误为turbojet（涡轮喷气），发动机类型张冠李戴；C只罗列部件清单，完全丢失to/from的层级控制关系，变成部件堆砌。

question: 动力装置是指包括发动机、进气道、安装架、整流罩、勺形进气口、整流罩盖板、冷却隔板等在内的整体动力组合。

options.A: The power plant refers to the overall power package, including engine, air intake, bracket, cowling, nacelle, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.
options.B: The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, scoops, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.
options.C: The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, nacelle caps, fairing flaps, cooling baffles, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The power plant refers to the overall power package inclusive of engine, air intake, mount, cowling, scoops, cowl flaps, cooling baffles, etc.【词汇】power plant=动力装置，overall power package=整体动力组合，mount=安装架，scoops=勺形进气口，cowl flaps=整流罩盖板，cooling baffles=冷却隔板。【解析】B正确：mount对应“安装架”，scoops对应“勺形进气口”，cowl flaps对应“整流罩盖板”。A把mount误为bracket（托架），scoops误为nacelle（短舱）；C把scoops误为nacelle caps，cowl flaps误为fairing flaps（整流片），两个部件均错。

question: 在STE中，如何为程序写句子（第5节)和如何为描述性文本写句子(第6节）有不同的规则。

options.A: In STE, there are different rules for how to write sentences for procedures (Section 5) and for how to write them for descriptive text (Section 6).
options.B: In STE, there are different rules for why to write paragraphs for procedures (Section 5) and for why to write them for descriptive text (Section 6).
options.C: How to write sentences for programs (Section 5) and how to write sentences for operative text (Section 6) have different means in STE.

explanation: 【译文】In STE, there are different rules for how to write sentences for procedures (Section 5) and for how to write them for descriptive text (Section 6).【词汇】STE=简化技术英语，rules=规则，sentences=句子，procedures=程序，descriptive text=描述性文本。【解析】A正确：how对应“如何”，sentences对应“句子”，procedures/descriptive text及节号对应准确。B把how误为why（为何），sentences误为paragraphs（段落），疑问对象和内容双重错位；C把procedures误为programs，descriptive text误为operative text，且different means偏离different rules。

question: 当你替换一个单词时，总是确保你选择的替代词不会改变句子的意思。

options.A: When you change a word, always assure that the alternative you choose does not change the sequence of the sentence.
options.B: When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.
options.C: When you exchange a word, always ensure that the alternative you pick does not change the order of the sentence.

explanation: 【译文】When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.【词汇】replace=替换，alternative=替代词，select=选择，meaning=意思/语义，sentence=句子。【解析】B正确：replace对应“替换”，alternative对应“替代词”，meaning of the sentence对应“句子的意思”。A把meaning误为sequence（顺序），“不改变句子顺序”与“不改变意思”是不同要求，词义错译；C同样把meaning误为order（语序），exchange也不如replace贴切“替换”。

question: 编制STE是为了帮助英语文档的读者来理解他们所读的内容，特别是当这些读者为非英语母语者。

options.A: STE was researched to help the writers of English-language file understand what they write, particularly when these writers are non-native English speakers.
options.B: STE is prepared to make readers of English-language documents know what they read difficultly, especially when these readers are native English speakers.
options.C: STE was developed to help the readers of English-language documentation understand what they read, particularly when these readers are non-native English speakers.

explanation: 【译文】STE was developed to help the readers of English-language documentation understand what they read, particularly when these readers are non-native English speakers.【词汇】developed=编制/制定，readers=读者，English-language documentation=英语文档，understand what they read=理解所读内容，non-native English speakers=非英语母语者。【解析】C正确：readers、what they read、non-native全部对应准确，developed对应“编制”。A把readers误为writers（作者）、read误为write，服务对象完全颠倒；B把non-native误为native（母语者），方向相反，know what they read difficultly也语病频出。

question: 在设计原理图时，有必要折衷两方面：使示意图具有一目了然的详细性和便于阅读和理解的简单性。

options.A: In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to combine two aspects: specification necessary to make the diagram clear; And the similarity essential for ease of reading and understanding.
options.B: In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to comprehend two aspects: detection necessary to make the diagram self-contained; And the simplification essential for ease of reading and understanding.
options.C: In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to compromise two aspects: detail necessary to make the diagram self-explanatory; And the simplicity essential for ease of reading and understanding.

explanation: 【译文】In designing schematic diagrams, it may be necessary to compromise two aspects: detail necessary to make the diagram self-explanatory; and the simplicity essential for ease of reading and understanding.【词汇】schematic diagrams=示意图/原理图，compromise=折衷，detail=详细性，self-explanatory=一目了然，simplicity=简单性，ease of reading and understanding=便于阅读和理解。【解析】C正确：compromise对应“折衷”，detail/self-explanatory/simplicity三考点全对。A把compromise误为combine（结合），simplicity误为similarity（相似性），specification误代detail；B把compromise误为comprehend（理解），detail误为detection（探测），词形相近但词义全错。

question: 定义符号、缩写和术语对于清楚地理解手册各部分提供的信息是必要的。

options.A: It is necessary to define symbols, abbreviations and terminology for the clear understanding of the information presented in various sections of the Handbook.
options.B: Define signatures, short words and jargon necessary for understanding clearly of the information contained in every section of the Handbook.
options.C: It is important to define signs, acronyms and nomenclature for the understanding of the information provided in these sections of the Handbook.

explanation: 【译文】It is necessary to define symbols, abbreviations and terminology for the clear understanding of the information presented in various sections of the Handbook.【词汇】define=定义，symbols=符号，abbreviations=缩写，terminology=术语，clear understanding=清楚地理解，various sections=各部分。【解析】A正确：symbols/abbreviations/terminology三术语规范，necessary对应“必要”，presented对应“提供”。B把symbols误为signatures（签名），abbreviations误为short words（非术语），terminology误为jargon（行话，贬义）；C把necessary弱化为important，terminology用nomenclature不够规范，these sections限定也不如various。

question: 机身包含蒙皮、隔框、桁条、地板梁、地板、尾锥，以及机身到机翼和尾翼的整流片等。

options.A: The fuselage includes skin, stringers, frames, floor beams, floor, tail cone, and fuselage to wing and tail fittings, etc.
options.B: The fuselage includes skin, frames, stringers, floor beams, floor, tail cone, and fuselage to wing and empennage fillets, etc.
options.C: The fuselage includes skin, beams, stringers, floor frames, floor, tail skid, and fuselage to wing and rear fairings, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The fuselage includes skin, frames, stringers, floor beams, floor, tail cone, and fuselage to wing and empennage fillets, etc.【词汇】fuselage=机身，skin=蒙皮，frames=隔框，stringers=桁条，floor beams=地板梁，tail cone=尾锥，empennage fillets=尾翼整流片。【解析】B正确：隔框=frames、桁条=stringers顺序对应，empennage fillets准确对应“尾翼整流片”。A把frames与stringers顺序颠倒，empennage fillets误为tail fittings（尾部接头），部件概念错误；C把frames误为beams，floor beams误为floor frames，tail cone误为tail skid（尾橇），empennage fillets误为rear fairings，多处部件错译。

question: 紧急程序检查单应简明扼要，旨在提醒飞行员检查的项目，但不应提供任何系统操作的细节。

options.A: The emergency procedures check list should be in concise, abbreviated form designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.
options.B: The normal procedures check list which should be in concise, abbreviated form is designed to tell pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.
options.C: The content of the emergency procedures check list should be in concise, abbreviated form and its purpose is to remind flight attendants of items to check with providing details concerning the operation of any system.

explanation: 【译文】The emergency procedures check list should be in concise, abbreviated form designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.【词汇】emergency procedures check list=紧急程序检查单，concise, abbreviated form=简明扼要，remind pilots of items=提醒飞行员检查项目，without providing details=不提供细节，operation of any system=任何系统操作。【解析】A正确：emergency对应“紧急”，without providing对应“不应提供”。B把emergency误为normal（正常程序），检查单性质张冠李戴；C把pilots误为flight attendants（乘务员），并把without反译为with providing，否定关系颠倒。

question: 目视检查将前发动机安装座连接到风扇框架的螺栓是否正确安装以及是否有损坏。

options.A: Visually check the forward engine mount to the fan frame bolts if they are correctly installed and damaged.
options.B: Do a visual check of the bolts which attach the forward engine mount to the fan frame for the correct installation and damage.
options.C: Visually check the correct installation and damage of the forward engine mount to the fan frame bolts.

explanation: 【译文】Do a visual check of the bolts which attach the forward engine mount to the fan frame for the correct installation and damage.【词汇】visual check=目视检查，bolts which attach A to B=把A连接到B的螺栓，forward engine mount=前发动机安装座，fan frame=风扇框架，correct installation and damage=正确安装与损坏。【解析】B正确：which attach引导的定语从句清楚表达“连接安装座与风扇框架的螺栓”，check…for installation and damage结构规范。A把attach关系写成mount to the fan frame bolts，螺栓与安装座的连接关系混乱；C把检查对象错改成correct installation and damage本身，螺栓要素缺失，句子重心错误。

question: 航空器审定服务办公室是在副局长领导下的各办公室中的一个，它的职责是监督航空器审定管理局及华盛顿总部与设计、生产和适航审定有关的各项工作。

options.A: Among the offices under the Associate Administrator is the Aircraft Certification Service, which has the responsibility for overseeing the Aircraft Certification Directorate, and the Washington Headquarters operations related to design, production, and airworthiness certification.
options.B: Aircraft Certification Directorate which is one of the offices under the Associate Administrator is responsible for overseeing the Aircraft Certification  Service, and the Washington Headquarters operations related to design, production, and airworthiness
options.C: Overseeing the Aircraft Certification Directorate, and the Washington Headquarters operations related to design, production, and approval is the duty of Aircraft Certification Service that is among the offices under the Associate Administrator.

explanation: 【译文】Among the offices under the Associate Administrator is the Aircraft Certification Service, which has the responsibility for overseeing the Aircraft Certification Directorate, and the Washington Headquarters operations related to design, production, and airworthiness certification.【词汇】Associate Administrator=副局长，Aircraft Certification Service=航空器审定服务办公室，overseeing=监督，Aircraft Certification Directorate=航空器审定管理局，airworthiness certification=适航审定。【解析】A正确：Service监督Directorate的主客体关系正确，design/production/airworthiness certification三项齐全。B把Service和Directorate主客对调，变成管理局监督服务办公室，职责颠倒；C把airworthiness certification漏成approval（批准），适航审定要素缺失。

question: 发动机的一部分，包括曲轴、主连杆总成、凸轮、凸轮传动齿轮、挺杆导套、滚柱、托架等。

options.A: The section of the engine which contains the sleeve, master and link rod assemblies, cams, cam drive  gears, tappet guides, rollers, carriers, etc.
options.B: The section of the engine which contains the crankshaft, master and link rod assemblies, cams, cam drive  gears, tappet guides, rollers, carriers, etc.
options.C: The section of the engine which contains the crankshaft, master and manifold assemblies, cams, cam drive  gears, tappet guides, rollers, carriers, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The section of the engine which contains the crankshaft, master and link rod assemblies, cams, cam drive gears, tappet guides, rollers, carriers, etc.【词汇】crankshaft=曲轴，master and link rod assemblies=主连杆总成，cams=凸轮，cam drive gears=凸轮传动齿轮，tappet guides=挺杆导套，rollers/carriers=滚柱/托架。【解析】B正确：crankshaft对应“曲轴”，link rod对应“连杆”，全部部件术语准确。A把crankshaft误为sleeve（衬套），核心部件错译；C把link rod误为manifold（歧管），连杆总成变成歧管总成，部件张冠李戴。

question: 在飞行中，使发动机以最低速度运转所需的功率，以确保满意的发动机运行和飞机操纵特性。

options.A: The power required to run an engine, in flight, at the lowest speed that will ensure satisfactory engine operation and airplane handling system.
options.B: The power required to run an engine, in flight, at the lowest speed that will ensure satisfactory engine operation and airplane handling characteristics.
options.C: The power required to run an engine, in flight, at the lowest speed that will ensure correct engine operation and airplane handling characteristics.

explanation: 【译文】The power required to run an engine, in flight, at the lowest speed that will ensure satisfactory engine operation and airplane handling characteristics.【词汇】in flight=在飞行中，lowest speed=最低速度，satisfactory=满意的，engine operation=发动机运行，airplane handling characteristics=飞机操纵特性。【解析】B正确：satisfactory对应“满意的”，handling characteristics对应“操纵特性”，术语规范。A把characteristics误为system（系统），handling system≠handling characteristics；C把satisfactory换成correct（正确的），程度与原文“满意/符合要求”的语义有偏差，不如B准确。

question: 数据应显示为时间、燃料和从海平面上升的距离与外部空气温度、高度和重量的关系。

options.A: Data shall be managed as time, fuel and distance to climb from sea level versus outside air temperature, altitude and weight.
options.B: Data shall be presented as time, fuel and distance to climb from sea level versus outside air temperature, altitude and weight.
options.C: Data shall be presented as time, fuel and distance to lift from sea level to outside air temperature, altitude and weight.

explanation: 【译文】Data shall be presented as time, fuel and distance to climb from sea level versus outside air temperature, altitude and weight.【词汇】presented=显示/表示，distance to climb=上升距离，from sea level=从海平面，versus=与……的关系（对比），outside air temperature=外部空气温度，altitude and weight=高度和重量。【解析】B正确：presented对应“显示”，versus对应“与……的关系”，climb对应“上升”。A把presented误为managed（管理），数据呈现方式错译；C把climb误为lift（升力），versus误为to，把“与……的关系”错改成方向，两处错。

question: 要指出的是，在对飞机进行任何改装之前，都应该先与联邦航空局联系，以确保飞机的适航性不受影响。

options.A: Point out that the FAA should be contacted prior to any alterations on airplane to ensure that the airworthiness of the airplane is not violated.
options.B: Point out that the FAA should be informed after any modifications on airplane to ensure that the airworthiness of the airplane is not effected .
options.C: Point out that any modifications on airplane may be informed to FAA to confirm  the airworthiness of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】Point out that the FAA should be contacted prior to any alterations on airplane to ensure that the airworthiness of the airplane is not violated.【词汇】contacted=联系，prior to=在……之前，alterations/modifications=改装，ensure=确保，airworthiness is not violated=适航性不受影响。【解析】A正确：prior to对应“之前”，contacted对应“联系”，not violated对应“不受影响”。B把prior to反译为after（之后），时间关系方向相反，effected误用（应为affected）；C把“应先联系以确保”的强制关系弱化为may be informed（可以告知），义务语气全失。

question: 附加信息或说明,例如“向制造商报告发现的任何裂纹”，包含在此。

options.A: Other information or messages, e.g."Report to the manufacturer about the cracks existed", is included here.
options.B: Additional information or instructions,such as "Report any cracks found to this manufacturer”, are contained here.
options.C: You can find the following instructions here, for example " Report any scratches to the OEM".

explanation: 【译文】Additional information or instructions, such as "Report any cracks found to the manufacturer", are contained here.【词汇】additional information=附加信息，instructions=说明，cracks found=发现的裂纹，report to the manufacturer=向制造商报告，contained here=包含在此。【解析】B正确：Additional对应“附加”，cracks found对应“发现的裂纹”，contained here对应“包含在此”。A把cracks found改成cracks existed（存在的裂纹），“发现”义丢失，Other也不如Additional准确；C把cracks误为scratches（划痕），manufacturer误为OEM（缩写虽相关但非原文表述），两处词义错译。

question: 推荐的燃油节约信息应整合到本节中，以便向飞行员展示如何在飞行过程中尽量减少燃油的使用。

options.A: This section includes all the fuel consumption information for the pilot to use during the flight and landing.
options.B: In this section, the pilot can find the recommending fuel saving information to use during takeoff and flight.
