options.C: The recommended fuel conservation information shall be integrated into this section to show the pilot how to minimize the fuel usage during the operation of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】The recommended fuel conservation information shall be integrated into this section to show the pilot how to minimize the fuel usage during the operation of the airplane.【词汇】fuel conservation=燃油节约，integrated into this section=整合到本节中，show the pilot how to=向飞行员展示如何，minimize fuel usage=尽量减少燃油使用，operation of the airplane=飞行过程。【解析】C正确：conservation对应“节约”，minimize对应“尽量减少”，during the operation对应“在飞行过程中”。A把conservation泛化为consumption（消耗），漏掉minimize，还自行添加landing；B把recommending（应为recommended）误用，operation of the airplane被窄化为takeoff and flight，阶段范围缩小。

question: 在简化技术英语（STE）中，段落以“主题句”开头，告诉读者该段的主题是什么。

options.A: In STE, a unit started with "topic sentence" is to instruct the main topic.
options.B: The "topic sentence" starts to tell the readers the topic of the paragraph in STE.
options.C: In STE, a paragraph starts with a “topic sentence” which tells the reader what the topic of that paragraph is.

explanation: 【译文】In STE, a paragraph starts with a "topic sentence" which tells the reader what the topic of that paragraph is.【词汇】paragraph=段落，topic sentence=主题句，starts with=以……开头，tells the reader=告诉读者，topic of that paragraph=该段主题。【解析】C正确：paragraph对应“段落”，starts with对应“以……开头”，which定语从句结构完整。A把paragraph误为unit（单元），instruct the main topic表达生硬；B让topic sentence作主语“开始告诉”，丢失“段落以主题句开头”的主从结构，逻辑主语错误。

question: 找到油箱加油活门开关，使燃油按计划传输到油箱。

options.A: Find the fueling valve switch for the tank that will get the fuel you are scheduled to transfer.
options.B: Find the fueling valve switch for the tank that you are  scheduled to transfer.
options.C: Find the fueling valve switch for the tank that need to transfer fuel.

explanation: 【译文】Find the fueling valve switch for the tank that will get the fuel you are scheduled to transfer.【词汇】fueling valve switch=加油活门开关，tank that will get the fuel=将接收燃油的油箱，scheduled to transfer=计划传输，find=找到。【解析】A正确：get the fuel对应“接收燃油”，you are scheduled to transfer修饰fuel，传输对象和计划关系清楚。B漏掉will get the fuel，句意变成“你要计划传输的那个油箱”，把燃油误作油箱作传输对象；C中need to transfer fuel的主语是油箱，同样把油箱当作燃油传输主体，逻辑不通。

question: 制造商在本节中应提供一份设备清单，作为单独的文件附于本手册，或单独提供。

options.A: In this Section which is  a separate attachment of the Handbook or as a separate document, the manufacturer shall provide an equipment list.
options.B: The manufacturer shall provide an equipment list in this Section, in a separate document appended to the Handbook, or as a separate document.
options.C: Being a separate appendix of the Handbook or as a separate document,  the manufacturer shall provide a list of equipment of this Section.

explanation: 【译文】The manufacturer shall provide an equipment list in this Section, in a separate document appended to the Handbook, or as a separate document.【词汇】manufacturer=制造商，equipment list=设备清单，in this Section=在本节中，appended to the Handbook=附于本手册，as a separate document=作为单独文件。【解析】B正确：in this Section与后两个or连接的提供方式层次分明，appended to对应“附于”。A把in this Section错并入separate attachment的从句，本节位置关系混乱；C开头Being a separate appendix把本节性质先定性，a list of equipment of this Section又把设备清单限定成本节所属，逻辑与原句相反。

question: 本规范编写时遵循的构成规则与FAA编写规则时用到的大体相同。

options.A: When making this Specification, the rules are generally refer to the rules that used by FAA in making its rules.
options.B: When making this Specification, we use the exact identical construction rules with FAA in making its specifications.
options.C: The rules of construction followed in the preparation of this Specification are the same as generally used by the FAA in the preparation of its rules.

explanation: 【译文】The rules of construction followed in the preparation of this Specification are the same as generally used by the FAA in the preparation of its rules.【词汇】rules of construction=构成规则，followed in the preparation=编写时遵循，the same as=相同，generally used=大体/通常使用，preparation of its rules=规则编写。【解析】C正确：followed in the preparation对应“编写时遵循”，the same as generally used对应“大体相同”，比较对象FAA的规则编写对应准确。A语法混乱，generally refer to the rules that used by FAA句子不通；B把generally the same（大体相同）升级为exact identical（完全一致），程度夸大，specifications也误代rules。

question: 如果机体制造商以任何方式改变部件制造商的文字或说明，他应使用自己的刊头。

options.A: If the airframe manufacturer modifies the component manufacturer's text or description by any means, he shall use his own headmaster.
options.B: If the airframe manufacturer changes the component manufacturer's text or illustration in any way, he shall apply his own masthead.
options.C: If the airframe manufacturer changes the component manufacturer's text or illustration in one way, he shall modify his own masthead.

explanation: 【译文】If the airframe manufacturer changes the component manufacturer's text or illustration in any way, he shall apply his own masthead.【词汇】airframe manufacturer=机体制造商，component manufacturer=部件制造商，text or illustration=文字或说明/图例，in any way=以任何方式，apply his own masthead=使用自己的刊头。【解析】B正确：changes对应“改变”，in any way对应“任何方式”，masthead对应“刊头”。A把masthead误为headmaster（校长），词形相近词义全错；C把in any way误为in one way（以一种方式），范围缩小，apply误为modify（修改刊头），“使用”变“修改”。

question: 为乘客和机组成员储存、调节和输送氧气的组件和部件,包括氧气瓶、释放活门、关断活门、出口、调节器、面罩等。

options.A: The units and components which store, regulate, and deliver oxygen to the passengers and crew include oxygen bottles, relief valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks, etc.
options.B: The units and components which reserve, adjust, and transfer oxygen to the passengers and pilots include oxygen bottles, relief valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks, etc.
options.C: The units and components to store, adjust, and transfer oxygen to the passengers and crew include oxygen bottles, release valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The units and components which store, regulate, and deliver oxygen to the passengers and crew include oxygen bottles, relief valves, shut-off valves, outlets, regulators, masks, etc.【词汇】store, regulate, and deliver oxygen=储存、调节和输送氧气，passengers and crew=乘客和机组人员，oxygen bottles=氧气瓶，relief valves=释放活门，shut-off valves=关断活门，regulators/masks=调节器/面罩。【解析】A正确：三个动词store/regulate/deliver与crew、relief valves等全部对应。B把三动词换成reserve/adjust/transfer（输送≠转运），crew误为pilots（飞行员只是机组的一部分），范围缩小；C用to store的不定式弱化定义句式，relief valves误为release valves，活门术语不准。

question: 在尽可能的情况下，示例、相关条件和技术的说明应与图表显示在同一页上。如果页面空间放不下必要的信息，则应使用面向图表的另一页面。

options.A: It is possible to use the same page to include the examples, associated conditions and technique. Should there be no necessary information included, refer to the page facing the chart.
options.B: If the same page contains examples, associated conditions and techniques, you need to include all the necessary information, it is forbidden to use the page that the figure faces.
options.C: Where possible, examples, associated conditions and technique should be presented on the same page as the chart. If space is not enough to include the necessary information, then the page facing the chart should be used.

explanation: 【译文】Where possible, examples, associated conditions and technique should be presented on the same page as the chart. If space is not enough to include the necessary information, then the page facing the chart should be used.【词汇】where possible=在可能的情况下，associated conditions and technique=相关条件和技术，presented on the same page as=与……在同一页，the page facing the chart=面向图表的另一页面。【解析】C正确：same page as the chart对应“与图表同一页”，space is not enough对应“页面空间放不下”，facing page对应“面向图表的另一页”。A把条件从句写成should there be no necessary information（没有必要信息时），与原义相反；B把“放不下时应使用对面页”反译为it is forbidden to use（禁止使用），处理逻辑完全相反。

question: 不定期维修检查是指制造商认为特殊或不寻常的情况下对飞机、其系统和组件进行的维修检查和检验，这些检查和检验与上文-10规定的时限无关。

options.A: Unscheduled maintenance checks are those maintenance checks and inspections on the aircraft, its systems and units which are recognized by the manufacturer as special or unusual conditions which are not related to the time limits specified in -10 above.
options.B: For the unscheduled maintenance checks and inspections of aircraft, aircraft systems and components, the manufacturer shall not include special or unusual conditions from the time limits specified in -10.
options.C: If the unscheduled maintenance checks and inspections on the aircraft, its systems and units are special or unusual conditions, the time limits specified in -10 shall be referred to by the manufacturer's.

explanation: 【译文】Unscheduled maintenance checks are those maintenance checks and inspections on the aircraft, its systems and units which are recognized by the manufacturer as special or unusual conditions which are not related to the time limits specified in -10 above.【词汇】unscheduled maintenance checks=不定期维修检查，recognized as special or unusual conditions=被认为特殊或不寻常的情况，not related to=与……无关，time limits=时限，specified in -10 above=上文-10规定的。【解析】A正确：unscheduled对应“不定期”，recognized by the manufacturer对应“制造商认为”，not related to time limits对应“与时限无关”。B把“与时限无关”错改成shall not include…from the time limits，否定对象混乱，定义句变成禁令；C用If条件句并写shall be referred to（应参考该时限），与“无关”的语义完全相反。

question: 以前没有纳入CAP的项目也许会经营运人检查被发现，这些项目将由ABC进行评估。

options.A: Those items that were not previously included in the CAP would be evaluated by ABC and provide to the operators for inspection.
options.B: Items not previously considered for inclusion in the CAP may be uncovered through operator inspections. These items will be evaluated by ABC.
options.C: Through operation inspection, ABC will evaluate the items uncovered in the CAP previously and provide the result to the operators.

explanation: 【译文】Items not previously considered for inclusion in the CAP may be uncovered through operator inspections. These items will be evaluated by ABC.【词汇】not previously considered for inclusion=以前未被考虑纳入，uncovered=被发现，through operator inspections=经营运人检查，evaluated by ABC=由ABC评估。【解析】B正确：not previously修饰considered for inclusion（以前没纳入），through operator inspections对应“经营运人检查”，两句结构对应清楚。A把uncovered through operator inspections的逻辑改写为“由ABC评估后提供给运营人检查”，因果顺序颠倒；C把previously错挂在uncovered上，变成“以前在CAP中发现的项目”，时间限定错位。

question: 通过持续适航的过程， 几乎组成飞机的每个部件都会涉及某种形式的保存，检查，预防性维修，翻修，修理或者更换件活动。

options.A:
After a continued
airworthiness process,almost every component composed of an airplane is involved in some form of preservation,inspection,preventative maintenance,
overhaul,repair, and/or
replacement activity.
options.B:
Through a continuing
airworthiness process, virtually every component comprising an airplane is involved in some form of preservation,inspection,preventative maintenance,overhaul,
repair, and/or
replacement activity.
options.C:
Through a continuing
airworthiness process, substantially every component of  an airplane is excluded in some type of preservation,inspection,preventative maintenance,
overhaul,repair, and/or
replacement activity.

explanation: 【译文】Through a continuing airworthiness process, virtually every component comprising an airplane is involved in some form of preservation, inspection, preventative maintenance, overhaul, repair, and/or replacement activity.【词汇】continuing airworthiness=持续适航，through=通过，virtually every component=几乎每个部件，comprising an airplane=组成飞机的，is involved in=涉及，preservation/overhaul=保存/翻修。【解析】B正确：Through对应“通过”，virtually对应“几乎”，is involved in对应“涉及”，各项活动列举完整。A把Through误为After（之后），continuing误为continued（被继续的），介词和分词两错；C把is involved in反译为is excluded（被排除），方向完全相反。

question: 一旦设计并得到批准， 就必须建立完整的维修程序，该程序必须以清晰、简明的语言提供给需要的人。

options.A: Upon designed and approved, a complete maintenance procedures must be established. This procedure must provide in clear, easy language to people who need it.
options.B: Upon design and approval, the establishment of complex maintenance procedures is a must. This procedure must provide a clear, precise language to those who need it.
options.C: Once designed and approved, the establishment of thorough maintenance procedures is a must. This procedure must be available in clear, concise language to those who need it.

explanation: 【译文】Once designed and approved, the establishment of thorough maintenance procedures is a must. This procedure must be available in clear, concise language to those who need it.【词汇】once designed and approved=一旦设计并得到批准，establishment=建立，thorough=完整的，is a must=必须，available in clear, concise language=以清晰简明的语言提供。【解析】C正确：Once对应“一旦”，thorough对应“完整”，be available对应“提供给需要的人”。A用upon designed and approved语法错误（upon后需名词），provide缺少be动词且搭配不当；B把thorough误为complex（复杂），“完整”变“复杂”，precise也不如concise贴切“简明”。

question: 确保文本不是抽象的，并且清楚地显示了如何执行任务或系统如何运行。具体点,不要给出含糊不清的一般信息。

options.A: Make sure the text is not so abstruse and that it clearly shows how to do a task or how a system operates. Be practical. Do not give vague, general information.
options.B: Make sure the text is not abstract and that it clearly shows how to do a task or how a system operates. Be specific. Do not give vague, general information.
options.C: Make sure the text is not so theoretical that it clearly shows how to do a task or how a system operates. Be concrete. Do not give unclear, general information.

explanation: 【译文】Make sure the text is not abstract and that it clearly shows how to do a task or how a system operates. Be specific. Do not give vague, general information.【词汇】not abstract=不是抽象的，clearly shows=清楚地显示，how a system operates=系统如何运行，be specific=具体点，vague, general information=含糊不清的一般信息。【解析】B正确：abstract对应“抽象”，specific对应“具体”，vague对应“含糊”。A把abstract误为abstruse（深奥难懂的），specific误为practical（实用的），两处近义错；C用so theoretical that句式使“清楚地显示”变成理论化的结果，逻辑关系错误，concrete也不如specific准确。

question: 当相应的装置运行时，如果信号器面板TRANSIT灯不亮，则认为该灯不工作。

options.A: If an annunciator panel TRANSIT light fails to illuminate while the corresponding device is in motion, then this light must be considered inoperative.
options.B: When related device is in operation and if annunciator panel TRANSIT light comes on, so this light does not work.
options.C: The light is considered to be available if the annunciator panel TRANSIT light goes off when the related device is in motion.

explanation: 【译文】If an annunciator panel TRANSIT light fails to illuminate while the corresponding device is in motion, then this light must be considered inoperative.【词汇】annunciator panel=信号器面板，TRANSIT light=TRANSIT灯，fails to illuminate=不亮，corresponding device=相应的装置，in motion=运行中，inoperative=不工作。【解析】A正确：fails to illuminate对应“不亮”，considered inoperative对应“认为不工作”，条件关系准确。B把fails to illuminate反译为comes on（点亮），条件相反，comes on…does not work逻辑也不通；C把inoperative反译为available（可用），goes off（熄灭）也改变灯态描述，整体意思相反。

question: 如果没有安装门测试止动器或胶带纸，在功能测试期间，PSU氧气盒门将打开，氧气面罩将从氧气盒内掉出。

options.A: During the system test, the PSU nitrogen mask doors will open and the nitrogen masks will appear in the nitrogen box if the door test stop or the tapes are not installed.
options.B: If the door test stop or the masking tape is not installed, the doors of the PSU oxygen box will open and the oxygen mask will remain in the original position.
options.C: The PSU oxygen box doors will open and the oxygen masks will go out of the oxygen boxes during the functional test if you do not install the door test stop or the masking tape.

explanation: 【译文】The PSU oxygen box doors will open and the oxygen masks will go out of the oxygen boxes during the functional test if you do not install the door test stop or the masking tape.【词汇】PSU oxygen box=PSU氧气盒，functional test=功能测试，door test stop=门测试止动器，masking tape=胶带纸，oxygen masks will go out=氧气面罩掉出。【解析】C正确：functional test对应“功能测试”，go out of对应“掉出”，if you do not install对应“如果没有安装”。A把oxygen误为nitrogen（氮气），气体种类错误，appear in the box也误改“掉出盒外”；B把will go out反译为will remain in the original position（留在原位），结果方向相反。

question: 如果委任工程代表的设计批准超出其正常授权范围，那么各设计批准只能由所了解的航空器审定办公室按照情况逐一授权。

options.A: If design appraisals by a DER is beyond his normal apprvoal, each appraisal can only be authorized by the known ACO according to current condition.
options.B: Design approvals by a DER that are outside his normal authorization may only be authorized by the cognizant ACO on a case by case basis.
options.C: The familiar ACO can approve each designation approval one one one according to condition if designation approval by a DER is outside his normal range.

explanation: 【译文】Design approvals by a DER that are outside his normal authorization may only be authorized by the cognizant ACO on a case by case basis.【词汇】DER（Designated Engineering Representative）=委任工程代表，design approvals=设计批准，outside his normal authorization=超出正常授权范围，cognizant ACO=主管的航空器审定办公室，case by case basis=逐一（按情况）。【解析】B正确：outside his normal authorization对应“超出正常授权”，cognizant对应“所了解的/主管的”，case by case对应“逐一”。A把approvals误为appraisals（评估），apprvoal拼写错误，according to current condition也不如case by case；C把design approvals误为designation approval（任命批准），one one one是one by one的错拼，familiar也不如cognizant规范。

question: 制造商应包括制造商和办公室或部门发布的类型服务信息的说明，以获取此类信息，从而按照最新信息维护飞机。

options.A: The manufacturer shall include a description of the type service information issued by the manufacturer and the office or department to contact to get  such  information  that  the aircraft may be maintained in accordance with the latest information.
options.B: The manufacturer shall include a description of the type service information issued by the manufacturer and the office or department to contact to obtain such information so that the aircraft may be maintained in accordance with the latest information.
options.C: The factory shall include a description of the type service information issued by the manufacturer and the office or department to contact to obtain  such  information  so  that  the aircraft may be maintained related to  the latest information.

explanation: 【译文】The manufacturer shall include a description of the type service information issued by the manufacturer and the office or department to contact to obtain such information so that the aircraft may be maintained in accordance with the latest information.【词汇】type service information=类型服务信息，issued by=发布的，office or department=办公室或部门，obtain such information=获取此类信息，in accordance with=按照，latest information=最新信息。【解析】B正确：obtain对应“获取”，so that对应“从而”，in accordance with对应“按照”，语体正式规范。A中that从句指代含混，get不如obtain正式，逻辑连接不清晰；C把manufacturer误为factory（工厂），in accordance with误为related to（与……相关），规范用语全部降级。

question: 推荐的燃油节约程序应包含一个警告（如适用），即制造商推荐的功率设置必须在新的和新检修的发动机磨合期间使用。

options.A: The recommended fuel conservation procedures shall contain a caution, if useful, that  the power settings recommended by the  manufacturer must be used during the use period of new and newly overhauled  engines.
options.B: The recommended fuel conservation procedures shall contain a caution, if applicable, that  the power settings recommended by the  manufacturer must be used during the break-in period of new and newly overhauled  engines.
options.C: The receptable fuel conservation procedures shall contain a caution, if applicable, that  the power settings recommended by the  manufacturer must be used during the management period of new and newly overhauled  engines.

explanation: 【译文】The recommended fuel conservation procedures shall contain a caution, if applicable, that the power settings recommended by the manufacturer must be used during the break-in period of new and newly overhauled engines.【词汇】fuel conservation procedures=燃油节约程序，caution=警告/告诫，if applicable=如适用，power settings=功率设置，break-in period=磨合期，newly overhauled engines=新检修的发动机。【解析】B正确：applicable对应“适用”，break-in period对应“磨合期”，newly overhauled对应“新检修”。A把applicable误为useful（有用的），break-in误为use period（使用期），磨合概念丢失；C把recommended误拼为receptable，break-in误为management period（管理期），两处错。

question: 对于特定飞机的路面要求是来源于作用在主起落架支柱负载的静态分析。

options.A:
Pavement requirements for the exactly aircraft are derived from the static analysis of
loads imposed on the main landing gear struts.
options.B:
Pavement requirements for the one aircraft are derived from the static analysis of
loads imposed on the main landing gear struts.
options.C:
Pavement requirements for the particular aircraft are derived from the static analysis of
loads imposed on the main landing gear struts.

explanation: 【译文】Pavement requirements for the particular aircraft are derived from the static analysis of loads imposed on the main landing gear struts.【词汇】pavement requirements=路面要求，particular aircraft=特定飞机，derived from=来源于，static analysis=静态分析，loads imposed on=作用在……上的载荷，main landing gear struts=主起落架支柱。【解析】C正确：particular对应“特定”，derived from对应“来源于”，imposed on对应“作用在”。A把particular误为exactly（确切地），副词不能修饰aircraft，词性错误；B把particular误为one（一架），“特定”的限定含义丢失。

question: 那些固定式和便携式的装置和部件探测和指示火灾或烟雾，并储存和分配灭火剂到飞机所有受保护的区域。

options.A: Those fixed and portable units and components detect and indicate fire or smoke, and store and distribute fire extinguishing agent to all protected areas of the aircraft.
options.B: Those stationary and portable devices and components find and show fire or smoke, and store and release fire extinguishing agent to all aircraft protected areas.
options.C: Those fixed and portable units and assemblies monitor and warn fire or smoke, and then reserve and distribute extinguishant to all protected areas of the aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】Those fixed and portable units and components detect and indicate fire or smoke, and store and distribute fire extinguishing agent to all protected areas of the aircraft.【词汇】fixed and portable=固定式和便携式，detect and indicate=探测和指示，fire or smoke=火灾或烟雾，fire extinguishing agent=灭火剂，protected areas=受保护的区域。【解析】A正确：fixed对应“固定式”，detect and indicate对应“探测和指示”，distribute对应“分配”。B把detect and indicate弱化为find and show，distribute误为release（释放≠分配）；C把detect and indicate误为monitor and warn（监控和警告），store误为reserve，extinguishant非规范术语。

question: 那些制造商对飞机及其系统和部件的检查、维护和大修的时间限制给出建议，也酌情给出零部件的使用寿命。

options.A: For inspections, repair and overhaul of the aircraft and its systems and units, those producers recommended time limits and life of parts if possible.
options.B: Those manufacturers recommended time limits for inspections, maintenance and overhaul of the aircraft, its systems and units, and life of parts, as applicable.
options.C: Those manufacturers gave time restrictions to inspect, repair and maintenance the aircraft, its systems and units, and according to the situation they gave the life of parts .

explanation: 【译文】Those manufacturers recommended time limits for inspections, maintenance and overhaul of the aircraft, its systems and units, and life of parts, as applicable.【词汇】recommended time limits=建议时间限制，inspections, maintenance and overhaul=检查、维护和大修，systems and units=系统和部件，life of parts=零部件使用寿命，as applicable=酌情/如适用。【解析】B正确：maintenance对应“维护”，as applicable对应“酌情”，宾语结构完整。A把maintenance误为repair（修理），as applicable误为if possible（如果可能），两处词义错；C把recommended误为gave，time limits误为time restrictions，maintenance误用为动词，句子结构混乱。

question: 检查单也可能包含飞行员可能经常使用的与飞机操作相关的补充信息，如性能数据、可选设备操作等。

options.A: The Check List may also include additional information relevant to the operation of the airplane, such as performance details, alternate equipment operation, etc., which the pilot might rarely use.
options.B: The Check List may also contain supplemental information pertinent to the operation of the airplane, such as performance data, optional equipment operation, etc., that the pilot might routinely use.
options.C: The Check List may also cover extra information that  the pilot might daily use and is decisive to the control of the airplane, such as performance data, alternate equipment operation, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The Check List may also contain supplemental information pertinent to the operation of the airplane, such as performance data, optional equipment operation, etc., that the pilot might routinely use.【词汇】check list=检查单，supplemental information=补充信息，pertinent to=与……相关的，performance data=性能数据，optional equipment operation=可选设备操作，routinely use=经常使用。【解析】B正确：supplemental对应“补充”，optional对应“可选”，routinely对应“经常”。A把routinely反译为rarely（很少），频率方向相反，details/alternate也不如data/optional规范；C把pertinent误为decisive（决定性的），optional误为alternate（备用的），daily use表述口语化。

question: 电气测量仪表是精密精确的装置，他们都是经过校准的。所有的仪表都应该由生产厂家或经过厂家授权的工厂进行定期检查以保证其精确性。

options.A: instruments are delicate precision devices and calibrited used to  measuring electrical .All instruments should be periodically checked for accuracy by the manufacturer or by some shop approved by manufacturer.
options.B: instruments are delicate precision devices and calibrited used to  measuring electrical .All instruments should be continuously checked for correct by the manufacturer or by some shop autherized by manufacturer.
options.C: Electrical measuring instruments are delicate precision devices and calibrited.All instruments should be periodically checked for accuracy by the manufacturer or by some shop approved by manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】Electrical measuring instruments are delicate precision devices and calibrated. All instruments should be periodically checked for accuracy by the manufacturer or by some shop approved by manufacturer.【词汇】electrical measuring instruments=电气测量仪表，delicate precision devices=精密精确的装置，calibrated=经过校准的，periodically checked for accuracy=定期检查精确性，shop approved by manufacturer=经厂家授权的工厂。【解析】C正确：electrical measuring instruments对应“电气测量仪表”，periodically对应“定期”，accuracy对应“精确性”。A缺主语electrical measuring instruments，句子残缺且used to measuring语法错误；B把periodically误为continuously（连续地），accuracy误为correct，autherized拼写错误。

question: 涉及到电子线路上工作，我们需要特殊的工具，例如伏特表，安培表，欧姆表。

options.A: To work with electrical cable, we need tools specifically vattmeter, amperemetres and ohm meters.
options.B: To work with electrical cable, vattmeter, amperemetres and ohm meters are helpful tools.
options.C: In order to work with electrical circuit, we need tools specifically voltmeter, amperemetres and ohm meters.

explanation: 【译文】In order to work with electrical circuit, we need tools specifically voltmeter, amperemetres and ohm meters.【词汇】electrical circuit=电子/电气线路，special tools=特殊工具，voltmeter=伏特表，amperemeter=安培表，ohm meter=欧姆表，in order to=为了。【解析】C正确：circuit对应“线路”，voltmeter拼写正确，we need对应“我们需要”。A把circuit误为cable（电缆），voltmeter误拼为vattmeter；B同样cable和vattmeter错误，并把“需要特殊工具”弱化为helpful tools（有帮助的工具），限定含义消失。

question: 伺服系统是一种具有响应和执行指令的装置，它必须能满足五项基本要求。

options.A: A servo system is a device that has the ability to carry out an order and give a response to fufill five basic requirements.
options.B: A servo system is a device that has the ability to carry out an order and give a response to orders. It can finish five basic requirements.
options.C: A servo system is a device that has the ability to respond to and carry out an order which must be able to fufill five basic requirements.

explanation: 【译文】A servo system is a device that has the ability to respond to and carry out an order which must be able to fulfill five basic requirements.【词汇】servo system=伺服系统，respond to=响应，carry out an order=执行指令，must be able to=必须能，fulfill five basic requirements=满足五项基本要求。【解析】C正确：respond to and carry out对应“响应和执行”，must be able对应“必须能满足”。A先carry out再give a response，响应执行顺序颠倒，to fulfill的逻辑主语混乱；B把“必须满足”弱化为can finish（能完成），语气降级且finish requirements搭配不当。

question: “异常程序”部分应在开始时包括一份检查单，说明当顺序对安全至关重要时的操作顺序。

options.A: The Abnormal Procedures Section shall include checklist of operation sequence indicating the result of important operations to ensure safety.
options.B: The Abnormal Procedures Section shall include a checklist as the attachment indicating the sequence of operations when safety is critical.
options.C: The Abnormal Procedures Section shall include, at the beginning, a check list with regard to order of action when sequence is essential to safety.

explanation: 【译文】The Abnormal Procedures Section shall include, at the beginning, a check list with regard to order of action when sequence is essential to safety.【词汇】Abnormal Procedures Section=异常程序部分，at the beginning=在开始时，check list=检查单，order of action=操作顺序，sequence is essential to safety=顺序对安全至关重要。【解析】C正确：at the beginning对应“在开始时”，with regard to order of action对应“说明操作顺序”，essential对应“至关重要”。A把order of action误为result of important operations（重要操作的结果），漏译at the beginning；B把at the beginning误为as the attachment（作为附件），位置概念张冠李戴，when safety is critical也未准确表达“顺序对安全至关重要”。

question: 本节飞行员操作手册应仅包含法规要求的限制，或由主管当局批准的飞机安全运行所必需的限制。

options.A: This section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall contain only those limitations required by regulation or necessary for safe operation of the airplane and approved by the regulatory authority.
options.B: This section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall include only those restrictions required by the regulations and those restrictions issued by the regulatory authority to ensure the safe operation of the airplane.
options.C: This section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall contain the regulatory requirements approved by the authorities and publish the necessary restrictions only for the safe operation of the airplane.

explanation: 【译文】This section of the Pilot's Operating Handbook shall contain only those limitations required by regulation or necessary for safe operation of the airplane and approved by the regulatory authority.【词汇】Pilot's Operating Handbook=飞行员操作手册，only those limitations=仅包含的限制，required by regulation=法规要求的，necessary for safe operation=安全运行所必需的，approved by the regulatory authority=由主管当局批准的。【解析】A正确：limitations对应“限制”，两类限制来源（法规要求/当局批准且安全必需）完整保留only限定。B把limitations换成restrictions（术语不统一），并把批准关系改成“当局发布的限制”，两类来源结构走样；C句子结构混乱，多出publish动作，regulatory requirements替代limitations，中心词错误。

question: 这本手册包括联邦航空法规要求提供给飞行员的材料和制造商提供的附加信息，这些资料构成联邦航空局批准的飞机飞行手册。

options.A: This Handbook includes materials required to be provided to pilots under Federal Aviation Regulations, as well as additional information that to be provided by the manufacturer. These data are the bases for FAA to compile the airplane flight manual.
options.B: This Handbook includes materials that the manufacturer needs to provide to the pilot, as well as additional information required by the Federal Aviation Administration.  Together, these data form the flight manual for FAA approved airplane.
options.C: This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the federal aviation regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.

explanation: 【译文】This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the federal aviation regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.【词汇】furnished to the pilot=提供给飞行员，federal aviation regulations=联邦航空法规，additional information provided by the manufacturer=制造商提供的附加信息，constitutes=构成，FAA approved airplane flight manual=FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。【解析】C正确：required by regulations修饰material、provided by manufacturer修饰additional information、constitutes对应“构成”，三层关系准确。A把constitutes误为the bases for FAA to compile（FAA编制依据），逻辑关系错误；B把法规要求与厂家提供的信息来源互换，张冠李戴。

question: 在某些情况下，如果数据表明，疲劳问题开始发生的飞行小时数比最初预测的要多，则有可能延长检查的间隔。

options.A: In some cases, extension of inspection intervals may be possible if the data suggests that the onset of fatigue problems occurs at a greater number of flight hours than initially predicted.
options.B: In some cases, if the data shows that the number of flight hours of fatigue problems occurring is greater than initially predicted, it is possible to extend the duration of inspection.
options.C: In some cases, if the data suggests that the fatigue problem initially emerges at more flight hours than originally predicted, lengthening of inspection intervals is compulsory.

explanation: 【译文】In some cases, extension of inspection intervals may be possible if the data suggests that the onset of fatigue problems occurs at a greater number of flight hours than initially predicted.【词汇】extension of inspection intervals=延长检查间隔，may be possible=有可能，onset of fatigue problems=疲劳问题开始发生，greater number of flight hours=更多的飞行小时数，initially predicted=最初预测的。【解析】A正确：intervals对应“间隔”，onset对应“开始发生”，may be possible对应“有可能”，比较结构完整。B把intervals误为duration（持续时间），interval是间隔而非时长，句子重心也不够准确；C把may be possible升级为compulsory（强制的），可能性变义务性，语气完全改变。

question: 外界大气温度是指自由空气的静态温度，可从飞机上的温度指示或地面气象源获得，并根据仪器误差和压缩性效应进行调整。

options.A: Outside air temperature is the free air static temperature, obtained either from temperature indications onboard or ground meteorological sources, adjusted for instrument error and compressibility effects.
options.B: Outside air temperature is the free air static temperature, acquired either from inflight temperature indications or ground geological sources, modified by instrument error and compression effects.
options.C: Outside air temperature is the free air static temperature, derived either from inflight temperature indicators or ground methodological sources, modulating instrument error and compressibility effects.

explanation: 【译文】Outside air temperature is the free air static temperature, obtained either from temperature indications onboard or ground meteorological sources, adjusted for instrument error and compressibility effects.【词汇】outside air temperature=外界大气温度，free air static temperature=自由空气静态温度，onboard=机载/飞机上，ground meteorological sources=地面气象源，instrument error=仪器误差，compressibility effects=压缩性效应。【解析】A正确：meteorological对应“气象”，adjusted for对应“根据……调整”，onboard对应“飞机上”。B把meteorological误为geological（地质的），气象源变地质源，词形相近词义全错；C把meteorological误为methodological（方法论的），modulating误代adjusted for，语法术语双错。

question: 运营人有责任确保所有适航指令得到遵守，并在需要时按照联邦航空法规对飞机进行操作、勤务和维修。

options.A: The airline operator is irresponsible for ensuring that all airworthiness instructions are complied with and that the handling, servicing and maintenance of the airplane is done when required and according to the Federal Aviation Regularities.
options.B: The operator is responsible for ensuring that all airworthiness directives are observed and that the handling, servicing and maintenance of the airplane is done when required and in accordance with the Federal Aviation Regulations.
options.C: The operator has the duty ensuring that all airworthiness directives are compiled with and that the handling, servicing and maintenance of the airplane is performed when needed and in accordance with the Feudal Aviation Regulations.

explanation: 【译文】The operator is responsible for ensuring that all airworthiness directives are observed and that the handling, servicing and maintenance of the airplane is done when required and in accordance with the Federal Aviation Regulations.【词汇】operator=运营人，responsible for ensuring=有责任确保，airworthiness directives=适航指令，observed=遵守，handling, servicing and maintenance=操作、勤务和维修，in accordance with=按照。【解析】B正确：responsible对应“有责任”，directives observed对应“指令得到遵守”，in accordance with对应“按照”。A把responsible反译为irresponsible（无责任的），Regularities拼写错误；C把observed误拼为compiled（编制），Federal误为Feudal（封建的），多处致命错误。

question: 室外空气温度是自由空气静止温度，从飞行温度指示或地面气象源获得，并根据仪器误差和压缩系数效应进行调整。

options.A: Outside Air Temperature is the free air static temperature, obtained either from inflight temperature indications or ground meteorological sources, adjusted for instrument error and compressibility effects.
options.B: Outdoor Air Temperature is the dynamic temperature of free air, obtained from flight temperature indications or ground meteorological sources and adjusted for instrumental error and compressibility effects.
options.C: Outdoor Air Temperature is free air stagnation temperature, from flight temperature indicating or ground meteorological resource, and according to the instrument error and compressibility effects to adjust.

explanation: 【译文】Outside Air Temperature is the free air static temperature, obtained either from inflight temperature indications or ground meteorological sources, adjusted for instrument error and compressibility effects.【词汇】Outside Air Temperature（OAT）=室外/外界空气温度，free air static temperature=自由空气静止温度，inflight temperature indications=飞行温度指示，ground meteorological sources=地面气象源，compressibility effects=压缩系数效应。【解析】A正确：static对应“静止”，meteorological对应“气象”，adjusted for对应“根据……调整”。B把static误为dynamic（动态），静止温度变动态温度，概念相反，Outdoor也不如Outside规范；C把static误为stagnation（滞止温度，虽相关但非原文），indicating/resource语法错误，句式不通。

question: 螺旋桨调速器是通过螺旋桨轮毂上的螺距改变机构，通过增加或减少螺旋桨的螺距来调节发动机或螺旋桨转速的装置。

options.A: Propeller governor is a device that adjusts the speed of the engine or propeller by increasing or decreasing the clearance of the propeller through the clearance changing mechanism on the propeller hub.
options.B: Propeller governor is the device that regulates the rpm of the engine or propeller by increasing or decreasing the propeller pitch, through a pitch change mechanism in the propeller hub.
options.C: Propeller governor is through the propeller hub of the propeller pitch changing machine, adjusts the speed of the propeller or engine by increasing or decreasing the propeller gap.

explanation: 【译文】Propeller governor is the device that regulates the rpm of the engine or propeller by increasing or decreasing the propeller pitch, through a pitch change mechanism in the propeller hub.【词汇】propeller governor=螺旋桨调速器，regulates the rpm=调节转速，propeller pitch=螺旋桨螺距，pitch change mechanism=螺距改变机构，propeller hub=螺旋桨轮毂。【解析】B正确：rpm对应“转速”，pitch对应“螺距”，hub对应“轮毂”，通过增减螺距调节转速的逻辑清楚。A把pitch误为clearance（间隙），螺距变间隙，核心概念错；C句子结构破碎（propeller pitch changing machine），propeller gap同样误译pitch。

question: 为清楚理解和准确使用手册各部分的信息，定义必要的符号、缩写和术语。

options.A: Define symbols, abbreviations and terminology necessary for the clear understanding and precise use of the information presented in various sections of the Handbook.
options.B: In order to understand and use the information in the manual clearly, give the definition to the symbols, abbreviations and terms which are necessary.
options.C: For clear understanding and accurate information about the use of each part of the manual, define the necessary symbols, abbreviations and terms.

explanation: 【译文】Define symbols, abbreviations and terminology necessary for the clear understanding and precise use of the information presented in various sections of the Handbook.【词汇】define=定义，symbols, abbreviations and terminology=符号、缩写和术语，necessary=必要的，clear understanding and precise use=清楚理解和准确使用，presented in various sections=各部分提供的。【解析】A正确：术语三件套规范，understanding and precise use对应“理解和准确使用”，祈使句式符合手册语体。B意思基本对但give the definition to搭配生硬，which are necessary后置使句子松散，语体不如A；C把precise use误连到accurate information（准确的信息），修饰对象错位，each part也不如various sections规范。

question: 每一章或每一节都是以这个系统及其操作的一般描述开始，并应称为“描述和操作”。

options.A: Each Chapter or Section is to begin with a specific instruction of the system and its Operation and should be labeled “Description and Operation”.
options.B: A general description of the system begins with each Chapter or Section and its operation and should be labeled “Description and Operation”.
options.C: Each Chapter or Section is to start with a general description of the system and its operation and should be labeled “Description and Operation”.

explanation: 【译文】Each Chapter or Section is to start with a general description of the system and its operation and should be labeled "Description and Operation".【词汇】each Chapter or Section=每一章或每一节，start with=以……开始，general description=一般描述，system and its operation=系统及其操作，labeled=称为/标记为。【解析】C正确：start with对应“以……开始”，general description对应“一般描述”，labeled对应“应称为”。A把general description误为specific instruction（具体说明），描述性质错；B主语变成general description begins with each Chapter，本末倒置，its operation修饰关系也乱。

question: 持续适航方案检查号也显示在页面底部，是CAP节号。

options.A: The Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection number is also provided above the page and is the CAP chapter number.
options.B: The Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection number is also displayed at the bottom of the page and is the CAP section number.
options.C: The Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection Code is also showed under the page and is the CAP item number.

explanation: 【译文】The Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection number is also displayed at the bottom of the page and is the CAP section number.【词汇】Continuing Airworthiness Program（CAP）=持续适航方案，Inspection number=检查号，displayed at the bottom of the page=显示在页面底部，CAP section number=CAP节号。【解析】B正确：at the bottom对应“底部”，section number对应“节号”。A把bottom误为above（上方），位置相反，section误为chapter（章），层级错误；C把number误为Code（代码），bottom误为under the page，section误为item（项目号），三处偏差。

question: 该规范根据飞机的复杂性提供了手册编制的灵活性，同时保持了结构、定义和性能信息的高度标准化。

options.A: The Specification provides flexibility in Handbook preparation based on the complexity of the airplane while maintaining a high degree of standardization of arrangement, definitions, and performance information.
options.B: The Specification provides flexibility in Handbook preparation based on the complicacy of the airplane, but ignoring a high degree of standardization of structure, definitions, and performance information.
options.C: The Specification provides uniformity in Handbook preparation based on the simplicity of the airplane while retaining a high degree of standardization of arrangement, definitions, and performance information.

explanation: 【译文】The Specification provides flexibility in Handbook preparation based on the complexity of the airplane while maintaining a high degree of standardization of arrangement, definitions, and performance information.【词汇】flexibility=灵活性，complexity=复杂性，while maintaining=同时保持，a high degree of standardization=高度标准化，arrangement=结构，performance information=性能信息。【解析】A正确：flexibility对应“灵活性”，while maintaining对应“同时保持”，并列三要素齐全。B把while maintaining反译为but ignoring（却忽略），转折关系完全相反，complicacy也非规范词；C把flexibility误为uniformity（统一性），complexity误为simplicity（简单性），两对反义概念全部颠倒。

question: 许多读者的英语知识有限,复杂的句子结构和许多英语单词所具有的大量的意义和同义词会引起混淆。

options.A: Many readers have little  knowledge of English. Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and antonyms that many English words have can cause misconception.
options.B: Many readers have a limited knowledge of English. Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and synonyms that many English words have can cause confusion.
options.C: Many readers have a little knowledge of English. Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and homonyms that many English words have can cause frustration.

explanation: 【译文】Many readers have a limited knowledge of English. Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and synonyms that many English words have can cause confusion.【词汇】limited knowledge=有限的知识，complex sentence structure=复杂的句子结构，synonyms=同义词，meanings=意义，confusion=混淆。【解析】B正确：limited对应“有限”，synonyms对应“同义词”，confusion对应“混淆”。A把synonyms误为antonyms（反义词），little knowledge语气也不同，misconception（误解）不如confusion贴切；C把synonyms误为homonyms（同音词），confusion误为frustration（挫折感），两处词义错。

question: 实施航线维修的维修机构，其航站在非本国领土时， 放行人员应依据航站所属国的航空法规进行资格审定。

options.A: For line maintenance carried out at a line station of an organization which is located outside the Community territory, the certifying staff may be qualified in accordance with the national aviation regulations of the State in which the line station is ba
options.B: For line maintenance  organization located outside the Community territory, the certified staff may be qualified in accordance with the national aviation regulations of the State in which the line station is based.
options.C: For maintenance organization whose line station is located outside the Community territory, the releasing staff may be audited in accordance with the  aviation regulations of the its State.

explanation: 【译文】For line maintenance carried out at a line station of an organization which is located outside the Community territory, the certifying staff may be qualified in accordance with the national aviation regulations of the State in which the line station is based.【词汇】line maintenance=航线维修，line station=航站，certifying staff=放行人员，qualified=资格审定，national aviation regulations=所属国航空法规，the State in which the line station is based=航站所属国。【解析】A正确：carried out at a line station of an organization对应“维修机构的航站”，certifying staff qualified对应“放行人员资格审定”，State in which the line station is based对应“航站所属国”。B漏掉carried out at a line station of的层次，certified staff也不如certifying staff规范；C把qualified误为audited（审核），its State语法错误，放行人员译成releasing staff不统一。

question: 您有权免费复制或出版本文件或其任何后续修改或修订的全部或部分内容

options.A: You have the right to duplicate or publish this document or any substituent  alteration or revision thereof, in whole or in part, free of charge.
options.B: You have the right to reproduce or publish this document or any subsequent modification or revision thereof, in whole or in part, free of charge.
options.C: You have the right to  recopy or publish this document or any substantial alternation or revision thereof, in whole or in part, free of charge.

explanation: 【译文】You have the right to reproduce or publish this document or any subsequent modification or revision thereof, in whole or in part, free of charge.【词汇】have the right=有权，reproduce or publish=复制或出版，subsequent modification or revision=后续修改或修订，thereof=其（指文件），in whole or in part=全部或部分，free of charge=免费。【解析】B正确：reproduce对应“复制”，subsequent对应“后续”，in whole or in part对应“全部或部分”。A把subsequent误为substituent（替代的），alteration也偏离modification；C把reproduce误为recopy（不规范），subsequent误为substantial（实质性的），“后续”变“重大”，alternation拼写错误。

question: 在一篇描述性的文章中，循序渐进地提供信息，并确保每个句子只包含一个主题。如果你过快地提供了太多的信息，你的文章将很难理解，读者将有必要再读一遍。

options.A: In a descriptive text, give information gradually and make sure that each sentence contains only one topic. If you give too much information too quickly, your text will be difficult to understand and it will be necessary for the reader to read it again.
options.B: In a descriptive article, provide the information in steps and make sure that each statement covers only one point. If you provide too much outdated information, your article will become difficult to read, which will force the reader to do it again.
options.C: In a descriptive essay, present information in an orderly manner and ensure that each sentence contains only one meaning. If you give too much information, your essay will be difficult to understand and the reader will need to look through it again.

explanation: 【译文】In a descriptive text, give information gradually and make sure that each sentence contains only one topic. If you give too much information too quickly, your text will be difficult to understand and it will be necessary for the reader to read it again.【词汇】descriptive text=描述性文章，give information gradually=循序渐进地提供信息，each sentence contains only one topic=每句只含一个主题，too quickly=过快，read it again=再读一遍。【解析】A正确：gradually对应“循序渐进”，one topic对应“一个主题”，necessary for the reader to read it again对应“读者有必要再读一遍”。B把outdated information无中生有加入，force the reader语气过重；C把topic误为meaning（含义），look through（浏览）不等于read again（再读），essay也不如text规范。

question: 当起落架正在放下或收上时，主起落架门靠液压顺序打开。

options.A: The main gear doors are pneumatically sequenced to remain open while the gear is extending or retracting.
options.B: The main gear doors are hydraulically sequenced to remain open while the gear is extending or retracting.
options.C: The main gear doors are automatically sequenced to remain open while the gear is extending or retracting.

explanation: 【译文】The main gear doors are hydraulically sequenced to remain open while the gear is extending or retracting.【词汇】main gear doors=主起落架门，hydraulically sequenced=靠液压顺序作动，remain open=保持打开，extending or retracting=放下或收上。【解析】B正确：hydraulically对应“液压”，extending or retracting对应“放下或收上”，sequenced对应“顺序”。A把hydraulically误为pneumatically（气动的），作动方式张冠李戴；C把hydraulically泛化为automatically（自动地），丢失“液压”这一具体作动方式，信息不完整。

question: 涡轮通过减速齿轮转动，向高压轴施加扭矩，从而驱动发动机和飞机附件。

options.A: The turbine rotates by a reduction gear,gives tolerance to the HP shaft,so it can drive the engine and the aircraft accessories.
options.B: The turbine turning through a reduction gear, applies a torque to the HP shaft, thus driving the engine and the aircraft components.
options.C: The turbine turning through a reduction gear, applies a torque to the HP shaft, thus driving the engine and the aircraft accessories.

explanation: 【译文】The turbine turning through a reduction gear, applies a torque to the HP shaft, thus driving the engine and the aircraft accessories.【词汇】turbine=涡轮，reduction gear=减速齿轮，applies a torque=施加扭矩，HP shaft=高压轴，driving=驱动，aircraft accessories=飞机附件。【解析】C正确：torque对应“扭矩”，accessories对应“附件”，through a reduction gear对应“通过减速齿轮”。A把torque误为tolerance（容差），扭矩变容差，词形相近词义全错；B把accessories误为components（部件），“附件”规范术语应为accessories。

question: 为了在预处理空气连接单向阀在打开位置不工作时放行飞机，执行以下步骤。

options.A: For release with the ground preconditioned air connection single valve inoperative in the open position, do these steps.
options.B: For dispatch with the ground preconditioned air connection check valve inoperative in the open position, do these steps.
options.C: For release with the ground reconditioned air connection check valve inoperative in the open position, do these steps.

explanation: 【译文】For dispatch with the ground preconditioned air connection check valve inoperative in the open position, do these steps.【词汇】dispatch=放行，ground preconditioned air connection=地面预处理空气连接，check valve=单向阀，inoperative=不工作，in the open position=在打开位置。【解析】B正确：dispatch对应“放行”，check valve对应“单向阀”，preconditioned对应“预处理”，inoperative in the open position对应“在打开位置不工作”。A把check valve误为single valve（单个活门），单向功能丢失，release不如dispatch规范；C把preconditioned误为reconditioned（再调节的），前缀误解，release同样不如dispatch准确。

question: 将溢流阀门拨动开关保持在打开位置，直到流出阀位置指示器显示完全打开。

options.A: Hoist the outflow valve toggle switch in the OPEN position until the outflow valve position indicator shows FULL OPEN.
options.B: Hoist the outflow valve trigger switch in the OPEN position until the outflow valve position indicator shows FULL OPEN.
options.C: Hold the outflow valve toggle switch in the OPEN position until the outflow valve position indicator shows FULL OPEN.

explanation: 【译文】Hold the outflow valve toggle switch in the OPEN position until the outflow valve position indicator shows FULL OPEN.【词汇】hold=保持，toggle switch=拨动开关，outflow valve=溢流活门，position indicator=位置指示器，FULL OPEN=全开。【解析】C正确："保持"对应hold，"拨动开关"对应toggle switch，"直到…显示完全打开"对应until…shows FULL OPEN，关键词全部对应。A把hold误为hoist（升起、吊起），动作方向不符，属词义错译。B两处错误：同样用hoist代替hold，还把toggle（拨动）误为trigger（扳机/触发），张冠李戴。

question: 包含大的过冷水滴、冻雨或混合情况的大气条件，可能超出FAR参数和认证的防冰系统能力。

options.A: Atmospheric conditions, including large supercooled water droplets, freezing rain or a mixture of conditions, may exceed the FAR parameters and the capabilities of the certified ice protection system.
options.B: Atmosphere conditions which include large too cold water drip, ice rain or a mixed conditions, may deviate the FAR specifications and the ability of the qualified anti-ice system.
options.C: The atmospheric conditions except for large overcold water drops, frozen rain or the combination condition, may exceed the FAR data and the verified anti-ice system capability.

explanation: 【译文】Atmospheric conditions, including large supercooled water droplets, freezing rain or a mixture of conditions, may exceed the FAR parameters and the capabilities of the certified ice protection system.【词汇】supercooled water droplets=过冷水滴，freezing rain=冻雨，exceed=超出，certified ice protection system=经认证的防冰系统。【解析】A正确：including对应"包含"，exceed对应"超出"，certified ice protection system对应"认证的防冰系统"，术语全部规范。B多处口语化错译：too cold water drip、ice rain、deviate、ability、qualified均非对应术语。C把including误为except for（范围相反），overcold、frozen rain、verified、data也非规范对应。

question: 列出修理或改装指示，可参考另一文件中的标准修理或其他地方（如服务工具包、服务通告等）定义的特殊修理或改装。

options.A: To list repair or modification orders, reference may be made to other document's repair standards or the definition of special repair or modification elsewhere (e.g., service kits, service notices, etc.).
options.B: Listing the repair or modification directions may contrast to the repair rules of another document or especial repairs or modifications defined elsewhere (e.g., service kits, service annunciations, etc.).
options.C: Set forth repair or modification instructions and may refer to a standard repair in another document or a special repair or modification defined elsewhere, such as in a service kit, service bulletin, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Set forth repair or modification instructions and may refer to a standard repair in another document or a special repair or modification defined elsewhere, such as in a service kit, service bulletin, etc.【词汇】set forth=列出/规定，instructions=指示，refer to=参考，service kit=服务工具包，service bulletin=服务通告。【解析】C正确："列出…指示"用set forth instructions，"可参考"用may refer to，标准修理、特殊修理及服务通告等示例一一对应。A把instructions误为orders（命令/订单），service bulletin误为service notices（通知），术语错译。B把refer误为contrast（对比，方向相反），especial用法错误，service annunciations（信号牌）张冠李戴。

question: 冷凝器将空调组件内空气的温度降低到露点以下，将水蒸气变成液体。

options.A: The condenser decreases the temperature of the air in the air conditioning pack to below the dew point, changing water vapor into liquid.
options.B: The cooler lowers the air temperature to the boiling point in the air conditioning module, which can transfer the steam into water.
options.C: The evaporator turns steam into liquid by reducing the temperature of the air in the air conditioning pack to the evaporating point.

explanation: 【译文】The condenser decreases the temperature of the air in the air conditioning pack to below the dew point, changing water vapor into liquid.【词汇】condenser=冷凝器，air conditioning pack=空调组件，dew point=露点，water vapor=水蒸气。【解析】A正确：condenser、dew point、below、water vapor into liquid分别对应冷凝器、露点、以下、水蒸气变液体，术语与逻辑全对。B把冷凝器误为cooler（冷却器）、露点误为boiling point（沸点），steam不如water vapor规范，属术语张冠李戴。C把condenser误为evaporator（蒸发器，功能相反的部件），并把露点误为evaporating point（蒸发点），双重错译。

question: 可以使用原理图指示系统“流向”、阐明系统工作原理，例如空气控制、电源、液压、燃油和涡轮系统。

options.A: Schematic diagrams may be used to indicate "flow" and to illustrate the operation of systems such as air control, electrical, fluid power, fuel and turbosystems.
options.B: Principle charts can be intended to show "flow" and explain the operation of systems as well as air control, electrical, hydraulic power, fuel and turbine systems.
options.C: Schematic diagrams can be employed to show "flow" and to explain the operation of systems along with air control, electrical, fluid power, fuel and turbosystems.

explanation: 【译文】Schematic diagrams may be used to indicate "flow" and to illustrate the operation of systems such as air control, electrical, fluid power, fuel and turbosystems.【词汇】schematic diagrams=原理图，indicate flow=指示流向，illustrate operation=阐明工作原理，such as=例如，fluid power=液压动力。【解析】A正确："原理图"=schematic diagrams，"指示流向"=indicate flow，"阐明"=illustrate，"例如"=such as，举例关系明确。B把schematic diagrams误为principle charts（原理图表，非术语），且as well as把示例关系变成并列补充，范围错误。C主体虽近，但along with同样把"例如"的举例关系误表为"连同"的并列关系，漏译要素。

question: 功能测试是指确定一个系统或组件在所有方面都按照最低可接受的系统或组件设计规范来运行所需的程序。

options.A: Functional test is the determination that a system or component performs the required procedures in all respects in accordance with the minimum acceptable system or component design specifications.
options.B: Functional test is that procedure required to ascertain that a system or unit is functioning in all aspects in accordance with minimum acceptable system or unit design specifications.
options.C: Functional testing is the procedure requested to determine that a system or component operates in all respects according to the minimum unsanctioned system or component design specification.

explanation: 【译文】Functional test is that procedure required to ascertain that a system or unit is functioning in all aspects in accordance with minimum acceptable system or unit design specifications.【词汇】functional test=功能测试，ascertain=确定，in all aspects=在所有方面，minimum acceptable design specifications=最低可接受设计规范。【解析】B正确："所需的程序"对应that procedure required，"确定"对应ascertain，"运行"对应functioning，与题干定义结构吻合。A把功能测试定义成determination（判定），宾语又写成performs the required procedures（执行程序），把"系统按规范运行"偷换成"执行程序"，属张冠李戴。C两处错误：requested应为required（并非被请求），unsanctioned（未经批准）与acceptable（可接受）词义相反。

question: 清洁/喷漆部分应提供对一个或多个区域进行清洁或喷漆所需的材料和程序信息，并包含人员和材料保护所需的安全预防措施。

options.A: The cleaning/painting section should provide information concerning the material and program needed to clean and paint an area or areas, except for containing safety precautions needed to protect people and material.
options.B: The cleaning / paint section shall provide information unrelated to the material and procedure required to clean and paint one or more areas, and include the safety precautions required to protect personnel and material.
options.C: The cleaning/painting portion shall provide information as to material and procedure necessary to clean and paint an area or areas, and contain safety precautions necessary to protect personnel and material.

explanation: 【译文】The cleaning/painting portion shall provide information as to material and procedure necessary to clean and paint an area or areas, and contain safety precautions necessary to protect personnel and material.【词汇】cleaning/painting portion=清洁/喷漆部分，procedure=程序，area or areas=一个或多个区域，safety precautions=安全预防措施，personnel=人员。【解析】C正确：portion、material and procedure necessary、contain safety precautions与原文要素一一对应，并列结构清楚。A把procedure误为program（计划），且except for containing把"并包含"译成"除了包含"，方向相反。B把provide information concerning误为unrelated to（与…无关），信息关系完全相反，属方向错误。

question: 当液压系统B的发动机驱动泵压力低于正常时，液压动力转换组件系统为前缘襟翼和缝翼提供备用液压。

options.A: When hydraulic system B engine drive pump pressure is under normal conditions，the hydraulic power transfer unit system supplies standby hydraulic pressure to the leading edge flaps and slats.
options.B: The hydraulic power transfer unit system is provide spare hydraulic pressure to the leading edge flaps and slats when hydraulic system B engine-driven pump pressure is abnormal.
options.C: The hydraulic power transfer unit system supplies alternate hydraulic pressure to the leading edge flaps and slats when hydraulic system B engine-driven pump pressure is below normal.

explanation: 【译文】The hydraulic power transfer unit system supplies alternate hydraulic pressure to the leading edge flaps and slats when hydraulic system B engine-driven pump pressure is below normal.【词汇】power transfer unit=动力转换组件，alternate hydraulic pressure=备用液压，leading edge flaps and slats=前缘襟翼和缝翼，below normal=低于正常。【解析】C正确：alternate对应"备用"，engine-driven pump对应"发动机驱动泵"，below normal对应"低于正常"，条件与动作表述完整。A把below normal误为under normal conditions（在正常条件下），条件范围相反；且under作"低于"解需接具体数值。B语法错误（is provide），spare hydraulic pressure不如alternate规范，abnormal（异常）也不等于"低于正常"。

question: 阻焰器确保过多的热量不能进入燃油通气系统。堵塞的阻焰器会使通气油箱内的释压活门打开。当打开时,释压活门成为燃油通气系统的另一个通风口。

options.A: Flame arrestors make sure excessive heat does not enter the fuel vent system. A clogged flame arrestor causes the pressure relief valve in the surge tank to open. When open, the pressure relief valve becomes another vent for the fuel vent system.
options.B: Flame cleaners make sure over hot air does not enter the fuel vent system. A blogged flame cleaners force the pressure relief valve in the surge tank to open. When open, the pressure relief valve becomes another vent for the fuel vent system.
options.C: Flame erasers make sure excessive hot air do not enter the fuel vent system. A condensed flame erasers causes the pressure relief valve in the surge tank open. When open, the pressure relief valve becomes a vent for another fuel vent system.

explanation: 【译文】Flame arrestors make sure excessive heat does not enter the fuel vent system. A clogged flame arrestor causes the pressure relief valve in the surge tank to open. When open, the pressure relief valve becomes another vent for the fuel vent system.【词汇】flame arrestor=阻焰器，excessive heat=过多热量，clogged=堵塞的，pressure relief valve=释压活门，surge tank=通气油箱。【解析】A正确：arrestors、excessive heat、clogged、causes…to open、another vent逐项对应，逻辑链条完整。B把arrestor误造为cleaners（清洁器），blogged为非规范词（应为clogged），force搭配也不当。C erasers、condensed同样错译阻焰器和堵塞，并把"系统的另一个通风口"误为"另一个燃油通气系统的通风口"，修饰对象张冠李戴。

question: 当出现低流量或冷却不充分情况时，低流量传感器向驾驶舱提供一个警报信号来发出警示。

options.A: When a low flow or undercooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor sends an alarm signal to the flight compartment for warning.
options.B: When a low flow or not sufficient cooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor supplies an alarm signal to the flight compartment for annunciation.
options.C: When a low flow or insufficient cooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor applies a alarm signal to the flight compartment for caution.

explanation: 【译文】When a low flow or undercooling condition occurs, the low flow sensor sends an alarm signal to the flight compartment for warning.【词汇】low flow=低流量，undercooling=冷却不充分，alarm signal=警报信号，flight compartment=驾驶舱，for warning=用于警示。【解析】A正确：undercooling对应"冷却不充分"，sends an alarm signal对应"提供警报信号"，for warning对应"发出警示"，表达规范简洁。B两处不足：not sufficient cooling为口语化解说而非术语，annunciation（通告/告示）偏离"警示"的词义侧重。C语法错误（a alarm应为an），applies与alarm signal搭配不当，caution（告诫）与warning警示层级不符。

question: 本手册包括联邦航空法规要求提供给飞行员的材料以及厂家提供的附加信息，以此构成了FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。

options.A: This manual contains materials provided for pilots required by Federal Aviation Regulations  and added information supplied by manufacturers ,so as to consist of an FAA approved aircraft flight manual.
options.B: This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.
options.C: This manual consists of the material required to be supplied to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and excessive information provided by the manufacturer and to form the approval of FAA airplane flight manual.

explanation: 【译文】This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.【词汇】be furnished to=被提供给，Federal Aviation Regulations=联邦航空法规，additional information=附加信息，constitutes=构成，FAA approved=FAA批准的。【解析】B正确："要求提供给飞行员的材料"用required to be furnished to the pilot，"构成"用constitutes，逻辑主语和并列谓语清晰。A语法错误：so as to consist of表"以便由…组成"，且added information不如additional规范。C把additional误为excessive（过多的，词义错译），to form the approval of…把"构成手册"误成"形成批准"，张冠李戴。

question: 能量永远不会产生或消失，这是一条物理定律。它只是从一种能量变成了另一种能量。在我们的例子中，动能在刹车时转变为热能。

options.A: Energy is never created or lost, it's a physics law that it just changes from one kind of energy to another and in our case, motion energy turns into heat energy when we brake
options.B: It is a law of physics that energy is never produced or destroyed. It just changes from one type of energy into another type. In our example the kinetic energy changes into heat energy during braking.
options.C: Energy is never produced or lost, it's a physical law that it just transfers from one kind of energy to another and in our case, moving energy turns into heat energy when  braking.

explanation: 【译文】It is a law of physics that energy is never produced or destroyed. It just changes from one type of energy into another type. In our example the kinetic energy changes into heat energy during braking.【词汇】law of physics=物理定律，produced or destroyed=产生或消失，kinetic energy=动能，heat energy=热能，during braking=刹车时。【解析】B正确：produce/destroy对应产生/消失，kinetic energy对应动能，changes into…during braking对应刹车时转变为热能，术语规范。A用lost（丢失）代替destroyed，motion energy（运动能）非动能术语，且句式松散。C的transfers（转移）不等于changes（转变），moving energy、physical law均不规范，属术语错译。

question: 在防滑模块与驻车制动模块之间的高压正常制动回路系统中，建议采用镀镉耐腐蚀钢或镀镉钢接头替代铝接头。

options.A: It is suggested that nickel plated corrosion resistant steel or nickel plated steel fittings be used as alternatives for aluminum fittings in the high pressure and normal brake return systems between the antiskid module and parking brake module.
options.B: Suggest to use vanadium plated corrosion resistant steel or vanadium plated steel fittings as alternatives for aluminum fittings in the high pressure and normal brake return systems between the antiskid module and parking brake module.
options.C: It is recommended that cadmium plated corrosion resistant steel or cadmium plated steel fittings be used as replacements for aluminum fittings in the high pressure and normal brake return systems between the antiskid module and parking brake module.

explanation: 【译文】It is recommended that cadmium plated corrosion resistant steel or cadmium plated steel fittings be used as replacements for aluminum fittings in the high pressure and normal brake return systems between the antiskid module and parking brake module.【词汇】cadmium plated=镀镉，corrosion resistant steel=耐腐蚀钢，fittings=接头，antiskid module=防滑模块，parking brake module=驻车制动模块。【解析】C正确：cadmium对应"镉"，replacements对应"替代"，It is recommended对应"建议采用"，术语与句型全对。A把cadmium误为nickel（镍），镀层材料张冠李戴。B把cadmium误为vanadium（钒），同样材料错译，且Suggest to use祈使句式不如题干陈述语气规范。

question: 对于所有飞机在起飞和飞行中（可能）发生的所有的发动机故障(包括部分失效)，均应提供程序。

options.A: Procedures shall be provided for all airplanes for all cases of engine failure, including partial failure, during takeoff and in flight.
options.B: Procedures shall be provided for all airplanes  for all cases of engine failure, including intermittent  failure, during roll out and in flight.
options.C: Procedures shall be provided for all airplanes  for all cases of engine flame out, including parts  failure, during takeoff and in flight.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures shall be provided for all airplanes for all cases of engine failure, including partial failure, during takeoff and in flight.【词汇】procedures shall be provided=应提供程序，engine failure=发动机故障，partial failure=部分失效，during takeoff and in flight=在起飞和飞行中。【解析】A正确：all cases of engine failure、partial failure、takeoff、in flight四处关键要素全部对应。B两处错误：把partial（部分的）误为intermittent（间歇的），把takeoff（起飞）误为roll out（滑跑/滑出），词义错译。C把engine failure误为flame out（熄火），故障范围缩窄，partial误为parts（零件），漏译要素。

question: 程序中应提供发动机空中启动、以及一旦发动机无法启动的后续措施。

options.A: Procedures shall be provided for starting the engine in air and, moreover  the engine does not start, for subsequent.
options.B: Procedures shall be provided for starting the engine in flight and, in the event the engine does not start, for subsequent.
options.C: Procedures shall be provided for starting the engine in flight and, for instance the engine does not start, for preceding.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures shall be provided for starting the engine in flight and, in the event the engine does not start, for subsequent.【词汇】in flight=空中/飞行中，in the event=一旦/倘若，subsequent=后续的，start the engine=启动发动机。【解析】B正确："空中启动"=in flight（非in air），"一旦…无法启动"=in the event…does not start，"后续措施"=subsequent。A两处错误：in air表达不规范，moreover（此外）不能表达"一旦"的条件含义，逻辑关系错。C把in the event误为for instance（例如），把subsequent（后续）误为preceding（先前），方向相反。

question: 应提供在下列飞行阶段应对客舱或发动机冒烟和/或起火情况的程序。

options.A: Procedures shall be omitted for coping with cases of smoke and/or fire in the cabin or from an engine in the following flight segments.
options.B: Procedures shall be provided for accompany with cases of smoke and/or fire in the cabin or from an engine in the following flight sectors.
options.C: Procedures shall be provided for coping with cases of smoke and/or fire in the cabin or from an engine in the following flight phases.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures shall be provided for coping with cases of smoke and/or fire in the cabin or from an engine in the following flight phases.【词汇】cope with=应对，smoke and/or fire=冒烟和/或起火，in the cabin or from an engine=客舱或发动机（处），flight phases=飞行阶段。【解析】C正确：provided对应"应提供"，coping with对应"应对"，phases对应"阶段"，句式与公文语体规范。A把provided误为omitted（省略），与"应提供"完全相反，属方向错误。B两处错误：accompany with（陪伴）错译应对，flight sectors（扇区）错译flight phases（阶段），均属词义错译。

question: 警告信息是一项操作步骤、检查、修理或维护操作，如果不正确执行可能导致人员受伤或死亡。

options.A: A warning is an operating procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance practice, which if not correctly followed, could result in personal injury, or loss of life.
options.B: The warning information that contains operational check, inspection, repair or maintenance tasks shall be properly followed, or injury to persons or loss of life can be caused.
options.C: Warning information contains operating procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance practice that will cause injury to persons or loss of life.

explanation: 【译文】A warning is an operating procedure, inspection, repair or maintenance practice, which if not correctly followed, could result in personal injury, or loss of life.【词汇】warning=警告，practice=操作做法，if not correctly followed=如未正确执行，result in=导致，loss of life=死亡。【解析】A正确：定义句式"A warning is…"，条件状语if not correctly followed对应"如果不正确执行"，could result in对应"可能导致"，要素齐全。B把定义句改写成"应被正确遵循"的要求句，并漏掉operating procedure要素，句式错误。C去掉if条件，把"可能"后果说成必然（will cause），程度错误，且以information作主语不合定义句式。

question: 句型应简单直接，无需阐述明显多余的和过于基础的信息。应避免讨论理论知识，除非该理论知识对实际操作的理解和施工是必要的。

options.A: Sentence forms shall be simple and direct, avoiding the obvious, the elementary and discussions of theory except where essential for practical understanding and application.
options.B: Sentence forms shall be simple and direct, avoiding the obvious and the elementary, and omitting discussions of theory except where essential for practical understanding and application.
options.C: Sentence forms shall be simple and direct so as to avoid the obvious and the elementary, and to omit discussions of theory except where essential for practical understanding and application.

explanation: 【译文】Sentence forms shall be simple and direct, avoiding the obvious and the elementary, and omitting discussions of theory except where essential for practical understanding and application.【词汇】sentence forms=句型，the obvious and the elementary=明显多余和过于基础的内容，discussions of theory=理论讨论，essential for practical understanding and application=对实际理解和应用必不可少。【解析】B正确：avoiding…omitting…两个分词结构分别对应"无需阐述"和"应避免讨论"，except where essential对应"除非必要"，并列层次清楚。A把"理论讨论"也塞进avoiding的并列宾语，缺and造成obvious/elementary/discussions三者层次含混。C用so as to表目的，把"应简单直接"与"避免…"硬绑成目的关系，逻辑移位。

question: 电磁活门应在图表中显示，并包含一条注释，说明活门是由弹簧加载在开位还是关位。

options.A: See the graphics for information of the solenoid valves which shall contain a note indicating the position of the valve (whether spring-loaded to its open or closed position).
options.B: Solenoid valves indicated on the schematic shall have a notation indicating when the valve shall be spring-loaded to the open or closed position.
options.C: Solenoid valves shall be indicated on the schematic and shall include a notation indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.

explanation: 【译文】Solenoid valves shall be indicated on the schematic and shall include a notation indicating whether the valve is spring-loaded to the open or closed position.【词汇】solenoid valve=电磁活门，schematic=原理图/图表，notation=注释，whether=是否，spring-loaded=弹簧加载的。【解析】C正确：shall be indicated对应"应显示"，include a notation对应"包含注释"，whether…or对应"是…还是"，三个考点全对。A把主语改成See the graphics（参看图表），原意"活门应显示"变成读者查阅动作，主谓关系张冠李戴。B两处错误：用when（何时）代替whether（是否），开位/关位的二选一关系表达不清。

question: 一般而言，在描述飞机或其系统时，应使用第三人称。（如：前轮设有减摆器，以防止轮子在地面滚动时出现摆振。）

options.A:
Generally, in describing the airplane or its system, third person wording should be used. (For example: The nose wheel is provided with a shimmy damper to keep the wheel from shimmying while rolling on the 
ground.)
options.B: In general, when describing the aircraft or its system, you should use third person such as there is shimmy damper on the nose wheel in order to prevent the wheel shimmying and rolling on the ground.
options.C: Generally speaking, third person should be used while describing the aircraft or their system. For example: the nose wheel is available on the shimmy damper so as to shimmy or roll on the ground.

explanation: 【译文】Generally, in describing the airplane or its system, third person wording should be used. (For example: The nose wheel is provided with a shimmy damper to keep the wheel from shimmying while rolling on the ground.)【词汇】third person=第三人称，shimmy damper=减摆器，keep…from shimmying=防止…摆振，rolling on the ground=地面滚动。【解析】A正确：第三人称表述完整，例句中is provided with a shimmy damper对应"设有减摆器"，keep from shimmying对应"防止摆振"。B使用第二人称you，违反题干"使用第三人称"的要求，示例还写成防止轮子摆振和滚动（shimmying and rolling并列），语义错误。C把减摆器与前轮的关系说反（the nose wheel is available on the shimmy damper），so as to shimmy or roll把目的状语译成轮子去摆振滚动，示例含义混乱。

question: 本段描述的程序是关于计算计划飞行的各个阶段的重量和力矩以及确保重心在批准的范围内。

options.A: This section provides procedures to calculate weight and moments for different phases of a scheduled flight and to make sure that the center of thrust is beyond approved limits.
options.B: The paragraph gives the weight and moments for calculating all kinds of phases of a planned flight and procedures for ensuring that center of gravity is within authorized limits.
options.C: This paragraph describes the procedures to calculate weight and moment for various phases of a planned flight and to ensure that the center of gravity is within approved limits.

explanation: 【译文】This paragraph describes the procedures to calculate weight and moment for various phases of a planned flight and to ensure that the center of gravity is within approved limits.【词汇】calculate weight and moment=计算重量和力矩，phases of a planned flight=计划飞行的各阶段，center of gravity=重心，within approved limits=在批准范围内。【解析】C正确：describes the procedures对应"描述的程序"，various phases对应"各个阶段"，center of gravity within approved limits对应"重心在批准范围内"。A两处严重错误：把重心误为center of thrust（推力中心），把within（范围内）误为beyond（超出），方向相反。B语序混乱，gives the weight and moments for calculating把"计算重量和力矩的程序"说反成"给出重量和力矩供计算"，属结构错译。

question: 解释当飞机的重量或力矩发生变化时，如何保持该记录，以便飞机在正常运行期间可以获得准确的起动数据来计算重量和重心。

options.A: Explain when there is any change to the weight or force distance of the airplane, how to keep this record so as to acquire right starting data by calculating the weight and c.g. during normal operation of the airplane.
options.B: Explain how to maintain this record when changes to the weight or moments of the airplane are made so that accurate starting data is available to calculate the weight and c. g. during normal operation of the airplane.
options.C: In order to get correct starting data during abnormal operation of the airplane, the weight and c. g. should be calculated and explain how to keep this record when there are changes to the weight or moments of airplane.

explanation: 【译文】Explain how to maintain this record when changes to the weight or moments of the airplane are made so that accurate starting data is available to calculate the weight and c.g. during normal operation of the airplane.【词汇】maintain this record=保持该记录，moments=力矩，accurate starting data=准确的起始数据，c.g.（center of gravity）=重心，normal operation=正常运行。【解析】B正确：maintain this record对应"保持该记录"，so that…is available对应"以便可以获得"，c.g.对应"重心"，因果与要素完整。A把moments误为force distance（力×距离的字面直译），属术语错译，right starting data by calculating表达也笨拙。C把normal operation误为abnormal operation（方向相反），且把"解释如何保持记录"这一核心动作漏译。

question: 如果压力不在给定范围内，对门阻尼器的蓄压器进行加压。

options.A: If the pressure is above the limits, pressurize the accumulator of the door damper.
options.B: If the pressure is not in the given limits, pressure the cylinder of the door damper.
options.C: If the pressure is not in the given limits, pressurize the accumulator of the door damper.

explanation: 【译文】If the pressure is not in the given limits, pressurize the accumulator of the door damper.【词汇】given limits=给定范围，pressurize=加压，accumulator=蓄压器，door damper=门阻尼器。【解析】C正确：not in the given limits对应"不在给定范围内"，pressurize对应"加压"，accumulator对应"蓄压器"，全部对应。A把"不在范围内"窄化为above the limits（高于上限），漏掉低于下限的情形，范围错误。B两处错误：把动词pressurize误作名词pressure（语法错误），把accumulator误为cylinder（作动筒），部件张冠李戴。

question: 用温度计测量外界大气温度和驾驶舱温度。

options.A: Measure the Outside Air Temperature and the temperature in the cockpit with a thermometer.
options.B: Do the Outside Air Temperature and the temperature in the cabin with a barometer.
options.C: Measure the Surrounding Air Temperature and the temperature in the cockpit with a thermometer.

explanation: 【译文】Measure the Outside Air Temperature and the temperature in the cockpit with a thermometer.【词汇】measure=测量，Outside Air Temperature（OAT）=外界大气温度，cockpit=驾驶舱，thermometer=温度计。【解析】A正确：Measure对应"测量"，OAT为标准术语对应"外界大气温度"，cockpit对应"驾驶舱"，thermometer对应"温度计"。B三处错误：do不能表"测量"，cabin（客舱）错译cockpit（驾驶舱），barometer（气压表）错译thermometer（温度计），均属词义错译。C把Outside Air Temperature误为Surrounding Air Temperature（非标准术语），关键术语不符。

question: 油箱排气系统可根据需要让空气进出油箱。

options.A: The tank recirculating system lets the air in or out of the fuel tanks if necessary.
options.B: The tank absorbing system lets the air in or out of the fuel tanks as necessary.
options.C: The tank venting system lets the air in or out of the fuel tanks as necessary.

explanation: 【译文】The tank venting system lets the air in or out of the fuel tanks as necessary.【词汇】venting system=通气/排气系统，lets…in or out=让…进出，fuel tanks=油箱，as necessary=根据需要。【解析】C正确：venting对应"排气/通气"，lets the air in or out对应"让空气进出"，as necessary对应"根据需要"，全部对应。A把venting误为recirculating（再循环），系统功能错译，if necessary也不如as necessary规范。B把venting误为absorbing（吸收），与"排气"功能相反，属功能错译。

question: 原理图必须有足够的尺寸，使图例、符号、装置、代码等都能被视力正常的人看清。应尽量避免使原理图翻页。

options.A: Schematics must be readable to a normal visioned person, so legends, symbols, devices, codes, etc., should be of sufficient size. The schematic diagram should be designed to turn over the page when the content is necessary.
options.B: The schematic diagram must be of sufficient size that legends, symbols, devices, codes, etc., are readable by persons with normal vision. Turn-page schematic diagrams shall be avoided to the extent practical.
options.C: The schematics, symbols, devices, codes, etc. must be legible, so people with normal vision should avoid turning the schematic pages as much as possible.

explanation: 【译文】The schematic diagram must be of sufficient size that legends, symbols, devices, codes, etc., are readable by persons with normal vision. Turn-page schematic diagrams shall be avoided to the extent practical.【词汇】sufficient size=足够尺寸，legends=图例，readable by persons with normal vision=正常视力者可看清，turn-page=翻页的，to the extent practical=在可行范围内。【解析】B正确："有足够尺寸使图例、符号等可读"因果正确，turn-page schematic diagrams shall be avoided对应"应尽量避免翻页原理图"，两句逻辑完整。A前后倒置：把"尺寸大使内容可读"改写为可读所以图例要足够大尚可，但后句把"避免翻页"译成"必要时设计成翻页"，方向相反。C把"避免翻页"的义务主体从图样设计误为视力正常的读者，且legible与size的关系混乱。

question: 如果为阀门或控制建立符号或图案，这种类型的装置在整个手册中都要用它。使用的符号应在原理图的图例块中显示和标识。

options.A: If a symbol or device is established for a valve or control, it shall be used for this type of unit throughout the manual. The symbols used should be shown and identified in a legend block on the schematic diagram.
options.B: If a symbol or device has been set up to a valve or control, the equipment type will be referred to as this symbol or device throughout the manual. The legend block in the diagram displays or identifies symbols or device.
options.C: If a symbol or design is specified for a valve or control, this type of device is used throughout the section of the manual. The symbols used can be found  and identified in the legend block of the schematic.

explanation: 【译文】If a symbol or device is established for a valve or control, it shall be used for this type of unit throughout the manual. The symbols used should be shown and identified in a legend block on the schematic diagram.【词汇】symbol or device=符号或图案，established for=为…建立，throughout the manual=贯穿全手册，legend block=图例块，identified=标识。【解析】A正确：shall be used throughout the manual对应"整个手册都要使用"，shown and identified in a legend block对应"在图例块中显示和标识"，要素齐全。B把"该符号用于此类装置"误为"装置类型被称作符号"，关系倒置，且will be referred to as语态不当。C把throughout the manual缩成throughout the section（范围错误），can be found弱化"应显示标识"的强制要求。

question: 机载辅助动力装置是那些装于飞机上的机载动力装置(发动机)，用于产生和供应单一类型或辅助电力、液压、气动或其他动力的组合。

options.A: AIRBORNE AUXILIARY POWER UNITS are those power plants (engines)  built-in on the aircraft for creating and supplying power in a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.
options.B: AIRBORNE AUXILIARY POWER UNITS are those units (engines) that are suspended on the aircraft for bringing and providing power in a single manner or combination of auxiliary electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or other power.
options.C: AIRBORNE AUXILIARY POWER UNITS are those airborne power plants (engines) which are installed on the aircraft for the purpose of generating and supplying a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.
