explanation: 【译文】AIRBORNE AUXILIARY POWER UNITS are those airborne power plants (engines) which are installed on the aircraft for the purpose of generating and supplying a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.【词汇】airborne auxiliary power unit（APU）=机载辅助动力装置，power plant=动力装置，installed on=安装于，generating and supplying=产生和供应，a single type or combination=单一类型或组合。【解析】C正确：airborne power plants installed on对应"装于飞机上的机载动力装置"，generating and supplying对应"产生和供应"，定义要素完整。A两处不足：built-in（内建）不如installed规范，creating（创造）不等于generating（产生动力）。B把installed误为suspended（悬挂），generating误为bringing，且units代替power plants漏掉"动力装置"概念，术语错译。

question: 向跑道进近过程中，航道指示器上的偏航指针指示飞行员必须向哪个方向操纵飞机。

options.A: When taking off from the runway, deviation pointers in the ADF indicators show the pilot in which direction he/she must control the airplane.
options.B: During the approach to the runway, deviation pointers in the course indicators show the pilot in which direction the aircraft must go.
options.C: In the approaching process, deviation pointers in the flight path deviation indicator show the pilot how to control the aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】During the approach to the runway, deviation pointers in the course indicators show the pilot in which direction the aircraft must go.【词汇】approach to the runway=向跑道进近，deviation pointers=偏差指针，course indicators=航道指示器，in which direction=向哪个方向。【解析】B正确：during the approach对应"进近过程中"，course indicators对应"航道指示器"，方向指示含义完整。A两处错误：把approach（进近）误为taking off（起飞），把course indicators误为ADF indicators（自动定向仪指示器），张冠李戴。C用In the approaching process和flight path deviation indicator均非对应术语，how to control与"向哪个方向"也不完全等同，漏译runway。

question: 它明确了制造商建议的部件或组件的退役时间（使用小时数、循环数或其他合适的因素）以及FAA要求的时寿部件或组件的退役（拆下）时间。

options.A: It sets forth supplier recommended and FAA required retirement (removal from service) times for parts or assemblies (using hours, intervals or other appropriate determinant) and life limited parts or assemblies.
options.B: It sets forth manufacturer recommended retirement times for parts or assemblies (using hours, cycles or another appropriate determinant) and FAA required retirement (removal from service) times for life limited parts or assemblies.
options.C: It sets forth retirement times for parts or assemblies (using hours, loops or another appropriate determinant)  established by the manufacturer and retirement (removal from service) times for life limited parts or assemblies required by FAA.

explanation: 【译文】It sets forth manufacturer recommended retirement times for parts or assemblies (using hours, cycles or another appropriate determinant) and FAA required retirement (removal from service) times for life limited parts or assemblies.【词汇】sets forth=明确/规定，retirement time=退役时间，cycles=循环数，determinant=决定因素，life limited parts=时寿部件。【解析】B正确：manufacturer recommended对应"制造商建议"，cycles对应"循环数"，life limited parts对应"时寿件"，removal from service对应"拆下退役"，两组退役时间的并列对象正确。A两处错误：supplier（供应商）误为manufacturer，intervals（间隔）误为cycles（循环），术语张冠李戴。C把cycles误为loops（圈），词义错译；后置修饰结构也使"制造商建议"与"FAA要求"的对应关系不如B清晰。

question: 对于拥有或操作非运营飞机的持照飞行员，可以在联邦航空法规43部的授权下对其飞机实施受限制的预防性维修。

options.A: A certificated pilot who owns or operates an airplane not used as an air carrier is authorized by FAR Part 43 to perform limited preventive maintenance on his airplane.
options.B: A certificated pilot who owns or operates an airplane that is not airworthy can perform limited predictive maintenance on his airplane authorized by FAR Part 43.
options.C: A licensed pilot authorized by FAR Part 43 who owns or operates an airplane not used to operate can perform time-limited maintenance on his airplane.

explanation: 【译文】A certificated pilot who owns or operates an airplane not used as an air carrier is authorized by FAR Part 43 to perform limited preventive maintenance on his airplane.【词汇】certificated pilot=持照飞行员，air carrier=航空承运人/运营人，FAR Part 43=联邦航空法规43部，limited preventive maintenance=受限制的预防性维修。【解析】A正确："非运营飞机"用not used as an air carrier，"受限制的预防性维修"用limited preventive maintenance，授权关系完整。B两处错误：not airworthy（不适航）错译"非运营"，predictive（预测性）错译preventive（预防性），概念均错。C把limited preventive误为time-limited（限时），not used to operate表达混乱，授权关系语焉不详。

question: 主最低设备清单应当以标牌、维修程序、机组运行程序等形式规定适当的限制条件，以及保证可接受的安全水平所需要的其他限制规定。

options.A: The MMEL should specify suitable limitations in the form of placards, maintenance procedures, crew operating procedures, and other restrictions as necessary to ensure an acceptable level of safety.
options.B: The MMEL should be in the form of annunciator, maintenance procedures, crew operating procedures to illustrate applicable limitations and other rules necessary to verify an acceptable level of safety.
options.C: The MEL should cover suitable limitations which are shown in palcards, maintenance procedures, crew operating procedures, and other rules to verify an acceptable level of safety.

explanation: 【译文】The MMEL should specify suitable limitations in the form of placards, maintenance procedures, crew operating procedures, and other restrictions as necessary to ensure an acceptable level of safety.【词汇】MMEL=主最低设备清单，placards=标牌，crew operating procedures=机组运行程序，ensure an acceptable level of safety=保证可接受的安全水平。【解析】A正确：MMEL、placards、ensure、acceptable level of safety逐项对应题干术语，in the form of对应"以…形式"。B把placards误为annunciator（信号牌），verify（验证）不如ensure（保证）贴切"保证"，术语错译。C把MMEL误为MEL（漏掉"主"），palcards拼写错误，rules与verify组合偏离"限制规定"含义。

question: 本章应提供制造商认为必要的信息，以便在飞机使用寿命内可能需要的各种维修、大修或重要修理中对飞机进行适当的校平。

options.A: Necessary information by manufacturer should be provided in this chapter  to maintain, overhaul or major repair the aircraft so as to properly level it during the life of the aircraft.
options.B: In order to properly level the aircraft when performing repair, overhaul or major repairs during the life of the aircraft, this chapter should provide all considered information by manufacturer.
options.C: This chapter shall provide that information considered necessary by the manufacturer to properly level the aircraft for any of the various maintenance, overhaul or major repairs which might become necessary during the life of the aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】This chapter shall provide that information considered necessary by the manufacturer to properly level the aircraft for any of the various maintenance, overhaul or major repairs which might become necessary during the life of the aircraft.【词汇】level the aircraft=校平飞机，maintenance, overhaul or major repairs=维修、大修或重要修理，during the life of the aircraft=在使用寿命内，considered necessary=认为必要的。【解析】C正确：information considered necessary by the manufacturer对应"制造商认为必要的信息"，might become necessary对应"可能需要"，句式完整规范。A的to maintain…so as to结构使"校平"与"修理"的目的关系错位，且漏译"认为必要的"。B all considered information语序错误（应为information considered…），并漏译"各种"和"可能需要"，漏译要素。

question: 适航指令规定的纠正措施，比如检查、修理或改装的具体要求，可由适航指令详细给出，或包含在另外一个文件中，如制造厂服务通告，该服务通告刊登在适航指令中作为参考。

options.A: AD describes corrective action, e.g. inspection, repair or maintenance, which may be listed by AD or included in another document, e.g. manufacturer's Service Bulletin that acts as reference in the AD.
options.B: The corrective action prescribed by the AD, such as an inspection, repair, or modification, may be detailed in the AD itself or may be contained in another document, such as manufacturer's Service Bulletin, which is referenced in the AD.
options.C: AD details the requirements for inspection, repair or modification described in corrective action, or it may be contained in another document, such as Service Bulletin referenced in AD.

explanation: 【译文】The corrective action prescribed by the AD, such as an inspection, repair, or modification, may be detailed in the AD itself or may be contained in another document, such as manufacturer's Service Bulletin, which is referenced in the AD.【词汇】corrective action=纠正措施，prescribed by=由…规定，Service Bulletin=服务通告，referenced in=在…中被引用。【解析】B正确：prescribed、inspection/repair/modification、detailed in the AD itself or contained in another document、referenced in the AD逐项对应原文。A把modification（改装）误为maintenance（维护），纠正措施类型错译；acts as reference也不如referenced规范。C结构混乱：AD details the requirements与corrective action关系颠倒，定语从句被处理成并列，逻辑错误。

question: 压缩机需要配备压力调节器、空气软管和适当的过滤系统，以确保将清洁、干燥、无油的空气输送至喷嘴。

options.A: The compressor needs to be equipped with a pressure regulator, air hoses, and an appropriate filter system to ensure that clean, dry, oil-free air is delivered to the nozzle.
options.B: A press regulator, air ducts, and a proper filtration system form the compressor, which surely delivers clean, dry, oily air to the spray nozzle.
options.C: For the compressor that ensures clean, dry, oilless air is delivered to the injector, it is necessary to be equipped with a pressurization regulator, air pipes, and an adequate filter system.

explanation: 【译文】The compressor needs to be equipped with a pressure regulator, air hoses, and an appropriate filter system to ensure that clean, dry, oil-free air is delivered to the nozzle.【词汇】pressure regulator=压力调节器，air hoses=空气软管，filter system=过滤系统，oil-free air=无油空气，nozzle=喷嘴。【解析】A正确：equipped with对应"配备"，pressure regulator、air hoses、oil-free、delivered to the nozzle逐项对应。B两处错误：form the compressor把"压缩机配备部件"说成部件组成压缩机（关系倒置），oily air（含油空气）与oil-free完全相反。C把nozzle误为injector（喷油嘴），pressure regulator误为pressurization regulator（增压调节器），术语错译。

question: 尽管如此，各制造商仍应遵循相同的基本系统和主题安排顺序，即使某些系统可能在不适用时被省略。

options.A: However, manufacturers are following the same fundamental systems and sequence of subject arrangements even if some systems, which are not available, may be bypassed.
options.B: Nevertheless, each manufacturer is expected to follow the same sequence of basic system and subject arrangements even though some systems may be omitted when not applicable.
options.C: Even so, all manufacturers are expected to submit to the same arrangements of main systems and subject sequences even though certain systems would be ignored when not applicable.

explanation: 【译文】Nevertheless, each manufacturer is expected to follow the same sequence of basic system and subject arrangements even though some systems may be omitted when not applicable.【词汇】nevertheless=尽管如此，is expected to follow=仍应遵循，sequence of arrangements=安排顺序，omitted when not applicable=不适用时被省略。【解析】B正确：Nevertheless对应"尽管如此"，is expected to对应"仍应"，omitted对应"省略"，语气与要素全部对应。A两处错误：are following（现在进行时）改变"应遵循"的情态含义，bypassed（绕过）不如omitted（省略）准确。C把follow误为submit to（服从），ignored（忽视）不如omitted，main systems也不等于basic systems，词义错译。

question: 所有飞机发动机必须满足某些效率、经济性和可靠性的一般要求，这就要求点火系统能够在各种天气和其他不利条件下，在适当的时间向火花塞传递点火脉冲。

options.A: All aircraft engines must meet certain general efficiency, economy, and reliability requirements, which require that the ignition system can provide ignition pulses at the proper time to the spark plug in various weather and other adverse conditions.
options.B: All aircraft engines must meet certain overall efficiency, economy and reliability requirements, which require the ignition system should provide ignition pulses at appropriate times under meteorological and other unfavorable conditions.
options.C: All aircraft engines must meet certain general requirements of reliability, economic and efficiency, which dictates the use of ignition systems that deliver the firing impulse to the spark plugs in all kinds of weather and under other adverse conditions.

explanation: 【译文】All aircraft engines must meet certain general efficiency, economy, and reliability requirements, which require that the ignition system can provide ignition pulses at the proper time to the spark plug in various weather and other adverse conditions.【词汇】ignition system=点火系统，ignition pulses=点火脉冲，at the proper time=在适当的时间，spark plug=火花塞，adverse conditions=不利条件。【解析】A正确：general efficiency, economy, reliability requirements对应三项一般要求，at the proper time对应"在适当的时间"，spark plug对应"火花塞"，要素齐全。B漏译spark plug（只说under meteorological…conditions，脉冲去向缺失），属漏译要素。C虽行文流畅，但把"在适当的时间"这一关键要素完全漏译，requirements的列举顺序也有出入。

question: 加速停止距离是指将飞机加速到指定速度，并假定在达到该速度的那一刻发动机发生故障，使飞机停止飞行所需的距离。

options.A: Accelerate Stop Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a specified speed and, assuming failure of an engine at the instant that speed is attained, to bring the airplane to a stop.
options.B: Accelerated stop distance refers to the distance required to promote an aircraft to a stipulated speed, assuming that engine failed occurs at that speed and the aircraft stops flying.
options.C: Accelerating stop distance is defined as  the distance requiring to speed up an aircraft to a specific speed, assuming that engine failed at that speed and the aircraft stops flying.

explanation: 【译文】Accelerate Stop Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a specified speed and, assuming failure of an engine at the instant that speed is attained, to bring the airplane to a stop.【词汇】Accelerate Stop Distance=加速停止距离，specified speed=指定速度，at the instant=在瞬间，bring the airplane to a stop=使飞机停下。【解析】A正确：accelerate对应"加速"，failure of an engine at the instant对应"达到该速度瞬间发动机故障"，bring to a stop对应"使飞机停止"，定义要素完整。B把accelerate误为promote（促进），engine failed occurs语法错误，stops flying（停止飞行）不等于停下。C用Accelerating stop distance（术语拼写错误），speed up口语化，stops flying同样错译。

question: 本手册包括联邦航空法规要求提供给飞行员的材料以及厂家提供的附加信息，以此构成了FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。

options.A: This manual contains the material required to be provided to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and additional information offered by the manufacturer and consists the FAA approved airplane flight manual.
options.B: This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.
options.C: Federal Aviation Regulations require the manual to furnish the material required to the pilot and additional information provided to the manufacturer and consists of the FAA approved airplane flight manual.

explanation: 【译文】This handbook includes the material required to be furnished to the pilot by the Federal Aviation Regulations and additional information provided by the manufacturer and constitutes the FAA approved airplane flight manual.【词汇】be furnished to=被提供给，additional information=附加信息，constitutes=构成，FAA approved airplane flight manual=FAA批准的飞机飞行手册。【解析】B正确：furnished对应"提供"，constitutes（及物动词）对应"构成"，includes…and constitutes并列谓语结构清楚。A语法错误：consists为不及物动词不能直接接宾语，须说consists of（由…组成），与"构成"含义不同。C把主语改成Federal Aviation Regulations，且provided to the manufacturer（提供给厂家）把信息流向弄反，张冠李戴。

question: 此规范由通用航空制造商协会编制，作为飞机、发动机和部件制造商编制持续适航方案检查文件的指南。

options.A: The General Aviation Manufacturers Association compiled this specification to guide  the manufacturers of the aircraft ,engine and component  developing their Continuous Airworthiness Program Inspection Documents.
options.B: The Continuous Airworthiness Program Inspection Documents prepared by  the manufacturers of the aircraft ,engine and component was guided by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association.
options.C: This specification was developed by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association as guidance for airplanes, engine and component manufacturers in preparing Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection Documents .

explanation: 【译文】This specification was developed by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association as guidance for airplanes, engine and component manufacturers in preparing Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection Documents.【词汇】General Aviation Manufacturers Association（GAMA）=通用航空制造商协会，guidance=指南，prepare documents=编制文件，Continuing Airworthiness Program Inspection Documents=持续适航方案检查文件。【解析】C正确：was developed by对应"由…编制"，as guidance for对应"作为…指南"，in preparing对应"编制时"，被动结构规范。A语法缺陷：guide the manufacturers…developing结构混乱，compiled与guide搭配不当。B把主客关系倒置：说检查文件由制造商编制且"被协会引导"，规范和指南的角色张冠李戴。

question: 列出每个故障的可能原因的第一步是显示系统的哪些部分可能出现故障。

options.A: The first step in listing possible causes of each trouble is to show what sections of the system may be at fault.
options.B: Listing possible causes of each trouble is the first step to show what sections of the system may be failure.
options.C: The first step in listing which parts of the system are likely to fail is to show the possible causes of each failure.

explanation: 【译文】The first step in listing possible causes of each trouble is to show what sections of the system may be at fault.【词汇】first step=第一步，possible causes=可能原因，trouble=故障，sections of the system=系统的部分，at fault=有故障。【解析】A正确：first step in listing…is to show…的句架对应"列出…的第一步是显示…"，at fault对应"有故障"，要素对应。B两处错误：主语改为Listing…使"第一步"变成目的，may be failure词性错误（应为at fault），语法错误。C把"列出原因"与"显示故障部分"的内容互换，且possible causes of each failure表述混乱，属结构张冠李戴。

question: 经批准的发动机滑油可以混用。但我们建议使用经批准的、同制造商生产的相同滑油。

options.A: It is possible to mix appropriate engine oils agreed by engineers .But we suggest that you use the identical oil agreed by the same manufacturer.
options.B: It is possible to mix approved engine oils. But we recommend that you use the same approved oil from the same manufacturer.
options.C: It is possible to mix engine oils authorized by the same manufacturer. But we suggest you use the same oils authorized by the engineers.

explanation: 【译文】It is possible to mix approved engine oils. But we recommend that you use the same approved oil from the same manufacturer.【词汇】approved engine oils=经批准的发动机滑油，mix=混用，recommend=建议，the same…from the same manufacturer=同制造商生产的相同滑油。【解析】B正确：approved对应"经批准"，recommend对应"建议"，same approved oil from the same manufacturer对应"同制造商的相同经批准滑油"。A两处错误：agreed by engineers（工程师同意）错译approved（经批准），identical oil agreed也不如same approved oil规范。C把批准主体弄错：authorized by the same manufacturer（同一制造商授权）与"经批准的滑油"原意不符，authorized by the engineers亦错。

question: 在涡轮风扇发动机大修手册中，本节将包括分解、清洁、检查、装配、测试等主题。

options.A: In the turbofan engine maintenance handbook this chapter would include such subjects as removal, cleaning, inspection, disassembly, testing , etc.
options.B: In the turbofan engine repair manual this section would include such topics as disassembly, cleaning, checking, accessory, adjusting , etc.
options.C: In the turbofan engine overhaul manual this section would include such subjects as teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly, testing , etc.

explanation: 【译文】In the turbofan engine overhaul manual this section would include such subjects as teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly, testing, etc.【词汇】turbofan engine=涡轮风扇发动机，overhaul manual=大修手册，teardown=分解，assembly=装配，testing=测试。【解析】C正确：overhaul manual对应"大修手册"，teardown/cleaning/inspection/assembly/testing与"分解、清洁、检查、装配、测试"五项逐一对应。A两处错误：maintenance handbook（维护手册）错译overhaul manual，且用removal（拆卸）代替assembly（装配），五项内容不全。B把overhaul误为repair（修理），accessory（附件）、adjusting（调节）替换assembly/testing，术语错译。

question: 每个探测器内的烟雾传感器监控高于预设限制的烟雾密度。如果密度保持高于限制大约8秒, 则传感器设定探测器到警报状态。

options.A: The smoke sensor in each detector monitors when the smoke density is above a previous limit. If the density keeps higher than the limit for about eight seconds, the sensor set the detector to the alarm condition.
options.B: The smoke sensor in each detector monitors for smoke density above a preset limit. If the density stays above the limit for appropriately eight seconds, the sensor sets the detector to the alarm condition.
options.C: The smoke transducer monitors for smoke density above a presumed limit of each detector. If the density remains over the limit about eight seconds, the  transducer turn the detector to the alarm condition.

explanation: 【译文】The smoke sensor in each detector monitors for smoke density above a preset limit. If the density stays above the limit for appropriately eight seconds, the sensor sets the detector to the alarm condition.【词汇】smoke sensor=烟雾传感器，preset limit=预设限制，stays above=保持高于，alarm condition=警报状态，detector=探测器。【解析】B正确：preset limit对应"预设限制"，stays above对应"保持高于"，sets…to the alarm condition对应"设定到警报状态"，主谓与术语对应。A两处错误：previous limit（先前的限制）错译preset（预设），the sensor set缺时态变化（语法错误）。C把sensor误为transducer（换能器），presumed（假定的）错译preset，turn…to搭配不当。

question: 说明当飞机的重量或力矩发生变化时，如何保持该记录，以便在飞机正常运行时能够获得准确的起动数据来计算重量和重心。

options.A: When the weight or torque of the aircraft change, illustrate how to keep this record in order to save the exact initial values to measure the weight and heavy center in normal flight.
options.B: Explain how to maintain this record when changes to the weight or moments of the airplane are made so that accurate starting data is available to calculate the weight and center of gravity during normal operation of the airplane.
options.C: When the changes to the mass or momentum occur, show the way to hold this record to get the beginning information easily to compute the mass and gravity core.

explanation: 【译文】Explain how to maintain this record when changes to the weight or moments of the airplane are made so that accurate starting data is available to calculate the weight and center of gravity during normal operation of the airplane.【词汇】maintain this record=保持该记录，moments=力矩，accurate starting data=准确的起始数据，center of gravity=重心，normal operation=正常运行。【解析】B正确：how to maintain this record对应"如何保持该记录"，so that…is available对应"以便能够获得"，center of gravity对应"重心"。A把moments误为torque（扭矩），center of gravity误为heavy center（杜撰词），术语错译。C把weight/moments误为mass/momentum（质量/动量），gravity core非规范表达，全句关键术语均错。

question: 程序应在每章中按参考编号的顺序编写，并带有恰当的主要和次要主题标题，不必在新的页面顶部开始每个程序。

options.A: Programs shall be written in order of the reference number of each chapter and own proper primary and secondary theme headings. It is not necessary to begin a program from the ceiling of a new page.
options.B: Procedures shall be sorted in priority order of the reference number in each chapter. They have appropriate main and subordinate topic headings and the beginning do not need to exceed the top of a new page.
options.C: Procedures shall be prepared in reference number sequence within each chapter with proper major and minor subject heads, without the necessity of each procedure starting at the top of a new page.

explanation: 【译文】Procedures shall be prepared in reference number sequence within each chapter with proper major and minor subject heads, without the necessity of each procedure starting at the top of a new page.【词汇】procedures=程序，reference number sequence=参考编号顺序，major and minor subject heads=主要和次要主题标题，the top of a new page=新页顶部。【解析】C正确：prepared in reference number sequence对应"按参考编号顺序编写"，without the necessity of对应"不必"，要素齐全且句式规范。A把procedures误为programs（计划），ceiling（天花板）错译页顶（top），词义错译。B两处错误：priority order（优先级顺序）错译编号顺序，exceed the top（超过顶部）错译"从新页顶部开始"。

question: 因此，不论大型飞机还是小型飞机的维护手册或线路图手册，希望获得有关燃油系统的指示部分信息的人员可以参考标签第28章燃油。

options.A: Thus, whether the manual be a maintenance manual or a wiring diagram manual for a large airplane or a small airplane, the person wishing information concerning the indicating portion of the fuel system would refer to the Tab Chapter 28, Fuel.
options.B: Therefore, those hoping to obtain information about the fuel system instructions section of the repair manual or circuit diagram manual for both large and small aircraft may correspond to the label, chapter 28, Fuel.
options.C: As a result, regardless of the aircraft type (large or small), the person who wants to get display section information of the fuel system in the servicing manual or line diagram manual may search the tag, chapter 28, Fuel.

explanation: 【译文】Thus, whether the manual be a maintenance manual or a wiring diagram manual for a large airplane or a small airplane, the person wishing information concerning the indicating portion of the fuel system would refer to the Tab Chapter 28, Fuel.【词汇】whether…or=不论…还是，wiring diagram manual=线路图手册，indicating portion=指示部分，refer to=参考，Tab Chapter 28=标签第28章。【解析】A正确：whether…be结构对应"不论…还是"，indicating portion对应"指示部分"，refer to对应"参考"，文体与要素均准。B把indicating portion误为instructions section（说明章节），correspond to错译refer to，词义错译。C把maintenance manual误为servicing manual（勤务手册），wiring diagram误为line diagram，tag错译Tab，术语不规范。

question: 飞机导航系统向机组人员提供飞行所需的数据，并满足最恰当的安全要求。

options.A: The aircraft navigation systems provide the flight which is required by the crew,and meet the the most appropriate safety requirements.
options.B: The aircraft navigation systems provide the crew with the data required for flight within the most provisional safety requirements.
options.C: The aircraft navigation systems provide the crew with the data required for flight within the most appropriate safety requirements.

explanation: 【译文】The aircraft navigation systems provide the crew with the data required for flight within the most appropriate safety requirements.【词汇】navigation systems=导航系统，provide the crew with the data=向机组提供数据，required for flight=飞行所需的，within…safety requirements=在…安全要求内/满足安全要求。【解析】C正确：provide…with结构对应"向…提供"，most appropriate对应"最恰当"，与safety requirements搭配自然。A两处错误：provide the flight缺with结构，且把提供对象从crew改成flight（语法及逻辑错误），the the拼写重复。B把appropriate误为provisional（临时的），词义错译，"最临时的安全要求"语义不通。

question: 直接损坏的定义如下：1）金属表面燃烧、熔化或出现金属变形迹象。2） 非金属表面被烧伤、刺穿或分层。

options.A: Direct Damage is defined as follows:  1)  Metallic surfaces are burned, melted or show signs of metal distortion.  2)  Non-metallic surfaces are burned, punctured or delaminated.
options.B: Direct Damage is defined as follows:  1)  Metallic surfaces are burned, combined or show signs of metal corrosion.  2)  Non-metallic surfaces are burned, punctured or contaminated.
options.C: Direct Damage is defined as follows:  1)  Metallic surfaces are burned, synthesised or show signs of metal distortion.  2)  Non-metallic surfaces are burned, cut or delaminated.

explanation: 【译文】Direct Damage is defined as follows: 1) Metallic surfaces are burned, melted or show signs of metal distortion. 2) Non-metallic surfaces are burned, punctured or delaminated.【词汇】Direct Damage=直接损坏，melted=熔化，distortion=变形，punctured=刺穿，delaminated=分层。【解析】A正确：melted、distortion、punctured、delaminated分别对应熔化、变形、刺穿、分层，两类损伤描述逐项对应。B两处错误：把melted误为combined（结合），把delaminated误为contaminated（污染），术语错译。C把melted误为synthesised（合成），punctured误为cut（切割），损伤类型张冠李戴。

question: 主滑油/燃料热交换器使用来自低压燃油泵的燃油来降低滑油回油的温度。

options.A: The main oil/fuel heat exchanger uses the low temperature of the scavenge oil to reduce the fuel flow from the low pressure fuel pump.
options.B: The main oil/fuel heat exchanger uses fuel from the low pressure fuel pump to decrease the temperature of the scavenge oil.
options.C: The main oil/fuel heat exchanger sends fuel from the low pressure fuel pump to the scavenge oil lines to decrease the oil temperature.

explanation: 【译文】The main oil/fuel heat exchanger uses fuel from the low pressure fuel pump to decrease the temperature of the scavenge oil.【词汇】oil/fuel heat exchanger=滑油/燃油热交换器，low pressure fuel pump=低压燃油泵，decrease the temperature=降低温度，scavenge oil=回油（滑油）。【解析】B正确：uses fuel from the low pressure fuel pump对应"使用来自低压燃油泵的燃油"，decrease the temperature of the scavenge oil对应"降低滑油回油温度"，热交换方向正确。A把热交换关系倒置：用滑油低温去降燃油流量，与原文用燃油降滑油温度相反。C把"用燃油降温"误为"把燃油送入回油管路"（sends fuel…to the scavenge oil lines），功能错译。

question: 脱开从防渗漏活门连接到润滑组件的滑油管时，防渗漏活门会防止滑油渗漏。

options.A: The anti-leakage valve prevents oil leakage when you disconnect the oil tube from the anti-leakage valve to the lubrication unit.
options.B: When you reconnect the oil tube from the anti-leakage valve to the lubrication unit, the anti-leakage valve stops oil leakage.
options.C: When you discharge the oil tube from the anti-leakage valve to the lubrication unit, the anti-leakage valve protects oil leakage.

explanation: 【译文】The anti-leakage valve prevents oil leakage when you disconnect the oil tube from the anti-leakage valve to the lubrication unit.【词汇】anti-leakage valve=防渗漏活门，prevents oil leakage=防止滑油渗漏，disconnect=脱开，lubrication unit=润滑组件。【解析】A正确：prevents对应"防止"，disconnect对应"脱开"，from…to对应"从…连接到"，动作方向与功能描述一致。B把disconnect误为reconnect（重新连接），动作方向相反。C两处错误：discharge（排放）错译disconnect，protects oil leakage（保护渗漏）逻辑不通，应为prevents。

question: 本词典包括一些未经批准的词，如果能把它们归于合适的技术名称类别中，那它们也可以算作技术名称。

options.A: The dictionary includes some unapproved words that can be technical names if you can put them in the applicable technical name category.
options.B: Some unapproved words in this dictionary can be seen as technical words if they have been classified into the technical name category.
options.C: The dictionary shall include the unapproved words that can be put in the appropriate technical name category and count as technical name.

explanation: 【译文】The dictionary includes some unapproved words that can be technical names if you can put them in the applicable technical name category.【词汇】unapproved words=未经批准的词，technical names=技术名称，applicable category=适用的类别，put…in=归入。【解析】A正确：includes some unapproved words对应"包括一些未经批准的词"，can be technical names对应"可以算作技术名称"，if you can put them in对应"如果能把它们归于"。B两处不足：technical words错译technical names（技术名称），且把includes弱化成定语从句（Some unapproved words in this dictionary），主句重心偏移。C把客观陈述"包括"译成shall include（应包括，强制意味不符），count as technical name表达生硬。

question: 铝线不应连接到安装在发动机上的附件或在有腐蚀性气体、严重振动、机械应力或需要频繁断开的地方使用。

options.A: Aluminum wire should not be attached to engine mounted accessories or used in areas having corrosive fumes, severe vibration, mechanical stresses, or where there is a need for frequent disconnection.
options.B: Aluminum line should not be connected to attachments which are mounted on the engine and also not be applied in domains where corrosive gases, serious oscillation, mechanical forces exist or where it is necessary to disconnect frequently.
options.C: Aluminum cable should not be linked to accessories installed on the engine. It should also not be used in the event of corrosive fumes, serious vibration, mechanic loads or the place where frequent disconnections are required.

explanation: 【译文】Aluminum wire should not be attached to engine mounted accessories or used in areas having corrosive fumes, severe vibration, mechanical stresses, or where there is a need for frequent disconnection.【词汇】aluminum wire=铝线，engine mounted accessories=发动机安装的附件，corrosive fumes=腐蚀性气体，severe vibration=严重振动，frequent disconnection=频繁断开。【解析】A正确：wire、engine mounted accessories、corrosive fumes、severe vibration、mechanical stresses、frequent disconnection六个考点全部对应，并列结构规范。B多处错译：line（线路/管路）≠wire（导线），attachments、domains（领域）、oscillation、mechanical forces均非对应术语。C把wire误为cable（电缆），mechanic loads错译mechanical stresses（机械应力），且拆句破坏并列条件。

question: 这种类型的开关的内部失效可能使开关保持闭合，尽管扳钮或按钮回到了OFF位。

options.A: An internal failure in this type of switch may allow the switch to remain closed even though the toggle or button returns to the OFF position.
options.B: An inner fault of this kind of switch may keep the switch clogged despite the knob or pushbutton returning to the OFF position.
options.C: An interior loss which occurs in this type of switch, may stay closed in spite of the OFF position of the knob or button.

explanation: 【译文】An internal failure in this type of switch may allow the switch to remain closed even though the toggle or button returns to the OFF position.【词汇】internal failure=内部失效，remain closed=保持闭合，even though=尽管，toggle=扳钮，OFF position=OFF位。【解析】A正确：internal failure对应"内部失效"，may allow…to remain closed对应"可能使开关保持闭合"，even though对应"尽管"，让步结构完整。B两处错误：inner fault不如internal failure规范，clogged（堵塞）严重错译closed（闭合/接通），属词义错译。C语法错误：interior loss（内部损失）≠internal failure，且may stay closed缺主语，句子结构残缺。

question: 为了避免振动路径上的边缘效应，使测试读数可能被误判，应移动测试探头，使检测路径沿表面边缘移动，为测试探头检测提供恒定的边缘。

options.A: In order to avoid edge effects on vibration routes that may misinterpret test readings, the test pitot should be moved so that the detection route moves along the surface edge to provide a constant edge for the test pitot detection.
options.B: To avoid edge effects on vibration paths which give a test reading that may be misinterpreted, the test probe should be moved so that the inspection path follows the surface edge, giving a constant edge for the test probe to inspect.
options.C: The detector should be removed along the inspection route which follows the surface edge to provide an immobile edge to detect, so as to avoid the effects on vibration route edge which may lead to the misunderstanding of the test reading.

explanation: 【译文】To avoid edge effects on vibration paths which give a test reading that may be misinterpreted, the test probe should be moved so that the inspection path follows the surface edge, giving a constant edge for the test probe to inspect.【词汇】edge effects=边缘效应，vibration paths=振动路径，test probe=测试探头，inspection path=检测路径，constant edge=恒定边缘。【解析】B正确：vibration paths、test probe、follows the surface edge、constant edge逐项对应，目的状语与结果分词结构清楚。A把test probe误为test pitot（皮托管），部件张冠李戴。C两处错误：removed（移除）错译moved（移动），immobile edge（不动的边缘）错译constant edge，且effects on vibration route edge语序混乱。

question: 设备的替代品可以列在同一项目号下。对于由位于飞机不同位置的多个组件构成的装置，每个组件应分别列出。

options.A: Alternates for equipment may be listed under the same item number. For installations made up of a number of units which my be located at various places in the airplane, each unit should be listed separately.
options.B: Alternative equipment can be listed under the same item number. Multiple identical components installed in different locations of the aircraft should be listed uniformly.
options.C: Different equipment may be substituted for each other and listed under the same item number. Multiple identical units installed on different aircraft should be listed individually.

explanation: 【译文】Alternates for equipment may be listed under the same item number. For installations made up of a number of units which may be located at various places in the airplane, each unit should be listed separately.【词汇】alternates=替代品，item number=项目号，installations=装置，made up of units=由组件构成，listed separately=分别列出。【解析】A正确：Alternates for equipment对应"设备的替代品"，installations made up of…units对应"由多个组件构成的装置"，listed separately对应"分别列出"。B两处错误：把"多个组件"误为identical components（相同组件），listed uniformly（统一列出）与separately相反。C把"位于飞机不同位置"误为installed on different aircraft（装在不同飞机上），范围错误。

question: 储备量按该飞行在巡航动力条件下飞行45分钟计算。对图表中说明性的信息应提供储备量是如何计算出的。

options.A: The reserved 45 minutes for use in aircraft cruising power shall be calculated. Chart should provide information of the calculation method for the reserve.
options.B: To reserve 45 minutes for the flight at cruising power is calculated. The calculation method of reserves should provide additional diagrams and related instructions.
options.C: Reserve shall be computed as 45 minutes at the cruise power to be used for the flight. The explanation information presented with the chart should explain how the reserve was computed.

explanation: 【译文】Reserve shall be computed as 45 minutes at the cruise power to be used for the flight. The explanation information presented with the chart should explain how the reserve was computed.【词汇】reserve=储备量，computed=计算，cruise power=巡航动力，explanation information=说明性信息，presented with the chart=随图表提供。【解析】C正确：computed as 45 minutes at the cruise power对应"按巡航动力45分钟计算"，how the reserve was computed对应"储备量如何计算"。A把45分钟储备量说成reserved 45 minutes for use，语序混乱，且chart should provide的表达未体现"说明性信息"要素。B逻辑错误：is calculated主语不明，且把"图表说明信息解释如何计算"误为"计算方法应提供图表"，关系倒置。

question: 校正空速是对位置和仪表误差修正后显示的飞机飞行速度。校正空速等于在海平面标准大气中的真实空速。

options.A: Calibrated Airspeed means according to aircraft position, after correction instrument error, the aircraft display speed. Calibrated airspeed can be achieved when aircraft in flight in sea level standard atmosphere.
options.B: Calibrated Airspeed means the indicated speed of an aircraft, corrected for position and instrument error. Calibrated airspeed is equal to true airspeed in standard atmosphere at sea level.
options.C: Calibrated Airspeed is the speed of the aircraft shown on the instrument after error correction. The calibrated airspeed is the flight altitude and speed of a real aircraft under normal atmospheric pressure.

explanation: 【译文】Calibrated Airspeed means the indicated speed of an aircraft, corrected for position and instrument error. Calibrated airspeed is equal to true airspeed in standard atmosphere at sea level.【词汇】Calibrated Airspeed=校正空速，indicated speed=指示速度，corrected for=经修正，position and instrument error=位置和仪表误差，true airspeed=真实空速，standard atmosphere at sea level=海平面标准大气。【解析】B正确：indicated speed corrected for对应"修正后的指示速度"，equal to true airspeed对应"等于真实空速"，两句定义完整。A语法混乱：according to aircraft position, after correction instrument error无法成句，can be achieved也错译"等于"。C第二句把定义误为"真实飞机的飞行高度和速度"，完全曲解"等于海平面标准大气中的真实空速"。

question: 航空器审定办公室已经按照法令授权，将一些检查和审定职责委派给委任工程代表去完成， 委任工程代表不是联邦航空局的雇佣人员， 而是经过其正式考核合格的个人。

options.A: In accordance with the laws, the ACOs have authorized and designated certain inspection and certification responsibilities to Designated Engineering Representatives(DERs),  who are qualified individuals formally tested but not employees of the FAA.
options.B: The ACOs have been authorized by statute to delegate certain inspection and certification responsibilities to Designated Engineering Representatives(DERs), who are properly qualified private persons not employed by the FAA.
options.C: The ACOs have dedicated certain inspection and certification responsibilities to Designated Engineering Representatives(DERs) as per the Act, the DERs are not employees of the FAA, but some qualified personnel agreed by FAA.

explanation: 【译文】The ACOs have been authorized by statute to delegate certain inspection and certification responsibilities to Designated Engineering Representatives (DERs), who are properly qualified private persons not employed by the FAA.【词汇】ACOs（Aircraft Certification Offices）=航空器审定办公室，authorized by statute=按法令授权，delegate=委派，Designated Engineering Representatives（DERs）=委任工程代表，not employed by the FAA=非FAA雇员。【解析】B正确：authorized by statute对应"按法令授权"，delegate responsibilities对应"委派职责"，properly qualified private persons not employed by对应"合格的非雇佣个人"。A两处不足：authorized and designated并列累赘且delegate更准确，formally tested（正式测试）与"考核合格"有偏差。C把delegate误为dedicated（奉献），agreed by FAA（经FAA同意）错译"考核合格"，词义错译。

question: 顶部所有垂直的主固定支柱都是可调节的。但是,调节主安装座支柱是不需要的,除非修理或更换支柱。在更换APU时，备用的垂直支柱(左前侧)和备用的侧支柱(右前侧)可能需要调节。

options.A: All of the top vertical mounting struts are adjustable except the primary mount struts unless they are repaired or replaced. The spare vertical strut (left forward ) and the side strut (right forward) may require adjustment during APU replacement.
options.B: All of the vertical primary mount struts at the top are adjustable. However, adjustments to the primary mount struts are not required unless a strut is repaired or replaced. The redundant vertical strut (forward left) and the redundant side strut (forward
options.C: The top of every vertical main retaining struts is adjustable. However, adjusting the main mount strut is not allowed if the strut is not repaired or replaced. During APU replacement, it may be necessary to adjust remained vertical strut (left anterior) a

explanation: 【译文】All of the vertical primary mount struts at the top are adjustable. However, adjustments to the primary mount struts are not required unless a strut is repaired or replaced. The redundant vertical strut and side strut may require adjustment during APU replacement.【词汇】primary mount struts=主安装座支柱，adjustable=可调节的，not required unless=除非…否则不需要，redundant strut=备用支柱，APU replacement=更换APU。【解析】B正确：vertical primary mount struts at the top对应"顶部垂直主固定支柱"，not required unless repaired or replaced对应"除修理或更换外不需要调节"，redundant对应"备用"。A逻辑错误：except the primary mount struts把"所有主支柱可调"说成"除主支柱外都可调"，范围相反。C把mount误为retaining（保持），not allowed（不允许）错译not required（不需要），remained也错译redundant。

question: 豁免许可申请者必须说明该豁免批准不会影响安全的理由，或者必须说明申请者要采取的措施以确保所提供的安全水平与寻求豁免的条例所提供的安全水平是等效的。

options.A: The applicant for an avoidance permit must show that the approval of the avoidance permit will not affect safety and must provide an explanation. The applicant shall take measures to ensure that the level of safety is equal to the level of safety provided
options.B: The petitioner for an exemption must include reasons why safety would not be adversely affected if the exemption is granted, or must explain the action to be taken by the petitioner to provide a level of safety equal to that provided by the rule from whic
options.C: The applicant for an exemption permit must state the reasons why safety will not be affected by the granted approval, or must take measures to ensure that the level of safety provided is consistent with the requirements of the regulations seeking exemptio

explanation: 【译文】The petitioner for an exemption must include reasons why safety would not be adversely affected if the exemption is granted, or must explain the action to be taken by the petitioner to provide a level of safety equal to that provided by the rule from which exemption is sought.【词汇】petitioner for an exemption=豁免许可申请者，adversely affected=受到不利影响，the action to be taken=将采取的措施，a level of safety equal to=与…等效的安全水平，rule from which exemption is sought=寻求豁免的条例。【解析】B正确：petitioner、adversely affected、action to be taken、equal to that provided by the rule逐项对应，两种情形的并列结构完整。A把exemption误为avoidance（避免），"豁免"术语错译，且句尾截断不完整。C把"等效于条例提供的安全水平"误为consistent with the requirements（与要求一致），等同对象错位。

question: 可以理解的是，在某些情况下，遵守上述规定会导致测试过程的重复，这是可以接受的。

options.A: It is understood that compliance with the above can in some instances cause duplication of test procedures, which is acceptable.
options.B: It will lead to repeat the test process when you obey the regulations in some cases, it is barely to be accepted.
options.C: It is understood that follow the above regulations may cause repeating in the test procedures , although it is allowable.

explanation: 【译文】It is understood that compliance with the above can in some instances cause duplication of test procedures, which is acceptable.【词汇】It is understood that=可以理解的是，compliance with=遵守，in some instances=在某些情况下，duplication of test procedures=测试程序重复，acceptable=可接受的。【解析】A正确：It is understood that对应"可以理解的是"，compliance with the above对应"遵守上述规定"，which is acceptable对应"这是可以接受的"，要素全对。B把acceptable误为barely to be accepted（勉强能接受），程度错译，且lead to repeat语法错误。C两处错误：follow the above regulations作主语缺形式主语（语法错误），although it is allowable的让步关系与"这是可以接受的"含义不符。

question: 维修手册的索引应与第20部分的基本标准分类兼容。然而，制造商可以省略不适用于其产品的系统或章节，或者在可行的情况下合并系统或章节。

options.A: The index of the maintenance manual shall be comparative to the basic standard category of Part 20. Manufacturers may, however, delete systems or sections that do not apply to their products or, where practicable, combine systems or sections.
options.B: The index for maintenance manuals shall be compatible with the basic standard breakdown of Section 20. However, manufacturers may omit system or chapters that are not applicable to the product or combine system or chapters where it is feasible.
options.C: The basic standard category of Part 20 must conform to the index of the maintenance manual. However, manufacturers may elide systems or sections that are not applied to their products, or incorporate systems or sections where applicable.

explanation: 【译文】The index for maintenance manuals shall be compatible with the basic standard breakdown of Section 20. However, manufacturers may omit system or chapters that are not applicable to the product or combine system or chapters where it is feasible.【词汇】index=索引，compatible with=与…兼容，basic standard breakdown=基本标准分类，omit=省略，where it is feasible=在可行的情况下。【解析】B正确：compatible with对应"兼容"，omit对应"省略"，combine where it is feasible对应"可行时合并"，要素对应完整。A把compatible误为comparative（比较的），Part 20应为Section 20，词义错译。C主客倒置：把"索引与分类兼容"译成"分类须符合索引"，且elide/incorporate也不对应omit/combine。

question: 当节或子系统单元编号后面的主题单元编号(28-20-00)为零时，该信息适用于系统内的子系统。

options.A: When the section or subsystem element number is followed with zeros in the subject element number (28-20-00) , the information is applicable to subsystems within the system.
options.B: This information applies to subsystems of the system when the topic number (28-20-00) following the section or subsystem part number is zero.
options.C: This information is suitable to subsystems in the system when the topic unit number (28-20-00) is followed by the section or subsystem unit number with zeros.

explanation: 【译文】When the section or subsystem element number is followed with zeros in the subject element number (28-20-00), the information is applicable to subsystems within the system.【词汇】section or subsystem element number=节或子系统单元编号，subject element number=主题单元编号，followed with zeros=后随零，applicable to=适用于。【解析】A正确：is followed with zeros in the subject element number对应"后面的主题单元编号为零"，applicable to subsystems within the system对应"适用于系统内子系统"。B两处错误：topic number（主题号）错译element number（单元编号），the topic number following…is zero把"主题编号后随零"说成"后面的编号为零"，条件含混。C把"主题编号为零"误为followed by the section or subsystem unit number with zeros（后随节编号零），条件关系倒置。

question: 航空器必须符合所适用的有关适航标准和专用条件，否则，不会对该航空器颁发型号合格证。

options.A: An aircraft must comply with all the Airworthiness Standards and special conditions applicable to it, otherwise, a Type Certificate can not be issued for that aircraft.
options.B: A Type Certificate will not be issued for the aircraft if that aircraft meets all the requirements of Airworthiness Standards and special conditions which are applicable to it.
options.C: The aircraft will get a Supplemental Type Certificate only if the aircraft accords with all the applicable Airworthiness Standards and special conditions.

explanation: 【译文】An aircraft must comply with all the Airworthiness Standards and special conditions applicable to it, otherwise, a Type Certificate can not be issued for that aircraft.【词汇】comply with=符合，Airworthiness Standards=适航标准，special conditions=专用条件，otherwise=否则，Type Certificate=型号合格证。【解析】A正确：comply with对应"符合"，special conditions对应"专用条件"，otherwise…cannot be issued对应"否则不会颁发"，因果逻辑完整。B逻辑相反：把"不符合才颁证"的条件关系颠倒（meets all requirements反而不颁证），方向完全错误。C把Type Certificate误为Supplemental Type Certificate（补充型号合格证），证件类型张冠李戴。

question: 飞机维修手册或章节，至少包括下列资料：关于飞机及其系统与设备资料，包括发动机、螺旋桨及电器设备。

options.A: Airplane maintenance manual or section should contain at least the following information: about the airplane and its systems and installations including its engines, propellers and articles.
options.B: Airplane structure manual or section should consist of at least the following information: data of the airplane and its systems and installations excluding its engines, propellers and appliances.
options.C: Airplane maintenance manual or section, which includes at least the following information: a description of the airplane and its systems and installations including its engines, propellers and appliances.

explanation: 【译文】Airplane maintenance manual or section, which includes at least the following information: a description of the airplane and its systems and installations including its engines, propellers and appliances.【词汇】maintenance manual=维修手册，at least the following information=至少下列资料，description=资料/描述，installations=设备，propellers and appliances=螺旋桨及电器设备。【解析】C正确：maintenance manual对应"维修手册"，a description of对应"关于…的资料"，including engines, propellers and appliances逐项对应。A漏译"资料/描述"（直接about the airplane），articles（物品）错译appliances（电器设备），漏译要素。B把maintenance误为structure（结构），including误为excluding（排除），方向相反。

question: 战略行动计划意欲在公约的框架范围之内实施，以保证国际民航组织在新的时代迎接对民用航空的重大挑战，并满足其所有成员国的需要。

options.A: The purpose of the Strategic Action Plan is to perform beyond the scope of the convention to ensure that ICAO deals with the challenges for civil aviation in the new era and meets the requirements of all its Member States.
options.B: The Strategic Action Plan is designed to work within the framework of the convention to ensure that ICAO responds to the major challenges for civil aviation in the coming years and meets the need of all its Member States.
options.C: The aim of the Strategic Action Plan is to implement within the scope of the convention to make sure that ICAO flinches from challenges for civil aviation in the coming era and meets the requirements of its Member States.

explanation: 【译文】The Strategic Action Plan is designed to work within the framework of the convention to ensure that ICAO responds to the major challenges for civil aviation in the coming years and meets the need of all its Member States.【词汇】Strategic Action Plan=战略行动计划，within the framework of=在…框架内，respond to challenges=应对挑战，Member States=成员国。【解析】B正确：within the framework对应"框架范围之内"，responds to对应"迎接/应对"，meets the need对应"满足需要"，要素齐全。A把within误为beyond the scope（超出范围），方向相反。C把responds to（应对）误为flinches from（退缩/畏缩），与"迎接挑战"完全相反，属方向相反错误。

question: 联邦航空法规要求，在机体和发动机组合取证时，应使用“最大连续推力”表明其符合相应标准。

options.A: The Federal Aviation Regulations require the use of ‘maximum continuous power’, during certification of an airframe and engine combination, to show compliance with certain standards.
options.B: The Federal Aviation Regulations require the compliance with certain standards for an airframe and engine combination if they use 'maximum continuous power' during certification.
options.C: The use of ‘maximum continuous power’ and the compliance with certain certification standards are required by the Federal Aviation Regulations.

explanation: 【译文】The Federal Aviation Regulations require the use of 'maximum continuous power', during certification of an airframe and engine combination, to show compliance with certain standards.【词汇】Federal Aviation Regulations=联邦航空法规，maximum continuous power=最大连续推力/功率，certification=取证，airframe and engine combination=机体和发动机组合，show compliance with=表明符合。【解析】A正确：require the use of对应"应使用"，during certification of…combination对应"组合取证时"，to show compliance对应"表明符合"，要素齐全。B把"使用最大连续推力以表明符合"误为条件句（if they use…才可合规），逻辑关系错。C漏译"在机体和发动机组合取证时"的场景，且把use与compliance并列，改变原句重点。

question: 从海平面到温度为-56.5摄氏度的海拔高度之间的温度变化率为每英尺-0.00198摄氏度。在该高度之上温度变化率为零。

options.A: The temperature decreases - 0.00198°C per foot from sea level to the altitude at which the temperature is -56.5°C and zero above that altitude.
options.B: The temperature gradient from sea level to the altitude at which the temperature is -56.5°C is - 0.00198°C per foot and zero above that altitude.
options.C: The temperature drops 0.00198°C per foot from sea level to the altitude at which the temperature is -56.5°C and to zero above that altitude.

explanation: 【译文】The temperature gradient from sea level to the altitude at which the temperature is -56.5°C is -0.00198°C per foot and zero above that altitude.【词汇】temperature gradient=温度变化率，sea level=海平面，altitude=高度，per foot=每英尺，above that altitude=在该高度之上。【解析】B正确：temperature gradient准确对应"温度变化率"，-0.00198°C per foot保留负号，zero above对应"以上为零"。A用decreases -0.00198°C per foot表示变化率，decrease本身已含下降义，与负值叠加表达不规范，术语不如gradient准确。C两处错误：drops 0.00198丢掉负号概念，and to zero把"变化率为零"误为"降到零"，结构错误。

question: 相应联邦航空法规批准的所有类型的通航飞机和部件均可准备持续适航文件。

options.A: Continuing Airworthiness Programs may be prepared according to the related Federal Aviation Regulations for all types of general aviation airplanes and components.
options.B: All types of general aviation airplanes and components are certified by the applicable Federal Aviation Regulations which require the preparation of Continuing Airworthiness Programs.
options.C: Continuing Airworthiness Programs may be prepared for all types of general aviation airplanes and components certificated under the applicable Federal Aviation Regulations.

explanation: 【译文】Continuing Airworthiness Programs may be prepared for all types of general aviation airplanes and components certificated under the applicable Federal Aviation Regulations.【词汇】Continuing Airworthiness Programs=持续适航文件，general aviation airplanes=通用航空飞机，components=部件，certificated under=按…审定/批准。【解析】C正确：may be prepared for对应"均可准备"，certificated under the applicable FARs对应"经相应法规批准（审定）"，修饰关系清楚。A把"经批准的飞机和部件"译成according to the related FARs（依据相关法规准备文件），修饰对象张冠李戴。B把may be prepared（可准备）误为which require the preparation（法规要求准备），are certified by的主谓关系也改变原意。

question: 由于飞机不对称导致滚转或偏航，从而自动驾驶控制滚转达到最大权限。

options.A: The autopilot has reached its roll authority limit due to an airplane roll or yaw asymmetry.
options.B: The autopilot has been out of its roll authority limit due to an airplane roll or yaw symmetry.
options.C: The autopilot has reached its yaw authority limit due to an airplane roll or yaw imbalance.

explanation: 【译文】The autopilot has reached its roll authority limit due to an airplane roll or yaw asymmetry.【词汇】autopilot=自动驾驶，roll authority limit=滚转权限限制，due to=由于，roll or yaw asymmetry=滚转或偏航不对称。【解析】A正确：reached its roll authority limit对应"滚转达到最大权限"，roll or yaw asymmetry对应"滚转或偏航不对称"，因果关系正确。B两处错误：out of its limit（超出权限）与"达到权限"含义不同，symmetry（对称）与asymmetry（不对称）词义相反。C把roll authority误为yaw authority（偏航权限），权限轴张冠李戴。

question: 大翼防冰“L VALVE OPEN" 或“R VALVE OPEN" 灯保持在蓝色明亮。大翼防冰活门则没有在指令位置。

options.A: A wing anti-ice L VALVE OPEN or R VALVE OPEN light stays illuminated dim blue. The wing anti-ice valve is not in the ordered position.
options.B: A wing anti-ice L VALVE OPEN or R VALVE OPEN light stays illuminated bright blue. The wing anti-ice valve is not in the commanded position.
options.C: A wing anti-ice L VALVE OPEN or R VALVE OPEN light stays illuminated dim blue. The wing anti-ice valve is not in the preferred position.

explanation: 【译文】A wing anti-ice L VALVE OPEN or R VALVE OPEN light stays illuminated bright blue. The wing anti-ice valve is not in the commanded position.【词汇】wing anti-ice=大翼防冰，L/R VALVE OPEN light=左/右活门打开灯，bright blue=明亮蓝色，commanded position=指令位置。【解析】B正确：bright blue对应"蓝色明亮"，commanded position对应"指令位置"，两处关键修饰全部对应。A一处错误：把bright（明亮）误为dim（暗淡），词义相反。C两处错误：同样把bright误为dim，并把commanded（指令的）误为preferred（优先的），词义错译。

question: 当双汇流条断电时，在飞行高度25000英尺以上，不建议试图启动APU,而高度在25000英尺以下，建议最多只启动一次。

options.A: APU start attempts are inhibited above 25,000 feet with both busses off, only one start attempt is allowed below 25000 feet.
options.B: With both busses power off, APU start attempts is recommended above 25000 feet and only one start could be accepted below 25,000 feet.
options.C:
APU start attempts are not 
recommended above 25,000 feet. 
With both busses off, only one start 
attempt is recommended below 25,000 feet.

explanation: 【译文】APU start attempts are not recommended above 25,000 feet. With both busses off, only one start attempt is recommended below 25,000 feet.【词汇】APU start attempts=APU启动尝试，not recommended=不建议，with both busses off=双汇流条断电，only one start attempt=最多启动一次。【解析】C正确：not recommended对应"不建议"，with both busses off对应"双汇流条断电"，only one…recommended对应"建议最多一次"，程度与条件对应准确。A把"不建议"加强为inhibited（被抑制/禁止），"建议一次"加强为is allowed（允许），情态程度错译。B逻辑相反：把25000英尺以上"不建议"误为is recommended（建议），方向相反。

question: 重要的是，在进行修理时采用正确的装配顺序，这将确保所有部件都正确对齐。

options.A: It is important that the correct sequence of assembly is used when doing a repair, this will make sure that all parts are correctly aligned.
options.B: It is important to assemble the parts in a correct order during a repair which makes sure all parts correctly aligned.
options.C: When doing a repair, the correct sequence of assembly is important, which will make sure that all parts are correctly engaged.

explanation: 【译文】It is important that the correct sequence of assembly is used when doing a repair, this will make sure that all parts are correctly aligned.【词汇】sequence of assembly=装配顺序，when doing a repair=进行修理时，make sure=确保，correctly aligned=正确对齐。【解析】A正确：It is important that对应"重要的是"，correct sequence of assembly对应"正确的装配顺序"，aligned对应"对齐"，完整对应。B语法缺陷：which makes sure all parts correctly aligned中which指代不清且aligned前缺are（语法错误）。C把aligned（对齐）误为engaged（啮合/接合），词义错译，且the correct sequence…is important弱化It is important的强调语气。

question: 系统由相互关联的部件组合在一起，执行一个特定的功能。

options.A: A system consists of related components used to perform a specific function.
options.B: A system is a combination of interrelated components arranged to perform a specific function.
options.C: A system is combined with relevant components that perform a specific function.

explanation: 【译文】A system is a combination of interrelated components arranged to perform a specific function.【词汇】system=系统，combination=组合，interrelated components=相互关联的部件，arranged to perform=组合起来执行，specific function=特定功能。【解析】B正确：a combination of对应"组合在一起"，interrelated对应"相互关联"，arranged to perform对应"组合执行"，标准定义句式完整。A的related components漏译"相互"（inter-），且consists of（由…组成）不如a combination of对应"组合"贴切，漏译要素。C语法错误：is combined with把被动式误作定义句式，relevant（相关）也不如interrelated（相互关联）精确。

question: 每个系统包括基本部件和所有仪表、机械控制器，以及与系统有关的电气和液压组件。

options.A: Each system is composed of basic components and all equipment, mechanic controls and system related electric and hydraulic units.
options.B: Basic components and all apparatus are made up of each system, including mechanical controls and electrical and hydraulic units related sytem.
options.C: Each system includes the basic components and all instruments, mechanical controls, electrical and hydraulic units related to the system.

explanation: 【译文】Each system includes the basic components and all instruments, mechanical controls, electrical and hydraulic units related to the system.【词汇】basic components=基本部件，instruments=仪表，mechanical controls=机械控制器，electrical and hydraulic units=电气和液压组件，related to the system=与系统有关的。【解析】C正确：includes对应"包括"，instruments对应"仪表"，units related to the system对应"与系统有关的组件"，并列成分与修饰关系清楚。A把instruments误为equipment（设备），mechanic（修理工的）错译mechanical（机械的），词义错译。B语法与逻辑错误：Basic components…are made up of each system主客倒置（部件组成系统而非系统包括部件），related sytem拼写及用法错误。

question: 当缩写词或符号作为计量单位时，将它和前面的数字计为一个单词。

options.A: When a capital letter or a symbol is used for a unit of measurement, you should take it and the number before it as a word.
options.B: When used in measurement, the acronym or the symbol and the related number should be taken as a word.
options.C: When you write an abbreviation or a symbol for a unit of measurement, count it and the preceding number as one word.

explanation: 【译文】When you write an abbreviation or a symbol for a unit of measurement, count it and the preceding number as one word.【词汇】abbreviation=缩写词，unit of measurement=计量单位，count…as one word=计为一个单词，preceding number=前面的数字。【解析】C正确：abbreviation or a symbol对应"缩写词或符号"，count…as one word对应"计为一个单词"，preceding number对应"前面的数字"。A两处错误：capital letter（大写字母）错译abbreviation（缩写词），缩小概念范围；the number before it也不如preceding规范。B漏译"前面的"（用related number代替preceding number），且When used in measurement省略了"作为计量单位"的对应用法，漏译要素。

question: 在某些情况下，尤其是对于复杂的飞机，可能需要针对飞机及其系统的适当维修提供专门培训。

options.A: In some cases, for complex aircraft, special training should be conducted so that the aircraft and its systems can be maintained properly.
options.B: Sometimes, especially for complex airplanes, it may be necessary to provide specific training in the proper maintenance of the airplane and its systems.
options.C: Sometimes,  for particularly complex airplanes, it is required to provide special training so as to perform proper maintenance of the aircraft and its systems.

explanation: 【译文】Sometimes, especially for complex airplanes, it may be necessary to provide specific training in the proper maintenance of the airplane and its systems.【词汇】especially=尤其，complex airplanes=复杂的飞机，may be necessary=可能需要，specific training=专门培训，proper maintenance=适当维修。【解析】B正确：especially对应"尤其"，may be necessary对应"可能需要"（推测语气），in the proper maintenance对应"针对适当维修"，培训对象明确。A两处不足：should be conducted（应开展）与"可能需要"情态不符，so that把"针对维修的培训"误为目的从句。C把may be necessary（可能必要）加强为it is required（被要求），情态程度错译。

question: 营运人应与当地的管理当局协商，调整间隔时间，使其最适合各自的运营环境。

options.A: Operators should negotiate with their local regulatory agency to adjust intervals to a best fit for their individual operational environments.
options.B: Airlines should consult local authority, the interval shall be adjusted although it best suits their unique operational environment.
options.C: In order to get the best  intervals for their operational environments, operators should consult with local administration.

explanation: 【译文】Operators should negotiate with their local regulatory agency to adjust intervals to a best fit for their individual operational environments.【词汇】operators=营运人，negotiate with=与…协商，local regulatory agency=当地管理当局，adjust intervals=调整间隔时间，best fit for=最适合。【解析】A正确：negotiate with对应"协商"，local regulatory agency对应"当地管理当局"，adjust intervals to a best fit对应"调整间隔至最适合"，要素对应。B两处错误：Airlines（航空公司）窄化Operators（营运人）范围，although it best suits的让步逻辑使目的关系混乱。C漏译"调整"（只说get the best intervals），local administration（地方行政）不如regulatory agency对应"管理当局"，漏译要素。

question: 长的名词词组也会让母语为非英语的读者感到困惑，因为在某些语言中，最重要的名词是词组中的第一个名词。

options.A: The reason why long collocations make non-native English readers confusing is that the key word is the first one in the collocation in some languages.
options.B: Non-native English readers also feel confused with long noun phrases because of the great importance of the first noun in the phrase in some languages.
options.C: Long noun clusters are also confusing for non-native English readers, because in some languages the main noun is the first noun in the cluster.

explanation: 【译文】Long noun clusters are also confusing for non-native English readers, because in some languages the main noun is the first noun in the cluster.【词汇】noun clusters=名词词组，non-native English readers=母语非英语的读者，confusing=令人困惑，main noun=最重要的名词，the first noun in the cluster=词组中的第一个名词。【解析】C正确：noun clusters对应"名词词组"，main noun对应"最重要的名词"，the first noun in the cluster对应"词组中的第一个名词"，因果结构完整。A两处错误：collocations（搭配）错译noun phrases（名词词组），key word（关键词）与"最重要的名词"不对等。B把名词首位说成great importance of the first noun（第一名词的重要性），且feel confused with搭配不如confusing for准确，表达偏移。

question: 不要使用压缩空气清洁显示组件后面的孔。压缩空气会将污染物吹入显示组件内，这会造成设备损坏。

options.A: Because pressurized air can blow contamination away from the display unit, you should not use it to clean the holes behind the display unit in order to avoid damaging the equipment.
options.B: Do not use compressed air to clean the holes on the rear of the display unit. Compressed air will push contamination into the display unit. This can cause damage to the equipment.
options.C: Do not use compressed air to clean the holes behind the display unit, because it can blow contaminants into display unit which may be damaged.

explanation: 【译文】Do not use compressed air to clean the holes on the rear of the display unit. Compressed air will push contamination into the display unit. This can cause damage to the equipment.【词汇】compressed air=压缩空气，holes on the rear of=后面的孔，push contamination into=把污染物吹入，cause damage to=造成损坏。【解析】B正确：Do not use对应"不要使用"，push contamination into对应"将污染物吹入"，cause damage to the equipment对应"造成设备损坏"，三句递进完整。A把push contamination into误为blow contamination away from（吹离），方向相反。C用which may be damaged作定语从句指代不清（易被理解为组件本身受损而非"这会造成"），结构错误。

question: 清洁位于机长主飞行、导航和中下发动机显示组件后侧的通风孔处的所有棉绒、灰尘和碎屑。

options.A: Clean all lint, dust and debris from the ventilation holes located on the aft side of the captain's primary flight, navigation, and center lower engine display units.
options.B: Clean the vent holes behind the captain's primary flight, navigation and lower middle engine display units which are blocked by lint, dust and debris.
options.C: The captain's primary flight, navigation, and center lower engine display units must be cleaned since the ventilation holes behind them are clogged by lint, dust and debris.

explanation: 【译文】Clean all lint, dust and debris from the ventilation holes located on the aft side of the captain's primary flight, navigation, and center lower engine display units.【词汇】lint=棉绒，debris=碎屑，ventilation holes=通风孔，aft side=后侧，captain's primary flight display=机长主飞行显示。【解析】A正确：Clean all lint, dust and debris对应"清洁所有棉绒、灰尘和碎屑"，located on the aft side对应"位于后侧"，三类显示组件名称全部对应。B两处错误：blocked by把清洁对象说成堵塞物（改变信息结构），behind不如aft side规范。C把"清洁通风孔处杂物"改写成"显示组件必须被清洁"，宾语张冠李戴，clogged也改变了原句含义。

question:
The Preface has been omitted in the sample CAP in Section III and the 
 necessary information has been included in the Objectives.

options.A:
The Preface has been neglected in the sample CAP in Section III and the 
 necessary information has  resumed in the Objectives.
options.B:
The Preface has been deleted in the sample CAP in Section III and the 
 necessary information has been excluded in the Objectives.
options.C:
The Preface has been canceled in the sample CAP in Section III and the 
 necessary information has been covered in the Objectives.

explanation: 【译文】在第三节的样例CAP中省略了前言，必要信息已包含在目标中。【词汇】Preface=前言，omitted=省略，sample CAP=样例CAP，Objectives=目标章节，included in=包含在。【解析】C正确：canceled（取消/删去）承接omitted，covered（涵盖）对应included，改写后含义最接近原文。A两处错误：neglected（被忽视，含疏忽义）错译omitted，resumed（恢复）与included词义相反。B一处严重错误：excluded（排除）与原文included（包含）方向完全相反，虽deleted对应omitted但整体句意反转。

question: When there is an "emergency" situation, it is usually a failure that requires an immediate and quick response, such as an entire engine failure, fire or smoke, or perhaps a rapid drop in cabin pressure.

options.A: For "emergency", the related failure should be responded immediately, for example, the total engine failure, fire or smoke, sudden cabin pressure lost.
options.B: An "Emergency" almost including a serious failure that requires later response, such as a total engines failure, flame out or smoke, or rapid cabin pressurization.
options.C: For "emergency", the related failure should be treated immediately, for example, the total engine is not malfunctioning, fire or smoke, sudden cabin pressure lost.

explanation: 【译文】"紧急"情况通常是要求立即快速响应的故障，如发动机整体失效、起火或冒烟，或客舱压力快速下降。【词汇】emergency=紧急情况，immediate and quick response=立即快速响应，entire/total engine failure=发动机整体失效，rapid drop in cabin pressure=客舱压力快速下降。【解析】A正确：responded immediately对应"立即响应"，total engine failure对应"整个发动机失效"，fire or smoke、cabin pressure lost逐项对应。B两处错误：later response（稍后响应）与immediate相反，rapid cabin pressurization（快速增压）与"压力下降"方向相反。C把engine failure误为engine is not malfunctioning（发动机没有故障），词义完全相反。

question: For purposes of this specification, "airplane" refers to the airframe and related components specified in the Type Certificate or made available as options by the airplane manufacturer.

options.A: For purposes of this specification, "aircraft" means the relevant optional parts of the airframe and parts specified in the type certificate or supplied by the aircraft manufacturer
options.B: For the intention of this specification, " airplane" is know as the airframe selective components set forth in the Type Certificate or provided by the airplane producer.
options.C: For purposes of this specification, "aircraft" means the airframe and parts specified in the Type Certificate or the related optional parts supplied by the aircraft manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】就本规范而言，"飞机"指型号合格证中规定的机体及相关部件，或由飞机制造商作为选装提供的部件。【词汇】for purposes of this specification=就本规范而言，Type Certificate=型号合格证，airframe=机体，made available as options=作为选装提供。【解析】C正确：means the airframe and parts specified in the Type Certificate对应"型号合格证规定的机体和部件"，related optional parts supplied by对应"制造商提供的相关选装部件"，两分支齐全。A遗漏airframe（机体）这一主干，relevant optional parts of the airframe把机体部件误为机体的选装件，漏译要素。B两处错误：is know as语法错误（应为is known as），selective components错译"相关部件"，producer也不如manufacturer规范。

question: Copies of the appropriate forms and a description of the entries to be completed are available to you from the Factory Customer Service Representative.

options.A: Copies of the applicable forms can be provided by the Factory Customer Service Representative and he/she will explain to you about what procedures you need to complete.
options.B: The Factory Customer Service Representative can provide copies of the appropriate forms and an instruction of how to fill in the form  to you.
options.C: The Factory Customer Service Representative is responsible to give copies of the appropriate forms to you and describe all obstacles you will go through.

explanation: 【译文】工厂客户服务代表可以向您提供适当表格的副本以及应填写条目的说明。【词汇】appropriate forms=适当的表格，description of the entries=条目说明，Factory Customer Service Representative=工厂客户服务代表，available to you from=可从…处获得。【解析】B正确：provide copies of the appropriate forms对应"提供适当表格副本"，instruction of how to fill in the form对应"填写说明"，双宾语结构清楚。A两处错误：explain about what procedures you need to complete把"填写条目的说明"扩大成"要完成的程序"，范围错误。C把description of the entries误为describe all obstacles（描述所有障碍），词义张冠李戴，responsible to give也改变了available的可获得性含义。

question: The significant details of inspection results, repairs and modifications accomplished must be communicated to ABC Aircraft Company in order to assess the effectiveness of the recommended inspection procedures and time intervals.

options.A: It is mandatory to inform ABC Aircraft Company of the important details of inspection results, repairs and modifications accomplished, which will be used to evaluate if the recommended inspection procedures and time intervals are effective.
options.B: ABC Aircraft Company will communicate to acquire the significant details of inspection results, repairs and modifications completed to modify the recommended inspection procedures and time intervals.
options.C: ABC Aircraft Company is obliged to assess the effectiveness of the recommended inspection procedures and time intervals by obtaining the significant details of inspection results, repairs and modifications accomplished.

explanation: 【译文】检查结果、已完成的修理和改装的重要细节必须通报给ABC飞机公司，以便评估推荐检查程序和时间间隔的有效性。【词汇】significant details=重要细节，accomplished=已完成的，communicated to=通报给，assess the effectiveness=评估有效性，time intervals=时间间隔。【解析】A正确：mandatory to inform…of对应"必须通报"，evaluate if…are effective对应"评估有效性"，目的状语对应完整。B两处错误：把"被通报"改成ABC主动获取（will communicate to acquire），且modify（修改）错译assess（评估），目的张冠李戴。C把被动义务（must be communicated）改成ABC的义务（is obliged），且obtaining弱化"被通报"的信息流向，主客关系错误。

question: It is very difficult to determine the effects of corrosion but, as the reports from the CAP inspections are received, the inspection times will be adjusted for any severe problems.

options.A: Although the effects of corrosion is hard to assess, the inspection intervals will be adjusted if severe damage is found according to the CAP inspection reports received.
options.B: When receiving the reports from the CAP inspections, inspection times  will be adjusted for any severe problems so as to make it easier to determine the effects of corrosion.
options.C: To determine the effects of corrosion is very difficult because the inspection times will be adjusted for any severe problems if reports from the CAP inspections are received.

explanation: 【译文】腐蚀的影响很难确定，但随着CAP检查报告的接收，将针对任何严重问题调整检查时间。【词汇】effects of corrosion=腐蚀的影响，difficult to determine=难以确定，as the reports are received=随着报告被接收，adjusted for severe problems=针对严重问题调整。【解析】A正确：hard to assess对应"很难确定"，if severe damage is found according to the reports received对应"根据收到的报告对严重问题调整"，让步与条件逻辑和原文吻合。B因果错误：so as to make it easier to determine把原文并列的"难以确定"偷换成"调整是为了更容易确定"，逻辑张冠李戴。C把because强加因果：报告接收不是"难以确定"的原因，逻辑关系完全颠倒。

question:
As the mach trim actuator output shaft moves, it turns
the feel and centering unit which moves the input to the elevator PCUs.

options.A: The feel and centering unit could be turned when the mach trim actuator output shaft moves, then the motion could be transferred to the elevator PCU input mechanism.
options.B: The mach trim actuator output shaft can move the input to the elevator PCU directly and bypass the feel and centering unit.
options.C: The mach trim actuator output is only connected with the feel and centering unit and elevator PCU input, the elevator could not be moved.

explanation: 【译文】当马赫配平作动筒输出轴移动时，它带动感觉和定中组件，后者驱动升降舵PCU的输入。【词汇】mach trim actuator=马赫配平作动筒，output shaft=输出轴，feel and centering unit=感觉和定中组件，elevator PCUs=升降舵动力控制组件。【解析】A正确：when the output shaft moves对应"输出轴移动时"，turned对应"带动转动"，transferred to the elevator PCU input对应"传递到升降舵PCU输入"，传动链完整。B两处错误：directly（直接）且bypass the feel and centering unit（绕过组件）与原文"经过组件传递"相反。C把传动关系说成only connected with（仅连接），并得出elevator could not be moved的错误结论，功能描述相反。

question: The mach trim actuator also causes the elevator to be in a more nose down position during takeoff which allows the pilots to move the stabilizer to a more nose up position.

options.A: The mach trim actuator make the airplane more nose down by the elevator, the pilots could move the stabilizer to get back nose up position during takeoff.
options.B: The elevator will be in a more nose down position caused by the mach trim actuator movement, and thereafter the stabilizer could be moved to a more nose up position by pilots during takeoff.
options.C: The operation of the mach trim actuator and the stabilizer cause the airplane move to different attitude during takeoff, One cause nose down and the other nose up.

explanation: 【译文】马赫配平作动筒还使升降舵在起飞时处于更低头位置，从而允许飞行员把安定面调到更抬头位置。【词汇】elevator=升降舵，nose down=低头，stabilizer=安定面，nose up=抬头，during takeoff=起飞时。【解析】B正确：in a more nose down position caused by the mach trim actuator对应"由作动筒导致的更低头位置"，thereafter…moved to a more nose up position by pilots对应"飞行员再调到更抬头"，因果链完整。A把"使升降舵低头"误为make the airplane more nose down（使飞机更低头），对象张冠李戴，get back nose up也改变了程度含义。C只说move to different attitude（不同姿态），未指明升降舵低头、安定面抬头的对应关系，漏译要素。

question: When the pilot moves the elevator column out of the neutral range, switches inside the column cutout switches open in a direction opposite to stabilizer trim.

options.A: Switches inside the column cutout switches will be open if the pilot move the column out of the neutral and in  opposite diretion as stabilizer trim.
options.B: The cutout switches will always be open when the column move in the same stabilizer trim direction and out of the neutral range.
options.C: The cutout switches will always be closed when the column move in the different direction as stabilizer trim and out of the neutral range.

explanation: 【译文】当飞行员把驾驶杆移出中立范围时，杆内切断开关的开关沿与安定面配平相反的方向打开。【词汇】elevator column=驾驶杆，neutral range=中立范围，cutout switches=切断开关，in a direction opposite to=与…方向相反，stabilizer trim=安定面配平。【解析】A正确：out of the neutral对应"离开中立范围"，will be open对应"打开"，in opposite direction as stabilizer trim对应"与配平相反方向"。B两处错误：same direction（相同方向）与opposite相反，always（总是）也加重了条件。C把open误为closed（闭合），动作相反，different direction也不如opposite准确。

question: For grounded delta systems, "T2" shall be considered as corresponding to the grounded phase, the reference point for the system.

options.A: In a three-phase ground line sysem, "T2" is corresponding to the phase that is intentionally grounded, as the neutral point for the system.
options.B: In a grounded delta electrical system, one of the phases is grounded to create the ground line for the system. In this system, "T2" is corresponding to  the phase that is intentionally grounded.
options.C: In a grounded delta system, one of the phases is intentionally grounded to create the zero line for the system. The phase labeled "T2" corresponds to the grounded phase, while the other two phases (T1 and T3) are not grounded.

explanation: 【译文】在接地三角形系统中，有一相被有意接地以形成系统的参考点；标为"T2"的相对应于接地相，另两相（T1和T3）不接地。【词汇】grounded delta system=接地三角形系统，intentionally grounded=有意接地，corresponds to=对应于，grounded phase=接地相，reference point=参考点。【解析】C正确：intentionally grounded对应"有意接地"，labeled "T2" corresponds to the grounded phase对应"T2对应接地相"，并补充T1、T3不接地，信息完整准确。A把grounded delta误为three-phase ground line system（三相接地线系统），系统类型张冠李戴，neutral point（中性点）错译reference point。B大意正确但ground line（地线）错译reference point（参考点），且未说明T2即接地相的完整含义，不如C完整。

question: The adjustment/test description shall provide instructions for accomplishment of a test or check to assure the integrity as an operational component of a system, subsystem or unit assembly. Such tests or  checks will vary in complexity and stringency according to the conditions under which the unit functions. It is not intended that a complex functional test of a complete system and its attendant closer tolerances be performed if the unit replaced reactivates the  system and operates within the confines of a go-no-go specification .

options.A: The description for adjusting or testing should include instructions on how to conduct a test or check to ensure that a system, subsystem, or unit assembly is functioning properly. The complexity and strictness of these tests or checks will depend on the operating conditions of the unit. If the unit operates within a limited range and meets the required specifications, it is not necessary to perform a complex functional test of the entire system with stricter tolerances when the unit is replaced and reactivated.
options.B: The description for adjusting or testing should include instructions on how to conduct a test or check to ensure that a system, subsystem, or unit assembly is functioning properly. To ensure that a system, subsystem, or unit assembly is functioning properly, it is necessary to conduct tests or checks, which may vary in complexity and strictness based on the operating conditions of the unit. If the unit operates within the required specifications, a complex functional test of the entire system with stricter tolerances is not necessary when the unit is replaced and reactivated.
options.C: The description for adjusting or testing should include instructions on how to conduct a test or check to ensure that a system, subsystem, or unit assembly is functioning properly.To ensure that a system, subsystem, or unit assembly is functioning properly, it is necessary to conduct tests or checks, which may vary in complexity and strictness based on the operating conditions of the unit. If the unit replaced reactivates the  system and operates within the required specifications, a complex functional test of the entire system with stricter tolerances is not necessary.

explanation: 【译文】调整/测试说明应提供完成测试或检查的指令，以确保单元作为系统、子系统或组件的运转部件的完整性。测试或检查的复杂性和严格度随单元工作条件而变化。如果更换的单元重新激活系统并在合格/不合格规范范围内工作，则不拟要求对完整系统及其更严格公差执行复杂功能测试。【词汇】adjustment/test description=调整/测试说明，assure the integrity=保证完整性，operational component=运转部件，stringency=严格度，go-no-go specification=合格/不合格规范。【解析】A正确：ensure…is functioning properly对应"保证作为运转部件"，depend on the operating conditions对应"随工作条件变化"，not necessary…when the unit is replaced and reactivated对应"更换并重新激活时不必"，三段要素完整。B重复了To ensure一句造成冗余，且漏译go-no-go的具体条件。C同样重复前句，且把"重新激活系统并在规范内工作"的条件压缩为operates within the required specifications，漏译reactivates the system要素。

question: System Test: That procedure containing all adjustment specifications and tolerances required to maintain system and/or unit performance at maximum effciency and design specification. It shall be self-contained and may duplicate other tests.

options.A: System Test: The system testing procedure contains all the necessary adjustments and tolerances required to maintain the aircraft system and/or unit performance at maximum efficiency and design specification. This testing procedure is comprehensive and complete, and contain all the necessary information to perform the testing without reference to other documents or procedures.It may include some of the same tests that have been performed during other maintenance procedures.
options.B: System Test: The system testing procedure contains all the necessary adjustments and tolerances required to maintain the aircraft system and/or unit performance at maximum efficiency and design specification. This testing procedure is complete, self-sufficient, and independent of external references or resources.It may be consistent with other tests.
options.C: System Test: The system testing procedure contains all the necessary adjustments and tolerances required to maintain the aircraft system and/or unit performance at maximum efficiency and design specification. This testing procedure is complete, self-sufficient, and independent of external references or resources.It may have an interface with other tests.

explanation: 【译文】系统测试：包含为保持系统和/或组件性能达到最大效率和设计规范所需的全部调整规范和公差的程序。它应自成一体，并可与其他测试重复。【词汇】adjustment specifications and tolerances=调整规范和公差，maximum efficiency=最大效率，self-contained=自成一体，duplicate=重复。【解析】A正确：self-contained被解释为comprehensive and complete、without reference to other documents，duplicate other tests被解释为may include some of the same tests，准确展开定义。B把duplicate（重复）误为consistent with（与…一致），与"可重复其他测试"的含义不符。C把duplicate误为have an interface with（与…有接口），概念错误，self-sufficient等表述也不如A的展开准确。

question: The cleaning and painting portion of maintenance practices shall provide information as to material and procedure necessary to clean and paint an area or areas, and contain safety precautions necessary to protect personnel and material.
