Materials shall be identified by generic names and by MIL or AMS specification number where applicable.

options.A: The cleaning and painting portion of maintenance practices shall provide information regarding material and procedure necessary to clean and paint an area or areas, and contain warning or caution information necessary to protect personnel and material. Materials shall be identified by general  names and by Military Specification or American Material Specification number where applicable.
options.B: The cleaning and painting portion of maintenance practices shall provide information concerning material and procedure necessary to clean and spray an area or areas, and safety precautions necessary to protect personnel and material. Materials shall be identified by generic names and by Military Specification or American Material Specification number where applicable.
options.C: The cleaning and painting portion of maintenance practices shall provide information concerning material and procedure necessary to clean and spray an area or areas, and safety precautions necessary to protect personnel and material. Materials shall be identified by generic names and Military Specification specification number or by generic names and Aerospace Material Specification number where applicable.

explanation: 【译文】维修实践中的清洁和喷漆部分应提供清洁和喷漆一个或多个区域所需的材料和程序信息，并包含保护人员和材料所需的安全预防措施。材料应在适用处用通用名称和MIL或AMS规范编号标识。【词汇】maintenance practices=维修实践，safety precautions=安全预防措施，generic names=通用名称，MIL（Military Specification）=军用规范，AMS（Aerospace Material Specification）=航空材料规范。【解析】C正确：safety precautions对应"安全预防措施"，generic names对应"通用名称"，并把MIL与AMS规范编号分别列明（Aerospace Material Specification全称正确）。A两处错误：warning or caution information错译safety precautions，American Material Specification错译AMS全称。B把AMS同样误为American Material Specification（美国材料规范），规范名称张冠李戴。

question: Manufacturer's reference to type and source of supply for latest available service releases to aid in maintaining aircraft

options.A: The manufacture-provided information about the latest service releases, including their type and where to obtain them, to assist with aircraft maintenance.
options.B: The type and source of latest service provided by manufacturers to aid in aircraft maintenance.
options.C: The latest service released by the manufacturers about the type and source, to aid in aircraft maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】制造商提供的关于最新可用服务发布的类型和获取来源的参考信息，以帮助维护飞机。【词汇】reference=参考信息，type and source of supply=类型和供应来源，latest available service releases=最新可用服务发布，aid in maintaining aircraft=帮助维护飞机。【解析】A正确：manufacture-provided information对应"制造商参考"，including their type and where to obtain them对应"类型及获取来源"，to assist with aircraft maintenance对应"以帮助维护飞机"。B漏译reference（参考信息）的含义，latest service provided by manufacturers把"最新服务发布"说成"制造商提供的服务"，漏译要素。C语序错误：service released by the manufacturers about the type and source把"发布的类型和来源"误为"关于类型和来源的发布"，修饰关系张冠李戴。

question: Manufacturer's maintenance data shall include the information as to special tools, application of protective treatments after inspection, Structural fasteners,etc.

options.A: Manufacturer's maintenance data shall include the information as to tools such as sandpaper, protective treatments such as the application of a protective cap after inspection, and structural fasteners, among others.
options.B: Manufacturer's maintenance data shall include the information as to tools such as sandpaper, protective treatments such as electroplating after inspection, and structural fasteners, among others.
options.C: Manufacturer's maintenance data shall include the information as to tools such as paint spray gun, protective treatments such as electroplating after inspection, and structural fasteners, among others.

explanation: 【译文】制造商的维修数据应包括有关专用工具、检查后保护处理的应用、结构紧固件等信息。【词汇】maintenance data=维修数据，special tools=专用工具，protective treatments=保护处理，application…after inspection=检查后施加，structural fasteners=结构紧固件。【解析】B正确：tools、electroplating after inspection（检查后电镀属典型保护处理）、structural fasteners三类信息齐备，as to结构对应"有关"。A把protective treatments误为application of a protective cap（加装保护盖），cap是物品而非处理工艺，词义错译。C把工具示例换成paint spray gun，结构上同样可对应special tools，与B仅在这一自拟示例上不同，题干未给出区分依据。

question:
The Airworthiness Section must set forth each mandatory replacement time, structural inspection interval, and related structural inspection procedure
required for type certification.

options.A: The Airworthiness Section is responsible for establishing the necessary replacement time, structural inspection schedule, and relevant inspection procedure that are obligatory for TC certification.
options.B: The Airworthiness section of manufacturer's maintenance data specify mandatory replacement time, structural inspection interval, and related structural inspection procedure required for type certification.
options.C: Airworthiness department specifies each mandatory replacement time, structural inspection interval, and related structural inspection procedure required for type certification.

explanation: 【译文】适航性章节必须列明型号合格审定要求的每一强制更换时间、结构检查间隔和相关结构检查程序。【词汇】Airworthiness Section=适航性章节，set forth=列明，mandatory replacement time=强制更换时间，structural inspection interval=结构检查间隔，type certification=型号合格审定。【解析】B正确：Airworthiness section of manufacturer's maintenance data对应"制造商维修数据的适航性章节"，mandatory replacement time、inspection interval、related procedure逐项对应。A把"章节"误为establishing…的责任主体（is responsible for），并把type certification缩成TC certification，主体性质改变。C把Section（章节）误为department（部门），把文档章节说成组织机构，张冠李戴。

question: The equipment included in the basic maintenance manual may be only that which is normally included and installed in quantity. Data for "Special Order" or other than standard options may be in separate manuals or as seperate data furnished with the individual aircraft.

options.A: The equipment included in the basic maintenance manual may be only that which is normally included and installed according to quantity. Data for customized equipment may be in separate manuals or one aircraft has one data manual as such.
options.B: The equipment included in the basic maintenance manual may be only that which is normally included and installed in quantity. Data for common or customized equipment may be in separate manuals or one aircraft has one data manual as such.
options.C: The maintenance manual typically covers only the equipment that is commonly included and installed in large numbers. Information regarding specialized or non-standard options may be provided in separate manuals or as individual data specific to each aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】基本维修手册中包含的设备可能只是通常包含并大量安装的设备。"特殊订购"或非标准选装设备的数据可在单独手册中，或作为随单机提供的单独数据。【词汇】basic maintenance manual=基本维修手册，installed in quantity=批量安装，Special Order=特殊订购，separate manuals=单独手册，furnished with the individual aircraft=随单机提供。【解析】C正确：covers only the equipment commonly included对应"只包含常规安装的设备"，specialized or non-standard options对应"特殊订购或非标准选项"，individual data specific to each aircraft对应"单机数据"。A两处错误：according to quantity错译in quantity（批量地），customized equipment对Special Order选项的概括不全。B把"特殊订购或非标准选项"误为common or customized equipment（普通或定制设备），common与非标准范围矛盾，范围错误。

question: The water extractor is made from light alloy or fiberglass, and contains static swirl vanes and a water drain inside a body. Swirl vanes centrifuge the water droplets in the air to the inner surface of the water extractor body. The water collects at the lowest point of the body. It is then drained to ducts which leads to the water injectors which spray the water into the ram airflow. This helps the cooling capacity through the process of evaporation.

options.A: The water extractor is made from light alloy or fiberglass, and contains static swirl vanes and a water drain inside a body. Swirl vanes force the water droplets in the air to move to the inner surface of the water extractor body. The water accumulates at the lowest point of the body. It is then drained to ducts which leads to the water injectors which spray the water into the ram airflow. The evaporation process makes cooling happen.
options.B: The water extractor is made from light alloy or fiberglass, and contains static swirl vanes and a water drain inside a body. Swirl vanes force the water droplets in the air to move to the inner surface of the water extractor body. The water accumulates at the lowest point of the body. It is then drained to ducts which leads to the water injectors which spray the water into the ram airflow. This helps to cool more air.
options.C: The water extractor is made from light alloy or fiberglass, and contains static swirl vanes and a water drain inside a body. Swirl vanes centrifuge the water droplets in the air to the inner surface of the water extractor body. The water accumulates at the lowest point of the body. It is then drained to ducts which leads to the water injectors which spray the water into the ram airflow. This helps to cool more air.

explanation: 【译文】水分离器由轻合金或玻璃纤维制成，在壳体内含固定旋流叶片和排水口。旋流叶片把空气中的水滴甩到水分离器壳体内表面。水在壳体最低点聚集，然后排入通向喷水嘴的导管，喷水嘴把水喷入冲压气流。这通过蒸发过程帮助提高冷却能力。【词汇】water extractor=水分离器，light alloy=轻合金，fiberglass=玻璃纤维，swirl vanes=旋流叶片，ram airflow=冲压气流，evaporation=蒸发。【解析】A正确：全段与原文几乎逐句对应，force…to move to the inner surface传达离心作用，The evaporation process makes cooling happen对应"通过蒸发帮助冷却"。B把末句"通过蒸发过程提高冷却能力"弱化为This helps to cool more air，漏译evaporation要素。C虽保留centrifuge，但末句同样漏译蒸发过程，漏译要素。

question: If a fastener is over-torqued, internal stress is present. Internal stress is more important than design stress, because stress corrosion is difficult to recognize before it has overcome the design safety factor. The level of stress varies from point to point within the metal. Stresses near the yield strength are generally necessary to promote stress corrosion cracking.

options.A: When a fastener is tightened beyond the recommended moment, it creates internal stress. Internal stress is a crucial factor to consider since stress corrosion can be challenging to detect until it has surpassed the safety factor of the design. The level of stress is not uniform throughout the metal and can vary from one point to another. Stress corrosion cracking is usually promoted by stresses that are close to the maximum stress that a material can withstand before it begins to deform .
options.B: Exceeding the recommended torque when tightening a fastener causes internal stress, which is more significant than design stress.Internal stress is a crucial factor to consider since stress corrosion can be challenging to detect until it has surpassed the safety factor of the design. The level of stress is not uniform throughout the metal and can vary from one point to another. Stress corrosion cracking is usually promoted by stresses that are close to the yield strength, beyond which a material will possibly return to its original shape.
options.C: Exceeding the specified moment when tightening a fastener causes internal stress, which is more significant than design stress.Internal stress is a crucial factor to consider since stress corrosion can be challenging to detect until it has surpassed the safety factor of the design. The level of stress is not uniform throughout the metal and can vary from one point to another. Stress corrosion cracking is usually promoted by stresses that are close to the yield strength, beyond which a material will possibly return to its original shape.

explanation: 【译文】如果紧固件过扭，就存在内应力。内应力比设计应力更重要，因为应力腐蚀在突破设计安全系数之前难以识别。金属内各点的应力水平各不相同。通常需要接近屈服强度的应力才会促进应力腐蚀开裂。【词汇】over-torqued=过扭，internal stress=内应力，stress corrosion=应力腐蚀，yield strength=屈服强度，safety factor=安全系数。【解析】A正确：tightened beyond the recommended moment对应"过扭"，close to the maximum stress…before it begins to deform正确描述屈服强度（开始变形前的最大应力），要素齐全。B一处严重错误：beyond which a material will possibly return to its original shape把屈服点后说成"可恢复原状"，物理方向相反（屈服后不可恢复）。C与B同样错误描述屈服强度，且specified moment也不如recommended torque对应over-torqued。

question: The yaw damper works by sensing any yaw motion and then applying corrective inputs to the aircraft's rudder to reduce or eliminate any unwanted yawing. It is particularly useful in minimizing the effects of turbulence or other external disturbances that can cause yawing and make the aircraft harder to control. The yaw damper is an important safety feature that helps to improve the overall stability and control of the aircraft, especially during critical phases of flight such as takeoff and landing.

options.A: The yaw damper works by sensing any nose changing motion  and then applying corrective inputs to the aircraft's rudder to reduce or eliminate any unwanted yawing. It is particularly useful in minimizing the effects of turbulence or other external disturbances that can cause yawing and make the aircraft harder to control. The yaw damper is an important safety device that helps to improve the overall stability and control of the aircraft, especially during critical phases of flight such as takeoff and landing.
options.B: The yaw damper works by sensing any nose left-and-right motion  and then applying corrective inputs to the aircraft's rudder to reduce or eliminate any unwanted yawing. It is particularly useful in minimizing the effects of wake turbulence and ambient disturbances that can cause yawing and make the aircraft harder to control. The yaw damper is an important safety device that helps to improve the overall stability and control of the aircraft, especially during critical phases of flight such as takeoff and landing.
options.C: The yaw damper works by sensing any yaw motion and then transmitting corrective inputs to the aircraft's rudder to reduce or eliminate any unwanted yawing. It is particularly useful in minimizing the effects of turbulence or other external disturbances that can cause yawing and make the aircraft harder to control. The yaw damper is an important safety component that helps to stabilize and control the aircraft, especially during critical phases of flight such as takeoff and landing.

explanation: 【译文】偏航阻尼器通过感受任何偏航运动，然后向飞机方向舵施加修正输入来减少或消除不需要的偏航。它在减小湍流或其他外部扰动影响方面特别有用，这些扰动会引起偏航并使飞机更难操纵。偏航阻尼器是重要的安全装置，有助于改善飞机整体稳定性和操纵性，尤其在起飞和着陆等关键飞行阶段。【词汇】yaw damper=偏航阻尼器，sensing yaw motion=感受偏航运动，corrective inputs=修正输入，rudder=方向舵，external disturbances=外部扰动，critical phases of flight=关键飞行阶段。【解析】C正确：transmitting corrective inputs对应"施加修正输入"，turbulence or other external disturbances对应"湍流或其他外部扰动"，stabilize and control对应"稳定和操纵"，要素齐全。A把yaw motion误为nose changing motion（机头变化运动），传感对象错译。B两处不足：nose left-and-right motion不如yaw motion规范，wake turbulence and ambient disturbances把"湍流或其他外部扰动"窄化为尾流和环境扰动，范围错误。

question: If the aircraft points into the wind and wind speed is between 50 and 70 Kts, moor the aircraft at the NLG.If the aircraft does not point into the wind or the direction of the wind is not stable,for wind speeds or gusts more than 50 Kts, moor the aircraft at the NLG and the MLG.

options.A: If the wind speed is between 50 and 70 Kts and the aircraft is down the wind, secure the aircraft at the NLG (nose landing gear). However, if the aircraft is not down the wind or if the wind direction is unstable and wind speeds or gusts are more than 50 Kts, then secure the aircraft at both the NLG and MLG (main landing gear).
options.B: If the wind speed is between 50 and 70 Kts and the aircraft is down the wind, the mooring point shall be  at the NLG (nose landing gear). However, if the aircraft is not down the wind or if the wind direction is unstable and wind speeds or gusts are more than 50 Kts, then secure the aircraft at both the NLG and MLG (main landing gear).
options.C: If the wind speed is between 50 and 70 nautical miles/hour and the aircraft is up the wind, the mooring point shall be at the NLG (nose landing gear). However, if the aircraft is not up the wind or if the wind direction is unstable and wind speeds or gusts are more than 50 nautical miles/hour , then secure the aircraft at both the NLG and MLG (main landing gear).

explanation: 【译文】如果飞机迎风停放且风速在50至70节之间，在前起落架处系留飞机。如果飞机不迎风或风向不稳定，风速或阵风超过50节时，在前起落架和主起落架处系留飞机。【词汇】points into the wind=迎风，Kts=节（nautical miles/hour等值），moor the aircraft=系留飞机，NLG（nose landing gear）=前起落架，MLG（main landing gear）=主起落架，gusts=阵风。【解析】C正确：up the wind对应"迎风"，mooring point shall be at the NLG对应"在前起落架系留"，both the NLG and MLG对应"前、主起落架"，nautical miles/hour与Kts等值，条件分支与原文一致。A一处错误：secure（固定）不如moor/mooring point对应"系留"，且down the wind（顺风）方向相反。B两处问题：down the wind（顺风）与"迎风"方向相反；仅系留点表述正确但方向词错误，故改选C。

question: "Scheduled Servicing" includes internal cleaning, etc. Shall not include lubrication procedures required for the accomplishment of maintenance practices. Reference may be made to supplier documents in lieu of component lubrication.

options.A: "Scheduled Servicing" refers to internal cleaning and other maintenance activities, but it does not include lubrication procedures that are required for carrying out maintenance practices. However, if lubrication is required for a particular component, the maintenance personnel can refer to the supplier documents or instructions to ensure that the lubrication requirements of the component are met.
options.B: "Scheduled Servicing" refers to internal cleaning and other maintenance activities, but it does not include lubrication procedures that are required for carrying out maintenance practices. Component lubrication may be replaced by supplier documents.
options.C: "Scheduled Servicing" refers to internal cleaning and other maintenance activities, but it does not include lubrication procedures that are required for carrying out maintenance practices. Refer to supplier documents instead of component lubrication in "Scheduled Servicing".

explanation: 【译文】"定期勤务"包括内部清洁等，不应包括完成维修实践所需的润滑程序。可以参考供应商文件以代替部件润滑。【词汇】Scheduled Servicing=定期勤务，internal cleaning=内部清洁，lubrication procedures=润滑程序，maintenance practices=维修实践，in lieu of=代替，supplier documents=供应商文件。【解析】A正确：does not include lubrication procedures对应"不包括润滑程序"，refer to the supplier documents对应"参考供应商文件"，并补充说明满足部件润滑要求，解释最完整。B把in lieu of component lubrication误为component lubrication may be replaced by supplier documents（部件润滑被文件替代），语义不通。C把"代替部件润滑（的规定）"译成在Scheduled Servicing中直接参考文件，in lieu of的替代对象说反，范围错误。

question: That portion of the system which provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction. Includes items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.

options.A: That portion of the system which provides for supporting and stabilizing the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation during retraction. Includes items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.B: That portion of the system which provides for rolling and starting the aircraft while on the ground and stopping wheel rotation after extension. Includes items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.
options.C: That portion of the system used to make the aircraft roll and halt while on the ground and stop wheel rotation after retraction. Includes items such as swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.

explanation: 【译文】系统中使飞机在地面滚动和停止、并在收上后停止机轮转动的部分。包括旋转接头、防滑装置、压力指示器、管路等项。【词汇】rolling and stopping=滚动和停止，while on the ground=在地面时，wheel rotation=机轮转动，after retraction=收上后，swivel glands=旋转接头，anti-skid devices=防滑装置，plumbing=管路。【解析】C正确：roll and halt对应"滚动和停止"，after retraction对应"收上后"，列举项逐项对应原文。A两处错误：supporting and stabilizing（支撑稳定）错译rolling and stopping，during retraction（收上过程中）错译after retraction（收上后）。B把stopping误为starting（启动），把retraction误为extension（放出），两处方向相反。

question: In order to achieve the objective of providing the pilot with required, useful or desirable information concerning the operation of the particular airplane, in a form reasonably uniform throughout the industry, drafters of Handbooks shall follow the Specification to the extent practical.

options.A: In order to meet the demand of offering optional, practical or desirable information on the operation of the particular aircraft in a consistent form throughout the industry, drafters of Handbooks shall follow the Specification to the minimal extent.
options.B: In order to attain the aim of furnishing the pilot with needed and skillful information related to the operation of all type of airplane, in a form reasonably uniform throughout the industry, drafters of Handbooks shall apply to the Specification to the extent practical.
options.C: To achieve the goal of offering pilot required, useful or desirable information on the operation of the particular airplane, in a way considerably consistent in the industry, drafters of Handbooks must conform to the Specification to the extent practical.

explanation: 【译文】为实现以行业内较统一的形式向飞行员提供特定飞机运行所必需、有用或期望信息的目的，手册编写者应在可行范围内遵循本规范。【词汇】achieve the objective=实现目的，required, useful or desirable information=必需、有用或期望的信息，particular airplane=特定飞机，reasonably uniform=较统一，to the extent practical=在可行范围内。【解析】C正确：offering pilot required, useful or desirable information对应三类信息，considerably consistent对应"较统一"，conform to the Specification to the extent practical对应"在可行范围内遵循规范"。A两处错误：optional（可选的）错译required（必需的），to the minimal extent（最小程度）与to the extent practical含义相反。B把particular airplane误为all type of airplane（所有机型，范围错误），skillful information语义不通。

question: The cover title and applicable designation shall be prominently displayed on the cover or spine (or both) of the Handbook.

options.A: The cover title and relevant description must be saliently shown on the cover or spine (or both) of the Handbook.
options.B: The cover title and descriptive design shall be anoynomously presented on the cover or spine (or both) of the Handbook.
options.C: The cover title and iconic description shall be anomalously shown on the cover or spine (or both) of the Handbook.

explanation: 【译文】封面标题和适用标志应醒目地显示在手册的封面或书脊（或两者）上。【词汇】cover title=封面标题，applicable designation=适用标志/名称，prominently displayed=醒目地显示，spine=书脊，or both=或两者。【解析】A正确：saliently shown对应prominently displayed（醒目显示），cover or spine (or both)对应"封面或书脊（或两者）"，全句对应最贴近。B两处错误：descriptive design错译applicable designation，anoynomously（匿名地，词义无关）错译prominently。C iconic description（图标式描述）错译designation，anomalously（反常地）错译prominently，副词错译。

question: The Abnormal Procedures Check List should be designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.

options.A: The Abnormal Procedures Check List aims to inform the flight crew to check the items while offering no details about the operation of any system.
options.B: The Abnormal Procedures Check List should be designed to tell the flight crew to check items while providing details concerning the operation of any system.
options.C: The Abnormal Procedures Check List tend to remind the pilots that they need to be concerned about the detailed information when checking the items.

explanation: 【译文】非正常程序检查单应设计为提醒飞行员要检查的项目，而不提供任何系统操作的细节。【词汇】Abnormal Procedures Check List=非正常程序检查单，remind pilots of items to check=提醒飞行员要检查的项目，without providing details=不提供细节，operation of any system=任何系统的操作。【解析】A正确：aims to inform…to check the items对应"提醒要检查的项目"，offering no details about the operation对应"不提供系统操作细节"，否定关系正确。B把without providing details误为providing details（提供细节），关键否定丢失，方向相反。C把"提醒检查项目"误为concerned about the detailed information（关注详细信息），焦点偏移且漏译without providing的排除结构。

question: Intentional One Engine Inoperative Speed is the minimum speed, selected by the manufacturer, for intentionally rendering one engine inoperative, inflight, for pilot training.

options.A: Intentional One Engine Inoperative Speed is a prescribed minimum speed established by the manufacturer, which is deliberately utilized to initiate the inflight rendering of one engine inoperative for the purposes of pilot training.
options.B: Intentional One Engine Inoperative Speed refers to the lowest speed at which it is deliberately intended to disable an airplane's engines during flight training.
options.C: Intentional One Engine Inoperative Speed is the designated maximum flight speed by pilots for training when one engine is deliberately shut down.

explanation: 【译文】有意单发不工作速度是制造商选定的、在飞行中为飞行员培训而有意使一台发动机不工作的最低速度。【词汇】Intentional One Engine Inoperative Speed=有意单发不工作速度，minimum speed=最低速度，selected by the manufacturer=由制造商选定，rendering one engine inoperative=使一台发动机不工作，pilot training=飞行员培训。【解析】A正确：prescribed minimum speed established by the manufacturer对应"制造商选定的最低速度"，deliberately utilized to…render one engine inoperative对应"有意使一台发动机不工作"，inflight、pilot training要素齐全。B两处错误：an airplane's engines泛指多台发动机而非one engine（单发），且漏译manufacturer这一选定主体。C把minimum（最低）误为maximum（最高），把manufacturer误为pilots，两处张冠李戴。

question: On reciprocating (piston) engine powered airplanes, the mixture control provides a mechanical linkage with the mixture control valve of the carburetor, or the fuel control unit of fuel injection engines, to control the size of the fuel feed aperture, and thus, the air/fuel mixture.

options.A: In engine-powered aircraft, the mixture control mechanism operates via a mechanical linkage with the piston's mixture control valve. This mechanism regulates the aperture size of the fuel feed and consequently adjusts the ratio of air to fuel in the mixture.
options.B: On airplanes powered by piston engines, the mixture control offers a mechanical connection with the carburetor's mixture control valve or the fuel control unit of fuel injection engines to regulate the size of the fuel feed aperture and subsequently the air/fuel mixture.
options.C: The mixture control function in airplanes is to establish a connection between the mixture control valve of the carburetor and the fuel control unit of fuel injection engines. Its primary purpose is to regulate the fuel feed aperture size.

explanation: 【译文】在活塞发动机驱动的飞机上，混合比控制通过机械连杆与化油器混合比活门或喷油发动机的燃油控制组件连接，控制燃油供给孔径的大小，进而控制空/燃混合比。【词汇】reciprocating (piston) engine=往复活塞发动机，mixture control=混合比控制，mechanical linkage=机械连杆，carburetor=化油器，fuel injection=燃油喷射，fuel feed aperture=燃油供给孔径，air/fuel mixture=空/燃混合比。【解析】B正确：On airplanes powered by piston engines对应"活塞发动机飞机"，carburetor's mixture control valve or the fuel control unit对应两种连接对象，air/fuel mixture对应"空燃比"。A两处错误：engine-powered未指明活塞式，the piston's mixture control valve把连接对象从化油器误为活塞本身，张冠李戴。C漏译"活塞发动机"前提和"机械连接"，且只提孔径调节而漏掉空燃比结果，漏译要素。

question: The Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity is the velocity of the crosswind component for which adequate control of the airplane during takeoff and landing was actually demonstrated during certification tests.

options.A: The speed of the crosswind component at which acceptable airplane control during takeoff and touchdown was really shown during simulator testing is known as the Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity.
options.B: The speed of the crosswind component at which sufficient airplane control during takeoff and landing was really shown during certification testing is known as the Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity.
options.C: The speed of the crosswind component at which limited airplane control during takeoff and touchdown was really shown during certification testing is known as the Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity.

explanation: 【译文】验证侧风速度是在审定试验中实际证明了飞机在起飞和着陆期间能够充分操纵的侧风分量速度。【词汇】Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity=验证侧风速度，crosswind component=侧风分量，adequate control=充分操纵，takeoff and landing=起飞和着陆，certification tests=审定试验。【解析】B正确：sufficient airplane control对应"充分操纵"，certification testing对应"审定试验"，takeoff and landing对应"起飞和着陆"，定义要素全部对应。A两处错误：simulator testing（模拟器测试）错译certification tests（审定试验），touchdown（接地）窄化landing（着陆），范围错误。C把adequate（充分的）误为limited（有限的），程度相反，touchdown同样错译landing。

question: The Accerlerate-Go Distance is the distance required to accelerate an airplane to a specified speed and, assuming failure of an engine at the instant that speed is attained, continue take-off on the remaining engine (s) to a height of 50 feet.

options.A: The distance needed for an aircraft to reach a certain speed and, in the event that one engine fails shortly after that speed is reached, continue landing on the remaining engine (s) to a height of 50 feet is known as the Accelerate-Go Distance.
options.B: The distance needed for an aircraft to reach a required speed and, in the event that one engine fails almost the same time that speed is reached, continue cruising on the remaining engine (s) to a height of 50 feet is known as the Accelerate-Go Distance.
options.C: The distance needed to accelerate an aircraft to a certain speed and, in the event that one engine fails at the same moment that speed is reached, continue takeoff on the remaining engine (s) to a height of 50 feet is known as the Accelerate-Go Distance.

explanation: 【译文】加速继续起飞距离是将飞机加速到指定速度、并假定在达到该速度瞬间一台发动机失效时，用剩余发动机继续起飞到50英尺高度所需的距离。【词汇】Accelerate-Go Distance=加速继续起飞距离，accelerate to a specified speed=加速到指定速度，failure of an engine=一台发动机失效，continue take-off on the remaining engines=用剩余发动机继续起飞，height of 50 feet=50英尺高度。【解析】C正确：accelerate an aircraft to a certain speed对应"加速到指定速度"，at the same moment对应"瞬间"，continue takeoff对应"继续起飞"，定义链完整。A把takeoff误为landing（着陆），飞行阶段完全相反。B把continue takeoff误为continue cruising（继续巡航），飞行阶段张冠李戴。

question: This is the minimum flight speed at which the airplane is directionally and laterally controllable, determined in accordance with the Federal Aviation Regulations.

options.A: This is the smallest flight speed, and the plane can be operated at the speed directionally and laterally. The speed is suggested by the Federal Aviation Regulations.
options.B: The smallest flight speed, at which the airplane can be controlled directionally and laterally, is decided by and based on the Federal Aviation Regulations.
options.C: The smallest flight speed, at which the airplane can be controlled directionally and vertically, is made by the Federal Aviation Regulations.

explanation: 【译文】这是飞机在方向和横向上可操纵的最小飞行速度，按联邦航空法规确定。【词汇】minimum flight speed=最小飞行速度，directionally and laterally controllable=方向和横向可操纵，determined in accordance with=按…确定，Federal Aviation Regulations=联邦航空法规。【解析】B正确：controlled directionally and laterally对应"方向和横向可操纵"，decided by and based on the FARs对应"按联邦航空法规确定"。A一处错误：suggested by（被建议）错译determined in accordance with（按…确定），且句式松散。C把laterally（横向）误为vertically（垂直向），方向轴张冠李戴，is made by也错译确定依据。

question: The specific content of this Section shall conform to the applicable Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) governing the certification and operation of the particular airplane.

options.A: The particular content of this section should follow the applicable Federal Aviation Regulations, which manage the certification and operation of the particular airplane.
options.B: The particular content of this section should be based on the property of Federal Aviation Regulations, which manage the certification and operation of the particular airplane.
options.C: The particular content of this section should follow the proper the Federal Aviation Regulations, which set the certification and maintenance of the particular airplane.

explanation: 【译文】本节的具体内容应符合适用于该特定飞机审定和运行的联邦航空法规（FARs）。【词汇】specific content=具体内容，conform to=符合，applicable FARs=适用的联邦航空法规，governing=规范/管理，certification and operation=审定和运行。【解析】A正确：follow the applicable FARs对应"符合适用法规"，manage the certification and operation对应"管理审定和运行"（manage此处作govern解），要素齐全。B把conform to误为be based on the property（基于…属性），property of FARs语义不通，词义错译。C两处错误：proper错译applicable（适用的），把operation（运行）误为maintenance（维护），要素错译。

question: Data shall be presented stating the Normal and Maximum Cabin Operating Differential Pressure. Restrictions on use of cabin pressurization during takeoff, landing, or in flight shall be noted.

options.A: Data indicating normal and maximum cabin operating differential pressure should be provided. During take-off, landing or flight, attention should be paid to the restrictions on the use of cabin pressurization.
options.B: Data indicating abnormal and maximum cabin pressure shall be provided. During takeoff, landing or flight, the restrictions on the use of cabin pressurization should be noted.
options.C: As provided data of normal and maximum cabin pressure, the restrictions on the use of cabin pressurization should be noticed during takeoff, landing and cruising.

explanation: 【译文】应提供说明正常和最大客舱工作压差的数据。起飞、着陆或飞行中使用客舱增压的限制应予以注明。【词汇】Normal and Maximum Cabin Operating Differential Pressure=正常和最大客舱工作压差，restrictions=限制，cabin pressurization=客舱增压，during takeoff, landing, or in flight=起飞、着陆或飞行中，be noted=予以注明。【解析】A正确：normal and maximum cabin operating differential pressure对应"正常和最大客舱工作压差"，attention should be paid to the restrictions对应"应注意限制"，起飞、着陆、飞行中三场景齐全。B把normal误为abnormal（异常的），词义相反。C两处错误：cabin pressure漏译differential（压差≠舱压），cruising（巡航）窄化in flight（飞行中），范围错误。

question: Provide, at an appropriate place in this Section, a statement of the kinds of operations allowed when listed operable equipment is installed. If any installed equipment affects an operating limitation, the equipment shall be listed and identified as to operational function.

options.A: In this section, provide a description about the types of operations allowed when installing the listed devices. If any equipment affects operating performance, the operating functions of the equipment should be listed and ensured.
options.B: Provide a description in this section about the operations allowed when installing the unlisted devices. If equipment affects operations, the  functions of the equipment should be listed and identified.
options.C: Provide, where appropriate in this section, a description of the types of operations allowed when installing the listed operable equipment. If any installed equipment affects operational restrictions, the operational functions of the equipment should be listed and identified.

explanation: 【译文】应在本节适当位置提供一份说明，阐明安装了列明的可用设备时所允许的运行种类。如果任何安装的设备影响某项运行限制，应列出该设备并标明其运行功能。【词汇】listed operable equipment=列明的可用设备，kinds of operations allowed=允许的运行种类，operating limitation=运行限制，identified as to operational function=标明其运行功能。【解析】C正确：where appropriate对应"适当位置"，listed operable equipment对应"列明的可用设备"，affects operational restrictions对应"影响运行限制"，listed and identified对应"列出并标明"。A两处错误：listed devices漏operable（可用），affects operating performance（性能）错译operating limitation（限制），概念错译。B把listed误为unlisted（未列明的），词义相反，且漏operable和installed。

question: The emergency procedures check list should be in concise, abbreviated form designed to remind pilots of items to check without providing details concerning the operation of any system.

options.A: The emergency procedures checklist should be brief and to the point, designed to remind the pilot of items to check, without providing detailed information on any system operation.
options.B: The emergency procedure checklist should be concise and intended to remind the pilot of the check item and provide detailed information about the operation of any system.
options.C: The emergency procedure checklist should be concise and designed to alert pilots to inspect checked items without providing details on operation.

explanation: 【译文】应急程序检查单应采用简明、缩略的形式，设计为提醒飞行员要检查的项目，而不提供任何系统操作的细节。【词汇】emergency procedures check list=应急程序检查单，concise, abbreviated form=简明缩略形式，remind pilots of items to check=提醒飞行员要检查的项目，without providing details=不提供细节。【解析】A正确：brief and to the point对应"简明扼要"，remind the pilot of items to check对应"提醒检查项目"，without providing detailed information对应"不提供细节"，要素齐全。B把without providing details误为provide detailed information（提供详细信息），否定丢失，方向相反。C alert pilots to inspect checked items（提醒检查已检项目）语义混乱，inspect与remind不对应，on operation也漏any system限定。

question: The amplified procedures may also include additional procedures that a pilot would not reasonably be expected to refer to in resolving a given emergency.

options.A: The shortened procedure may also exclude other procedures that the pilot could not reasonably have referred to in addressing a particular operation.
options.B: Expanded procedure may also include a procedure that the pilot may not reasonably be expected to recall in addressing specific emergency situations.
options.C: The expanded procedures may also include other procedures that the pilot may not reasonably refer to when addressing a particular emergency.

explanation: 【译文】扩展程序还可以包括飞行员在处置某一特定紧急情况时不会被合理期望去查阅的其他程序。【词汇】amplified procedures=扩展/详细说明的程序，additional procedures=附加程序，would not reasonably be expected to refer to=不会被合理期望去参考，resolving a given emergency=处置特定紧急情况。【解析】C正确：expanded procedures对应"扩展程序"，may not reasonably refer to对应"不会被合理期望参考"，a particular emergency对应"特定紧急情况"，要素与语义完整。A两处错误：shortened（缩短的）错译amplified（扩展的），方向相反；exclude（排除）错译include（包括），且a particular operation错译emergency。B把refer to（查阅）误为recall（回忆），且a procedure数量也不如other procedures对应原文additional procedures。

question: The Check List may be followed by amplified procedures to provide pilots with a better understanding of the reasons for actions in the check list.

options.A: There may be more detailed procedures after the Checklist to help the pilots better understand the reasons for actions in the check list.
options.B: The Check List should provide pilots with a better understanding of the warnings followed by the reasons for actions in the check list.
options.C: The Check List may be amplified so that the pilots can better understand the consequences of actions in the check list.

explanation: 【译文】检查单之后可以接有详细说明程序，以帮助飞行员更好理解检查单中各项动作的原因。【词汇】be followed by=紧随其后，amplified procedures=详述程序，reasons for actions=动作的原因。【解析】A正确：more detailed procedures after the Checklist对应“检查单后接详述程序”，reasons for actions对应“动作原因”，信息完整。B两处错误：把reasons误作warnings（张冠李戴），followed by关系表达混乱。C两处错误：reasons误为consequences（后果≠原因，词义错译），把“程序在检查单之后”误成“检查单被扩展”（张冠李戴）。

question: That portion of the systems which controls the position and movement of the spoilers, drag devices and variable aerodynamic fairings. Includes items such as control handles, cables, warning systems, linkages, spoilers, drag devices, position indicators, etc.

options.A: Adjust the components of spoiler, resistance device and variable pneumatic fairing. It includes control handle, cable, warning system, linkage device, spoiler, towing device, position indicator and other components.
options.B: This system is responsible for regulating the movement and position of the spoilers, drag devices and variable aerodynamic fairings. Components involved include control handles, cables, warning systems, linkages, spoilers, drag devices, position indicators, etc.
options.C: They control the changes of spoilers, resistance devices and variable pneumatic fairing. It includes control handle, cable, warning system, linkage device, spoiler, towing device, position indicator and other components.

explanation: 【译文】系统中控制扰流板、阻力装置和可变气动整流罩位置与运动的部分，包括操纵手柄、钢索、警告系统、连杆、位置指示器等。【词汇】spoilers=扰流板，drag devices=阻力装置，aerodynamic fairings=气动整流罩，linkages=连杆。【解析】B正确：regulating the movement and position对应“控制位置和运动”，部件清单逐项对应。A多处错误：定义句改为祈使句Adjust，aerodynamic误为pneumatic（词义错译），drag误为towing（张冠李戴）。C同样把controls误为changes、aerodynamic误为pneumatic、drag误为towing，并漏译“位置”。

question: The units or components which give visual or aural warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Units which record, store, or compute data from unrelated systems.

options.A: The units or components which are used to give conditions warning visually and aurally in separate systems. Also, there are other units which are used to record, reserve, or compute data from separate systems.
options.B: The units or components which give visual or unusual warning on irrelevant system conditions. They are also used to record, store, or computerize various sources of information from diverse systems.
options.C: The units or components which help people get warning information through sighting and touching about different systems conditions. Other units which help people input, reserve, or calculate data in different systems.

explanation: 【译文】用于对其他不相关系统的状况发出目视或音响警告的组件或部件；以及用于记录、存储或计算来自不相关系统数据的组件。【词汇】visual or aural warning=目视或音响警告，unrelated systems=不相关系统，record/store/compute=记录、存储或计算。【解析】A正确：visually and aurally对应visual or aural，虽有reserve代替store的瑕疵但语义最全。B两处错误：aural误为unusual（词义错译），compute误为computerize。C两处错误：aural误为touching（听觉→触觉，方向相反），record误为input（词义错译）。

question: The units used for computing data from a number of different sources without a preponderance of functions in any one system.

options.A: The units which function as data computing portions. The data sources are different and not limited within system functions.
options.B: The units which are used to compute data which come from several diverse sources. And the data should not be collected mainly from any one system.
options.C: The units which are used to collect data from a few different sources and compute the data to respond to different functions in any one system.

explanation: 【译文】用于计算来自多个不同来源数据的组件，其功能不主要集中于任何一个系统。【词汇】computing data=计算数据，different sources=不同来源，preponderance=占主导。【解析】B正确：several diverse sources对应不同来源，not mainly from any one system最接近without a preponderance。A错误：只说来源不同，漏译“功能不集中于单一系统”的限定（漏译要素）。C两处错误：a number of缩窄为a few（范围错误），compute误成collect and compute to respond to functions（结构错译）。

question: The portion of the system which is classified as auxiliary, emergency or standby, and which is used to supplement or take the place of the main hydraulic system.

options.A: The portion of the system which can be divided into three parts: auxiliary, emergency or standby, and which is equally important to the main hydraulic system.
options.B: The portion of the system which is used as an auxiliary section in emergency or standby situations, and which cannot be used as a supplement and replacement of the main hydraulic system.
options.C: The portion of the system which can be called in different names: auxiliary, emergency or standby. And if the main hydraulic system malfunctions or fails, this portion of the system can be used.

explanation: 【译文】系统中被归类为辅助、应急或备用的部分，用于补充或替代主液压系统。【词汇】auxiliary/emergency/standby=辅助/应急/备用，supplement=补充，take the place of=替代，main hydraulic system=主液压系统。【解析】C正确：called in different names对应三种分类，if the main hydraulic system malfunctions...can be used隐含补充替代之意。A错误：把classified as理解成“分成三部分”，equally important无中生有。B错误：cannot否定supplement and replacement（方向相反）。

question: Those units and components which furnish a means of supporting and steering the aircraft on the ground or water, and make it possible to retract and store the landing gear in flight. Includes brakes, wheels, floats, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems.

options.A: Those units and components which provide a way to stabilize and fix the aircraft on the ground or water, and it is feasible to retract and store the landing gear in flight. Includes brakes, wheels, floats, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems.
options.B: Those units and components which can be used to support and control the aircraft on the ground or water, and it is likely to reclaim and reserve the landing gear in flight. Includes brakes, wheels, floats, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems.
options.C: Those units and components which furnish a means of fixing and steering the aircraft on the ground or water, and make it possible to retract and put the landing gear down in flight. Includes brakes, wheels, floats, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems.

explanation: 【译文】用于在地面或水面支撑和操纵飞机、并能在飞行中收存起落架的组件和部件，包括刹车、机轮、浮筒、舱门、减震支柱、轮胎、连杆、位置指示和警告系统。【词汇】supporting and steering=支撑和操纵，retract and store=收起并存放，landing gear=起落架，shock struts=减震支柱。【解析】A正确：stabilize and fix虽不及support and steer贴切，但retract and store准确、清单完整。B错误：retract/store误为reclaim and reserve（词义错译）。C两处错误：support误为fixing，put the landing gear down与store方向相反。

question: Devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid blocks, wheels, etc.

options.A: Instruments used to make the aircraft stable while on the ground and prevent wreck by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid blocks, wheels, etc.
options.B: Equipment used to fix the aircraft while on the ground and allow damage by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid blocks, wheels, etc.
options.C: Facilities used to hold the aircraft steady while on the ground and provide protection by ground contact. Includes items such as shock amplifier, skid blocks, wheels, etc.

explanation: 【译文】用于在地面使飞机保持稳定并防止因地面接触造成损坏的装置，包括减震支柱、滑橇块、机轮等。【词汇】devices=装置，stabilize=使稳定，prevent damage=防止损坏，ground contact=地面接触，skid blocks=滑橇块。【解析】A正确：make the aircraft stable对应stabilize，prevent wreck近似prevent damage，清单一致。B两处错误：stabilize误为fix，prevent误为allow（方向相反）。C两处错误：provide protection by ground contact曲解“防止地面接触损坏”（漏译要素），shock strut误为shock amplifier（张冠李戴）。

question: The lighting subsystems in the compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Does not include cargo compartment. Includes direct and indirect illumination of work areas, panels and instruments.

options.A: The lighting subsystems within the compartment on top of the ground and between the forward rider partition and therefore the forward dome. Does not embrace parcel compartment. Includes direct and indirect illumination of labor areas, panels and instruments.
options.B: The lighting subsystems in the compartment over the floor and between the forward traveler parcel and the forward pressure arch. Exclude freight compartment. Incorporates immediate and backhanded enlightenment of workspace, boards and instruments.
options.C: The lighting subsystems within the compartment on top of the ground and between the forward rider partition and therefore the forward dome. Does not include bulbs and wiring inside of instruments which are removed with the instrument.

explanation: 【译文】位于地板以上、前客舱隔板与前承压穹顶之间舱室的照明子系统，不包括货舱，含工作区、面板和仪表的直接与间接照明。【词汇】passenger partition=客舱隔板，pressure dome=承压穹顶，cargo compartment=货舱，direct and indirect illumination=直接与间接照明。【解析】A正确：保留“不包括货舱”和“直接/间接照明”两大结构，虽有ground、rider、parcel等错词，骨架最全。B错误：partition误为parcel、dome误为arch、illumination误为enlightenment（三处词义错译）。C错误：第二句漏掉“不包括货舱”与“直接间接照明”核心（漏译要素）。

question: Overhaul of any or all components in Chapter 34 must be accomplished in a qualified shop in accordance with data supplied by the component manufacturer.

options.A: In order to perform maintenance of any or all components in Chapter 34, the component manufacturer must supply a qualified shop in accordance with data.
options.B: If something goes wrong with any or all components in Chapter 34, the component manufacturer must provide data of a thorough overhaul in its qualified shop.
options.C: If any or all components in Chapter 34 need a complete overhaul, we must refer to information provided by the component manufacturer to find a qualified shop to do it.

explanation: 【译文】第34章中任何或所有部件的大修，都必须按部件制造商提供的资料在合格车间完成。【词汇】overhaul=大修，qualified shop=合格车间，in accordance with=按照。【解析】C正确：complete overhaul对应overhaul，refer to information provided by the component manufacturer对应in accordance with data。A两处错误：overhaul缩窄为maintenance（范围错误），“在合格车间”误成“制造商提供车间”（张冠李戴）。B两处错误：If something goes wrong缩小条件，漏译“按制造商资料”。

question: Those units and components (ducts and valves) deliver large volumes of compressed air from a power source to connecting points for such other systems as environmental controls, deicing, etc.

options.A: Those units and components, including ducts and valves, transfer large volumes of compressed air from a power source to points of junctions for other systems , such as environmental controls, deicing, etc.
options.B: Those units and components (referring to ducts and valves) use a power source to compress large volumes of air, and then send air to other systems as environmental controls, deicing, etc.so they can build connections.
options.C: A great deal of compressed air is moved by those units and components (ducts and valves) , from a power source to connecting surfaces and other systems including environmental controls, deicing, etc.

explanation: 【译文】这些组件和部件（导管和活门）把来自动力源的大量压缩空气输送到环境控制、防冰等其他系统的连接点。【词汇】ducts and valves=导管和活门，deliver compressed air=输送压缩空气，connecting points=连接点。【解析】A正确：transfer large volumes of compressed air对应deliver，points of junctions对应connecting points。B错误：把“输送压缩空气”误成“用动力源压缩空气”（曲解功能）。C两处错误：connecting points误为connecting surfaces（词义错译），被动结构模糊输送关系。

question: Indicating system refers to that portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system. Includes temperature and pressure warning systems.

options.A: Indicating system can shadow temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system, with the assistance of temperature and pressure warning systems.
options.B: People use indicating system to forecast temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system, which includes temperature and pressure warning systems.
options.C: Indicating system can give us information about temperature and pressure of the pneumatic system and it covers temperature and pressure warning systems.

explanation: 【译文】指示系统是系统中用于指示气源系统温度和压力的部分，包括温度和压力警告系统。【词汇】indicating system=指示系统，indicate=指示，pneumatic system=气源/气压系统，warning systems=警告系统。【解析】C正确：give us information about temperature and pressure对应indicate，covers对应includes，两要素齐全。A两处错误：把indicate误为shadow（指示≠遮蔽，词义错译），把includes误为with the assistance of（包含→借助，结构错译）。B两处错误：把indicate误为forecast（指示≠预测，词义错译），主语错成people。

question: The Waste disposal system is that portion of the system which is used for disposal of water and waste. It includes items such as wash basins, water closets, flushing systems, etc.

options.A: The waste disposal component of the system is where waste and water are stored and used. It excludes things like wash basins, restrooms, flushing mechanisms, etc.
options.B: The waste disposal component of the system is the portion other than wash basins, restrooms, flushing mechanisms, etc., which are used for storage of water and waste.
options.C: The waste disposal component of the system is where waste and water are disposed of. It includes things like wash basins, restrooms, flushing mechanisms, etc.

explanation: 【译文】废物处理系统是系统中用于处理水和废物的部分，包括洗手盆、厕所、冲洗装置等。【词汇】waste disposal system=废物处理系统，disposal of=处理，wash basins=洗手盆，water closets=厕所，flushing systems=冲洗装置。【解析】C正确：disposed of对应disposal，includes对应includes，例举一致。A两处错误：把disposal误为stored and used（处理→储存使用，词义错译），把includes反成excludes（方向相反）。B两处错误：把包括项说成“除……之外的部分”（方向相反），把disposal误为storage（词义错译）。

question: Integrated Circuits contains general coverage of those devices having integrated components, in monolithic structure, which perform complete circuit functions. It includes integrated Logic devices.

options.A: Integrated Circuits contains general coverage of those devices having separated components, in compartmentalized structure, which perform complete circuit functions. It includes independent Logic devices.
options.B: Integrated Circuits covers any devices with disintegrated components in a compartmentalized structure that execute partial circuit functions. It doesn’t have Logic devices built in.
options.C: Integrated Circuits covers any devices with integrated components in a monolithic structure that execute complete circuit functions. It has Logic devices built in.

explanation: 【译文】集成电路概括指在单片结构中具有集成部件、能执行完整电路功能的器件，包括集成逻辑器件。【词汇】integrated components=集成部件，monolithic structure=单片结构，complete circuit functions=完整电路功能。【解析】C正确：integrated、monolithic、complete、has Logic devices built in四要素全对。A错误：三处分别误为separated、compartmentalized、independent（方向相反）。B错误：误为disintegrated、partial、doesn't have（方向相反）。

question: Airborne Auxiliary Power includes power and drive section, fuel, ignition and control systems, also wiring, indicators, plumbing, valves, and ducts up to the power unit. It does not include generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc., or their connecting systems which supply and deliver power to their respective aircraft systems.

options.A: Airborne Auxiliary Power includes power and drive section, fuel, ignition and control systems, also wiring, indicators, plumbing, valves, and ducts up to the power unit. It also includes generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc., or their connecting systems which supply and deliver power to their respective aircraft systems.
options.B: In addition to the power and drive section, fuel, ignition, and control systems, Airborne Auxiliary Power also includes wiring, indicators, plumbing, valves, and ducts that lead up to the power unit. It excludes power supply and delivery systems for the corresponding aircraft systems, such as generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc.
options.C: In addition to the power and drive section, fuel, ignition, and control systems, Airborne Auxiliary Power also includes wiring, indicators, plumbing, valves, and ducts that lead up to the power unit. It also includes power supply and delivery systems for the corresponding aircraft systems instead of generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps, etc.

explanation: 【译文】机载辅助动力包括动力驱动段、燃油、点火和控制系统及直到动力装置的导线、指示器、管路、活门和导管，不包括发电机、交流发电机、液压泵等或其连接系统。【词汇】Airborne Auxiliary Power=机载辅助动力，plumbing=管路，does not include=不包括，alternators=交流发电机。【解析】B正确：excludes...generators, alternators, hydraulic pumps准确对应排除范围。A错误：does not include误成also includes（方向相反）。C两处错误：排除误成包含（方向相反），instead of用法歪曲原意。

question: Those subjects that are general in nature to the entire structure of the aircraft and are not specifically covered under the following structure chapters, including standard practices applicable to structures.

options.A: Those topics that focus on the entire structure of the aircraft and are not specifically covered in the previous chapters, including standard practices used in structures.
options.B: Those topics in general regarding the overall structural properties of the aircraft and are not specifically covered in the following structural sections, including standard practices applicable to structures.
options.C: Those subjects not only focusing on the entire structure of the aircraft but also are covered by the following structure chapters includes traditional practices used in structures.

explanation: 【译文】那些性质上属于飞机整体结构的一般性主题，未被下列结构章节专门涵盖，包括适用于结构的标准作法。【词汇】general in nature=一般性质，entire structure=整体结构，standard practices=标准作法。【解析】B正确：in general regarding the overall structural对应general in nature，following structural sections对应following chapters。A错误：following误为previous（方向相反）。C两处错误：“未被涵盖”误成“也被以下章节涵盖”（方向相反），standard误为traditional（词义错译）。

question: Those removable units used for entrance or exit, and for enclosing other structure contained within the fuselage. Includes passenger and crew doors, cargo doors, emergence exits, etc. Electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control are included as appropriate.

options.A: These changeable units are used to connect the inlet and outlet, and are also used to connect other structures contained within the fuselage. Include passenger and crew doors, cargo doors, emergency exits, etc. Whether should contain electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control based on the current situation.
options.B: These units were used to combine imports and exits, and also to seal other parts contained in the body. Including passenger and crew doors, cargo hold, emergency exits, etc. Whether should contain electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control based on the current situation.
options.C: These units, which can be taken off, were used for entrance and exits, and also to enclose other structures contained in the fuselage. Including passenger and crew doors, cargo doors, emergency exits, etc. Whether electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control should be included is based on the situation.

explanation: 【译文】那些可拆下的、供进出并封闭机身内其他结构的部件，包括旅客机组舱门、货舱门、应急出口等，相关电气液压系统视情况包括。【词汇】removable units=可拆部件，entrance or exit=进出，enclosing=封闭。【解析】C正确：taken off对应removable，enclose对应封闭，based on the situation对应as appropriate。A两处错误：entrance/exit误为connect the inlet and outlet（词义错译），enclose误为connect。B错误：entrance/exit误为imports and exits、enclose误为seal。

question: The fittings on the fuselage are used for the attachment doors, wings, stabilizers, landing gear, engine and rotor pylons.

options.A: The fastenings positioned on the fuselage are employed to connect the landing gear and other parts.
options.B: The mechanisms on the body of the plane are utilized to connect doors, wings, and other components.
options.C: The fittings on the fuselage are used to connect doors, wings, stabilizers, landing gear, engine, and rotor pylons.

explanation: 【译文】机身上的接头用于连接舱门、机翼、安定面、起落架、发动机和旋翼吊架。【词汇】fittings=接头/连接件，attachment=连接，stabilizers=安定面，landing gear=起落架，rotor pylons=旋翼吊架。【解析】C正确：连接对象doors、wings、stabilizers、landing gear、engine、rotor pylons一项不漏。A错误：只提landing gear，其余对象用other parts笼统带过（漏译要素）。B两处错误：把fuselage弱化为body of the plane（范围模糊），且漏译安定面、起落架、发动机、旋翼吊架等具体对象（漏译要素）。

question: Analyzers refer to the portion of the system that is used to analyze engine performance or condition by means of instruments or devices such as oscilloscopes, and are inclusive of several components such as the generator, amplifier and oscilloscopes.

options.A: The analyzer is comprised of components such as the generator, amplifier and oscilloscope, and is employed in the analysis of engine condition or performance, which is primarily achieved through the use of specific equipment such as oscilloscopes.
options.B: Generators, amplifiers, and oscilloscopes are the essential components of analyzers, but only oscilloscopes function to analyze the performance of the engine's condition.
options.C: The analyzer plays a crucial role in analyzing engine performance or status, with its components including generators, amplifiers, and oscilloscopes.

explanation: 【译文】分析器是系统中借助示波器等仪器分析发动机性能或状态的部分，包括发生器、放大器和示波器等。【词汇】analyzer=分析器，performance or condition=性能或状态，by means of=借助，oscilloscopes=示波器。【解析】C正确：analyzing engine performance or status对应功能，generators、amplifiers、oscilloscopes对应部件清单。A错误：“借助示波器等仪器”缩窄成primarily through oscilloscopes（范围错误）。B两处错误：部件说成essential components（程度错误），妄称only oscilloscopes执行分析（无中生有）。

question: For turbine engines, the external units and components and integral basic engine parts which go together to conduct air to various portions of the engine and to the extension shaft and torquemeter.

options.A: The external units, components, and integral essential engine parts are interconnected for piston engines to transmit air to various engine parts, including the extension shaft and the torquemeter.
options.B: In turbojet engines, the external components and essential engine components are interconnected, facilitating the delivery of air to different engine parts and to the extension shaft and torquemeter.
options.C: Air is delivered to various sections of the turbine engine through its external components, as well as the integral components of the engine itself.

explanation: 【译文】对于涡轮发动机，指外部组件和发动机整体基本部件中共同把空气导向发动机各部分及延伸轴和扭矩表的部分。【词汇】turbine engines=涡轮发动机，integral basic engine parts=整体基本部件，conduct air=导气，torquemeter=扭矩表。【解析】C正确：保留turbine engine范围和导气核心语义，仅省略末端对象。A错误：turbine误为piston（张冠李戴）。B错误：turbine缩窄为turbojet（范围错误；torquemeter主要见于涡桨，更不能用turbojet替换）。

question: The anti-icing system of the engine eliminates and prevents ice formation by bleed air in all parts of the engine (excluding power cowling), and is inclusive of several components such as valves, plumbing, regulators, etc.

options.A: Valves, plumbing, and regulators are essential components of the engine's anti-icing system, which reduce and prevent specific engine components from icing, excluding power cowling.
options.B: The function of the engine anti-icing system is to eliminate and prevent ice accumulation occurring in the valves, tubes, regulators, and other associated engine components.
options.C: The engine anti-icing system is comprised of valves, plumbing, regulators, and various other components that can eliminates and prevent ice formation by bleeding air in all engine sections, with the exception of the power cowling.

explanation: 【译文】发动机防冰系统通过引气消除并防止发动机除动力整流罩外各部位结冰，包括活门、管路、调节器等。【词汇】anti-icing system=防冰系统，eliminates and prevents ice formation=消除并防止结冰，bleed air=引气，power cowling=动力整流罩。【解析】C正确：by bleeding air、exception of the power cowling等要素齐全。A两处错误：eliminate弱化为reduce（程度错误），all parts缩窄为specific components（范围错误）。B错误：把“防止各部位结冰”误成“防止活门管路等结冰”（张冠李戴）。

question: Miscellaneous charts are not applicable to any particular system, such as wire diagrams, junction box charts, disconnect plug charts, conduit and wire routing charts, and lists of special tools.

options.A: Miscellaneous charts cannot be applied to system like wire diagrams, junction box charts, disconnect plug charts, conduit and wire routing charts, and lists of special tools.
options.B: Miscellaneous charts are appropriate for many systems, such as wire diagrams, junction box charts, disconnect plug charts, conduit and wire routing charts, and list of special tools.
options.C: Many systems, such as wire diagrams, junction box charts, disconnect plug charts, conduit and wire routing charts, and list of special tools can suit miscellaneous charts well.

explanation: 【译文】杂项图表是不适用于任何特定系统的图表，如线路图、接线盒图、脱开插头图、导管导线布线图和专用工具清单。【词汇】miscellaneous charts=杂项图表，applicable to=适用于，particular system=特定系统，wire diagrams=线路图，junction box charts=接线盒图。【解析】A正确：cannot be applied to传达“不适用于特定系统”的核心含义，例举完整。B错误：把not applicable反译为appropriate for many systems（方向相反）。C错误：把不适用误成“很多系统适合杂项图表”（方向相反），且主客颠倒。

question: Accessory gearboxes do not include those accessory drives which are bolted to and are immediately adjacent to the engine.

options.A: Accessory gearboxes exclude those accessory drives being fixed to and closely near the engine.
options.B: Accessory drives are not connected to the engine and are far away from it, thus accessorye gearboxes does not include it in.
options.C: Accessory gearboxes connect accessory drives to the engine, which are adjacent to each other.

explanation: 【译文】附件齿轮箱不包括那些用螺栓固定且紧邻发动机的附件传动装置。【词汇】accessory gearboxes=附件齿轮箱，accessory drives=附件传动装置，bolted to=用螺栓固定于，immediately adjacent to=紧邻。【解析】A正确：exclude对应do not include，fixed to and closely near对应bolted to and immediately adjacent。B错误：把bolted to and adjacent误成not connected and far away（方向相反）。C错误：把“不包括”误成“把传动装置连接到发动机”（曲解排除关系，张冠李戴）。

question: Collector/Nozzle does not include power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., nor noise suppressors or thrust reversers where they are not an integral part of the nozzle system.

options.A: Collector/Nozzle does not include power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc. But it includes noise suppressors and thrust reversers.
options.B: The collector/nozzle includes no power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., along with noise suppressors or thrust reversers because they are not an integral part of the nozzle system.
options.C: The collector/nozzle system does not encompass power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., nor does it include noise suppressors or thrust reversers unless they are integral to the nozzle system.

explanation: 【译文】集气器/喷管不包括动力回收涡轮、涡轮增压器等，也不包括消音器或反推装置——除非它们是喷管系统的整体组成部分。【词汇】power recovery turbines=动力回收涡轮，turbo-superchargers=涡轮增压器，noise suppressors=消音器，thrust reversers=反推装置。【解析】C正确：unless they are integral to the nozzle system完整保留条件。A错误：无条件包含noise suppressors and thrust reversers（方向相反）。B错误：把条件排除说成绝对排除because they are not an integral part（漏译条件）。

question: Starting are those units, components and associated systems used for starting the engine. It includes electrical, inertia air or other starter systems. It does not include ignition systems.

options.A: Starting refers to the units, components, and associated systems employed to initiate the engine, encompassing electrical, inertia air, or other starter systems, but excluding ignition systems.
options.B: Starting are those units, components, and associated systems used for starting the engine. It includes ignition systems but not electrical, inertia air, or other starter systems.
options.C: The units, components, and associated systems employed to initiate the engine, such as electrical, inertia air, or other starter systems, fall under the category of starting instead of ignition systems.

explanation: 【译文】起动系统指用于起动发动机的组件、部件和相关系统，包括电动、惯性空气或其他起动机系统，不包括点火系统。【词汇】starting=起动，associated systems=相关系统，inertia air starter=惯性空气起动机，ignition systems=点火系统。【解析】A正确：encompassing electrical, inertia air, or other starter systems, but excluding ignition systems，包含排除关系完整。B错误：includes/does not include两项完全颠倒（方向相反）。C错误：instead of ignition systems表达排除含混，句式残缺。

question: Inspection and observation are the windows used for examining compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, including items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.

options.A: Inspection and observation refer to the windows used to inspect and observe compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, including items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.
options.B: Inspection and observation are the windows used for discovering compartments and equipment in and around the airplane, excludes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.
options.C: Inspection and observation are defined as the windows used for questioning compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, inclusive of items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.

explanation: 【译文】检查和观察窗是用于检查飞机内外舱室和设备的窗口，包括透明材料及其框架等。【词汇】inspection and observation=检查和观察，examining=检查，compartments=舱室，transparent material=透明材料。【解析】A正确：inspect and observe compartments and equipment、including transparent material完全对应。B两处错误：examining误为discovering（词义错译），including反成excludes（方向相反）。C错误：examining误为questioning（词义错译）。

question: The cowling part includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of accessory section cowls but it does not include the structure integral with the airframe.

options.A: The cowling part includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of attached section cowls and it also includes the structure independent of the airframe.
options.B: The cowling part includes the functioning and installation aspects of independent section cowls but it does not include the structure interreconnected with the airframe.
options.C: The cowling part includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of attached section cowls but it does not include the structure that is one part of the airframe.

explanation: 【译文】整流罩部分包括附件段整流罩的功能和维护方面，但不包括与机体一体的结构。【词汇】cowling=整流罩，accessory section cowls=附件段整流罩，integral with the airframe=与机体一体。【解析】C正确：functioning and maintenance对应原词，one part of the airframe对应integral with。A两处错误：accessory误为attached，does not include反成also includes（方向相反）。B错误：maintenance误为installation、accessory误为independent、integral误为interreconnected。

question: The fireseals refer to the seals mounted on or about the power package for the purpose of isolating areas subject to fire.

options.A: Fireseals are mounted on or about the power plant to separate the areas where a fire breaks out.
options.B: Fireseals are mounted on or below the power plant so as to isolate the engine when there is fire breaking out in the area.
options.C: Fireseals are mounted on or above the power package to in order to separate the firing areas.

explanation: 【译文】防火密封是安装在动力装置上或其周围的密封件，用于隔离易受火灾影响的区域。【词汇】fireseals=防火密封件，mounted on or about=安装于……上或周围，power package=动力装置。【解析】A正确：on or about the power plant对应位置，separate the areas where a fire breaks out对应隔离火区。B两处错误：about误为below（位置错误），isolate areas误为isolate the engine（张冠李戴）。C两处错误：on or about误为on or above，subject to fire误为firing areas（词义错译）。

question: Items such as cables and conduits are banded together to facilitate removal and installation of the power plant.

options.A: The engine's cables and conduits are bound together in order to make power plant easier to remove and install.
options.B: The engine's cables and conduits should be grouped together in order to make them easier to remove and maintain.
options.C: The engine's cables and conduits are classified into a group in order to make it easier to take off and install.

explanation: 【译文】把电缆和导管等物品捆扎在一起，便于动力装置的拆卸和安装。【词汇】cables and conduits=电缆和导管，banded together=捆扎在一起，facilitate=便于，removal and installation=拆卸和安装。【解析】A正确：bound together对应banded，easier to remove and install对应facilitate。B两处错误：installation误为maintain（词义错译），them指代不清。C两处错误：banded弱化为classified into a group（捆扎≠分类），take off含混。

question: The by-pass section of the engine by-passes a portion of the normal engine airflow (either ram or compressed air) for the prime purpose of adding to engine thrust or reducing specific fuel consumption.

options.A: The bypass section of the engine redirects a portion of the unusual airflow (whether it's ram air or compressed air) with the main objective of increasing thrust or decreasing fuel consumption in the engine.
options.B: The bypass section of the engine redirects a portion of the usual airflow (whether it's ram air or compressed air) with the main objective of increasing thrust or decreasing fuel consumption in the engine.
options.C: The bypass section of the engine is used to change the usual airflow (whether it's ram air or compressed air) to diminish thrust or decrease fuel consumption in the engine.

explanation: 【译文】发动机旁通段把一部分正常发动机气流（冲压或压缩空气）旁通，主要目的是增加推力或降低单位燃油消耗。【词汇】by-pass section=旁通段，normal engine airflow=正常发动机气流，prime purpose=主要目的，specific fuel consumption=单位燃油消耗。【解析】B正确：usual airflow对应normal，increasing thrust or decreasing fuel consumption对应目的。A错误：normal误为unusual（方向相反）。C两处错误：by-passes误为change the airflow（漏译分流），adding thrust误为diminish thrust（方向相反）。

question: In aviation, it is mandatory to correctly understand maintenance and operation documentation to make sure that systems operate safely and correctly and to protect human lives.

options.A: In aviation,  in order to protect human lives and to achieve safe and correcct operation of systems, it is obligatory to properly understand maintenance and operation documentation.
options.B: In aviation，it is required by rule that correct understanding of maintenance and operation documentation should be determined by safe and correct operation of systems and human lives.
options.C: In aviation, you have to properly understand maintenance and operation documentation so that the safe and correct operation of systems can protect human lives.

explanation: 【译文】在航空领域，必须正确理解维护和操作文件，以确保系统安全、正确地运行并保护人的生命。【词汇】mandatory=强制的/必须的，maintenance and operation documentation=维护和操作文件，operate safely and correctly=安全正确运行，protect human lives=保护人的生命。【解析】A正确：obligatory to properly understand对应mandatory to correctly understand，目的关系清晰完整。B错误：把“理解文件以保证安全运行”误成“理解文件由安全运行来决定”（因果颠倒）。C错误：把“理解文件以保护生命”误成“系统安全运行来保护生命”（曲解目的关系，张冠李戴）。

question: Special inspection intervals for airplane systems and, possibly, for life limited parts, may be covered in this paragraph or there may be a reference to another section or another document where such inspection intervals may be found.

options.A: This paragraph maybe include the special inspection intervals either for  airplane systems or for life limited parts, or there may be another section or document also include the inspection intervals.
options.B: You may find special inspection intervals for airplane systems and possibly for life limited parts either in this paragraph or in another section  or another document cited in this paragraph.
options.C: Special inspection intervals for airplane systems instead of life limited parts may be found in this paragraph or another section or another document mentioned.

explanation: 【译文】飞机系统及可能的时寿件的特殊检查间隔可在本段给出，也可注明见于其他章节或文件。【词汇】inspection intervals=检查间隔，life limited parts=时寿件，reference to=引用/参见。【解析】B正确：for airplane systems and possibly for life limited parts对应对象，in this paragraph or in another section or document对应出处。A两处错误：and/possibly误为either...or（关系错），also include未表达“参见”（漏译要素）。C错误：instead of把life limited parts排除在外（方向相反）。

question: Open communication should exist with the operator telling the manufacturer as soon as some new kind of situation arises and the manufacturer responding back with solid help to the operators.

options.A: The operator should have open communication, in case of any new situation arises, the manufacturer should be informed timely and give effective help to the operator.
options.B: Open communication should exist with the operator and the manufacturer respectively, so the operator can know the new situation and the manufacturer can provide reliable help.
options.C: There should be an open communication between the operator and the manufacturer so that the latter can provide useful help once being timely informed of newly arising situation.

explanation: 【译文】应保持开放沟通：运营人一旦出现新情况立即告知制造商，制造商则以切实帮助回应。【词汇】open communication=开放沟通，operator=运营人，solid help=切实的帮助。【解析】C正确：between the operator and the manufacturer对应双方沟通，timely informed of newly arising situation对应及时告知。A错误：沟通弱化为运营人单方行为（漏译要素），in case of any new situation arises语法不通。B两处错误：respectively割裂互动，operator can know the new situation张冠李戴（应是运营人报告）。

question: Identify revisions, additions and deletions by a vertical black line along the outside of the page  opposite only that portion of the printed matter that was changed.

options.A: A vertical black line should be drawn to mark any revision, addition and deletion along the outside of the page opposite to the changed contents.
options.B: Whenever the printed matter is to be revised, replenished or updated,  mark a black cross  on the right margin of the page opposite to the changed portion .
options.C: In order to revise, supplement and delete the printed material, a perpendicular black line must be used to identify the changed portion along the margin of the page.

explanation: 【译文】在页面外侧、正对发生变更的印刷内容处画一条竖直黑线，以标识修订、增加和删除。【词汇】revisions, additions and deletions=修订、增加和删除，vertical black line=竖直黑线，opposite=正对。【解析】A正确：vertical black line、outside of the page、opposite to the changed contents要素齐全。B两处错误：vertical black line误为black cross（张冠李戴），additions/deletions误为replenished/updated（词义错译）。C两处错误：“标识变更”目的误成“为了修订材料”（曲解目的），漏译“仅对应变更部分”限定。

question: The equipment list shall contain all required or optional equipment installed in the particular airplane when delivered.

options.A: All auxiliaries or additional  equipment which is to be installed in the particular airplane shall be excluded in the equipment list when delivered.
options.B: When delivering an airplane, make sure the equipment in it  lists all mandatory or auxiliary items.
options.C: When a particular airplane is delivered, all required or optional equipment installed in it shall be contained in the equipment list.

explanation: 【译文】设备清单应包含特定飞机交付时已安装的所有必备或选装设备。【词汇】equipment list=设备清单，required or optional=必备或选装，installed=已安装的，when delivered=交付时。【解析】C正确：all required or optional equipment installed in it shall be contained结构完整对应。A两处错误：把required or optional弱化为auxiliaries or additional，且把contain反成excluded（方向相反）。B错误：把“清单包含设备”误成“设备列出项目”（主宾颠倒，张冠李戴）。

question: Airline operators are encouraged to evaluate their particular 737NG operating environment, accompanied with debris findings at time of cleaning to identify and implement the most effective and economic maintenance interval.

options.A: Airline operators should determine and carry out the most effective and economic maintenance interval after evaluating their particular 737NG operating environment and the debris found when cleaning.
options.B: In order to find the most effective and economic maintenance interval, airline operators have to evaluate and clean the debris accumulated in particular areas of 737NG.
options.C: Before identifying the most effective and economic maintenance interval, airline operators can evaluate the 737NG operating environment by cleaning the debris.

explanation: 【译文】鼓励航空公司运营人评估其特定的737NG运行环境，并结合清洁时发现的碎屑，确定并实施最有效且经济的维护间隔。【词汇】evaluate operating environment=评估运行环境，debris findings=碎屑发现，identify and implement=确定并实施，maintenance interval=维护间隔。【解析】A正确：determine and carry out对应identify and implement，debris found when cleaning对应原词。B错误：把“结合清洁时碎屑发现”误成“评估并清洁碎屑”（张冠李戴）。C错误：把清洁碎屑误为评估环境的手段（曲解逻辑）。

question: The Introduction Section of the Maintenance Manual should contain either a list of vendor publications or refer to the location of such lists whether they are included in system descriptions or provided in separate documents.

options.A: The Introduction Section of the Maintenance Manual should not only include a list of vendor publications, but a cross-reference to where you can find such lists in system description or in separate documents.
options.B: In addition to separate documents, the list of vendor publications and its location information should also be contained both in the Introduction Section of the Maintenance Manual and in system descriptions.
options.C: A list of vendor publications should be included in the Introduction Section of the Maintenance Manual, otherwise the exact location of these lists in system description or in separate documents should be indicated.

explanation: 【译文】维修手册引言部分应包含供应商出版物清单，或注明此类清单的位置——无论它们列在系统描述中还是单独文件中。【词汇】Introduction Section=引言部分，vendor publications=供应商出版物，either...or=或者……或者，refer to the location=注明位置。【解析】C正确：should be included..., otherwise the exact location...should be indicated准确表达二者择一关系。A错误：用not only...but把either/or改成两者兼有（逻辑错误）。B错误：说清单和位置信息应在引言和系统描述中同时包含（曲解either/or关系）。

question: Open communication should exist with the operator telling the manufacturer as soon as some new kind of situation arises and the manufacturer responding back with solid help to the operators.

options.A: The operator is responsible for keeping an open communication with the manufacturer so as to inform him of the new situation and get extra help.
options.B: In order to keep the manufacturer being informed of new situation and the operator receiving solid help in time, there should be an open communication between the operator and the manufacturer.
options.C: The manufacturer should communicate with the operator in an open and transparent way so that he can keep up with new situation and assist the operator randomly.

explanation: 【译文】应保持开放沟通：运营人一旦出现新情况立即告知制造商，制造商则以切实帮助回应运营人。【词汇】open communication=开放沟通，responding back=回应，solid help=切实的帮助。【解析】B正确：keep the manufacturer being informed of new situation对应运营人告知，operator receiving solid help对应制造商回应。A错误：solid误为extra（词义错译），沟通关系只体现运营人单方职责（漏译要素）。C两处错误：运营人报告说成manufacturer keep up with new situation（张冠李戴），solid误为randomly。

question: In "Restricted Area B", the operator can undertake repairs as required, in applying either procedures specified in related chapters of the SRM, or any solution of his choice on condition that prior Airframe Manufacturer's approval is obtained.

options.A: If it is required to perform repairs in "Restricted Area B", the operator should consult the SRM for specific procedures in related chapters rather than his own solution even though prior Airframe Manufacturer's approval is obtained.
options.B: In "Restricted Area B", when conducting repairs as required, the operator can either obey procedures in relevant chapters of the SRM, or apply his own solution approved by Airframe Manufacturer beforehand.
options.C: In "Restricted Area B", where  satisfactory working condition is available and approved by Airframe Manufacturer, the operator is required to perform repairs based on the procedures contained in related chapters of the SRM.

explanation: 【译文】在“限制区域B”内，运营人可按需修理：既可采用SRM相关章节程序，也可用自选方案，条件是事先获机体制造商批准。【词汇】Restricted Area B=限制区域B，undertake repairs=实施修理，SRM=结构修理手册，prior approval=事先批准。【解析】B正确：either obey SRM procedures or apply his own solution approved beforehand，二选一及批准条件完整。A错误：rather than否定自选方案（方向相反），even though曲解批准前提。C两处错误：修理条件误成working condition（无中生有），只留SRM一条路径（漏译要素）。

question: The center of gravity is the point at which an airplane would balance if suspended.

options.A: If an airplane is suspended, it would balance at the point called the center of gravity.
options.B: The center of gravity is the point of an airplane. It would hardly balance if suspended.
options.C: If an airplane is hung, it wouldn’t balance at the point called the center of gravity.
