explanation: 【译文】重心是飞机被悬挂时能够保持平衡的那一点。【词汇】center of gravity=重心，balance=保持平衡，suspended=被悬挂。【解析】A正确：it would balance at the point called the center of gravity，条件与定义均对应。B错误：把would balance误为hardly balance（能→几乎不能，方向相反），且拆句破坏定义结构。C错误：把would balance误为wouldn't balance（方向相反）。

question: Because airplanes are intended to have long lives, their flight safety must be assured.

options.A: In order to make airplanes have long lives, they are often in good condition.
options.B: To make airplanes have long lives, it is necessary to ensure their flight safety.
options.C: Because the long lives of airplanes are required, make sure the mechanics do the maintenance  task correctly.

explanation: 【译文】由于飞机的预期使用寿命很长，必须保证其飞行安全。【词汇】be intended to=旨在/预期，long lives=长寿命，flight safety must be assured=必须保证飞行安全。【解析】B正确：necessary to ensure their flight safety对应must be assured，虽把because转为目的表达，但保留必要性与寿命的关联，语义最接近。A错误：把“保证安全”误成“经常处于良好状态”（漏译飞行安全要素）。C错误：把flight safety误成“机务正确完成维护任务”（张冠李戴）。

question: STE has a controlled general dictionary that gives the words that are most frequently used in technical writing.

options.A: There is a controlled general dictionary in STE. The words in this dictionary are occasionally used in technical writing.
options.B: STE has a controlled general dictionary in which the words are seldom used in technical writing.
options.C: STE has a controlled general dictionary. This dictionary gives the words that are often used in technical writing.

explanation: 【译文】STE有一部受控通用词典，收录技术写作中最常用的词汇。【词汇】STE=简化技术英语，controlled general dictionary=受控通用词典，most frequently used=最常使用的，technical writing=技术写作。【解析】C正确：gives the words that are often used对应most frequently used。A错误：把frequently误为occasionally（常用→偶尔用，频率相反）。B错误：把frequently误为seldom（方向相反）。

question: If the constant speed drive (CSD) does not operate correctly, disconnect it from the gearbox.

options.A: If the constant speed drive (CSD) is inoperative, disconnect it from the gearbox.
options.B: If the constant speed drive (CSD) is in good condition, disconnect it from the gearbox.
options.C: If the constant speed drive (CSD) is operative, remove it from the gearbox.

explanation: 【译文】如果恒速传动装置（CSD）工作不正常，将其从齿轮箱上脱开。【词汇】constant speed drive (CSD)=恒速传动装置，does not operate correctly=工作不正常，inoperative=不能工作的，disconnect from=从……脱开。【解析】A正确：inoperative对应does not operate correctly，disconnect对应disconnect。B错误：把does not operate correctly误为in good condition（方向相反）。C两处错误：operative（方向相反），且把disconnect误为remove（脱开≠拆下，词义错译）。

question: The troubleshooting section should follow the material on “Description and Operation”.

options.A: The troubleshooting section should be placed before the material on “Description and Operation”.
options.B: The troubleshooting section should be placed after the material on “Description and Operation”.
options.C: The troubleshooting section should tell the mechanic to do a work according to the material on “Description and Operation”.

explanation: 【译文】故障排除部分应排在“描述与操作”内容之后。【词汇】troubleshooting section=故障排除部分，follow=在……之后（编排顺序），Description and Operation=描述与操作。【解析】B正确：placed after准确对应follow的编排顺序含义。A错误：把follow误为placed before（方向相反）。C错误：把内容编排顺序误成“告诉机务按该材料工作”（曲解follow含义，张冠李戴）。

question: This section explains how to check flight instruments for recognizing a malfunction.

options.A: This section tells how to identify a fault by checking flight instruments.
options.B: This section tells parameters on flight instruments.
options.C: This section tells how to find a failure of flight instruments.

explanation: 【译文】本节说明如何通过检查飞行仪表来识别故障。【词汇】check flight instruments=检查飞行仪表，recognize a malfunction=识别故障，identify a fault=识别故障。【解析】A正确：identify a fault by checking flight instruments，手段与目的对应准确。B错误：只说tells parameters，完全漏译“识别故障”这一目的（漏译要素）。C错误：把“检查仪表以识别故障”误成“查找仪表自身的故障”（张冠李戴）。

question: Some airplanes may not need CAPs because adequate information is contained in the airplane's maintenance manual.

options.A: Some airplanes' maintenance manuals have enough information so that these airplanes need no CAPs.
options.B: Some airplanes' maintenance manuals involves the same information as CAPs so that these airplanes need no CAPs.
options.C: Insufficient information is holded in these airplanes' maintenance manual so that these airplanes need no CAPs.

explanation: 【译文】有些飞机可能不需要CAP，因为其维护手册中已包含足够的信息。【词汇】CAP=持续适航文件（客户化计划），adequate information=足够的信息，maintenance manual=维护手册。【解析】A正确：have enough information so that...need no CAPs，因果对应完整。B错误：把adequate information误为same information as CAPs（无中生有，范围错误）。C错误：把adequate误为insufficient（方向相反），“信息不足所以不需要”逻辑自相矛盾。

question: The check list should be limited to the minimum number of items determined to be essential to aid the pilot in an emergency.

options.A: The check list should include abundant items which are helpful to the pilot in an emergency.
options.B: The check list should include the fewest items which must be critical to help the pilot in an emergency.
options.C: The check list should have all items that are determined useful by the pilot in an emergency.

explanation: 【译文】检查单应限于经确定对在紧急情况下帮助飞行员必不可少的最少项目数。【词汇】limited to=限于，minimum number=最少数量，essential=必不可少的，in an emergency=在紧急情况下。【解析】B正确：the fewest items对应minimum number，must be critical对应determined essential。A错误：把minimum误为abundant（方向相反），helpful也弱于essential（程度错误）。C错误：把minimum number误为all items（范围错误），把determined essential误为useful by the pilot（张冠李戴）。

question: Identify sections that can cause specific types of trouble.

options.A: Restore sections that relate to certain types of trouble.
options.B: Locate sections that result in general types of trouble.
options.C: Recognize sections that lead to particular types of trouble.

explanation: 【译文】找出可能导致特定类型故障的部分。【词汇】identify=识别/找出，sections=部分/章节，cause=导致，specific types of trouble=特定类型的故障。【解析】C正确：Recognize对应identify，lead to particular types of trouble对应cause specific types of trouble。A错误：把identify误为restore（识别≠恢复，词义错译）。B两处错误：identify误为locate（可接受但不及recognize贴切），specific误为general（方向相反）。

question: The system provides information to determine position and is mainly independent of ground installations.

options.A: The system shows information of position and mainly depends on ground installations.
options.B: The system collects information to calculate position and mainly connects with ground installations.
options.C: The system gives information to identify position and is mainly free from ground installations.

explanation: 【译文】该系统提供用于确定位置的信息，且基本上不依赖地面设施。【词汇】determine position=确定位置，independent of=不依赖于，ground installations=地面设施。【解析】C正确：gives information to identify position对应前半，mainly free from ground installations对应independent of。A错误：independent of误为depends on（方向相反）。B两处错误：provides...to determine误为collects...to calculate（词义错译），independent of误为connects with（方向相反）。

question: Make sure that all the lights on the front of the CMU do not come on.

options.A: Make sure that some of the lights on the front of the CMU do not go out.
options.B: Make sure that all the lights on the front of the CMU do not illuminate.
options.C: Make sure that all the lights on the behind of the CMU do not come on.

explanation: 【译文】确保CMU前面的所有灯都不亮。【词汇】make sure=确保，on the front of=在……前面，do not come on=不亮/不接通，illuminate=点亮。【解析】B正确：all the lights on the front of the CMU do not illuminate，要素齐全。A两处错误：把all误为some（范围错误），把not come on误为not go out（点亮→熄灭，方向相反）。C错误：把on the front误为on the behind（方向相反）。

question: Most of the switches you use to control the electrical power system are on the electrical system control panel.

options.A: You can use most of the switches to control the electrical power system.
options.B: You can find most of the switches that you use to control the electrical power system on the electrical system control panel.
options.C: There are some switches for electrical power system on the electrical system control panel.

explanation: 【译文】用于控制电源系统的大多数开关都位于电气系统控制面板上。【词汇】most of the switches=大多数开关，electrical power system=电源系统，control panel=控制面板。【解析】B正确：find most of the switches...on the electrical system control panel，数量与位置完整。A错误：漏译“位于电气系统控制面板”这一关键位置信息（漏译要素）。C错误：把most误为some（大多数→一些，范围错误）。

question: Let the temperature of the component decrease until it is the same as the ambient temperature.

options.A: Let the temperature increase until it is the same as the ambient temperature.
options.B: Wait for a few minutes until the temperature of the component exceeds the ambient temperature.
options.C: Let the component cool down until its temperature is the same as the ambient temperature.

explanation: 【译文】让部件的温度降低到与环境温度相同为止。【词汇】decrease=降低，component=部件，ambient temperature=环境温度，the same as=与……相同。【解析】C正确：cool down until its temperature is the same as the ambient temperature，准确对应decrease与终点条件。A错误：把decrease误为increase（方向相反）。B两处错误：把decrease误为exceeds（降低→超过，方向相反），且把until引导的终点改成wait a few minutes（曲解条件）。

question: However, the systems are independent and there is no fluid exchange between them.

options.A: However, the systems are independent of each other and they do not exchange fluid.
options.B: However, the systems depend on each other and they can't exchange fluid.
options.C: The systems exchange fluid from each other and so they are independent.

explanation: 【译文】然而，这些系统相互独立，它们之间没有液体交换。【词汇】independent=独立的，fluid exchange=液体交换，between them=彼此之间。【解析】A正确：independent of each other对应independent，they do not exchange fluid对应no fluid exchange。B错误：把independent误为depend on each other（方向相反），can't exchange的语气也不当。C两处错误：把no fluid exchange反成exchange fluid（方向相反），并用so强加因果。

question: Flight compartment is the compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome.

options.A: The compartment which is above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the backward pressure dome is flight compartment.
options.B: Flight deck is the compartment  below the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome.
options.C: The definition of the flight compartment is the compartment which is above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome.

explanation: 【译文】驾驶舱是位于地板以上、前客舱隔板与前承压穹顶之间的舱室。【词汇】flight compartment=驾驶舱，above the floor=地板以上，forward passenger partition=前客舱隔板，forward pressure dome=前承压穹顶。【解析】C正确：above the floor、between...and...、forward pressure dome全部对应。A错误：把forward误为backward（方向相反）。B错误：把above误为below（方向相反）。

question: The precision of this adjustment is important.

options.A: The correctness of this adjustment is important.
options.B: This adjustment is wrong.
options.C: The importance of the adjustment is correct.

explanation: 【译文】这一调整的精确性很重要。【词汇】precision=精确性，adjustment=调整，important=重要的。【解析】A正确：correctness与precision含义最接近，保留“这一调整……很重要”的判断结构。B错误：把is important误为is wrong（词义错译），且丢失“精确性”概念。C错误：把“精确性很重要”颠倒成“重要性是正确的”（结构错译，张冠李戴）。

question: Close valve “A” when you get the same indications on gauges“X” AND “Y”.

options.A: Close valve A when the indications on gauges X and Y correctly .
options.B: Close valve A when you get the indications on gauges X and Y independently.
options.C: Close valve A when the indications on gauges X and Y correspond.

explanation: 【译文】当X表和Y表的指示相同时，关闭活门A。【词汇】close valve=关闭活门，same indications=相同指示，gauge=仪表，correspond=相符/一致。【解析】C正确：the indications on gauges X and Y correspond准确表达same含义。A错误：when the indications...correctly语法残缺、语义不明（语法错误）。B错误：把same误为independently（相同→各自独立，方向相反）。

question: Select the hydraulic system that you will pressurize.

options.A: Decide which hydraulic system you will pressurize.
options.B: The pressurized hydraulic system is the best.
options.C: Check the hydraulic system that you will pressurize.

explanation: 【译文】选择你将增压的那个液压系统。【词汇】select=选择，hydraulic system=液压系统，pressurize=增压。【解析】A正确：Decide which对应select，you will pressurize保留将来增压的限定。B错误：把选择指令误成“增压的系统是最好的”（句意错译）。C错误：把select误为check（选择≠检查，词义错译）。

question: In this configuration, a different test procedure is mandatory.

options.A: In this configuration, we required a same test procedure.
options.B: This configuration demands a different test procedure.
options.C: In this configuration, a different test procedure is required or not.

explanation: 【译文】在此构型下，必须采用不同的测试程序。【词汇】configuration=构型，different test procedure=不同的测试程序，mandatory=强制的/必须的。【解析】B正确：demands a different test procedure对应mandatory要求与different限定。A两处错误：把different误为same（方向相反），we required语法也不规范。C错误：把mandatory误为required or not（强制→两可，方向相反）。

question: The CAP is not intended to change or replace any portion of the applicable airplane maintenance manual .

options.A: The CAP hardly tends to exchange or replace any part of the related airplane maintenance manual.
options.B: The CAP prefers to vary or be instead of any part of the relevant aircraft maintenance manual.
options.C: Any part of the applicative aircraft maintenance manual can not be changed or replaced by the CAP.

explanation: 【译文】CAP无意改变或替代适用飞机维护手册的任何部分。【词汇】is not intended to=无意于，change or replace=改变或替代，applicable=适用的，maintenance manual=维护手册。【解析】C正确：can not be changed or replaced by the CAP，保留否定和全部对象（虽语气略强于not intended，但为三选项最佳）。A两处错误：把not intended误为hardly tends（语义走样），把change误为exchange（词义错译）。B两处错误：把not intended反成prefers to（方向相反），把change误为vary（词义错译）。

question: Comments are located directly below the repair/modification section, extending from the left to the right margins.

options.A: There are remarks directly below the maintenance/overhaul section, extended from left to the right side.
options.B: You can find the comments which extends from left to right margins in the repair/modification section below.
options.C: The comments extended from right to left margins are located in the repair/alternation section.

explanation: 【译文】备注位于修理/改装部分的正下方，从左边距延伸至右边距。【词汇】comments=备注，directly below=正下方，margins=页边距。【解析】A正确：directly below和left to the right两大要素对应，仅repair/modification表述为maintenance/overhaul属近义偏差。B错误：in the repair/modification section below把“位于该部分下方”误成“在下方部分之内”（位置错误）。C两处错误：left to right误为right to left（方向相反），modification误为alternation（词义错译）。

question: Such wires and cables shall be capable of being connected to the ground network of the aircraft electrical system.

options.A: Such wires and cables should be disable of being coupled to the ground network of the aircraft electrical system.
options.B: These wires and cables are capable to be connected to the aircraft electrical system ground network.
options.C: The connected wires and cables shall be attached to the ground network of the aircraft electrical system.

explanation: 【译文】此类导线和电缆应能连接到飞机电气系统的接地网络。【词汇】wires and cables=导线和电缆，be capable of being connected=能够被连接，ground network=接地网络，electrical system=电气系统。【解析】B正确：capable to be connected to the aircraft electrical system ground network对应完整。A错误：把capable误为disable（方向相反）。C两处错误：把“应能连接”误成“已连接的导线应连接”（时态/逻辑错误），attached to不及connected贴切。

question: To establish the basis for those items to be included, the following assumptions have been made.

options.A: To found the basis for those items, the following conceptions have been made.
options.B: In order to set up the basis for those items to be included, make the following assumptions.
options.C: Do the following assumptions to build up the basis for those items to be excluded.

explanation: 【译文】为确立将这些项目纳入的依据，已作出以下假设。【词汇】establish the basis=确立依据，items to be included=将被纳入的项目，assumptions=假设。【解析】B正确：set up the basis for those items to be included, make the following assumptions，结构对应完整。A两处错误：establish误用found（词形错用），assumptions误为conceptions（词义错译）。C两处错误：把被动完成态改成祈使句Do the assumptions（语法生硬），且included误为excluded（方向相反）。

question: Because airplanes are intended to have long lives, their flight safety must be assured.

options.A: Since airplanes usually have long service lives, their flights are surely safe.
options.B: It is mandatory to ensure the flight safety because of the long lives of airplanes.
options.C: Despite the long lives of airplanes, their flight safety cannot be assured.

explanation: 【译文】由于飞机的预期使用寿命很长，必须保证其飞行安全。【词汇】be intended to=旨在/预期，long lives=长寿命，mandatory=强制的，flight safety must be assured=必须保证飞行安全。【解析】B正确：mandatory to ensure the flight safety对应must be assured，because of the long lives对应because原因状语。A错误：把“必须保证安全”误成“飞行肯定安全”（把要求说成事实，逻辑错误）。C两处错误：把because误为despite（因果→转折），把must be assured误为cannot be assured（方向相反）。

question: If the air intake flap is not serviceable, do the deactivation procedure of the air inlet valve.

options.A: If the air intake flap is not serviceable, lock the air inlet valve in the fully open position.
options.B: Once the air intake flap does not work, activate the air inlet valve.
options.C: Deactivate the air inlet valve unless the air intake flap is useable.

explanation: 【译文】如果进气折流门不可用，执行进气活门的解除（失效）程序。【词汇】air intake flap=进气折流门，serviceable=可用的，deactivation procedure=解除/失效程序，air inlet valve=进气活门。【解析】A正确：条件not serviceable完整保留，lock the air inlet valve in the fully open position是对解除程序的合理具体化。B两处错误：Once...does not work把条件弱化为时间状语，deactivate误为activate（方向相反）。C错误：unless useable使解除成为默认动作，逻辑重心与原句不符（条件关系错误）。

question: Entrance stairs or step operate in conjunction with but are not integral part of entrance doors.

options.A: Entrance stairs or step are connected with entrance doors and move accordingly.
options.B: Entrance stairs or step are integrated with entrance doors and operate together.
options.C: Although entrance stairs or step operate together with entrance doors, they are not integrated.

explanation: 【译文】登机梯或踏步与登机门联动工作，但不是登机门的整体组成部分。【词汇】entrance stairs/step=登机梯/踏步，in conjunction with=与……协同，integral part=整体组成部分，entrance doors=登机门。【解析】C正确：operate together with entrance doors对应联动，they are not integrated对应not integral part。A错误：只说connected and move accordingly，漏译“不是整体组成部分”（漏译要素）。B错误：把not integral误为integrated（方向相反）。

question: Unless the manufacturer’s instructions tell you differently, do the procedure that follows.

options.A: Obey the following procedure if the manufacturer provides you different instructions.
options.B: If the manufacturer instructs you differently, the following procedure should be ignored.
options.C: If the manufacturer's instructions are different from the following procedure, obey the following procedure.

explanation: 【译文】除非制造商的说明另有指示，否则执行下面的程序。【词汇】unless=除非，manufacturer's instructions=制造商说明，differently=不同地，the procedure that follows=下面的程序。【解析】B正确：If the manufacturer instructs you differently, the following procedure should be ignored，准确表达例外条件。A错误：把unless误成“if...different instructions→执行下述程序”（条件反置，方向相反）。C错误：同样把“不同则不执行”误成“不同仍执行下述程序”（方向相反）。

question: Two operators found bent pins in the discharge cartridge on some fire extinguishers.

options.A: According to two operators, bent pins were found in the discharge cartridge on some fire bottles.
options.B: On some fire bottles, the discharge cartridge was found bent by two operators.
options.C: The discharge cartridge of some fire bottles were found missing pins by two operators.

explanation: 【译文】有两家运营人在某些灭火瓶的释放筒中发现了弯曲的销子。【词汇】operators=运营人，bent pins=弯曲的销子，discharge cartridge=释放筒，fire extinguishers/fire bottles=灭火瓶。【解析】A正确：bent pins were found in the discharge cartridge on some fire bottles，主宾完整。B错误：把bent pins误成discharge cartridge was found bent（张冠李戴：销子弯变成筒弯）。C错误：把bent误为missing（弯曲≠缺失，词义错译）。

question: Make sure that the position of the clamp agrees with the position that you recorded during the removal procedure.

options.A: Be sure that the position of the clamp has the same opinion with your record before you remove it.
options.B: Make sure that the position of the clamp is the same as the position you recorded during the removal procedure.
options.C: Insure that the clamp matches the position  that you recorded during the repair procedure.

explanation: 【译文】确保卡箍的位置与你在拆卸程序中记录的位置一致。【词汇】clamp=卡箍，agrees with=与……一致，recorded=记录的，removal procedure=拆卸程序。【解析】B正确：is the same as the position you recorded during the removal procedure，完全对应。A两处错误：把agrees with误为has the same opinion（词义错译），把during the removal误为before you remove it（时间关系偏差）。C两处错误：make sure误用insure（词形错用），把removal误为repair（拆卸→修理，张冠李戴）。

question: This is the minimum flight speed at which the airplane is directionally and laterally controllable.

options.A: This is the low limit of flight speed at which the airplane can be controlled directionally and laterally.
options.B: This is the upper limit of flight speed at which the aircraft is directionally and laterally controllable.
options.C: This is the largest flight speed at which the airplane is directionally and laterally steerable.

explanation: 【译文】这是飞机在方向上和横向上均可操纵的最低飞行速度。【词汇】minimum flight speed=最低飞行速度，directionally=方向上的，laterally=横向上的，controllable=可操纵的。【解析】A正确：low limit of flight speed对应minimum，controlled directionally and laterally对应可控性。B错误：把minimum误为upper limit（方向相反）。C错误：把minimum误为largest（方向相反），steerable虽为近义词但整句不成立。

question: The system is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil.

options.A: The quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil are calculated by the system.
options.B: The system is used to show the information of the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil.
options.C: The system is used for the analysis of the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil.

explanation: 【译文】该系统用于指示滑油的数量、温度和压力。【词汇】indicate=指示，quantity=数量，temperature and pressure=温度和压力，oil=滑油。【解析】B正确：show the information of the quantity, temperature and pressure，对应indicate与三个参数。A错误：把indicate误为calculated（指示≠计算，词义错译），被动句式也改变系统功能表述。C错误：把indicate误为analysis（指示≠分析，词义错译）。

question: Once designed and approved, the establishment of thorough maintenance procedures is a must.

options.A: It is urgent to establish the thorough maintenance procedure after designed and approved.
options.B: Once designed and approved, scheduled maintenance procedures must be built.
options.C: Once designed and approved, complete maintenance procedures must be set up.

explanation: 【译文】（飞机）一经设计并获批准，就必须建立完善的维护程序。【词汇】once=一经，designed and approved=设计并批准，thorough=完善的/彻底的，a must=必须做的事。【解析】C正确：complete maintenance procedures must be set up，thorough对应complete，a must对应must。A两处错误：把a must误为urgent（强制≠紧急，词义错译），after designed语法不规范。B错误：把thorough误为scheduled（完善≠定期的，词义错译）。

question: This system does not supersede the normal channels of communication for items not covered by the CAP.

options.A: This system does not exceed the normal channels of communication for items not included in the CAP.
options.B: For items not included in the CAP, this system does not take the place of the normal channels of communication.
options.C: For items not mentioned in the CAP, this system does not occupy the normal channels of communication.

explanation: 【译文】对于CAP未涵盖的项目，本系统不取代正常的沟通渠道。【词汇】supersede=取代，normal channels of communication=正常沟通渠道，covered by=被……涵盖。【解析】B正确：does not take the place of准确对应supersede，not included in the CAP对应not covered。A错误：把supersede误为exceed（取代≠超过，词义错译）。C两处错误：把supersede误为occupy（词义错译），把covered误为mentioned（程度偏差）。

question: This CAP has been prepared with the intent to expand present inspection requirements as a further assurance of the ability of the airplane to perform within the limits of the original certification.

options.A: The purpose of the CAP is to extend the current inspection scope so that the performance of the aircraft keeps fulfilling the capability of the original certification.
options.B: The CAP is worked out to maintain the need for flight so that the performance of the aircraft would conform to the original certification standards.
options.C: CAP is designed to address the growing demand for flying and to keep aircraft in compliance with the original certification standards.

explanation: 【译文】制定本CAP的目的是扩大现行检查要求，以进一步保证飞机能在原始审定限制内运行。【词汇】with the intent to=意在，expand inspection requirements=扩大检查要求，further assurance=进一步保证。【解析】A正确：extend the current inspection scope对应expand，fulfilling the capability of the original certification对应审定限制。B错误：expand inspection requirements误为maintain the need for flight（张冠李戴）。C错误：意图误为demand for flying（曲解目的）。

question: Maintenance information shall include General procedural instructions and application of protective treatments after inspection.

options.A: Maintenance information does not necessarily include general procedural instructions but the application of protective treatments after inspection.
options.B: The maintenance information contains the general procedural instructions and the protective handling measures after inspection
options.C: The general procedural description in the maintenance information includes the  protective treatment measures after inspection.

explanation: 【译文】维护信息应包括一般程序说明以及检查后保护性处理的应用。【词汇】maintenance information=维护信息，general procedural instructions=一般程序说明，protective treatments=保护性处理，after inspection=检查后。【解析】B正确：contains the general procedural instructions and the protective handling measures保持并列包含关系。A错误：does not necessarily include把shall弱化为“不一定包括”（方向相反）。C错误：并列关系误成“程序说明包含保护处理措施”（从属关系错，结构错译）。

question: It is expected that the manufacturers of major components will provide maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection and repair data in the format of this specification.

options.A: The specification of major components' maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection and repair data is according to the format of the manufacturers.
options.B: The major component manufacturers need to prepare all maintenance related data as specified format.
options.C: The maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection and repair data is to be prepared in the format of this specification by the major components manufacturers.

explanation: 【译文】预计主要部件制造商将按本规范的格式提供维护、排故、检查和修理数据。【词汇】major components=主要部件，troubleshooting=排故，inspection and repair=检查和修理，in the format of=按……格式。【解析】C正确：prepared in the format of this specification by the major components manufacturers，格式归属和数据类型完整。A错误：把“按本规范格式”误成“按制造商的格式”（归属颠倒）。B错误：把四类具体数据笼统为all maintenance related data（漏译细分要素）。

question: If the Specification is used to prepare a Continuing Airworthiness Program for acceptance by an airworthiness authority other than FAA, the appropriate authority and its regulations may be substituted.

options.A: This Specification shall be excepted to prepare a continuous airworthiness program other than the FAA airworthiness organization.
options.B: If the continuous airworthiness program is prepared accordingly and to be accepted by other airworthiness agencies but FAA, it may replace the appropriate agency and its regulations.
options.C: This Specification could be used to prepare a continuous airworthiness program approved by other airworthiness agencies, but it must be approved by FAA airworthiness agencies.

explanation: 【译文】如果本规范被用于编制供FAA以外的适航当局认可的持续适航大纲，则可替换为相应的当局及其规章。【词汇】Continuing Airworthiness Program=持续适航大纲，airworthiness authority=适航当局，other than=除……以外，substituted=替代。【解析】B正确：保留“非FAA当局接受”的前提和may replace/substitute的替换含义。A错误：把is used to prepare误为shall be excepted（词义错译），语句不通。C两处错误：把other than FAA误成“必须经FAA批准”（方向相反），且漏译替换规章的内容。

question: To get correct clearance, add special shims as necessary.

options.A: Special shims are necessary to make the place clean.
options.B: Get correct clearance to add special shims as necessary.
options.C: Adjust the clearance correctly by adding special shims as necessary.

explanation: 【译文】为获得正确间隙，按需加装专用垫片。【词汇】clearance=间隙，special shims=专用垫片，as necessary=按需要。【解析】C正确：by adding special shims as necessary准确表达“以获得正确间隙”的手段目的关系。A错误：把clearance误读为clean（词形/词义错译，间隙→清洁）。B错误：把“为获间隙而加垫片”误成“取得间隙以便加垫片”（目的手段颠倒）。

question: The CAP will address primary and secondary airframe components, and primary and secondary systems to accomplish the stated objective of continued airworthiness.

options.A: The CAP will cover primary and secondary airframe components, and primary and secondary systems to achieve the stated target of continued airworthiness.
options.B: The CAP will remark primary and secondary airframe components, and primary and secondary systems to complete the stated objection of continued airworthiness.
options.C: The CAP will locate primary and secondary airframe components, and primary and secondary systems to accompany the stated objective of continued airworthiness.

explanation: 【译文】CAP将涉及主要和次要机体部件以及主要和次要系统，以实现既定的持续适航目标。【词汇】address=涉及，primary and secondary=主要和次要，airframe components=机体部件，continued airworthiness=持续适航。【解析】A正确：cover对应address，achieve the stated target对应accomplish the objective。B两处错误：address误为remark，objective误为objection（词形错用）。C两处错误：address误为locate，accomplish误为accompany（词义错译）。

question:
The Handbook should advise pilots to 
 obtain a service manual prior to performing 
 preventive maintenance to be sure that proper 
 procedures are followed.

options.A:
The Handbook should advise pilots to 
 obtain a service manual before performing 
 preventive maintenance to be sure that proper 
 procedures are observed.
options.B:
The Handbook should advise pilots to 
obtain a service manual  after performing 
 preventive maintenance to be sure that proper 
procedures are followed.
options.C:
The Handbook should advise pilots to 
 obtain a service manual prior to perform preventive maintenance to be sure of the following procedures.

explanation: 【译文】手册应建议飞行员在执行预防性维护之前先取得勤务手册，以确保遵循正确的程序。【词汇】advise=建议，prior to=在……之前，preventive maintenance=预防性维护，procedures are followed=遵循程序。【解析】A正确：before performing preventive maintenance对应prior to，procedures are observed对应followed。B错误：把prior to误为after（方向相反）。C两处错误：prior to后接perform语法错误，be sure of the following procedures曲解procedures are followed（结构错译）。

question: This procedure is only for repairs that include a very small number of rivets.

options.A: Repairs that contain several rivets  can only conform to this procedure.
options.B: This procedure can be the reference for repairs that have lots of rivets.
options.C: This procedure is only applicable to repairs that include very few rivets.

explanation: 【译文】本程序仅适用于只涉及极少量铆钉的修理。【词汇】only for=仅适用于，repairs=修理，a very small number of=极少量，rivets=铆钉。【解析】C正确：only applicable to repairs that include very few rivets，完全对应。A两处错误：把very small number误为several（程度错误），can only conform to句式也改变“仅适用”关系。B错误：把very small number误为lots of（极少→很多，方向相反）。

question: This cover will keep dirt, particles, or other unwanted material out of the system.

options.A: This cover will make sure that dirt, particles, or other foreign material are in the system.
options.B: This cover will keep dirt, particles, or other foreign material from entering the system.
options.C: This cover is the only method to separate dirt, particles, or other unwanted material from the system.

explanation: 【译文】此盖将防止污物、颗粒或其他不需要的材料进入系统。【词汇】cover=盖/罩，keep...out of=防止……进入，particles=颗粒，foreign/unwanted material=外来物/不需要的材料。【解析】B正确：keep dirt, particles, or other foreign material from entering the system，准确对应keep out of。A错误：把keep out误为are in the system（方向相反）。C两处错误：only method无中生有，且把keep...out of误为separate...from（防止进入≠分离，词义错译）。

question: If there is noise when the pump operates, examine the filter for metal particles.

options.A: If pump operation is noisy, check pump filter for metal debris.
options.B: If sound is detected when the pump is inoperative, test the filter for metal contamination.
options.C: When the pump operates, there will be noise. That means there must be metal debris.

explanation: 【译文】如果泵工作时出现噪声，检查过滤器是否有金属颗粒。【词汇】noise=噪声，operates=工作，examine=检查，filter=过滤器，metal particles=金属颗粒。【解析】A正确：pump operation is noisy对应noise when operates，check pump filter for metal debris对应examine filter。B两处错误：把operates误为inoperative（方向相反），把examine误为test（词义错译）。C错误：把“若有噪声则检查过滤器”误成“工作必有噪声、必有金属碎屑”（曲解条件关系，逻辑错误）。

question: Make sure that the L-Shaped seal stays bonded. If the seal does not stay bonded, a leak can occur.

options.A: The L-Shaped seal must stay separated, otherwise there will be leakage.
options.B: Make sure that the L-Shaped seal stays bonded or a leak can occur.
options.C: Make sure that leakage can occur after  the L-Shaped seal is bonded.

explanation: 【译文】确保L形密封保持粘接；如果密封未保持粘接，可能发生泄漏。【词汇】L-Shaped seal=L形密封，stays bonded=保持粘接，leak=泄漏，occur=发生。【解析】B正确：stays bonded or a leak can occur，准确表达条件后果关系。A错误：把bonded误为separated（粘接→分离，方向相反）。C错误：把“未粘接导致泄漏”误成“粘接后发生泄漏”（条件颠倒，方向相反）。

question: After the ailerons go back to neutral, make sure that they are flush with the flaps.

options.A: Make sure that the ailerons are in the same direction with the flaps after they return to central position.
options.B: After the ailerons are in the same position with the flaps, they can return to neutral.
options.C: After the return of the ailerons to neutral, check that they are in the same level with the flaps.

explanation: 【译文】副翼回到中立位后，确保其与襟翼齐平。【词汇】ailerons=副翼，neutral=中立位，flush with=与……齐平，flaps=襟翼。【解析】C正确：return of the ailerons to neutral对应先后顺序，in the same level with the flaps对应flush。A错误：把flush误为in the same direction（齐平≠同方向，词义错译）。B错误：把“先回中立再检查齐平”的顺序颠倒（顺序错误）。

question: Before closing the hatch, it is mandatory to ensure that no persons are in the crew rest compartment.

options.A: Unless you close the hatch, ensure that persons are in the crew rest compartment.
options.B: Before you close the hatch, make sure that no persons are in the crew rest compartment.
options.C: Before you close the hatch, notice  whether or not that there is  persons are in the crew rest compartment.

explanation: 【译文】关闭舱口前，必须确保机组休息舱内无人。【词汇】hatch=舱口/舱盖，mandatory=强制的，no persons=无人，crew rest compartment=机组休息舱。【解析】B正确：Before you close the hatch、make sure that no persons are in，完全对应。A错误：Unless you close the hatch曲解before条件，且把no persons反成persons are in（方向相反）。C错误：用whether or not把“确保无人”弱化为“注意是否有人”（漏译禁止要素）。

question: Reject the component if the test is not satisfactory.

options.A: Rejection is mandatory if the test proves the component to be defective.
options.B: Rejection is  non-mandatory if the test is not satisfactory.
options.C: The component is acceptable if the test is not satisfactory.

explanation: 【译文】如果测试不合格，拒收该部件。【词汇】reject=拒收，component=部件，test is not satisfactory=测试不合格，defective=有缺陷的。【解析】A正确：if the test proves the component to be defective对应不合格后果，mandatory强化reject指令，语义最接近。B错误：把强制要求误为non-mandatory（方向相反）。C错误：把reject误为acceptable（方向相反）。

question: The data used for the calculations in this example apply only to a Type B unit.

options.A: In this example, it's applicable to  calculate type B unit only to the data.
options.B: In this example, it's applicable to  calculate the data  only to a type B unit.
options.C: In this example, it's acceptable to  calculate the data  only to a type B unit.

explanation: 【译文】本例中用于计算的数据仅适用于B型组件。【词汇】data=数据，calculations=计算，apply to=适用于，only to a Type B unit=仅对B型组件。【解析】B正确：applicable对应apply，the data...only to a type B unit保留“数据仅适用于B型组件”的核心语义。A错误：calculate type B unit only to the data把数据与组件的适用关系说反（张冠李戴）。C错误：把applicable误为acceptable（适用≠可接受，词义错译），结构虽同B但关键用词错误。

question: If you do not safety the door, it is possible that strong winds will cause damage to the structure.

options.A: If you do not safety the door,  strong winds must cause damage to the structure.
options.B: If you do not safety the door, damage to the structure due to strong winds is acceptable.
options.C: If you do not safety the door, damage to the structure due to strong winds is probable.

explanation: 【译文】如果不给舱门上保险，强风有可能对结构造成损坏。【词汇】safety the door=给门打保险/固定，possible=可能的，strong winds=强风，cause damage=造成损坏。【解析】C正确：damage...is probable最接近possible的风险含义。A错误：把possible误为must（可能→必然，程度错误）。B错误：把可能的损坏误为acceptable（可能损坏→可接受，词义错译）。

question: The center of gravity moves in relation to the loads on the wings.

options.A: Movement of the center of gravity is not depending on the loads on the wings.
options.B: Movement of the center of gravity is relative with the loads on the wings.
options.C: Movement of the center of gravity is regardless to the loads on the wings.

explanation: 【译文】重心随机翼上的载荷变化而移动。【词汇】center of gravity=重心，moves in relation to=随……而移动/与……相关，loads on the wings=机翼载荷。【解析】B正确：is relative with the loads对应in relation to的相关关系。A错误：把in relation to误为not depending on（方向相反）。C错误：把in relation to误为regardless to（相关→无关，方向相反）。

question: First, second and third level heads and captions should be distinctive in size or style or both.

options.A: The size or style or both of the first, second and third level heads and captions should be different.
options.B: First, second and third level heads and captions should be of the same size or style or both.
options.C: First, second and third level heads and captions should use the uniform size or style or both.

explanation: 【译文】一、二、三级标题和题注在尺寸或样式或两者上应有区别。【词汇】level heads=各级标题，captions=题注，distinctive=有区别的/独特的，size or style=尺寸或样式。【解析】A正确：should be different对应distinctive。B错误：把distinctive误为same（方向相反）。C错误：把distinctive误为uniform（方向相反）。

question: The loading conditions together with the resulting margins of safety were evaluated.

options.A: The loading conditions including its generating safety limits were indicated.
options.B: The loading conditions and the consequent margins of safety were assessed.
options.C: The loading conditions and its relevant safety margins were extended.

explanation: 【译文】已对载荷条件以及由此产生的安全裕度进行了评估。【词汇】loading conditions=载荷条件，resulting=由此产生的，margins of safety=安全裕度，evaluated=评估。【解析】B正确：consequent margins of safety were assessed对应resulting和evaluated。A两处错误：把resulting误为generating，把evaluated误为indicated（词义错译）。C两处错误：把resulting弱化为relevant（漏译因果关系），把evaluated误为extended（评估→扩展，词义错译）。

question: The turbines extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.

options.A: The turbines produce energy from the exhaust gases and are connected to the crankshaft.
options.B: The turbines store energy from the exhaust gases and are linked to the crankshaft.
options.C: The turbines obtain energy from the exhaust gases and are attached to the crankshaft.

explanation: 【译文】涡轮从废气中提取能量，并与曲轴相连。【词汇】turbines=涡轮，extract energy=提取能量，exhaust gases=废气，coupled to=与……相连，crankshaft=曲轴。【解析】C正确：obtain energy对应extract，attached to the crankshaft对应coupled。A错误：把extract误为produce（提取≠产生，词义错译）。B错误：把extract误为store（提取≠储存，词义错译）。

question: The emergency exit doors are used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit.

options.A: The emergency exit doors are known as backup exit and they should not be used in special condition.
options.B: The emergency exit doors are used for the escape and are not used as the normal exits.
options.C: The emergency exit doors are applied to board that are not usually used for exit.

explanation: 【译文】应急出口门用于便于撤离，正常情况下不作为出口使用。【词汇】emergency exit doors=应急出口门，facilitate evacuation=便于撤离，normally used=通常使用，exit=出口。【解析】B正确：used for the escape对应facilitate evacuation，not used as the normal exits对应not normally used。A错误：把not normally used误成“特殊情况下也不应使用”（条件颠倒，方向相反）。C错误：把evacuation误为board（撤离→登机，方向相反）。

question: If the airplane is pressurized, explain how to recognize potential problems and handle emergencies.

options.A: If the airplane is pressurized, explain the ways to identify potential problems and deal with emergencies.
options.B: If the air pressure in the airplane is augmented, state how to find critical problems and dispose emergencies.
options.C: If the airplane is inflated, state how to find significant problems and handle emergencies.

explanation: 【译文】如果飞机是增压的，说明如何识别潜在问题和处置紧急情况。【词汇】pressurized=增压的，recognize=识别，potential problems=潜在问题，handle emergencies=处置紧急情况。【解析】A正确：identify potential problems and deal with emergencies要素齐全。B三处错误：pressurized误为air pressure augmented（表述走样），potential误为critical（词义错译），dispose不及handle贴切。C两处错误：pressurized误为inflated（词义错译），potential误为significant。

question: The SATCOM system supplies higher quality data and voice message signals for passengers and crew over longer distances than VHF and HF communication systems.

options.A: The quantity of data and voice message supplied to passangers and crew by VHF and HF is higher than that  by SATCOM over longer distances.
options.B: The quality of data and voice message supplied to passangers and crew by VHF and HF is lower than that  by SATCOM over  longer distances.
options.C: The quality of data and voice message supplied to passangers and crew by VHF and HF is higher than that  by SATCOM over longer distances.

explanation: 【译文】与VHF和HF通信系统相比，SATCOM系统能为乘客和机组在更远距离上提供更高质量的数据和语音信息信号。【词汇】SATCOM=卫星通信，higher quality=更高质量，data and voice message signals=数据和语音信息信号，VHF/HF=甚高频/高频，over longer distances=更远距离。【解析】B正确：以反向比较“VHF/HF质量低于SATCOM”等价表达原文比较关系。A两处错误：把quality误为quantity（词形错用），且比较方向也错。C错误：把higher/lower比较方向弄反（方向相反）。

question: When you use the hand micphone, the REU will decrease the volume to the flight compartment speaker.

options.A: The hand micphone will decrease the volume to the flight compartment speaker by the REU.
options.B: The volume of REU in the cockpit will be reduced when you use a handmicphone .
options.C: The volume of speaker in the cockpit will be reduced by REU when you use a hand micphone.

explanation: 【译文】当你使用手持话筒时，REU会降低通往驾驶舱扬声器的音量。【词汇】hand microphone=手持话筒，REU=遥控电子组件，decrease the volume=降低音量，flight compartment speaker=驾驶舱扬声器。【解析】C正确：volume of speaker in the cockpit will be reduced by REU，主宾关系与原文一致。A错误：把REU执行降音误成话筒执行（主客颠倒）。B错误：把speaker的音量误为volume of REU（张冠李戴）。

question: You must turn on the service interphone switch to operate the system from service interphone jacks.

options.A: If you want to operate the system at service interphone jacks, the service interphone switch must be turned on.
options.B: If you want to operate the system, the service interphone switch must be turned on at service interphone jacks.
options.C: The service interphone system must be turned on  to operate the system switch from service interphone jacks.

explanation: 【译文】必须打开勤务内话电门，才能从勤务内话插孔操作该系统。【词汇】turn on=打开，service interphone switch=勤务内话电门，operate the system=操作系统，service interphone jacks=勤务内话插孔。【解析】A正确：operate the system at service interphone jacks与must be turned on，目的条件对应。B错误：把“从插孔操作系统”误成“在插孔处打开电门”（位置关系错误）。C错误：把service interphone switch误为service interphone system（张冠李戴），system switch表述混乱。

question: The yaw damper system keeps the airplane stable around the airplane yaw(vertical)axis to command rudder movement in proportion to and opposite to the airplane yaw moment.

options.A: The rudder will be moved in proportion to and opposite to yaw condition of aircraft to keep it stable around vertical axis by the yaw damper system.
options.B: The rudder will be moved  in unticlockwise to yaw condition proportionally of aircraft to keep it stable around vertical axis by the yaw damper system.
options.C: The rudder will be commanded to move in opposite to yaw condition proportionally of aircraft to keep it stable around vertical axis by the yaw damper system.

explanation: 【译文】偏航阻尼系统通过指令方向舵按与偏航力矩成正比且相反的方式运动，使飞机绕垂直轴保持稳定。【词汇】yaw damper=偏航阻尼器，vertical axis=垂直轴，command=指令，in proportion to and opposite to=成正比且反向，yaw moment=偏航力矩。【解析】A正确：moved in proportion to and opposite to yaw condition保留正比反向两要素。B错误：opposite to误为unticlockwise（反向≠逆时针，拼写也错）。C错误：commanded to move in opposite to yaw condition proportionally语序混乱，语义不如A完整。

question: Rectify the defect before you stop the pump momentarily.

options.A: Correct the defect before you stop the pump for a short time.
options.B: Record the defect before you stop the pump later.
options.C: Restore the defect before you stop the pump for a long time.

explanation: 【译文】在你短暂停泵之前，先纠正缺陷。【词汇】rectify=纠正/排除，defect=缺陷，momentarily=短暂地，stop the pump=停泵。【解析】A正确：Correct the defect对应rectify，for a short time对应momentarily。B两处错误：把rectify误为record（纠正→记录，词义错译），把momentarily误为later（时间含义丢失）。C两处错误：rectify误为restore（词义错译），momentarily误为for a long time（方向相反）。

question: The time intervals for the inspections vary with the types of aircraft.

options.A: The time between two inspections is not the same on different types of aircraft.
options.B: The time of inspections is the same on the same type of aircraft.
options.C: The duration of inspections is depending on the types of aircraft.

explanation: 【译文】检查的时间间隔随机型不同而变化。【词汇】time intervals=时间间隔，inspections=检查，vary with=随……变化，types of aircraft=机型。【解析】A正确：not the same on different types of aircraft准确表达vary with types。B错误：把vary with types误成“同型飞机时间相同”（方向相反）。C错误：把intervals（间隔）误为duration（持续时间，词义错译），虽保留随机型变化但核心概念已变。

question: Aircraft equipped with tail wheels are generally towed forward by attaching the tow bar to the main landing gear.

options.A: Normally, for an aircraft that has tail wheels, you can tow the tail wheels forward. To do this you can connect the tow bar to the main landing gear.
options.B: Usually, for an aircraft that has tail wheels, you can link the tow bar to the main landing gear, thus you can tow the aircraft forward.
options.C: For an aircraft that has tail wheels, you can tow the aircraft forward only when the tow bar is linked to the main landing gear.

explanation: 【译文】装有尾轮的飞机一般通过把牵引杆连接到主起落架来向前牵引。【词汇】tail wheels=尾轮，towed forward=向前牵引，tow bar=牵引杆，main landing gear=主起落架。【解析】B正确：link the tow bar to the main landing gear, thus you can tow the aircraft forward，方式与目的对应。A错误：把tow the aircraft误为tow the tail wheels（牵引飞机→牵引尾轮，张冠李戴）。C错误：加入only when把一般做法说成唯一条件（范围错误）。

question: The signal must be given in such a precise way that the pilot cannot confuse.

options.A: You must give the obvious signal in a certain way in order to be seen by the pilot.
options.B: You must stand on a specific road, that is a clear signal for the pilot.
options.C: You must give the pilot the clear signal that is not misunderstood by the pilot.

explanation: 【译文】给出的信号必须精确到使飞行员不会产生混淆。【词汇】signal=信号，precise way=精确的方式，confuse=混淆，misunderstood=误解。【解析】C正确：clear signal that is not misunderstood by the pilot对应cannot confuse的目的。A错误：把“不产生混淆”误为“能被看见”（漏译核心目的）。B错误：把give a signal误为stand on a specific road（张冠李戴，语义不通）。

question: Maintain the power lever at the "start" position until the specified minimum oil temperature is reached.

options.A: Keep the power lever at the "start" position when the specified minimum oil temperature is not reached.
options.B: After the specified minimum oil temperature is arrived, put the power lever at the "start" position.
options.C: When the specified minimum oil temperature is reached, put the power lever at the "off" position.

explanation: 【译文】保持功率杆在“起动”位，直到达到规定的最低滑油温度。【词汇】maintain=保持，power lever=功率杆，start position=起动位，until=直到，minimum oil temperature=最低滑油温度。【解析】A正确：when the specified minimum oil temperature is not reached与until...reached逻辑等价。B错误：把“达到前保持起动位”误成“达到后才放到起动位”（顺序相反）。C错误：把start误为off（张冠李戴），且条件关系也反了。

question: It is possible that local fire codes, and standards make it necessary to use more restrictive procedures than those given in the subsequent steps.

options.A: It is permitted, if the local fire regulations and standards are more stringent than those regulations described in the following steps.
options.B: It is allowed, if the local fire codes and standards are more complicated than those legislations listed in the following steps.
options.C: It is possible that local fire protection regulations, and standards are necessary to be used more restrictive than those mentioned in the subsequent steps.

explanation: 【译文】当地消防法规和标准有可能要求采用比后续步骤更严格的程序。【词汇】local fire codes=当地消防法规，make it necessary=使得有必要，more restrictive=更严格，subsequent steps=后续步骤。【解析】C正确：保留It is possible、necessary、more restrictive than subsequent steps核心含义，虽有语病但语义最全。A错误：It is possible误为It is permitted（可能→允许，词义错译），且“法规要求更严程序”误成条件句。B错误：同样用It is allowed误译可能性，restrictive误为complicated（词义错译）。

question: The Continuing Airworthiness Program is not intended to change or replace any portion of the applicable airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.

options.A: The Continuing Airworthiness Program is not designed to adjust or substitute any partition of the proper airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.
options.B: The Continuing Airworthiness Program doesn't have the intention to alter or replace any part of the appropriate aircraft Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.
options.C: Any part of the applicative airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters will not be changed or replaced by Continuing Airworthiness Program.

explanation: 【译文】持续适航大纲无意改变或替代适用飞机维护手册或服务信函的任何部分。【词汇】Continuing Airworthiness Program=持续适航大纲，is not intended to=无意于，Service Letters=服务信函。【解析】B正确：doesn't have the intention to alter or replace any part保留“无意”情态和全部对象。A多处错误：change误为adjust、portion误为partition、applicable误为proper（词义错译）。C两处错误：applicative为生造词，且把not intended说成will not be changed的绝对断言（语气错误）。

question: Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and synonyms that many English words have can cause confusion.

options.A: Complicated sentence configurations and a lot of meanings and synonymity that many English words have can make confusion.
options.B: Complex sentence structure and a great deal of meanings and antonyms that many English words have can cause misunderstanding.
options.C: Intircate sentence structure and lots of meanings and synonyms that many English words have can likely cause confusedness.

explanation: 【译文】复杂的句子结构以及许多英语单词所具有的大量词义和同义词会造成混淆。【词汇】complex sentence structure=复杂句子结构，meanings=词义，synonyms=同义词，cause confusion=造成混淆。【解析】A正确：Complicated sentence configurations、a lot of meanings and synonymity、make confusion，核心均对应。B错误：把synonyms误为antonyms（同义→反义，方向相反）。C两处错误：can cause误为can likely cause（添加多余情态），confusion误为不规范的confusedness（词形错误）。

question: If the vocabulary, meanings of words, and the types of sentence constructions in a text are controlled, the variation between texts will be minimal.

options.A: If the wordlist, meanings of words, and the types of sentence skeleton in a text are under controlled, the change between texts will be smallest.
options.B: If the wordlist, meanings of words, and the types of sentence structure in a text are under controlled, the change between texts will be minimum.
options.C: The variation between texts will be minimal, if the meaning of the new words and the sentence architecture in the article are well controlled.

explanation: 【译文】如果文本中的词汇、词义和句子结构类型受到控制，文本之间的差异将是最小的。【词汇】vocabulary=词汇，sentence constructions=句子结构，controlled=受控的，variation minimal=差异最小。【解析】B正确：wordlist、meanings、sentence structure三项受控要素齐全，change...minimum对应variation minimal。A两处错误：constructions误为skeleton（词义错译），under controlled语法错误。C两处错误：漏译vocabulary受控（漏译要素），meanings误为meaning of the new words（范围错误）。

question: Each approved word in the dictionary has a specified approved meaning which can be more restricted than its meaning in standard English.

options.A: The word meaning in standard English may be less restricted than the specified approved meaning of each word in the dictionary.
options.B: The specific approved meaning of each approved word in the dictionary can be more limited than its meaning in standard English.
options.C: The special meaning approval of every word in the dictionary may be more constrained than its meaning in common standard English.

explanation: 【译文】词典中每个批准词都有规定的批准含义，该含义可能比其在标准英语中的含义更受限制。【词汇】approved word=批准词，specified approved meaning=规定的批准含义，more restricted=更受限制，standard English=标准英语。【解析】B正确：each approved word、specific approved meaning、more limited than standard English要素齐全方向一致。A错误：比较方向颠倒成“标准英语含义更不受限”，逻辑接近但表述绕口，弱化approved word限定。C错误：approved meaning误为special meaning approval（张冠李戴）。

question: Remove the cover assembly to get access to the lamp assembly.

options.A: In order to get access to the lamp assembly, remove the cover assembly.
options.B: After getting access to the lamp assembly, remove the cover assembly.
options.C: At the same time of getting access to the lamp assembly, remove the cover assembly.

explanation: 【译文】拆下盖组件以便接近灯组件。【词汇】cover assembly=盖组件，get access to=接近/够到，lamp assembly=灯组件。【解析】A正确：In order to get access to the lamp assembly, remove the cover assembly，目的手段关系对应。B错误：把“拆盖以接近灯”误成“接近灯后再拆盖”（顺序相反）。C错误：把先后关系误为at the same time（顺序错误）。

question: The information to be included on the cover will be left to the manufacturer's discretion.

options.A: The manufacturer couldn’t decide the information to be included on the cover.
options.B: The information to be included on the cover will be decided by the manufacturer.
options.C: The information is included on the left side of the cover by the manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】封面上应包含哪些信息将由制造商自行决定。【词汇】left to...discretion=由……自行决定，manufacturer=制造商，cover=封面。【解析】B正确：will be decided by the manufacturer对应discretion。A错误：把自行决定误为couldn't decide（方向相反）。C错误：把left to discretion误读为“放在封面左侧”（left一词多义误用，词义错译）。

question: The distance between the edge of the panel and the partition must not be more than 0.05 mm.

options.A: The distance between the edge of the panels and the partition must be less than 0.05 m.
options.B: The distance between the edge of the panel and the partition must be equal to 0.05 mm.
options.C: The distance between the edge of the panel and the partition must be 0.05 mm or less.

explanation: 【译文】面板边缘与隔板之间的距离不得超过0.05毫米。【词汇】distance=距离，edge=边缘，partition=隔板，must not be more than=不得超过，0.05 mm=0.05毫米。【解析】C正确：0.05 mm or less准确对应not more than。A两处错误：把0.05 mm误为0.05 m（单位错误），panel误为复数panels。B错误：把not more than误为equal to（不超过→必须等于，范围错误）。

question: Be careful when you move jet pipes or exhaust cones that have insulating blankets.

options.A: Be careful when you move jet pipes or exhaust cones having insulating blankets.
options.B: Be careful when you move jet pipes, or exhaust cones have insulating blankets.
options.C: Jet pipes have insulating blankets. Be careful when you move exhaust cones.

explanation: 【译文】移动带有隔热毯的喷管或排气锥时要小心。【词汇】be careful=小心，jet pipes=喷管，exhaust cones=排气锥，insulating blankets=隔热毯。【解析】A正确：having insulating blankets作后置定语同时修饰jet pipes or exhaust cones，与原文结构一致。B错误：逗号把or exhaust cones have insulating blankets切成并列分句，使“排气锥有隔热毯”成为独立陈述而非修饰关系，语法语义均被割裂（语法错误）。C两处错误：把隔热毯归属单独说成喷管所有（张冠李戴），且漏译移动喷管也需小心。

question: If you do not find damage during the inspection procedure, assemble the unit.

options.A: If you do not find damage during the inspection procedure, disassemble the unit.
options.B: If you find damage during the inspection procedure, don’t assemble the unit.
options.C: If you find damage during the inspection procedure, disassemble the unit.

explanation: 【译文】如果在检查程序中未发现损伤，则组装该组件。【词汇】find damage=发现损伤，inspection procedure=检查程序，assemble=组装，unit=组件。【解析】B正确：If you find damage...don't assemble the unit是“未发现损伤则组装”的合理逆否表述，语义最接近原意。A错误：保留“未发现损伤”条件却把assemble误为disassemble（方向相反）。C错误：条件与动作均被改动，把“无损则装”改成“有损则拆”（漏译原条件）。

question: These FAA advisory circulars provide specific information regarding continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.

options.A: These FAA advisory circulars furnish specific information related to continued airworthiness requirements for the manufacturer and owner/operator.
options.B: These FAA advisory circulars apply to specific information regarding continued airworthiness requirements from the manufacturer and owner/operator.
options.C: These FAA advisory circulars supply specific information with continued airworthiness requirements of the manufacturer and owner/operator.

explanation: 【译文】这些FAA咨询通告为制造商和机主/运营人提供有关持续适航要求的具体信息。【词汇】FAA advisory circulars=FAA咨询通告，provide...regarding=提供有关……的，continued airworthiness=持续适航，owner/operator=机主/运营人。【解析】A正确：furnish specific information related to对应provide...regarding，服务对象完整。B错误：把provide误为apply to（提供≠适用于，词义错译），from the manufacturer也曲解服务方向。C错误：用with/of取代regarding/for，介词搭配使服务对象与信息关系含混（语法错误）。

question: If possible, always tell your reader what can occur if the safety instruction is not obeyed.

options.A: If possible, always tell your reader what can show if the safety instruction is not accepted.
options.B: If possible, always tell your reader what can we do if the safety instruction is not understood.
options.C: If possible, always tell your reader what can happen if the safety instruction is not followed.

explanation: 【译文】如有可能，务必告知读者：若不遵守安全须知，会发生什么。【词汇】occur=发生，safety instruction=安全须知/指示，obeyed/followed=被遵守，reader=读者。【解析】C正确：what can happen对应what can occur，not followed对应not obeyed。A两处错误：occur误为show，obeyed误为accepted（词义错译）。B两处错误：把“会发生什么”误为“我们能做什么”（张冠李戴），obeyed误为understood（词义错译）。

question: Install packing and backup rings on bearing. Slide bearing into cylinder until bottomed.

options.A: Install packing and support rings on bearing. Glide bearing into cylinder until it is bottomed.
options.B: Install packing and backward rings on bearing. Slash bearing into cylinder until the bottom is visible.
options.C: Install packing and alternative rings on bearing. Skid bearing into cylinder until you see the bottom.

explanation: 【译文】在轴承上安装填料和支承环，将轴承滑入缸筒直至到底。【词汇】packing=填料，backup rings=支承环，bearing=轴承，slide...into=滑入，cylinder=缸筒，bottomed=到底。【解析】A正确：support rings对应backup rings，Glide...into cylinder until it is bottomed对应滑入到底。B两处错误：backup误为backward、slide误为slash（词义错译），bottom visible曲解bottomed。C两处错误：backup误为alternative、slide误为skid，until you see the bottom曲解bottomed（词义错译）。

question: The CMCS can latch this EICAS message when it occurs. After you find the cause of the fault and correct it, it is possible that the EICAS message will continue to show.

options.A: The CMCS can detect this EICAS message when it occurs. After you find the cause of the fault and correct it, it is possible that the EICAS message will stay.
options.B: The CMCS can receive this EICAS message when it occurs. After you correct the fault, it is possible that the EICAS message will continue on.
options.C: The CMCS can seize this EICAS message when it occurs.  it is possible that the EICAS message will remain displayed after you find the cause of the fault and correct it.

explanation: 【译文】CMCS可在该EICAS信息出现时将其锁存；找出故障原因并纠正后，该信息仍可能继续显示。【词汇】CMCS=中央维护计算系统，latch=锁存，EICAS message=EICAS信息，continue to show=继续显示。【解析】C正确：seize对应latch的锁定含义，remain displayed after you find the cause and correct it完整保留条件结果。A错误：latch弱化为detect（漏译“锁存保持”机制）。B两处错误：latch误为receive（词义错译），After you correct the fault漏译find the cause（漏译要素）。

question: This specification provides broad general guidance for preparing handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes certified under applicable regulations.

options.A: This specification provides broad general command for preparing handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes authorized under applicable regulations.
options.B: This specification provides broad general instructions for preparing handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes certificated under applicable regulations.
options.C: This specification provides broad general glimpse for preparing handbooks for all types of general aviation airplanes approved under applicable regulations.

explanation: 【译文】本规范为编制各类按适用规章审定的通用航空飞机手册提供广泛的一般性指导。【词汇】specification=规范，broad general guidance=广泛的一般性指导，handbooks=手册，general aviation airplanes=通用航空飞机。【解析】B正确：general instructions对应guidance，certificated对应certified。A错误：guidance误为command（词义错译），certified误为authorized。C错误：guidance误为glimpse（词义错译），certified误为approved。

question: Prior to the applicant for the authorization of Aircraft Type I, the applicant shall have obtained the basic portion of the license for the maintenance personnel.

options.A: Applicant for the authorization of Aircraft Type I may not have the basic portion of the license for the maintenance personnel.
options.B: Applicant for the authorization of Aircraft Type I shall get the basic portion of the license for the maintenance personnel.
options.C: Applicant for the authorization of Aircraft Type I may get the  basic portion of the license for the maintenance personnel later.

explanation: 【译文】申请航空器I类授权之前，申请人应已取得维修人员执照的基础部分。【词汇】prior to=在……之前，applicant=申请人，authorization=授权，basic portion of the license=执照基础部分，maintenance personnel=维修人员。【解析】B正确：shall get the basic portion of the license对应shall have obtained的要求。A错误：把shall have obtained误为may not have（方向相反）。C两处错误：把shall（应当）误为may（可以），且把“申请前已取得”误为“之后取得”（时间方向相反）。

question: The purpose is directly below the Effectivity and lnspection Compliance sections, extending from the left to the right margins.  Any service history discussion is also located here.

options.A: The purpose of the Effectivity and Inspection Compliance section is at the bottom of the page, arranged from left to right. A discussion of all service processes is also available here.
options.B: Effectivity and Inspection Compliance sections are listed from left to right at the bottom, the purpose of doing so is to include all the discussion of  service processes.
options.C: The purpose is just below the Validity and Inspection Compliance section, extending from left to right margin. All the discussion of previous service is also here.

explanation: 【译文】“目的（Purpose）”部分位于“适用性与检查符合性”两节正下方，自左边距延伸至右边距，服役历史讨论也在此处。【词汇】directly below=正下方、margins=页边距、service history=服役历史。【解析】C正确：just below对应directly below，previous service对应service history，位置与内容都对应。A把“Purpose位于两节下方”误为“该两节的目的”（结构错译），service history错成service processes。B主语颠倒成“两节从左到右排列”，逻辑混乱。

question: A certificated repair station may not maintain or alter any article for which it is rated if it requires special technical data, equipment, or facilities that are not available to it.

options.A: A certified repair station may carry out non-rated maintenance if it is necessary to perform maintenance or alteration any article.
options.B: A certificated repair station may maintain or alter any article for which it is rated only if all the required special technical data, equipment, or facilities that are available to it.
options.C: A licensed maintenance station is not allowed to repair or change any assessed article which it is rated.

explanation: 【译文】若维修工作需要其不具备的特殊技术资料、设备或设施，持证维修站不得维修或改装其等级范围内的任何项目。【词汇】certificated repair station=持证维修站、rated=等级内的、article=维修项目、available to it=其可获得的。【解析】B正确：用only if...available改写may not...if...not available，否定条件语义等价。A错改成non-rated maintenance且漏条件。C过度概括为“不得修理任何等级内项目”，漏掉“缺乏资料/设备/设施”前提（漏译要素）。

question: It is extremely important to observe the fuel safety precautions.

options.A: It is very important to explain the fuel safety precautions.
options.B: It is very important to obey the fuel safety precautions.
options.C: Combining the fuel safety precautions is very important.

explanation: 【译文】遵守燃油安全注意事项极其重要。【词汇】observe=遵守（与rules/precautions搭配，非“观察”）、fuel safety precautions=燃油安全注意事项/预防措施、extremely important=极其重要。【解析】B正确：obey对应observe的“遵守”义，precautions表述完整。A把observe错译为explain（解释），词义错译。C把observe错译为combining（结合），且句型变成“合并注意事项很重要”，漏掉“遵守”这一核心动作（词义错译＋漏译要素）。

question: When you do maintenance on the waste water system, do not touch your face with your gloves.

options.A: When you do maintenance on the waste water system, make sure that your gloves are put on.
options.B: Face away from waste water system when you do maintenance on it with gloves.
options.C: Face away from your gloves when you do maintenance on the waste water system.

explanation: 【译文】对污水系统做维修时，不要戴着手套触碰你的脸。【词汇】waste water system=污水系统、do maintenance on=对…进行维修、touch your face with your gloves=用（戴着的）手套触碰面部。【解析】A相对最佳：保留了“维修污水系统”的场景和gloves（手套）这一要素，“确保手套戴好”与“勿用手套触脸”同为防止污染的安全提示，是三个选项中唯一语义相关、无语病的改写。B错把do not touch your face改成“脸背离污水系统（face away）”，属于方向性误读。C同样误用face away，变成“脸避开手套”，语义荒谬。三项均非严格直译，A为可接受项。

question: Tighten the bolts manually if you cannot do it with the specified tool.

options.A: Tighten the bolts manually until you can do it with the specified tool.
options.B: Tighten the bolts manually if it is not feasible to do it with the specified tool.
options.C: In case that you cannot do it with the specified tool in case,tighten the bolts manually.

explanation: 【译文】如果无法用规定工具拧紧，就用手动方式拧紧螺栓。【词汇】manually=手动地、specified tool=规定/指定工具、if you cannot do it=如果无法做到、tighten=拧紧。【解析】B正确：“if it is not feasible to do it with the specified tool”准确对应“if you cannot do it with the specified tool”（无法用规定工具完成），条件关系和祈使句式均保留。A把条件“if”错改成“until（直到）”，句意变为“手动拧紧直到能用工具为止”，逻辑相反（方向相反）。C虽含条件义，但“in case that...in case”重复杂糅，属语法错误，表达不合格。

question: This procedure obeys all the requirements of service bulletin no. 97.

options.A: This procedure completes all the requirements of Service Bulletin No. 97.
options.B: This procedure fulfills all the requirements of Service Bulletin No. 97.
options.C: All the requirements of Service Bulletin No. 97 are in this procedure.

explanation: 【译文】本程序符合第97号服务通告的全部要求。【词汇】obeys=遵守/符合（此处作“满足”讲）、requirements=要求、service bulletin=服务通告（SB）。【解析】B正确：fulfills（满足）准确对应obeys/requirements的搭配，“of Service Bulletin No.97”对应正确。A用completes（完成），“完成要求”与“符合要求”有偏差（词义错译）。C把句子改成“所有要求都在本程序中”，主宾颠倒，丢失“程序符合要求”的判断关系（结构错译）。

question: The BITE function collects the failures and sends the failure message to the central maintenance computer.

options.A: The BITE function rectifies the failures and sends the failure message to the Central Maintenance Computer.
options.B: The failures are sent to the BITE function and the central maintenance computer.
options.C: The BITE function garners the failures and sends the failure message to the central maintenance computer.

explanation: 【译文】BITE（机内自测）功能收集故障并将故障信息发送给中央维护计算机。【词汇】BITE=Built-In Test Equipment机内自测设备、collects=收集、failure message=故障信息、central maintenance computer=中央维护计算机（CMC）。【解析】C正确：garners（收集）准确对应collects，后半句主谓宾完整对应。A把collects错译为rectifies（纠正/排除），词义错译。B把信息流方向写反：“故障被发送给BITE功能和维护计算机”，实际是BITE收集故障后发给CMC（方向相反＋张冠李戴）。

question: Other configurations include an in-line flow indicator which changes color to green in the presence of oxygen.

options.A: An in-line flow indicator is embodied in other configurations. If there is oxygen, the color of the indicator becomes green.
options.B: The oxygen is dyed green in other configurations that include an in-line flow indicator.
options.C: The present oxygen indicator comes on green  due to an in-line flow in the other configurations.

explanation: 【译文】其他构型含有一个管道内流量指示器，有氧时其颜色变为绿色。【词汇】in-line flow indicator=管路内流量指示器、in the presence of oxygen=有氧存在时、changes color to green=变为绿色。【解析】A正确：is embodied in对应include，if there is oxygen...becomes green对应in the presence of oxygen与changes color to green。B错成“氧气被染绿”，主客体张冠李戴。C把变绿原因错为“in-line flow（管道内流动）”，实为氧气存在，因果错译。

question: These windshields are formed to the exact shape required, but are slightly larger than necessary so they  may be trimmed to the exact size.

options.A: The windshields are filled in a form that requires an exact shape, but they are necessary to have a slightly larger space for the ease of adjustment.
options.B: The shape of the windshields has exact requirements, but for purpose of exact size, they appear slightly larger.
options.C: These windshields are shaped to a required exact appearance, but in order to be clipped accurately, they are a little bigger than necessary.

explanation: 【译文】这些风挡按要求的精确形状成形，但做得比所需稍大，以便修剪到精确尺寸。【词汇】formed to the exact shape=按精确形状成形、slightly larger than necessary=比所需稍大、trimmed to the exact size=修剪至精确尺寸。【解析】C正确：a little bigger than necessary对应slightly larger，clipped accurately对应trimmed to the exact size，因果完整。A把formed错成filled in a form且漏“修剪”目的。B漏译trimmed这一关键动作，只说“为精确尺寸而稍大”（漏译要素）。

question: To prevent overheat damage to the wing leading edge, the engine bleed air is given maximum cooling during ground operations.

options.A: Prior to ground operations, maximum cooling of the engine bleed air is provided to avoid the overheat damage to the wing leading edge.
options.B: To keep the wing leading edge from overheat damage, the engine bleed air has a maximum cooling effect during ground operations.
options.C: While the aircraft is operating on the ground, the engine bleed air provides a best cooling to the wing leading edge to renovate the damage due to overheat.

explanation: 【译文】为防止机翼前缘过热损伤，地面运转期间对发动机引气施以最大冷却。【词汇】wing leading edge=机翼前缘、engine bleed air=发动机引气、maximum cooling=最大冷却、ground operations=地面运转。【解析】B正确：keep...from overheat damage对应prevent overheat damage，during ground operations保留。A把during错为Prior to（之前），时间错误。C把prevent（防止）错为renovate（修复），预防变修复，方向相反。

question: Except when the Handbook producer is restricted in choice or otherwise limited, the choice is his.

options.A: The Handbook producer can choose the alternatives in addition to his limited choice or otherwise limited.
options.B: Apart from the situation that there are some restrictions in the choice or otherwise limitations for the Handbook producer, the producer can do his own decision.
options.C: Other than the event that the handbook producer has limitations in choice or otherwise things, he can decide without mind.

explanation: 【译文】除非手册编制者在选择上受限制或有其他限制，否则由他自行选择。【词汇】Handbook producer=手册编制者、restricted in choice=选择受限、otherwise limited=另有其他限制、the choice is his=由他选择。【解析】B正确：Apart from...restrictions对应Except when restricted，do his own decision对应the choice is his。A把Except when错成in addition to，条件关系错。C用without mind（不加思索）歪曲“自行决定”。

question: The diagram shall be arranged so that the flow of the system can be traced with a minimum of effort.

options.A: The flow of the system can be traced as easily as possible through the arrangement of the diagram.
options.B: A  reasonable distribution of the diagram helps to duplicate the flow of the system with least difficulties.
options.C: The diagram shall be arranged in order to draw a minimum flow of the system without effort.

explanation: 【译文】图样编排应使系统流程能被尽可能省力地追踪。【词汇】diagram=图样、flow of the system=系统流程、traced=追踪、with a minimum of effort=以最省力的方式。【解析】A正确：as easily as possible对应with a minimum of effort，through the arrangement对应shall be arranged。B把traced错为duplicate（复制），词义错译。C错成“draw a minimum flow（画出最小流程）”，追踪变画图。

question: The sequence of topics in the Handbook is intended to increase in-flight usefulness.

options.A: The subsequence of topics in the Handbook is intensive to improve in-flight usefulness.
options.B: The order of topics in the Handbook is designed to increase in flight usefulness.
options.C: The series of topics in the Handbook is protected to increase its usefulness in flight.

explanation: 【译文】手册中各主题的编排顺序旨在提高飞行中的实用性。【词汇】sequence of topics=主题顺序、is intended to=旨在、in-flight usefulness=飞行中的实用性。【解析】B正确：order对应sequence，designed to对应is intended to，increase in flight usefulness完整对应。A两处错误：subsequence（子序列）错译sequence，intensive（密集的）错配intended。C两处错误：series可勉强对应sequence，但protected（保护）严重错译intended（旨在），属张冠李戴。

question: The difference between the two dimensions must not be more than 0.10mm.

options.A: The difference between the two sizes must be 0.10mm or less.
options.B: The difference between the two dimensions must exceed 0.10mm.
options.C: The error between the two sizes must be less than 0.10mm.

explanation: 【译文】两个尺寸之差不得大于0.10毫米。【词汇】difference=差值、dimensions=尺寸、must not be more than=不得超过、0.10mm=0.10毫米。【解析】A正确：“must be 0.10mm or less”准确对应“must not be more than 0.10mm”（含等于），sizes对应dimensions（可接受）。B方向相反：must exceed（必须超过）与原意完全相反。C两处偏差：把difference错译为error（误差），“less than”漏掉“等于0.10mm”的边界情形，范围错误。

question: Make sure that the intensity of the reticle light decreases gradually to zero.

options.A: Make sure that the brightness of the reticle light rapidly drops to zero.
options.B: Make sure that the intensity of the reticle light lessens radically to zero.
options.C: Make sure that the brightness of the reticle light is gradually reduced to zero.

explanation: 【译文】确认分划板灯光的强度逐渐降到零。【词汇】reticle light=分划板/标线灯光、intensity=强度（brightness可同义）、decreases gradually=逐渐降低、to zero=归零。【解析】C正确：“brightness...gradually reduced to zero”对应intensity decreases gradually to zero，intensity与brightness在此同义，gradually保留。A把gradually（逐渐）错译为rapidly（迅速），方向相反。B把gradually错译为radically（急剧地/根本地），同样是词义错译。

question: Flow control devices within the system, such as check valves, fuel pumps, accumulators, and relays, should be included.

options.A: Flow control devices within the system and relays should be included. These control devices include check valves, fuel pumps, and accumulators, etc.
options.B: Flow control devices within the system, fuel pumps, accumulators and relays should be included. These control devices include check valves.
options.C: Flow control devices within the system should be included. These control devices include check valves, fuel pumps, accumulators, and relays, etc.

explanation: 【译文】系统内的流量控制装置——如单向活门、燃油泵、蓄压器和继电器——均应包括在内。【词汇】flow control devices=流量控制装置、check valves=单向活门、accumulators=蓄压器、such as=例如（引导举例）。【解析】C正确：先总说flow control devices应included，再用“These control devices include...”完整列举四个例子，such as结构还原准确。A把relays从举例中抽出与主句并列，变成“装置和继电器都应包括”，举例层级错乱且漏举。B同样把四个元件拆散重排，导致举例残缺错乱，check valves被孤零零归入从句（结构错译）。

question: Set the applicable L PACK switch or the R PACK switch, on the P5-10 air conditioning panel, to the AUTO position.

options.A: Set the suitable L PACK switch or the R PACK switch to the AUTO position. L PACK switch and the R PACK switch are on the P5-10 air conditioning panel.
options.B: Set L PACK switch or R PACK switch on suitable p5-10 air conditioner panel to AUTO position.
options.C: Set the applicable L PACK switch or the R PACK switch to the AUTO position. The R PACK switch is on the P5-10 air conditioning panel.

explanation: 【译文】将P5-10空调面板上的适用L PACK或R PACK电门置于AUTO位。【词汇】applicable=适用的、PACK switch=空调组件电门、air conditioning panel=空调面板、AUTO position=自动位。【解析】A正确：suitable对应applicable，且两电门都交代在P5-10面板上，信息完整。B把suitable错挂到panel上（张冠李戴）。C只说“R PACK switch is on the P5-10”，漏掉L PACK电门位置（漏译要素）。

question: The outputs of the VOR receiver go, for display, to the Navigation Display or HSI and on most aircraft also to a Radio Magnetic Indicator.

options.A: The outputs from the VOR receiver are displayed on the Navigation Display or HSI and on most aircraft, and on a Radio Magnetic Indicator.
options.B: The VOR receiver will be put out, for display, to the Navigation Display or HSI and on most aircraft also to a Radio Magnetic Indicator.
options.C: The outlets of the VOR receiver on display, go to the Navigation Display or HSI and on most aircraft also to a Radio Magnetic Indicator.

explanation: 【译文】VOR接收机的输出送至导航显示器或HSI用于显示，多数飞机上还送至无线电磁指示器。【词汇】outputs=输出、for display=用于显示、HSI=水平状态指示器、Radio Magnetic Indicator=无线电磁指示器。【解析】A正确：are displayed on...and on...对应go for display to...and also to，on most aircraft保留。B把outputs错成will be put out（被放出），词义错译。C错成outlets（插座/出口）与“on display（展出中）”，术语错译。

question: The procedures should address how often the program will be reviewed to determine if it is current and adequate for the type of maintenance being performed at the facility.

options.A: The procedures should give the address of the facility and time the program will be rechecked to find out if it is coherent enough for the type of maintenance being performed at the facility.
options.B: The program shall be checked to decide if it is updated and sufficient for the type of maintenance being performed at the facility. The interval of the checks shall be stated in this procedure.
options.C: The program will not be performed at the facility if this procedure shows outdated and inadequency information for the the type of maintenance.

explanation: 【译文】程序中应规定多久评审一次该方案，以确定它对设施内维修类型是否现行有效且充分。【词汇】address=规定/阐明（非“地址”）、how often=频率、current and adequate=现行有效且充分。【解析】B正确：checked to decide if updated and sufficient对应reviewed to determine if current and adequate，interval stated对应how often。A把address错为give the address（给出地址），望文生义。C改成“过时则不执行”，偏离“规定评审频率”原意（结构错译）。

question: Directly below are the purpose sections and extending from the left to the right margins.

options.A: Seen below are the purpose sections and expansions from the left to the right margins.
options.B: All followed below are the purpose sections and excluding from the left to the right margins.
options.C: Right below are the target sections and covering from the left to the right margins.

explanation: 【译文】正下方是目的（Purpose）部分，自左边距延伸至右边距。【词汇】directly below=正下方、purpose sections=目的部分、extending from...to...=自…延伸至…。【解析】A正确：保留purpose sections，Seen below对应Directly below，expansions对应extending（松散但可接受）。B把extending错为excluding（排除），义反。C把purpose错为target（目标），栏目名译错。

question: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered when complying.

options.A: The manufacturer may offer procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered to be complied.
options.B: In order to discover any unairworthy conditions when compiling, the manufacturer shall comply with certain procedures.
options.C: The manufacturer may set up procedures to feed back unairworthy conditions discovered when complying.

explanation: 【译文】制造商可制定程序，以便就遵守规定时发现的不适航状况提供反馈。【词汇】establish procedures=制定程序、provide feedback on=就…反馈、unairworthy conditions=不适航状况、when complying=遵守时。【解析】C正确：may set up对应may establish，feed back unairworthy conditions discovered when complying要素全对。A错成“discovered to be complied（被发现已遵守）”。B颠倒目的：写成“为发现不适航状况而须遵守程序”。

question: If you use more complicated types of sentence structure other than the imperative form, you can cause ambiguity.

options.A: You can lead to ambiguous, if you use an imperative mood other than more sophisticated sentence type.
options.B: If you use a more complex sentence structure instead of an imperative, you can create vagueness.
options.C: If you use a more complicated types of sentence structure imperatively, you could lead to ambient.

explanation: 【译文】若使用祈使句以外的更复杂句型结构，可能造成歧义。【词汇】sentence structure=句型结构、imperative form=祈使句式、other than=除…以外、ambiguity=歧义。【解析】B正确：instead of an imperative对应other than the imperative form，create vagueness对应cause ambiguity。A比较对象写反且ambiguous误作名词（语法错）。C把other than错为imperatively，ambient错译ambiguity。

question: For airplanes having an array of sophisticated or complex systems, the full system/chapter method of indexing is recommended.

options.A: For aircraft with a range of sophistic or complex systems, a system-wide indexing approach is recommended.
options.B: For aircraft including an article of exquisite or complex systems, a whole system indexing way is intended.
options.C: The aircraft which have a number of complicated or complex systems are suggested to use the full system/chapter index method.

explanation: 【译文】对装有一系列精密或复杂系统的飞机，建议采用完整的系统/章节索引法。【词汇】an array of=一系列、sophisticated=精密的/复杂的、full system/chapter method of indexing=完整系统/章节索引法。【解析】C正确：a number of complicated systems对应an array of sophisticated systems，suggested对应recommended，方法名完整。A错：sophistic（诡辩的）错译sophisticated，system-wide丢失chapter。B错：an article of（一件）、exquisite（精美的）均错译。

question: Access doors and panels in a zone are identified by the zone number and a two or three letter suffix.

options.A: Access doors and panels within the area are recognized by the number of the area  and two or three letter prefix.
options.B: The area number and a postfix with two or three letters identifies the access doors and panels in an area.
options.C: The identification of the access panels and doors is accomplished by the zone number suffix.

explanation: 【译文】区域内检修门和口盖由区域编号加两到三字母后缀标识。【词汇】access doors and panels=检修门与口盖、zone=区域、identified by=由…标识、suffix=后缀。【解析】B正确：postfix对应suffix，two or three letters保留，主动语态等价identified by。A把suffix错为prefix（前缀），方向相反。C只说zone number suffix，漏“两到三字母”限定（漏译要素）。

question: If the CONTINUE shows during the BITE test, then do the instructions that show on the CDU display before you push the LSK that is adjacent to CONTINUE.

options.A: If the CONTINUE is displayed during BITE test, execute the instructions presented on the CDU display before pressing LSK which is next to CONTINUE.
options.B: When CONTINUE appears in the BITE test, follow the instructions shown on the CDU and then push the CONTINUE button next  to LSK.
options.C: If the instructions are shown on the CDU display during the BITE test  before you press the adjacent LSK , push CONTINUE.

explanation: 【译文】若BITE测试期间显示CONTINUE，先执行CDU显示器上的指令，再按与CONTINUE相邻的LSK。【词汇】BITE test=机内自测、CDU display=控制显示组件、LSK=行选键、adjacent to=与…相邻。【解析】A正确：execute instructions...before pressing LSK next to CONTINUE，顺序与相邻关系全对。B错成“按LSK旁的CONTINUE按钮”，操作对象张冠李戴。C逻辑打乱成“显示指令就按CONTINUE”，丢失顺序。

question: The engine bleed air system leak check using the APU describes how to use the APU to pressurize the system to check the sense lines and these system components for leaks.

options.A: In order to do the engine bleed system leak check, use APU to pressurize the system and check if there are leaks in the sensing tube and these system components.
options.B: The leak inspection of the engine bleed air system describes how to use APU to pressurize the system to inspect whether the sense lines and the system parts leak or not.
