options.C: The way to check the leakage of the sense pipes and the system components by compressing system using APU is described.

explanation: 【译文】“使用APU的发动机引气系统渗漏检查”一节说明如何用APU增压，检查感应管路和这些系统部件是否渗漏。【词汇】leak check=渗漏检查、pressurize=增压、sense lines=感应管路、describes how to=说明如何。【解析】B正确：保留describes how to use APU to pressurize的叙述框架，sense lines与system parts齐全。A虽内容可用，但改写成祈使操作句，丢失“describes（本节说明）”框架，sense lines缩为单数。C漏掉增压检查渗漏的目的链，主语混乱。

question: If the tower does not respond, use a different channel.

options.A: If there is no respond from the tower, select a different frequency and contact again.
options.B: If there is not any answer from the tower, use a different tunnel.
options.C: If the tower does not respond, use a different radio device.

explanation: 【译文】如果塔台没有回应，换用其他频道。【词汇】tower=塔台、respond=回应、channel=（通信）频道/波道、use a different channel=改用别的频道。【解析】A正确：航空通信中channel即频率，“select a different frequency and contact again”准确传达了换频道再联络的意图。B把channel错译为tunnel（隧道），词义错译且荒谬。C把channel错译为radio device（无线电设备），换频道误为换电台，设备层级错误。

question: If the instrument does not operate correctly, do a test.

options.A: Perform a test to confirm if the instrument can operate correctly.
options.B: If the instrument wasn't working properly, perform a test.
options.C: If a test is performed, then the instrument will be found failed.

explanation: 【译文】如果仪表不能正常工作，就做一个测试。【词汇】instrument=仪表/仪器、operate correctly=正常工作、do a test=做一个测试。【解析】A最佳：把条件句改写为目的句式“Perform a test to confirm if the instrument can operate correctly”（做测试以确认仪表能否正常工作），条件与动作含义完整保留。B时态误用：“wasn't working properly”用过去时，原文为一般性条件，且语义尚可但不及A贴切。C逻辑颠倒：“做了测试就会发现仪表故障”，把条件关系改写成必然结果（结构错译）。

question: Remove the bolts that attach the transmission housing to the engine.

options.A: The bolts for attaching the transmission housing to the engine should be removed.
options.B: Remove the bolts and attach the transmission housing to the engine.
options.C: Remove the bolts that attach the transmission housing, then move it to the engine.

explanation: 【译文】拆下把传动壳体固定到发动机上的螺栓。【词汇】remove=拆下、bolts that attach...to...=把…固定到…的螺栓、transmission housing=传动（装置）壳体。【解析】A正确：被动改写“The bolts for attaching...should be removed”与祈使句Remove the bolts语义等价，attaching housing to engine的修饰关系完整。B把定语从句割裂成“拆螺栓并安装壳体”，attaching由修饰语错变成新动作（结构错译）。C错加“then move it to the engine（再把它移到发动机上）”，原文无此动作，属无中生有。

question: Adjust the door operating rod until it aligns with the attachment point.

options.A: Adjust the door and operating the rod to make the rod aligns with the weld point.
options.B: The rod for the door operating should be adjusted until it aligns with the attachment point.
options.C: Adjust the door operating rod until it stagger  the attachment point.

explanation: 【译文】调整舱门操纵杆，直到它与连接点对齐。【词汇】door operating rod=舱门操纵杆、aligns with=与…对齐、attachment point=连接点/安装点。【解析】B正确：被动改写“The rod...should be adjusted until it aligns with the attachment point”，attachment point保留准确。A把attachment point错译为weld point（焊接点），且“Adjust the door and operating the rod”语法混乱、把门和杆并列成两个操作对象（张冠李戴）。C把aligns with错译为stagger（错开/使交错），对齐变错开，方向相反。

question: Before you do this procedure, engage the ramp service door safety connector pin.

options.A: Insert the pin of the apron service door security connector, then you can perform this procedure.
options.B: The ramp service door safety pin shouldn't be engaged until you start this procedure.
options.C: Firstly you should perform this procedure then you can engage the ramp service door safety connector pin.

explanation: 【译文】执行本程序前，先接合停机坪勤务门的安全接头销。【词汇】engage=接合/插上、ramp=停机坪（=apron）、safety connector pin=安全接头销、before=在…之前。【解析】A正确：insert对应engage，apron对应ramp，“insert...then perform”对应before you do this procedure。B方向相反：“开始前不要接合”。C顺序颠倒：先执行程序再接合销子。

question: Make sure that the rate of supply of fuel from the wing tanks to the center tank is equal.

options.A: Make sure that the fuel quantity from the wing tanks to the center tank is the same.
options.B: Make sure that fuel from the wing tanks flows at the same rate into the center tank.
options.C: Make sure that the fuel flow supplied to the wing tanks and the center tank is at the same rate.

explanation: 【译文】确保从机翼油箱向中央油箱的供油速率相等。【词汇】rate of supply=供油速率、wing tanks=机翼油箱、center tank=中央油箱、equal=相等。【解析】B正确：“flows at the same rate into the center tank”对应rate of supply...is equal，方向（机翼→中央）正确。A把rate（速率）错译为quantity（油量），速率和总量是两个概念（词义错译）。C把供油方向写错：“supplied to the wing tanks and the center tank”变成向两翼油箱和中央油箱同时供油，方向相反。

question: Manually push the ram air turbine in the direction of the retracted position.

options.A: Retract the ram air turbine manually.
options.B: The ram air turbine can be pushed to the retracted position manually.
options.C: Push the ram air turbine with your hands in the direction that the turbine retracted.

explanation: 【译文】用手将冲压空气涡轮朝收回位置方向推。【词汇】ram air turbine=冲压空气涡轮、manually=用手、in the direction of=朝…方向、retracted position=收回位。【解析】C正确：with your hands对应Manually，in the direction that...retracted对应in the direction of the retracted position，祈使句保留。A概括为Retract manually，丢失“朝收回方向推”（漏译要素）。B改成can be pushed to the retracted position，情态和动作指向改变。

question: If desired, the manufacturer may include more than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual.

options.A: The manufacturer shall include no less than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual if required.
options.B: The manufacturer is desired to include more than one airplane model in the Maintenance Manual.
options.C: The Maintenance Manual may include more than one airplane model at the discretion of the manufacturer.

explanation: 【译文】如有需要，制造商可在维修手册中收录一个以上机型。【词汇】if desired=如有需要、may=可以、more than one=一个以上、at the discretion of=由…裁量。【解析】C正确：at the discretion of the manufacturer对应if desired，may include more than one要素齐全。A错：may改成shall，more than one改成no less than one。B：is desired to include语法不当，且“若需要”变“被期望”。

question: Each page shall bear the date of the original issue until revised and, when revised, that of the latest revision.

options.A: Each page shall have the date of the original issue until revised and, when revised the latest revision shall take place.
options.B: Each page shall bear the date of the original issue until the revised latest revision occur.
options.C: The original issue date shall show on each page until revised. The latest revision date shall show when revised.

explanation: 【译文】每页应标注初版日期直至修订，修订后标注最新修订日期。【词汇】bear the date=标注日期、original issue=初版、revised=修订、latest revision=最新修订。【解析】C正确：拆成两句——初版日期显示至修订、修订后显示最新修订日期，与原意完全对应。B“until the revised latest revision occur”语法杂糅。A“the latest revision shall take place”把“标注修订日期”误为“修订发生”。

question: Indicated Airspeed is the speed of an aircraft as shown in the airspeed indicator when corrected for instrument error.

options.A: Indicated Airspeed is corrected for instrument error and the speed of an aircraft shown in the airspeed indicator.
options.B: Indicated Airspeed is the speed of an aircraft that is corrected for instrument error and shown in the airspeed indicator.
options.C: The speed of an aircraft is shown in the airspeed indicator. It is corrected for instrument error.

explanation: 【译文】指示空速是经仪表误差修正后空速表上显示的飞机速度。【词汇】Indicated Airspeed=指示空速、airspeed indicator=空速表、corrected for instrument error=经仪表误差修正。【解析】A最佳：保留Indicated Airspeed主语，修正与表上显示两要素都在。B：“an aircraft that is corrected”使被修正对象错位（语法错误）。C拆成两句且丢失Indicated Airspeed被定义术语（漏译要素）。

question: If you install the upper drag strut incorrectly, it will hit the lower drag strut during retraction.

options.A: Nothing will happen during retraction if the upper drag strut is replaced correctly.
options.B: If you install the upper drag strut by mistake, it will break the lower drag strut during extension.
options.C: Wrong installation of the upper drag strut will cause the hitting of the lower drag strut during retraction.

explanation: 【译文】上阻力支柱若安装不正确，收起时会撞击下阻力支柱。【词汇】drag strut=阻力支柱、install incorrectly=安装不正确、hit=撞击、during retraction=收起时。【解析】C正确：Wrong installation对应install incorrectly，hitting during retraction要素全对。A：incorrectly错成correctly，Nothing will happen相反。B：hit错成break，retraction错成extension，两错。

question: When there are several words in English for the same thing (synonyms), STE permits one of these synonyms to the exclusion of the others.

options.A: STE uses one of these acronyms including others when there are different words in English for the same thing(acronyms).
options.B: When there are different words in English for the same thing (synonyms), STE allows one synonym rather than others.
options.C: It is allowable in STE to use one of these abbreviations when several words can express the same thing(abbreviations).

explanation: 【译文】当同一事物在英语中有多个词（同义词）时，STE只允许使用其中一个同义词而排除其余。【词汇】synonyms=同义词、permits=允许、to the exclusion of the others=排除其余、STE=简化技术英语。【解析】B正确：“allows one synonym rather than others”准确对应“permits one of these synonyms to the exclusion of the others”，且synonyms一词前后照应。A把synonyms错译为acronyms（首字母缩略词），术语错译。C把synonyms错译为abbreviations（缩写词），同样术语错译；二者都是利用-onyms形近词设置的干扰。

question: Each approved word in the dictionary has a specified approved meaning which can be more restricted than its meaning in standard English.

options.A: Each approved word in the dictionary is assigned a specified approved meaning, which is strictly controlled comparing with the meaning in standard English.
options.B: A specified unapproved meaning corresponds to each approved word in the dictionary that leads to the restriction of the meaning in standard English.
options.C: Comparing with the meaning of standard English, the specified approved meaning for each approved word in the dictionary is more appropriate.

explanation: 【译文】词典中每个获准词都有指定的获准含义，可能比标准英语中的含义更受限制。【词汇】approved word=获准词、specified approved meaning=指定获准含义、more restricted=更受限制。【解析】A正确：assigned a specified approved meaning对应has a specified approved meaning，strictly controlled对应more restricted。B把approved错成unapproved（未获准），关键限定相反。C把more restricted错为more appropriate（更合适），词义错译。

question: When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.

options.A: When you change a word with the alternative, you must ensure that the meaning of the sentence varies.
options.B: The meaning of the sentence can be different when you use the alternative you select to replace a word.
options.C: Always keep the same meaning of the sentence when you use the alternative to replace a word.

explanation: 【译文】替换单词时，务必确保所选替代词不改变句子意思。【词汇】replace=替换、alternative=替代词、does not change the meaning=不改变意思。【解析】C正确：keep the same meaning对应does not change the meaning，否定禁令转肯定要求，语义等价。A：meaning varies（意思改变）方向相反。B：can be different（可以不同）把应避免的说成允许的，方向相反。

question: This will be limited to the forward and aft edges of the windshield due to the bottom edge not being visible and the top edge having the bus bar in the way.

options.A: The forward and aft edges of the windshield has limits, otherwise the bottom and the top edge has not limites.
options.B: Because of the visiblity of the bottom edge of the windshield and the top edge having the bus bar in the way, the forward and aft edges of the windshield will be limited.
options.C: This will be limited to the forward and aft edges of the windshield because of the bottom edge invisible and the top edge having the bus bar in the way.

explanation: 【译文】这将仅限于风挡前缘和后缘，因为下边缘不可见、上边缘有母线挡着。【词汇】forward and aft edges=前后缘、due to=由于、not being visible=不可见、bus bar=母线。【解析】C正确：bottom edge invisible对应not being visible，top edge having the bus bar保留。A“otherwise...has not limites”逻辑混乱有语病。B把not being visible错成visibility，不可见变可见，方向相反。

question: The aircraft and engine manufacturers recommend that you do not weld engine components when the engine is installed on the airframe.

options.A: You had better not to weld engine components when the engine is installed on the airframe.
options.B: You're not allowed to operate engine components when the engine is installed on the airframe.
options.C: You had better not to weld engine components when the engine is running.

explanation: 【译文】制造商建议：发动机装在机体上时不要焊接发动机部件。【词汇】recommend=建议、weld=焊接、engine components=发动机部件、installed on the airframe=装在机体上。【解析】A正确：had better not weld对应recommend not weld，installed on the airframe保留。B：weld错为operate，recommend错为not allowed。C把“装在机体上”错成when running（运转时），条件错译。

question: The laws are reconfigured to keep the load alleviation capability should an aileron or spoiler surface become inoperative.

options.A: If an aileron or spoiler surface failed, the laws are reconfigured to keep the load alleviation capability.
options.B: If an aileron or spoiler surface activated, the laws are reconfigured to keep the load alleviation capability.
options.C: If an aileron or spoiler surface replaced, the laws are reconfigured to keep the load alleviation capability.

explanation: 【译文】若副翼或扰流板舵面失效，控制律将重新构型以保持载荷减缓能力。【词汇】laws=控制律、reconfigured=重新构型、load alleviation=载荷减缓、become inoperative=失效。【解析】A正确：failed对应inoperative，reconfigured to keep load alleviation capability保留。B：activated（作动）与失效相反。C：replaced（更换）错译inoperative，词义错译。

question: On the ground, it provides a fixed relationship between the side stick controller angle and the elevator deflections.

options.A: On the ground, the relationship between the side stick controller angle and the elevator deflections  can be changed.
options.B: On the ground, the relationship between the side stick controller angle and the elevator deflections cannot be changed.
options.C: On the ground, the relationship between the side stick controller angle and the elevator deflections is flexible.

explanation: 【译文】在地面时，（系统）在侧杆控制器角度与升降舵偏转之间提供固定的关系。【词汇】side stick controller=侧杆控制器、elevator deflections=升降舵偏转、fixed relationship=固定关系、on the ground=在地面。【解析】B正确：fixed（固定的）即cannot be changed（不可改变），语义等价改写，地面条件保留。A“can be changed（可以改变）”与fixed相反（方向相反）。C“flexible（灵活的）”同样与fixed矛盾，方向相反。

question: The SOV has a manual override capability which permits the valve to be opened or closed in case of failure of the electrical control.

options.A: The SOV has a manual override capability, so we can open or close the electrical control.
options.B: If the electrical control is faulty,we still can open or close the valve by manual method.
options.C: If the electrical control is fault, we still can open or close the SOV by manual method.

explanation: 【译文】该关断活门具有人工超控能力，电气控制失效时可人工开闭活门。【词汇】SOV=关断活门、manual override=人工超控、in case of failure=万一失效、electrical control=电气控制。【解析】B正确：If the electrical control is faulty对应in case of failure，open or close the valve by manual method对应原文，语法通顺。C语义近B但“is fault”语法错误（应faulty），故取B。A错成“开闭电气控制”，对象是valve，张冠李戴。

question: A CAP supplements the airplane's maintenance manual which is the primary document containing the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of the airplane.

options.A: As part of the airplane's maintenance manual, CAP is the primary document containing the procedures for aircraft continued airworthiness.
options.B: The maintenance manual is the fundamental document containing the aircraft's continuous airworthiness procedures, and the CAP is a supplement to the aircraft maintenance manual.
options.C: A CAP is an important document of the aircraft's continuous airworthiness procedure, which incorporates the supplementary part of the aircraft maintenance manual.

explanation: 【译文】CAP是对飞机维修手册的补充，维修手册是包含持续适航程序的基本文件。【词汇】CAP=持续适航方案、supplements=补充、primary document=基本文件、continuing airworthiness=持续适航。【解析】B正确：维修手册是fundamental document、CAP是supplement，关系与原文一致。A张冠李戴：把primary document说成CAP。C反写成“CAP incorporates the supplementary part”，主从颠倒。

question: The flight controls are divided into primary flight controls which control the aircraft around the three axes and secondary flight controls.

options.A: The flight controls are divided into primary flight controls and secondary flight controls, the primary flight controls control the aircraft around the three axes.
options.B: The flight controls are divided into primary flight controls and secondary flight controls, these controls control the aircraft around the three axes.
options.C: The flight controls control the aircraft around the three axes, while the primary flight controls control the secondary flight controls.

explanation: 【译文】飞行操纵装置分为控制飞机绕三轴的主操纵装置和辅助操纵装置。【词汇】primary flight controls=主飞行操纵装置、secondary=辅助的、the three axes=三轴、divided into=分为。【解析】A正确：保留两分结构，且明确“the primary flight controls control...three axes”，定语归属清楚。B：these controls指代不明。C错成“主操纵装置控制辅助操纵装置”，逻辑错误。

question: The Objectives Statement contains the information that the relationship of the CAP to existing inspection programs and the manufacturer's objectives for the CAP.

options.A: The relationship of manufacturer to existing inspection programs is included in the CAP Objectives Statement, as well as information on expectations of CAP's objectives.
options.B: The Objectives Statement covers CAP's relationship to existing inspection projects, as well as information of manufacturer's target about the CAP.
options.C: The manufacturer's Objectives Statement includes information about the CAP's relationship to existing inspection programs and goals for the CAP.

explanation: 【译文】目标声明包含CAP与现行检查方案的关系以及制造商对CAP的目标。【词汇】Objectives Statement=目标声明、relationship to=与…的关系、existing inspection programs=现行检查方案。【解析】C正确：CAP's relationship to existing inspection programs与goals for the CAP两要素齐全。A张冠李戴：错成“制造商与检查方案的关系”。B把programs错为projects，表述松散。

question: It describes items which are standard and explains their function and how they are operated.

options.A: The items described, their function explained and how they are operated must be standard.
options.B: It describes definition of standard items and explains their function and how they are operated.
options.C: Standard items, including their function and how they are operated are introduced.

explanation: 【译文】它描述哪些项目是标准的，并说明其功能及操作方式。【词汇】items which are standard=标准项目、function=功能、how they are operated=操作方式。【解析】C正确：Standard items加function与how operated三要素完整，introduced对应describes/explains。A语法杂糅，把standard错套到所有要素上。B错把“标准项目”改成“definition of standard items（标准项目的定义）”，无中生有。

question: This portion of the system is used to conduct power from the engine to the gearbox.

options.A: Power from the engine to the gearbox is transferred by this part of the system.
options.B: Electrical power is supplied from the engine to the gearbox using this part of the system.
options.C: Power from the engine to the gearbox is generated by this portion of the system.

explanation: 【译文】系统的这一部分用于把动力从发动机传递到齿轮箱。【词汇】conduct power=传送动力、from the engine to the gearbox=从发动机到齿轮箱、portion of the system=系统的该部分。【解析】A正确：conduct→transferred（传递），“by this part of the system”被动改写等价，动力流向正确。B擅自把power限定为Electrical power（电功率），动力可能是机械轴功率，范围错误。C把conduct（传导）错译为generated（产生），传递变产生，词义错译。

question: The purpose of the APU is to generate and supply a single type or combination of auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.

options.A: The APU is designed to generate and supply one or some of the following power: auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.
options.B: The purpose of the APU is to produce and distribute one or more auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power.
options.C: Auxiliary electric, hydraulic, pneumatic or other power can be generated and supplied by one or several APUs.

explanation: 【译文】APU的用途是产生并提供单一或组合的辅助电力、液压、气压等动力。【词汇】APU=辅助动力装置、a single type or combination=单一类型或组合、auxiliary power=辅助动力。【解析】A正确：one or some of the following power对应a single type or combination，四类动力齐全。B的one or more与distribute欠贴切，易生歧义。C错把“动力组合”译成“one or several APUs（多台APU）”，张冠李戴。

question: Air supply system is used for pressurizing supply tanks to insure fluid flow.

options.A: Air supply system provides pressurized air to the supply tanks so that they will maintain a positive supply of fluid flow.
options.B: The pneumatic system is used for increasing the pressure in the supply tanks to make the hydraulic fluid flow.
options.C: The engine/APU bleed air or external ground air is the main source to pressurize supply tanks to provide a positive supply of fluid to the pumps.

explanation: 【译文】供气系统用于向供给油箱增压以保证流体流动。【词汇】air supply system=供气系统、pressurizing=增压、supply tanks=供给油箱、insure fluid flow=保证流体流动。【解析】A正确：provides pressurized air对应pressurizing，maintain a positive supply对应insure fluid flow。B的hydraulic fluid擅自限定流体，范围错误。C添加“发动机/APU引气或地面气源”等原文没有的信息，无中生有。

question: Unless the manufacturer's instructions tell you differently, do the procedure that follows.

options.A: No matter what the manufacturer's instructions are, perform the following procedure.
options.B: If there are same instructions with the manufacturer, perform the following procedure.
options.C: If there are different instructions from the manufacturer,  the following procedure cannot be done.

explanation: 【译文】除非制造商说明另有指示，否则执行以下程序。【词汇】unless=除非、instructions=说明、tell you differently=另有指示、the procedure that follows=随后的程序。【解析】C正确：逆否等价——“若制造商有不同说明则不做该程序”，与“除非另有说明否则照做”逻辑一致。A：No matter what丢失排除条件。B：“若说明相同才执行”逻辑颠倒。

question: This torque shaft can not move inboard. Thus, before you move it, remove the outboard torque shaft.

options.A: Before removing the outboard torque shaft, this torque shaft can move inboard.
options.B: If you remove the outboard torque shaft first, this torque shaft can move inborad.
options.C: After this torque shaft moves inboard, remove the outboard torque shaft.

explanation: 【译文】这根扭力轴不能内移，因此移动它之前先拆外侧扭力轴。【词汇】torque shaft=扭力轴、move inboard=向内移动、outboard=外侧、thus=因此。【解析】B正确：先拆外侧轴→该轴才能内移，条件顺序与原文一致。A：“拆之前就能内移”与原意相反。C：“内移后再拆外侧轴”顺序颠倒。

question: Examine the area that is around the drain holes for signs of corrosion.

options.A: Perform check to see if there are traces of corrosion around the drain holes.
options.B: Check the drain holes for signs of corrosion.
options.C: Check the area surrounding the drain holes for signs of contamination.

explanation: 【译文】检查排放孔周围区域是否有腐蚀迹象。【词汇】examine=检查、the area around the drain holes=排放孔周围区域、signs of corrosion=腐蚀迹象。【解析】A正确：“traces of corrosion around the drain holes”对应signs of corrosion和area around，检查对象是孔周围区域而非孔本身。B错把检查对象缩为“the drain holes”本身，漏掉“周围区域”（范围错误）。C把corrosion（腐蚀）错译为contamination（污染），检查内容张冠李戴。

question: Make sure that the fuel load is equal on each side of the aircraft centerline.

options.A: There is different fuel load on each side of the aircraft centerline.
options.B: Avoid different fuel load on each side of the aircraft centerline.
options.C: Make sure that the fuel load on left side of the aircraft centerline is not same with the one on right side.

explanation: 【译文】确保飞机中心线两侧的燃油载量相等。【词汇】fuel load=燃油载量、each side of the aircraft centerline=飞机中心线两侧、equal=相等。【解析】B正确：“Avoid different fuel load on each side”（避免两侧油量不同）以否定形式等价表达“确保两侧相等”，语义对应。A“There is different fuel load”变成陈述两侧油量不同，失去“确保相等”的指令性且方向相反。C“is not same with the one on right side”错改成左右侧不相等，与原意相反。

question: If you accidentally spray rain repellent fluid onto a dry windshield, remove the fluid with a solvent.

options.A: Ignore it if you spray rain repellent fluid onto a dry windshield intentionally.
options.B: Before spraying rain repellent fluid onto a clean windshield, use a solvent to remove it.
options.C: Use a solvent to remove the fluid if you spray rain repellent fluid onto a dry windshield unexpectedly.

explanation: 【译文】若不慎把防雨液喷到干燥风挡上，用溶剂清除该液体。【词汇】accidentally=意外地、rain repellent fluid=防雨液、dry windshield=干燥风挡、solvent=溶剂。【解析】C正确：unexpectedly对应accidentally，solvent用法对应。A：intentionally（故意）与Ignore（不理会）两错。B错成“喷之前用溶剂”，时间顺序错。

question: Chemical oxygen-generating systems require less space and weigh less than gaseous oxygen systems supplying the same number of people.

options.A: Gaseous oxygen systems have lighter weight and bigger size than chemical-generating systems when supplying air to the same number of people.
options.B: When providing oxygen to the same number of people, compared with the gaseous oxygen systems, chemical oxygen-generating systems need less space and have lighter weight.
options.C: Comparing with the chemical oxygen-generating systems when providing oxygen to the same amount of people, the gaseous oxygen systems are lighter and smaller.

explanation: 【译文】供同等人数使用时，化学制氧系统比气态氧系统占地更小、重量更轻。【词汇】chemical oxygen-generating systems=化学制氧系统、gaseous oxygen systems=气态氧系统、require less space and weigh less=更小更轻。【解析】B正确：chemical systems need less space and lighter weight比较方向与原文一致。A：气态系统说成lighter（更轻），方向相反。C：gaseous are lighter and smaller，比较对象结论全颠倒。

question: In some cases, cleaning the connectors or replacing the IDG appears to correct the problem, but the messages recur after some time.

options.A: In certain circumstances, cleaning the connector or replacing the IDG seems to solve the problem, but the messages will appear again later.
options.B: Sometimes, cleaning the connector or replacing the IDG seems to settle the problem, but the message will reappear occasionally.
options.C: Sometimes, sterilizing the connector or renewing the IDG seems to resolve the problem, but the message will occur later.

explanation: 【译文】某些情况下清洁接头或换IDG看似解决问题，但一段时间后信息会再次出现。【词汇】connectors=接头、IDG=整体驱动发电机、appears to correct=看似解决、recur=再次出现。【解析】A正确：seems to solve对应appears to correct，appear again later对应recur after some time。B的occasionally把“过段时间复发”改成“偶尔复发”，频率走偏。C：sterilizing（消毒）错译cleaning，occur漏“再次”。

question: Enter the entry/exit corridor only when the engine is at idle and you have positive communication with the flight compartment.

options.A: Only when the engine is at idle speed and has active communication with the flight cabin, can you enter and exit the corridor.
options.B: Only when the engine is running at idle speed and you have good contact with the cockpit, can you enter the access corridor.
options.C: Enter / exit the corridor only when the engine is at idle state and in good contact with the cabin.

explanation: 【译文】只有发动机慢车且与驾驶舱建立可靠通信联络时，才能进入进出通道。【词汇】at idle=慢车、positive communication=可靠联络、flight compartment=驾驶舱、corridor=通道。【解析】B正确：Only when...can you enter对应only when强调，good contact with the cockpit对应positive communication with the flight compartment。A：enter and exit把“进入通道”误为“进出动作”，active略逊于positive。C漏you have主体，cabin（客舱）错译flight compartment。

question: The maintenance manual shall provide the location and pictorial illustrations of each placard stencil or marking indicating those which are required by the minimum equipment list.

options.A: The maintenance manual shall furnish the position and picture description of each identification plate or indicate what is required by the minimum equipment list.
options.B: The maintenance manual shall provide the location and picture description of each placard or indicate what are required by the minimum equipment list.
options.C: The maintenance manual shall provide a description of the location and picture of each sign template, or indicate the equipment which is described in the minimum equipment list.

explanation: 【译文】维修手册应提供每块标牌、模板或标记的位置和图示，注明最低设备清单所要求者。【词汇】placard=标牌、stencil=模板、marking=标记、minimum equipment list=最低设备清单（MEL）。【解析】A最佳：identification plate对应placard，position and picture description对应location and pictorial illustrations，required by the MEL保留。B漏stencil/marking（漏译要素）。C把required by错成described in the MEL。

question: Overhaul of any or all components in this chapter must be accomplished in a qualified shop in accordance with data supplied by the component manufacturer.

options.A: The modification of any or all parts in this chapter must be performed in a qualified workshop in accordance with the data provided by the component manufacturer.
options.B: The maintenance of any or all components in this chapter must be done in a qualified workshop in accordance with data provided by the component manufacturer.
options.C: According to the data provided by the component manufacturer, the heavy repair of any or all components in this chapter must be completed in a qualified workshop.

explanation: 【译文】本章任何或所有部件的大修必须按部件制造商资料在合格车间完成。【词汇】overhaul=大修、qualified shop=合格车间、in accordance with=按照。【解析】C正确：heavy repair对应Overhaul，data provided by the component manufacturer与qualified workshop对应。A：Overhaul错为modification（改装）。B：弱化为maintenance（一般维修），大修级别丢失。

question: The Fault Isolation Manual is furnished either as a printed manual or as digital products, or a combination of the two.

options.A: The Fault Isolation Manual is provided neither as a printed manual nor as digital products, or a combination of these two.
options.B: The Fault Isolation Manual can be either a printed handbook or digital products, or a combination of both.
options.C: The Fault Isolation Manual  furnishes a printed handbook ,or a digital product, or a combination of these two.

explanation: 【译文】故障隔离手册可以印刷版、数字产品或两者结合形式提供。【词汇】Fault Isolation Manual=故障隔离手册、furnished=提供、either...or...=或者…或者、combination=结合。【解析】B正确：can be either...or...or both完整保留选择结构。A：neither...nor全部否定，方向相反。C：主谓搭配错（FIM furnishes a handbook使手册成提供方），且丢either...or。

question: Tank unit capacitance varies as a function of the fuel level in the tank.

options.A: Tank unit capacitance changes with the fuel level in the tank.
options.B: Tank unit capacitance changes the function of the fuel level in the tank.
options.C: A function of the fuel level in the tank is varied by tank unit capacitance.

explanation: 【译文】油箱组件的电容随油箱内燃油液面高度而变化。【词汇】tank unit capacitance=油箱组件电容、varies=变化、as a function of=作为…的函数/随…而变、fuel level=燃油液面。【解析】A正确：“changes with the fuel level”对应varies as a function of the fuel level，主被动关系正确。B“changes the function of the fuel level”变成“电容改变液面的功能”，主宾错位且语义荒谬。C把因果颠倒成“液面的函数被电容改变”，原文是电容随液面变化（方向相反）。

question: If you do not safety the door, it is possible that strong winds will cause damage to the structure.

options.A: If you do not safety the door, there is hardly a risk that strong winds will cause damage to the structure.
options.B: If you don't secure the door, strong winds are likely to cause damage to the structure.
options.C: If you do not close the door, strong winds are sure to damage the structure.

explanation: 【译文】若不锁固舱门，强风有可能损坏结构。【词汇】safety（动词）=锁固、secure=锁紧、it is possible=有可能、cause damage=造成损坏。【解析】B正确：secure the door对应safety the door，are likely to对应it is possible that。A：hardly a risk（几乎无风险）相反。C：safety错成close（关闭），possible错成sure to（肯定），两错。

question: The fuel quantity processor unit sends excitation to and receives signals from the tank units and the compensators.

options.A: The fuel quantity processor unit sends excitation to the tank units and the compensators. The excitation receives signals from these tank units and these compensators.
options.B: The fuel quantity processor unit sends excitation to the tank units and the compensators. The fuel quantity processor unit receives signals from these tank units and these compensators.
options.C: The fuel quantity processor unit sends excitation to the tank units and the compensators. These tank units and these compensators receives signals from the fuel quantity processor unit.

explanation: 【译文】燃油油量处理组件向油箱组件和补偿器发送激励并接收其信号。【词汇】processor unit=处理组件、excitation=激励信号、tank units=油箱组件、compensators=补偿器。【解析】B正确：收发主体都是processor unit——发excitation、收signals，与sends...and receives等价。A错把接收主语写成The excitation，张冠李戴。C方向反：油箱组件接收来自处理器的信号。

question: It is comprised of turbine, compressor and fan which are connected by a common shaft.

options.A: It is made up of a turbine, a compressor and a fan. The compressor and the fan are connected by a common shaft.
options.B: It consists of a turbine. The compressor and the fan are connected by a common shaft.
options.C: It consists of a turbine, a compressor and a fan. The turbine, the compressor and the fan are connected by a common shaft.

explanation: 【译文】它由涡轮、压气机和风扇组成，三者由一根共用轴连接。【词汇】is comprised of=由…组成、turbine=涡轮、compressor=压气机、fan=风扇、common shaft=共用轴。【解析】C正确：“consists of a turbine, a compressor and a fan”对应is comprised of turbine, compressor and fan，且明确三者都由common shaft连接，which从句的指代范围还原准确。A把连接范围缩成“compressor and the fan”，漏掉turbine（漏译要素）。B只保留“a turbine”，把compressor和fan拆出组成关系，结构错译。

question: When the smoke control relay R648 energizes, it supplies 28v dc to energize the supply system control interrupt relay R645.

options.A: When the smoke control relay R648 is powered, it gives 28v dc to activate the supply system control interrupt relay R645 .
options.B: As the smoke control relay R648 is connected, 28v dc is supplied to the supply system control interrupt relay R645.
options.C: When the smoke control relay R648 has power, it needs 28v dc to start the supply system control interrupt relay R645.

explanation: 【译文】当烟雾控制继电器R648通电时，它向供给系统控制中断继电器R645提供28V直流电使其通电。【词汇】relay=继电器、energizes=通电/励磁、supplies 28v dc=提供28伏直流电、interrupt relay=中断继电器。【解析】A正确：“is powered”对应energizes，“gives 28v dc to activate”对应supplies 28v dc to energize，供电—通电的因果链完整。B把energizes错译为is connected（被接通线路），供电励磁变成物理连接，词义错译。C把“supplies 28v dc”错改为“needs 28v dc（需要28V）”，供出变需求，方向相反。

question: Do not use a material that is not equivalent to the material specified by the manufacture, a material that is not equivalent can cause damage to the equipment and can make the warranty not applicable.

options.A: Do not use a material that is not the same to the material specified by the manufacture, a different material can cause damage to the equipment and can make the warranty unable to be applied.
options.B: Do not use a material that is not similar to the material provided by the manufacture, a material that is not similar can cause damage to the equipment and can make the warranty cancelled.
options.C: Use a material that has equivalency with the material specified by the manufacture, other material can cause damage to the equipment and can make the warranty not effective.

explanation: 【译文】勿用与制造商规定材料不等效的材料，否则可能损坏设备并使保修失效。【词汇】equivalent to=与…等效、specified=规定的、warranty not applicable=保修失效。【解析】A正确：not the same to对应not equivalent to，warranty unable to be applied对应not applicable。B：equivalent错为similar（相似），not applicable错为cancelled。C改写成肯定句“用等效材料”，other material指代含混，丢失禁令语气。

question: When you push the FAULT/INOP test switch, faults are simulated to do a check of the circuit ability to detect a fault.

options.A: When you push the FAULT/INOP test switch, faults are emulated to do a check of the circuit to see if it has ability to detect a fault.
options.B: Faults are similar when doing a check of the circuit ability to correct a fault When you push the FAULT/INOP test switch.
options.C: When pushing the FAULT/INOP test switch, faults are shown so that we can check the circuit ability to eliminate a fault.

explanation: 【译文】按FAULT/INOP测试电门时模拟故障，以检查电路检测故障的能力。【词汇】simulated=模拟、circuit ability=电路能力、detect a fault=检测故障。【解析】A正确：emulated对应simulated，see if it has ability to detect对应check the ability to detect。B：simulated错成similar，detect错成correct（纠正）。C：shown错译simulated，eliminate错译detect，两错。

question: At the fire temperature set point, the gas expands more to close the FIRE pressure switch in the detector. This decreases the resistance further.

options.A: Set a point at the fire temperature ,the gas grows larger to close the FIRE pressure switch in the detector. This influences the resistance longer.
options.B: When the fire temperature is set at the point, the gas extends more to shut the FIRE pressure switch in the detector. This abates the further resistance.
options.C: At the fire temperature set point, the gas inflates further so as to close the FIRE pressure switch in the detector. This diminishes the resistance moreover.

explanation: 【译文】在火警温度设定点，气体进一步膨胀使探测器FIRE压力电门闭合，电阻进一步减小。【词汇】set point=设定点、expands=膨胀、pressure switch=压力电门、decreases the resistance=减小电阻。【解析】C相对最佳：inflates对应expands，close the FIRE pressure switch与diminishes the resistance对应（moreover不及further但减阻义保留）。A把set point错成祈使句Set a point，resistance longer走样。B：is set at the point误为被动设置；abates the further resistance结构错译。

question: Push the interrupt switch to stop all indications except for the red alarm LED on the smoke sensor. The alarm LED will go out when the smoke sensor no longer detects smoke.

options.A: Push the interrupt switch to stop all indications besides the red alarm LED on the smoke sensor. The alarm LED will light up when the smoke sensor doesn't detect longer smoke.
options.B: Push the interrupt switch to stop all indications but the red alarm LED on the smoke sensor. The alarm LED will go off when the smoke sensor  detects no more smoke.
options.C: Push the interrupt switch to stop all displays in addition to the red alarm LED on the smoke sensor. The alarm LED will go on when the smoke sensor no longer detects smoke.

explanation: 【译文】按中断电门停止烟雾传感器上除红色报警LED外所有指示，传感器不再探到烟雾时LED熄灭。【词汇】interrupt switch=中断电门、except for=除…外、alarm LED=报警LED、go out=熄灭。【解析】B正确：but对应except for，go off对应go out，detects no more smoke对应no longer detects。A：light up与go out相反。C：go on（点亮）同样相反。

question: When the hatch is closed, there is no airflow to the compartment and there is a risk of suffocation.

options.A: The closed door prevents airflow from entering the compartment and may cause death because of no air to breathe.
options.B: When the access plate is closed, the lack of ventilation of the compartment brings a risk of suffering injury.
options.C: If you close the opening, the airflow can not enter into the compartment and creates a risk of jam.

explanation: 【译文】舱口关闭时舱内无气流，存在窒息风险。【词汇】hatch=舱口、airflow=气流、compartment=舱、risk of suffocation=窒息风险。【解析】A正确：closed door prevents airflow对应无气流，death because of no air to breathe把suffocation释义化。B：suffocation弱化为injury，hatch错成access plate。C：suffocation错成a risk of jam（卡住），后果全错。

question: Before flight operations over water at low altitudes, apply corrosion-preventive fluid to the door hinges of the landing gear.

options.A: Scrape corrosion-protective liquid of the door connections of the landing gear earlier than the flight procedures of low water level.
options.B: Apply anti-corrosion fluid to the door hinges of the landing gear prior to flight operation above water at low altitude.
options.C: Solidify corrosion inhibitor on the door hinges of the landing gear in advance of flying across the low water.

explanation: 【译文】低空水上飞行运行前，对着落架舱门铰链涂防腐液。【词汇】corrosion-preventive fluid=防腐液、door hinges=舱门铰链、landing gear=起落架、over water at low altitudes=低空水上。【解析】B正确：anti-corrosion fluid对应corrosion-preventive，prior to对应Before，部位与条件全对。A：apply错成Scrape（刮除）。C：apply错成Solidify（固化）。

question: If fuel or lubricating oil spills, clean the area immediately. A wet surface is dangerous and can cause you to fall.

options.A: When fuel or lubricating oil overflows, clean the area at once. There exists a danger due to the wet surface that can cause falling.
options.B: Clean the area where fuel or lubricating oil are knocked over without delay because the wet surface that may lead to the fall is dangerous.
options.C: The area contaminated by fuel or lubricating oil shall be cleared up firstly because the dirty surface brings a risk of fall.

explanation: 【译文】燃油或滑油溅洒时立即清洁该区域，湿滑地面危险易致摔倒。【词汇】spills=溅洒、immediately=立即、wet surface=湿滑地面、cause you to fall=致摔倒。【解析】A正确：overflows对应spills，at once对应immediately，danger/wet surface/falling对应。B揉成一句且knocked over误“溅洒”为“被打翻”。C：immediately错为firstly，wet错为dirty。

question: The resistance of the fuel temperature bulb on the rear spar on main tank No.1 changes with fuel temperature.

options.A: The fuel temperature bulb on the rear spar on the main tank No.1 resists the change of fuel temperature .
options.B: The fuel temperature bulb is on the rear spar on main tank No.1. Its resistance varies with fuel temperature.
options.C: Resistance to the change of fuel temperature is done by the fuel temperature bulb, which is located on the rear spar on main tank No.1.

explanation: 【译文】1号主油箱后梁上的燃油温度感温包电阻随燃油温度变化。【词汇】resistance=电阻、temperature bulb=感温包、rear spar=后梁、changes with=随…变化。【解析】B正确：先定位rear spar on main tank No.1，再述resistance varies with fuel temperature，定语与随变关系准确。A把名词resistance误用为动词resists（抵抗）。C错读为“Resistance to the change（对变化的抵抗）”，方向相反。

question: This method is recommended as minimizing errors of distribution, and also informs owner of the availability of systems and equipment.

options.A: This proposed method is to reduce the errors of distribution to the lowest possible level. It also let the owner know that the systems and equipment are available.
options.B: In order to decrease the distribution errors, this way is mandatory to tell the owner about the status of systems and equipment.
options.C: Because the errors of distribution is minimum, this method is used to notify the owner to get the systems and equipment.

explanation: 【译文】建议采用此方法：能把分配误差降到最低，并告知所有人系统设备的可用情况。【词汇】recommended=建议、minimizing errors=误差降到最小、informs owner of=告知所有人、availability=可用性。【解析】A正确：reduce...to the lowest level对应minimizing，let the owner know...available对应informs of availability。B：recommended错为mandatory（强制）。C因果倒置：“因为误差最小”，且曲解availability。

question: The Design Authority must give approval to changes that you make to the repair scheme.

options.A: Any changes made to the repair scheme by the Design Authority must be approved.
options.B: The Design Authority must approve any revisions you make to the repair scheme.
options.C: Should any changes be made, the approval must be granted by the Design Authority to the repair shceme.

explanation: 【译文】设计批准当局必须批准你对修理方案所做的更改。【词汇】Design Authority=设计批准当局、give approval to=批准、changes you make=你所做的更改、repair scheme=修理方案。【解析】B正确：approve any revisions you make to the repair scheme主谓宾全对应。A：you make错成made by the Design Authority，主体张冠李戴。C：granted...to the repair scheme语法杂糅且丢you make。

question: The configuration of the inserts is related to the dimensions of the connector shell.

options.A: The way of arranging the inserts is uncorrelated to  the dimensions of the connector shell.
options.B: The dimensions of the connector shell is determined by the arrangement of the inserts.
options.C: The arrangement of the inserts is related to the dimensions of the connector shell.

explanation: 【译文】插件的构型与连接器外壳的尺寸相关。【词汇】configuration=构型/布置、inserts=插件/嵌件、connector shell=连接器外壳、is related to=与…相关。【解析】C正确：“The arrangement of the inserts”对应configuration of the inserts，“is related to the dimensions of the connector shell”原样对应，相关关系方向中性准确。A“uncorrelated（不相关）”与原文相反（方向相反）。B“the dimensions...is determined by the arrangement”把“相关”强化为单向的“决定”关系，程度错误。

question: You must have the aid of one more person for the step that follows.

options.A: You must have the assistance of another person for the following step.
options.B: You must seek for help at this step, but not necessary for the following procedure.
options.C: One person is sufficient for the following step.

explanation: 【译文】进行下一步时你必须再有一人协助。【词汇】the aid of one more person=再一个人的帮助、the step that follows=随后的步骤、must=必须。【解析】A正确：“the assistance of another person”对应the aid of one more person，“for the following step”对应for the step that follows，要素全对。B把意思改成“本步骤求助、后续步骤不必”，把需要帮助的对象步骤弄反（张冠李戴）。C“One person is sufficient（一人足够）”与“还需一人”相反。

question: If it is possible that the temperature values will be more than the permitted limits, decrease the power.

options.A: Once the power is decreased, increase the temperature to the permitted limits.
options.B: If it appears that the temperature limits will be exceeded, decrease the power.
options.C: The temperature limits should not be exceeded, otherwise you have to boost the power.

explanation: 【译文】若温度值可能超过允许极限，就减小功率。【词汇】it is possible=有可能、permitted limits=允许极限、decrease the power=减小功率。【解析】B正确：limits will be exceeded对应values more than the limits，decrease the power保留。A因果颠倒成“降功率后升温”。C：boost the power与decrease相反。

question: To make pin removal easier, manually turn the canopy in one direction and then in the other.

options.A: To facilitate pin removal, manually turn the canopy alternately in the two directions.
options.B: It is easier to manually turn the canopy in either direction during the removal of the pin.
options.C: The removal of the pin could be easier by turning the canopy by hand in either direction.

explanation: 【译文】为便于拔销，先手动把座舱盖朝一个方向转再朝另一方向转。【词汇】pin removal=拔销、canopy=座舱盖、in one direction and then in the other=先一向再另一向。【解析】A正确：facilitate对应make easier，alternately in the two directions准确概括交替转动。B：in either direction（任一方向）丢交替义，during the removal把目的改成时间。C同样错用either direction。

question: Refer to detail C on Fig. 4 for a different procedure to attach the cable.

options.A: The procedure of attaching the cable is different from that in detail C on Fig. 4.
options.B: See detail C on Fig. 4 for another way of attaching the cable.
options.C: You can find a different diagram of the cable in detail C on Fig. 4.

explanation: 【译文】另一种连接钢索的程序参见图4详图C。【词汇】refer to=参见、detail C=详图C、a different procedure=另一种程序、attach the cable=连接钢索。【解析】B正确：See detail C对应Refer to，another way of attaching对应a different procedure to attach。A错成“程序与详图C不同”，结构错译。C：procedure错为diagram（图纸）。

question: Let the temperature of the component decrease until it is the same as the ambient temperature.

options.A: Do not increase the temperature of the component until it is the same as the air.
options.B: If the component is of the same temperature as the ambient, lower its temperature.
options.C: Let the temperature of the component cool to ambient.

explanation: 【译文】让部件的温度下降，直到与环境温度相同。【词汇】decrease=下降、ambient temperature=环境温度、until it is the same as=直到与…相同、component=部件。【解析】C正确：“cool to ambient”简洁准确地对应“decrease until it is the same as the ambient temperature”（降到环境温度为止）。A错把“让温度下降”改成“Do not increase（不要升温）”，动作指令不同，且“same as the air”用air代ambient欠准确。B逻辑相反：“若部件已与环境同温则降温”与原句“降到与环境同温为止”的条件关系错位。

question: Make sure that the position of the clamp agrees with the position that you recorded during the removal procedure.

options.A: Be sure that the clamp is positioned together with those you removed.
options.B: Make sure that the position of the clamp corresponds to the position recorded during the removal procedure.
options.C: The position of the clamp should be aligned with the position of the clamp that you removed.

explanation: 【译文】确保卡箍位置与拆卸程序中记录的位置一致。【词汇】clamp=卡箍、agrees with=与…一致、recorded=记录的、removal procedure=拆卸程序。【解析】B正确：corresponds to对应agrees with，position recorded during the removal procedure逐词对应。A：recorded错成removed，变成“与被拆件放一起”。C同样误recorded为removed（the clamp that you removed），错上加错。

question: If your decision is not to replace the unit, monitor its temperature for a minimum of 15 cycles.

options.A: If the unit is unchanged, it is necessary to monitor the ambient temperature for at least 15 cycles.
options.B: Keep monitoring the temperature of the unit for a minimum of 15 cycles until you install a new one.
options.C: If the unit remains unchanged, its temperature should be checked for at least 15 cycles.

explanation: 【译文】若决定不更换组件，至少15个循环监测其温度。【词汇】decision is not to replace=决定不更换、monitor=监测、a minimum of 15 cycles=至少15循环。【解析】C正确：remains unchanged对应not replace，checked for at least 15 cycles对应monitor...15 cycles。A：监测对象错成ambient temperature。B错加until you install a new one，无中生有。

question: If you accidentally spray rain repellent fluid onto a dry windshield, remove the fluid with a solvent.

options.A: The rain repellent fluid should be used to wipe off the solvent accidentally sprayed onto the dry windshield.
options.B: If rain repellent fluid is unintentionally sprayed onto a dry windshield, remove it using solvent.
options.C: You should use a solvent to remove any rain repellent fluid which is applied on the dry windshield on purpose.

explanation: 【译文】若不慎把防雨液喷到干燥风挡上，用溶剂清除。【词汇】accidentally=不慎、rain repellent fluid=防雨液、unintentionally=非故意地、solvent=溶剂。【解析】B正确：unintentionally sprayed对应accidentally spray，remove it using solvent对应remove with a solvent。A：溶剂与防雨液角色互换（张冠李戴）。C：accidentally错成on purpose（故意），方向相反。

question: The dictionary includes some unapproved words that can be technical verbs if you can put them in the specified categories.

options.A: In the dictionary, there are some unapproved technical verbs which are listed in the specified categories.
options.B: You can specifically categorize those unapproved words in  the dictionary as technical verbs.
options.C: Some unapproved words in the dictionary can be technical verbs if they are put in the specified categories.

explanation: 【译文】词典收录的某些未获准词，若能归入规定类别可用作技术动词。【词汇】unapproved words=未获准词、technical verbs=技术动词、specified categories=规定类别。【解析】C正确：can be technical verbs if they are put in the specified categories条件完整。A丢条件：误为“已列为技术动词的未获准词”。B把被动条件改成主动归类行为，语义偏离。

question: Complex sentence structure and the large number of meanings and synonyms that many English words have can cause confusion.

options.A: Confusion may occur due to the large quantity of meanings and synonyms of English words  as well as complex sentence structure.
options.B: The large number of meanings and synonyms of English words can cause confusion, while common sentence structure cannot.
options.C: Many English words have complex sentence structure, different meanings and synonyms, which can cause confusion.

explanation: 【译文】复杂句型及许多英语词的大量含义和同义词可能造成混乱。【词汇】complex sentence structure=复杂句型、meanings and synonyms=含义与同义词、cause confusion=造成混乱。【解析】A正确：两个致乱因素（多义/同义词＋复杂句型）齐全。B错加“common sentence structure cannot”，无中生有。C把复杂句型归到English words名下，搭配错误。

question: However, any repair should be made in such a way that, based upon data provided by Stress Analysis Manual, sufficient static strength is maintained .

options.A: However, any repair should be made in accordance with the data given in Stress Analysis Manual to maintain sufficient static strength.
options.B: However, in order to make repairs, you should consult Stress Analysis Manual for the data about appropriate static strength.
options.C: However, critical static strength can be sustained even though the repairs disagree with the data given in Stress Analysis Manual.

explanation: 【译文】但任何修理都应基于应力分析手册的数据进行，以保持足够静强度。【词汇】Stress Analysis Manual=应力分析手册、sufficient static strength=足够静强度、based upon=基于。【解析】A正确：in accordance with the data对应based upon data，to maintain static strength对应strength is maintained。B弱化为“查手册取数据”，丢失保持静强度的要求。C：repairs disagree with the data与原意相反。

question: Inspection and modification per this bulletin will reduce the possibility of stress corrosion cracks which would require replacement of the stabilizer center section front spar.

options.A: This bulletin should be followed to inspect and modify the stress corrosion cracks which is caused by replacing the stabilizer center section front spar.
options.B: The stabilizer center section front spar would be replaced due to the stress corrosion cracks. However, if the spar is inspected and modified per this bulletin, the cracks will be reduced.
options.C: During inspection and modification per this bulletin, the stress corrosion cracks are found after replacement of the stabilizer center section front spar.

explanation: 【译文】按本通告检查改装将降低应力腐蚀裂纹的可能性，此类裂纹会要求更换安定面中段前梁。【词汇】per this bulletin=按本通告、stress corrosion cracks=应力腐蚀裂纹、front spar=前梁。【解析】B正确：cracks would require replacement展开为“裂纹导致换梁”，inspected and modified...cracks will be reduced对应reduce possibility。A因果颠倒：裂纹由换梁导致。C误为“换梁后发现裂纹”，时间逻辑全错。

question: The design authority must give approval to changes that you make to the repair scheme.

options.A: The design authority must approve any amendments you make to the repair scheme.
options.B: The design authority must approve any supports you make to the repair scheme.
options.C: The design authority must approve any amendments you make to the maintenance plan .

explanation: 【译文】设计批准当局必须批准你对修理方案所做的更改。【词汇】design authority=设计批准当局、give approval to=批准、changes=更改（amendments同义）、repair scheme=修理方案。【解析】A正确：“approve any amendments you make to the repair scheme”对应give approval to changes that you make to the repair scheme，amendments对应changes准确。B把changes错译为supports（支撑），词义错译。C把repair scheme错译为maintenance plan（维修计划），批准对象张冠李戴。

question: If it is possible that the temperature values will be more than the permitted limits, decrease the power, then apply the sealant with a wooden spatula.

options.A: If it is possible that the temperature values will be not less than the permitted limits, decrease the power, then the application of sealant must be carried out with a wooden spatula.
options.B: If it appears that the temperature limits will be exceeded, decrease the power, then the application of sealant must be carried out with a wooden spatula.
options.C: If it appears that the temperature limits will be decreased, increase the power,then the application of sealant must be carried out with a wooden spatula.

explanation: 【译文】若温度值可能超过允许极限，先降功率，再用木制刮刀涂密封剂。【词汇】permitted limits=允许极限、decrease the power=降功率、apply the sealant=涂密封剂、wooden spatula=木制刮刀。【解析】B正确：limits will be exceeded对应more than the limits，先降功率后涂胶顺序对。A：not less than（≥）与“超过”不等价（范围错误）。C：limits decreased、increase the power方向双反。

question: While you do each step of the valve test, make sure that there is no leakage. Calculate the quantity of fuel necessary.

options.A: As you do the valve test, make sure that there is no leakage. Release the quantity of fuel needed.
options.B: While you do each step of the valve test, make sure that there is no leakage. Concern the quantity of fuel necessary.
options.C: As you do the valve test, make sure that there is no leakage. Assess the quantity of fuel needed.

explanation: 【译文】活门测试每步进行时确保无渗漏，并计算所需燃油量。【词汇】each step=每一步、leakage=渗漏、calculate=计算、quantity of fuel=燃油量。【解析】C正确：no leakage对应无渗漏，Assess the quantity对应Calculate（估算义可接受）。A：Calculate错为Release（释放）。B：错为Concern（关注），计算动作漏译。

question: Apply two layers of protective compound to prevent hydraulic fluid damage to the sealant.

options.A: Apply two houses of protective compound to prevent hydraulic fluid from attacking the sealant.
options.B: Apply two coats of protective compound to prevent hydraulic fluid from attacking the sealant.
options.C: Apply two coats of protective compound to prevent hydraulic fluid from sealing the sealant.

explanation: 【译文】涂两层保护化合物防止液压油损伤密封剂。【词汇】layers/coats=层（涂层）、protective compound=保护化合物、damage to the sealant=损伤密封剂。【解析】B正确：coats对应layers，attacking对应damage。A：layers错写成houses（房屋）。C：damage错为sealing，“防液压油密封密封剂”不通。

question: A mixture of water and methanol increases the power of the engine. If the adjustment of the stops is not correct, the results of the test will not be accurate.

options.A: A mixture of water and methanol decreases the power of the engine. If the stops are not correctly adjusted, the results of the test will be wrong.
options.B: A mixture of water and methanol augments the power of the engine. If the stops are not correctly adjusted, the results of the test will not be authentic.
options.C: A mixture of water and methanol decreases the power of the engine. If the stops are not correctly adjusted, the results of the test will not be authentic.

explanation: 【译文】水-甲醇混合液可提高发动机功率；止动块调整不正确则测试结果不准。【词汇】mixture=混合液、methanol=甲醇、increases=提高、stops=止动块、accurate=准确。【解析】B正确：augments对应increases，not authentic对应not accurate。A：increases错为decreases，方向相反。C同样错成decreases。

question: Use the mark to help you put the clamp in its correct position.

options.A: The mark can be used to let you put the clamp in its right position.
options.B: The clamp can be used to let you set the mark in its correct position.
options.C: Put the mark in its correct position with the help of the clamp.

explanation: 【译文】利用该标记帮助你将卡箍装到正确位置。【词汇】mark=标记、clamp=卡箍、put...in its correct position=把…装到正确位置、help you=帮助你。【解析】A正确：“The mark can be used to let you put the clamp in its right position”对应use the mark to help you put the clamp，工具（mark）与对象（clamp）关系正确。B主客颠倒：“用卡箍来定标记位置”，工具与对象互换（张冠李戴）。C同样颠倒：“借助卡箍把标记放到位”，对象关系错误。

question: Use a drill bit that has a maximum length of 45 mm.

options.A: Keep the length of the drill bit at 45 mm maximum.
options.B: Use a drill bit so that its length does not become longer than 45 mm.
options.C: A drill bit can only be used if its length does not exceed 45 mm.

explanation: 【译文】使用最大长度45毫米的钻头。【词汇】drill bit=钻头、maximum length=最大长度、45 mm=45毫米。【解析】A最佳：Keep the length at 45 mm maximum直接对应a maximum length of 45 mm。B：does not become longer隐含“防止变长”的多余意味。C：can only be used if改成条件许可句式，偏离祈使指令。

question: Make sure that you remove all tools, equipment and loose objects from the air intake.

options.A: Make sure that all tools, equipment and loose objects are not installed on the air intake.
options.B: Make sure that you keep all tools, equipment and objects that are not fixed in place away from the air intake.
options.C: Make sure that you remove all tools and equipment, and you loosen objects from the air intake.

explanation: 【译文】确保从进气道移走所有工具、设备和松散物品。【词汇】remove from=从…移走、air intake=进气道、loose objects=松散物品。【解析】B正确：keep...away from对应remove from，objects not fixed in place释义loose objects。A错成“未安装在进气道上”，动作错位。C把loose（松动的）误读为动词loosen（松开），词性误读。

question: The primary cause of valve failure is contamination of the hydraulic fluid.

options.A: Hydraulic fluid contamination is the major contributor for the valve failure.
options.B: The failure of the valve is unrelated to the contamination of the hydraulic fluid.
options.C: The failure of the valve causes the contamination of the hydraulic fluid.

explanation: 【译文】活门失效的主要原因是液压油污染。【词汇】primary cause=主要原因、valve failure=活门失效、contamination of the hydraulic fluid=液压油污染。【解析】A正确：“Hydraulic fluid contamination is the major contributor for the valve failure”因果方向与原文一致，major contributor对应primary cause。B“unrelated to（无关）”与“主要原因”相反（方向相反）。C“The failure...causes the contamination”因果倒置，污染是原因而非结果。

question: If the warning light is on when the door is closed, the microswitch is incorrectly adjusted.

options.A: Adjust the microswitch correctly if the warning light comes on when the door is closed.
options.B: If the microswitch is adjusted right, the warning light will be on when the door is closed.
options.C: The microswitch, if not adjusted right, will cause the warning light to come on when the door is closed.

explanation: 【译文】若舱门关闭时警告灯亮，说明微动电门调整不正确。【词汇】warning light=警告灯、microswitch=微动电门、incorrectly adjusted=调整不正确。【解析】C正确：if not adjusted right, will cause the warning light因果表述与“灯亮说明调整不对”逻辑等价。A改成操作指令Adjust correctly，句类偏离。B：“调整正确灯就亮”方向相反。

question: If the format parameter or rule is inappropriate to the type of airplane, equivalents likely to achieve the same objective may be used.

options.A: In the event of unappropriated format parameter or rule for the aircraft type, we may use the same format to get the equal object.
options.B: If the format parameter or rule is not appropriate for the aircraft type, an equivalent format that may achieve the same purpose maybe used.
options.C: While the airplane model is not suitable to the parameter or rule of the form, an  additional option may be used to gain the same goals.

explanation: 【译文】若格式参数或规则不适用于该机型，可用能达到同样目的的等效形式。【词汇】inappropriate=不适当、equivalents=等效形式、achieve the same objective=达到同样目的。【解析】B正确：not appropriate对应inappropriate，an equivalent format对应equivalents。A：unappropriated错词，same format错成“相同格式”。C：equivalents错为additional option（额外选项）。

question: Except when inapplicable or inappropriate to the particular airplane model, handbooks shall contain the recommended normal procedures for the following phases of flight, in the order shown.

options.A: The recommended normal procedures shall be presented in the handbooks according to the command of the subsequent flight phases.
options.B: Handbooks shall include recommended normal procedures for the following phases of flight in the order shown, besides the applicable or inapplicable condition to specific aircraft model.
options.C: If it is applicable or appropriate to the particular airplane model, the recommended normal procedures for the following flight phases shall be contained in the handbooks in the order shown.

explanation: 【译文】除对特定机型不适用或不适当外，手册应按所示顺序包含下列飞行阶段的推荐正常程序。【词汇】inapplicable=不适用、recommended normal procedures=推荐正常程序、phases of flight=飞行阶段。【解析】C正确：以If applicable or appropriate改写Except when inapplicable，逆否等价，in the order shown保留。A：错成“按后续阶段指令”且丢除外条件。B：besides把除外写成包含，逻辑混乱。

question: All parts of an integral installation may be combined into a single equipment list item if variation of weight or arm is not significant.

options.A: If weight or arm doesn't vary significantly, all parts of an integral installation may be integrated into a single equipment list item .
options.B: An individual equipment list may contain all parts of a general installation  when the amount of weight or arm is not remarkable.
options.C: A separated equipment list may include all components of an  integral installation  in case of no signification in the change of weight or arm.

explanation: 【译文】若重量或力臂变化不显著，整体安装的所有部件可合并为一个设备清单条目。【词汇】integral installation=整体安装、combined into a single item=合并为单一条目、variation=变化、not significant=不显著。【解析】A正确：doesn't vary significantly对应variation not significant，integrated into a single item对应combined。B：integral错为general，variation错为amount。C：single错为separated（分开的），方向相反。

question: Coils and probes are not always interchangeable between various types of instruments and, for best results, should be matched to a specific instrument and frequency range.

options.A: Coils are not always interchangeable with probes between different types of instruments. They should suit to a particular instrument and frequency range for best effects.
options.B: Various types of instruments are not always capable to alternate coils and probes and it's best to be compared with the similar instrument and frequency scope.
options.C: Coils and probes of various types of instruments can not be interchanged, and they should be suited to a specific instrument and frequency range in order to obtain the best results.

explanation: 【译文】各类仪表间的线圈和探头并非总能互换，为最佳效果应与特定仪表和频率范围匹配。【词汇】coils and probes=线圈和探头、interchangeable=可互换、matched to=与…匹配、frequency range=频率范围。【解析】C正确：can not be interchanged对应not always interchangeable，suited to a specific instrument对应matched to。A错读成“线圈与探头互换”，实为同类件跨仪表互换（张冠李戴）。B：match错为compare，表述混乱。

question: The presence of oxygen, however, serves to accelerate combustion, and causes materials to burn with great intensity.

options.A: However, oxygen is presented to provide service to the combustion process and improve the burn intensity of the material.
options.B: However, the presence of oxygen helps to advance the combustion and results in an intense burn of material.
options.C: However, the existence of oxygen  inhibits the acceleration of combustion and leads to a strong burn of material.

explanation: 【译文】然而氧气的存在会加速燃烧并使材料剧烈燃烧。【词汇】presence of oxygen=氧气存在、accelerate combustion=加速燃烧、burn with great intensity=剧烈燃烧。【解析】B正确：helps to advance the combustion对应accelerate，intense burn对应burn with great intensity。A：serves to accelerate生硬译成“为燃烧提供服务”。C：inhibits the acceleration方向相反。

question: Nomenclature shall be consistent throughout all technical data provided to the Customer. For example, a part once identified as a "cover" shall not' be referred to elsewhere as a "plate."

options.A: The name of a part shall be consistent in all technical data provided to the customer. For example, once a part is identified as a "cover", it cannot be referred to as a "plate" in a different chapter.
options.B: Terminology shall be uniform in all technical data provided to the customer. If a part is named "cover", special instructions are required to call it "board".
options.C: Terminology shall be uniform in all technical data provided to the customer. Different names for different parts, such as "cover" and "plate" need to be explained.

explanation: 【译文】提供给客户的所有技术资料命名应一致，如一部件定为“cover”不得在别处称“plate”。【词汇】nomenclature=命名、consistent=一致、referred to as=被称作、elsewhere=在别处。【解析】A正确：name consistent in all technical data对应Nomenclature consistent，cover不得称plate例子对应。B：special instructions无中生有，plate错成board。C误为“不同名称需解释”，意思走样。

question: A revision means a modification of information in an existing manual. Appropriate revision pages and related effective page lists will be provided when amending the basic document.

options.A: Revision means incorporating information from existing manuals. When modifying the basic document, provide a list of valid pages in addition to the revision page.
options.B: Revision refers to the replacement of an old manual with a pure new one. The contents that differ from the original should be indexed, so an effective list of contents should be provided.
options.C: Revision refers to changing information in an existing manual. When modifying the basic part of the document, provide a list of valid pages in addition to the revision pages.

explanation: 【译文】修订指修改现有手册中的信息，修订基本文件时提供修订页和有效页清单。【词汇】revision=修订、modification=修改、existing manual=现有手册、effective page lists=有效页清单。【解析】C正确：changing information对应modification of information，valid pages对应effective page lists。A：modification错为“收录现有手册信息”。B：revision错解为“以全新手册替换旧手册”，修订与换版混淆。

question: Handbook producer's selection of data contained in this section shall be bounded by the concepts contained in the Preface to this Specification.

options.A: Manufacturer's provision of data contained in this section of the Handbook shall be governed by the concepts given in the preface to this Specification.
options.B: The selection of data by the Handbook producer, to be included in this Section shall be governed by the concepts contained in the Preface of this Specification.
options.C: Handbook producer may select the data contained in this chapter based on the concepts given in the preface to this specification, but it is not binding.

explanation: 【译文】手册编制者对本节数据的选择应受本规范前言概念的约束。【词汇】Handbook producer=手册编制者、selection of data=数据选择、bounded by=受…约束、Preface=前言。【解析】B正确：selection...governed by对应shall be bounded by，要素全对应。A：Handbook producer错为Manufacturer，selection错为provision。C：not binding（不具约束力）与原意相反。

question: A Safety and Operational Tips section may be incorporated in the Handbook. It may contain Safety information of a general nature, such as kinds of information and rules to be found in FAA publications.

options.A: The Handbook is only an operation guide, so Safety and Operational Tips should be separate volumes, such as general safety information, and various information and rules in FAA publications.
options.B: Safety and Operational Tips can be incorporated into the Handbook. However, only critical safety information, as well as information and rules found in FAA publications, can be included.
options.C: Handbook can include Safety and Operation Tips. It will include general safety information, such as information and rules in FAA publications.

explanation: 【译文】手册可编入“安全与操作提示”节，含一般性安全信息如FAA出版物中的信息和规则。【词汇】Safety and Operational Tips=安全与操作提示、incorporated=编入、of a general nature=一般性质。【解析】C正确：can include对应may be incorporated，general safety information对应of a general nature。A：incorporated错成separate volumes（单独成册），相反。B：general错成only critical，范围相反。

question: If the pointer is within the green band, the cylinder pressure is correct for the cylinder temperature.

options.A: If the pointer is in the green zone, the cylinder pressure and the cylinder temperature are not wrong.
options.B: If the pointer exceeds the green band, the cylinder pressure and the cylinder temperature are matched.
options.C: If the pointer is within the green band, the cylinder temperature is right for the cylinder pressure.

explanation: 【译文】如果指针在绿色区域内，则相对于气缸温度而言气缸压力是正确的。【词汇】green band=绿色区域/绿区、cylinder pressure=气缸压力、correct for=相对于…是正确的、cylinder temperature=气缸温度。【解析】A最佳：“in the green zone”对应within the green band，“the cylinder pressure and the cylinder temperature are not wrong”宽松地表达了“压力对温度而言正确”的匹配关系。B把within错译为exceeds（超出），方向相反。C主客颠倒：原文是“压力相对于温度正确”，C写成“温度相对于压力正确”，判断主体张冠李戴。

question: If necessary, initiate CA (compliance action) per Volume 14, Chapter 1, Section 2 to identify the root cause that led to any deviations from rules, standards, or procedures; analyze corrective action to resolve them; and schedule follow up to validate the

options.A: Implement CA (compliance action) as necessary per Volume 14, Chapter 1, Section 2 to make clear the root cause that led to any deviations from rules, standards, or procedures; analyze corrective action to resolve them; and schedule follow-up audit to eval
options.B: When necessary, perform CA (compliance action) per Volume 14, Chapter 1, Section 2 to eliminate the root cause of any deviations from rules, standards, or procedures; analyze corrective action to resolve them; and schedule the following steps to validate
options.C: If necessary, initiate CA (compliance action) per Volume 14, Chapter 1, Section 2 to mark the root cause leading to any deviations from rules, standards, or procedures; analyze corrective action to handle them; and schedule follow up to validate the repai

explanation: 【译文】如有必要按14卷1章2节启动CA（符合性行动），查明偏离规章标准程序的根本原因，分析纠正措施并安排跟踪验证。【词汇】initiate CA=启动符合性行动、root cause=根本原因、deviations=偏离、corrective action=纠正措施。【解析】A正确：Implement CA as necessary对应initiate if necessary，make clear the root cause对应identify。B：identify错为eliminate（消除）。C：identify错为mark（标记），handle不如resolve准确。

question: Compliance with both the maintenance and manufacturing requirements is the only way a certificate holder can ensure that a fabricated part is airworthy.

options.A: A certificate holder shall ensure that a fabricated part is airworthy which is both the  requirements of maintenance and manufacturing.
options.B: A certificate holder has the only way to ensure that a fabricated part is airworthy considering both the maintenance and manufacturing requirements.
options.C: Not only maintenance but also the manufacturing requirements shall be met by the certificate holder to ensure that a fabricated part is airworthy.

explanation: 【译文】同时符合维修和制造要求，是持证方确保自制件适航的唯一途径。【词汇】compliance with both=同时符合、certificate holder=持证方、fabricated part=自制件、airworthy=适航的。【解析】C正确：Not only...but also...shall be met对应Compliance with both，ensure airworthy保留。A：“airworthy which is both the requirements”语法不通。B虽保留only way但considering弱化compliance，句式生硬。

question: The fault isolation task explains how to find the cause of the fault. When the task says " You corrected the fault" you know that the fault is gone.

options.A: The fault isolation work describes how to locate the fault. After you solve the fault , you may find  " The fault is corrected"  shown on the screen.
options.B: The fault isolation task tells the way to find the reason of the fault. When you find the words "You corrected the fault" , it means  that the problem is solved.
options.C: You could find the reason of the fault in the fault isolation steps. If the step indicates " The fault is being corrected", it means that you have finished the work.

explanation: 【译文】故障隔离任务说明如何找故障原因，任务显示“You corrected the fault”即知故障已消除。【词汇】fault isolation=故障隔离、cause of the fault=故障原因、the fault is gone=故障消除。【解析】B正确：tells the way to find the reason对应explains how to find the cause，find the words...means problem is solved对应显示即知消除。A：先后颠倒成“排除故障后显示”，且添shown on the screen。C：corrected错为being corrected（进行中）。

question: The wheel to rudder interconnect system (WTRIS) assists turns during flight control manual reversion operations when both flight control A and B hydraulics are OFF, and the standby system is ON.

options.A: The wheel to rudder interconnect system (WTRIS) helps to turn in manual flight control   operations meanwhile flight control A and B hydraulics power are OFF, and the alternating system is ON.
options.B: While both flight control A and B hydraulic system OFF, and the standby system ON, the wheel to rudder interconnect system (WTRIS) helps turning when the manual flight control is reversing.
options.C: With both flight control A and B hydraulic system OFF, and the standby system ON, the wheel to rudder interconnect system (WTRIS) assists turning in time of restoring manual flight control.

explanation: 【译文】A、B飞行操纵液压关断且备用系统接通时，WTRIS在人工回退（恢复人工操纵）运行中辅助转弯。【词汇】WTRIS=机轮-方向舵互联系统、assists turns=辅助转弯、manual reversion=人工回退、standby system=备用系统。【解析】C最佳：restoring manual flight control准确传达manual reversion（恢复人工操纵），OFF/ON条件完整。B：manual reversion误为is reversing（正在反转），词义错译。A：standby错成alternating system，术语错译。

question: The blankets have a waterproof covering and their installation in a shingled configuration prevents condensation from leaking into the compartment.

options.A: The isolation blanket has a waterproof layer that is installed in a brick configuration to prevent leakage of condensed water into the carriage.
options.B: The insulation blankets have a waterproof layer and are installed in a tiled configuration to prevent leakage of condensed water into the compartment.
options.C: The insulating blankets have a watertight layer which is mounted in a shingled configuration to protect leakage of water condensation into the compartment.

explanation: 【译文】隔热毯带防水覆盖层，叠瓦式安装构型可防止冷凝水漏入舱内。【词汇】blankets=隔热毯、waterproof covering=防水覆盖层、shingled configuration=叠瓦式构型、condensation=冷凝水。【解析】B正确：insulation blankets、waterproof layer、tiled configuration对应shingled（瓦片式可接受），prevent leakage对应prevents...from leaking。A：brick configuration错译shingled，compartment错成carriage。C：which is mounted错挂到layer上，protect leakage搭配不通。

question: The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described as well as the location of the units.

options.A: Besides describing the function and operation of each unit in the system, the location of the units also should be depicted.
options.B: In addition to set forth the location of the components, the functional operation of every component shall be represented.
options.C: The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described except the location of the units.

explanation: 【译文】系统每个组件的功能和工作应描述，组件位置也应说明。【词汇】function and operation=功能和工作、each unit=每个组件、as well as=以及、location=位置。【解析】A正确：Besides describing...also should be depicted对应described as well as，并列两项保留。B：function and operation合并为functional operation，漏要素。C：as well as错为except，并列变排除，方向相反。

question: With the loss of normal power, the standby power system supplies a minimum of 60 minutes of AC and DC power to systems necessary to maintain safe flight.

options.A: In the event of loss of normal power, the backup power system offers AC and DC power for at least 60 minutes to the systems to maintain the flight safe.
options.B: In order to hold the flight safety, the standby power system supplies a minimum of 60 minutes of AC and DC power to systems when the normal power is not available.
options.C: If there is no normal power, the standby power system provides AC and DC power to systems necessary to keep safe flight for at least 60 minutes.

explanation: 【译文】正常电源失效时，备用电源系统向维持安全飞行必需的系统供至少60分钟交直流电。【词汇】loss of normal power=正常电源失效、standby power system=备用电源、a minimum of 60 minutes=至少60分钟。【解析】A正确：In the event of对应With the loss of，backup对应standby，at least 60 minutes限定供电时长。B：In order to hold the flight safety错把状语当目的。C：60 minutes移到句尾，修饰从供电时长错成飞行安全时长。

question: Troubleshooting in a complex system consists of identifying sections that can cause specific types of trouble.

options.A: Troubleshooting of a complex system includes identifying part which can cause special trouble.
options.B: Identifying sections that can cause major types of trouble can be found in troubleshooting part of a complex system.
options.C: You can find identifying sections which include the content resulting in specific types of trouble in troubleshooting part of a complex system.

explanation: 【译文】复杂系统的排故，就是识别出可能引起特定类型故障的那些部分。【词汇】troubleshooting=排故、故障排查，consist of=由……组成/包括，section=部分、段（此处指系统内可划分的功能段），specific types of trouble=特定类型的故障。【解析】A正确：includes对应consists of，identifying对应identifying，sections简化为part虽有损失但“识别可致故障的部分”主干完整，special对specific略有弱化但语义最接近。B两处错误：把specific types改为major types（重大类型），故障范围被改变；且把consists of（由……组成）曲解为can be found in（可在排故部分中找到），组成关系变成位置关系。C把“识别可能引起特定故障的部分”错译为“识别包含导致故障之内容的部分”，嵌套关系混乱，核心动宾结构丢失。

question: From the top sentences, the reader will understand the contents of your text and will find specific information quickly.

options.A: The reader will understand the contents of your text and find important information quickly according to the above sentences.
options.B: The reader will understand the text contents and will find particular information quickly according to the above sentences.
options.C: It will be very difficult for the reader to understand the contents of your text and find specific information according to the top sentences.

explanation: 【译文】通过这些前置句（主题句），读者将理解你文章的内容并能快速找到具体信息。【词汇】top sentences=前置句、文首句（常指段首主题句），contents of your text=你文章的内容，find specific information quickly=快速找到具体信息。【解析】A正确：according to the above sentences对应From the top sentences，完整保留contents of your text与will understand/will find的并列结构；仅把specific弱化为important，整体最完整。B把specific译为particular虽亦接近，但漏译your（你的），text contents结构松散且把contents of your text所有格关系丢失，信息完整度不及A。C方向相反：译成“读者将很难理解”（very difficult），与原文will understand完全相反。

question: The example has short paragraphs, which give the text a clear structure and make it easy for the reader to understand.

options.A: The example contains short paragraphs which presents the text in a clear structure and it is easy for the reader to understand.
options.B: The example gives the text a clear content which has long paragraphs and the reader can understand it easily.
options.C: The example describes the text in a clear way without the use of short paragraphs and the reader can understand it easily.

explanation: 【译文】该示例采用短段落，使文本结构清晰、便于读者理解。【词汇】short paragraphs=短段落，clear structure=清晰的结构，make it easy for the reader=使读者容易理解。【解析】A正确：contains对应has，presents...in a clear structure对应give the text a clear structure，easy for the reader to understand对应make it easy，三要素齐全。B两处错误：把short paragraphs错译为long paragraphs（长段落），方向相反；且clear structure弱化为clear content（内容而非结构）。C两处错误：without the use of short paragraphs把原文肯定关系译成否定（不用短段落），并把give a clear structure错译为describes in a clear way（以清晰方式描述），结构与句意均偏离。

question: If there is no change, a statement to that effect shall be made.

options.A: If change occurs, there will be statement to that effect.
options.B: There will be a statement to that effect if no change occurs.
options.C: Once there is any change, there will be an effect to that.

explanation: 【译文】如没有任何更改，应就此作出声明（说明无更改）。【词汇】no change=没有更改，a statement to that effect=就此事项作出的声明，shall be made=应作出（被动表强制要求）。【解析】B正确：if no change occurs准确对应If there is no change，statement to that effect完整保留，仅将语序调整为主句在前、条件在后。A把条件错译为if change occurs（如有更改），去掉no后条件方向相反。C两处错误：同样把条件错译为Once there is any change（一旦有任何更改），与原文“无更改”相反；且把statement（声明）错译为an effect（效果），声明的对象整个丢失。

question: Supplements may be issued only to owners of airplanes equipped with the subject systems or equipment.

options.A: If the airplanes are equipped with the subject systems or equipment, the owners of the airplanes will not get the Supplements.
options.B: The operators of airplanes will get the issue of the Supplements no matter the airplanes equip with the subject systems or equipment.
options.C: All the owners of airplanes which have subject systems or equipment can get the Supplements.

explanation: 【译文】补充资料只可发放给装有本主题所述系统或设备的飞机所有人。【词汇】supplement=补充资料、增补本，be issued to=发放给，only to=仅发给（限定发放范围），subject systems or equipment=本主题所述的系统或设备。【解析】C正确：All the owners of airplanes which have subject systems or equipment can get准确传达“仅具备该系统或设备的所有人可获发”的限定关系。A把句意译反：装有设备的所有人will not get（拿不到），与only to的肯定发放关系完全相反。B两处错误：把owners（所有人）错换为operators（运营人），主体张冠李戴；且no matter the airplanes equip（无论是否装备）取消了only的限定条件，发放范围被无限扩大。

question: When you do work with cleaning agents,use breathing equipment.

options.A: The breathing equipment should be used if you do work with cleaning agents.
options.B: Before you use breathing equipment the cleaning agents should be used.
options.C: If you accompany with the personnel whose job is cleaning, the breathing equipment should be used.
