Includes brakes, wheels, floats, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems.【词汇】支撑和操纵方向=supporting and steering，在飞行中收回和储存=retract and store in flight，减震支柱=shock struts，浮筒=floats，位置指示和告警系统=position indicating and warning systems。【解析】A正确：supporting and steering、retract and store the landing gear、brakes至warning systems的九项清单与题干逐词对应，是起落架系统定义的标准译文。B两处错误：把“起落架”错译为empennage（尾翼），部件张冠李戴；且holding and controlling不如supporting and steering贴切，选项截断亦不完整。C把“收回和储存”错译为fold away（折叠收起，非起落架收放规范表达），stabilize替代supporting欠准，选项末尾同样截断。

question: 辅助起落架指地面上用于稳定飞机并防止因接触地面而遭受损坏的装置，包括减震支柱、防滑板、机轮等。

options.A: Supplementary Gear refers to devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as actuating cylinders, plumbing, wheels, etc.
options.B: Supplementary Gear refers to devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid blocks, wheels, etc.
options.C: Supplementary Gear refers to devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. Includes items such as bogie swivel unlock, valves, wheels, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Supplementary Gear refers to devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the ground and prevent damage by ground contact. It includes items such as shock struts, skid blocks, wheels, etc.【词汇】辅助起落架=Supplementary Gear，地面稳定飞机=stabilize the aircraft while on the ground，接触地面损坏=damage by ground contact，减震支柱=shock strut，防滑板=skid blocks。【解析】B正确：stabilize the aircraft while on the ground对应“地面上用于稳定飞机”，prevent damage by ground contact对应“防止因接触地面而遭受损坏”，shock strut, skid blocks, wheels与题干“减震支柱、防滑板、机轮”三项逐一对应。A把清单错译为actuating cylinders, plumbing, wheels（作动筒、管路），两项部件不符，张冠李戴。C把清单错译为bogie swivel unlock, valves, wheels（转向架回转解锁、活门），部件错配同A。

question: 系统中的这一部分可以用来感知环境条件并利用数据来影响导航。

options.A: That portion of the system is used to sense environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation.
options.B: The part of the system that feels environmental criteria and uses data to influence navigation.
options.C: The section of the system that detects environmental conditions and uses information to influence guidance.

explanation: 【译文】That portion of the system is used to sense environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation.【词汇】感知=sense/detect，环境条件=environmental conditions，利用数据=uses the data，导航=navigation。【解析】A正确：sense environmental conditions对应“感知环境条件”，uses the data to influence navigation逐词对应“利用数据来影响导航”，That portion of the system对应“系统中的这一部分”。B把sense错译为feels（触摸感到，仪器探测不适用），且environmental criteria（环境标准）错译conditions（条件/状况），词义错译。C把“导航”错译为guidance（制导/导引）——guidance指导引控制，navigation指航行定位，两个技术概念不同，术语错误。

question: 指示子系统是指系统中用于指示压力的相关部分，其中包括压力报警系统。

options.A: Indicating subsystem is that portion of the system which is used to indicate pressure, which includes pressure warning system.
options.B: Indicating subsystem is that portion of the system which is used to increase or pressure, which includes pressure warning system.
options.C: Indicating subsystem is that portion of the system which is used to indicate pressure, which actually excludes pressure warning system.

explanation: 【译文】The indicating subsystem is that portion of the system which is used to indicate pressure, and it includes the pressure warning system.【词汇】指示子系统=indicating subsystem，用于指示压力=used to indicate pressure，压力报警系统=pressure warning system，包括=includes。【解析】A正确：indicate pressure对应“指示压力”，includes pressure warning system对应“包括压力报警系统”，that portion of the system which结构对应“系统中用于……的相关部分”。B把“指示压力”错译为increase or pressure（增加或压力）——indicate与increase近形但语义全变，词形错译。C把“包括”错译为excludes（不包括），包含关系方向完全相反。

question: 外舱门主要用于为勤务飞机系统和设备提供接近，包括结构件、闩锁机构、把手、隔热材料、内衬、操纵装置等物品。

options.A: The interior doors are used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment. Include items such as structure, latching mechanisms, switch, insulation, lining, controls, etc.
options.B: The exterior doors are used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment. Include items such as structure, latching mechanisms, switch, insulation, controls, etc.
options.C: The exterior doors are used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment. Include items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The exterior doors are used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment. They include items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, etc.【词汇】外舱门=exterior doors（区别于interior内部门），提供接近=gain access for servicing，闩锁机构=latching mechanisms，把手=handles，隔热材料=insulation，内衬=lining，操纵装置=controls。【解析】C正确：exterior doors对应“外舱门”，gain access for servicing对应“为勤务提供接近”，handles、insulation、lining、controls与题干“把手、隔热材料、内衬、操纵装置”逐项吻合。A两处错误：把“外舱门”错译为interior doors（内部门），内外方向相反；且清单用switch（电门）替代handles、漏掉lining。B虽exterior doors正确，但清单同样缺handles与lining，要素不完整。

question: 对于涡桨发动机，相位检测器可以指示发动机的运行情况。

options.A: For turbojet engines, the phase monitors can display the engine's operating status.
options.B: For turboprop engines, the phase detectors can indicate engine operation.
options.C: For turbofan engines, the phase monitors can indicate engine operation.

explanation: 【译文】For turboprop engines, the phase detectors can indicate engine operation.【词汇】涡桨发动机=turboprop engines，相位检测器=phase detectors，指示运行情况=indicate engine operation。【解析】B正确：turboprop engines准确对应“涡桨发动机”，phase detectors对应“相位检测器”（detector=检测器），indicate engine operation对应“指示发动机的运行情况”。A把“涡桨”错译为turbojet（涡轮喷气发动机），发动机类型张冠李戴，且monitors不如detectors对应“检测器”。C把“涡桨”错译为turbofan（涡轮风扇发动机），类型错误同A，phase monitors用词亦欠准。

question: 发动机附件冷却系统用于发动机舱和附件通风，包括活门、管路、引射泵、涡流扰流器等部件。

options.A: Valves, tube lines, injection pumps, and vortex spoilers are the essential components of the engine auxiliary cooling system, which facilitate ventilation of engine pylon and accessories.
options.B: The accessory cooling system dissipates air from the engine compartments and accessories, including several components and units such as valves, pipelines, injection pumps, and vortex spoilers.
options.C: The engine accessory cooling system is used to ventilate engine compartments and accessories, inclusive of valves, plumbing, jet pumps, vortex spoilers, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The engine accessory cooling system is used to ventilate the engine compartments and accessories, including items such as valves, plumbing, jet pumps, vortex spoilers, etc.【词汇】附件冷却系统=accessory cooling system，发动机舱=engine compartments，通风=ventilate，管路=plumbing，引射泵=jet pumps（射流引射泵），涡流扰流器=vortex spoilers。【解析】C正确：used to ventilate engine compartments and accessories准确对应“用于发动机舱和附件通风”，jet pumps对应“引射泵”（靠射流引射原理工作）比injection pumps贴切，plumbing对应“管路”。A两处错误：把“发动机舱”错译为engine pylon（发动机吊架），部件张冠李戴；且injection pumps（喷射泵）不如jet pumps对应“引射”。B把“通风”错译为dissipates air from（从……散出空气），功能描述失准，injection pumps同A错。

question: 发动机控制器能够调节发动机的运行，包括用于紧急停车的互联组件和部件。

options.A: In the event of an emergency stop, the components of the engine control, and associated items, all manage the engine's operation.
options.B: The engine controls govern the engine's operation, which includes units and components interconnected for emergency shutdown.
options.C: The engine's operation is controlled by the engine control, which includes various components and items that are connected to enable emergency cut-off.

explanation: 【译文】The engine controls govern engine operation and include units and components interconnected for emergency shutdown.【词汇】发动机控制器=engine controls，调节=govern/control，互联的=interconnected，紧急停车=emergency shutdown，组件和部件=units and components。【解析】B正确：govern the engine's operation准确对应“调节发动机的运行”（govern含调控之意），units and components interconnected for emergency shutdown完整译出“用于紧急停车的互联组件和部件”，includes的包含关系明确。A把包含关系倒置为时间条件：译成“紧急停车时所有部件都管理发动机运行”，原文“控制器调节运行、其中含紧急停车互联组件”的逻辑被曲解。C把“互联”弱化为connected，emergency cut-off虽可用，但engine control单数与is controlled by同义反复，表达冗余不如B精炼准确。

question: 涡轮中配有的涡轮增压器能够利用排气能量驱动空气压缩机。

options.A: The turbines are equipped with turbo supercharger, which can extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor.
options.B: The turbines are coupled to turbo supercharger, and can absorb energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor.
options.C: Turbo superchargers can absorb energy from exhaust gas and then use it to drive the air compressor.

explanation: 【译文】The turbines are equipped with turbo superchargers, which extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor.【词汇】涡轮增压器=turbo supercharger，配有=equipped with，利用排气能量=extract energy from the exhaust gases，驱动空气压缩机=drive an air compressor。【解析】A正确：equipped with turbo supercharger对应“配有的涡轮增压器”，extract energy from the exhaust gases and drive an air compressor准确译出“利用排气能量驱动空气压缩机”——extract对应“提取/利用”。B两处欠佳：coupled to（连接到）弱于equipped with（配有、装有），且absorb energy（吸收能量）不如extract energy贴切废气能量利用。C漏译“涡轮中配有”这一载体结构——主语直接变为Turbo superchargers，turbines作为安装位置的信息丢失，属漏译要素。

question: 传动轴部分能将功率从发动机传至齿轮箱。

options.A: Drive shaft section is used to conduct power from the engine to the gearbox.
options.B: Drive shaft section drives power from the gearbox to the engine.
options.C: The function of drive shaft section is to drive the power to the gearbox.

explanation: 【译文】The drive shaft section transmits power from the engine to the gearbox.【词汇】传动轴部分=drive shaft section，将功率从……传至……=conduct/transmit power from...to...，齿轮箱=gearbox。【解析】A正确：conduct power from the engine to the gearbox准确对应“将功率从发动机传至齿轮箱”，功率流向engine→gearbox正确。B把传动方向弄反：drives power from the gearbox to the engine变成“从齿轮箱传向发动机”，流向完全相反。C两处不足：漏译“从发动机”这一功率来源（缺from the engine），且drive the power搭配不自然——传递功率应用conduct/transmit。

question: 滑油分配系统包括管路、活门、温度调节器、控制系统等。

options.A: Distribution includes items such as plumbing, tank, temperature regulator, control systems, etc.
options.B: Distribution includes items such as plumbing, valves, temperature regulator, control systems, etc.
options.C: Distribution includes items such as plumbing, valves, pressure regulator, control systems, etc.

explanation: 【译文】Distribution includes items such as plumbing, valves, temperature regulators, control systems, etc.【词汇】分配=distribution，管路=plumbing，活门=valves，温度调节器=temperature regulator，控制系统=control systems。【解析】B正确：plumbing, valves, temperature regulator, control systems与题干“管路、活门、温度调节器、控制系统”四项逐一对应，includes items such as对应“包括……等”。A把“活门”错译为tank（油箱/储罐），部件张冠李戴。C把“温度调节器”错译为pressure regulator（压力调节器），调节对象错误——temperature与pressure是不同控制参数。

question: 对涡轮发动机来说，排气系统包括发动机本体以外的装置，如反推装置和消声装置。

options.A: For turbine engines, exhaust includes units external to the basic engine such as thrust reverser and noise suppressor.
options.B: For turbine engines, exhaust includes units inside the basic engine such as thrust reverser and noise suppressor.
options.C: For turbine engines, exhaust includes units external to the basic engine such as propeller and noise suppressor.

explanation: 【译文】For turbine engines, the exhaust system includes units external to the basic engine, such as the thrust reverser and noise suppressor.【词汇】涡轮发动机=turbine engines，排气系统=exhaust，发动机本体以外的装置=units external to the basic engine，反推装置=thrust reverser，消声装置=noise suppressor。【解析】A正确：units external to the basic engine准确对应“发动机本体以外的装置”，thrust reverser and noise suppressor对应“反推装置和消声装置”。B把“以外”错译为inside the basic engine（以内），内外方向相反——反推与消声装置均在发动机外部。C把“反推装置”错译为propeller（螺旋桨），部件张冠李戴，且螺旋桨本就不属排气系统范畴。

question: 方向舵是可移动翼面，连接在垂直安定面上，用于偏航控制。

options.A: The rudder is the removable airfoil which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and is used for yaw control.
options.B: The airfoil is the removable rudder which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and is used for yaw control.
options.C: The rudder is the removable airfoil which is attached to the vertical tail and is used for roll control.

explanation: 【译文】The rudder is a movable airfoil which is attached to the vertical stabilizer and is used for yaw control.【词汇】方向舵=rudder，可移动翼面=movable airfoil，垂直安定面=vertical stabilizer，偏航控制=yaw control。【解析】A正确：主语rudder对应“方向舵”，attached to the vertical stabilizer对应“连接在垂直安定面上”，yaw control对应“偏航控制”，三要素俱全；removable为“可移动”的宽松译法（严格应为movable），但其余选项错误更大。B把主从关系颠倒：The airfoil is the removable rudder（翼面是方向舵），主语张冠李戴。C两处错误：把“垂直安定面”弱化为vertical tail（垂尾泛称），且roll control（滚转控制）错译yaw control（偏航控制），操纵轴系混淆。

question: 垂直安定面是指与方向舵相连的垂直翼面，包括翼梁、肋、桁条、板/蒙皮、检修盖、翼尖等。

options.A: Vertical Stabilizer is the vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached, including items such as spars, ribs, stringers, plates/skin, access covers, tips, etc.
options.B: Vertical stabilizer refers to the vertical wing surface connected to the rudder, including spars, ribs, stringers, plates/skins, access covers, tips, etc.
options.C: The vertical stabilizing surfaces are the vertical airfoils connected to the rudder, including the wing beams, ribs, trusses, plates/skins, access covers, wing tips, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The vertical stabilizer is the vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached; it includes items such as spars, ribs, stringers, plates/skins, access covers, tips, etc.【词汇】垂直安定面=vertical stabilizer，与方向舵相连的垂直翼面=vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached，翼梁=spars，桁条=stringers，检修盖=access covers，翼尖=tips。【解析】B与A几乎等价且均正确：B用refers to the vertical wing surface connected to the rudder对应“是指与方向舵相连的垂直翼面”，refers to贴合题干“是指”的判断句式，spars, ribs, stringers, plates/skins, access covers, tips六件清单完整。A用is the vertical airfoil to which the rudder is attached同样准确（airfoil甚至略优于wing surface），两选项实质等价，取舍仅在句式对应度。C多处术语错误：vertical stabilizing surfaces把安定面复数化，wing beams错译spars（翼梁规范词为spar），trusses（桁架）错译stringers（桁条）。

question: 螺旋桨组件包括桨叶、桨帽、桨毂、整流锥、滑环、除冰带、分配阀等部件。

options.A: Propeller assembly includes items such as blades, dome, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distributor valve, etc.
options.B: Propeller assembly includes blades, cowling, disk, hub, slip ring, de-icing belt, distribution valve and other components.
options.C: Propeller assembly includes leaves, fairing, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distribution valve, and so on.

explanation: 【译文】The propeller assembly includes items such as blades, dome, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distributor valve, etc.【词汇】螺旋桨组件=propeller assembly，桨叶=blades，桨帽=dome，桨毂=hub，整流锥=spinner，滑环=slip ring，除冰带=deicer boot，分配阀=distributor valve。【解析】A正确：blades, dome, hub, spinner, slip ring, deicer boot, distributor valve七项与题干“桨叶、桨帽、桨毂、整流锥、滑环、除冰带、分配阀”完全对应。B多处错误：把“桨帽”错译为cowling（整流罩），把“整流锥”错译为disk（圆盘），de-icing belt、distribution valve词形可用但关键部件已错。C把“桨叶”错译为leaves（树叶/薄片），核心部件错译严重；fairing（整流罩）错译dome（桨帽）亦误。

question: 这部分包括发动机架、减震器、支撑杆、安装螺栓等。

options.A: This section includes engine supports, shock absorb, support links, mounting bolts, etc.
options.B: This section includes engine mounts, vibration dampers, support levers, mounting bolts, etc.
options.C: This section includes engine mounts, vibration dampeners, support links, mounting bolts, etc.

explanation: 【译文】This section includes items such as engine mounts, vibration dampeners, support links, mounting bolts, etc.【词汇】发动机架=engine mounts，减震器=vibration dampeners/dampers，支撑杆=support links，安装螺栓=mounting bolts。【解析】C正确：engine mounts对应“发动机架”（mount含安装支座义），vibration dampeners对应“减震器”（阻尼减振件），support links对应“支撑杆”（杆状连接件），mounting bolts对应“安装螺栓”，四项全对。A把“减震器”错译为shock absorb——shock absorb为动词短语“吸收冲击”，名词应为shock absorber，词性残缺。B把“支撑杆”错译为support levers（杠杆）——links为连杆/吊杆，levers为杠杆，机械件不同。

question: 发动机大修手册中包括了拆卸、清洁、检查、组装、测试等主题。

options.A: There are subjects such as teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly and testing in the engine overhaul manual.
options.B: There are the subjects of teardown, cleaning, inspection, removal and testing in the engine overhaul manual.
options.C: Subjects, including teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly and testing are mostly prescribed by the engine overhaul manual.

explanation: 【译文】The engine overhaul manual includes subjects such as teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly and testing.【词汇】发动机大修手册=engine overhaul manual，拆卸=teardown（拆解），清洁=cleaning，检查=inspection，组装=assembly，测试=testing。【解析】A正确：teardown, cleaning, inspection, assembly and testing与题干“拆卸、清洁、检查、组装、测试”五项主题完全对应，subjects...in the engine overhaul manual结构对应“手册中包括……主题”。B把“组装”错译为removal（拆卸/拆除）——assembly与removal是维修中一对相反工序，方向相反。C两处错误：把“包括……主题”错译为mostly prescribed by（大多由手册规定），包含关系变成规定关系且加mostly限定；句子重心亦从主题清单偏移。

question: 为便于相互参阅，图解、图形和表格在可行条件下应以垂直布局。

options.A: Illustrations, figures and tables should be vertically presented in order to read the cross reference.
options.B: For ease of reading the cross reference, illustrations, figures and tables should be presented in a vertical layout, if practical.
options.C: If possible, illustrations, figures and tables could be reproduced in a vertical way.

explanation: 【译文】For ease of cross-reference, illustrations, figures and tables should be presented in a vertical layout where practical.【词汇】相互参阅=cross-reference，图解=illustrations，图形=figures，表格=tables，垂直布局=vertical layout，在可行条件下=if/where practical。【解析】B正确：For ease of reading the cross reference对应“为便于相互参阅”，presented in a vertical layout对应“以垂直布局”，if practical对应“在可行条件下”，目的、方式、条件三要素齐全。A两处错误：漏译“在可行条件下”的限定，且in order to read the cross reference搭配生硬。C把“应”弱化为could（可以），指令语气降低；且reproduced in a vertical way（以垂直方式复制）错译“以垂直布局呈现”，同时漏译“相互参阅”的目的。

question: 在海平面标准大气压下，校准空速和真实空速是相同的。

options.A: Calibrated airspeed is equal to true airspeed in standard atmosphere at sea level.
options.B: Corrected airspeed is the same as actual airspeed at sea level standard atmosphere.
options.C: At sea level standard atmosphere, calibrated airspeed is equal to real airspeed.

explanation: 【译文】At sea level in a standard atmosphere, calibrated airspeed is equal to true airspeed.【词汇】校准空速=calibrated airspeed（CAS），真实空速=true airspeed（TAS），海平面标准大气=standard atmosphere at sea level，相同=be equal to。【解析】A正确：Calibrated airspeed与true airspeed为空速术语规范对译（CAS/TAS），in standard atmosphere at sea level对应“在海平面标准大气压下”，is equal to对应“相同”。B两处欠佳：把“校准空速”错译为Corrected airspeed（修正空速，非规范术语），actual airspeed（实际空速）亦非true airspeed规范译法。C把“真实空速”错译为real airspeed——real为泛称“真实”，航空术语固定为True Airspeed，术语不准。

question: 包括在此节的限制因素是经联邦航空局批准的。

options.A: The limitations included in this Section are supported by the Federal Aviation Administration.
options.B: The limitations included in this Section are proved by the Federal Aviation Administration.
options.C: The limitations included in this Section are approved by the Federal Aviation Administration.

explanation: 【译文】The limitations included in this Section are approved by the Federal Aviation Administration.【词汇】限制因素=limitations，本节=this Section，经……批准=approved by，联邦航空局=Federal Aviation Administration（FAA）。【解析】C正确：approved by准确对应“经……批准”——适航限制内容须经局方批准，approved是行政许可的规范用语，the limitations included in this Section对应“包括在此节的限制因素”。A把“批准”错译为supported by（支持），行政许可关系弱化为态度支持，词义错译。B把“批准”错译为proved by（被证明）——prove指证实真伪而非官方核准，许可含义丢失。

question: 若插图有修订，则所修订内容对面左边空白处会有一条黑色竖线。

options.A: There will be a black vertical line on the other side of the left margin where there is a annotation to an illustration.
options.B: When an illustration is revised, there is a black vertical line on the other left side of the revision.
options.C: In the case of a revision to an illustration, a black vertical line will appear in the left margin opposite the revision.

explanation: 【译文】If an illustration is revised, a black vertical line will appear in the left margin opposite the revised portion.【词汇】插图修订=revision to an illustration，黑色竖线=black vertical line（修订标识符），左边空白处=left margin，对面/正对=opposite。【解析】C正确：In the case of a revision to an illustration对应“若插图有修订”，in the left margin opposite the revision准确译出“所修订内容对面左边空白处”——opposite表达与修订处正对的位置关系。A两处错误：把“修订”错译为annotation（注释），且on the other side of the left margin把“对面左边”的空间关系说得含混错位。B的on the other left side of the revision表述不通——“另一个左侧”指代混乱，且未译出“空白处/页边”的位置要素。

question: 原理图必须有足够的尺寸，以便视力正常的人能够看清图例、符号、设备、代码等等。

options.A: The schematic diagram must big enough that normal-sighted people can see the photos, images, fonts, codes, etc.
options.B: The schematic diagram must be of sufficient size that legends, symbols, devices, codes, etc. are readable by persons with normal vision.
options.C: The schematic diagram must be suitable in size that pictures, symbols, devices, codes, etc., are readable by persons with contact lenses.

explanation: 【译文】Schematic diagrams must be of sufficient size so that legends, symbols, devices, codes, etc. are readable by persons with normal vision.【词汇】原理图=schematic diagram，足够的尺寸=sufficient size，图例=legends（图中符号说明），符号=symbols，设备=devices，视力正常的人=persons with normal vision。【解析】B正确：legends准确对应“图例”，legends, symbols, devices, codes四项清单完整，readable by persons with normal vision对应“视力正常的人能够看清”，of sufficient size对应“足够的尺寸”。A两处错误：把“图例、设备”错译为photos, images, fonts（照片、图像、字体），清单对象全错；normal-sighted虽可用但前错已致命。C把“图例”错译为pictures（图片），且把“正常视力的人”错译为persons with contact lenses（戴隐形眼镜的人），人群张冠李戴。

question: 气动整流罩的结构包括翼根整流罩、前后整流锥、雷达罩和下垂的机头等。

options.A: The structure of aerodynamic cowlings includes wings fillets, nose and tail cones, antenna, sunshade visor and droop nose, etc.
options.B: The structure of aerodynamic fairings includes wings fillets, nose and tail cones, radome, visor and droop nose, etc.
options.C: The structure of aerodynamic cowlings includes winglets, nose and tail domes, antenna, sunshade visor and dropping nose, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The structure of aerodynamic fairings includes items such as wing fillets, nose and tail cones, the radome, visor and droop nose, etc.【词汇】气动整流罩=aerodynamic fairings（区别于cowling发动机短舱罩），翼根整流罩=wing fillets，前后整流锥=nose and tail cones，雷达罩=radome，遮板=visor，下垂机头=droop nose。【解析】B正确：aerodynamic fairings准确对应“气动整流罩”，wing fillets, nose and tail cones, radome, visor, droop nose与题干“翼根整流罩、前后整流锥、雷达罩、遮板、下垂机头”逐一对应。A两处错误：把fairings错译为cowlings（cowling专指发动机整流罩），且把“雷达罩”错译为antenna（天线）。C多处错误：把“翼根整流罩”错译为winglets（翼梢小翼），整流锥错译为domes（圆顶），droop nose错译为dropping nose，且cowlings/antenna错误同A。

question: 活塞式发动机包括发动机外部的废气涡轮组件和涡轮增压器组件。

options.A: Reciprocating engines includes power recovery turbine assembly and turbo-supercharger unit when external to the engine.
options.B: Turbine engine is composed of power recovery turbine unit and supercharger unit outside of the engine.
options.C: Reciprocating engines include power recovery turbine assembly and turbo-supercharger unit inside the engine.

explanation: 【译文】Reciprocating engines include the power recovery turbine assembly and the turbo-supercharger unit when these are external to the engine.【词汇】活塞式发动机=reciprocating engines，废气涡轮组件=power recovery turbine assembly（回收废气能量的涡轮），涡轮增压器组件=turbo-supercharger unit，发动机外部=external to the engine。【解析】A正确：power recovery turbine assembly and turbo-supercharger unit准确对应“废气涡轮组件和涡轮增压器组件”——power recovery turbine正是活塞机废气能量回收涡轮的规范名，when external to the engine对应“发动机外部的”。B把“活塞式发动机”错译为Turbine engine（涡轮发动机），发动机类型张冠李戴，且is composed of句式也不如includes对应“包括”。C把“外部”错译为inside the engine（内部），内外方向相反。

question: 远距离安装的附件齿轮箱通过传动轴连接到发动机，驱动多种附件。

options.A: Accessory gearboxes are remotely installed and connected to the engine by a drive shaft and which drive multiple types of accessories.
options.B: The drive shaft connects the engine with accessory gearboxes and it drives lots of accessories.
options.C: Accessory gearboxes are installed near the engine, and connected to a drive shaft, which drive multiple types of accessories.

explanation: 【译文】Accessory gearboxes installed remotely are connected to the engine by a drive shaft and drive various types of accessories.【词汇】远距离安装=remotely installed，附件齿轮箱=accessory gearboxes，传动轴=drive shaft，连接到发动机=connected to the engine，驱动多种附件=drive multiple accessories。【解析】A正确：remotely installed对应“远距离安装的”，connected to the engine by a drive shaft对应“通过传动轴连接到发动机”，drive multiple types of accessories对应“驱动多种附件”，齿轮箱主语地位保留。B两处错误：漏译“远距离安装”这一关键限定，且把主语错置为drive shaft——原文齿轮箱是主语、传动轴只是连接手段，主从关系颠倒。C把“远距离安装”错译为installed near the engine（近发动机安装），方向相反。

question: 齿轮箱部分包括齿轮、轴、密封件、油泵、冷却器等。

options.A: Gearbox section includes items such as gears, shafts, seals, oil pumps, coolers, etc.
options.B: Items like gears, cranks, seals, oil tanks and coolers all belong to gearbox section.
options.C: Gearbox is composed of gears, shafts, seals, gas pumps, coolers, etc.

explanation: 【译文】The gearbox section includes items such as gears, shafts, seals, oil pumps, coolers, etc.【词汇】齿轮箱部分=gearbox section，齿轮=gears，轴=shafts，密封件=seals，油泵=oil pumps，冷却器=coolers。【解析】A正确：gears, shafts, seals, oil pumps, coolers与题干“齿轮、轴、密封件、油泵、冷却器”五项逐一对应，includes items such as对应“包括……等”。B两处错误：把“轴”错译为cranks（曲柄/曲轴——曲轴仅为轴的一种，原文为泛指的轴），且把“油泵”错译为oil tanks（油箱），部件错配。C把“油泵”错译为gas pumps（气泵/燃油泵），泵的工作介质对象错误——oil≠gas。

question: 控制部分控制螺旋桨的桨距，但不包括任何与螺旋桨组件一起旋转的部件。

options.A: The control section controls the pitch of the propeller blades, but does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly.
options.B: The control section controls the distance of the propeller blades, but does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly.
options.C: The control section controls the space between the propeller blades, but does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly.

explanation: 【译文】The control section controls the pitch of the propeller blades, but does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly.【词汇】控制部分=control section，桨距=pitch（桨叶迎角），桨叶=propeller blades，随螺旋桨组件旋转=rotate with the propeller assembly。【解析】A正确：controls the pitch of the propeller blades准确对应“控制螺旋桨的桨距”——pitch为桨叶角规范术语，does not include any parts which rotate with the propeller assembly对应排除范围“不包括随组件旋转的部件”。B把“桨距”错译为the distance of the propeller blades（桨叶距离），pitch误作空间距离，词义错译。C把“桨距”错译为the space between the propeller blades（桨叶间距），同样把角度参数误作线性间隔，词义错译。

question: 本节包括附件部分整流罩、整流罩盖板、整流罩撑杆以及连接和锁定机构等的功能和维护信息。

options.A: This section includes the functioning and operation aspects of accessory section cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and attach and locking systems, etc.
options.B: This section includes the functioning and maintenance guidelines for additional cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and connecting and locking mechanisms, etc.
options.C: This section includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of accessory section cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and attach and locking mechanisms, etc.

explanation: 【译文】This section includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of accessory section cowls, cowl flaps, cowling supports, and attach and locking mechanisms, etc.【词汇】功能和维护信息=functioning and maintenance aspects，附件部分整流罩=accessory section cowls，整流罩盖板=cowl flaps，整流罩撑杆=cowling supports，连接和锁定机构=attach and locking mechanisms。【解析】C正确：functioning and maintenance aspects准确对应“功能和维护信息”，accessory section cowls对应“附件部分整流罩”，attach and locking mechanisms对应“连接和锁定机构”，四项清单完整。A把“维护信息”错译为operation aspects（运行方面），maintenance要素漏译。B两处错误：把“附件部分”错译为additional cowls（附加整流罩），且maintenance guidelines（维护指南）不如aspects对应“信息/方面”贴切。

question: 螺旋桨指完整的机械或电动螺旋桨、泵、马达、交流发电机，以及用于控制桨叶角的发动机部件。

options.A: Propeller refers to the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, alternators, and those engine components used to control the propeller blades pitch.
options.B: Propeller refers to the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, generators, and those engine components used to control the propeller blade angel.
options.C: Propeller refers to the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, alternators, and those engine components used to control the propeller blade angel.

explanation: 【译文】“Propeller” refers to the complete mechanical or electrical propeller, pumps, motors, alternators, and those engine components used to control the propeller blade pitch.【词汇】电动螺旋桨=electrical propeller，马达=motors，交流发电机=alternators（区别于generators发电机泛称），控制桨叶角=control the propeller blade pitch/angle（angle勿拼成angel天使）。【解析】A正确：alternators准确对应“交流发电机”——alternator专指交流发电机，complete mechanical or electrical propeller、pumps、motors及control the propeller blades pitch均对应。B两处错误：把“交流发电机”错译为generators（发电机泛称，可含直流机），且blade angel把angle（角）拼成angel（天使），词形错误。C虽alternators正确，但blade angel同样拼写错误，术语不可用。

question: 发动机排放装置用于排放发动机及附件里的多余流体。

options.A: Engine drains are used to drain off excess fluids from the power plant and its accessories.
options.B: Engine exhaust is used to remove excessive fluids out of the power plant and its accessories.
options.C: Engine channel is used to drain excess fluids out of the power plant and its accessories.

explanation: 【译文】Engine drains are used to drain off excess fluids from the power plant and its accessories.【词汇】排放装置=drains（放泄装置），排放多余流体=drain off excess fluids，动力装置=power plant，附件=accessories。【解析】A正确：Engine drains对应“发动机排放装置”（drain=放泄口/装置），drain off excess fluids准确译出“排放多余流体”，power plant and its accessories对应“发动机（动力装置）及附件”。B把“排放装置”错译为Engine exhaust（发动机排气）——exhaust指废气排放，与液体放泄混淆，词义错译。C把“排放装置”错译为Engine channel（发动机通道），部件名称完全不符，张冠李戴。

question: 如适用，本章可以参考随飞机提供的厂商数据来代替某些章节。

options.A: This chapter may refer to supplier data, furnished with the aircraft, in lieu of some sections, as available.
options.B: This chapter may refer to supplier data, furnished with the aircraft, to replace some sections, as applicable.
options.C: This chapter may refer to supplier data, furnished with the aircraft, in lieu of some sections, as applicable.

explanation: 【译文】Where applicable, this chapter may refer to the supplier data furnished with the aircraft in lieu of certain sections.【词汇】如适用=as applicable，厂商数据=supplier data，随飞机提供=furnished with the aircraft，代替=in lieu of，某些章节=some sections。【解析】C正确：in lieu of some sections用规范术语译出“代替某些章节”——in lieu of是手册/法律文体“代替”的标准用语，as applicable准确对应“如适用”，supplier data furnished with the aircraft对应“随飞机提供的厂商数据”。A把“如适用”错译为as available（如有、可用时）——applicable指条件适用性而非可获得性，词义错译。B把“代替”译作to replace虽语义正确，但in lieu of为手册规范表达，且replace作目的状语结构松散，语体上逊于C。
